m: Amendement van het lid Peters c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over een beperkte tweedegraadse bevoegdheid voor het vbo
Amends the teaching-qualification article so that the limited second-degree authority also covers vbo (pre-vocational secondary education) subjects.
This amendment therefore proposes that the limited second-degree authority applies to a subject matching the training on vbo
Met dit amendement wordt daarom voorgesteld dat de beperkte tweedegraadse bevoegdheid geldt voor een met de opleiding inhoudelijk overeenkomend vak op het vbo
Motie van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over laagdrempelige instroomroutes tot vakleerkracht muziek of muziekspecialist (36132, nr. 10)
Asks the government to investigate low-threshold entry routes to become a music specialist teacher in primary education and inform the House.
requests the government to investigate which low-threshold entry routes to music teacher or music specialist in primary education could be offered
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken welke laagdrempelige instroomroutes tot vakleerkracht muziek of muziekspecialist in het basisonderwijs aangeboden kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Peters c.s. over voldoende aandacht voor het mbo in de lerarenopleiding (36132, nr. 11)
Motion asks the government to investigate whether vocational (mbo) education receives sufficient attention in teacher training.
requests the government to investigate whether there is sufficient attention for mbo in teacher training
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken of er voldoende aandacht is voor het mbo in de lerarenopleiding
Motie van het lid Peters c.s. over meer aandacht voor het vmbo in de eerstegraads lerarenopleidingen en in de educatieve minor en module (36132, nr. 12)
Asks the government to examine how first-degree teacher training, the educational minor and module can give more attention to teaching in vmbo schools.
requests the government to examine how the first-degree teacher training programmes, educational minor and module can pay more attention to teaching in vmbo
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe de eerstegraadslerarenopleidingen, educatieve minor en educatieve module meer aandacht kunnen besteden aan lesgeven in het vmbo
Motie van het lid Paul c.s. over een pilot met een vierjarige voltijdpabopraktijkopleiding
Asks the government to investigate whether a pilot with a four-year full-time pabo practical training programme can start next school year and to inform the House before summer recess.
requests the government to investigate whether a pilot with a four-year full-time pabo practical training programme can be realised
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of een pilot met een vierjarige voltijdpabopraktijkopleiding kan worden gerealiseerd
Motie van de leden Peters en Paul over het team van leraren als een noodzakelijke voorwaarde voor onderwijsverbetering benoemen in de onderzoekskaders van de inspectie

Asks the government to name the teacher team as a precondition for school improvement in the Inspectorate's assessment frameworks and to inform the House on how inspection will oversee team improvement plans.
requests the government to name the team of teachers as a necessary condition for educational improvement in the Inspectorate's research frameworks
verzoekt de regering om het team van leraren als noodzakelijke voorwaarde voor onderwijsverbetering te benoemen in de onderzoekskaders van de inspectie
Motie van de leden El Yassini en Paul over kaders voor het begeleiden van nieuwe leraren en afspraken over het behouden van zijinstromers en nieuwe leraren
Asks the government to set frameworks for mentoring new teachers and agreements with social partners on retaining career changers and new teachers.
requests the government to develop frameworks for mentoring new teachers
verzoekt de regering om te komen tot kaders ten aanzien van het begeleiden van nieuwe leraren
Amendement van de leden Paul en Van Meenen ter vervanging van nr. 53 over middelen voor begaafde leerlingen
Shifts 9.5 million euro in the education budget from secondary to primary education to fund full-time provision for gifted pupils.
In article 01 Primary education the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 9,500 thousand euro
In artikel 01 Primair onderwijs worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 9.500 (x € 1.000).
Motie van de leden Van Meenen en Paul over sociale partners oproepen om meer belonen van meer uren werk te betrekken in de cao-onderhandelingen
Asks the government to urge social partners to include rewarding more working hours in upcoming teacher collective agreement negotiations.
requests the government to call on social partners to include rewarding more hours of work in the coming collective bargaining
verzoekt de regering om sociale partners op te roepen om meer belonen van meer uren werk te betrekken
Motie van de leden Van Meenen en Paul over verkennen hoe een revolverend fonds en een programmatische aanpak kunnen bijdragen aan de problematiek rond onderwijshuisvesting
Asks the government to explore whether a revolving fund and programmatic approach could help school housing renovation and construction, and to report to the House in spring 2023.

requests the government, together with BZK, EZK and private investors such as pension funds, to explore whether and how a revolving fund and a programmatic approach can contribute to school housing problems

verzoekt de regering in samenwerking met BZK, EZK en particuliere investeerders zoals pensioenfondsen te verkennen of en hoe een revolverend fonds en een programmatische aanpak kunnen bijdragen aan de problematiek rond onderwijshuisvesting
Motie van het lid Segers c.s. over het ondersteunen van scholen in het vormgeven van inspraak van leerlingen via de medezeggenschapsraden
Asks the government to support schools in giving pupils a voice through works councils and pupil councils.
schools are not obliged to facilitate or encourage a pupil council
scholen niet verplicht zijn een leerlingenraad te faciliteren of te stimuleren
Amendement van de leden Paul en Van Meenen over middelen voor begaafde leerlingen
Shifts 9.5 million euros one-off from secondary to primary education funding to keep full-time programmes for gifted pupils running.
This amendment provides for maintaining the current full-time giftedness facilities by adding 9.5 million euros on a one-off basis
Dit amendement voorziet in de instandhouding van de huidige voltijd hoogbegaafdheidsvoorzieningen door € 9,5 miljoen incidenteel toe te voegen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Meenen en Paul ter vervanging van nr. 18 over maatschappelijk verantwoordelijkheidsbesef in het funderend onderwijs en het mbo

Adds a duty on schools to promote civic responsibility and refrain from discrimination, and creates advisory committees that advise the minister on whether to intervene against school boards that fail this duty.
There is an advisory committee whose task is to advise the Minister at his request
Er is een commissie van advies die tot taak heeft om Onze Minister op diens verzoek advies te geven
Motie van de leden De Hoop en Paul over het periodiek in beeld brengen van democratische attituden om de effecten van burgerschapsonderwijs te kunnen monitoren
Asks the government to periodically measure young people's democratic attitudes to monitor the effects of citizenship education.
requests the government to periodically map these democratic attitudes in order to monitor the effects of citizenship education
verzoekt de regering deze democratische attituden periodiek in beeld te brengen om de effecten van burgerschapsonderwijs te kunnen monitoren
Amendement van de leden Van Meenen en Paul over maatschappelijk verantwoordelijkheidsbesef in het funderend onderwijs en het mbo
Adds a duty on schools to promote civic responsibility and creates an advisory commission that the minister must consult before acting against a school's governing body for failing that duty.
The Minister takes no decision as referred to in the first paragraph until he has requested advice from the advisory commission.
Onze Minister neemt geen besluit als bedoeld in het eerste lid dan nadat hij advies heeft gevraagd aan de commissie van advies.
Motie van de leden Paul en Van Meenen over ongewenste praktijken en effecten rond de oprichting van nieuwe scholen onderzoeken en aanpakken
Motion asking the government to investigate and tackle improper practices in founding new schools, talk with the VNG about municipalities' role, and report annually on use of the law.
requests the government to report annually on the use of the law
verzoekt de regering jaarlijks te rapporteren over het gebruik van de wet
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over voorlichting vragen aan de Raad van State over de wijze waarop de Kamer beschikking kan hebben over het Raad van State-advies bij de voorhang van de AMvB
Asks the Raad van State for advice on how the House can access the Council's advice on draft general administrative orders (AMvB) during their pre-submission consultation.
decides to ask the Raad van State for guidance on how the House can have access to the Raad van State advice on the pre-submission of the AMvB
besluit om voorlichting aan de Raad van State te vragen op welke wijze de Kamer beschikking kan hebben over het Raad van State-advies bij de voorhang van de AMvB
Amendement van het lid Paul c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 32 over middelen voor het in het onderwijs bespreekbaar maken van gevoelige maatschappelijke thema's
Shifts 500,000 euro from a subsidy budget to support teachers in discussing sensitive social themes such as racism and discrimination.
EUR 500,000 is made available for the coming year
wordt EUR 500.000 voor het komende jaar vrijgemaakt
Amendement van het lid Paul c.s. over middelen voor het in het onderwijs bespreekbaar maken van gevoelige maatschappelijke thema's
Shifts 500 thousand euro from the labour market budget to support teachers in discussing sensitive social themes in education.
EUR 500,000 is made available for the coming year
wordt EUR 500.000 voor het komende jaar vrijgemaakt
Motie van het lid Segers c.s. over handreikingen om de betrokkenheid van minder mondige ouders te versterken
Asks the government, with parent associations, to develop guidance helping less articulate parents engage in school advice procedures.
Requests the government, together with representatives of parent associations, to develop guidance.
verzoekt de regering, om samen met vertegenwoordigers van ouderverenigingen en -stichtingen handreikingen te ontwikkelen
Motie van het lid Kwint c.s. over schooladvisering een vast onderdeel laten zijn van de pabo-opleiding
Asks the government, with teacher training colleges, to make school advice a compulsory part of primary teacher training from 2022-2023.
requests the government, in cooperation with the teacher training colleges, to make school advice a fixed part of the training
verzoekt de regering, in samenwerking met de pabo's schooladvisering een vast onderdeel te laten zijn van de opleiding
Motie van de leden Peters en Paul over terugkoppeling van middelbare scholen aan basisscholen over de schooladviezen
Motion asks the government with schools to monitor secondary schools' feedback to primary schools on school advice and analyse it to improve predictive value, reporting before the budget debate.
requests the government, together with schools in primary and secondary education and other education organisations, to set up a monitoring
verzoekt de regering, om samen met de scholen in het funderend onderwijs en andere onderwijsorganisaties te komen tot een monitoring
Amendement van het lid Paul over het schooladvies bij een hogere eindtoetsscore in beginsel steeds naar boven bijstellen
Amendment requires schools to raise the school advice upward when the final test shows higher ability, with the school able to deviate only with reasons in the pupil's interest.
This amendment provides that where the final test score is higher, the school advice is in principle always adjusted upward.
Dit amendement regelt dat bij een hogere eindtoetsscore het schooladvies in beginsel steeds naar boven wordt bijgesteld.
Motie van de leden Peters en Paul over de uitwerking van het Actieplan Lerarentekort
Asks the government to develop plans for schools operating with fewer teachers using innovative ICT applications, and inform the House before the budget debate.
requests the government, when elaborating the Teacher Shortage Action Plan, to come up with plans for organising education with fewer teachers
verzoekt de regering, om bij de uitwerking van het Actieplan Lerarentekort in samenspraak met het onderwijsveld eveneens te komen met plannen
Motie van de leden Paul en Peters over best practices in het kader van monitoring binnen het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs
Asks the government to examine which monitoring best practices in the National Education Programme could become permanent, without extra bureaucracy for teachers, and to inform the House.
asks the government to examine which so-called best practices for monitoring within the National Education Programme could become permanent
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken welke van de zogenaamde best practices als het gaat om de monitoring binnen het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs
Motie van de leden Peters en Paul over bij de evaluatie van de initiatiefwet-Kwint/Westerveld de effecten op de ouderbijdragen meenemen
Asks the government to pay separate attention to effects on parental contributions at profile schools when evaluating the Kwint/Westerveld initiative bill.
requests the government, when evaluating the Kwint/Westerveld initiative bill, to pay separate attention to the effects on parental contributions
verzoekt de regering, om bij de evaluatie van het initiatiefwetsvoorstel-Kwint/Westerveld apart aandacht te besteden aan de effecten op de ouderbijdragen
Motie van de leden Peters en Paul over meetbare doelen voor de inzet van de middelen van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs
Asks the government to set measurable goals and accountability for the NPO education funds, with monitoring and questioning of schools on results.
requests the government, in consultation with the education sector, to set clear measurable goals for the use of NPO funds
verzoekt de regering, om in samenspraak met het onderwijsveld op korte termijn te komen tot heldere meetbare doelen voor de inzet van de middelen van het NPO
Motie van de leden Paul en Peters over een Rekenkameronderzoek naar de resultaten van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs
Asks the government to request the Algemene Rekenkamer to examine the results and efficient spending of the Nationaal Programma Onderwijs and report to the House after it ends.
requests the government to submit a request to the Court of Audit to investigate the results achieved by the National Education Programme
verzoekt de regering, om een adviesaanvraag in te dienen bij de Algemene Rekenkamer om onderzoek te doen naar de behaalde resultaten
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kouwenhoven en Saris over het bericht 'Terugbetaling toeslagen leidt steeds vaker tot problemen bij burgers'

MPs Kouwenhoven and Saris asked the Dutch government about reports that repayment of childcare and other benefits is causing growing problems for citizens, including the scale of repayments and debts, the complexity of the system and its social and economic costs. The state secretary answered that the system is not bankrupt but needs fundamental reform, pointed to recent simplification measures and planned bills, and acknowledged that repayments cannot always be avoided under the current design.
To prevent that, it is necessary to fundamentally revise the system of allowances.
Om dat te voorkomen is het nodig om het stelsel van toeslagen fundamenteel te herzien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Saris over de berichten ‘Meer buitenlanders kopen woning in Nederland, verdubbeling in vijf jaar’ en ‘Steeds meer woningen verkocht aan expats, ‘terwijl zoveel Nederlanders juis

MPs Welzijn and Saris asked the government about reports that expats and international buyers are increasingly purchasing homes, and about calls to end the 30% tax ruling, restrict expat admission and require municipal consent in scarcity areas. The minister answered that international buyers account for about 1.6% of purchases, with local price effects, that existing municipal tools suffice, that the 30% ruling is kept for business continuity, and that the government will address the shortage by building more homes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het bericht 'Als trans persoon gevlucht voor Trumps beleid, maar is dat genoeg voor asiel? ‘Het is niet veilig voor haar’'

An MP from Volt asks the Asylum and Migration Minister and colleagues whether transgender US asylum claims can succeed given the Trump administration's policies, whether the 2024 US country report should be revised, and whether transgender people should be designated a risk group. The government answers that US developments do not currently justify presuming a well-founded fear of persecution for transgender Americans, that each claim is judged individually on recent sources, that no general country report is planned, and that discretionary residence permits will be reviewed after a Council of State ruling.
By letter of 27 August I informed your House about the ruling of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.
Bij brief van 27 augustus jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Piri over asielaanvragen van lhbtqia+-personen uit de Verenigde Staten

MPs Westerveld and Piri asked whether asylum applications from LGBTQIA+ people from the United States have risen, whether the government will engage the US on this, whether US safety for LGBTQIA+ people is reassessed, and whether enough dedicated reception places exist. The Minister said such motives are not registered, applications rose modestly to 35 by July 2025, US safety does not in general justify asylum, and COA places LGBTQIA+ residents together in units when requested but has no fixed quota.
Asylum motives, such as sexual orientation or gender, are not systematically registered and therefore cannot be reproduced at an aggregated level.
Asielmotieven, zoals seksuele geaardheid of gender, worden niet systematisch geregistreerd en zijn dus niet op geaggregeerd niveau te reproduceren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over de berichten 'Joodse studenten voelen zich onveilig en buitengesloten op UvA en VU: "De universiteit adviseerde me niet meer te komen"' en 'Antisemitisme drijft leerli

Christian Union MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the education minister how the government responds to reports that Jewish students feel unsafe at Dutch universities and that antisemitism drives pupils to Jewish schools, and what measures exist. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures (Strategy Against Antisemitism, guidance, planned security duty, monitoring plans) and said further steps would be considered after a task force reports in early 2026, while declining to register religion or monitor the handbook's use.
Institutions do not register religion for privacy reasons.
Instellingen registreren religie wegens privacy redenen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Haage over de achterstanden van kinderen van Europese arbeidsmigranten en de financiering van scholen

MPs Patijn and Haage ask the government about funding shortfalls for schools with many children of Eastern European labour migrants, whose weighting under the disadvantage-funding model is seen as inadequate, and about reviewing the model. The State Secretary says the CBS is recalibrating the disadvantage indicator, expected to be in use in 2027, and that the funding model is not the solution for family instability caused by economic hardship.
It illustrates the need to periodically recalibrate the indicator used for educational disadvantage.
Het illustreert de noodzaak om de gebruikte indicator voor onderwijsachterstanden periodiek te herijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Burg over ‘anti-emancipatoire beïnvloeding’

MPs Becker and Van der Burg asked about foreign lobby and funding aimed at influencing Dutch public and political debate on anti-emancipatory themes, including US, Russian and Islamic-linked funding, and what the government will do. The government answered that lobbying is legitimate but that incitement and discrimination are not, pointed to the Nationale Extremismestrategie, said it has no legal basis to map funding flows from most countries, noted the pending Wtmo law as a possible tool, and said it is willing to raise the issue in the EU.
The ministries have no legal basis for processing personal data in addressing problematic conduct and unwanted foreign financing.
De ministeries hebben geen juridische grondslag voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens in het kader van de aanpak van problematisch gedrag en ongewenste buitenlandse financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Leerlingen pesten elkaar met nepnaaktbeelden, middelbare scholen willen verbod op uitkleedapps'

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked about reports that pupils circulate AI-generated fake nude images of classmates and schools want a ban on nudify apps. The government says bullying is unacceptable, points to existing criminal law, school safety duties, support for School & Veiligheid and Helpwanted, and rejects a general ban as easily circumvented, while promising a cabinet response to the 'Online seksueel geweld' report after the summer.
A more general ban on offering the nudify apps does not, however, seem appropriate at this time.
Een algemener verbod op het aanbieden van de uitkleedapps ligt op dit moment echter niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Rooderkerk over onverwachte bezuinigingen van een half miljard euro extra op onderwijs in de Voorjaarsnota.

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister why nearly half a billion euros in extra cuts to education were introduced in the spring budget memorandum, given pressure on basic skills, and asked about the effects on pupils losing the education opportunities scheme, higher education funding, vocational practical training, and consistency with earlier parliamentary deals. The minister answered that the net budget rises structurally by about 2 billion euros, that the cuts are offsets within the OCW budget, that the education opportunities scheme is abolished (about 177 million per year) with the government pointing to other basic-skills programmes, and that institutions can absorb the higher education and practical-training reductions.
With this spring budget memorandum, the OCW budget is structurally increased by a net of about 2 billion euros, largely as a result of the fully paid-out wage adjustment.
Met deze Voorjaarsnota wordt er per saldo structureel circa € 2 miljard toegevoegd aan de OCW-begroting, grotendeels als gevolg van de loonbijstelling die volledig wordt uitgekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mutluer over buitenlandse beïnvloeding op het emancipatiebeleid

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Education, Culture and Science and the Minister of Justice and Security about foreign influence by extreme conservative lobby groups on emancipation policy, including disinformation, funding flows, and threats to LGBTQ+ and migrant rights. The government answered that lobbying is lawful but that incitement and intimidation fall outside democratic limits, pointed to the pending Wtmo and an anti-SLAPP directive, and said it lacks a legal basis for the requested investigations into funding.
The ministries do not have a legal basis to carry out these kinds of investigations.
De ministeries beschikken niet over een juridische grondslag om dit soort onderzoeken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het initiatief in Hardenberg waarbij asielzoekers een MDT-certificaat kunnen behalen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Hardenberg project in which asylum seekers could earn an MDT certificate, and whether the Labour Inspectorate's investigation and existing rules are proportionate. The minister explained the volunteer-work exemption and UWV procedures, said the inspection investigation is ongoing and it will not comment on it, and declined to contact the municipality directly.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make statements about ongoing investigations.
De Arbeidsinspectie doet geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Terwijl Hongaarse parlement Pride verbiedt, radicaliseert Orbán: zijn critici betitelt hij als ‘bedwantsen’’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about Hungary's 2025 anti-LGBTIQ+ legislation banning Pride and restricting assembly, its compatibility with EU fundamental rights, the suspension of EU cohesion funds, and possible Article 7 steps. The minister replied that the Commission must first assess legal compatibility, that the Netherlands has voiced concern bilaterally and in Council of Europe and EU fora, and that the Article 7 majorities are not currently in sight.
The Netherlands calls on the Commission to do this expeditiously and to take action if it finds that EU law has been infringed.
Nederland roept de Commissie op om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over één- of tweevakkigheid van de tweedegraads lerarenopleidingen

An MP asked the minister about the history of two-subject teacher training in the Netherlands, comparison with other European countries, and whether dual qualifications for shortage subjects like German should be supported, including in a plan to address teacher shortages. The minister explained that two-subject training was abolished in 1989 for quality reasons, that dual qualifications remain possible at institutions' discretion, and that a Herstelplan Kwaliteit Onderwijs focuses on staffing quality.
The current two-qualification system offers possibilities for training towards a dual qualification.
Het huidige tweebevoegdhedenstelsel biedt mogelijkheden voor het opleiden tot een dubbele bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over de zorgwekkende staat van het funderend onderwijs op Curaçao

MP White asked the minister how the Curaçao education inspectorate's alarming report on primary education should be explained, whether the situation was discussed at the 2024 M4LO meeting, what the Caribbean countries and the Netherlands can do, and how the BES islands are included. The minister replies that education is a matter for the autonomous Caribbean countries, that the issue was not specifically tabled at M4LO 2024, that cooperation runs through voluntary programmes such as Kibrahacha and SEA, and that Caribbean Netherlands is represented by the Netherlands with separate island education agendas.
For this reason it is not for the Ministry of OCW to make statements about reports on education in Curaçao prepared by the Curaçao Education Inspectorate or one of the other countries.

Het is hierdoor niet aan het Ministerie van OCW om uitspraken te doen over rapporten over het onderwijs in Curaçao die zijn opgesteld door de Inspectie van het Onderwijs van Curaçao of één van de andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de dreiging van vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

MP Dobbe (SP) asked about the scale and threat of female genital mutilation (FGM) in the Netherlands, prevention measures, UK-style protection orders, prosecution, and reimbursement of reconstructive surgery. The government answers that a new prevalence study is underway, lists current prevention measures, says additional measures are being explored, notes one prosecution but no convictions, and promises a study extending exemption from the own risk for reconstructive surgery.
The cabinet intends to take additional (preventive) measures aimed at female genital mutilation.
Het kabinet is voornemens aanvullende (preventieve) maatregelen te nemen gericht op vrouwelijke genitale verminking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Zanten en Stoffer over het bericht van De Nieuwe Ster ’Hakenkruizen en antisemitisme op UWC’

MPs Van Zanten and Stoffer asked about reports of swastikas, antisemitic remarks by a guest speaker, and a student email at UWC Maastricht, and whether the school and the Inspectorate are protecting pupils. The State Secretary answered that the school has registered incidents, tightened its guest-speaker and email protocols and safety policy, and that the Inspectorate sees no reason for further steps while staying alert, offering support via a school-safety foundation.
The inspectorate is of the view that the board and the school are taking the situation very seriously.
De inspectie is van oordeel dat het bestuur en de school de situatie zeer serieus oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over onderwijs in justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the government about education in youth detention institutions (JJI's), citing Education Council and Inspectorate reports on lack of guaranteed schooling, staffing shortages, examination barriers and detained youths in adult prisons. The government acknowledges the concerns, lists funding increases and a mbo-coordinator, and promises further reactions and letters before the summer recess, though it refers many structural questions to later responses.
That there are ongoing concerns about education in the JJIs we take extremely seriously.
Dat er aanhoudende zorgen zijn over het onderwijs in de JJI's nemen wij uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Dringend meer geld nodig voor schoolgebouwen'

MPs Sneller and Rooderkerk asked the government whether school building funding is adequate, citing an IBO finding of at least 730 million euros a year shortfall, and how school housing fits the Herstelplan and the planned school housing bill. The State Secretary acknowledged the IBO figure and the need for faster renewal but said no additional funds are available, and argued the housing bill sets no new building standards and that gemeenten will be compensated via the gemeentefonds.
The honest story is that this cabinet has had to make hard choices; there are no additional funds.
Het eerlijke verhaal is dat dit kabinet scherpe keuzes heeft moeten maken; er zijn geen aanvullende middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over passend onderwijs aan kinderen met Long COVID en andere infectieziekten

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Health about schooling for children with Long COVID and other infections causing severe energy limitation, including lack of understanding, inadequate support, school ventilation and remote learning. The government answered that data on affected children are limited, it is investing in research, information and tailored education options, and is preparing legislation to expand flexible and digital schooling.
My goal is for digital distance learning to become a full part of the passend onderwijs system.
Mijn doel is dat digitaal afstandsonderwijs een volwaardig onderdeel wordt van het stelsel van passend onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Krul en Stoffer over het onderzoek ‘De herstelopdracht doorgelicht: Een verkenning naar de rechtmatigheid van herstelopdrachten in het funderend onderwijs’

MPs Ceder, Krul and Stoffer asked the Minister of Education about Professor Van Schoonhoven's study questioning whether Inspectorate remediation orders (herstelopdrachten) rest on legal grounds, and how the Inspectorate avoids overreach, distinguishes its supervisory from its stimulating role, justifies orders, and informs school boards of their rights. The Minister replies that the Inspectorate found its orders lawful, tied to statutory adequacy standards, will refine justification and frameworks, and will not withdraw any orders, while describing existing safeguards such as complaint procedures and board responses.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer en Krul over het schrappen van de subsidie op het godsdienstig onderwijs of levensbeschouwelijk vormingsonderwijs

MPs Ceder, Stoffer and Krul asked why the government plans to end the subsidy for religious and life-stance formation education and whether this conflicts with the statutory basis and with pupils' access to such education. The State Secretary answered that about 50,000 pupils receive it, that the subsidy ends from 2027 via a legislative proposal, and that schools' civic and worldview curriculum will cover the needs, but did not expect equal access and gave only partial answers on consultation with parents.
For the termination of the subsidy, a proposal for a legislative amendment will be made.
Voor de beëindiging van de subsidie wordt een voorstel tot wetswijziging gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Sneller over marktconcentratie op de schoolboeken- en schoolboekendistributiemarkt

MPs Rooderkerk and Sneller asked about market concentration in the school textbook and distribution market, including market shares, ownership, vendor lock-in, costs and waste of workbooks. The State Secretary gave estimates of concentration (about 77% for the three largest VO publishers, about 80% for the four largest PO publishers, two main distributors per sector), said ACM oversight and a study with EZ are underway, and pointed to SIVON, Edu-V and open learning materials, while declining to give exact market-share data.
The Ministry of OCW does not have specific market shares for individual publishers.
Het Ministerie van OCW beschikt niet over specifieke marktaandelen van afzonderlijke uitgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en De Hoop over de hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Bushoff and De Hoop asked about high hospital parking fees, public transport access for low-income patients, parking outsourcing, and the Rover report on hospital accessibility. Minister Agema answered that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, pointed to existing transport and tax schemes, and committed only to forwarding the Rover report to sector bodies.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Velde en Heutink over ‘de onacceptabele uitsluiting van PVV-bewindspersonen door UN Women bij de aftrap van een campagne tegen geweld tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Enschede.’

PVV MPs asked whether UN Women excluded PVV state secretaries from a campaign launch against violence against women in Enschede because of their party affiliation, and whether this is acceptable. The government condemned unequal treatment on political grounds, said UN Women Nederland is an independent Dutch foundation rather than a UN body, and noted the Enschede municipality has withdrawn from the event.
If ministers are excluded because of their political affiliation, that is completely unacceptable.
Indien bewindslieden omwille van hun politieke affiliatie worden uitgesloten is dat volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Tseggai over ‘Opnieuw meer jongeren van middelbare school of mbo af zonder diploma’

MPs Pijpelink and Tseggai asked the Minister of Education about a report that early school leaving without diploma rose again, including causes such as mental health and the need for income, and what the government will do to reduce it. The Minister acknowledges the rise, states the government keeps the action plan and 18,000 target for 2026 (calling it ambitious), points to planned legislation on support toward sustainable work, mental health measures, and an ongoing study into a statutory minimum internship allowance.
The cabinet adheres to the early school leaving action plan and the target agreed in the Werkagenda mbo of 18,000 new early school leavers in 2026.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan het actieplan vsv en de in de Werkagenda mbo afgesproken doelstelling van 18.000 nieuwe voortijdig schoolverlaters in 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paternotte over de niet ingevulde bezuiniging op het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs en het mbo

D66 MPs Rooderkerk and Paternotte asked why the education subsidy cut (subsidietaakstelling) was booked on primary, secondary and vocational education budgets without concrete measures, which initiatives are affected, and why the cut was not allocated in detail. Minister Bruins explained the provisional booking was a deliberate technical choice, confirmed that several named organisations and internship funding are not cut in substance, but declined to give some details, deferring them to a forthcoming letter and amendment note.
The fact that subsidy budgets in the draft budget were reduced by such large amounts, ahead of an amendment note with the structural allocation of the cut, raises many questions.

Het feit dat subsidiebudgetten in de Ontwerpbegroting met dergelijke grote bedragen zijn verlaagd, vooruitlopend op een nota van wijziging met structurele invulling van de taakstelling, roept veel vragen op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MPs Rooderkerk and Van der Werf asked whether misogyny should be treated as ideological extremism after a UK announcement, whether there are links to far-right ideology and violence against women, and whether security services monitor it. The government answered that misogyny is not classed as an extremist ideology by itself but appears in extremist narratives, that the NCTV will consult the UK, and that the AIVD cannot publicly detail how it investigates threats.
As stated in the answer to question 9, the AIVD cannot, under the Wiv 2017, publicly disclose how it investigates threats to national security.

Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 9 kan de AIVD, op basis van de Wiv 2017, geen uitspraken in het openbaar doen op welke wijze onderzoek wordt gedaan naar dreigingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MP Becker asked the government about the UK's plan to treat misogyny as ideological extremism, and whether the Netherlands should follow with a stronger approach to misogyny, incels and manosphere influencers. The government answers that misogyny is a serious problem covered by existing plans and laws, that it is not classed as an extremist ideology but appears in extremist narratives, and that it will consult the UK and include misogyny in the forthcoming Emancipation Note.
The cabinet therefore does not regard misogyny as an extremist ideology, but it does appear as part of the narrative within various extremist and terrorist ideologies.

Vrouwenhaat wordt door het kabinet daarom niet gezien als een extremistische ideologie, maar komt wel terug als onderdeel in het narratief bij verschillende extremistische en terroristische ideologieën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kostić over een brand op een balkon waar een lhbti+ vlag hing

MPs Mutluer and Kostić asked the Justice and Education ministers about an arson fire in Breda that possibly targeted a rainbow flag, the aftercare for the victim, rising anti-LGBTI discrimination, the regenbooggemeenten programme, the timing of a new action plan, and the implementation of motions on police and intersectional discrimination. The minister condemned the incident while noting the investigation is ongoing, listed support measures, school programmes and planned research, and committed to a follow-up approach and action plan by spring 2025 while declining to comment on the victim's case for privacy reasons.
Because of the privacy and safety of the victim, I will not make further statements about this specific case.
Vanwege de privacy en de veiligheid van het slachtoffer doe ik geen verdere uitspraken over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de herkansingsperiode voor leerlingen in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked why vso pupils whose resits run into early September cannot enroll in higher education on time and what arrangements exist for them. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said institutions decide their own enrolment rules, and committed to arranging resits before 1 September for the affected group and to better communication.
For 2025 onwards I instruct the examination system to make it possible for the specific group of pupils who want to move on to hbo and wo to take their resits before 1 September

Voor 2025 en verder geef ik de examenketen de opdracht om het mogelijk te maken voor de specifieke groep leerlingen die willen doorstromen naar het hbo en wo hun herkansingen af te leggen vóór 1 september
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het item in Nieuwsuur "Hoe schoolbestuurders zakendoen met bekenden en zichzelf"

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Education about a Nieuwsuur report on school board members doing business with acquaintances and themselves, including the growth of education consultancy firms financed from public funds, the lack of transparency on spending, and whether intern toezicht and the Inspectorate should get more powers. The State Secretary acknowledged that conflicts of interest are unacceptable, pointed to existing rules and the Inspectorate's role, said spending is not separately reported, and announced a bill with stricter integrity requirements and expanded Inspectorate oversight, with an internet consultation planned for end of December.

With this bill I intend, among other things, to give a further and non-voluntary impulse to the professionalisation of education boards, and more direction will be given to internal supervision about what is expected.

Met dit wetsvoorstel wil ik onder meer de professionalisering van onderwijsbesturen een nadere en niet-vrijblijvende impuls geven en wordt er meer richting gegeven aan het intern toezicht over wat er wordt verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Bulgaria's new anti-LGBTQ law is official. Opponents beg EU to take action.’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether a Bulgarian law banning 'propaganda' of non-traditional sexual orientation and gender identities in and around schools breaches EU non-discrimination principles, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government answered that the European Commission is primarily responsible for assessing compliance with EU law, that the Netherlands will raise concerns bilaterally and at EU level, has already voiced concerns publicly, and funds LGBTQ+ organisations including in Bulgaria.
The Netherlands will, together with like-minded member states, raise concerns about the amendment bilaterally and at EU level.
Nederland zal, in samenwerking met gelijkgezinde lidstaten, zorgen over de wetswijziging bilateraal en in EU-verband aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Opnieuw irritatie in carnavalswereld Limburg over datum voorjaarsvakantie'

An MP asked why the 2025 spring holiday for the southern region does not coincide with the carnival week, and what weight is given to carnival as cultural heritage. The Staatssecretaris answered that the spring holiday is only an advisory date, schools may deviate, the 7-8 weeks school rhythm drives planning, and a 2024 evaluation of the holiday regulation will consider carnival's role.
First and foremost, all schools that wish to can simply hold their spring holiday during the carnival week.
Voorop staat dat alle scholen die dat willen, gewoon hun voorjaarsvakantie tijdens de carnavalsweek kunnen houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Zeedijk-Raeven en Hertzberger over de Kamerbrief 29338-276 over het Nationaal Versterkingsplan van Micro-chiptalent als reactie op het advies van speciaal gezant microchipindustrie Dhr. H.

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about how the Nationaal Versterkingsplan Microchip-talent allocates funds across regions, including consultation with regions, the Beethoven-motion compliance, selection of regions, training numbers, and whether Twente, Groningen and Limburg receive fair shares. The Minister answered all 17 questions, explaining that regional plans exceeded the budget and failed to show delivery to industry, that allocation follows industry hiring practices concentrated in Brainport, and that revised plans are due by 29 September.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en De Kort over het artikel 'Havo-leerlingen stappen vaker over naar het mbo'

MPs Martens-America and De Kort asked about rising numbers of havo students leaving secondary school without a diploma for mbo vocational training, and whether basic skills and startkwalificatie are secured. The minister answers that numbers have risen, that the trend is largely positive, that basic skills plans and a planned study on the beroepshavo are underway, and that a tracking study shows 85% of such transfers obtained an mbo diploma.
In the autumn I will commission a study to gain insight into this.
Ik zal in het najaar een onderzoek uitzetten om hier zicht op te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Deel huisartsen zwicht voor druk ouders en scholen bij voorschrijven ADHD-medicatie’

MPs Tielen and Van Eijk asked about reports that some GPs yield to parent and school pressure to prescribe ADHD medication, and about diagnosis and prescription trends, the ADHD misuse programme, referrals to specialist mental health care, and medical certificates. The minister says the government takes pressure on GPs seriously, points to 'Meer Tijd voor de Patiënt', the Gezonde Focus programme (focused mainly on students) and tables of diagnoses, prescriptions and referrals, but does not commit to new research on referral growth or to studying doctors' pressure around medical certificates.
I cannot provide an overview of the number of referrals to specialist mental health care since 2010 broken down by age group.
Ik kan geen overzicht geven over het aantal doorverwijzingen naar de specialistische ggz sinds 2010 uitgesplitst naar leeftijdsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelmans over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over door de Chinese overheid gefinancierde weekendscholen

MPs Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker and Brekelmans asked whether the government has oversight of Chinese state-funded weekend schools and their teaching materials, and about the delayed bill on supervising informal education. The minister says the government has no full overview of informal education, will seek talks with China and consider signal-based supervision, but gives no firm timeline beyond consultation before Prinsjesdag.
I will make efforts to enter into consultation with the Chinese government and will ask whether they can provide the transparency you desire.
Ik zal mij inspannen om in overleg te treden met de Chinese overheid (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 9) en zal daar vragen of zij de door u gewenste transparantie kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de vergoeding van medische hulpmiddelen die nodig zijn om onderwijs te kunnen volgen

An MP asked whether necessary medical aids for pupils to follow education should be reimbursed, how reimbursement works across schools, insurers and municipalities, and how to reduce bureaucracy and costs for parents. The minister answered that children can obtain aids via the Zvw, Wmo and UWV school provisions, that parents may face co-payments under the Zvw, that the UWV provided 5,168 education provisions worth 30 million euros in 2023, and that insurers are working on uniform rules from 2025.
It is undesirable that parties point at each other and parents thus do not receive reimbursement for (medical) aids.
Het is onwenselijk dat partijen naar elkaar wijzen en ouders zo geen (medische) hulpmiddelen vergoed krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Hoeff en Crijns over het bericht 'Zorgen bij kinderombudsman: Steeds meer kinderen gaan niet naar school'

MPs Van der Hoeff and Crijns asked the minister about a report that more children are staying out of school and the implications for the child ombudsman's concerns, including links to youth care waiting lists and the closure of secure youth care. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites causes such as waiting lists, teacher shortages and Long COVID, and lists measures like digital schooling and a truancy bill, without confirming a link to secure youth care closures.
Together with schools, collaborative partnerships, municipalities and care organisations, we are working to ensure that no child stays at home unnecessarily any longer.
Samen met scholen, samenwerkingsverbanden en gemeenten en zorgorganisaties zetten we ons in om ervoor te zorgen dat geen kind meer onnodig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het bericht 'Turkse sekte met tweeëntwintig moskee-internaten stapt nu in scholen'

MPs Becker and De Kort asked about reports that a Turkish religious movement with boarding schools was entering mainstream schools in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, raising concerns about civic integration, founder backgrounds, oversight of the approval process and boarding houses. The government answered that the schools meet all legal founding requirements and may open in August 2024, that inspectorates monitor civic education, that it can refuse applications where concrete signals exist, but that no such signals were received, and that the boarding-house oversight and the planned informal-education bill are being maintained.
The powers to investigate persons and/or civil society organisations are not vested in the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Social Affairs and Employment, and Health, Welfare and Sport.

De bevoegdheden om onderzoek te doen naar personen en/of maatschappelijke organisaties zijn niet belegd bij de Ministeries van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het artikel “Dit is de extreem-conservatieve club die zich ook dit jaar verzet tegen lessen over seks”

Two VVD MPs asked the Education Minister whether pressure by Civitas Christiana on schools to avoid sex-education material (Rutgers) is unacceptable, whether schools are obliged to teach respect for sexual diversity, and whether the government will monitor and act. The minister called the pressure undesirable and misleading, said schools are free to choose materials and reported no known cases of schools dropping them, but stated that the ministries have no legal basis to investigate or ban such organisations and offered support and a newsletter instead.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk en Dijk over de interactieve tablettour van het Nationaal Holocaustmuseum voor groepen leerlingen uit het voortgezet onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the government recognises the value of school visits to the Holocaust Museum, whether it will push all secondary pupils to visit, and whether free museum admission for all Dutch citizens will be explored. The government agrees Holocaust education matters, says schools must take the initiative, points to existing school funding and a forthcoming national Holocaust education plan, and leaves museum pricing to the museum itself.
However, it is up to schools themselves to take the initiative here and to look at which activity fits the school and target group.
Het is echter aan scholen zelf om hier initiatief toe te nemen en te kijken welke activiteit past bij de school en doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over het bericht dat gemeenten de nieuwe norm voor grotere schoolpleinen niet meenemen in beleid

SP MPs asked whether the government will act on reports that municipalities are not applying the new norm for larger school playgrounds in their policy, and whether they will discuss this with the VNG and school associations or fund larger playgrounds. The minister replied that the norm is a non-binding guideline, that space trade-offs are a municipal responsibility, that the government will discuss it with the VNG and school associations, and that municipal funds are freely spendable.
It is possible that municipalities sometimes get into difficulty in this area and have to make choices.
Het is mogelijk dat gemeenten soms in de knel komen op dit vlak en keuzes moeten maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Bamenga, Becker en Brekelman over het nieuwsbericht 'Chinese overheid sponsort weekendles Chinees-Nederlandse kinderen'

MPs from D66 and VVD asked the government about RTL reporting on Chinese state-funded weekend schools for Chinese-Dutch children, including oversight, visas for Chinese teachers, foreign interference and possible visitation of schools. The government answered that it has no data on these informal schools, that it is working on a bill for signal-based oversight, and that it sees no reason yet to raise the matter with the Chinese government.
The cabinet does not have figures on informal education institutions, where they are located, how many pupils attend them, or what their funding structure is.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over cijfers van instellingen voor informeel onderwijs, waar zij zich bevinden, hoeveel leerlingen deze instellingen bezoeken of hoe de financieringsstructuur eruit ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ellian over antisemitisme in Nederland

MPs Bikker and Ellian asked about rising antisemitism in the Netherlands after the Hamas attack on Israel, including Jewish pupils' safety, reporting channels and EU cooperation. The minister answered that the government is in close contact with the Jewish community, that the NCAB and police monitor the situation, and that schools are encouraged to hold dialogue, though the answers largely restate existing policy and do not give concrete numbers or new measures.
I have tried to comply with your request. However, gathering the necessary data took some time.
Ik heb getracht aan uw verzoek te voldoen. Met het verzamelen van de benodigde gegevens ging echter enige tijd gemoeid.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid van der Graaf over mbo-nieuwkomersonderwijs

An MP asked the ministers about the Alfa-college's extra Dutch and maths support for newcomers in MBO vocational courses, whether they would engage with the college, and whether they would prepare a statutory basis for MBO education for non-Dutch speakers. The minister confirmed awareness and willingness to talk, and said a future-exploration and national dialogue on newcomer education is underway, with scenarios to be shared before summer 2024.
We aim to share future scenarios with your House before summer 2024.
Wij streven ernaar om voor de zomer van 2024 toekomstscenario's met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Woude over het artikel ‘Exorcisten ’De Laatste Reformatie’ onder vuur: duiveluitdrijvingen bij kinderen en wegbidden autisme’

MPs Becker and Van der Woude asked about reports of exorcisms of children and prayer to cure autism by the group De Laatste Reformatie, covering child protection, reporting routes, foreign contacts, visas and a promised law on informal education. The government condemned such practices, pointed to Veilig Thuis, the police and existing child protection tools, declined a new investigation or legal measures against the group citing religious freedom, and said it had no knowledge of a promised study on the scale of exorcisms.
I do not intend to investigate this further.
Ik ben niet voornemens dit nader te onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Wat weegt zwaarder: demonstratierecht of leerplicht? ‘Niet de bedoeling iedere vrijdag vrij te geven’ en het artikel ‘Wegblijven van school om deel te nemen aan k

An MP asks the Education Minister whether pupils may skip school to attend climate demonstrations, whether a school's active promotion of a demonstration undermines compulsory schooling, and how schools' neutrality and missed tests are handled. The minister answers that truancy is never allowed for any reason, attendance may be part of the curriculum subject to works council approval, schools' neutrality is not necessarily compromised, and the Inspectorate can intervene if a school cannot justify its decisions.
Truancy, for whatever reason, is not permitted.
Spijbelen, om wat voor reden dan ook, is niet geoorloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Paul over het bericht ‘Kinderen wachten soms langer dan jaar op logopedie: Gevolgen worden onderschat’

MPs Tielen and Paul asked the health and education ministers about reported long waiting lists for speech therapy for children, their causes, administrative burden, the link with school advice, and digital options. Minister Kuipers reported rising waiting lists (half of first-line practices with waits over a year in 2022), said data cannot yet be split further, promised to discuss more intensive supervision with the NZa, and pointed to existing initiatives while giving no firm new measures.
I will consult with the NZa on whether it is possible to exercise more intensive supervision over speech therapy.
Ik ga met de NZa overleggen, of het mogelijk is om intensiever toezicht op de logopedie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Paul en Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Ouders eisen verbod op autismebehandeling voor kinderen'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about reports that parents demand a ban on ABA-based autism treatment for children, including the number of providers, complaints, safety oversight and the evidence base. The government answered that ABA covers many varying treatments, that complaints to the IGJ are limited, that it will commission research into effects on young people, but that it does not support a ban.
I will therefore have research carried out into the impact of ABA and treatments containing ABA elements on young people.
Ik ga daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van ABA en behandelingen waar elementen van ABA in zitten op jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over Confucius Classrooms in het voortgezet onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a Confucius Classroom opened at a Haarlemmermeer secondary school and whether foreign state influence in Dutch schools is acceptable and how it is monitored. The minister said such interference is undesirable, that the Confucius Classrooms have no influence on lesson content, that no concrete signals of interference exist, and that no new rules are planned for now.
I currently see no reason to tighten the rules on contacts with China in secondary education, but I am keeping an eye on the theme.
Ik zie momenteel dus geen aanleiding om de regels voor contacten met China in het voortgezet onderwijs aan te scherpen, maar ik hou het thema wel in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel 'Zorgen om online bedreigingen leerlingen: ’Doet een beetje denken aan de kogelbrief’'

MPs Paul and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about online threats against pupils and schools, including how often they occur, how schools should respond, and whether perpetrators are caught. Minister Wiersma answers that no national trend data exists, points to a planned incident-reporting duty in a forthcoming bill, and describes existing protocols and support organisations, without committing to new structural oversight measures.
There is no national picture of how often these kinds of threats occur.
Er is geen landelijk beeld hoe vaak dit soort bedreigingen voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het artikel 'Op deze school werden kinderen geslagen. Toch mochten de leerkrachten blijven'

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education how corporal punishment at the Plato school could have happened and whether current rules and inspection prevent it, and whether stricter rules and oversight of private and informal education are needed. The minister answered that the government is tightening rules: a reporting obligation for serious incidents, stronger complaint procedures, more school safety monitoring, and a bill for signal-based inspection of informal education expected in mid-2023, while noting no comparable cases are known to the inspectorate.
That is why I announced in my letter to the House of 18 November that I will work on a bill enabling signal-based inspection by the inspectorate of informal education.
Daarom heb ik in mijn brief aan de Kamer van 18–11 jl. aangekondigd om aan de slag te gaan met een wetsvoorstel dat signaalgericht toezicht van de inspectie op informeel onderwijs mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel ‘Zorgen om schade aan schoolgebouwen in heel Nederland door geweld hangjongeren’

Two VVD MPs asked about damage to school buildings from youth vandalism, how often damages and parents are held liable, convictions, Halt referrals, and whether cameras on school playgrounds should be promoted. The minister answers that no data on damage, claims, or convictions are kept, cites Halt figures, points to the ongoing exploration of expanding parental liability, and refers to municipalities and schools for camera decisions.
There are no figures available on the extent of damage to school buildings.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de omvang van schade aan schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Paul over het bericht ‘Ondanks ophef wijzen meer reformatorische scholen homohuwelijk af’

MPs Van Meenen and Paul asked the Minister about reports that many reformed schools still reject same-sex marriage and same-sex relationships in their guides, and about inspectorate oversight of social safety, school-identity statements and guest lectures. The Minister says such school statements are undesirable, that the Inspectorate supervises school climate and will intervene, and describes tightened inspection procedures and complaint handling, while deferring a decision on banning some identity statements to a later letter.
I will inform the House later this year about possibly banning (certain forms of) identity statements in response to the Kwint et al. and Gündoğan/Simons motions.
Ik informeer uw Kamer in de loop van dit jaar over het mogelijk verbieden van (bepaalde vormen van) identiteitsverklaringen in reactie op de motie-Kwint c.s. en de motie-Gündoğan/Simons.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de brandbrief van een basisschool die voltijdonderwijs voor hoogbegaafde kinderen aanbiedt

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about a school letter reporting that full-time gifted education is becoming unavailable to more pupils, and about schools refusing pupils from other partnerships due to funding. The minister acknowledged the situation, said partnerships (samenwerkingsverbanden) are responsible for a complete offer, pointed to a new subsidy scheme and extra funding, and said talks with the letter writers are ongoing.
The partnership is responsible for providing sufficient suitable educational provisions for the entire giftedness spectrum.
Het samenwerkingsverband is verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van voldoende passende onderwijsvoorzieningen voor het gehele begaafdheidsspectrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Van der Woude, El Yassini en Rajkowski over kunstmatige intelligentie in het onderwijs

MPs from the VVD asked the education and economic affairs ministers about the risks and opportunities of AI such as ChatGPT in schools, teacher preparedness, research, and cooperation with the Dutch AI Coalition. The ministers answered that they support schools through Kennisnet, SURF, the national education lab NOLAI and funding, but offered no measures to check or constrain executive power.
It is important that school boards and teachers are sufficiently aware of the risks of AI for education, in addition to its opportunities.
Het is belangrijk dat schoolbesturen en leraren naast de kansen ook voldoende op de hoogte zijn van de risico's van AI voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de berichten ‘Studenten met STAP-budget niet tevreden over commerciële opleiders’ en ‘Stapbudget maakt meerjarige studie vaak juist duurder dan voorheen.’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that STAP-budget students are dissatisfied with commercial providers, that multi-year courses are not well covered and became more expensive, and about the lottery-like allocation of the budget. The ministers answered that quality safeguards are being tightened, that multi-year funding for follow-on years will be introduced around July 2023, that a transitional arrangement for students affected by the tax-deduction switch is being considered, and that the application process will be reviewed.
The cabinet considers it necessary that citizens must be able to trust the suitability and quality of the training offered through the STAP budget.
Het kabinet acht het noodzakelijk dat burgers moeten kunnen vertrouwen op de geschiktheid en de kwaliteit van de opleidingen die worden aangeboden middels het STAP-budget.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Paul over het bericht ‘Helft van scholen aan nieuwbouw of renovatie toe, extra geld onzeker’

MPs Peter de Groot and Paul (VVD) asked the ministers for Housing and for Primary and Secondary Education about a report that nearly half of Dutch schools need renovation or replacement and that extra funding is uncertain. Minister Wiersma answered that a national picture is still being compiled, that responsibilities are split across municipalities, school boards and the central government, and promised a funding task force reply and further information in Q1 2023.
In the first quarter of 2023 I will inform you of the outcomes of the research.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2023 zal ik u informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het initiatief 'Agora Underground'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the Roermond 'Agora Underground' initiative to run a digital school for truant pupils, including whether the Inspectorate's finding that it fails the Compulsory Education Act should be reconsidered and what steps will provide education to around fifteen thousand truants. The Minister says the government sees digital distance learning as a promising tool, that the Inspectorate will assess such initiatives constructively but found quality and regular school attendance lacking, and that a fuller digital school design will be reported to parliament in spring 2023.
With Agora Underground, however, it has become apparent that the quality of education and the guidance of pupils do not meet the law, so that the basic quality of education falls short.
Bij Agora Underground is echter gebleken dat de onderwijskwaliteit en de begeleiding van leerlingen niet voldoen aan de wet waardoor de basiskwaliteit van het onderwijs tekort schiet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over thuiszitters in het funderend onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about the number of school truants, the rising number of compulsory-education exemptions under article 5(a) of the Leerplichtwet, the procedure for granting them, and the role of school boards and digital or part-time schooling. The minister reported about 4,300 long-term truants in 2020-2021, promised further research and a bill tightening the exemption procedure around mid-2023, and said there was no explanation yet for the rise in exemptions.
Based on the figures I receive via municipalities, I have no explanation for the increase.
Op basis van de cijfers die ik via gemeenten ontvang heb ik geen verklaring voor de toename.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Rajkowski over Privacy van leerlingen

MPs Paul and Rajkowski asked the minister about claims that children's online activity, including at school, is recorded and commercially exploited, and about media literacy and EU child-advertising rules. The minister replied that schools must not use pupil data commercially under the GDPR and a privacy convenant, that digital literacy core goals are being developed, and that EU rules ban targeted advertising to minors.
School boards, as data controllers, are themselves responsible for compliance and must make agreements with suppliers of those products that process pupils' data.

Schoolbesturen zijn als «verwerkingsverantwoordelijke» zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving daarvan en moeten afspraken maken met leveranciers van die producten waarin gegevens van leerlingen worden verwerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Paul, De Hoop, Beertema, Segers, Kwint, Bisschop en Westerveld over de berichten Klachtenregen van ouders over Trevvel: Ik kwam elke dag te laat op mijn werk en verloor zo mijn

MPs asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports of late or missing school transport for pupils in special education, caused by driver shortages. The minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, promised to pressure the VNG, gather information on affected regions, and await a monitoring study due by year-end.
However, for privacy reasons it is not possible to make the results public per municipality.
Het is vanwege privacy echter niet mogelijk om de resultaten per gemeente openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht 'Jezelf ontdekken in Parijs? Het kan op kosten van de overheid'

MPs Paul and Smals (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that course providers misuse the STAP training budget, for example by offering free trips and overnight stays, and about quality control, value for money, and whether the scheme should be evaluated early and targeted at shortage sectors. The minister replied that non-necessary costs are excluded, that the Toetsingskamer has asked providers to remove over 2,000 courses and is pursuing four providers for non-compliance, and that an invoeringstoets and a full evaluation will follow, but declined to target the budget at shortage sectors for now.
If the STAP budget is used to fund unnecessary items, action will be taken.
Indien het STAP budget wordt aangewend voor het bekostigen van niet-noodzakelijke zaken, wordt actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over zij-instromers die moeilijkheden ervaren om aan de slag te gaan in het onderwijs

An MP from the VVD asked the education ministers why career changers who want to become teachers are turned away because teacher-training intakes start only twice a year, and what will be done to make hiring them easier and support them. The ministers acknowledge the concern, point to a higher subsidy for career changers, regional cooperation and extended RAP funding, but do not commit to changing the twice-yearly start dates.
We expect that, through the increase in the subsidy budget for guiding and training career changers, it will become attractive for school boards to hire career changers.
Wij verwachten dat het door de verhoging van het subsidiebudget voor het begeleiden en opleiden van zij-instromers aantrekkelijk wordt voor schoolbesturen om zij-instromers aan te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de huisvesting van onderwijsexpertisecentrum De Berkenschutse

An MP asks whether municipality Heeze-Leende can finance new premises for the special-education centre De Berkenschutse, and whether small municipalities generally can fund school buildings with regional functions. The minister answers that municipalities are responsible for school housing, funded via the general fund without earmarking, that the Education Expertise Centres Act offers no room for school boards to co-finance, and that ministry officials will visit the school on 1 July 2022 and report after the summer.
It is the responsibility of the municipality to provide suitable housing for the school that meets the legal requirements, as set out in the Building Decree.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente te voorzien in passende huisvesting van de school, die voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten, zoals opgenomen in het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over koppelverkoop door educatieve uitgeverijen

An MP asked whether the LiFo licence-plus-book model used by educational publishers amounts to tying (koppelverkoop) that forces schools to buy time-limited online licences, and what the government will do about it. The minister said tying is for the competition authority ACM to establish, that ACM sets its own agenda, that schools choose materials and can articulate demand via SIVON, and that the government will respond after summer in its reaction to the Free School Books Act evaluation.
Tying is a form of abuse of a dominant economic position. It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) to establish tying in specific cases.
Koppelverkoop is een vorm van misbruik van een economische machtspositie. Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om koppelverkoop in specifieke gevallen vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Paul over de toegankelijkheid van leermiddelen voor kinderen met een visuele beperking

MPs De Kort and Paul asked whether the European Accessibility Act, which does not cover education, could be extended to schoolbooks and digital learning materials for pupils with visual impairments, and whether this fits the curriculum review. The minister said amending the Act would be lengthy and uncertain, so national options and agreements with publishers are being explored, while pointing to existing subsidies and the curriculum work.

In that light, I am already in discussion with the parties involved, including the Mediafederatie and Koninklijke Visio, to look for ways to ensure publishers make their digital learning materials accessible to pupils with a (visual) impairment.

In dat licht ben ik al in gesprek met de betrokkenen waaronder de Mediafederatie en Koninklijke Visio om te zoeken naar mogelijkheden om ervoor te zorgen dat uitgevers hun digitale leermiddelen toegankelijk maken voor leerlingen met een (visuele) beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Becker over het nieuwe inspectierapport over het Cornelius Haga Lyceum

MPs Paul and Becker (VVD) asked the minister why the Cornelius Haga Lyceum's education quality deteriorated, why the school remains open despite serious concerns, and what sanctions and faster intervention are possible. Minister Wiersma answered that the inspectorate rated all departments very weak, outlined sanctions already applied and options still available, and said she will inform parliament before summer on faster intervention for underperforming schools.
If education does not improve within a year, the limit has been reached and I will intervene.
Indien het onderwijs niet binnen een jaar verbetert, is de maat vol en zal ik ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Becker over het bericht ‘Menstruatie meteen melden bij de juf – straks ook in het Westland’

MPs Paul and Becker asked the Education and Social Affairs ministers about an Islamic school board's rule requiring girls to report menstruation to teachers before joining prayer, and about citizenship education and oversight of Islamic schools. The minister answered that the rule was unacceptable, that the Inspectorate contacted the board which agreed to remove it, and that the government will use the Inspectorate, the safety duty and a planned expansion of administrative powers, while stating the matter would be raised with the municipality.
In this case, the inspectorate discussed the entire identity policy, as it appeared on the website, with the board.
In dit geval heeft de inspectie het hele identiteitsbeleid zoals dat op de website stond besproken met het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht ‘Meerderheid scholen weigert inzet zzp’ers ondanks lerarentekort’

MPs Paul and Smals asked the government about a report that most schools refuse to deploy freelancers (zzp'ers) despite teacher shortages, and about enforcement moratorium, the DBA web module and legal uncertainty over flexible contracts. The minister answered that there are no signs refusals worsen teacher shortages, that enforcement moratorium remains in force with exceptions for malicious cases and unfollowed instructions, that the web module is only indicative and a broader policy letter will follow before summer 2022.
Before the summer we will inform you further about the elaboration of this ambition in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer zullen wij u nader informeren over de uitwerking van deze in het coalitieakkoord opgenomen ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Paul over het voorstel in de Maastrichtse gemeenteraad om het openbaar voortgezet onderwijs af te schaffen

Two MPs asked the minister whether a Maastricht council proposal to abolish public secondary education and centralise schools on one campus undermines the constitutional guarantee of public education, whether a draft covenant overreaches council powers, and whether large-scale schooling harms the human scale of education. The minister replied that conversion from public to special-denomination schools is possible under legal conditions, that the public-education guarantee remains a municipal responsibility and cannot be transferred by covenant, and that evidence does not link school size to human scale.
However, a covenant cannot transfer or set aside (constitutional or statutory) legal tasks.
In een convenant kunnen echter geen (grond)wettelijke taken overgedragen of opzijgezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Bijlesindustrie dreigt publiek onderwijs uit te hollen’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about regulation of the private supplementary tutoring market, the lack of a mandatory certificate of good conduct (VOG) for staff there, and whether a quality label should be created. The minister replies that the market is private and outside education law and inspection oversight, that schools are responsible for their contracted partners, and that talks with the sector and a reaction to the Onderwijsraad advice will follow.
This also means that the inspectorate has no authority to supervise this.
Dit betekent ook dat de inspectie geen bevoegdheid heeft om hier toezicht op te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'In achterkamertje van beautysalon verdienen ze aan leed van toeslagenouders: 'Schandalig''

An MP asked whether paid intermediaries offering to help people claim compensation for childcare benefit problems are acceptable and what the government will do about them.
