The state secretary answered that such help is not required, that the government will improve information on free legal aid and municipal support, will refer suspected criminal conduct to police and possibly the consumer authority, but cannot yet judge misuse.
Following this case, the VNG and UHT are taking another look at the information provision and services for these citizens.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus kijken de VNG en UHT opnieuw naar de informatievoorziening aan en dienstverlening richting deze burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'De baby aanmelden voor een witte basisschool gaat in Utrecht niet meer: 'als mijn kind naar Kanaleneiland moet, zou ik niet blij zijn''

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that some Utrecht schools use informal waiting lists to pre-register babies before the legal age of three, favouring children of highly educated parents, and about segregation and admissions policy. The Minister says pre-registration without legal basis must not lead to priority, that the Inspectorate will act on signals, and that a segregation policy agenda and letter to school boards are underway, while admissions remain the responsibility of school boards and no national policy is planned yet.
This school year we are sending all school boards in primary and secondary education a letter about the existing rules on registration and admission.
Dit schooljaar sturen wij alle schoolbesturen in het po en vo een brief over de bestaande regels rondom aanmelding en toelating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Schoolboeken zonder bloot, dino’s en ‘decadente’ cultuur, s.v.p.’

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether educational publishers have guidelines to avoid certain topics, such as evolution or historical facts, and whether this conflicts with the civic education mandate. The minister answered that no such guidelines are known, that schools and inspectorate are responsible for covering mandatory content, and that a structural dialogue with publishers and schools is being pursued.
I am not aware of any examples of guidelines to exclude certain topics, such as evolution theory, from being addressed.
Er zijn mij geen voorbeelden bekend van richtlijnen om bepaalde onderwerpen, zoals de evolutieleer, niet aan de orde te laten komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over flyeracties om ouderverklaringen te verzamelen

An MP asked the minister about flyer campaigns collecting parent declarations via DigiD to support new schools, questioning whether such non-binding support is valid and whether DUO's process is controlled. The minister answered that initiators may choose their outreach, the declaration signals interest rather than enrolment, the method is more valid than before, and the process will be monitored with DUO and IvhO.
Initiators are free to choose the form in which they bring their initiative to attention.
Het staat initiatiefnemers vrij om de vorm te kiezen waarin zij hun initiatief onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Van der Woude over problemen met ouderverklaringen en DUO

MPs Paul and Van der Woude asked about reported instability of DUO's online system for parental declarations needed to found a new school, and about the deadline. The minister says the reported errors were limited, largely traceable to one outage, DUO is investigating, and the deadline will not be extended.
I am closely following developments around MijnDUO, as well as the contact between DUO and the reporters, and will intervene where necessary.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen rondom MijnDUO nauwgezet, net als het contact tussen DUO en de melders, en grijp in waar nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Het is nog altijd onrustig op het Haga Lyceum’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether the Inspectorate's visit to the Cornelius Haga Lyceum, reported as ongoing unrest, is consistent with its earlier positive 2020 assessment and whether the school's recovery obligations are at risk. The Minister says the Inspectorate found no reason for immediate further investigation, will use its information in two planned inquiries after the summer, and will report on results under the usual procedure.
The Inspectorate has decided to use the information obtained in designing the two previously announced inquiries into the board and the school, which take place after the summer.
De inspectie heeft besloten de verkregen informatie te gebruiken bij de inrichting van de eerder aangekondigde twee onderzoeken bij het bestuur en de school die na de zomer plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Kaag wilde Kamer informeren over fraudemelding bij stichting, ambtenaren hielden brief tegen’

Rep. Paul (VVD) asked Minister Kaag why she initially planned to inform parliament about possible fraud at Stichting Mayday Rescue, which supports the White Helmets in Syria, then dropped that plan, and asked about oversight of the funds and of partner organisations' financial administration. The minister answered that she followed advice to wait for an independent investigation, which found no proven malversation, and that under the Nota Beheer en Toezicht only proven malversations are reported to parliament, while defending the financial control measures and noting that 0.12 percent of ODA over five years was subject to proven malversation.
The advice from my officials was, in line with established policy on this, not to inform the House on the basis of suspicions, but first to await the independent investigation
Het advies van mijn ambtenaren was, conform staand beleid hieromtrent, de Kamer niet in te lichten op basis van vermoedens, maar eerst het onafhankelijke onderzoek af te wachten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'Nederlandse ontwikkelingshulp vloeide naar Palestijnse terreurgroep'

An MP asked the minister about reports that Dutch development aid reached a Palestinian group linked to a terrorist organisation, and why Israeli intelligence was shared only with an EU team and whether funding to the organisations would be recovered. The minister answered that the Israeli information was too general to support the claim, that payments were suspended and partly resumed via an independent auditor, that the matter was referred to OLAF, and that recovery is not currently warranted.
The ministry takes reports of possible links with terrorist organisations and/or fraud seriously.
Het ministerie neemt berichten over mogelijke banden met terroristische organisaties en/of fraude serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Spanning in de klas: verdwijnen controversiële thema’s van het lesrooster?’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether teachers have become more cautious about teaching controversial topics, following a survey by history and civics teacher associations, and what concrete steps will support teachers. The Minister acknowledges the concern, outlines planned research and monitoring, support programmes for sensitive topics, and civic education reforms, but gives no specific new commitments to parliamentary scrutiny of executive power.
No representative research has been conducted into how many school leaders responded to the call from my colleague Van Engelshoven and myself, or actively discouraged it.
Er is geen representatief onderzoek gedaan naar hoeveel schoolleiders gehoor hebben gegeven aan de oproep van mijn collega Van Engelshoven en mijzelf, dan wel dit actief afgeraden hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Onderwijsinspectie op bezoek bij Tjalling Koopmans College vanwege hevige onrust, SVPO blijft knokken tegen publicatie rapporten’

MPs Paul and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about inspection findings of very weak quality at SVPO schools, the inspectorate's handling of them, and SVPO's court action to delay publication of the reports. The minister confirmed the very weak ratings, described the recovery orders, financial-oversight measures and a specific financial investigation, explained that publication is suspended pending a court ruling, and promised to inform parliament on the inspection's findings.
Article 21 of the Education Supervision Act provides that the inspectorate publishes reports in the fifth week after they are established.
Uit artikel 21 van de Wet op het onderwijstoezicht volgt dat de inspectie rapporten in de vijfde week na vaststelling openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'Wetenschappers: Overheid weet niet welke ontwikkelingshulp werkt'

An MP (VVD) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch aid money is used effectively, given a Trouw report that the government does not know which aid works, and asked about evaluation, results measurement and the role of IOB. The minister answers that evaluation is intensive but tailored to project type and budget, cites existing tools (IOB, MEL reserve, systematic reviews, IATI), and states that results measurement has practical limits, without committing to a new concrete step.
That is why the cabinet continues, unchanged, the good practice of intensive evaluation within development cooperation to gain insight into what does and does not work.
Daarom zet het kabinet de goede gewoonte, waarbij binnen Ontwikkelingssamenwerking intensief wordt geëvalueerd om zicht te krijgen op wat wel en niet werkt, onverminderd voort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Erkens en Van Strien over het rapport 'The Role of Critical Minerals in Clean Energy Transitions' van het Internationale Energieagentschap (IEA)

MPs Paul, Erkens and Van Strien asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the IEA report on critical minerals, including dependence on China, strategic stockpiles, nuclear energy and resource efficiency technology. The minister answered that Europe-level policy, circular strategies and industry-led risk management are the preferred response, that stockpiles are only sometimes useful and Europe should first improve risk analysis, and that nuclear could contribute to diversification without being decisive.
That is why the Netherlands is pursuing ambitious raw materials policy at the European level.
Daarom zet Nederland in op ambitieus grondstoffenbeleid op Europees niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Onderzoek inspectie: 1 op 3 scholen weigert schooladviezen bij te stellen’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about a report that one in three schools refuses to revise school advice after the final test, and whether this breaches the legal duty to reconsider. The Minister acknowledges the concern, says schools must reconsider and will discuss this with the Inspectorate and others, but rejects making upward revision mandatory.

Schools are legally required to reconsider the school advice when the final test score is higher, and I consider it part of the school's professional attitude to carry out this reconsideration seriously for each individual pupil.

Scholen zijn wettelijk verplicht om het schooladvies te heroverwegen bij een hogere eindtoetsscore en ik vind het onderdeel van de professionele attitude van de school om deze heroverweging per individuele leerling serieus uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Paul over de brief van de regering over de bekostiging van investeringsvoorstellen uit het Nationaal Groeifonds

Two VVD MPs asked how regional balance was ensured in Groeifonds investment allocations, why the advisory commission rejected the Rotterdam–Chemelot pipeline proposal, what the Flemish Antwerp–Chemelot pipeline consultation means for Rotterdam's competitiveness, and whether the government will act on the commission's advice for a pipeline bundle. The government answered that regional spread is not a goal in itself but a consideration, that the commission advised independently, that a Rotterdam-led follow-up study is underway with IenW, and that it endorses making capacity available but it is too early to commit budget.
The fund managers do not interfere in the commission's substantive weighing of proposals, in order to safeguard the commission's independent role.
De fondsbeheerders mengen zich niet in de inhoudelijke weging van voorstellen door de commissie, om zo de onafhankelijke rol van de commissie te waarborgen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over criminele netwerken en arbeidsuitbuiting

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about criminal family networks in Zaanstad, mortgage and property fraud, labour exploitation of migrants, and related regulation. The government answered that it cannot disclose ongoing police matters, points to RIEC support, a fenomeentafel, planned legal changes and studies, and says existing tools for overcrowding and labour-exploitation enforcement are adequate, while promising further briefings in 2026.
Due to the confidentiality of ongoing police cases, it is not possible to address whether there are more municipalities where one or a small number of persons lead criminal pyramid structures.

Wegens de vertrouwelijkheid van lopende politiezaken kan er niet worden ingegaan op de vraag of er meer gemeenten zijn waar één of een klein aantal personen aan het hoofd staat van criminele piramidestructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Drie dagen in dienst, 19.000 euro na ontslag wegens geloof

An MP asked three ministers about a court ruling that an employer unlawfully dismissed a worker during probation over religious grounds, and about its consequences for employers and the labour market. The Minister of Social Affairs answered that courts' rulings cannot be commented on, that existing law gives employers enough room, and that no legislative change is currently considered necessary.
In view of the answers given, we currently see no reason to amend laws and regulations.
Met inachtneming van de geformuleerde antwoorden, zien wij op dit moment geen reden om wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de toepassing van artikel 137 Pensioenwet bij pensioenfondsen met bijstortingsverplichting

MP Joseph (BBB) asked whether the Wtp exception to the indexation rules of article 137 Pensioenwet for funds with an employer top-up obligation lapses once new accrual moves out, and how the transition safeguards protect members from social partners invaring such funds. The minister confirmed the exception lapses for closed funds, said invaren is a choice for social partners subject to DNB review and the requirement of an evenwichtige transitie, and rejected the premise that members could rely on article 137 in the way described.
It is not for me to pass judgment on whether or not to invaren.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over het wel of niet invaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Beleid asiel en werk op de schop'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report on tighter rules for asylum seekers' access to work, including barring those from safe countries and Dublin claimants, and shortening the waiting period from six months to three. The government answered that the proposal is in internet consultation, that the 24-week rule was struck down by the Council of State, that the new rules are to take effect with the Migration Pact on 12 June 2026, and that other countries use various waiting periods, while promising to review consultation responses.
The cabinet expects to send the documents to the House at the beginning of 2026.
Het kabinet verwacht uw Kamer de stukken begin 2026 toe te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jimmy Dijk over het artikel “1 op 6 Nederlanders heeft stressvol werk, vooral in de zorg en het onderwijs.”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about news that one in six Dutch workers have stressful jobs, concentrated in care and education, and whether low pay, low autonomy and understaffing are linked to this. The state secretary replied that stress stems mainly from high workload combined with low autonomy rather than undervaluation of the public sector, pointed to existing prevention plans and workload-reduction funds, and said wages are primarily a matter for employers and unions.
I therefore do not share the analysis that this is related to any undervaluation of the public sector.
Ik deel de analyse dan ook niet dat dit te maken heeft met eventuele onderwaardering van de publieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het sectoraal uitzendverbod en initiatieven van de Centrale Organisatie voor de Vleessector (COV) om de omstandigheden van arbeidsmigranten te verbeteren

An MP asked the minister whether the sectoral temporary-agency ban for the meat sector is justified, whether it would actually end abuses given that contract forms would merely shift, and whether the government would drop it in favour of sector-party initiatives led by the COV. The minister said widespread violations justify preparing a sectoral in- and uitleenverbod as a backstop, that agency use is the main predictor of violations and weak-link risks will be studied, and that talks with VleesNL are ongoing with the Chamber to be informed later.
In large parts of the meat sector there are high percentages of flexible work (around 70%) and especially temporary agency workers.
In grote gedeelten van de vleessector is sprake van hoge percentages flexwerk (rond de 70%) en met name uitzendkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Struijs over het artikel 'Schrijnend beeld: gepensioneerden zien inkomen al jaren achterblijven ten opzichte van anderen'

Members Van Brenk and Struijs (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an article showing pensioners' income lagging behind workers, the self-employed and benefit recipients, and about indexation of pensions compared with other EU countries. The minister confirmed the CBS figures but argued the article overstates the gap, attributed the lag mainly to limited indexation of supplementary pensions under the old system, rejected the age-discrimination claim, and promised a balanced purchasing-power outlook.
It is not possible to provide the requested information on the basis of publicly accessible data.
Het is niet mogelijk om op basis van publiek toegankelijke data de gevraagde informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over fouten bij het UWV in de uitvoering van de afschaffing van het garantiebedrag in de Wajong

An MP asked whether the UWV is mishandling the termination of the Wajong guarantee amount and its communication, and what help affected people can get. The State Secretary says the guarantee is not being abolished but ends for those who meet the five-year work condition, admits about 3,400 people will lose it from 1 January 2026, reports minor selection errors, and announces postponement of terminations to 2027 and other support measures.
As far as I am aware at present, no errors have been made.
Voor zover mij nu bekend zijn er geen fouten gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over “risico’s op schijnconstructies bij gemeenten via zzp-opdrachten"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about municipal job postings that let candidates choose between secondment or self-employment, and the risk of bogus self-employment this creates. The minister said the government sees a risk if the same work is done identically by a freelancer and an employee, but no central data exist on how many municipalities comply, and points to existing awareness campaigns, Belastingdienst enforcement and VNG guidance.
The cabinet considers it very important that the national government sets a good example in tackling bogus self-employment
Het kabinet vindt het van groot belang dat de rijksoverheid het goede voorbeeld geeft als het gaat om de aanpak van schijnzelfstandigheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Dijk over het bericht 'Vacatures voor renovatie Binnenhof duiden op schijnzelfstandigheid'

MPs Van Kent and Dijk (SP) asked the government about reports that Binnenhof renovation vacancies point to bogus self-employment, asking about enforcement, contracting, possible tax offences and worker safety. The minister replies that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf does not recognise the reports, that no cases are known, that contractors are bound by contract to follow the law, and that enforcement and the phase-out of bogus self-employment within the state are being pursued.
You will be informed shortly by the Minister of BZK about progress in phasing out the number of (potential) bogus self-employed within central government.
Over de voortgang van het afbouwen van het aantal (potentieel) schijnzelfstandigen bij de Rijksoverheid wordt u op korte termijn geïnformeerd door de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Saris over het bericht dat schijnzelfstandigen worden ingezet bij de renovatie van het Binnenhof

MP Saris asks whether false self-employed workers are being used on the Binnenhof renovation and what the government is doing about it. The government answers that it has not received union complaints, that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf checks contractors on compliance and will take measures if violations are found, and that it plans to reduce false self-employment within the central government by 1 January 2026.
On the progress in reducing the number of (potential) false self-employed workers in central government, you will be informed shortly by the Minister of BZK, in line with the Boon motion.
Over de voortgang van het afbouwen van het aantal (potentieel) schijnzelfstandigen bij de Rijksoverheid wordt u – conform de motie Boon – op korte termijn geïnformeerd door de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Dijk en Patijn over de Kamerbrief 'Informeren over bouwplaats ID en over inhoudingen op het minimumloon,' d.d. 30 oktober 2025 (kenmerk: 2025-0000214845)

MPs Saris, Dijk and Patijn asked why the minister abandoned the planned phase-out of deductions from the minimum wage for housing, given the migration goal, the Labour Inspectorate's warnings about abuse and the Aanjaagteam recommendations. The minister answered that the 25% cap stays because abolition would currently harm migrant workers more, and pointed to consultation, the Wet Goed Verhuurderschap and planned measures, answering all twelve questions in substance.
The cabinet has therefore decided that employers may for the time being continue to charge up to 25% of the statutory minimum wage for housing costs.
Het kabinet heeft daarom besloten dat werkgevers vooralsnog maximaal 25% van het Wettelijk minimumloon in rekening mogen blijven brengen voor huisvestingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn, Saris en Dijk over het besluit de inhoudingsregeling voor huisvesting op het minimumloon van arbeidsmigranten in stand te houden

MPs Patijn, Saris and Dijk asked why Minister Paul decided within two weeks of taking office to keep the wage-deduction scheme for housing from the minimum wage for migrant workers, which the ministry had planned to phase out, and with whom he had discussed it. The minister answered that he made an independent decision based on the ministry's exploratory review, that employer and union bodies were consulted earlier in that review, and that the only later contact was a briefing to the Stichting van de Arbeid under embargo, with the rest of the answers repeating that no other conversations took place.
On 28 August my ministry received a copy of a letter sent by VNO-NCW/MKB-Nederland to members of the House of Representatives.
Op 28 augustus heeft mijn ministerie een kopie ontvangen van een brief die door VNO-NCW/MKB-Nederland is verzonden aan leden van de Tweede Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de opvolging van aanbevelingen van de Ombudsman Pensioenen en het functioneren van de Geschilleninstantie Pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the follow-up given by pension funds to Ombudsman Pensioenen recommendations and the functioning of the GIP dispute body, including calls for stronger powers and wider use of hardship clauses. The Minister largely defends the existing framework, stating no legal change is needed now, the GIP will be evaluated in 2028, and promising only to raise the Ombudsman's recommendations in consultations with the Pensioenfederatie and the GIP.
I hold regular consultations with the Pensioenfederatie and also regularly speak with the GIP. I take the Ombudsman's recommendation seriously and will raise it in those consultations.
Ik heb periodiek overleg met de Pensioenfederatie en daarnaast spreek ik periodiek de GIP. De aanbeveling die de Ombudsman maakt neem ik ten harte en zal ik bespreekbaar maken in die overleggen.
Antwoord op van het lid Saris over het bericht ‘Voor 325.000 huishoudens dreigt pensioenarmoede’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that 325,000 households risk pensioner poverty, the definition of an adequate pension, the reduction target for workers without supplementary pension, and gaps for migrants and the self-employed. The minister answered that the AIO safety net prevents most such households from falling below the poverty line, that the reduction target is on track, and that foreign pension accrual cannot be tracked, while promising monitoring of self-employed pension accrual.
The Dutch pension system has several objectives.
Het Nederlandse pensioenstelsel kent meerdere doelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Door angst voor schijnzelfstandigheid worden wachtlijsten bij UWV nog langer'

VVD MPs asked why UWV is ending contracts with self-employed occupational physicians over fear of sham self-employment, whether this reflects tax enforcement, and how it fits motions to avoid categorical exclusion of freelancers. The government answers that UWV no longer hires physicians as freelancers due to sham-self-employment risk, that the Tax Authority enforces risk-based and has lifted its moratorium with a soft landing, and that freelancers still work at UWV in some domains.
The Tax Authority cannot, under its duty of confidentiality, answer whether enforcement has taken place against occupational physicians working on UWV assignments.
De Belastingdienst kan op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht niet beantwoorden of van handhaving sprake is bij verzekeringsartsen die in opdracht van UWV werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over communicatie en inrichting van compensatieregelingen in de pensioentransitie

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about how pension funds communicate compensation arrangements during the pension transition, citing an AFM report warning of late and unclear information and differences in compensation rules across funds. The Minister replies that funds must send personal transition forecasts one month before transition, that funds and employers can and should inform members earlier, that differences in compensation design are acceptable, and that no new communication rules are currently planned.

Because there are differences between pension funds in how compensation arrangements are designed, it is advisable for employees to contact their employer or pension fund with questions when something changes.

Omdat er verschillen zijn tussen pensioenfondsen in de vormgeving van compensatieregelingen, is het verstandig dat werknemers met vragen contact opnemen met de werkgever of met het pensioenfonds als er iets gaat veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het gebruik van ALM-modellen in de transitie naar het nieuwe pensioenstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether ALM models, designed for high-level strategy, are unsuitable for individual-level wealth redistribution during the pension transition, and whether statutory requirements risk overstating model reliability. The minister defended the framework, stating that ALM models are useful, that transition effects are assessed per cohort rather than individually, that DNB supervises the process, and that no additional guidelines are needed.
The supervision by DNB is sufficient. Therefore, no investigations, additional guidelines or safeguards are needed.
Het toezicht van DNB is voldoende. Er zijn dus geen onderzoeken, aanvullende richtlijnen of waarborgen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Welzijn over het Bureau InformatieDiensten Nederland

MPs Saris and Welzijn asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the legal basis, supervision, Woo coverage and accountability of the Bureau InformatieDiensten Nederland (BIDN), formerly the Inlichtingenbureau. The minister said tasks are largely statutory or performed as processor for public bodies, that the statutes change will be pre-submitted later this year, and that a conversion into an independent administrative body is left to that decision.

After advice on this intention from the Ministry of Finance's Toetsingscommissie Verzelfstandigingen and the Algemene Rekenkamer, the cabinet will take a decision, which is expected to be pre-submitted to the Eerste and Tweede Kamer by the end of this year.

Na advisering over dit voornemen door de Toetsingscommissie Verzelfstandigingen van het Ministerie van Financiën en de Algemene Rekenkamer neemt het kabinet hierover een besluit, dat naar verwachting voor het eind van dit jaar zal worden voorgehangen bij de Eerste en de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Saris over het memo uniforme beoordeling duurzaamheid post-COVID

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a UWV memo on uniform assessment of long-COVID durability, WIA caseload figures, a planned monitor, and follow-up on Central Court rulings for ME/CFS. The minister confirmed awareness of the memo, gave case counts, declined an annual long-COVID monitor, and deferred to the NVVG guideline and UWV's own regional-differences study while noting that the rulings bind future and non-final decisions.
UWV's research into regional differences is in full swing and its results are expected in December of this year.
Het onderzoek van UWV naar regionale verschillen is in volle gang en de uitkomsten hiervan worden in december van dit jaar verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de spreiding van financiële schokken in de uitkeringsfase van flexibele premieregelingen

An MP asked the government whether pension rules on smoothing financial shocks in the payout phase disadvantage participants in flexible premium schemes compared with solidarity schemes, and whether these rules should be harmonised. The state secretary acknowledged implementation difficulties, pointed to a forthcoming bill (Q1 2026) allowing a one-off capital allocation at retirement, and largely referred back to that bill without committing to a new harmonisation review.
As already reported to your House, the Bill on pension commitments is expected to be sent to your House in the first quarter of 2026.
Zoals reeds aan uw Kamer gemeld wordt het Wetsvoorstel toezeggingen pensioenonderwerpen naar verwachting in het eerste kwartaal van 2026 naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over ‘het fiscaal belasten van persoonlijk pensioenadvies’

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority's view that employer-paid personal pension advice is taxable wage conflicts with the Wet toekomst pensioenen goal of guidance and whether tax treatment should change. The state secretary replies that mandatory choice guidance is not taxable, but employer-paid personal advice is a private cost and thus taxable wage; a tax exemption would require a law change with budget effects, which the government sees no reason to pursue.
That is something different from extensive personal pension advice.
Dat is wat anders dan een uitgebreid persoonlijk pensioenadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over de opbouw van vakantiedagen tijdens ziekte

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a court ruling extending holiday accrual to employees in a dormant employment contract is compatible with EU law, and whether the law will be amended. The minister answered that Dutch law is not contrary to EU law, that the directive concerns work or wage periods, and that no legislative change is planned.
The cabinet does not believe that the provisions on the accrual of holiday in Dutch legislation conflict with European law.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat de bepalingen over de opbouw van vakantie in Nederlandse wetgeving in strijd zijn met Europees recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over governance bij pensioenfondsen

MP Joseph (BBB) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension fund boards have too much influence over the supervisory board (RvT) and accountability body (VO), and whether independence of internal oversight should be strengthened. The minister answered that the bodies deliberately check each other, that no reform is planned now, and that a governance study will start in 2026.
In line with the answer to the previous question, all bodies in pension fund governance influence each other.
In lijn met de beantwoording op de vorige vraag hebben alle organen in de governance van pensioenfondsen invloed op elkaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over vervolgopleidingen voor jongeren met een beperking of specifieke ondersteuningsbehoefte

MP Westerveld asked the Minister about lack of suitable follow-on education for pupils with disabilities or special support needs, UN committee criticism, exam retakes, transition support, deelcertificaten and an overview of options. The Minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to existing mbo/hbo/wo support measures, a commissioned study due by year-end, and existing information sources, but made no new binding commitment.
The ministry has therefore asked Oberon and the Beleidsonderzoekers to research effective interventions to improve the transition from special secondary education to mbo.

Het ministerie heeft Oberon en de Beleidsonderzoekers daarom gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar effectieve interventies die bijdragen aan het verbeteren van de overgang van het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs naar het mbo.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Patijn over het artikel Groot deel bedrijven houdt zich al decennia niet aan wettelijke plicht medezeggenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why about 30 percent of companies legally required to have a works council do not establish one, and why Dutch law lacks public enforcement while Belgium and France have it. The minister confirmed the non-compliance, said enforcement is left to private law and that adding public sanctions is not being considered, while a broader package to improve compliance will be sent to parliament by year-end.
At this moment this is not being considered.
Op dit moment wordt dit niet overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris, Patijn en Bikkers over borging van de regionale scholingsfondsen

MPs Saris, Patijn and Bikkers asked the Minister of Social Affairs about structural funding for regional training funds such as Twente and Achterhoek, the complexity of the SLIM subsidy scheme, unused SLIM funds, and the status of the Lifelong Development agenda. The minister acknowledged their value, said structural funding is still being explored and that no money is available for it, and promised a letter on the LLO agenda by year-end.
There are no funds available for structural funding, so a bridge to structural funding is not realistic.
Er zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor structurele borging, waardoor een overbrugging naar structurele borging niet reëel is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martens-America over de beantwoording van Kamervragen op 21 augustus 2025 over de artikelen «Picnic en Flink vallen onder supermarkt-cao, zegt rechter» van RTL-nieuws en «Online-supermarkte

Martens-America (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government will act on weak business climate caused by rigid rules, clarify the AVV and dispensation procedure for the Picnic/online supermarket collective agreement, disclose the decision and planned reforms. The minister answered that the AVV decision was taken on 22 September, granting dispensation to the e-commerce employers' association, with publication expected 25 September, while withholding the dispensation text and promising a report to parliament in autumn.
I cannot give access to the text of the dispensation decision.
Ik kan geen inzage geven in de tekst van het dispensatiebesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Westerveld, Van Campen en Heite over de staat van lhbti-acceptatie in het onderwijs en scherper toezicht daarop

MPs asked whether the Inspectorate of Education's last thematic study on sexual diversity (2020) should be repeated, how school supervision covers LGBTQ acceptance and civic duties, and what support schools receive. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate has deeper research planned for 2026, that sexual diversity is a standing supervision point with repair orders and funding sanctions for non-compliance, and listed existing surveys, a pending bill on safe education, and support programmes.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de berichten 'Door kabinet beloofd onderzoek naar doorstroomtoetsen blijkt niet te bestaan' en 'Scholen die overstapten op andere doorstroomtoets scoren flink beter'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Education why no targeted research into differences between primary-school end-of-primary tests (doorstroomtoetsen) providers was started, despite earlier promises, and about the PO-Raad analysis showing schools switching providers scored higher. The State Secretary answered that a broad CvTE research programme examines factors such as paper versus digital administration and that the government will address consequences of the test's role in the school-advice system and supervision.
No, this is not correct. Several studies are underway that contribute to answering the question of where the differences between test providers come from.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Er lopen verschillende onderzoeken die bijdragen aan het antwoord op de vraag waar de verschillen tussen toetsaanbieders vandaan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haage en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de Asielnoodmaatregelenwet op het onderwijs

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education whether the Asylum Emergency Measures Act (Asielnoodmaatregelenwet) would create uncertainty and harm for schools, staff, children and parents without valid residence status, and whether it conflicts with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government answered that all children in the Netherlands keep the right to education, that the Minister for Asylum has asked the Council of State for advice on the criminal liability of humanitarian helpers, and that the matter will be debated with parliament after that advice arrives.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de aanhoudende problemen met leerlingenvervoer en Samen naar School-klassen

MP Westerveld asks the state secretary about persistent problems with pupil transport, the effect of leaving the consultation, monitoring, responsibility split between ministries, uithuisplaatsing cases and the closure of a Samen naar School class. The state secretary answers that municipalities are responsible, points to the interdepartmental improvement agenda and a planned monitor repeat in 2026, and promises further talks and information later this year.
However, since pupil transport has been decentralised to municipalities, where implementation takes place, I cannot directly intervene in problems that arise in implementation.

Gezien het feit echter dat het leerlingenvervoer gedecentraliseerd is bij gemeenten en daar de uitvoering wordt vormgegeven – door het college én de gemeenteraad – kan ik niet direct ingrijpen op problemen die zich in de uitvoering voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Kathmann over het emancipatiebeleid van Nederland en de rol van digitalisering

Two MPs (Westerveld and Kathmann, GroenLinks-PvdA) asked about emancipation policy and digitalisation, covering AI bias and discrimination, gender equality and LHBTIQ+ rights in the EU, Roma and Sinti inclusion, and online radicalisation of young men. The government answered each of the 23 questions in substance, pointing to existing tools, EU regulation and ongoing programmes, without addressing parliamentary oversight of the executive directly.
The cabinet rejects all forms of discrimination.
Het kabinet keurt iedere vorm van discriminatie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Westerveld over het bericht 'Transgender teenager is sixth Russian LGBTQ asylum seeker to die in Dutch detention in three years'

MPs Piri and Westerveld asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the death of a transgender Russian asylum seeker in Dutch detention, the safety of LGBTQ asylum seekers, and reporting of incidents. The minister said an evaluation by COA, Nidos and the inspectorates must be awaited before conclusions, that no criminal indications were found, and that data on incidents is not registered for privacy reasons, while outlining existing protection measures.
At this stage it is not appropriate to draw such a conclusion.
Het past in dit stadium niet om een dergelijke conclusie te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Pijpelink over de onderwijstaal op Caribisch Nederland

MPs White and Pijpelink asked the State Secretary of Education about aligning education law for Caribbean Netherlands, school quality on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and the CAS islands, and the role of Dutch versus Papiamentu in schooling. The State Secretary answered that Caribbean Netherlands education is subject to comply-or-explain and separate laws, that quality concerns are being addressed through island education agendas and support, and that Dutch-language and multilingual policy is pursued through ministerial cooperation.
It is worrying that the inspectorate again assesses the education quality of one of the schools as insufficient.
Het is zorgelijk dat de inspectie de onderwijskwaliteit van een van de scholen wederom als onvoldoende beoordeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Ouders die kind van school houden vanwege geloofsovertuiging worden niet meer vervolgd'

MPs asked the State Secretary for Education about press reports that the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has stopped prosecuting parents who keep children out of school for religious or ideological reasons, and whether this creates a precedent and undermines compulsory schooling. The government answered that the OM now prosecutes only formal-ground cases, that it shares concern about rising non-attendance, and that it is exploring alternatives, including possible legislation, reporting back before the summer.
I am examining what options there are to get children who stay at home without permission due to objections arising from their parents' religious conviction or worldview into school as well.

Ik ben aan het bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om kinderen die zonder toestemming thuiszitten vanwege bezwaren die voortkomen uit de geloofsovertuiging of levensopvatting van hun ouders, ook naar school te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ouders die kind van school houden vanwege geloofsovertuiging worden niet meer vervolgd'

Two MPs (Pijpelink and Westerveld) asked the State Secretary of Education about the Public Prosecution Service's decision to stop prosecuting parents who keep children home on grounds of religious or life-conviction objections to schooling, and the risks this poses for children's right to education. The State Secretary answered that the OM made the decision because the legal provisions are interpreted inconsistently, regretted not being informed beforehand, is examining other enforcement options and a possible removal of the exemption, and provided case figures.
I regret that the OM feels compelled to take this decision and that the Ministry of OCW was not informed in advance.
Ik betreur dat het OM zich genoodzaakt ziet om dit besluit te nemen en dat het Ministerie van OCW hier niet van te voren op de hoogte is gesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heite en Becker over de ANBI-status van Civitas Christiana in verband met de rechterlijke uitspraak over onrechtmatige uitlatingen die Rutgers in verband brengen met pedofilie

MPs Heite and Becker asked whether the ANBI tax-exempt status of Civitas Christiana should be reviewed after a court ruled it had unlawfully linked Rutgers to paedophilia, and whether the ANBI framework is adequate. The Secretary of State answered that tax confidentiality prevents comment on individual institutions, that the public-benefit test is deliberately neutral, that status is revoked only on limited legal grounds such as a final criminal conviction, and that the cabinet will respond to the ANBI evaluation and explore adding criminal offences before summer.
Because the Tax and Customs Administration is bound by the confidentiality duty of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no further information can be provided about individual institutions.
Omdat de Belastingdienst gehouden is aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de BNN/VARA-documentaire ‘Hoe familievloggers zoals de Bellinga’s hun kinderen in gevaar kunnen brengen’

An MP asked the state secretaries about the BNNVARA documentary on family vloggers and children's exposure to commercial exploitation, including regulation, children's wellbeing, the Children's Ombudsman's concerns, and platform responsibility. The government acknowledges current law is not suited to 'kidfluencing', announces amending regulation and parents' awareness campaigns, but leaves platform and age-verification matters to EU-level coordination.
To better protect children from the harmful influence of this, I will amend the existing laws and regulations.
Om kinderen beter te beschermen tegen de nadelige invloed hiervan ga ik de bestaande de wet- regelgeving aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Kisteman en Heite over het bericht 'Civitas Christiana voert al jaren een leugen– en lastercampagne tegen Rutgers

MPs Becker, Kisteman and Heite asked the State Secretary of Education about Civitas Christiana's campaign against Rutgers, including its impact on schools, desinformation, foreign influence and the motion on foreign funding. The State Secretary answered that schools must be free from external pressure, pointed to a court ruling against Civitas and to existing support tools, and said the motion on foreign funding is being followed up through consultations and pending legislation.
In addition, the bill on free and safe education will make a confidential counsellor mandatory at every school.
Daarnaast wordt met het wetsvoorstel vrij en veilig onderwijs een vertrouwenspersoon op elke school verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Pijpelink over de Week van de Lentekriebels

MPs Westerveld and Pijpelink asked the state secretaries of Education and Health about misinformation campaigns against the Week van de Lentekriebels and its effect on school participation. The government acknowledged the misinformation as harmful, noted participation fell from 43.2% to 35%, and promised continued support, information efforts and curriculum safeguards while stressing school autonomy.
Spreading incorrect and incomplete information is harmful.
Het verspreiden van onjuiste en onvolledige informatie is schadelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uppelschoten en Wilders over signalen van islamisering in het Nederlandse onderwijs

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary for Education about reports of religiously motivated pressure, intimidation of teachers, and antisemitism in Dutch schools, and whether schools' neutrality and safety are being undermined. The state secretary condemned such conduct, pointed to existing duties (civic education, neutrality, safety care) and the inspectorate's enforcement, and said a Vrij en veilig onderwijs bill with an incident-reporting duty is in preparation, but declined an independent investigation.

Are you willing to have independently investigated the extent to which religious pressure, antisemitism and administrative looking away undermine freedom of education, the safety of pupils and teachers, and equality within schools?

Bent u bereid om onafhankelijk te laten onderzoeken in hoeverre religieuze druk, antisemitisme en bestuurlijk wegkijken de onderwijsvrijheid, de veiligheid van leerlingen en docenten en de gelijkwaardigheid binnen de school aantasten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over herstelopdrachten van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs

The MP asked how many remedial orders the Inspectorate of Education issued to primary schools over five years, and how many concerned arithmetic and language teaching. The State Secretary answered that 1,440 orders were issued in 2024, that earlier totals are not centrally available, and that orders are not broken down by subject in general, though 18 arithmetic and 48 language orders arose from sampled inspections in 2024.
For the years before 2024 the full figures are not available, because the total number of remedial orders has no function in accountability at system level.
Voor de jaren voor 2024 zijn de volledige cijfers niet beschikbaar, omdat het totale aantal herstelopdrachten geen functie heeft in de verantwoording op stelselniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uppelschoten over de structurele gedragscrisis in het Nederlandse onderwijs

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Education about a reported crisis in classroom discipline, linking poor behaviour to weaker learning outcomes, teacher authority and school safety, and asked about zero-tolerance measures. The State Secretary said causation cannot be firmly established, pointed to the Herstelplan and planned attention to classroom management, noted that schools and employers are responsible for discipline and teacher training, and referred to a Wetsvoorstel vrij en veilig onderwijs and school safety support.
In the debate on educational opportunities I committed to also paying attention to maintaining order and classroom management in the elaboration of this plan.
In het debat over onderwijskansen heb ik toegezegd in de uitwerking van dit plan ook aandacht te hebben voor het orde houden en klassenmanagement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uppelschoten en Wilders over islamitische iftars en/of gebedsmomenten op openbare scholen

MPs Uppelschoten and Wilders asked whether an Islamic iftar with prayer at Einstein Lyceum, and similar events at public schools, are compatible with the neutrality of public education, and how many schools hold them. The State Secretary answered that schools may hold religious activities provided no single religion is favoured and no religious acts are imposed, that the Inspectorate will act if this is breached, and that no figures on such events are kept.
I do not know when and how often public schools organise iftars or other religious gatherings such as Chanukah celebrations, Diwali or Christmas celebrations.
Bij mij is niet bekend wanneer en hoe vaak openbare scholen iftars of andere religieuze bijeenkomsten zoals Chanoekavieringen, Diwali of kerstvieringen organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de zienswijze van scholen die weigeren de doorstroomtoets uit te voeren

MP Rooderkerk asked the State Secretary for Education how the government responds to schools' objections to the doorstroomtoets (transition test) and the claims of excessive differentiation and weak validity of the test. The State Secretary defends the test as an objective second input to school advice, rejects the claim of over-differentiation, and promises further discussion and a letter in April.
The transition test offers pupils an objective second data point alongside the provisional school advice.
De doorstroomtoets biedt leerlingen een objectief, tweede gegeven bij het voorlopige schooladvies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht 'Basisscholen die weigerden om doorstroomtoets af te nemen krijgen ultimatum'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about primary schools that refused to administer the mandatory end-of-primary transition test and about the risks and parental information involved. The State Secretary answered that the test is legally required and serves students' interests, that schools must be held to the law, and that a new test scenario will be outlined in an April letter to parliament.
If schools do not administer the transition test, I am therefore obliged, in the interest of pupils, to enforce the law.
In het geval dat scholen geen doorstroomtoets afnemen ben ik dan ook genoodzaakt om, in het belang van de leerlingen, de wet te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heite over het artikel ‘VN-rapport: vrouwenrechten onder grote druk, discriminatie diep verankerd’

The MP asks about a UN report on women's rights in the Netherlands, the Global Gender Gap ranking, the pay gap, the top-position quota, femicide and female genital mutilation. The Secretary of State answers that an Emancipation Note will be sent before the summer recess and describes existing measures on financial independence, pay transparency and the quota, but gives no new concrete measures beyond promised letters.
Before the summer I will send the House the Emancipation Note elaborating these priorities.
Voor de zomer stuur ik uw Kamer de Emancipatienota waarin ik de genoemde prioriteiten uitwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de emancipatie van lhbtqia+ personen en vrouwen in Nederland

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the emancipation of LGBTQIA+ people and women, including rising discrimination, budget cuts to emancipation subsidies, intersex children's medical treatment, parenthood law, asylum shelter safety, X gender markers and evaluation of discrimination detectives. The State Secretary answers that the government takes discrimination seriously, cites monitoring showing mixed but partly hopeful trends, says budget cuts do not affect ongoing subsidies, and promises a letter on intersex treatment, an evaluation of Regenboogsteden, and sharing the discrimination-detective evaluation via a police letter in June 2025, while referring several questions to earlier letters or other responsible actors.
I will shortly send a letter to your House informing you about the follow-up process and the associated timeline.
Ik zal op korte termijn een brief aan uw Kamer sturen waarin ik u informeer over het vervolgproces en bijbehorend tijdspad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Leerlingen mogen niet bidden op school: ‘Als je wordt gepakt krijg je straf’

MP Ergin (DENK) asked the state secretary for Education about reports that over 180 secondary schools ban prayer, and whether this breaches pupils' rights. The state secretary replied that public schools may not forbid prayer but need not facilitate it, that pupils can seek redress via the Equal Treatment Commission, courts or the Inspectorate, and that no additional measures or guidelines are planned.
If pupils nevertheless feel discriminated against, I call on them to discuss this with the school before taking legal steps.
Als leerlingen zich toch gediscrimineerd voelen, dan roep ik ze op om daarover met de school in gesprek te gaan vóórdat ze juridische stappen ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over het bericht ‘Dilemma’s door de doorstroomtoets: scholen doen met tegenzin mee of haken af omdat ze de toets niet meer vertrouwen’

An MP asked whether primary schools refusing the doorstroomtoets (transition test) would leave pupils without a definitive school advice and how to handle this. The State Secretary answered that the four schools involved now plan to administer the test during the catch-up period, that the test is legally required for a definitive advice except for statutory exemptions, and that the government will intervene if schools refuse.
For all these reasons I see myself obliged to intervene when a school refuses to administer the transition test.
Om al deze redenen zie ik mij genoodzaakt in te grijpen wanneer een school weigert de doorstroomtoets af te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht ‘Staatssecretaris Paul stelt ultimatum: 'weigerscholen' moeten voor 7 maart doorstroomtoets maken’’

An MP asks the state secretary about the refusal of some primary schools to administer the transition test (doorstroomtoets) after sanctions were threatened, and what this means for pupils whose advice may be underestimated. The state secretary answers that the test is a second objective signal that helps pupils at risk of underadvice, that the school's advice remains decisive but should normally be adjusted if the test shows more capacity, and that the test also informs inspectorate monitoring.
I will communicate the final figures for school year 2023–2024 to the House in April, including breakdowns by various groups of pupils.
Ik communiceer de definitieve cijfers over schooljaar 2023–2024 in april met uw Kamer, waarbij ook uitsplitsingen worden gemaakt naar diverse groepen leerlingen.

Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Stoffer en Westerveld over de berichten 'Wie betaalt voor zorg op school? In Limburg krijgen ouders van kwetsbare kinderen de rekening' en 'Vage facturen en creatief boekhouden op M

MPs Stoffer and Westerveld asked the state secretary about reports that Limburg schools for disabled children pressure parents to transfer part of their personal care budgets (pgb) to the school, and whether this is lawful and transparent. The state secretary answered that such arrangements are permissible in agreement with parents, that the Inspectorate has not investigated the use of care funds and has no legal task to do so, and that a new care-in-school policy aims to improve transparency.
The Inspectorate of Education has not conducted any investigation into the use of care funds.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft naar de besteding van zorgmiddelen geen onderzoek gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over Leerlingen die thuiszitten zonder onderwijs en de financiële reserves van Samenwerkingsverbanden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about unspent reserves at special-needs cooperation bodies (samenwerkingsverbanden), where the money went, the number of truants, and their publicly available data. The State Secretary answered that excess reserves have fallen sharply, that the Inspectorate monitors spending and salaries, that the ministry is reviewing how these bodies function, and that data is partly available online.
The inspectorate supervises the spending of funds.
De inspectie houdt toezicht op besteding van middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Nispen over de beantwoording van Kamervragen d.d. 3 oktober 2024 over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen ask about the responsibility of dance sport federations (NADB) for misconduct, the lack of apology and recognition for a whistleblower, the absence of mandatory VOG checks, the independence of the CVSN reporting centre, and the reach of the Alliantie Dans Veilig. The Secretary of State answers that federations have limited responsibility, that a whistleblower meeting will be arranged, that VOG remains voluntary and that a law to create an independent integrity centre is in preparation.
To strengthen social safety in sport, I am currently working on a bill that will lead to the establishment of an independent integrity centre, which will also separate the CVSN from NOC*NSF.

Om sociale veiligheid in de sport te versterken, werk ik momenteel aan een wetsvoorstel dat zal leiden tot de oprichting van een onafhankelijk integriteitscentrum, waarmee het CVSN tevens wordt losgekoppeld van NOC*NSF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uppelschoten over het stopzetten van subsidie aan stichting 'Na de Oorlog'

An MP asked the state secretary why the grant to foundation 'Na de Oorlog', which gives guest lessons on the Holocaust and antisemitism, was ended and given to Fawaka, an organisation focused on decolonisation, and questioned Fawaka's expertise and links to radical views. The secretary replied that the project subsidy simply expired under the agreement, that Fawaka won the tender on the three published criteria, and that there is no reason to doubt its competence and no reason to reconsider the award.
The subsidy for foundation Na de Oorlog was a project subsidy implementing an amendment by MPs Ellian (VVD) and Segers (CU) to the 2023 budget.
De subsidie voor stichting Na de Oorlog was een projectsubsidie ter invulling van een amendement van de leden Ellian (VVD) en Segers (CU) op de begroting van 2023
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Harde klap voor gastlessen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education why the stichting Na de Oorlog lost a tender for teacher support on antisemitism lessons, and whether the tender criteria, process and winner (Fawaka) were appropriate. The State Secretary answered that the 2023 subsidy and the 2024 tender stem from separate amendments, that the tender was run correctly with relevant expertise as a criterion, and announced new subsidy schemes and tenders for 2025.
The tender process was carefully conducted in accordance with the applicable guidelines of the General Government Terms and Conditions for Services (ARVODI).
Het aanbestedingsproces is zorgvuldig verlopen volgens de daarvoor geldende richtlijnen van de Algemene Rijksinkoopvoorwaarden voor diensten (ARVODI).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Een derde van de schoolbestuurders laat zich maximaal belonen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about a report that a third of school board members are paid up to the WNT maximum, and about exceeding the cap in 51 cases, plus pay, cao, cost, and cumulation questions. The State Secretary says the supervisory board sets pay within the WNT, overruns were mostly optical and checked by the accountant and Inspectorate, and a bill on governance and integrity is planned.
If there is in fact a violation, the Inspectorate of Education can take enforcement action.
Indien er wel sprake is van een overtreding dan kan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Op veel scholen wordt gehandeld in vuurwerk, inclusief cobra’s en nitraten'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that illegal fireworks, including cobras and nitrates, are traded at many schools and whether national guidelines exist. The State Secretary said general national rules apply, schools have a safety duty, and the Wet vrij en veilig onderwijs will add incident registration and reporting to the Inspectorate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over kinderopvang voor speciaal onderwijs

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of out-of-school care for children in special education and whether a statutory obligation similar to that for primary schools should be extended to special schools. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, noted that a legal obligation is complex and costly, and committed to discussing the option with the sector and developing a guidance document.
We will discuss and explore the possibilities of a statutory obligation as one of the options with the field.
We zullen de mogelijkheden van een wettelijke verplichting als een van de opties bespreken en verkennen met het veld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht 'Veel schade bij basisschool na brand begint nu wel een patroon te worden'

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Education whether arson and vandalism at an Islamic primary school showed a worrying pattern, whether threats to Islamic institutions were tracked, and what preventive measures would be taken. The State Secretary said he had no signals of heightened threat, that such incidents are the responsibility of police, prosecutors and the municipality, that the ministry keeps no overview of threats to schools, and that the Inspectorate supervises school safety, while largely referring the matter to other bodies.
Such an overview is not maintained by the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.
Een dergelijk overzicht wordt niet door het Ministerie van OCW bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paulusma over het artikel 'Aidsfonds maakt zich zorgen over stijging hiv-infecties bij jonge mannen'

MPs Rooderkerk and Paulusma asked the State Secretary of Health about rising HIV diagnoses among young men, the effectiveness of PrEP and condom campaigns, budget cuts to prevention, and whether Amsterdam's approach can be scaled nationally. The State Secretary acknowledged the rise, described PrEP-care and prevention measures, said that cuts to specific grants are under review with decisions due early next year, and promised a monitoring update before summer.
I will inform your House about this in more detail before the summer.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover voor de zomer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'AOB waarschuwt voor 'onopgemerkte bezuiniging': in Randstad vanaf 2026 minder geld voor leraren.'

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the abolition of the Randstad salary function-mix scheme for secondary teachers from 2026, its financial impact on schools, and whether a phase-in path or reversal is possible. The state secretary confirmed the cuts, said a phase-in is not necessary, refused to reverse the measure, and promised to share the financial analysis with parliament.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de berichten ‘Kleine scholen kunnen ‘zomaar’ worden opgeheven’ en ‘Zorgen over toekomst van Amelander basisschool: “Dan vergrijst het dorp”

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about reports that small primary schools can be closed easily, including a case on Ameland, and about the effect on village life and quality. The government answers that closures are mostly mergers, that closure norms are differentiated by municipality, that small schools matter for liveability, and that it will inform parliament before year end on a differentiated rural supplement and a review of the closure system.
I intend to inform your House further on this before the end of the year.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer hier nog voor het einde van het jaar nader over te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over het onderzoek van Nieuwsuur naar de basisschoolbezoeken van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs, waaruit blijkt dat de inspectie ernstig verzuimd heeft om scholen te inspecteren

An MP asked the Education Minister how the Inspectorate could fail to visit all primary schools every four years, whether the policy choice was justified and communicated to Parliament, and what improvements are planned. The Minister acknowledged the shortfall and the incomplete reporting, announced an external audit by the Auditdienst Rijk and a registration improvement plan, and said the Inspectorate had dropped the four-year cycle in 2021, while several questions about historical data were deferred until the audit is complete.
We intend to commission an independent external investigation into the reports on the Inspectorate's visits to schools in primary and secondary education.
Wij zijn voornemens om een onafhankelijk en extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de rapportages over de bezoeken van de inspectie aan scholen in het funderend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Inspectie bezoekt al jaren veel minder basisscholen dan aan Kamer is beloofd'

An MP asks whether the Inspectorate of Education met its 2007 commitment to visit every primary school every four years, given poor registration and a visit gap of about one third, and how it plans to fix this. The minister admits the commitment was not met, announces an independent external investigation by the Auditdienst Rijk, and promises a verification plan for registration plus a later letter on the new inspection framework.
We intend to commission an independent and external investigation into the reports on the inspectorate's visits to schools in primary and secondary education.
Wij zijn voornemens een onafhankelijk en extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de rapportages over de bezoeken van de inspectie aan scholen in het funderend onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het rapport ‘Van wet naar werkelijkheid: Bewegingsonderwijs op de Basisschool’

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about a Mulier Institute report finding about a third of primary schools fail the 90-minute weekly physical education norm, and asked what support, facilities, teacher recruitment and enforcement steps would follow. The government says it expects all schools to comply, notes the earmarked subsidy ended and funds moved into the general subsidy budget, delegates facility duties to municipalities, and says the Inspectorate can issue a remedial order.
I expect all schools to comply with the statutory obligations that apply to education, including the hours norm for physical education.
Ik verwacht van alle scholen dat ze voldoen aan de wettelijke verplichtingen die gelden voor het onderwijs, inclusief de urennorm voor bewegingsonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pijpelink en Westerveld over reclame voor en samenwerking met extern aanvullend onderwijs

MPs Pijpelink and Westerveld asked the State Secretary of Education about schools advertising or cooperating with commercial supplementary tutoring providers despite government guidelines, and about inequality, municipal funding and a possible legal ban. The State Secretary answered that the 2025 Monitor will assess the effect of the guidelines, that further measures will be considered if they prove ineffective, and that no statutory ban or municipal agreements are planned for now.
If it turns out that the guidelines are not sufficiently effective, I will consider possible follow-up measures.
Indien blijkt dat de richtlijnen niet afdoende effectief zijn, zal ik mij beraden op eventuele vervolgmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht ‘’Olifant in kamer’ blijft ongenoemd in debat over dalende homoacceptatie'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about declining acceptance of same-sex relationships among young people, including in Amsterdam, and the role of religious, cultural and social media factors. The State Secretary acknowledged the decline as troubling, pointed to mixed research evidence, and committed to commissioning a study on the causes with results expected by summer 2025, while declining to request a separate national study from the SCP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over Het bericht 'Tien jaar Passend Onderwijs: hogere kosten en meer thuiszitters'

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Education why special education enrolment and the number of children staying at home without schooling keep rising ten years after the introduction of Passend Onderwijs, and how this relates to the aims of inclusive education, funding and exemptions. The State Secretary answers all questions in substance, attributing the rise to broader social developments and staff shortages, setting out short, medium and long-term measures, and announcing the Terugdringen Verzuim bill and further research into absolute truancy.
I will soon submit the Terugdringen Verzuim bill.
Daarom dien ik binnenkort het wetsvoorstel Terugdringen Verzuim in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht «School van Anneloes kost ouders 7.100 euro per jaar: «Dag begint niet met wiskunde, maar meditatie»»

The MP asks the state secretary about a news report on a costly private school (B3-school) with meditation-focused mornings, including numbers of applications, reasons parents choose such schools, teacher employment, lighter requirements and homeschooling oversight. The state secretary reports 85 inspection advisory visits in 2020-2023 with only a handful of negative advice, explains that private schools face fewer regulations because there is no funding relationship, and says a bill setting minimum homeschooling requirements is being prepared.
The Ministry of OCW has no overview of the number of teachers working at a B3 school, and therefore also not whether teachers at a B3 school are employed permanently or as freelancers.
Het Ministerie van OCW heeft geen overzicht van het aantal docenten dat op een b3-school werkt, en dus ook niet of docenten op een b3-school in vast dienstverband of als zzp-er werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uppelschoten over het bericht 'Kinderen voor wie geen plaats is op school zijn een goudmijn voor slimme ondernemers'

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Education about a Follow the Money report on private 'stay-at-home' (thuiszitters) initiatives using unproven methods, and how quality and misuse of public funds are controlled. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate supervises schools and partnerships, that privately funded initiatives outside OCW funding have no supervision, and that a bill on tailored education-care solutions with additional quality requirements is being prepared.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, however, there are also initiatives that are not subject to any supervision.
Zoals in antwoord op vraag 2 aangegeven bestaan er echter ook initiatieven waar geen toezicht op is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Beckerman, Pijpelink en Ergin over het delen van alternatieve opties voor het uitstellen van de curriculumherziening

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Education to share a scenario exploration document on revising the core objectives (kerndoelen) before a committee debate on the curriculum reform. The State Secretary refused, citing the convention that documents prepared for cabinet and sub-committee deliberations are not made public to protect cabinet unity.
In line with cabinet-wide disclosure policy, documents prepared for the Council of Ministers and its sub-committees are in principle not made public in order to safeguard the unity of cabinet policy.

In lijn met het kabinetsbrede beleid rondom openbaarmaking worden stukken ter voorbereiding van de ministerraad en onderraden in principe niet openbaar gemaakt om de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht 'Basisscholen bestookt met ‘linkse’ lespakketten: Het is echt dagelijkse spam’

Kisteman (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that primary schools are flooded with unsolicited, 'left-leaning' teaching packages, and whether schools are protected against one-sided information and commercial interests. The State Secretary said schools are free to choose materials within the law, expressed concern about the overload and called on providers to be restrained, but declined to inventory package use and did not propose binding rules.
Given the constitutional freedom of education regarding teaching materials, it does not fit my responsibility to carry out an inventory of the use of teaching packages.
Gezien de grondwettelijke onderwijsvrijheid ten aanzien van leermiddelen past het niet bij mijn verantwoordelijkheid om een inventarisatie te doen naar het gebruik van lespakketten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht ‘Pleidooi voor AI-richtlijn op scholen: 'Risico's groot, bewustzijn laag'’

Rooderkerk (D66) asked the State Secretary for Education about an AOb call for an AI guideline in schools, student data flowing to AI companies, teacher preparedness, algorithmic discrimination risks in adaptive learning tools, and oversight of programs like Snappet. The State Secretary answered that schools choose their own AI tools under GDPR and the EU AI Act, that national bodies like NOLAI and Kennisnet provide guidance, and that she will talk with the education sector without committing to a national AI guideline.
I have no insight into how students use AI at home to produce assignments and homework.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de manier waarop leerlingen thuis gebruik maken van AI voor het maken van werkstukken en huiswerkopdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis, Inge van Dijk, van Eijk en Paulusma over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs from several parties asked the government why victims of abuse in the dance world feel that compensation, apologies and trauma care are missing, and why the answers to earlier questions were so cold. The government replies that it relies on the Alliantie Dans Veilig and two new commissions, refers trauma care to existing mental health providers, says compensation is for the sector and civil or criminal law, and promises continued involvement without committing to new measures.
As for compensation for victims, that is a matter for the sector itself. It is not the role of the government here.
Wat betreft een tegemoetkoming aan slachtoffers is dat aan de sector zelf. Dat is hier niet de rol van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Pijpelink over het bericht 'Gebruik laptop op veel scholen verplicht, lang niet elke ouder kan dat betalen'

An MP asked the state secretary for education about reports that laptops are mandatory at many schools while not all parents can afford them, and about the growing number of requests to charities like Stichting Leergeld. The state secretary said schools must provide a full alternative if parents cannot pay, that devices are not covered by the Free Schoolbooks Act, and that an inquiry into device access will report this autumn.
If parents cannot or will not pay for a laptop, the school must ensure a full alternative.
Als ouders een laptop niet kunnen of willen betalen moet de school zorgen voor een volwaardig alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Becker over de nieuwe vo-school van Soner Atasoy

MPs De Kort and Becker asked about the new secondary school founded by Soner Atasoy despite his dismissal as board member of Cornelis Haga Lyceum and AIVD warnings, and about the criteria for school board eligibility, the Tilburg Islamic school, and the 15 km catchment area. The Staatssecretaris answered that Atasoy met all legal requirements, announced a bill to set stricter board requirements for all boards, and deferred structural changes (such as municipal consent rights) until the evaluation of the new founding law at the end of 2025.
My ministry is currently working on a bill that sets further requirements for school boards.
Momenteel werkt mijn ministerie aan een wetsvoorstel waarin nadere eisen worden gesteld aan schoolbesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over “Tientallen schoolbestuurders privé actief bij onderwijsadviesbureaus”

An MP asked the state secretary about school board members holding paid roles at education advisory firms, conflicts of interest, and the privatised education support market.
