The state secretary called conflicts of interest unacceptable, pointed to existing legal duties and planned legislation, and promised to inform parliament this autumn about regulating the advisory market.
If there is a conflict of interest, I consider this undesirable and unacceptable.
Als er sprake is van belangenverstrengeling vind ik dit onwenselijk en ontoelaatbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Hoeff over het bericht “Hoe schoolbestuurders zakendoen met bekenden en zichzelf”

An MP asks whether school board members and supervisors who also hold paid roles at private education advisory firms create conflicts of interest, and why OCW and the Inspectorate cannot intervene. The Secretary of State calls such conflicts unacceptable, points to existing civil-code and governance-code rules and inspectorate enforcement, and promises a bill on governance and internal supervision with consultation expected by end of December, plus a letter in autumn on regulating the advisory market.
Board members and internal supervisors must be beyond any doubt.
Bestuurders en intern toezichthouders moeten boven elke twijfel verheven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht “Tientallen schoolbestuurders privé actief bij onderwijsadviesbureaus”

An MP asked the state secretary for education about reports that dozens of school board members are also active for education advisory firms, and whether this conflict of interest and the quality and integrity rules for board members and advisers are adequate. The state secretary called such conflicts unacceptable, pointed to existing civil law and inspectorate powers, and announced a bill on minimum integrity and quality requirements for school boards and internal supervision, plus a review of the advisory market with a letter to parliament this autumn.
It is not known how many education board members have given up their secondary positions.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel onderwijsbestuurders nevenfuncties hebben opgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat minder dan de helft van de lhbti+ personen vindt dat het goed gaat met acceptatie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about a survey showing only 47% of LGBTI+ people think acceptance is going well, and about measures against conservative and foreign influence, and the follow-up on the LGBTI safety action plan. The State Secretary agreed action is needed, announced a study into causes of declining acceptance due in summer 2025, and promised further letters on safety measures, while noting existing disinformation strategy.
I will commission this research this autumn and expect the results of the study before summer 2025.
Ik zet dit najaar de onderzoeksopdracht uit, en verwacht de resultaten van het onderzoek voor de zomer van 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over de doorstroomtoets

An MP asked the State Secretary about the 2024 doorstroomtoets: the fall in vwo advice, the higher upward adjustment of advice for pupils from low-SES families, differences between test providers and regions, and whether action is needed. The State Secretary answered that the vwo share fell about 4 percentage points on definitive figures, that the new upward-adjustment rule is working with about three-quarters of eligible pupils adjusted, that differences between test providers are under study, and that further monitoring and action are planned.

I am pleased that the final DUO data show that schools in 2024 responded well to the new measure: three quarters of pupils with a higher test result than the provisional school advice received an adjusted advice.

Ik ben blij dat uit de definitieve data van DUO blijkt dat scholen in 2024 goed gehoor hebben gegeven aan de nieuwe maatregel: driekwart van de leerlingen met een hoger toetsresultaat dan het voorlopig schooladvies kreeg een bijgesteld advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht 'Minder dan helft Amsterdamse jongeren zegt homoseksualiteit te accepteren'

An MP asked the government about a report that fewer than half of Amsterdam youths accept homosexuality, and about causes, school obligations and planned action. The State Secretary answered that acceptance has fallen sharply in the Gezondheidsmonitor Jeugd, that no causal research exists, that data cover only the regions surveyed, and that the government will consult COC and others and encourage Amsterdam to act.
I will share these reports with your House.
Ik zal deze rapporten met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Kisteman over het bericht «Steeds meer Twentse scholen vinden Paarse Vrijdag maar gedoe»

MPs Becker and Kisteman asked the State Secretary of Education about a report that more Twente schools find Paarse Vrijdag (Purple Friday, an LGBTIQ+ awareness initiative) burdensome, and about acceptance, safety, and support for LGBTIQ+ pupils. The answers affirm the importance of sexual diversity education, report COC-coordinated participation by nearly 3,000 school locations, describe ministry subsidies and support for GSAs, and promise talks with Twente schools and further follow-up on the evaluation of the safety action plan.
I am happy to discuss this with the Twente secondary schools and the Healthy School Programme
Ik ga hier graag over in gesprek met de Twentse middelbare scholen en het Programma Gezonde School
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de niet nagekomen afspraken aan de organisatie Digibende

An MP asks why promised funding for Digibende, a non-state-funded truancy initiative, has not materialised and what will be done. The State Secretary says direct funding is not possible, promises a subsidy scheme for school partnerships expected to open in spring 2025, and says the original commitment has been explored but not met.
Digibende will be able to use the planned subsidy scheme for partnerships in the same way as other unfunded truancy initiatives.
Digibende kan straks wel op dezelfde wijze gebruik maken van de beoogde subsidieregeling voor samenwerkingsverbanden zoals andere niet-bekostigde thuiszittersinitiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Maandenlang geen chauffeurs voorleerlingenvervoer: 'Kinderen staan op straat''

An SP MP asked the minister about news reports that around 600 pupils in the Utrecht region could not be transported to school after the summer due to a shortage of drivers, and about contingency measures and responsibilities. The state secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, that they are arranging alternative transport and parental compensation, and that the sector-wide driver shortage is being addressed through a broader improvement agenda.
First and foremost, it is up to the Utrecht region to get pupil transport in order together.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de regio Utrecht om samen het leerlingenvervoer op orde te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over budget voor de ondersteuning van leerlingen

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about Rotterdam's special-needs cooperative (PPO Rotterdam) closing its student support budget for 2023-2024, its large reserves, rising truancy, and whether the generic reserve cut and related motions were working. The minister answers that students still get support through school contact persons, the Inspectorate has no signals of students falling through, the budget closed because it was fully spent, and that the reserve cut and follow-up agreements are being monitored and will be reported in the budget debate.
Should students or parents nonetheless have questions about the application stop or the solutions offered, they can contact the relevant school contact person at PPO Rotterdam.

Mochten er onverhoopt toch leerlingen of ouders zijn met vragen over de aanvragenstop of de geboden oplossingsmogelijkheden, dan kunnen zij contact opnemen met de betrokken schoolcontactpersoon van PPO Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het artikel 'Prostitutie, drugs en vechtpartijen: meer heftige incidenten op middelbare scholen'

The MP De Kort asks the minister for Primary and Secondary Education about rising severe safety incidents at secondary schools, including causes, whether schools' tools are adequate, longer suspensions or expulsions, mandatory reporting to police, locker checks, police presence, data sharing, and reporting. The minister answers that school safety is unacceptable and points to the forthcoming Wetsvoorstel vrij en veilig onderwijs and a letter before summer, declining mandatory suspension changes, a mandatory reporting duty, and routine locker rotation while promising a letter and some reporting.
In this short timeframe it is not possible to gain insight into this.
Op deze korte termijn lukt het niet om hier inzicht in te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over de sluiting van de Van Brienenoordschool in Rotterdam

An MP asked the minister why the Van Brienenoordschool's education quality was not acted on earlier, how former pupils (spread over about 25 schools) are monitored and funded for catching up, and how a repeat can be prevented. The minister answered that the inspectorate found the school adequate in 2020, intervened in 2022 after risk signals, that the board closed the school, that inspection does not monitor individual pupils' results, that receiving schools must catch up largely on their own with limited coordinated funding, and that boards bear primary responsibility.
Inspection supervision takes place at the level of schools and boards, including the schools and boards concerned here.
Het toezicht van de inspectie vindt plaats op het niveau van scholen en besturen, ook de scholen en besturen waar het hier om gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van Westerveld over Samen naar School Klassen

An MP asks the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the number, funding, and failure of Samen naar Schoolklassen initiatives, age limits, legal barriers to secondary enrolment, and the status of the Westerveld-Kwint motion. The Minister says the number of initiatives is not centrally recorded but exceeds 50, that no specific funding rules exist, that the handreiking and NSGK support are in place, and that secondary-level options and possible legislative changes will be explored.
The number of Samen naar Schoolklassen is not centrally registered by the Ministry of OCW, so these are not known.
Het aantal Samen naar Schoolklassen wordt niet centraal door het Ministerie van OCW geregistreerd, dus deze zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over te lage schooladviezen voor bijna de helft van de Drentse basisschoolleerlingen

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about under-advising of Drenthe primary pupils (schooladviezen lower than end-test results) and whether final advice should be postponed until after the third year of secondary school. The minister answered that a new measure requiring schools to adjust advice upward, and ongoing research and monitoring, are in place, and that regional differences will be tracked, with further policy to follow.
Through the annual DUO Monitor on school advice and transfer test we closely monitor how this new measure affects the transfer and opportunities of pupils.
Via de jaarlijkse DUO Monitor schooladvies en doorstroomtoets houden we scherp in de gaten hoe deze nieuwe maatregel uitwerkt op de doorstroom en kansen van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Extern ingehuurde docenten voor scholen bijna twee keer zo duur'

MP Rooderkerk asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that externally hired teachers cost nearly twice as much, and about the growth of hiring, why permanent teachers leave, and what the government will do. The minister answered that personnel not in employment (PNIL) rose from 2.5% to 4.4% of personnel costs in primary education and from 2.3% to 4.4% in secondary education, that a planned bill (SHRM) aims to curb external hiring, and that research into teachers' motives is underway with results expected end of this year.
Whether teachers leave their permanent posts and are then hired back in education cannot be determined from the PNIL data for 2022 and 2023 due to insufficient data.
Of leerkrachten uit dienst gaan en zich vervolgens laten inhuren in het onderwijs kan ik door onvoldoende gegevens niet uit de PNIL-uitvraag van 2022 en 2023 halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het bericht ‘hoe wenselijk zijn islamitische scholen?’

MPs Becker and De Kort asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether Islamic schools' rules (gender-segregated classes, pop-music ban, resilience training against LGBTIQ+ ideology) fit the civic-education duty, and how the inspectorate checks this. The minister says segregation and such teaching are not desirable but are allowed under conditions, that the inspectorate supervises the civic-education duty, and that no talks with schools are currently needed.
The inspectorate will investigate the named schools further if it sees reason to do so.
De inspectie zal nader onderzoek doen naar de genoemde scholen, als zij daar aanleiding toe ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Onrust op basisscholen over uitkomsten nieuwe doorstroomtoets: ‘Dit klopt gewoon niet’'

An MP asked the minister about school leaders doubting the reliability of the new end-of-primary (doorstroom) test, its effect on equal opportunity, the weighting of test results against teacher judgement, the multiple commercial providers, the absence of a pilot, and the CvTE review. The minister defended the new norming and the rule requiring schools to revise advice when a higher test result is obtained, promised a full analysis after summer 2024, and declined to provide complaint figures per provider, referring the MP to the providers.
I do not have this data. For this I refer you to the providers of the end-of-primary tests.
Ik beschik niet over deze gegevens. Hiervoor verwijs ik u naar de aanbieders van de doorstroomtoetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Soepboer over de berichten ‘Op welk nijpend probleem zijn deze nieuwe kerndoelen een antwoord’ en ‘Curriculumherziening stevent af op mislukking’

An MP asks whether added civics and digital-skills content will overload teachers or hollow out existing subjects, and whether the Chamber should get earlier say over the curriculum revision. The Minister replies that clearer, more concrete core goals will reduce overload, that the Chamber has been informed at several points and will get a technical briefing and a nahang procedure before the goals take effect.
The Chamber has and will have every opportunity to express its views on the curriculum and the current revision, even before the pilot phase.
De Kamer heeft en krijgt dus alle gelegenheid om zich – nog voor de pilotfase – uit te spreken over het curriculum en de huidige herziening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de stille reserve in het onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports of a teacher shortage 'stille reserve' of at least 6,000 people, why many qualified teachers left, how many left after short periods, and what is being done to bring them back. The minister answered that teacher retention and return are being addressed through salary increases, workload funds, the professionalisation agenda, regional education partnerships and reports on reasons for leaving, but gave no new commitments beyond existing policy.
Question 4: How many people with a teaching qualification no longer work as teachers but do work in a role related to education?
Vraag 4 Hoeveel mensen met een lesbevoegdheid werken niet meer als leraar, maar wel in een functie rondom het onderwijs?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over achterblijvende investeringen in onderwijshuisvesting

An MP asked the minister about poor acoustics in gymnasiums causing hearing damage to gym teachers, the share of non-compliant gyms, school boards' capacity to meet their duty of care, and progress on the IBO school-building recommendations. The minister answered that employers bear the duty of care, that the ministry cannot map non-compliant gyms because municipalities own many of them, and listed ongoing measures such as a housing-planning bill and a programmatic approach.
The Ministry of OCW therefore cannot show how many gyms do or do not meet the noise standards.
Het Ministerie van OCW kan daarom niet inzichtelijk maken hoeveel gymzalen wel of niet voldoen aan de geluidsnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over inclusief onderwijs

An MP asks how the Inspectorate of Education takes inclusive education into account in its supervision, whether inspection frameworks and the new basic skills standard disadvantage small schools or schools moving toward inclusion, and whether schools exempt pupils from the transition test to protect their scores. The minister answers that existing legal standards already reflect inclusion, that exemptions must be justified and are unwelcome, and that supervision, funding and rules will be reviewed with the sector as part of the route to inclusive education by 2035.
If a pupil wrongly does not take part, this can have consequences for the rating on standard OP6 Completion and possibly for standard OR1 Results.
Als een leerling onterecht niet meedoet, kan dit consequenties hebben voor het oordeel op de standaard OP6 Afsluiting en mogelijk voor de standaard OR1 Resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over de groeiende bijlesindustrie die de kloof tussen rijke en arme kinderen vergroot

The MP asks the minister about the growing private tutoring industry and its effect on inequality, including whether schools should stop cooperating with commercial tutoring firms. The minister says schools should provide extra help on-site, prefers non-profit partners, reports positive early signals from its appeal to schools, and promises a repeat monitor in 2025.
With the periodic Monitor Aanvullend Onderwijs, which will be carried out again in 2025, I will among other things track the effect of the appeal more structurally.
Met de periodieke Monitor Aanvullend Onderwijs, die in 2025 opnieuw wordt uitgevoerd, zal ik onder andere het effect van de oproep structureler in beeld brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Verbijstering over sluiting van het Auris College in Goes: 'Onze kinderen verzuipen op de reguliere school''

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the planned closure of three Auris College special secondary schools (Goes, Leiden, Rotterdam), parents' fears that their children will not thrive elsewhere, and the wider shift from special to regular education. The Minister answered that Auris decided independently after consultation, not for financial reasons, that the ministry is in contact with Auris and regional partnerships, and that individual placements and extra support are being arranged, but many questions on capacity, prognoses and risks were left open.
My officials will consult with Auris and the relevant partnerships in the coming period to see whether, and if so what, additional support and efforts are needed.
Mijn ambtenaren zullen de komende periode met Auris en de betrokken samenwerkingsverbanden in overleg treden om te zien of en zo ja welke extra ondersteuning en inspanningen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het artikel ‘Leesvaardigheid Nederlandse 15-jarigen verder achteruitgegaan'

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about declining reading skills among 15-year-olds in PISA results, the effect of the loss of the old school types, digital media use, parental involvement and international lessons. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the Masterplan basisvaardigheden, new core curriculum goals, library-in-school programmes and phone restrictions in classrooms, and said the EUR 15.7 million underspend will be spent in 2024 rather than left unused.
Our intention is to spend the EUR 15.7 million in the second part of the school year (2024).
Ons voornemen is om de € 15,7 miljoen in het tweede deel van het schooljaar (2024) uit te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pijpelink over het lerarentekort in Zeeland

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about the growing teacher shortage in Zeeland, its similarity to urban shortages, and whether the national teacher strategy needs adjusting for cross-border regions. The Minister acknowledged concern, cited Centerdata figures showing falling primary shortages and a rising secondary outlook, and said the existing regional approach through education regions already suits cross-border contexts.
I share the concerns about the teacher shortage in Zeeland.
Ik deel de zorgen over het lerarentekort in Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van Soepboer over de slechte PISA-scores in verhouding tot de genomen maatregelen om achterstanden weg te werken en te voorkomen en de Kamerbrief van 5 december jl.

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education why Dutch 15-year-olds' PISA results fell faster than elsewhere, how NPO education funds and the Masterplan basisvaardigheden are working, and how school pressure relates to results. The minister attributes the decline to multiple structural causes plus COVID, says the effects of NPO funds cannot yet be fully assessed, and commits to evaluation and further reports without changing oversight of the executive.
The cabinet aims to structurally fund all schools from 2026 for improving basic skills.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar alle scholen vanaf 2026 structureel te financieren voor het verbeteren van de basisvaardigheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Hagen over de werking van de wet meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen

D66 MPs asked how start-up funding for new schools works, whether its timing and amount hinder founding, and about slow DUO issuance of institution codes. The minister said start-up funding is paid from 1 June before opening, that the amount and timing are being discussed with new boards, and that DUO is exploring faster issuance of codes.
My ministry has received signals from new school boards about the issuing of an institution code by DUO.
Mijn ministerie heeft signalen ontvangen van nieuwe schoolbesturen over de verstrekking van een instellingscode
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Joodse school Cheider opnieuw dicht uit angst voor antisemitische incidenten' en 'Gepeste Joodse leerlingen wisselen van school'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that Jewish schools closed due to antisemitic threats and that bullied Jewish pupils are switching schools. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says schools should stay open, notes school boards close buildings on municipal and security advice, and points to existing support and inspection channels while committing to visit the schools.
Precise figures are not known to us or the inspectorate, because parents are free to enrol their children at another school.
Precieze cijfers zijn ons en de inspectie niet bekend, omdat ouders vrij zijn om hun kinderen op een andere school in te schrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de berichtgeving‘Hoogoplopend conflict op Drachtster Lyceum: onderwijs- enarbeidsinspectie starten onderzoek. 'MR-mes in onze rug niet verdiend’’en ‘Dream School-directeur Eric v

An MP asks whether the school leader sidelining the works council at Drachtster Lyceum, a color-coding staff assessment system, and the inspectorates' role are acceptable and what will be done to protect the works council and staff. The minister answers that the Inspectorate is investigating, that the works council's cost coverage and dispute route exist under the WMS, that school leaders are being strengthened, and that the board, not the government, judges the school leader's conduct.
The Inspectorate of Education is currently investigating the situation at the school and at the board.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs doet momenteel onderzoek naar de situatie op de school en bij het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Richardson over het bericht ‘Schoolleiding zet docent onder druk: krik cijfer leerling op’

An MP asks the Minister whether school management pressuring teachers to raise pupils' grades, as reported by the AOb union, breaches the teacher's statutory autonomy in assessment, and what oversight and remedies exist. The Minister says such pressure is impermissible, that teachers should first raise it within the school and can then report to the Inspectorate, and promises to share relevant findings and a herijking of steering model by early 2024.
It is impermissible for school management to pressure teachers to adjust grades, norms and tests.
Het is ongeoorloofd als schooldirecties leraren onder druk zetten om cijfers, normeringen en toetsen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Peters, Kwint, Beertema, Westerveld en Van der Plas over carnaval en de afname van de doorstroomtoets

Six MPs asked the minister why the doorstroomtoets (transition test) was not moved around the carnival period and whether an extra week could be granted to carnival regions. The minister answered that after a stakeholder meeting the test window was extended from two to three weeks, with the extension for 2024 applied to the digital test and to be codified in law after that, while the test timing will be evaluated later.
Based on that conversation, I have decided to extend the period in which schools can administer a transition test from two to three weeks.
Op grond van dat gesprek heb ik besloten de periode waarin scholen een doorstroomtoets kunnen afnemen van twee naar drie weken te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Richardson over het bericht ‘Emotionele ouderavond om nieuw schoolplan: Kinderen komen huilend thuis’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that a Zoetermeer school's new plan cut subject instruction to 30 minutes per week, with students doing homework in large groups, and about whether this breaches instruction-time norms and how parents can complain. The minister said the Inspectorate is investigating the school and will report this autumn, and that whether statutory norms are met is for the Inspectorate to judge, while giving general guidance on complaints channels.
It is good that the Inspectorate of Education is currently investigating this school, given the unrest that has arisen.
Het is goed dat de Inspectie van het Onderwijs momenteel onderzoek doet op deze school, gezien de ontstane onrust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht 'Schoolkosten onbetaalbaar, ouders vragen vaker financiële hulp'

An MP asks the Minister about reports that school costs are unaffordable, rising requests to Stichting Leergeld, continued compulsory-in-practice voluntary parental contributions despite the 2021 law, and whether a cap will be introduced. The government answers that it funds child-poverty support organisations, pursues poverty and equal-opportunity policy, says schools must follow the law with the Inspectorate enforcing it, and defers a cap decision to the budget debate.
Schools must comply with the law.
Scholen moeten zich aan de wet houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Drost over de toegankelijkheid van het funderend onderwijs voor kinderen met long COVID

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether children with long COVID face obstacles in following education, whether schools lack knowledge and willingness to adapt teaching, and what schools' obligations are. The Minister answered that no hard figures exist, referred to a school-participation advice, stated that schools have a legal duty to organise education for sick pupils, and committed to further work on digital distance learning and continued dialogue with patient groups.
There are, however, no hard figures known on the number of pupils in the Netherlands who face this.
Er zijn echter geen harde cijfers bekend over het aantal leerlingen in Nederland dat hiermee te maken heeft.

m: Motie van het lid Bergkamp c.s. over de financiële ondersteuning van het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie
Asks the government to examine whether and how the Expertise Centre Euthanasia should receive financial support for its training tasks and report to parliament.
requests the government to examine whether and what financial support for the Expertise Centre Euthanasia is desirable
verzoekt de regering, na te gaan of en, zo ja, welke (financiële) ondersteuning van het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie gewenst is
Motie van het lid Van Gerven c.s. over een backpay-regeling voor weduwen van ambtenaren of militairen die tijdens de Japanse bezetting een dienstverband hadden met het Nederlands-Indisch Gouvernement
Asks the cabinet to examine whether a backpay-style financial scheme is feasible for widows of civil servants and military personnel who were not fully paid during the Japanese occupation.
asks the cabinet to investigate whether such a financial scheme is feasible and implementable
vraagt het kabinet, te onderzoeken of een dergelijke financiële regeling haalbaar en uitvoerbaar is
Motie van het lid Laan-Geselschap c.s. over verlagen van de drempel voor gesprekken over euthanasie met de huisarts
Asks the government for an action plan to lower the threshold for patients to discuss end-of-life wishes with their GP, sent to the House by summer 2020.
requests the government to come up with a concrete action plan to stimulate conversations between GP and patient
verzoekt de regering, met een concreet actieplan te komen waardoor de gesprekken tussen huisarts en patiënt gestimuleerd worden
Motie van het lid Laan-Geselschap c.s. over gebruikmaken van de kennis van het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie
Motion asking the government to explore making Expertisecentrum Euthanasie modules available to all GPs and report before summer.
requests the government, in consultation with the professional associations, to investigate how these modules can become available to all GPs
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de betrokken beroepsverenigingen, te onderzoeken hoe deze modules van het Expertisecentrum Euthanasie voor alle huisartsen in Nederland beschikbaar kunnen komen
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over de opschaling van de Nierteams aan Huis
Asks the government to prepare expansion of the Nierteams aan Huis in 2020 and to fund it from an unused budget article.
requests the government to prepare the scaling up of the Nierteams aan Huis in 2020
verzoekt de regering, om de opschaling van de Nierteams aan Huis in 2020 voor te bereiden
Motie van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over kwaliteitseisen aan de keuzehulpgesprekken onder de reikwijdte van de Wkkgz
Asks the government to make quality criteria for decision-aid counselling on unintended pregnancy fall under the Wkkgz so the Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd can supervise them.
also requests the government to draft the quality criteria so that they fall under the scope of the Wkkgz, so that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate can supervise them

verzoekt de regering tevens, de kwaliteitseisen zo op te stellen dat deze vallen onder de reikwijdte van de Wet kwaliteit klachten en geschillen zorg, zodat er toezicht kan worden gehouden door de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd
Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries c.s. over ter beschikking stellen van het definitieve jaarverslag en de definitieve jaarrekening
Requires subsidiaries of Sanquin to provide their final annual report and accounts to the minister so the minister can supervise effectively.
To be able to exercise effective supervision, the Minister needs information.
Om effectief toezicht te kunnen houden heeft de Minister informatie nodig.
Motie van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Ellemeet over een tijdelijke abortusvoorziening
Asks the government to set up a temporary facility where women can find the nearest abortion provider and waiting time.
requests the government, while the nationwide network is under pressure, to set up a temporary facility
verzoekt de regering, zolang het landelijk dekkend netwerk onder druk staat, een tijdelijke voorziening in te richten
Motie van de leden Ellemeet en Pia Dijkstra over positieve seksuele gezondheid
Asks the government to invest also in promoting positive sexual health, not only in preventing unintended pregnancies.
requests the government to invest not only in prevention of and support for unintended pregnancies
verzoekt de regering om, niet alleen in de preventie van en ondersteuning bij onbedoelde zwangerschappen te investeren
Motie van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over herinrichting van de kwaliteitsregistraties
Asks the government to have an expert commission advise by 1 July 2018 on reorganising quality registrations in healthcare and to report to the House every six months on progress.
to report to the House every six months on progress within the so-called Information Council
de Kamer halfjaarlijks te rapporteren over de voortgang binnen het zogenoemde Informatieberaad
Motie van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over standaardisatie van het totale polisaanbod

Asks the government to measure how many identical basic health insurance policies are sold under different names, report to the House by April 2018, and report periodically on progress toward standardisation.
requests the government to carry out a baseline measurement of how many identical policies are offered under different names and to inform the House about this by April 2018
verzoekt de regering, een nulmeting uit te laten voeren naar de vraag hoeveel identieke polissen onder verschillende namen worden aangeboden en de Kamer hier voor april 2018 over te informeren
Motie van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Dik-Faber over geestelijke verzorging binnen de eerste lijn
Asks the government to examine whether spiritual care can gain a more structural place in first-line health care.
to examine whether spiritual care can receive a more structural place within the first line
te onderzoeken of geestelijke verzorging een meer structurele plek binnen de eerste lijn kan krijgen
Motie van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over kennisinfrastructuur op het gebied van e-health
Asks the government to set up a knowledge infrastructure to collect, spread and embed good e-health examples across regions.
requests the government to set up a knowledge infrastructure
verzoekt de regering, een kennisinfrastructuur in te richten
Amendement van de leden Ellemeet en Pia Dijkstra over een overbruggingssubsidie voor het uitbreiden en voortzetten van de AmPrep studie
Shifts 1.2 million euro within curative care to bridge funding for extending the AmPrEP PrEP study.
The submitters want a bridging subsidy of 1.2 million euro to expand and continue the AmPrEP study
De indieners willen een overbruggingssubsidie van € 1,2 miljoen voor het uitbreiden en voortzetten van de AmPrep studie
Amendement van de leden Arno Rutte en Pia Dijkstra waarmee regels voor de ambulancezorgprofessional bij AMvB worden gesteld.

Amends the bill so that rules for the ambulance care professional are set by general administrative order (AMvB) rather than ministerial regulation, with a four-week pre-consultation period before the Houses of Parliament.
With a light pre-consultation (voorhang) of the general administrative order, it is ensured that both Houses of the States General are involved in its elaboration.
Met een lichte voorhang van de algemene maatregel van bestuur is geborgd dat beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal bij de uitwerking daarvan betrokken worden.
Motie van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het hanteren van een implementatietijd van minimaal achttien maanden
Asks the government to use an implementation period of at least eighteen months for the Wvggz, as the sector considers necessary.
requests the government to use an implementation period of at least eighteen months, which the field considers necessary
verzoekt de regering, de implementatietijd van minimaal achttien maanden te hanteren die het veld noodzakelijk acht
Motie van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Voortman over de tolkenvergoeding binnen de Wet verplichte ggz

Asks the government to make interpreter reimbursement available throughout the whole Wvggz procedure, including the application for a compulsory care order, not only when deprivation of liberty applies.
make interpreter reimbursement available throughout the entire procedure under the Wvggz
de tolkenvergoeding gedurende de gehele procedure die binnen de Wet verplichte geestelijke gezondheidszorg valt beschikbaar te stellen
Motie van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het monitoren van de beleving en de ervaringen van patiënten
Asks the government to monitor costs, efforts and patient experiences after the compulsory mental health care law and report to the House every six months.
to monitor how the costs, efforts and experiences of patients develop after the law is introduced, and to inform the House about this every six months
te monitoren hoe de kosten, inspanningen en ervaringen van patiënten zich ontwikkelen nadat de wet is ingevoerd, en de Kamer hierover halfjaarlijks te informeren
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Voortman en Pia Dijkstra ter vervanging van nr. 48 over vervanging van "ernstig nadeel" door "schade"

Motie Dijkstra over een eigen bijdrage voor huisartsenbezoek
Asks the government to research the effects of different co-payment variants for GP visits and inform the House before Prinsjesdag 2012.
requests the government to conduct research into the effects of different variants of a co-payment for GP visits
verzoekt de regering om een onderzoek te doen naar de effecten van verschillende varianten van een eigen bijdrage voor huisartsenbezoek
Motie-Dijkstra over besteding van de extra 150 mln.
Asks the government to provide Parliament with information on how municipalities spend the extra 150 million for safety, including enforcement of the Drank- en Horecawet.
requests the government to provide the Chamber with further information on the exact spending of those 150 million by Dutch municipalities
verzoekt de regering nadere informatie te verstrekken aan de Kamer over de exacte besteding van die 150 mln. door Nederlandse gemeenten
Motie-Dijkstra/Voortman over toetsing van de gegevensverstrekking
Asks the government to have the data disclosure under the chronic illness and disability decree reviewed by the Data Protection College and report results to parliament.

requests the government to have the data provision under the implementation of the Decree on chronically ill and disabled persons reviewed by the Data Protection Board and to provide the results to the House

verzoekt de regering om de gegevensverstrekking bij de uitvoering van het Besluit chronisch zieken en gehandicapten te laten toetsen door het College bescherming persoonsgegevens en de resultaten hiervan te verstrekken aan de Kamer
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Pia Dijkstra ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het scheppen van de mogelijkheid voor apothekers om laboratoriumuitslagen in te zien
Lets pharmacists request and keep patients' laboratory results with the patient's explicit consent, with rules set by ministerial regulation.
The pharmacist may, if the patient has explicitly given consent, request, consult and keep laboratory results necessary for dispensing a medicine.

De apotheker kan indien de patiënt hem daartoe uitdrukkelijk zijn toestemming heeft gegeven, ten behoeve van de door hem te verlenen zorg laboratoriumuitslagen die noodzakelijk zijn bij de terhandstelling van een geneesmiddel aan de patiënt opvragen, raadplegen en bewaren.
Amendement van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het scheppen van de mogelijkheid voor apothekers om laboratoriumuitslagen in te zien
Amendment would allow pharmacists, with patient consent, to request and keep laboratory results needed for dispensing medicines, with rules set by ministerial regulation.
The pharmacist may, if the patient has unambiguously given consent, request, consult and keep laboratory results
De apotheker kan indien de patiënt hem daartoe ondubbelzinnig zijn toestemming heeft gegeven, ten behoeve van de door hem te verlenen zorg laboratoriumuitslagen
Motie Van der Veen c.s. over zenden van alternatieve beleidsmaatregelen aan de Kamer
Asks the government to send alternative policy measures to the Chamber before Prinsjesdag 2010 to avoid a cut in AWBZ care spending.
requests the government to send alternative policy measures to the Chamber before Prinsjesdag 2010
verzoekt de regering voor Prinsjesdag 2010 alternatieve beleidsmaatregelen aan de Kamer te zenden
Motie Van der Veen c.s. over een uitzondering voor cliënten die zonder een pgb-toekenning gedwongen in een duurdere zorginstelling opgenomen worden
Motion asking for an exception so clients admitted to more expensive institutional care without a personal budget award are not disadvantaged by the budget ceiling.
requests the government to make an exception for clients who are forced to be admitted to a more expensive institution without a personal budget award
verzoekt de regering voor cliënten die zonder een pgb-toekenning gedwongen worden in een duurdere instelling opgenomen te worden een uitzondering te maken
Motie Van Miltenburg c.s. over opheffen van de aparte pgb-subsidieregeling
Asks the government to abolish the separate pgb subsidy scheme, fund pgbs from the AWBZ growth room and enshrine the right to a pgb in law.
the right to a personal budget must be fully maintained
het recht op een persoonsgebonden budget onverkort dient te worden gehandhaafd
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Vermeer over Huisarts waarschuwt voor negatieve gezondheidsgevolgen van windturbines

MPs Van der Plas and Vermeer asked the ministers about a GP's warning on health effects of wind turbines, including whether noise limits and distance norms adequately protect residents. Minister Dijkstra answered that RIVM monitors the evidence, that sleep and hinder effects are documented but other health effects lack sufficient evidence, and that new environmental rules are being prepared through a plan-MER with a decision expected after summer 2024.
As long as the process is still ongoing, I cannot anticipate the outcomes.
Zolang het traject nog loopt, kan ik niet op de uitkomsten vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Deel huisartsen zwicht voor druk ouders en scholen bij voorschrijven ADHD-medicatie’

MPs Tielen and Van Eijk asked about reports that some GPs yield to parent and school pressure to prescribe ADHD medication, and about diagnosis and prescription trends, the ADHD misuse programme, referrals to specialist mental health care, and medical certificates. The minister says the government takes pressure on GPs seriously, points to 'Meer Tijd voor de Patiënt', the Gezonde Focus programme (focused mainly on students) and tables of diagnoses, prescriptions and referrals, but does not commit to new research on referral growth or to studying doctors' pressure around medical certificates.
I cannot provide an overview of the number of referrals to specialist mental health care since 2010 broken down by age group.
Ik kan geen overzicht geven over het aantal doorverwijzingen naar de specialistische ggz sinds 2010 uitgesplitst naar leeftijdsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and BBB asked the government how it will protect vulnerable people from suicide powder Middel X, given a study finding at least 172 deaths and 70% with a psychiatric history, and why the substance is not banned. The minister says access is limited via an industry code, that a ban is legally complicated and of limited effect, and that additional forensic powers and follow-up research are planned.
A change to the Burial and Cremation Act is currently being prepared, giving forensic physicians more powers to conduct further investigation.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een wijziging van de Wet op de lijkbezorging (Wlb), waarbij de forensisch arts meer bevoegdheden krijgt om nader onderzoek te doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over verspreiding van medische misinformatie op sociale media

An MP asks the government how it responds to the spread of medical misinformation on social media, its effects on trust in vaccination, contraception and maternity care, and whether platforms and regulators under the DSA should act. The government answers that it relies on platform responsibilities under the DSA, the Commission's enforcement, prebunking, trusted doctors' initiatives and public information, and declines to regulate content or require BIG registration for information-sharers.
It is still too early to assess whether very large online platforms and search engines are taking sufficient measures to mitigate that risk.
Het is nu nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen of zeer grote online platforms en zoekmachines voldoende maatregelen nemen om dat risico te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over nieuwe misstanden en toezicht bij zorgboerderijen

MP Westerveld asks the minister about abuses at care farms (Aurora Borealis, Zonnehoeve, United Souls), inspection capacity, PGB-financed care, support for victims and financial transparency of care providers. The minister answers that inspection has been expanded, recounts how the GGD and IGJ handled Zonnehoeve, and announces measures on PGB wooninitiatieven and integrity of financial management while noting that some answers defer to other bodies.
The IGJ is currently investigating the content of these reports and will determine any follow-up actions based on its investigation.
De IGJ onderzoekt op dit moment de inhoud van deze meldingen. Zij zal op basis van haar onderzoek eventuele vervolgacties bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een noodkreet van het Dijklander ziekenhuis over de geplande wegwerkzaamheden bij de versterking van brug A7 ter hoogte van Purmerend

Ms Van der Plas (BBB) asked the ministers about the Dijklander hospital's alarm over bridge works on the A7 near Purmerend, including traffic disruption for ambulances, emergency care and births, compensation, and how the ministries coordinated. The government answered that Rijkswaterstaat manages mitigation measures, that a temporary bridge was ruled out for traffic, emissions and permit reasons, and that care providers coordinate through the regional acute care body, while committing to improve future coordination with the care sector.

For future projects, Rijkswaterstaat will, in consultation with the Ministry of VWS and together with the sector, make arrangements on how they are involved in such projects, for the accessibility of care.

Voor toekomstige projecten zal Rijkswaterstaat in afstemming met het Ministerie van VWS samen met de sector afspraken maken over wijze waarop zij betrokken worden bij dergelijke projecten, ten behoeve van de bereikbaarheid van de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Crijns en Maeijer over het bericht dat 400.000 kinderen nooit buitenspelen

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that 400,000 children never play outside and whether safe play spaces and social safety are declining. The state secretary acknowledged the problem as complex, said data on play spaces is incomplete, and promised a study and further consultation with Jantje Beton, but committed to no binding measures.
The lack of (complete) data overviews makes it difficult to properly investigate, evaluate or monitor policy on and the availability of sports and play spaces in Dutch municipalities.
Het gebrek aan (volledige) data-overzichten maakt het lastig om het beleid over en de beschikbaarheid van sport- en speelplekken in Nederlandse gemeenten goed te onderzoeken, evalueren of monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt- Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs asked the health minister about top salaries of healthcare executives, including interim managers exceeding WNT pay norms, unenforced expense-disclosure rules in the Governancecode Zorg, and whether a statutory duty or lobbying-register reform should apply. The minister said the WNT norms rightly apply by status rather than appointment form, that she prefers talks with sector bodies before legislating on expense transparency, and that a lobbying-register letter is forthcoming.
I will first talk with the BoZ, NVZ, NVZD and NVTZ to see how transparency around declarations can be promoted.
Ik ga eerst met de BoZ, NVZ, NVZD en NVTZ in gesprek om te kijken hoe transparantie rondom declaraties bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Verzorgingshuis laat stervende patiënt (87) niet meer eten, verpleger kan het niet verkroppen en gaat in de fout’

An SGP MP asked ministers about a reported case in which a nursing home stopped feeding a dying 87-year-old patient, a nurse broke with protocol, and whether refusal of feeding is legally protected. The ministers answered that the OM and IGJ investigations are pending, the patient's right to voluntarily stop eating and drinking is grounded in self-determination, conscientious objections are governed by professional codes, and the assessment of sanctions is for competent bodies.
Pending the ruling of the Supreme Court, the OM's investigation is at a standstill.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad ligt het onderzoek van het OM stil.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht "Maartje Kraamzorg trekt de stekker eruit, kraamzorg in Twente moet hulp zoeken voor 160 gezinnen"

An SP MP asked the minister about the closure of Maartje Kraamzorg in Twente, which leaves about 160 families needing other midwifery care, and about low insurer tariffs, workforce shortages and future guarantees of kraamzorg. The minister says insurers and providers are responsible, that the NZa and IGJ had no prior signals, that the preferred insurer is working with other providers to place clients, and that a follow-up to the sector convenant is being negotiated.
I made inquiries with the NZa and IGJ. They indicate that they had not previously received signals about the discontinuation of Maartje Kraamzorg.
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij de NZa en IGJ. Zij geven aan dat zij niet eerder signalen hebben ontvangen over het wegvallen van Maartje Kraamzorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over het bericht 'Thom kwam met z’n rolstoel wel de Domtoren op, maar station Maarssen is 'onmogelijke horde''

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked about repeated elevator and escalator failures at Maarssen station and whether ProRail and the state meet their accessibility duties. The state secretary said real-time elevator data is being rolled out gradually, that ProRail provides alternative travel advice when elevators fail, and that the Maarssen elevator was repaired on 1 March with the escalator expected back around 22 March.

Following your earlier written questions of 25 August 2023, it was stated that general information will be added to the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management website on accessibility facilities in station buildings

Naar aanleiding van uw eerdere schriftelijke vragen d.d. 25 augustus 2023 is meegedeeld dat algemene informatie zal worden toegevoegd op de website van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat over toegankelijkheidsvoorzieningen in stationsgebouwen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over de topsalarissen van zorgbestuurders

MPs Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman and Westerveld asked about high executive pay in healthcare, including a UMC Maastricht board chair above the WNT pay cap, interim manager exemptions, and municipal leverage over pay. The minister defended the exemption mechanism, said data on sector-wide pay totals and jeugdzorg management costs are not kept, and noted only seven exemptions were granted in healthcare.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het niet willen toelichten van de voorgenomen blokkade van de benoeming van een capabele jurist tot de regionale toetsingscommissie euthanasie (RTE).

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister why he blocked the appointment of a qualified jurist to the regional euthanasia review committee (RTE), and about the selection process, consultation with the Health ministry, and parliamentary control. The ministers answered in detail on the procedure and timeline but declined to share the substance of the individual case, citing privacy of the candidate.

We consider it undesirable, in the interest of protecting the privacy of those involved in appointment procedures, to substantively disclose the preparation and motivation of decisions regarding proposed candidate members.

Wij vinden het in het belang van de bescherming van de privacy van de betrokkenen bij benoemingsprocedures onwenselijk om over de voorbereiding en motivering van beslissingen ten aanzien van voorgedragen kandidaat-leden inhoudelijk mededelingen te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over de kabinetsreactie op het 73e OMT COVID-19 advies en de berichten over het testbeleid van Duitsland en Frankrijk, respectievelijk het bericht over

MPs from D66 asked the health and infrastructure ministers about testing of travellers from high-risk countries, airport contact tracing, air cargo capacity and pricing for vaccine distribution, and EU vaccine negotiations. The ministers answered that testing and quarantine measures are being developed, that contact tracing follows RIVM guidance, and that logistics preparations and EU negotiations are ongoing, but declined to answer each question separately.
Unfortunately, this has not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Paternotte over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het bericht dat een Amerikaanse farmaceut een Nederlands coronamedicijn in productie neemt

MPs Paternotte and Pia Dijkstra asked why the government was not involved in negotiations between an American pharmaceutical firm and Dutch research institutions over a Dutch COVID-19 drug licence, despite public funding, and whether the MVL licensing principles guarantee affordability and availability, including under possible US export restrictions. Minister De Jonge answered that IP ownership lies with the universities, that the government has expectations but no direct role, that the MVL principles will be applied but are not legally binding, and that a licensing toolbox will be delivered by late August.
As long as we do not know what the actual provisions are on which the described collaboration is based, any statement from me on this would be speculative.
Zolang we niet weten wat de daadwerkelijke bepalingen zijn waarop de beschreven samenwerking is gebaseerd zou elke uitspraak mijnerzijds hierover speculatief zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de reactie van het kabinet op het 'Draaiboek triage op basis van niet medische overwegingen voor IC-opname ten tijde van fase 3 in de COVID-19 pandemie'

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the cabinet why the Minister for Medical Care signed the June 2020 letter on the triage draft for ICU admission in COVID-19 phase 3, whether it is an ethical matter, how the draft was prepared, and what the cabinet's role and alternatives are. The government answered that medical care falls under the Medical Care minister, that the cabinet rejects age-only selection as discriminatory and favours first come, first served, and that it will await a broad societal dialogue before deciding whether to confirm the draft or use regulation.
I am awaiting the broad societal discussion now, but if necessary the general prohibition of discrimination will be clarified in legislation or regulations.
Ik wacht de brede maatschappelijke discussie nu af, maar zo nodig zal in wet- of regelgeving het algemene discriminatieverbod worden verduidelijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een Amerikaanse farmaceut een Nederlands coronamedicijn in productie neemt

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that an American pharmaceutical firm would mass-produce a Dutch COVID-19 antibody drug, including the government's role, licensing terms, export risks and European production. The minister answered that he was not involved in licensing talks, that UMC licensing principles would apply, and that export-restriction questions were premature.
Conversations of this kind are usually confidential, and I have no further information about them.
Dit type gesprekken verloopt in de regel vertrouwelijk, ik heb hier verder geen informatie over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht dat Amsterdam streeft naar nul nieuwe hiv-infecties in 2026

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Medical Care about Amsterdam's goal of zero new HIV infections by 2026, PrEP subsidy capacity and waiting lists, and whether a national plan is needed. The minister welcomed Amsterdam's ambition but said zero new infections is not achievable in the short term, rejected a dedicated national plan and expansion of the PrEP scheme for now, and pointed to a pilot evaluation and annual report later.
I do not intend to expand the scheme.
Ik heb niet het voornemen de regeling uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de oprichting van de Inclusieve Vaccin Alliantie

An MP asked the health minister how the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance with Germany, France and Italy relates to a joint EU vaccine purchase, whether more countries will join, how it balances EU supply against vaccines for vulnerable countries, how it fits with other global initiatives, and how EU production will be stimulated. The minister answered that the Alliance is a step toward the EU Vaccine Strategy, that talks with some member states are ongoing, that non-EU interest is being considered, and that commitments to production in Europe and to CEPI were made.
It was taken as a starting point that every agreement should be accessible to all EU member states under the same conditions as for the initiators.
Daarbij is het uitgangspunt vooropgezet dat elke afspraak voor alle EU-lidstaten onder dezelfde condities als voor de initiatiefnemers toegankelijk zou moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de voorgenomen aanwijzing omtrent de beschikbaarheidbijdrage voor postmortale orgaanuitname bij donoren

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister for Medical Care what is meant by using the current project subsidy as a guideline for the NZa's supplement to the availability fee for post-mortem organ retrieval, and what this means for continuity in staffing and funding from 1 January 2021. The Minister explained that the subsidy amount will be used to set the supplement, that the NZa will re-calibrate the availability fee in its 2021 cost study, and that continuity of staffing and funding is secured.
In 2021 the NZa will again carry out a cost study to recalibrate the level of the availability fee, in which this new item will also be included.
In 2021 zal de NZa 2021 weer een kostenonderzoek uitvoeren om de hoogte van de beschikbaarheidsbijdrage opnieuw te herijken, waarbij ook deze nieuwe post zal worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het datalek van het Donorregister

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Health Minister 19 questions about the missing external hard drives holding Donorregister data, covering timing, security, notification and remedies. The minister answered that the CIBG discovered the loss in February-March 2020, notified the Data Protection Authority, is informing affected citizens, and that the Audit Dienst Rijk and the Data Protection Authority are investigating, with the findings to be shared with parliament.
I will therefore inform the House of the outcomes of the investigations by the ADR and the AP, and ask the CIBG to report any follow-up steps to me and make them public.
Ik zal de Kamer daarom informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken door de ADR en AP en het CIBG vragen om eventueel te nemen vervolgstappen aan mij te rapporteren en deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Costa Rica de WHO oproept een internationale pool op te richten voor intellectueel eigendom inzake COVID-19

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Medical Care about Costa Rica's call for the WHO to create a global patent pool for COVID-19 technologies and whether public funding for COVID-19 vaccines or medicines should require the resulting IP to be placed in such a pool. The minister supports information sharing and FAIR principles and says the government will back a global COVID-19 pool, but says mandatory pooling of patents from publicly funded research is not clearly desirable because private investment must be able to recover costs, while the government will fund only therapies available on acceptable terms.

As requested on 8 April in the amended motion by MP Ellemeet et al. on establishing a global COVID-19 pool, the government will show leadership before and during the WHO's annual meeting and explicitly advocate for such a global COVID-19 pool and actively support the WHO in this.

Zoals 8 april jongstleden in de gewijzigde motie van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over het opzetten van een wereldwijde COVID-19 pool (t.v.v. motie 25 295, nr. 224 ) is gevraagd, zal de regering voorafgaand, en tijdens, de jaarlijkse vergadering van de WHO leiderschap tonen en zich expliciet uitspreken voor zo'n wereldwijde COVID-19 pool en de WHO hierbij actief steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Overleg over mogelijk tekort aan medicijnen’

An MP asked the health minister about a possible shortage of medicines during the coronavirus crisis, including industry concerns, EU coordination and cross-border export restrictions. The minister pointed to a new coordination body, EU-level monitoring with the EMA, and confirmed Dutch compliance with EU green lanes for goods, mostly referring to earlier letters without new commitments.
For a full explanation of the concrete and possible steps I have in mind for the coming period, I refer you to my letter on this subject.
Ik verwijs voor de uitgebreide toelichting op de concrete en mogelijke stappen die ik in de aankomende periode voor ogen heb graag naar mijn brief over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over een farmaceut die honderd medicijnen verloot onder baby’s met een dodelijke spierziekte

An MP asked the health minister about Novartis's lottery giving 100 free doses of the costly SMA drug Zolgensma to infants, and whether the minister would take EU-wide or sanctioning steps and demand price transparency. The minister condemned the lottery as lacking medical selection criteria, issued a joint Benelux statement and urged Novartis to revise its program, but declined further steps for now and only called on the company to disclose its pricing.
At this moment I am not considering further steps.
Op dit moment overweeg ik geen nadere stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht 'Wachttijd nieuwe levensreddende medicijnen loopt op tot meer dan een jaar'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a report that waiting times for expensive life-saving drugs in the Dutch drug-pricing 'sluis' (gate) had risen to over a year, and why the manufacturer of Yescarta has not made it available. The minister disputes the 410-day average, says the sluis is not the main cause, and offers only general monitoring and European co-negotiation options without concrete new commitments.
I have no insight into the considerations other countries make in their individual reimbursement decisions.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de afwegingen die andere landen maken bij hun individuele vergoedingsbesluiten
Antwoord op vragen van lid Pia Dijkstra over de (ongelijke) behandeling van homoseksuele weefseldonoren

MP Pia Dijkstra asked about a reported case in which a gay tissue donor was allegedly refused because of his sexual orientation, and about the planned shortening of the MSM deferral period for blood donation and alternatives to group-based donor selection. The minister regrets the distress, states sexual orientation is not an exclusion ground for organ donation, explains that tissue donation rules use population risk because donor information is often incomplete, and says the NTS is examining whether the 12-month period can be shortened.
Homosexual orientation is not a ground for exclusion in organ donation.
Homoseksuele geaardheid is geen uitsluitingsgrond bij orgaandonatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het lastig vallen van vrouwen bij abortusklinieken door anti-abortusdemonstranten

An MP asked the health minister about anti-abortion demonstrators harassing women at abortion clinics, including Rotterdam and Utrecht, and whether the government would protect access via buffer zones. The minister said demonstrations are primarily a municipal responsibility, that buffer zones may be a legitimate option decided locally by mayors, and that he will convene municipalities and clinics before the summer recess.
It is primarily up to municipalities to steer demonstrations in the right direction, as I also indicated in my earlier committee letter and answers to parliamentary questions on this matter.
Het is primair aan gemeenten om demonstraties in goede banen te leiden, zoals ik ook aangaf in mijn eerdere commissiebrief en beantwoording van de Kamervragen hierover
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat in nieuwe spotjes zwijgen over dat het niet-registreren van een keuze wordt vastgelegd als ‘geen bezwaar’

An MP asked why the government's new organ donation campaign does not explicitly state that not registering a choice will count as no objection from 1 July 2020, and why it does not urge people to register actively now. The minister defended a phased communication plan that avoids stressing the consequence of non-registration, arguing this would only motivate 'no' voters, and said the campaign will later reinforce the 'no objection' message.
The aim of the campaign is in principle to motivate all citizens in the Netherlands to make and register their choice, whatever that choice may be.
Het doel van de campagne is om in principe alle burgers in Nederlander te motiveren hun keuze te maken en te registreren, welke keuze dan ook.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het gevaar dat het goede werk dat Nierteam aan Huis voor nierpatiënten verricht, mogelijk moet worden stopgezet vanwege lange beoordelingstermijnen bij de Nederlandse Zorg

An MP asked the minister whether the Nierteam aan Huis project, now funded by insurers and the Kidney Foundation, can be added to regular care reimbursement despite long assessment times at the NZa, and whether bridge funding will be provided. The minister answered that the NZa's timelines are being discussed, that the NZa will look at speeding up its process, and that bridge funding will be explored with insurers in 2020.
I will discuss with ZN the possibilities for bridge funding in 2020.
Ik zal met ZN in gesprek gaan over mogelijkheden voor overbruggingsfinanciering in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de geringe aandacht voor levenseindezorg in medische opleidingen

An MP asked the health minister why end-of-life care receives little attention in Dutch medical curricula and whether mandatory teaching should be added. The minister said curricula are the responsibility of the profession and training institutions, noted ZonMw projects supporting palliative care education, and committed only to bringing the Leyden study to the attention of the committee revising the training framework.
It is not for me to adopt this advice. It is for the profession and the training institutions, which are responsible for the content of the training programmes.
Het is niet aan mij om dit advies over te nemen. Het is aan de beroepsgroep en de opleiders, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de inhoud van de opleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Oproep ‘noodregeling’ voor pil die hiv kan voorkomen’

MPs Ellemeet and Dijkstra asked the Minister of Medical Care whether PrEP reimbursement could start in early 2019 after advocacy groups urged an emergency arrangement, and about the pros and cons of national purchasing versus purchasing by pharmacists. The Minister said the RIVM advice was received on 18 December and is under consideration, that implementation is aimed for mid-2019, and that a decision on purchasing will be sent to the House soon.
Soon I will inform the House of my decision on how the reimbursement of PrEP will be implemented.
Binnenkort zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn besluit hoe de vergoeding van PrEP zal worden geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat weer meer medicijnen niet leverbaar zijn

The MP Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of rising medicine shortages in 2018, their causes, comparison with other EU states, the KNMP claim that low prices contribute, progress on the promised sector talks, stockpiling obligations, and EU cooperation. The minister answered that shortages are a Europe-wide problem, that low prices are not shown to cause shortages, that a stock-building agreement and a report from the Meldpunt will follow, and that EU-level cooperation is being pursued.
I will inform your House about this in the second half of 2019.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in de tweede helft van 2019 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Eijs over het bericht dat Nederland investeringen in gentherapie misloopt

MPs Dijkstra and Van Eijs asked whether the Netherlands applies an extra environmental procedure and stricter interpretation to gene therapy, whether Dutch patients treated abroad need an import permit, and whether Dutch procedures are slower and could be streamlined. The minister replied that gene therapy falls under the GMO environmental release directive as in other states, that no import permit is needed, that procedural differences stem from EU rules, and that two rounds of streamlining already removed national bottlenecks, with an evaluation due in 2019.
The Netherlands has no extra environmental procedure for gene therapy and likewise does not choose to interpret the European rules for gene therapy more strictly than other member states.
Nederland kent voor gentherapie geen extra milieuprocedure en maakt evenmin voor gentherapie de keuze om Europese regels voor gentherapie strenger te interpreteren dan andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat zware pijnstillers nog steeds met een vervalst recept te verkrijgen zijn

Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister about a broadcast showing strong painkillers still obtainable with forged prescriptions, and what has been done since 2017 to improve controls. Minister Bruins answered that forgery is fraud, pointed to pharmacist alerting, IGJ inspections and a planned December meeting with pharmacists and KNMP, and urged electronic prescribing for the remaining paper prescriptions.
In December I will hold a discussion with the pharmacists involved in the report and with the KNMP.
In december ga ik in gesprek met de betrokken apothekers uit de reportage en de KNMP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het kapitaalrecord voor medische bedrijven alweer gebroken is

An MP asked the Minister about reports that a record amount of capital was raised for medical companies, the trend of large pharma firms acquiring small biotech firms, and the regulatory barriers young firms face, including follow-up on an Actal advisory report. The minister said no data is kept on acquisitions or self-marketing by young firms, framed acquisitions as a success, and described steps taken to reduce regulatory burden on the reimbursement procedure.
Within the ministries of VWS and EZK, no information is kept on the exact number of acquired (young) medical companies in recent years.
Binnen de ministeries van VWS en EZK wordt er geen informatie bijgehouden over het exact aantal opgekochte (jonge) medische bedrijven in de afgelopen jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat in Nederland steeds vaker zware pijnstillers worden voorgeschreven

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of rising prescribing of strong painkillers such as oxycodone, the possible link to ziekenhuis pain scores, hospital information on opioid addiction, and patient deaths. The minister acknowledged increased use, pointed to professional guidelines and monitoring, denied that hospital pain scores create an incentive, and gave partial figures on overdoses while noting addiction data is not available.
It is important to continue monitoring developments regarding opioid use.
Het is van belang om de ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot gebruik van opioïden te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het uitblijven van een besluit over de overgangsregeling voor mbo- en inservice verpleegkundigen

MPs Bergkamp and Pia Dijkstra asked why no decision has been taken on the transitional arrangement for mbo-trained and in-service nurses, and about the planned expert committee. The minister answers that no existing body can assess these training programmes on both content and level, so an independent expert committee will be set up, with results expected in Q4 2018 and the BIG II bill to follow by end 2018.
To take a careful decision on the transitional arrangement, an independent party is needed that can assess these follow-up training programmes on both content and level.
Om een zorgvuldig besluit te nemen over de invulling van de overgangsregeling is een onafhankelijke partij nodig die deze vervolgopleidingen op zowel inhoud als niveau kan beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Maak vaccineren verplicht’

MPs asked whether mandatory childhood vaccination should apply in daycare centres, how other EU countries handle it, and whether parents can learn daycare vaccination rates. The government opposes mandatory vaccination in daycare (limited effect, constitutional objections) and says a rate-disclosure obligation has little benefit and lacks support, promising a plan of action in autumn.
I am not in favour of making vaccination mandatory for children at daycare centres.
Ik ben geen voorstander van het verplicht stellen van vaccinatie voor kinderen op kinderdagverblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Dodelijke bacterie rukt op in Nederland’

MPs Diertens and Pia Dijkstra asked about the meningococcal vaccine shortage after the national programme was changed, the later vaccination of 14-year-olds, and why scarce vaccines were kept for travellers. The state secretary explained the tender shortfall, said the risk remains very small, and that free-market travel vaccines are outside government control.
Therefore, from 1 May 2018 children aged 14 months will be vaccinated, and teenagers born between 1 May 2004 and 31 December 2004 from 1 October 2018.
Daarom worden vanaf 1 mei 2018 kinderen van 14 maanden gevaccineerd en tieners geboren tussen 1 mei 2004 en 31 december 2004 vanaf 1 oktober 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sneller over het bericht dat miljoenen te besparen valt op dure medicijnen

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether doctors prescribe cheaper, equally effective biosimilars less often, whether this could save hundreds of millions a year, and what is being done to improve their reputation. The minister acknowledged rising biosimilar use, said the savings potential is uncertain, and pointed to a subsidised implementation programme and ongoing stakeholder engagement, without any structural change to oversight.
Prescribing biosimilars, however, is not a goal in itself.
Het voorschrijven van biosimilars is echter geen doel op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Mbo'ers lossen tekorten arbeidsmarkt niet op’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about shortages of skilled workers in care and welfare, including the share of career changers and returners, the availability and cost of BIG re-registration training and exams, and whether pass rates and exam frequency could be improved. The minister answered in detail with figures, describes Zorgpact and SectorplanPlus measures, says pass rates will be published on request to the MBO Raad, and states that digitalising the exam will be decided in autumn.
I will contact the MBO Raad to that end.
Ik zal daartoe contact opnemen met de MBO Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Pia Dijkstra over zorgverzekeraars die beleggen in farmaceutische bedrijven

Two MPs asked the Minister whether health insurers investing in pharmaceutical firms charging very high drug prices creates a perverse incentive, and about insurers' invested capital and reserves. The Minister replied that exposure is small (under 0.1% in named firms), that ESG exclusion and engagement policies apply, and gave invested capital of 13.2 billion euros and equity of about 11 billion euros at end-2016.
I do not fear a perverse effect.
Ik vrees niet voor een pervers effect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Robotrechter e-Court is een groot en niet-transparant zwart gat?’

MPs Groothuizen and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked about the private digital arbitration firm e-Court, its opaque caseload, algorithm use, publication of awards and arbiter lists, and insurers' arbitration clauses.
