The minister answered that e-Court's caseload data is confidential, that the courts' review of its awards is pending a Supreme Court referral, that arbitral transparency is not legally required, and that a rights-of-appeal exists for consumers.
This is commercially sensitive information which e-Court therefore did not wish to provide.
Dit is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie die e-Court om die reden niet heeft willen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Veertien patiënten overleden bij medisch onderzoek AMC’

Dijkstra (D66) asked why the AMC study in which fourteen patients died was stopped and only now made public, why no report was made to the IGJ, and whether the two existing procedures' differing risks warrant further research. Minister De Jonge confirmed the figures and timing, said the CCMO is analysing the file and the IGJ will decide on further inquiry after the CCMO results, and held that no report was obviously required yet.
The CCMO has requested the research file from the METC and will subject it to further analysis.
De CCMO heeft het onderzoeksdossier opgevraagd bij de METC en zal dit aan een nadere analyse onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen behandelen intensief door bij levenseinde’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister how the government views conflicting findings from a university consortium and the Zorginstituut on whether hospitals overtreat patients at the end of life, and why hospital-level practice variation was not studied. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut commissioned and published the studies, that its own analysis nuanced the consortium's findings, and that practice variation at hospital level was not requested because of legal limits on identifiable data, while saying further hospital-level research is possible only if institutions share data and declining to commission it now.
The Zorginstituut awarded the assignment on the basis of this offer, and informed the researchers that it has no legal possibility to publish information traceable to individual institutions.

Het Zorginstituut heeft de opdracht toegekend op basis van deze offerte, en heeft de onderzoekers laten weten dat het Zorginstituut juridisch geen mogelijkheden heeft om tot instellingen herleidbare informatie te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht 'Verbod embryo’s kweken niet houdbaar'

Tellegen (VVD) and Dijkstra (D66) asked the Health Minister about calls by European doctors' associations to legalise creating human embryos for research and about the implications for patients if the ban remains. The minister said the coalition parties hold differing views, that a broad ethical debate must come first, and that the government will pursue alternative stem-cell research instead.
The cabinet will stimulate this discussion and at the same time focus on innovative stem cell research.
Het kabinet zal deze discussie stimuleren en tegelijkertijd inzetten op innovatief stamcelonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘E-healthweek 2018: ‘Opschaling is altijd gedoe’’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the slow scaling of e-health innovations, the potential of blockchain in healthcare, its obstacles, and the status of the Mijn Zorg Log prototype including its possible use for personal budgets. The minister answered that scaling is a challenge involving organisational change, listed existing support instruments, said blockchain is still early-stage with research ongoing by Zorginstituut Nederland, and described a small practice trial and the need for further study before wider use.
To deploy Mijn Zorg Log more broadly, including for personal budgets, further research is needed.
Om Mijn Zorg Log breder in te zetten, waaronder voor PGB, is nader onderzoek nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Paternotte over de radiouitzending 'Schimmige praktijken bij ZonMw' en de Kamerbrief van Minister Schippers van 3 oktober 2017 (Kamerstuk 30850-45)

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about a radio report on conflict-of-interest practices at ZonMw, including whether its 2016-2017 evaluation checked compliance with the Awb and codes of conduct, and whether exceptions to the conflict-of-interest code exist elsewhere. The minister replied that the evaluation did not cover these aspects, acknowledged a legal exception clause was removed after a 2015 appeal ruling, found a single NWO case of insufficiently strict application, announced a joint code evaluation that will delete the exception clause, and promised further measures and to send the answers to the Chamber.
Following that, the application of and supervision of compliance with the code of conduct has been tightened for all ZonMw committees.
Naar aanleiding daarvan is de toepassing van en het toezicht op naleving van de gedragscode voor alle ZonMw-commissies verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht dat meerderheid van de zorgsites onbeveiligd is

MPs Dijkstra and Verhoeven asked whether the Minister would act after a report that most healthcare provider websites lack secure connections, and why some sectors perform worse. The Minister replied that information security is primarily the providers' own responsibility, enforced by the Data Protection Authority and IGZ, and pointed to an action plan and awareness efforts without new binding measures.
I do not have a specific explanation for why one healthcare sector has a higher percentage of secure connections than another.
Ik heb niet een specifieke verklaring waarom de ene zorgsector een hoger percentage beveiligde verbindingen heeft dan de andere zorgsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat kinderartsen afhankelijk werden van geld van farmaceutische bedrijven

MPs Bergkamp and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that paediatricians became dependent on pharmaceutical company funding, including whether they prescribe unnecessarily expensive growth hormones in exchange for research money. The minister said the IGZ will handle the case as a report and examine it, that the Medicines Act bans inducements tied to prescribing, and that the IGZ, NZa and the Transparantieregister Zorg are the relevant safeguards, while awaiting the IGZ findings.
The IGZ has committed to handle this case as a report.
De IGZ heeft toegezegd, om deze casus als melding te behandelen.
Antwoord op de leden Pia Dijkstra en Diertens over het niet uitvoeren van een rechterlijke uitspraak betreffende erkenning van beroepskwalificaties voor mensen met een buitenland diploma

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Diertens asked why the government does not implement a court ruling that a required additional training course for a foreign-trained psychotherapist was unlawful, and how many applicants are affected. Minister Schippers says she has appealed the ruling because the Dutch curriculum requires two courses, that a settlement was reached in the interim relief proceedings, that the appeal has no suspensive effect, and that she will decide on consequences once the Council of State rules.
Because I do not agree with the court's finding that the person concerned need only take one deepening course, I have lodged an appeal against this ruling.
Omdat ik het niet eens ben met het oordeel van de rechtbank dat betrokkene slechts een verdiepingscursus moet volgen, heb ik tegen deze uitspraak hoger beroep ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de voortgang van het onderzoek naar patiënten die niet wisten dat ze een proefkonijn waren

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the minister about the progress of the IGZ investigation into patients who were unknowingly used as test subjects for a cryoballoon heart procedure. The minister confirms the investigation was completed in May, that the report will be published by the IGZ before summer after a consultation with those involved, subject to privacy rules.
The report is expected to be published on the IGZ website before the summer.
Het rapport zal naar verwachting voor de zomer worden gepubliceerd op de site van de IGZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat de huisartsenpraktijk uit Woerden verdwijnt

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the out-of-hours GP post in Woerden, which is closing and merging into Leidsche Rijn, is adequate for Woerden residents and whether a local alternative was considered. The Minister defended the decision as a matter for GPs and insurers based on quality and patient safety, noting that residents still have access and that similar consolidation is a national trend.
It is up to GPs and health insurers to organise care at local level so that quality and accessibility are adequately guaranteed.
Het is aan huisartsen en zorgverzekeraars om de zorg op lokaal niveau zo in te richten dat kwaliteit en bereikbaarheid voldoende zijn gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de eerder ontvangen antwoorden op vragen aangaande wachtlijsten in de transgenderzorg.

MPs Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked the minister to explain how transgender care waiting lists would be reduced, whether coordinated care contracting and the rejection of separate contracting is evidence-based, the stigma of certain statements, the informed consent model, and the timeline of the quality standard. The government answered with capacity expansions, a planned quality standard by April 2018, a defence of coordinated multidisciplinary care, and that waiting times of two years are not recognised from available data.
The VUmc has decided to again substantially increase the capacity of its Knowledge and Care Centre for Gender Dysphoria for 2017, by 20%.
Het VUmc heeft besloten om voor 2017 de capaciteit van het Kennis- en Zorgcentrum voor Genderdysforie (KZcG) opnieuw fors, te weten met 20%, te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de problemen met de uitvoering van de Niet Invasieve Prenatale Test (NIPT)

MP Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister about midwives' complaints that the NIPT prenatal test is customer-unfriendly, with few blood-draw sites, a multi-step online payment process, and why only three laboratories perform the test. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said the payment process has been simplified and an evaluation of blood-draw locations will take place mid-May with adjustments where needed, while defending the limited number of labs on cost and quality grounds.
In mid-May an evaluation will take place of the number of blood-draw locations and their distribution across the Netherlands.
Half mei zal er een evaluatie plaatsvinden van het aantal bloedafnamelocaties en de spreiding in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de noodkreet van transgenders over veel te lange wachtlijsten

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister about lengthening waiting lists for gender clinics, rising referral numbers, risks from self-medication with hormones, whether Treek norms apply, specialist shortages, and whether a national network is desirable. Minister Schippers answered that referrals are rising, that providers and insurers must spread care and recruit staff, that the NZa has asked providers to publish waiting times without a Treek norm, and that a quality standard is being developed.
I believe providers and health insurers must work hard on spreading this care, scaling up chain treatment and recruiting staff.
Ik vind dat aanbieders en zorgverzekeraars hard moeten werken aan spreiding van deze zorg, het opschalen van ketenbehandeling en het werven van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Pechtold over het bericht dat de benodigde gelden voor Huntington onderzoek niet op tafel komen

D66 MPs Pechtold and Pia Dijkstra asked whether the Health Ministry told Huntington researchers to seek the required 4 million euro elsewhere, whether this matches the minister's promised support, and whether the money should be provided quickly. Minister Schippers answered that ministry staff assisted in contacting RVO, Life Sciences & Health, NWO and ZonMw, that the ministry has no innovation fund for the sum, and that drug development is primarily the pharmaceutical industry's responsibility, while promising to keep assisting.
However, I did commit to support the researchers in finding other possible sources of funding.
Wel heb ik toegezegd om de onderzoekers te ondersteunen bij het vinden van andere mogelijke financieringsbronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Weyenberg over jonge vrouwen die vaak in deeltijd werken

MPs Dijkstra and Van Weyenberg asked about young women working part-time more often than men, its causes, its long-term effects on economic independence, and whether the government will act. The minister answers that causes are not yet clear and are being studied in a joint OCW/SCP project, and points to existing awareness and budgeting initiatives and general part-time work rules, without committing to new legislation.
The causes are not yet clear now; that is precisely the subject of the research.
De oorzaken zijn nu nog niet duidelijk, dat is juist onderwerp van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de voortgang van de gesprekken met de Huntington-onderzoekers en het Campagneteam Huntington

The MP asks whether the minister has held the promised talks with Huntington researchers and the Huntington campaign team about funding a breakthrough, and what their progress and results are. The minister answers that VWS staff and the Life Sciences & Health top sector met them, that RVO is exploring European and TKI funding options, and that outcomes will be discussed with all parties at the end of February.
At the end of February, the researchers, the campaign team, RVO and the top sector LSH will jointly discuss the outcomes and next steps.
Eind februari zullen de onderzoekers, het Campagneteam, RVO en de topsector LSH samen de uitkomsten en vervolgstappen bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de uitvoering van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about implementation of the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), including the government's stance on a CEDAW Committee recommendation to compensate self-employed women who gave birth in 2005, sexism, intersex and transgender care, abortion pill rules, sex work registration, and a conference. The government answered most questions by restating its positions, citing pending Centrale Raad van Beroep cases, and promising to inform parliament of outcomes.
Several procedures are currently pending before the Central Appeals Tribunal. The cabinet is waiting for those rulings.
Er lopen nu enkele procedures bij de Centrale Raad van Beroep. Die uitspraken wacht het kabinet af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de kwaliteit in de hoorzorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about criticism of the 2013 hearing-aid reimbursement system, falling device prices, whether low reimbursement harms care quality and encourages low-care high-volume practice, and whether the minister will convene the sector on protocol version 2.0. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut evaluation found user satisfaction with care broadly unchanged, average co-payments halved, and improvements still possible, and that she sees no need to convene the sector while the parties talk constructively.
The evaluation showed that user satisfaction with the quality of care has generally remained the same and has increased in some areas.
Uit de evaluatie bleek dat de tevredenheid van gebruikers over de kwaliteit van zorg over het algemeen gelijk is gebleven en op sommige onderdelen is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het uitvoeren van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked several ministers about implementing the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), covering reporting, the 2005 self-employed maternity compensation case, stereotyping in advertising, domestic violence, care for trans and intersex people, sex work registration, and Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that it will inform parliament in January 2017, rejects the committee's recommendation on maternity compensation pending a Supreme Court-level ruling, and pledges several follow-up actions but declines to investigate some concerns.
The committee recommended that the Dutch government (financially) compensate self-employed women who gave birth in that period. The government decided not to follow this recommendation.

Het comité heeft de Nederlandse regering aanbevolen om vrouwelijke zelfstandigen, die in die periode zijn bevallen, (financieel) te compenseren. De regering heeft besloten om deze aanbeveling van het Comité niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Pechtold over het bericht dat er geen aidsremmers meer in Curaçao beschikbaar zijn

MPs Dijkstra and Pechtold asked the ministers about reports that HIV/AIDS medication was unavailable in Curaçao, including how many patients were affected and what Nederland would do. Minister Schippers answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own healthcare, declined to provide patient figures, and said she is not currently in talks with Curaçao's government.
In this case it is not for the government of another country, the Netherlands, to judge and intervene in what I regard as internal affairs of the country of Curaçao.
Het is in dit geval niet aan de regering van een ander land, Nederland, om te oordelen over en te interveniëren in wat ik als, interne aangelegenheden van het land Curaçao beschouw.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS zorgverleners aanraadt om browsers niet te updaten

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked why the Ministry of Health advised healthcare providers not to update browsers over Java plugin support ending, and whether this exposed patient data to cyberattacks. The minister explained the advice was to avoid uncontrolled updates that could break software, that responsibility lies with providers, that NCSC was not initially involved but now is, and that a solution is expected by year-end.
It is important that healthcare providers themselves weigh security against possible limits on functionality.
Het is belangrijk dat zorgverleners zelf de afweging maken tussen beveiliging en mogelijke beperking in functionaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de politie in Istanbul leden van de Gay Pride-organisatie heeft gearresteerd

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knew the official reason for Istanbul police arresting Gay Pride organisers, and how it would respond to Turkey's treatment of LGBTI rights. The ministers answered that Turkish authorities gave no official reason, that the government regrets the cancelled Pride but accepts possible security motives, and that it funds LGBTI projects in Turkey and raises the issue in EU accession talks.
The Turkish authorities have not given an official explanation for why these people were briefly detained.
De Turkse autoriteiten hebben geen officiële verklaring gegeven waarom deze mensen korte tijd zijn vastgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Falen met psychoten’

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health about a news report on failures in dealing with psychiatric patients who may pose a danger, including whether municipalities had a plan of action by summer 2016, why the aanjaagteam target was missed, and whether the Hoekstra monitoring report had been received. The Minister replied that the aim of a sound approach by all municipalities in summer 2016 was ambitious, that answers will follow in the government's reaction to the second interim report in late September, and that the Hoekstra report will be submitted by 15 October.
I have not yet received the monitoring report from Mr Hoekstra.
Het monitorrapport van de heer Hoekstra heb ik nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Meenen over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen onderzoekstijd verliezen

MPs Dijkstra and Van Meenen asked the minister whether pregnant female researchers lose research time because temporary contracts are not extended, despite UWV pregnancy benefits, and what will be done about the low share of female professors. The minister answered that UWV pay is a general scheme meant to compensate wages, that universities are asked to use it flexibly, that the Wwz four-year chain rule is adequately flexible, and that she will ask universities how they will address the problem and monitor progress.
I consider the problem for female researchers urgent and will ask the universities how they concretely shape possible solutions.
Ik vind de problematiek voor vrouwelijke onderzoekers urgent en zal de universiteiten vragen hoe zij concreet vorm geven aan mogelijke oplossingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Cyber security van apparatuur in ziekenhuizen kwetsbaar’

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked about reports that medical equipment in hospitals is vulnerable to cyber attacks, including malware infections and whether ministers would investigate device security and push for a national approach. The minister replied that hospitals are responsible for their own information security, pointed to existing NCSC initiatives (ISAC, Z-CERT) and a forthcoming quickscan, and committed to further study and discussion with stakeholders.
Information security is an own responsibility of a healthcare institution.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een zorginstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over PrEP

An MP asked the health minister about the effectiveness and safety of PrEP, why its introduction awaits EMA registration despite FDA approval elsewhere, and whether preparatory steps can avoid delay. The minister replied that PrEP awaits EMA registration, will seek a Health Council advisory opinion, and cannot anticipate those outcomes.
I will ask the Health Council for advice on the desirability of deploying PrEP for very specific risk groups.
Ik ga de Gezondheidsraad om advies vragen over de opportuniteit van de inzet van PrEP bij zeer specifieke risicogroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de geschillencommissie onder de Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg

An MP asked the health minister whether low-threshold recognised complaints committees under the Wkkgz will be available from 1 January 2017, and why none had yet been recognised. The minister said providers must join a recognised dispute body from that date, no recognition had yet been granted, parties were working on setting them up with the expected recognitions in the coming months, and she saw no reason to doubt compliance.
At this moment I have not yet granted recognition for such a dispute body.
Op dit moment heb ik nog geen erkenning verleend voor een dergelijke geschilleninstantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Het is een prachtig kind. Waarom is hij overleden’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a news report on a stillbirth linked to disputes between midwives and obstetricians over a fetal growth restriction protocol and the use of ultrasound. The minister answered that professional groups should cooperate, that the IRIS study on a third-trimester scan is delayed, that stakeholders were invited to talk, and that the government will not introduce universal third-trimester scans without evidence and professional support.
I do not intend to introduce a universal third-trimester ultrasound without sufficient scientific evidence and without support among the professional groups.
Ik ben niet van plan om, zonder voldoende wetenschappelijk bewijs en zonder draagvlak onder de gezamenlijke beroepsgroepen, over te gaan op algehele invoering van een 3 e termijn echo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat meer soa’s (seksueel overdraagbare aandoeningen) zijn gevonden bij vrouwen en heteroseksuele mannen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that STI diagnoses are rising while fewer people get tested, and about waiting times at STI clinics for high-risk contacts. The minister answered that testing data are incomplete, that rising diagnoses may reflect better targeting, and that the government funds supplementary sexual health care for high-risk groups while GP care remains available.
To get a view of the total number of people in the Netherlands who get tested for an STI, insight is also needed into the number of tests carried out by GPs and through home testing.

Om zicht te kunnen krijgen op het totale aantal mensen in Nederland dat zich op een soa laat testen, is ook zicht nodig op het aantal testen dat wordt gedaan door de huisarts en door middel van thuistesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over PrEP

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the minister about the GGD Amsterdam PrEP demonstration project, EU/WHO recommendations, Dutch guidelines, pricing (about 7,000 euro per year for Truvada) and reimbursement of PrEP. The minister answered that PrEP is still in EMA registration, that a Dutch guideline is being prepared by the professional groups, and that no decision on adding PrEP to the insured package or changing prices can yet be made, deferring to ZIN.
Anticipating the EMA decision, I cannot yet make any statements on this.
Ik kan hier, vooruitlopend op het besluit van de EMA, dan ook nog geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Noodtoestand in Amerikaans ziekenhuis wegens ransomware’ (een chantagemethode op internet)

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether a ransomware-driven emergency like the US hospital case could happen in the Netherlands and what safeguards exist for hospital IT. The minister answers that no such emergency is known, that information security is the hospitals' own responsibility under existing NEN norms, and points to breach notification duties, IGZ outreach, and planned NIS directive and Z-CERT measures, but declines to commit to mandatory IT testing.
Information security is the hospital's own responsibility.
Informatiebeveiliging is een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de erkenning van beroepskwalificaties in de zorg voor mensen met een buitenlands diploma

An MP asked the health minister about recognition of foreign qualifications in healthcare, including application volumes, processing times and compliance with statutory deadlines. The minister reported 719 and 790 applications in 2014 and 2015, explained average processing times by profession, and acknowledged that faster processing is needed while outlining improvements.
I consider a further acceleration of the application process necessary and desirable.
Ik acht een verdere versnelling van het aanvraagproces noodzakelijk en gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over de verduurzaming van sportcomplexen

MPs Van Veldhoven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether greening sports facilities was an agreed measure of the Energy Agreement, whether the sports energy-savings subsidy is the main instrument, whether its budget will be topped up, and what the added value is if not. The minister replied that the subsidy stems from a parliamentary motion and is separate from the Energy Agreement, that no budget top-up is planned, and that other schemes remain available.
No, both my colleague of Economic Affairs and I see no possibilities within our budgets to top up the budget.
Nee, zowel mijn collega van Economische Zaken als ik zien geen mogelijkheden binnen onze begrotingen om het budget nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over hormoon verstorende stoffen en de relatie met de volksgezondheid

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Health about national and EU measures to reduce exposure to BPA and other hormone-disrupting substances, including prenatal advice, cancer trends and costs. The Minister replied that hospital and industry agreements, pressure on EFSA and the EU, and further research and advice updates are under way, with no firm timelines for some measures.
I have submitted the RIVM report to the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) and urged it to reconsider the tolerable daily intake (TDI) standard in light of the new insights.

Ik heb het RIVM-rapport aan de Europese Autoriteit voor Voedselveiligheid (EFSA) aangeboden en er op aangedrongen de norm voor de toelaatbare dagelijkse inname (Tolerabele Daily Intake, TDI) op grond van de nieuwe inzichten opnieuw te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over het gegeven dat de Rijksoverheid samenwerkt met de tabaksfirma Japan Tobacco International (JTI)

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked whether government co-operation with tobacco company JTI, via the Green Deal Schone Stranden on cigarette litter, complies with FCTC article 5.3. The state secretary answered that continuing the Green Deal in its current form is no longer acceptable and that the government will explore continuing it without the tobacco industry as a party.
I am of the opinion that continuing the GDSS in its current form is no longer acceptable in light of the current interpretation of article 5.3 of the WHO Framework Convention.
Ik ben van mening dat voortzetting van de GDSS in de huidige vorm niet meer acceptabel is gelet op de huidige invulling van artikel 5.3 WHO-kaderverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de nijpende situatie van Lesbische, Homo-, Biseksuelen en Transgenders (LHBT's) in Indonesië

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dijkstra asked the government about rising hostility toward LGBT people in Indonesia, including declarations of war by militant groups and stigmatising remarks by ministers. The minister answered that the Netherlands is monitoring the situation, raised concerns with Indonesian ministers, supports NGO and HIV programmes, and will raise human rights in the EU-Indonesia dialogue.
The cabinet shares the view that the stigmatisation of and negative statements about LGBT people are undesirable.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat de stigmatisering van en negatieve uitspraken over LHBT's onwenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over medische websites die gezondheidsgegevens lekken

An MP asked the Minister of Health about medical websites leaking health data via cookies, the limited capacity of the Data Protection Authority, and privacy safeguards in eHealth. The minister said the AP and ACM oversee cookies and data processing, the Informatieberaad will discuss extra safeguards with a first agreement expected in September, and organisations bear primary responsibility for compliance.
Given my eHealth ambitions, I will discuss with the members of the Informatieberaad whether there are possibilities to realise extra safeguards and promote privacy by design.
Gezien mijn eHealth ambities zal ik met de leden van het Informatieberaad bespreken of er mogelijkheden zijn om extra waarborgen te realiseren en «privacy by design» te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Koser Kaya over het suikergehalte in drinkpakjes voor kinderen

MPs Dijkstra and Koşer Kaya asked about Foodwatch findings that children's drink cartons contain more sugar than Coca-Cola, the child-targeted marketing of these products, and whether the 2020 sugar-reduction target is adequate. The minister points to the Product Composition Agreement, a stepwise approach to sugar reduction, EU-level action, and existing health education programmes, without committing to a stricter target.
A stepwise approach is needed to achieve sustainable results, both because of consumer taste adaptation and because of feasibility for industry.
Een stapsgewijze aanpak is nodig om duurzaam resultaat te behalen, zowel vanwege smaakgewenning bij de consument als vanwege haalbaarheid voor het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya, Verhoeven, Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Bontkragen van kinderjassen vol schadelijk gif’

D66 MPs asked whether mislabelling of fur-trimmed children's jackets and possible toxic substances warranted action, and whether the NVWA should have flagged the issue proactively. The minister said labelling rules are already set at EU level, toxic levels were below legal norms per NVWA and RIVM, and a formal NVWA risk assessment is pending with advice expected end of March.
I have asked the NVWA to have its risk assessment of the Kassa research reviewed by the RIVM.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht haar risico-inschatting van het onderzoek van Kassa te laten toetsen door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sjoerdsma over het zikavirus

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Sjoerdsma asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about Zika virus information for pregnant women, travel advice consistency with Belgium, and implementation of a motion on a medical rapid-response unit. The minister answered that information is provided via RIVM, LCR and foreign affairs channels, that the Netherlands follows WHO advice without a negative travel advice, and that Dutch contributions to the EU medical corps and WHO reform are underway.
The RIVM follows the WHO advice unless conditions in the Netherlands are so different that they justify different advice.
Het RIVM volgt de advisering van de WHO tenzij de omstandigheden in Nederland zo anders zijn dat dit een andere advisering rechtvaardigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Dit is wat teveel energiedrank met je lichaam doet’

MPs Koşer Kaya and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister how consumers, including minors, can learn from energy drink packaging that heavy consumption may cause serious health effects, and whether labelling and corporate responsibility are adequate. The minister replied that mandatory high-caffeine warnings already apply under EU rules, that industry's voluntary code adds further labelling and marketing limits, and that the government promotes information via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes.
Yes, see answer 2. In addition, I am focusing, for example, via the Voedingscentrum and school programmes on targeted information about healthy and unhealthy food
Ja, zie antwoord 2. Daarnaast zet ik bijvoorbeeld via het Voedingscentrum en schoolprogramma's in op gerichte voorlichting over gezonde en ongezonde voeding
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over de “ADHD-epidemie”

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked about the reported fourfold rise in ADHD medication over ten years, the risk of over-medicalisation of children, and whether psychiatrists' concerns and calls for more diagnostics were being addressed. The state secretary acknowledged the rise as worrying, pointed to the Health Council report and a 'Plan van Aanpak Gepaste Zorg' with concrete actions and a session on diagnostic pressure, but gave no independent analysis of the causes.
This strong increase in the use of medication for ADHD in recent years is worrying, although the Health Council found no clear explanation for the increase in its advice.

Deze forse stijging in het gebruik van medicatie bij ADHD de afgelopen jaren is zorgelijk, alhoewel de Gezondheidsraad in haar advies geen duidelijke verklaring heeft gevonden voor de toename in het gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Slowaakse overheid geen Nationaal Actieplan LHBTI gelijkheid aanneemt

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Slovak government dropping its national LGBTI equality action plan, and whether this conflicts with the Dutch-Maltese-Slovak EU presidency trio. The minister confirmed awareness, said the trio statement on gender equality remains intact and that the Netherlands will seek Council conclusions backing the Commission's LGBTI action plan, without new concrete steps.
I will continue to work for improving the position of LGBTI people in Europe.
Ik blijf mij inspannen voor de verbetering van de positie van LHBTI in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Pia Dijkstra over gesjoemel bij het Nederlands-Belgisch WK-bid

MPs Van Dekken and Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about alleged payments, including EUR 10,000 to vote-canvasser Amadou Diallo, in the Netherlands-Belgium World Cup bid. The minister answered that the KNVB found no violations in an initial review, that an independent accountant is investigating with results expected in Q1 2016, that business-sensitive documents will not be made public, and that she will await outcomes before considering recovering funds.
Documents containing business-sensitive information that give insight into the operational process for this bid have not been made public by me under the Wob.
Documenten met bedrijfsgevoelige informatie, die inzicht geven in het bedrijfsvoeringproces ten behoeve van dit bid zijn, in het kader van de Wob, door mij niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bruins Slot over over een dreigend tekort aan een geneesmiddel voor schildklierpatiënten

MPs Dijkstra (D66) and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked the health minister about an impending shortage of the thyroid medicine Thyrax Duotab 0.025 mg, including whether the manufacturer's planning error, its legal duty to keep stock, the inspectorate's enforcement and the EMA's role were handled properly. Minister Schippers answered that the inspectorate is investigating possible breach of the duty to keep stock and will not prejudge it, that alternative suppliers can partly fill the gap, and that she is concerned by the rising number of shortages and will bring parties together.
While the investigation is ongoing, the IGZ and I cannot say anything about the possible outcome or any enforcement action.
Lopende het onderzoek kunnen de IGZ en ik over de mogelijke uitkomst en eventuele inzet van handhaving niets zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat medische websites gezondheidsgegevens lekken

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health whether medical websites such as thuisarts.nl and hospital sites passing visitors' health data to commercial data firms without explicit notice is unacceptable, and whether such practices should be banned and investigated. The Minister said enforcement rests with the Data Protection Authority, found misuse of health data undesirable, and will discuss additional safeguards with the Informatieberaad without committing to a ban or a full investigation.
It is up to the Data Protection Authority, formerly the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens, to judge to what extent practices like these comply with laws and regulations.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, voorheen College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens, om te oordelen in hoeverre praktijksituaties als deze aan wet- en regelgeving voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat verzekeraars nog niet alle contracten met ziekenhuizen hebben gesloten, maar dat patiënten nu wel hun zorgverzekering moeten kiezen

An MP asked the Health Minister about insurers not yet having contracted all hospitals while patients must choose their health insurance for 2016, and asked about enforcement by the NZa and the agreement deadline. The Minister said insurers must inform policyholders about contracted care under NZa rules, that the 19 November deadline is not fully met but contracts are being added daily, and that she will discuss contracting deadlines with providers and insurers.
The NZa supervises this transparency by the health insurer.
De NZa houdt toezicht op deze transparantie door de zorgverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat homo mannen één jaar geen seks mogen hebben voordat ze bloed doneren

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister about reports that gay men must abstain from sex for a year before donating blood, questioning the rationale, the lack of attention to sexual risk behaviour and HIV testing windows, and the scientific basis for the 12-month deferral. Minister Schippers answered that the policy is based on epidemiological risk, that 12 months is a common deferral in Western countries, that sexual risk behaviour is already asked about, and that she will monitor international developments and talk again with Sanquin and COC next year.
Should data become available in the near future that allow further adjustment of the MSM donor selection policy without compromising the safety of the blood supply, I will of course consider this.

Mochten in de nabije toekomst gegevens beschikbaar komen die een verdere aanpassing van het donorselectiebeleid rond MSM mogelijk maken zónder dat dit ten koste gaat van de veiligheid van de bloedvoorziening, dan zal ik dit uiteraard in overweging nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het effectiever vormgeven van geneesmiddelenonderzoek

An MP asked the health minister whether pharmaceutical firms' focus on single cancer drugs wastes potentially useful combination-therapy research, and what role government could play in encouraging more efficient R&D. The minister answered that combination research is possible but depends on competing firms, that firms are responsible for their own efficiency, that the CBG offers scientific advice, and that ZonMw translational research funding is available, without committing to a new government role.
Pharmaceutical companies are free to collaborate in the development stage to investigate combination therapies and to organise an efficient R&D approach.
Het staat farmaceutische bedrijven vrij om samen te werken in het ontwikkelstadium om combinatietherapieën te onderzoeken en een efficiënte R&D-werkwijze in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘GGZ-instelling weigert VGZ-klanten nog te behandelen’

Rep. Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Health whether it is acceptable that GGZ patients insured with VGZ may be refused treatment late in the year because of volume caps, whether insurers must disclose such caps in advance, whether providers may refuse patients under a must-deliver obligation, and what alternatives to caps exist. The Minister answered that insurers must inform policyholders about contracted providers and caps, that the insurer lifted the must-deliver obligation for the specific institution and arranges referrals, and that insurers are free to use alternative contracting forms.
Insured persons have a right to care.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Achmea premiekorting biedt in ruil voor privédata

MPs Verhoeven and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Achmea's offer of premium discounts in exchange for private driving and health-related data is acceptable, and how it complies with privacy law. The minister answered that insurers may use behavioural data within the Wbp framework, that the DPA is responsible for enforcement, that Achmea has not yet submitted the plan to the DPA, and that sharing with third parties is not Achmea's intent, while declining to judge the desirability of such practices.
It is not my place to pass judgment on the way insurers treat their customers.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel te geven over de manier waarop verzekeraars hun klanten tegemoet treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over gelijke rechten voor LHBT's in de SDG's

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would challenge Saudi Arabia over reports it wanted LGBT rights removed from the UN Sustainable Development Goals, and about Saudi membership of the Consultative Group of the Human Rights Council and the Cairo Declaration. The minister answered that LGBT rights were never explicitly included in the SDGs, that the non-discrimination and Leave No One Behind principles apply to everyone, and that the Universal Declaration remains the leading standard, without committing to new action against Saudi Arabia.
It is worth stressing that there was never any explicit inclusion of equal rights for LGBT persons in the SDGs.
Daarbij is het goed te benadrukken dat er nooit sprake is geweest van expliciete opname van gelijke rechten voor LHBT's in de SDG's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een verboden emulgator in frisdranken AH en Jumbo zit

Two D66 MPs asked how a banned emulsifier could end up in soft drinks sold by AH and Jumbo without enforcement, and how import controls by the NVWA work. The minister answered that businesses are responsible for food safety, the NVWA uses risk-based inspection, the chain acted after a signal, and full certainty cannot be given.
The NVWA enforces compliance with food legislation. It deploys its capacity and resources based on risk assessments.
De NVWA handhaaft de naleving van de levensmiddelenwetgeving. Zij zet haar capaciteit en middelen in op basis van risico-inschattingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat wachttijden in ziekenhuizen schijn zijn

An MP asked the health minister about a report that hospital waiting times are largely artificial, with capacity available but insurer budgets exhausted, and whether academic hospitals deliberately lengthen waits and whether insurers evade their duty of care. The minister rejected these claims, pointing to existing transparency rules and NZa monitoring, and promised only continued monitoring and an annual market scan without a separate meeting with parties.
The NZa has received no signals that academic hospitals fail to comply with these regulations.
Bij de NZa zijn geen signalen binnengekomen dat de academische ziekenhuizen deze regelingen niet naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een veelbelovend longkankermedicijn niet voor elke patiënt beschikbaar is

An MP asked the health minister how access to the lung cancer drug nivolumab is guaranteed regardless of place of residence, given that only four of twelve designated hospitals currently provide it, and what doctors should do when no nearby hospital has capacity. The minister answered that the drug is free while in the scheme, care is covered by insurers' duty of care, insurers must arrange access, and a 10-hospital phone check shows access is largely in place.

I call on the parties, where this has not yet happened, to make concrete agreements in the ongoing contracts as soon as possible to remove any remaining uncertainty about the (reimbursement for) provision of nivolumab.

Ik roep partijen op om, daar waar dit nog niet is gebeurd, op zo kort mogelijke termijn concrete afspraken te maken in de lopende contracten die nodig zijn om eventuele resterende onduidelijkheid rond de (vergoeding bij) verstrekking van nivolumab weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Pia Dijkstra over apotheken die ’s nachts in dorpen soms tien keer duurder zijn dan in de stad

MPs Bruins Slot and Pia Dijkstra asked why out-of-hours pharmacy prices differ up to tenfold between regions and whether the 2014 financing model, a possible night closure, or a national tariff could fix this. The minister acknowledged the problem and said it is resolved from 2016 after talks with the NZa and stakeholders, but declined to commit to a national tariff, citing subsidiarity and proportionality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat bestuurders van ziekenhuizen massaal declaratieregels negeren

An MP asked the health minister about reports that hospital boards exceed declaration norms and ignore collective agreement rules, and whether governance is in order and what will be done. The minister regretted the reports, asked the hospital associations to remind members of the rules, said the NFU will inventory declaration rules, and pointed to planned governance measures, while stating that hospitals are private institutions whose supervisory boards are responsible for compliance.
I have no information about how declaration rules are handled and what those rules look like.
Ik heb geen informatie over de omgang met declaratieregels en hoe deze regels eruit zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Pia Dijkstra over de hoge bedragen pgb-geld die verhaald worden op kwetsbare cliënten omdat hun zorgverleners hun zaken niet op orde hadden

MPs Leijten and Dijkstra asked why clients of the care provider Fundament, dragers in zorg must repay large PGB sums misspent by their providers, whether repayment can be dropped, whether a criminal complaint was filed, and about inspection and conflict-of-interest rules for court-appointed administrators. The Secretary of State says repayment claims are suspended, a joint framework with insurers is being drafted, legal conflict rules apply to administrators, and a law change will be discussed with the NZa in autumn.
The repayment claims in this case have been suspended.
De terugvorderingen in onderhavige casus zijn opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over gezondheidsschade door hormoonverstorende stoffen in medische hulpmiddelen

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about health harm from hormone-disrupting substances leaking from medical devices used on premature infants, children and dialysis patients, and about BPA and phthalates in such devices. The minister answered that risks are not conclusively established, that EU criteria for endocrine disruptors are being developed, that the RIVM is studying the matter, and that she will pursue EU-level regulation and clearer labelling.
The RIVM has produced an overview of the main national and international risk assessments of BPA for humans and the environment, and of the uncertainties in them.
Het RIVM heeft een overzicht gemaakt van de belangrijkste nationale en internationale risicobeoordelingen van BPA voor mens en milieu, en de onzekerheden daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van het Pia Dijkstra over instituten die psychische hulp verlenen aan kankerpatiënten en afhankelijk zijn van goodwill

Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister about psycho-oncology institutes that depend on goodwill and face financial hardship, asking why reimbursement is based on regular mental health tariffs, how care is secured without national coverage, and whether dependence on goodwill is acceptable. Minister Schippers answered that she is engaging umbrella organisations and IPSO, will inform parliament before the budget debate, sees no reason to think maximum tariffs are insufficient, and does not judge the private funding share of individual providers.

I have agreed with IPSO to talk with them and other relevant parties in the field about this in the short term, so that it becomes clear whether improvements are needed in the organisation or funding of this care.

Ik heb met IPSO afgesproken met hen en met andere relevante partijen in het veld daarover op korte termijn door te praten, zodat helder wordt of er verbeteringen nodig zijn in de organisatie of bekostiging van deze zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de gevolgen van de wijziging van financiering voor de soa-poli Amsterdam

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the consequences of a funding ceiling for the Amsterdam GGD sexual health clinic, including fewer free STI tests for risk groups, long HIV testing waits, and risks of avoidance behaviour. The State Secretary replied that triage and efficiency measures are intended to free capacity, that GGDs and GPs remain available, and that the scheme will be evaluated in 2018 rather than earlier.
It is still too early to say whether the changes and the available amount are sufficient. That is why the evaluation has been scheduled for 2018.
Het is nog te vroeg om te zeggen of de wijzigingen en het beschikbare bedrag voldoende zijn. Daarom is de evaluatie in 2018 ingepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het taboe op seks in de ouderenzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary whether sexuality is still a taboo in elderly care and disability care, and whether a sexual service provider could be used for clients. The state secretary acknowledged the importance of intimacy and sexuality, said he would raise it with the sector and professional bodies, and saw no need to extend this to disability care or to endorse sexual service provision beyond leaving it to client-caregiver agreements.
At the General Consultation on quality policy for nursing home care of 18 March 2015 I indicated that I intend to discuss this topic with the field and the professional organisations.
In het Algemeen Overleg Kwaliteitsbeleid verpleeghuiszorg van 18 maart 2015 heb ik aangegeven dat ik voornemens ben dit onderwerp te bespreken met het werkveld en de beroepsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Levenseindekliniek niet blij met ‘gebrek aan nuance’ bij toetsing’

MPs Dijkstra and Tellegen asked the Health Minister about a report that the euthanasia clinic objected to the 'onzorgvuldig' label used by review committees even where only procedural shortcomings existed, and about whether doctors can demonstrate no alternative treatment was possible. The minister acknowledged that the terminology can create a non-nuanced picture, said it would be discussed with the committees, explained the review process and the referral to the IGZ and Public Prosecution Service, and said a forthcoming code of practice will clarify how the care criteria are applied.
I will therefore discuss the use of this terminology in a periodic consultation with the Rte.
Ik zal daarom in een periodieke overleg met de Rte het gebruik van deze terminologie bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de strijd rondom ADHD-medicatie voor volwassen

An MP asked the health minister about the regulatory rejection of Concerta for adults with ADHD, the Strattera trial populations, and whether the non-registration was kept secret; the minister answered that the CBG rejected the adult indication on risk-benefit grounds, that the rejection was published, and that she will await the psychiatric association's guideline before responding further. The answers are largely substantive but defer on the guideline and on new research.
This is incorrect, the rejection was not kept secret.
Dit is onjuist, de afwijzing is niet geheim gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het gebrek aan voorlichting aan meisjes en vrouwen met kanker over het behoud van hun vruchtbaarheid

An MP asked the Health Minister why only about 1 in 10 women with cancer are referred to a specialist to discuss fertility preservation, and whether guidelines are followed. The minister replied that counselling is part of care, that the field is responsible for guideline content and compliance, and that IGZ supervises compliance through risk-based oversight, without committing to new action.
The field itself is responsible for the content of the guidelines and their compliance.
Het veld is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud van de richtlijnen en de naleving daarvan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66) over het bericht dat de Nederlandse zorgautoriteit (NZa) jarenlang medische gegevens, onbeveiligd en in strijd met privacy regels, heeft bewaard

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked how the NZa could keep sensitive patient records and bank card copies unsecured and unchecked for years, what safeguards exist for supervisors' data handling, whether the Dutch data protection authority will be involved, and when the Chamber will be informed. The government's answer is a referral to an earlier written consultation letter on the NZa, without substantive answers to the five questions.

The written questions from MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (both D66), question number 2014Z06807, have been answered by means of the letter 'Report of a written consultation on the functioning of the NZa 2012'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2014Z06807 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het functioneren van de NZa 2012» (Kamerstuk 25 268, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over handel in illegale en levensbedreigende afslankproducten en doping

MPs Bruins Slot and Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about the easy online sale of illegal slimming pills, anabolics and EPO, low prosecution priority, enforcement capacity, reporting of counterfeit medicines and the doping law. The minister answered that enforcement is part of regular inspection work, a reporting point is being studied with results expected late 2014, and a doping bill has been delayed to late 2014.
After the summer recess you will receive a letter from me on the implementation of the Bruins Slot/Pia Dijkstra motion.
Na het zomerreces ontvangt u van mij een brief over de uitvoering van de motie Bruins Slot/Pia Dijkstra
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over een uitzending waarin een BIG-geregistreerde arts een ALS-patiënt dupeert

An MP asked the minister about a broadcast showing a BIG-registered doctor falsely promising to cure ALS, and what the Inspectorate had done. The minister said the Inspectorate referred the doctor to the disciplinary court, ordered him to remove misleading material, and described existing and proposed oversight powers over alternative care.
The IGZ decided to submit the doctor's conduct to the disciplinary court for review.
De IGZ heeft besloten het handelen van de arts ter toetsing voor te leggen aan de tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Tongeren over de samenstelling van de staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Van Tongeren asked whether a member of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap should be reconsidered given his tweet that there should be no more than two legal parents or guardians, and whether the government would reconsider his appointment. The Secretary of State confirmed the tweet, said all members are chosen for expertise and may hold views, and saw no reason to reconsider the appointment.
The mere fact that Prof. Nuytinck, prior to his appointment to the state commission, took part in the public debate via a tweet does not mean he would be biased regarding the commission's outcomes.

Het enkele feit dat (bijvoorbeeld) prof. Nuytinck zich, voorafgaand aan zijn benoeming in de staatscommissie, door middel van een tweet heeft gemengd in het maatschappelijk debat, betekent niet dat hij vooringenomen zou zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het Europese burgerinitiatief ‘One of Us’

Dijkstra (D66) asked the ministers about the European citizens' initiative 'One of Us', which would end EU funding for research and aid activities that may destroy embryos, and its effects on Dutch embryonic stem cell research, Flemish diabetes and Parkinson's research, and women's reproductive health aid. The ministers answered that the initiative conflicts with Dutch policy, that it would harm Dutch and Belgian research and reproductive health aid, and that the Netherlands will oppose tightening EU rules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht Besneden vrouw betaalt hersteloperatie zelf

An MP asked why reconstructive surgery for victims of female genital mutilation is not covered by the basic insurance package and whether the College voor Zorgverzekeringen should advise on it. The minister says the basic package covers plastic surgery only in limited cases, describes existing care and subsidised projects, and commits to including reconstructive surgery in the Zorgverzekeringswet once a protocol being drafted by professional groups is finished.
Once this protocol is completed I will bring reconstructive operations for genital mutilation under the Health Insurance Act.
Zodra dit protocol is afgerond zal ik hersteloperaties van genitale verminkingen onder de Zorgverzekeringswet brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat Nederlandse homostellen niet langer Russische kinderen kunnen adopteren

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Pia Dijkstra asked whether Russia's 2014 decree blocking adoptions by same-sex married couples and unmarried persons from countries allowing same-sex marriage affects Dutch applicants, and whether the Netherlands would support them before the European Court of Human Rights. The government answered that Russia-Netherlands adoption cooperation has never existed so effects are limited, and that intervention in ECHR cases would be assessed case by case and only in exceptional situations.
Whether the Netherlands will support any Dutch couples will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
Of Nederland eventuele Nederlandse stellen zal bijstaan zal per zaak worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het VUmc stopt met nieuwe behandelingen van transgenders en patiënten met genderdysforie

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Health Minister about VUmc reportedly halting new gender treatments due to lack of funds, and about the right to care, financing, capacity and the 2014 gender-declaration requirement. The minister said insurers and VUmc must resolve financing, pointed to the insurers' duty of care and the NZa's oversight, and said the declaration process is separate from medical treatment.
It is therefore up to insurers to agree with VUmc how much funding is needed for care for transgender people.
Het is dus aan verzekeraars om in overleg met het VUmc af te spreken hoeveel middelen nodig zijn voor de zorg voor transgenders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘tandarts maakte behandelingen niet duurder’

An MP asked the health minister how she views a Milliman study claiming dentists only applied inflation corrections during the free-tariff experiment, contrary to NZa findings of over 10% price rises, and about delays in the NZa/Deloitte cost study and the future of dental tariffs. The minister defends the NZa market scans, sees no reason to re-examine them or to launch a new free-price experiment, and says a multi-year agenda is being drawn up with the sector.
Based on the explanations of the methods used by Milliman and the NZa, I have no reason to doubt the outcomes of the NZa market scans.
Op basis van de toelichtingen op de gebruikte methoden door Milliman en de NZa heb ik geen aanleiding te twijfelen aan de uitkomsten van de NZa-marktscans.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de levensomstandigheden van psychiatrische patiënten bij langdurige opname

An MP asked the health minister about living conditions for long-term psychiatric inpatients after a press report on a patient, including the Inspectorate's views and whether the Bopz 'bestwil' criterion should return. The minister said individual cases fall to providers, cited Inspectorate findings on somatic care, and rejected reinstating the 'bestwil' criterion in favour of the harm-based Wet verplichte GGZ.
As Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, however, I am not competent to mediate in individual cases.
Als minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ben ik echter niet bevoegd om te bemiddelen in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht dat kinderen en jongeren vaker antidepressiva slikken

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked about reports that children and young people increasingly take antidepressants, the progress of round-table talks on demedicalisation, monitoring, and related actions. The State Secretary says rising help-seeking reflects better diagnosis and treatment, outlines the round-table process, ongoing research, and planned follow-up without giving hard outcome data.
Before summer 2014 I will organise a third round table to keep the discussion going and to exchange experiences with demedicalisation.
Voor de zomer van 2014 organiseer ik een derde ronde tafel om de discussie gaande te houden en om ervaringen met demedicalisering uit te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat homostellen hun kind niet kunnen erkennen

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether married gay men can be prevented from recognising an unborn child they fathered with an unmarried woman, given differing municipal practice under Article 1:204(1)(e) of the Civil Code. The State Secretary agreed there is no good reason for unequal treatment, explained that a 2013 amendment removes the provision (planned for 1 April 2014), and said municipalities apply the law individually.
From the standpoint of equal treatment, however, there is no good reason to continue giving the man married to a woman other than the mother a different position from a man married to a man.

Er is vanuit het oogpunt van gelijke behandeling evenwel geen goede reden om de met een andere vrouw dan de moeder gehuwde man een andere positie te blijven laten innemen dan de met een man gehuwde man.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pia Dijkstra over politie-inzet bij voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Dijkstra (D66) asked whether the 281,552 police hours spent on football matches in 2012–2013 were high compared with other events, whether this fits local priorities, and what preventive measures would reduce it. Minister Opstelten answered that football-related police deployment has fallen by 5% year-on-year and 15% over three seasons, that local authorities decide the balance of police deployment, and that cooperation with clubs and the KNVB is the preventive route.
That weighing is made at local level by the local authority, which has control over police deployment.
Die afweging wordt op lokaal niveau gemaakt door het lokaal gezag, dat zeggenschap heeft over de inzet van politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra over een dreigende ernstige verslechtering van de positie van Iraanse lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele en transgender (LHBT) asielzoekers

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra asked whether the abolition of the national c-ground in the asylum bill would worsen protection for Iranian LGBT asylum seekers, given continuing severe persecution, and whether the government would keep the protection level promised by a previous minister. The state secretary answered that a current country report on Iran will be assessed before the new law takes effect to decide whether equivalent protection under the a- or b-ground is needed, and that the group's protection is not automatically worsened.

However, this means that before the bill takes effect, based on current information on the situation of LGBT persons in Iran, it will be assessed whether there is reason to offer them a comparable level of protection under the a- or b-ground.

Wel brengt dit mee dat, voorafgaand aan de inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel, op basis van de actuele informatie over de situatie van LHBT's in Iran, zal worden beoordeeld of er aanleiding bestaat om hen een vergelijkbaar beschermingsniveau te bieden in het kader van de a- of de b-grond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over mensenrechtenschendingen in Rusland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked what Dutch and EU action has been taken against Russia's anti-gay propaganda and NGO laws, and whether a state complaint, suspension under Council of Europe Article 8, or a UN resolution is warranted. Minister Timmermans answered that Nederland and the EU have raised concerns repeatedly and will pursue dialogue, UN statements and bilateral initiatives, but judged a state complaint, suspension and a UN resolution not appropriate or lacking support.
The Netherlands wants to focus on broad international attention and dialogue on the legislation and the position of the LGBT community in Russia rather than initiating a bilateral process.
Nederland wil inzetten op brede internationale aandacht en dialoog over de wetgeving en de positie van de LHBT-gemeenschap in Rusland in plaats van een bilateraal proces te entameren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de inzet van de Koning om de Olympische Spelen naar Nederland te halen

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the King's role in securing his succession on the IOC and in lobbying for the Olympics, and how this fits the coalition agreement's stance against bidding. The minister acknowledged the article, said the IOC decides its own membership with no entitlement to a Dutch seat, that the King's support was a supportive contribution, and that the coalition agreement governs the government's position on hosting.
There is no question of direct succession, because there is no right to a Dutch seat on the IOC.
Van directe opvolging is geen sprake omdat er geen recht bestaat op een Nederlandse zetel in het IOC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra en Voortman over autisme en rijbewijskeuringen

MPs asked why people with autism must be medically re-examined for a driving licence, whether a standard test and a public list of examining specialists should exist, why examination fees vary, and whether periodic re-examination can be dropped after the Health Council advice. The minister explains the Health Council basis and checklist, notes that the NZa sets maximum fees and plans tariff differentiation from 2014, declines free choice of doctor for now while promising to weigh a list with the CBR and specialists, and intends to adopt the advice dropping triennial re-examination by 1 October.
I intend to adopt this advice from the Health Council.
Ik ben voornemens dit advies van de Gezondheidsraad over te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de moord op een homo-activist in Kameroen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister how the government would respond to the murder of gay rights activist Eric Lembembe in Cameroon, including pressing for investigation, decriminalisation, and monitoring and protecting LHBT people. The minister condemned the killing, said the Netherlands is acting mainly through the EU since closing its Yaoundé embassy, and that the EU High Representative called on Cameroon to prosecute the perpetrators, with monitoring to continue.
At the Dutch request, High Representative Ashton called on the Cameroonian government to track down and prosecute the perpetrators.
Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton heeft op Nederlands verzoek de Kameroenese regering opgeroepen de daders op te sporen en te berechten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de anti-homowet in Rusland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about Russia's anti-gay law, the safety of LGBT people and NGOs, foreign-agent rules, EU human rights strategy, and Dutch steps taken. The minister said he is concerned about the law's signal effect, will monitor NGO court cases in EU framework, and raised the issue with Russian officials.
The intention is to continue following the court cases against NGOs under the foreign agent legislation within the EU framework, if the NGO concerned wishes this.
Het voornemen is om de rechtszaken tegen NGO's n.a.v. de «foreign agent»-wetgeving te (blijven) volgen in EU-verband, indien de betreffende NGO dit wenst.
Antwoord vragen Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat honderden huisartsen gedwongen onveilige software gebruiken

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that hundreds of GP practices were forced to use insecure Java software, risking patient records and data protection. The minister answered that the vendor Promedico had delayed a security patch only for practices using UZI cards, that the fix was released on 3 June, that responsibility for data security lies with care providers and vendors, and that a stricter security norm (NEN 7510) will be referenced by decree.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Pia Dijkstra over de veiligheid van homoseksuele asielzoekers

MPs Schouw and Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the State Secretary about safety of LGBT asylum seekers in reception centres, incidents, discrimination reports, the Deloitte and COC reports, and the COC's recommendations. The State Secretary replied that COA, IND and DT&V have taken measures, about 90 possible discrimination cases were recorded in 2012 at reception locations, the IND reported no incidents, and he committed to continued dialogue with the COC while rejecting some COC demands such as blanket asylum for LGBT nationals of countries criminalising homosexuality.
Without further information, such as file numbers, it is not feasible to establish what exactly happened in these cases.
Het is, zonder nadere informatie, zoals bijvoorbeeld dossiernummers, niet haalbaar om na te gaan wat er in deze zaken exact gespeeld heeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de ILGA-Europe Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People in Europe 2013

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about the Netherlands dropping in the ILGA-Europe 2013 rankings, the human rights situation of LGBT people in Europe, and whether the government would back an EU action plan and anti-discrimination directive. The minister answered that the rankings methodology changed, that the Netherlands remains a leader on LGBT rights, and that the government supports the proposed EU initiative.
The cabinet supports the COC proposal.
Het kabinet steunt het voorstel van het COC.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het beoordelingssysteem voor geneesmiddelen niet bevorderlijk is voor de volksgezondheid

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the minister of Health about radio claims that the drug approval system is not conducive to public health, including the burden of additional research and leaks of advisory information. Minister Schippers answered that few truly new drugs have reached the market, that no single cause can be identified, that the regulator CBG requests additional studies when needed, and that the Escher project examines barriers to drug innovation.
However, I see it as my task to constantly and critically examine the necessity and usefulness of new rules.
Wel zie ik het als opdracht om nut en noodzaak van nieuwe regels constant en kritisch te bezien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over het oppakken van een homorechtenactivist in Zambia

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about the arrest and trial in Zambia of LGBT rights activist Paul Kasonkomona, the legal basis for his prosecution, the impact of closing the Dutch embassy on LGBT support, the safety of LGBT people, and whether the minister would press for decriminalisation. The minister confirmed the case under section 178(g) of the penal code, said the penalty is not yet known, outlined the worsening situation for LGBT people, and said Dutch efforts would continue via the EU and in ministerial contacts without a concrete commitment to a specific public intervention.
After the embassy closes in July 2013, Dutch efforts for LGBT rights in Zambia will continue within the EU framework.
Na de sluiting van de ambassade in juli 2013 zal de Nederlandse inzet in Zambia ten behoeve van LHBT-rechten in EU-verband worden voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het bericht dat controle op de verkoop van tabak aan jongeren onder de 16 jaar niks voorstelt

An MP asked why NVWA inspections of tobacco sales to under-16s fell to about 900 in 2012, and what will be done about enforcement, inspection capacity, mystery shoppers, technology and store numbers. The state secretary attributed the drop to priorities on smoking bans in hospitality and aggression against inspectors, announced a 17 fte youth tobacco team from 2014, and argued the age-limit increase to 18 supports the norm.
I consider compliance and supervision of the age limit to be of great importance.
Ik vind naleving en het toezicht op de leeftijdsgrens van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat de helft van bezoekers aan de eerste hulppost van het Medisch Centrum Haaglanden doorverwezen wordt naar de huisarts

Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister whether half of walk-in patients at a hospital emergency department could be referred to the GP post, and about integration of ER and GP out-of-hours services, costs, experiments and the payment system. The minister replied that integration is a policy priority, that about 40% of walk-ins at MCH are expected to be referred to the GP post, that savings are uncertain but the business case is positive, and that payment reforms are being prepared.
Cooperation between the GP post (HAP) and the ER is therefore important and aimed at clear access to acute care for the patient with one entrance and one triage
Samenwerking tussen Huisartsenpost (HAP) en SEH is daarom belangrijk en gericht op een voor de patiënt heldere toegang tot acute zorg met één loket en één triage
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht “Meer gedwongen opnames”

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about reports that compulsory psychiatric admissions rose between 2002 and 2009, including whether the trend continues, regional differences, and effects on outpatient care and costs. The minister confirmed the rise (64% for court authorisations, 20% for emergency detentions), said numbers were roughly flat through 2012, and pointed to the new Wet verplichte ggz and outpatient coercion as ways to reduce compulsory admissions.
Preventing compulsory admissions has my attention and is part of the GGZ policy aimed at reducing coercive measures in mental health care.
Het voorkomen van dwangopnamen mijn aandacht en is onderdeel van het ingezette ggz beleid met betrekking tot het terugdringen van dwangtoepassingen in de GGZ.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Van Meenen over het bericht dat buitenlandse studenten onterecht een aanmaning voor een zorgverzekering ontvangen

MPs Dijkstra and Van Meenen asked whether foreign students were wrongly sent demands to take out Dutch health insurance, with fines, and whether this could be changed. The minister answered that students registered with DUO are not targeted, that students who work alongside their studies are rightly insured, that fines are withdrawn or refunded once students respond, and that the government will improve communication and an English-language form but will not exempt students with small jobs.
If the student responds to the CVZ or SVB after the letter, no fine is imposed at all.
Als de student na de aanschrijving van het CVZ reageert naar het CVZ of de SVB, dan wordt er in het geheel geen boete opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de Russische anti-homowet

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign and education ministers about a Russian bill banning public speech on homosexuality, and whether the Netherlands would protest and protect LGBT rights.
