Minister Timmermans said the bill is discriminatory and harmful, that the concern was conveyed to the Russian ambassador, raised at the EU level and in a planned visit, and that Dutch funding for LGBT projects in Russia continues.
On 1 February I had my concerns conveyed to the Russian ambassador.
Op 1 februari heb ik mijn zorgen aan de Russische ambassadeur laten overbrengen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen met een verhoogd risico op een kind met het syndroom van Down niet langer in een Nederlandse ziekenhuis terecht kunnen voor een bloedtes

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that LUMC stopped offering a non-invasive prenatal blood test for Down syndrome after a warning that it lacked the licence required under the Population Screening Act. The minister confirmed the warning, said no licence application had yet been filed, and promised to ask the Health Council for advice once one is submitted and to request a signalement on the test's ethical implications.
The ministry of VWS did warn the LUMC because it did not have the licence required under the Population Screening Act (WBO).
Het ministerie van VWS heeft het LUMC echter gewaarschuwd omdat zij niet beschikte over de vergunning die in het kader van de Wet op het bevolkingsonderzoek (WBO) nodig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Schouw over het bericht dat er nauwelijks controle is op het rookverbod in de horeca

MPs Pia Dijkstra and Schouw asked whether enforcement of the smoking ban in hospitality is too thin, given roughly 3,154 targeted checks by the NVWA in 2012, uneven regional coverage and reported fine figures. The state secretary answered that enforcement is as optimal as current capacity allows, that the problem is concentrated in cafés and discotheques, that about 4,000 targeted checks are planned for 2013, and that he is examining options to expand enforcement capacity.
I am currently examining the options to increase enforcement capacity.
Ik onderzoek op dit moment de mogelijkheden om de handhavingscapaciteit te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over de toename van het aantal rokers

An MP asks the health minister about a report showing a rise in smokers, its causes (small-café exemption, unfunded quit programmes, no anti-smoking campaigns), and whether quit programmes and new tobacco measures will be continued. The state secretary refers to earlier answers on some points, says quit-smoking care enters the basic insurance from 2013 and that existing tobacco measures stay in force, and announces more prevention for youth and a higher minimum purchase age of 18.
In addition, I intend to raise the minimum age for purchasing tobacco to 18.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens de minimumleeftijd voor het kopen van tabak te verhogen naar 18 jaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

Two D66 MPs asked the government about a proposed Ugandan anti-homosexuality bill carrying the death penalty, its likely passage, diplomatic steps, and whether deportations of Ugandan LGBT asylum seekers should be suspended. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns, that the EU ambassadors raised them with Uganda's prime minister, that further steps are premature, and that asylum seekers are assessed individually rather than as a group.
A careful individual assessment is therefore carried out, taking into account the worrying situation of homosexuals in Uganda.
Er vindt derhalve een zorgvuldige individuele toets plaats met inachtneming van de zorgelijke situatie van homoseksuelen in Oeganda.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het bericht dat er aanwijzingen zijn dat Nederlandse patiënten in het buitenland organen kopen en laten transplanteren

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the health minister about reports that Dutch patients buy organs abroad, including whether there are concrete cases, whether the government will analyse the Dutch situation, and whether donation practice should be adapted. Minister Schippers answered that one concrete case from 2007 led to tightened reimbursement rules, that a method to estimate organ trade in the Netherlands is awaited from the NTS, and that financial incentives for living donation are legally not possible.
I will inform the House in due course about the data collected using the method proposed by the NTS.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer te zijner tijd informeren over de gegevens die aan de hand van de door NTS voorgestelde methode zijn verzameld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra, Van Gent en Marcouch over het niet uitvoeren van de motie die verzoekt bloeddonatie voor homoseksuelen mogelijk te maken

MPs Dijkstra, Van Gent and Marcouch asked why the minister did not implement a motion to allow blood donation by gay men and whether she would reconsider using new scientific evidence and foreign practice. The minister replied that she relies on Sanquin's advice and current epidemiological data, will not yet reconsider, and will inform parliament after consultations with other experts by early September.
I aim to send your House a letter on this subject in the short term, by early September at the latest.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer op korte termijn, uiterlijk begin september, een brief over dit onderwerp te sturen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Schouw over controles op EK-voetbalpoules in café's en kroegen

MPs Dijkstra and Schouw asked whether the Kansspelautoriteit will actively check cafés and pubs running EK football pools, whether fines can reach 780,000 euro, and what criteria distinguish open from closed pools. The State Secretary answered that the regulator sets its own priorities, will focus on large-scale commercial gambling rather than small café pools, may impose fines up to 780,000 euro or 10% of turnover, and will consider whether a venue is open to the public.
In principle the gambling authority itself decides how it carries out those tasks and which priorities it sets.
In beginsel bepaalt de kansspelautoriteit zelf hoe zij die taken uitvoert en welke prioriteiten zij daarbij stelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het bericht dat artsen vinden dat ernstig zieke patiënten te lang worden doorbehandeld

An MP asked the health minister how she views reports that doctors feel gravely ill patients are kept in treatment too long, and whether doctors need more support and curriculum attention for end-of-life treatment conversations. The minister agreed the topic matters, attributed the gap partly to patient and family preferences, and said she sees no need for a broader curriculum but supports initiatives and raises the theme herself.
I consider it very important that attention is paid to which treatment goals are pursued.
Ik vind het erg belangrijk dat er aandacht is voor de vraag welke behandeldoelen nagestreefd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra inzake “de vertraging van verplichte voorlichting over (homo- en trans)seksualiteit op scholen

An MP asked the minister why the Council of State requested an Onderwijsraad advice on the mandatory sex and sexual diversity education decree, and whether the 1 August 2012 start date can still be met. The minister confirmed the advice request, explained that the decree can now only take effect on 1 August 2013 due to procedural steps, and pointed to voluntary initiatives in the meantime.
I therefore aim for the amendment of the core objectives to take effect on 1 August 2013.
Ik streef er daarom naar de wijziging van de kerndoelen per 1 augustus 2013 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over de beheersing van het budget voor huisartsenzorg

Deputy Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Health how the budget for GP care and multidisciplinary care can be kept within macro limits, and whether health insurers share responsibility, including for predicting chronic-care volumes and monitoring quarterly costs. Minister Schippers answered that she is ultimately responsible for collective health spending, that overruns should first be absorbed within the sector, that insurers may shape their purchasing freely but must buy care efficiently, and that quarterly GP cost data will be monitored with the LHV and insurers.
As minister I am ultimately responsible for collective spending in healthcare.
Antwoord 1 Als minister ben ik eindverantwoordelijke voor de collectieve uitgaven in de zorg.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het bericht dat de wachtlijsten voor donororganen explosief zijn gestegen

An MP asked the health minister about reports that organ donation waiting lists had risen sharply, and whether the figures were a fair measure of progress under the Masterplan. The minister disputed the press release as tendentious, defended the waiting-list counting method, and declined to adopt an Active Donor Registration system, while pointing to existing steps to raise transplant numbers.
I consider it of little use to count patients as waiting when in fact they are not, because they cannot undergo a transplant.
Ik vind het weinig zinvol om patiënten als wachtenden aan te merken als zij dat feitelijk niet zijn omdat ze geen transplantatie kunnen ondergaan.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over de sponsoring door een jeneverproducent van een ziekenhuis

An MP asked the health minister to respond to news that a gin producer sponsored a Schiedam hospital, whether such sponsorship could lead to business influence over hospital policy, and whether rules on independence and transparency should be introduced. The minister answered that the donation was not sponsorship, that the board remains responsible for policy, that existing annual-report rules suffice, and that the sector code is being promoted.
No. Through the annual accounts, hospital boards already account for the hospital's financial flows.
Nee. Via de jaarrekening leggen besturen van ziekenhuizen al verantwoording af over de geldstromen van het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra en Hachchi over onveilige software in pacemakers

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about security vulnerabilities in SCADA software in pacemakers and insulin pumps, including whether manufacturers must report flaws and whether certification should be mandatory. The minister answered that no central registry exists, that manufacturers must validate software and carry out post-market surveillance, that reports go to notified bodies or the IGZ, and that tightening of the existing regime is planned.
In my letter dated 27 March 2012, I informed you of my plans to tighten the current legal regime.
In mijn brief d.d. 27 maart 2012, heb ik mijn voornemens voor aanscherpingen binnen het huidige wettelijke regime aan u kenbaar gemaakt.

MPs from six parties asked the health minister about breast implants (PIP), the ASIA syndrome, the AZM autoimmune centre closure, registration, quality standards and liability. The minister said evidence linking implants to autoimmune disease is limited, referred to the pending NIV/NVPC study, and said clinics and insurers will cover aftercare while IGZ monitors, with other matters deferred to a separate letter.
Aftercare is the responsibility of the clinics and hospitals where these prostheses were implanted.
De nazorg is de verantwoordelijkheid van de klinieken en ziekenhuizen, waar deze protheses zijn ingebracht.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over de geringe stijging van het aantal orgaandonoren

Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister why the number of organ donors rises only slightly, covering donor registrations, waiting lists, transplant numbers and whether trends show progress. Minister Schippers answered that registrations and transplants are slowly increasing, that waiting list size is a weak indicator, and that promising hospital pilots are being rolled out nationally, though it is too early to speak of trends.
I expect that further growth can be stimulated by rolling out the pilots in hospitals.
Ik verwacht dat een verdere groei kan worden gestimuleerd door de uitrol van de pilots in de ziekenhuizen.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over De uitspraak van de Minister-president dat het voor homoseksuele mannen mogelijk wordt bloed te doneren.

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister's statement that gay men would be allowed to donate blood is accurate, and whether the government had already decided its position without waiting for Council of Europe recommendations. The minister answered that the policy is under review in consultation with the education minister, that current rules exclude men who have sex with men, and that a decision depends on a forthcoming Council of Europe resolution expected in May 2012, with a letter to parliament promised before the summer recess.
I expect to inform your House about this before the summer recess.
Naar verwachting zal ik uw Kamer hier voor het zomerreces over informeren.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het besluit in de gemeente Staphorst om informatie over abortus op de website van het Centrum voor Jeugd en Gezin (CJG) weg te laten

MP Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister about Staphorst municipality's decision to omit abortion information from its CJG website, whether other municipalities do the same, and whether the minister will set norms. The state secretary replied that municipalities decide their own website content, that the Stichting Opvoeden.nl database is being reviewed, and that she will not impose norms on municipalities.
This does not mean that I want to intervene normatively towards municipalities.
Dit betekent niet dat ik normerend wil optreden richting gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het onderzoek van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg naar het aanbieden van christelijke homotherapie

An MP from D66 asked the health minister to explain the government's view that Different's therapy does not aim to cure homosexuality, and why the Inspectorate's report does not reflect former clients' testimonies. The minister answered that the therapy supports acceptance of one's sexuality, that the Inspectorate has told Different that treatment aimed at curing homosexuality can never comply with guidelines, and that former clients' experiences were included and the Inspectorate will re-check within two months.
If the IGZ still receives reports from (former) clients pointing to treatment aimed at 'curing' homosexuality, the IGZ will investigate these directly and take measures where necessary.
Als de IGZ alsnog meldingen krijgt van (ex-) cliënten die wijzen op behandeling gericht op het «genezen» van homoseksualiteit, dan zal de IGZ deze direct onderzoeken en zo nodig maatregelen treffen
Antwoord vragen Pechtold, Hachchi, Schouw en Dijkstra over Kamervragen Oeganda anti-homoseksualiteitswet

D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest to Uganda over a renewed anti-homosexuality bill that proposes the death penalty, and what concrete steps would follow if it passed. The minister said the bill is unacceptable, that Nederland and the EU have raised objections with Uganda, that the Ugandan premier distanced himself from it, and that further steps are premature.
I do not consider the proposed private member's bill acceptable.
Ik acht het voorliggende initiatiefwetsvoorstel niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over het bericht dat het kabinet wil bezuinigen op de zorg voor mensen met een laag IQ

An MP asked whether the planned 2013 cut to care for people with IQ 70-85 leaves them without support, whether a study would consider effects, stakeholders and a reversal. The state secretary postponed the measure by one year, stated it still must yield EUR 250 million structurally, and said no separate study exists while she is considering how to implement it.
There is no question of a study.
Er is geen sprake van een onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een brief naar aanleiding van een noodoproep in verband met de dengue-epidemie op Bonaire (ingezonden 9 dece

MPs Dijkstra and Hachchi asked how much money is spent on strengthening public health care on Bonaire, the role of RIVM, GGD and CAREC in dengue control, how local prevention policy will be continued and evaluated, and the cost of prevention relative to incomes. The minister answers that the island authorities are responsible for public health, that the ministry supports them with funding of up to 0.7 million euro a year for RIVM work and about 1 million euro for the GGD project to mid-2013, and that local evaluation is the island government's responsibility.

The island executives of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba (the BES islands), like municipal governments in the Netherlands, are themselves responsible for public health care, including infectious disease control.

De bestuurscolleges van Bonaire, Sint Eustasius en Saba (de BES-eilanden) zijn net als gemeentebesturen in Nederland, zelf verantwoordelijk voor de publieke gezondheidszorg, waaronder infectieziektebestrijding.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de aanpak van onderzoeksfraude in patiëntgebonden onderzoek, naar aanleiding van een opinieartikel over de affaire-Poldermans i

An MP asked the health minister about research fraud in patient-related studies following the Poldermans affair, including harm to patients, extra quality controls, FDA-style inspection, and publication of data. The minister replied that the Inspectorate is investigating, that existing rules (WMO, Geneesmiddelenwet, VSNU code) are sufficient, that repression is not the best tool, and that she will rely on the Schuyt commission and planned measures such as METC professionalisation and publication of results.
The Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is investigating the Poldermans case, particularly where it concerns the direct conduct of the research and the patients involved.
De Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) onderzoekt de casus Poldermans met name daar waar het de directe uitvoering van, en daarmee de patiënten in, het onderzoek betreft.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het hoogoplopende conflict tussen de minister en de huisartsen naar aanleiding van een uitzending van het televisieprogramma Bu

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about the conflict with GPs over chronic care, budget overruns in integrated chronic care and the 2011 GP tariff cut, and whether insurers and specialists share responsibility. The minister answered that she regrets GPs refusing certain patients, defended the tariff measure, and promised talks with insurers, GPs and specialists on substitution and chronic care.
It is not possible to specify which amounts can be attributed to overruns in chronic care delivered by medical specialists.
Het is niet mogelijk te specificeren welke bedragen toe te wijzen zijn aan (overschrijdingen in) de ketenzorg geleverd door medisch specialisten.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat verscheidene gemeenten de preventieve seksuele gezondheidszorg van jongeren staken (ingezonden 2 december 2011)

MP Dijkstra asked the health minister whether the GGD Midden Nederland was ending sexual health prevention for youth in 25 municipalities due to budget cuts, and about the wider impact. The minister denied the specific claim, said municipal health tasks are legally anchored and that municipalities set their own priorities, and promised further talks with municipalities.
No, for the explanation of this answer I refer to the answer to question 1 from Member Arib.
Nee, voor de toelichting op dit antwoord verwijs ik naar het antwoord op vraag 1 van het lid Arib

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een vergoeding van secundaire geslachtskenmerken voor transgenderoperaties (ingezonden 18 november

Two MPs asked the minister about a Transgender Remembrance Day and whether secondary sex characteristics should be covered by insurance for gender-affirming treatment, citing an adopted motion. The government acknowledged the importance of these characteristics for transgender people but said it sees no room in the Health Insurance Act to extend coverage or provide funding.
However, the cabinet currently sees no room to extend the entitlements under the Health Insurance Act on this point or otherwise make funding available for this.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment echter geen ruimte om de aanspraken ingevolge de Zorgverzekeringswet op dit punt uit te breiden of anderszins hiervoor financiering ter beschikking te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een te ontwikkelen multidisciplinaire richtlijn dwang en drang in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister why she frames a multidisciplinary guideline on coercion in mental health care as something to enforce, though the sector is willing to develop it, and why it is excluded from usual ZonMw funding. The minister replies that the sector must develop the guideline, that no government funding for guidelines has existed since 2008/2010, and that she will discuss the matter with parties and explore options without VWS funding.
In this conversation with the parties I want to once again outline the importance of the MDR coercion.
Ik wil in dit gesprek met partijen nogmaals het belang van de MDR dwang schetsen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een Argos-reportage over het (dis-)functioneren van trombosediensten (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about an Argos report on gaps in anticoagulant (thrombosis) care, including deaths linked to anticoagulant use, quality differences between thrombosis services, follow-up on a 2008/2010 IGZ report, and whether funding and purchasing should reward quality. The minister acknowledged 28 reported deaths of anticoagulant users, said there are no large quality differences, listed improvement initiatives with an IGZ follow-up study planned for late 2012, and explained that insurers already purchase this care with some room for quality-based tariffs.
The IGZ will carry out a study at the end of 2012 into the extent to which the agreements have been realised.
De IGZ zal eind 2012 een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mate waarin de afspraken zijn gerealiseerd.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over dat de Nederlandse Officieren Vereniging deelname van militairen aan de Gay Pride afkeurt (i

Two D66 MPs asked the Defence and Education ministers whether the government would distance itself from the Dutch Officers' Association's criticism of military participation in the Gay Pride Canal Parade, and whether uniformed personnel could participate again next year. The Defence minister replied that uniformed participation has been permitted since 2009 and will continue, that the magazine article is the association's responsibility, and that existing diversity measures on sexual orientation are largely being maintained.
Defence bears no responsibility for this magazine and the article is therefore the responsibility of the editorial board.
Defensie draagt geen verantwoordelijkheid voor dit blad en het artikel komt dan ook voor rekening van de redactie.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de minister weigerambtenaren de mogelijkheid wil blijven geven huwelijken tussen personen van gelijk geslacht te

An MP asks the minister of Education, Culture and Science whether her statements in an interview that civil servants should keep the option to refuse same-sex marriages reflect personal or cabinet views, and why she spoke before informing parliament about her promised response to the Equal Treatment Commission's 2008 advice. The minister answers that the position was already stated in parliament, that the cabinet will respond after seeking advice from the Council of State, and declines to answer within 48 hours.
Once the Council of State's advice has been received, the cabinet will send you a response.
Na ommekomst van de voorlichting van de Raad van State, zal het kabinet u een reactie doen toekomen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het uitsluiten van homo’s voor bloeddonatie ingaat tegen Europese rege

An MP asked the ministers whether EU rules require the Netherlands to quickly stop lifetime exclusion of gay men from blood donation and to wait for Council of Europe recommendations. The minister agreed that sexual risk behaviour, not sexual orientation, should be the criterion, but would not yet change the rules, saying changes depend on safety assessment, the Council of Europe resolution and talks with Sanquin.

As I indicated in answers to recent parliamentary questions from MP Arib on blood donation by homosexuals, the rules on blood donation by MSM can be amended if it is shown that the safety of blood product recipients is guaranteed.

Zoals ik in antwoorden op recente Kamervragen van het Kamerlid Arib over bloeddonatie door homoseksuelen heb aangegeven, kunnen de regels rondom bloeddonatie van MSM worden aangepast, als blijkt dat de veiligheid van ontvangers van bloedproducten gewaarborgd is.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie aanmerken van de tran

Deputy Dijkstra (D66) asked ministers whether the Netherlands agrees with the WHO's ICD-10 classification of transgender identity as a disorder and whether it would lobby for a different classification. The ministers said they support transgender emancipation, will facilitate an expert meeting to draft a text proposal for the WHO, but see no role for the Dutch government to argue the scientific debate itself, noting classification is separate from reimbursement decisions.
At this moment I see no role for the Dutch government to put its own arguments into the scientists' debate.
Op dit moment zie ik geen rol voor de Nederlandse overheid om zich met eigen argumenten in het debat van de wetenschappers te begeven.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de bezuiniging in de huisartsenzorg (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

Dijkstra (D66) asks the health minister whether, given budget cuts, GPs will stop necessary investments needed to implement integrated primary care, and whether the financial policy still serves better and cheaper primary care. Minister Schippers answers that overspending in GP and multidisciplinary care is being recovered, that investment room exists, that GPs can agree investments with insurers, and that costs are shared across patients, providers and insurers.
I have invited the Dutch GPs' association to discuss this, and I hope they are willing to do so.
Ik heb de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging uitgenodigd om hierover in gesprek te gaan en ik hoop dat zij hiertoe bereid is.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over patiëntregistraties als voorwaarde voor zorgcontractering (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether patient registries should be made a binding condition for contracting hospital care with expensive drugs, and questioned the NZa's role and timeline. The minister said NZa must first study whether mandatory transparency is necessary and feasible, that voluntary initiatives are also possible, and that she disagrees prestatiebekostiging depends on such a link.
I expect that the NZa needs several months to carry out research into these questions and to consult field parties.
Ik verwacht dat de NZa enkele maanden nodig heeft om onderzoek naar deze vragen te verrichten en om veldpartijen te consulteren.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de daling van het aantal rokers sinds de introductie van de stoppen-met-roken-vergoeding (ingezonden 18 augustus 2011).

Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister whether the falling smoking rate since the 2011 stop-smoking reimbursement reflects that policy, and whether removing reimbursement for stop-smoking programmes would reverse gains; the minister answered that causation is not yet certain, that counselling remains reimbursed while medication costs are dropped, and that anti-smoking policy continues.
That cannot yet be said with certainty.
Dat is nog niet met zekerheid te zeggen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over artsen die maanden moeten wachten op een oordeel over uitvoering van euthanasie (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the minister why physicians wait about three and a half months for the euthanasia review committees' verdicts and whether the committees have enough funding to rule on time. The minister confirms an average of 103 days in the first half of 2011, describes extra staffing and funding and pilot efficiency measures, and says the statutory six-week term (with one six-week extension) should be met by 2012 without lengthening it.
I consider it undesirable to extend this term.
Ik acht het onwenselijk om deze termijn te verlengen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een fout in de rekeningen van verzekeraars (ingezonden 23 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about a calculation error by the NZa affecting the 2007 high-cost compensation for insurers, its effects on 2007 settlements and 2010-2012 budgets, and accountability between the NZa and CVZ. The minister confirmed the error, said its financial effects are not yet known and will take months to resolve, and committed to reviewing controls with the NZa, CVZ and insurers.
The error was made at the NZa.
De fout is gemaakt bij de NZa.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over antihomo-uitspraken van een Indiase minister (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

Two MPs from D66 asked the Dutch foreign and education ministers how they would respond to a report that an Indian health minister called homosexuality a disease, and whether they would raise concerns with India and seek an EU condemnation. The minister answered that such statements would be unacceptable, that the Indian minister said his words were misquoted and meant HIV/AIDS, and that the issue of discrimination based on sexual orientation was raised during a visit to India.
If the person concerned had made the statements in question, that would have been unacceptable to the government.
Indien betrokkene bedoelde uitspraken had gedaan, was dat voor de regering onacceptabel geweest.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over positief leefstijlbeleid (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MP Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister whether citizens should still be encouraged via civil society organisations to make healthy choices, given the end of STIVORO's subsidy and a 65% cut to smoking prevention, and how this fits the WHO FCTC. Minister Schippers answered that the subsidy ends in 2013 to bundle tobacco prevention with other addiction expertise, that core tobacco measures remain, and that policy choices stay national.
The Cabinet attaches importance to decisions ultimately being taken at national political level in consultation with parliament.
Het Kabinet hecht eraan dat op nationaal politiek niveau uiteindelijk in overleg met het parlement besluiten worden genomen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de bezuinigingen op PGO’s (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about planned cuts of 18 million euros to patient and elderly organisations, their representative role, and whether they should be funded from health premiums to keep them independent. The minister confirms the cuts, says elderly organisations will no longer receive subsidy, and rejects premium financing as undesirable while committing to a new funding framework and more patient-organisation influence.
I agree that patient and disability organisations have an important task in influencing parties to improve care, support and social participation.
Ik deel dat patiënten- en gehandicaptenorganisaties een belangrijke taak hebben in het beïnvloeden van partijen om zorg, ondersteuning en maatschappelijke participatie te verbeteren.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra (D66) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ondeugdelijke kostenramingen WK 2018 en verkeerd informeren van de Kamer (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

MPs Dijkstra and Van Dekken asked the health minister why the Chamber was told the 2018 World Cup would cost at most 300 million euros in fiscal guarantees and police costs of 200 million, when officials had estimated more, and about a planned evaluation. The minister denied the reporting, said estimates were uncertain and communicated with caveats, and promised an evaluation report in September.
The Chamber has consistently been informed of the insights the cabinet had, noting the uncertainties inherent in estimates.
Er is consequent aan de Kamer meegedeeld over welke inzichten het kabinet beschikte onder vermelding van de onzekerheden die nu eenmaal inherent zijn aan schattingen.
Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over opnieuw een tegenvaller in de zorg (ingezonden 5 april 2011).

MPs Dijkstra and Koolmees asked the health and finance ministers about a reported extra overspend in healthcare in 2010 and its causes, whether it is structural, and whether enough is being done to curb rising costs. The minister denied an additional EUR 1 billion overspend, put the total budget overrun at EUR 1.4 billion with components specified, promised fuller figures in the annual report and spring memorandum, and defended the policy of containing growth through efficiency measures and shifting costs to individuals.
With the Annual Report, which your House receives on the third Wednesday of May, the latest insights will be shared.
Met het Jaarverslag, dat uw Kamer op de derde woensdag van mei ontvangt, worden de laatste inzichten gedeeld.
Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de actuele situatie ten aanzien van medicinale cannabis (ingezonden 18 april 2011).

MPs Van der Ham and Dijkstra asked the health minister about medicinal cannabis: a cancer-appetite study, the BMC's evidence review and research duties, patient supply and alternatives, insurance coverage, and registration prospects. The minister answered that the evidence is not yet sufficient for a formal assessment, that research is a pharmaceutical-industry task, that varieties will be added only if demand is substantial, and that certain information (prescription counts, manufacturer plans) is unavailable or confidential.
No, this information is not available.
Nee, deze informatie is niet beschikbaar.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de helft van de jongeren in het voortgezet onderwijs homoseksualiteit afwijst (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a GGD survey showing half of secondary school youths reject homosexuality, and about the government's response to the Stichting Leerplan Ontwikkeling proposal implementing a motion on sexual diversity in core objectives. The Minister noted slight improvement since 2005, pointed to NJR campaigns and planned dialogue with youth, and referred the Kamer to a separate policy reply already sent on the Leerplan proposal.

Moreover, I will actively engage in dialogue in the coming period on (un)safety and resilience, together with role models, to make young people's own strength visible and contribute to a safe climate for gay youth.

Bovendien zal ik de komende tijd actief de dialoog aangaan over (on)veiligheid en weerbaarheid – samen met rolmodellen – om zo de eigen kracht van jongeren zichtbaar te maken en bij te dragen aan een veilig leefklimaat voor homoseksuele jongeren.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma (PvdA), Leijten (SP), Voortman (GroenLinks), Wiegman-van Meppelen Schepping (ChristenUnie) en Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van

MPs from several parties asked the health minister why a second cochlear implant for young deaf children is not reimbursed, and whether the evidence supports it, including costs and the CVZ's pending reassessment. The minister said the CVZ must judge the added benefit, that the research in Nijmegen is uncertain, and that she is open to temporary admission or conditional financing to generate evidence, as the motion requested.
It is for the College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) to answer that question within the context of its role as package manager.
Het is aan het College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) om die vraag te beantwoorden binnen de context van zijn rol als pakketbeheerder.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afrekenbare en controleerbare doelstellingen ten aanzien van het gebruik van antibiotica in de (pluim)

MPs Van Veldhoven and Dijkstra (D66) asked the health minister about measurable, enforceable targets for reducing antibiotic use in (poultry) livestock farming, including indicators, baselines, interim goals, enforcement capacity and EU comparisons. The minister answered that the 20% (2011) and 50% (2013) reduction targets apply across sectors against 2009 use, cited the MARAN monitoring data and planned registration rules and inspection reinforcement, and said other EU countries show little comparable ambition.
Making antibiotic use transparent is an important part of the antibiotic policy for livestock farming.
Het transparant maken van het antibioticagebruik is een belangrijk onderdeel van het antibioticabeleid voor de veehouderij.
Vragen van de leden van Veldhoven en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de besmetting van nVWA-medewerkers met Q- koorts (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

Two MPs from D66 asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the reported Q-fever infection of nVWA staff involved in culling operations, including protective measures, prevention, aftercare and infection risks for other workers. The minister confirmed the infections, listed protective measures and aftercare arrangements, and gave comparative infection figures, though the answers describe existing protocols rather than new commitments.
Yes, the Inspector-General of the nVWA informed us of this.
Ja, de Inspecteur-generaal van de nVWA heeft ons hiervan op de hoogte gesteld.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de acceptatie van homo’s in de sportwereld (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of health and education whether they would respond to reports on acceptance of gay people in football, continue funding the Gay Straight Alliantie Gelijkspelen, and develop anti-homophobia policy in sport. The government reaffirmed its support for LHBT emancipation, said talks are underway on continuing the alliance after 2011, and referred back to those answers on the policy question.
The cabinet is willing to support a continuation of this alliance.
Het kabinet is bereid een vervolg op deze alliantie te ondersteunen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de exploderende kosten in de langdurige zorg (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MP Dijkstra (D66) asked the state secretary for Health about projected explosive growth in long-term care costs, premium increases, the reasons for high Dutch spending, and reactions to CDA and other proposals. The state secretary acknowledged the projections are uncertain, identified institutionalised care and formalised entitlements as causes, and pointed to planned reforms in the letter 'Vertrouwen in de zorg' and a forthcoming renewal programme.
A further elaboration of these measures I will present to you in the letter 'Vernieuwingsprogramma langdurige zorg', which I will send to your House in the spring.
Een nadere uitwerking van deze maatregelen zal ik u presenteren in de brief «Vernieuwingsprogramma langdurige zorg», die ik uw Kamer in het voorjaar zal toezenden.
Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de moord op de Oegandese homoactivist David Kato (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister how the government reacted to the murder of Ugandan gay rights activist David Kato, whether it would ask Uganda to protect threatened gay people, and whether the EU could identify and protect threatened gay activists worldwide. The minister said the government was shocked, had urged Uganda to protect activists, funds a project assessing the needs of threatened gay people in Uganda, and pointed to existing EU guidelines as a basis for action.
Following this case, the Netherlands urged the Ugandan authorities to provide adequate protection for activists working on the rights of sexual minorities.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze zaak bij de Ugandese autoriteiten aangedrongen op adequate beveiliging van activisten op het gebied van de rechten van seksuele minderheden.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het ADR-systeem (Actief Donorregistratiesysteem) leidt tot meer orgaandonaties (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister how she reacts to research finding that an opt-out donor registration system (ADR) increases post-mortem organ donation, whether she shares those conclusions, how she weighs the reported negative effect on living donation, and what drives the rise in living donors and what measures could raise it further. The minister answers that the evidence is too mixed to justify the infringement on self-determination an ADR would bring, attributes the rise in living donors to improved information, hospital capacity and medical advances, and rejects active government promotion of living donation as undesirable.
I consider the uncertainties about the effects of a system change too great to proceed with a system change.
Ik vind de onzekerheden over de effecten van een systeemwijziging te groot om tot een systeemwijziging over te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Nederlanders Belgische organen wegkapen (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the health minister about reports that Dutch patients receive Belgian organ transplants, including how many, why, whether Belgian patients wait longer, and whether Dutch rules should change. The minister answered that 28 Dutch-resident patients received transplants in Belgium in 2010, that the choice reflects EU cross-border care and proximity, and that the national foundation NTS and Eurotransplant allocate organs without nationality data; she declined to commit to new talks, pointing to earlier answers on the ADR system.
Eurotransplant does not register nationality, but it does register which country donors and recipients come from.
Eurotransplant registreert geen nationaliteit, maar registreert uit welk land donoren en ontvangers afkomstig zijn.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Dijkstra (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over internationale beleidsbeïnvloeding op het gebied van LHBT-emancipatie en LHBT-men

MPs Pechtold and Dijkstra asked about Dutch support for LGBT organisations such as COC in international fora and whether the programme subsidy would continue after 31 December 2010. The minister said LGBT emancipation remains a priority, that the COC subsidy request will be assessed alongside others after 31 March 2011 without a bridging arrangement, and that maintaining expertise is the COC's own responsibility.

In the short term you will receive a memorandum from the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, setting out this cabinet's intentions regarding the promotion of, among other things, homo-emancipation.

Op korte termijn ontvangt u een notitie van de minister van OCW, mede namens de minister van BZ, waarin de voornemens van dit kabinet op het gebied van de bevordering van onder andere homo-emancipatie nader uiteen worden gezet.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over babysterfte (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

Dijkstra (D66) asks the health minister why the promised reimbursement of the preconception (kinderwens) consult for all pregnant women was withdrawn, on what criteria pilots will be judged, and why the government departs from an advisory group's target of 200 fewer avoidable infant deaths within five years. Minister Schippers answers that prevention will focus on risk groups, pilots will assess the consult's added value, and she declines to set numerical targets, while citing a near-halving of infant mortality in ten years.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, I primarily want to focus on risk groups in the information provided about pregnancy and birth.
Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven wil ik mij bij de voorlichting rondom zwangerschap en geboorte primair richten op risicogroepen.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitspraken van de FIFA-voorzitter, de heer Blatter, met betrekking tot homoseksuelen in Qatar (ingez

An MP asked ministers whether they would confront FIFA over FIFA president Blatter's remarks that gay people in Qatar should abstain from sex, and whether Qatar should protect all players and fans regardless of sexual orientation during the World Cup. The government condemned the remarks, said Blatter apologised and that it saw no need to confront him further, while Dutch efforts to get Qatar to decriminalise homosexuality continue, and answered yes on the protection question.
I believe he has distanced himself sufficiently from his statement.
Ik vind dat hij daarmee voldoende afstand heeft genomen van zijn uitspraak.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de documentaire «Help! Een homo in de klas» (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asked the education minister how many Dutch schools give lessons on homosexuality, whether schools refusing such lessons should be pressed, and about a proposal to include sexual diversity in core curriculum targets. The minister said the number of schools is unknown but declined to research it for administrative-burden reasons, promised a broader policy letter, and said the SLO proposal has been received with a letter to follow.
It is not known how many schools in the Netherlands provide information on homosexuality.
Het is niet bekend op hoeveel scholen in Nederland voorlichting over homoseksualiteit wordt gegeven.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de 66 miljoen euro extra aan ICT-uitgaven in het Academisch Ziekenhuis Maastricht (AZM) (ingezonden 13 december 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether the Maastricht academic hospital's ICT overspending (66 million euro extra, possibly 132 million by 2013) amounts to mismanagement and whether the minister will act or investigate, including links to planned cuts. The minister declines to judge individual hospital management decisions, states the hospital disputes any overspend, and points to the supervisory board, works council and insurers as the correcting mechanisms.
It would go too far to set specific rules from The Hague for this kind of situation.
Het zou te ver gaan om vanuit Den Haag specifieke regels te bepalen over dit soort situaties.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de rapportage van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) over verpleeghuis Houtwijk te Den Haag (ingezonden 29 nove

An MP asks the state secretary whether the IGZ's intensive supervision and subsequent enhanced supervision of nursing home Houtwijk has produced the needed care quality improvements, and what further sanctions, deadlines and anchoring measures apply. The secretary replies that enhanced supervision was imposed on 11 November, that the IGZ may issue a directive to the board, that improvements are due by early March 2011, and that the IGZ will monitor and take additional measures if the new plan fails.
If the IGZ finds that the action plan does not lead to the desired improvements, I will take additional measures, partly on the advice of the IGZ.
Als de IGZ constateert dat het plan van aanpak niet tot de gewenste verbeteringen leiden zal ik –mede op basis van advies van de IGZ- aanvullende maatregelen nemen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister-president over een uitspraak van de minister-president bij presentatie WK-bid (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP asks the prime minister whether he promised to meet all FIFA demands in the World Cup bid presentation, and how this squares with FIFA's demands on tax exemption, criminal immunity and labour rules. The prime minister denies saying he would meet all FIFA wishes, says he only claimed the bid meets FIFA's needs, and states he made no additional commitments beyond earlier letters to parliament.
With this statement I have made no additional commitment beyond the guarantees of the World Cup bid as set out in the letters to your House.
Ik heb met deze uitspraak geen enkele extra toezegging gedaan ten opzichte van de garanties van het WK-bid zoals vermeld in de brieven aan uw Kamer

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het in opspraak raken van artsen in ziekenhuizen te Amstelveen, Emmen, Enschede en Purmerend die jarenlang hun gang konden gaan

An MP asked the health minister how to prevent poorly functioning doctors from practising for years and harming patients, and about the roles of hospital boards, peer review and the inspectorate in the case of an orthopaedic surgeon in Waterland hospital. The minister answered that steps were already taken (new board information on visitation reports, IGZ guidelines), rejected a mandatory reporting duty, and explained that the inspectorate and hospital board had no earlier signals beyond a 2008 tribunal warning until new tribunal rulings in March 2010.

As I already informed your House in the letter 'Status of commitments AO IGZ and supervision of medical specialist conduct (31 March 2010)', many steps have already been taken to identify dysfunction of doctors at an early stage and take appropriate measures.

Zoals ik uw kamer al heb laten weten in de brief «Stand van zaken toezeggingen AO IGZ en toezicht met betrekking tot medisch specialistisch handelen (31 maart 2010)» zijn er al veel stappen gezet om disfunctioneren van artsen in een vroegtijdig stadium te signaleren en passende maatregelen te nemen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over exclusietesten voor Huntingtonpatiënten (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks why Dutch couples at risk of carrying the Huntington gene cannot use an exclusion test during embryo selection without learning their own genetic status, and whether other countries allow it. The minister confirms it is not permitted in the Netherlands because IVF and PGD would be used unnecessarily, and says the test does not fall within the ethics policy framework and will not be authorised.
I do not intend to permit the exclusion test in the case of PGD.
Ik ben niet voornemens de exclusietest in geval van PGD toe te staan.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat succesvolle en geldbesparende zorgprojecten in Leiden en Nijmegen dreigen te stoppen (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about Leiden and Nijmegen care projects at risk of closure, including the NZa's 65 euro hourly cap on GP out-of-hours pay and the NZa's enforcement approach. The minister said cooperation is desirable, explained the tariff rationale, described enforcement steps, and said she was examining rule changes to allow budget transfer from the emergency department to the GP post, though she left funding of future innovations to the field.
In consultation with the NZa I am currently examining whether it is possible in the short term to amend the regulations so that budget can be transferred from the SEH to the GP out-of-hours post.
In overleg met de NZa ben ik momenteel aan het bekijken of het op korte termijn mogelijk is om de regelgeving aan te passen zodat er budget overgeheveld kan worden van de SEH naar de huisartsenpost.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Opnieuw fors financieel tekort Gelre Ziekenhuizen'

An SP MP asked the Minister about reports of a large financial deficit at Gelre Ziekenhuizen, including the hospital director's remarks on planning more patients, closure of Zutphen maternity and limited ER hours, and the role of insurers. The Minister said hospital management is the providers' responsibility, no Early Warning System report was received, and she will not give detailed financial insight, while noting earlier meetings and committing to no new concrete action beyond existing motions and the coming regeerprogramma.
I do not have detailed insight into the financial situation of Gelre Ziekenhuizen. Moreover, the financial management of an individual hospital organisation is not my responsibility.

Ik heb geen gedetailleerd inzicht in de financiële situatie van Gelre Ziekenhuizen. Daarnaast valt de financiële huishouding van een individuele ziekenhuisorganisatie niet onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Eijk over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar klachten over evangelist Tom de Wal, hij geeft intussen Mercedes CLA en Audi A6 weg'

MPs asked whether faith healer Tom de Wal, who reportedly gives away luxury cars, falls under the Wkkgz, whether his title misleads patients, and whether his foundation's ANBI status fits the public-benefit requirement. The minister said the IGJ has no signals of structurally harmful practices, sees no reason to re-evaluate the rules, considers religious healing protected, and explained that ANBI status is neutrally assessed and the tax authority cannot act on such conduct.
However, I have no concrete signals that this is the case in practice.
Ik heb echter geen concrete signalen dat hiervan sprake is in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten 'Problemen Ommelander Ziekenhuis waren te voorspellen’ en 'Miljoenenverlies voor ziekenhuis Viecurie financiële hulp nodig'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about financial distress at the Ommelander and VieCuri hospitals, including whether hospital closures and public access to care could be prevented. The Minister attributed the losses mainly to price and wage increases, rising sickness absence and staff shortages, said the hospitals were not in an uncontrollable situation according to the NZa and IGJ, and placed primary responsibility for regional care with insurers and providers while promising to keep regional hospitals open.
I have not received an EWS notification about Ommelander Ziekenhuis, nor any informal signals from the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa).
Ik heb over Ommelander Ziekenhuis geen EWS-melding gehad en ook geen informele signalen ontvangen van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Artsentekort Zeeland groeit, ook huisartsenspoedpost Oostburg dicht'

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Medical Care about the closure of the Oostburg out-of-hours GP post and the neurology ward in Terneuzen due to staff shortages, including the continuity of care, the risks to patient safety and possible incentives for doctors in Zeeland. The Minister answered that a continuity plan and accessibility analysis (92% within half an hour) are in place, that acute neurology patients will be referred to Ghent or other Belgian hospitals, and that she is willing to discuss solutions with local providers and authorities.

Yes, I am willing to engage in discussion with local care providers and authorities to see how we can further support the path taken in Zeeland through the ZZC transformation plan and cooperation with the social domain.

Ja, ik ben bereid het gesprek aan te gaan met lokale zorgaanbieders en overheden om te zien hoe we de ingeslagen weg in Zeeland via het transformatieplan van de ZZC en de samenwerking met het sociale domein verder kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen niet klaar voor toestroom van patiënten met meerdere ziekten’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that hospitals are not ready for patients with multiple chronic conditions, poor cooperation between specialists, and the status of a motion on medical generalists. The minister acknowledged fragmented care, pointed to IZA agreements, a new FMS guideline and CGS work, but had no national data on specialist cooperation incidents and only promised to raise the issue with IZA parties.
Given the major challenges for this patient group, I will once again bring the need for good organisation around the multimorbid patient to the attention of the relevant IZA parties.

Gegeven de grote uitdagingen die er liggen voor deze patiëntgroep zal ik de noodzaak voor goede organisatie rond de multimorbide patiënt nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen van de relevante IZA partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending over de zorgen van plastische chirurgen betreffendebekwaamheid van cosmetische artsen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about surgeons' concerns over the competence of cosmetic doctors and why the sector has not agreed competence requirements after three years. The minister answered that the sector is responsible, pointed to the Zorginstituut's quality framework and possible future intervention, and said she will consider asking the Zorginstituut to act if the sector fails to resolve the impasse within a year.

Should the sector fail to break the impasse over competence requirements within a year, and if intervention based on IGJ reports appears proportionate, I will consider asking the Zorginstituut to place the subject of competence requirements for cosmetic care on its multi-year agenda.

Mocht de sector er niet in slagen om binnen een jaar de impasse rond de bekwaamheidseisen in de cosmetische sector te doorbreken, en mocht op basis van de meldingen bij de IGJ ingrijpen proportioneel lijken, dan zal ik overwegen om het Zorginstituut te verzoeken het onderwerp bekwaamheidseisen cosmetische zorg op de Meerjarenagenda te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Ingrijpen zorgverzekeraars duwt huisartsenketen Co-Med nog dieper in de problemen'

The MP Dijk (SP) asks the Minister for Medical Care about the collapse risk of the GP chain Co-Med, the insurers' termination of contracts, reports of an unsafe incident and the rejected private-equity ban motion. The Minister answers that continuity of care is paramount, that insurers and inspectorates are acting first, that some documents will be sent after consulting stakeholders, and that the government sees insufficient grounds for a private-equity ban.
I will send your House the requested official documents on developments at Co-Med after the bankruptcy on 16 April 2024 of PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam, a subsidiary of Co-Med, as soon as possible.

Ik zal uw Kamer de gevraagde ambtelijke stukken over de ontwikkelingen bij Co-Med na het faillissement op 16 april 2024 van PCC Tele-Services Amsterdam, een dochteronderneming van Co-Med, zo spoedig mogelijk sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht ‘Crisis in Meldkamer Oost Nederland: ‘ik zou mijn familie niet aan 112 toevertrouwen’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times at the Eastern Netherlands emergency call centre (MKON) and the risks of using PTT alongside C2000 for communication. The minister outlined measures such as allowing non-nurses to take 112 calls, care coordination pilots, and ongoing IGJ intensified supervision, while declining to give further detail on the inspectorate's findings.
Because of this ongoing process, the IGJ cannot currently provide further information on this.
Vanwege dit lopende traject kan de IGJ hier nu geen verdere informatie over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de berichten ‘Rechtszaak om zeldzame gebreken coronavaccin AstraZeneca’ en ‘AstraZeneca trekt coronavaccin wereldwijd terug na bekentenis'

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Medical Care about news reports on lawsuits over rare side effects of the AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine and the vaccine's global withdrawal, including vaccination numbers, Lareb reports, TTS cases, and information for citizens. The minister answered that about 1.5 million people received at least one AstraZeneca dose, that 20 Lareb reports showed strong signs of TTS, that the information leaflet was updated in March 2021, and that no information is available on the UK lawsuits.
I have no information about lawsuits against AstraZeneca in the United Kingdom.
Ik heb geen informatie over rechtszaken tegen AstraZeneca in het Verenigd Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘Mythe van 'hogere pijngrens bij migranten' blijft een probleem in de zorg’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that patients with migrant backgrounds have their pain dismissed, about the stigmatising content of the huisarts-migrant.nl website funded partly by the ministry, and about discrimination monitoring in care. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to existing programmes, research and a forthcoming handreiking, and said the website's outdated pain-threshold article was removed and its editorial process tightened.
I deeply regret that patients experience it this way.
Ik betreur het ten zeerste dat patiënten dit zo ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de stand van zaken naar aanleiding van het bericht: 'Martine en Marieke moesten borstenfoto’s opsturen aan hun verzekeraar'

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about insurers requiring patients to send intimate photos for prior authorisation of plastic surgery, questioning whether insurers decide this themselves, whether patients and surgeons are involved in reviewing the process, who can appeal, and whether a sample-based post-hoc system would be preferable. The Minister replies that insurers have a legal duty to verify covered care, that medical photos are needed for visual assessment and are sent by the treating doctor via VECOZO rather than by patients, that a review of the procedure is ongoing without patient representatives, and that complaints can go to the SKGZ, but rejects a shift to post-hoc control.
I share the conclusion that primacy in the assessment of medical treatment lies with the treating physician.
Ik deel de conclusie dat het primaat van een medische behandeling bij de behandelend arts ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Neem vrouwen serieus. Verbeter de pijnbestrijding bij het plaatsen van een spiraal’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about pain relief when fitting an IUD (spiraal), and whether women's care is undervalued. The Minister replied that the NHG standard advises oral painkillers and does not recommend local anaesthetic or sedation due to insufficient evidence and risks, and committed to passing the concern to the NHG and Stichting Ava and to a ZonMw knowledge programme on women-specific conditions.
I will put Stichting Ava, author of the opinion piece 'Take women seriously. Improve pain relief when fitting an IUD', in contact with the NHG so they can discuss good care when fitting an IUD.

Ik zal Stichting Ava, schrijver van het opiniebericht «Neem vrouwen serieus. Verbeter de pijnbestrijding bij het plaatsen van een spiraal», in contact brengen met het NHG zodat zij in gesprek kunnen over goede zorg bij het plaatsen van een spiraal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de vergoeding van reconstructieoperaties bij besneden vrouwen

An MP asked why reconstructive surgery for women who underwent FGM is not covered for all, whether the deductible applies, and whether it can be waived. The minister agrees FGM is serious abuse and that financial barriers are undesirable, says surgery is covered only with somatic complaints, and plans a one-year pilot to compensate the deductible, though no decision is taken yet.
For that reason I intend to implement the amendment submitted by the former members Bergkamp and Raemakers (D66).
Ik ben mede daarom voornemens om het door de (voormalige) leden Bergkamp en Raemakers (D66) ingediende amendement 3 uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Drie doden door ‘soms levensgevaarlijke kruiden’, RIVM waarschuwt’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about deaths linked to herbal supplements, the number and composition of supplements on the market, RIVM risk assessments, labelling rules, and enforcement by the NVWA. The minister answered that the market is too broad to count precisely, that three herbs are under RIVM assessment with a national list extension planned after summer 2024, that labelling and enforcement are in place (21 supplements flagged in 2024 so far), and that the #WeetWatJeSlikt campaign should continue.
Because of the broad definition, the many (online) points of sale and the fast-moving market, it is not possible to attach a number to the number of types of food supplements on the market.
Door de brede definitie, de vele (online) verkooppunten en de sterk bewegende markt, is het niet mogelijk een getal te hangen aan het aantal soorten voedingssupplementen dat op de markt is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over de visie op geneesmiddeleninformatie voor zorgverleners

MP Tielen asked the minister about signals of a restructuring of the medicines information landscape for healthcare professionals, its consequences for providers, the criteria distinguishing generic from direct decision-support information, alternatives if information becomes scarce, and how private platforms are involved. The minister confirmed the planned shift toward specific, directly applicable information for vulnerable groups, said decisions on subsidies will be taken by a new cabinet from 2026, and stated that medicines information remains broadly available.
There is and will be no risk of too little medicines information being available.
Er is en zal geen sprake zijn van een risico op te weinig geneesmiddeleninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Spoedpoli St Jansdal in Lelystad sluit ’s avonds'

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care why the Lelystad St Jansdal emergency department closes in the evenings, whether residents and municipalities can block such decisions, and whether the Minister will intervene. The Minister answers that hospitals and insurers decide on regional acute care, that she will not prevent the change or grant municipalities a binding say, and that the parliamentary motions cannot be executed yet.
I am not going to prevent the opening hours of the Spoedpoli in Lelystad from being changed.
Ik ga niet voorkomen dat de openingstijden van de Spoedpoli in Lelystad worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Daniëlle Jansen over het aanblijvend, groot tekort aan salbutamol aerosol

MP Daniëlle Jansen asked the Minister for Medical Care about the persistent large shortage of salbutamol aerosol, including alternatives, stock, causes, EU coordination, insurer roles and IGJ powers. The minister answered that stock is insufficient, a shortage order was issued, alternatives exist depending on the patient, and broad measures such as a national critical medicines list (publication planned June 2024) and additional Meldpunt funding are being pursued, while not guaranteeing availability.
Ik ben onlangs in gesprek geweest met LAN.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten 'Bestuurders UMCG declareren voor ton aan autoritten en 15.000 euro voor trip VS' en 'Ziekenhuisbestuurders houden zich niet aan declaratie-afspraken'

MPs Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of very high expense claims by hospital board members (UMCG) and widespread non-compliance with declaration agreements. The Minister said individual expense claims are a matter between supervisory and management boards, called for transparency, relied on self-regulation via the Governancecode Zorg with talks planned, and declined to set caps or legal duties.
I do not have the ability to cap hospital expense claims, because such arrangements fall under self-regulation.
Ik heb niet de mogelijkheid om declaraties van ziekenhuizen te maximeren, omdat zulke afspraken onder zelfregulering vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de noodkreet van MSD-baas ’Kankerpatiënt eindeloos in wachtkamer voor nieuwe behandelingen’

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why Dutch cancer patients wait longer than patients in other countries for new treatments such as pembrolizumab for triple-negative breast cancer, and what will be done to shorten waits. The Minister defends the sluis (pakketbeoordeling) system on cost and effectiveness grounds, says the Zorginstituut is assessing the indication, and rejects a fixed maximum decision period while promising efficiency measures and a dashboard update.
I point to the responsibility of manufacturers to ask for socially responsible prices.
Ik wijs daarbij op de verantwoordelijkheid van fabrikanten om maatschappelijk verantwoorde prijzen te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Adrz verrast vriend en vijand met sluiting poliklinieken in Zierikzee; college stuurt brief op poten'

Van der Plas (BBB) asks the Minister for Medical Care about the Adrz hospital's decision to close outpatient clinics in Zierikzee, the lack of consultation with the municipality and residents, risks to access and care avoidance for elderly islanders, and the roles of CZ insurer and the Minister. The Minister replies that the hospital decides within legal frameworks, that regional care must be reorganised under the IZA agreements, that CZ and the NZa oversee the duty of care and no signals of breach have been received, and that the Minister sees no reason to talk to the parties personally.
It is up to the hospital board to make balanced choices with the relevant parties, ensuring the quality, accessibility and affordability of care are safeguarded.
Het is aan het ziekenhuisbestuur om met de relevante partijen afgewogen keuzes te maken waarbij de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid en betaalbaarheid van de zorg zijn geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over het bericht ‘Adrz verrast vriend en vijand met sluiting poliklinieken in Zierikzee; college stuurt brief op poten’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the planned closure of the Admiraal de Ruyter hospital's outpatient clinics in Zierikzee, its effects on access to care on Schouwen-Duiveland, and what the government would do. The Minister answered that the hospital decides on its own services within legal frameworks, that care will be relocated to Goes and Vlissingen over six months, and that regional integrated care plans and talks with the municipality continue.
The Adrz is responsible for providing good-quality care.
Het Adrz is verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van zorg van goede kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het grote tekort aan huisartsen

An MP asked the minister about a claimed GP shortage, gemeenten luring doctors with financial incentives, low tariffs and patient registration stops. The minister replied that there is no national shortage but a distribution problem, backed municipal initiatives, promised a study into people unable to register with a GP, and a later review of tariffs.
I have no insight into the current number of GP practices that have introduced a patient registration stop.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het huidige aantal huisartsenpraktijken dat een patiëntenstop heeft ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Hertzberger  over perinatale zorg

MPs Bikker and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Medical Care about the 24-week lower limit for active neonatal care of extremely premature babies, international comparison, and whether guidelines should change given new evidence. The minister answered that the guideline keeps the 24+0 week threshold, that clinicians may deviate in individual cases after consultation with parents, and that the guideline was published in March 2024 with a new revision planned from 2025.
In the previous and revised guideline, the lower limit for offering active care is an estimated gestational age of 24+0 weeks.
In de vorige en herziene richtlijn is de ondergrens voor het bieden van actieve opvang een geschatte zwangerschapsduur van 24+0 weken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over euthanasie bij psychisch lijden

MP Paulusma asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times for euthanasia requests based on psychological suffering, their causes, and how to speed up help and expand expertise. The minister acknowledged the unacceptable waits, pointed to psychiatrists' reluctance and the ThaNet network, and said EE's consultation function is under review, with no firm timeline for structural change.
I find it unacceptable if people with psychological suffering and a persistent death wish/euthanasia wish do not receive timely and appropriate care
Ik vind het onacceptabel als mensen met psychisch lijden en een aanhoudende doodswens/euthanasiewens geen tijdige en passende zorg krijgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de uitzending van Radar d.d. 11 maart 2024 over te dure gehoorapparaten

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Medical Care how she views a Radar broadcast on overpriced hearing aids sold by commercial hearing shops, the failure of parties to honour the 2017 consensus on hearing care, what can be done to ensure correct advice, and whether the lack of quality supervision of audiologists will be addressed. The Minister said the situation is undesirable, pointed to the Zorginstituut's improvement signal and self-regulation in the sector, said the IGJ does not supervise audiology care, and said further supervision will be examined together with the Zorginstituut and IGJ, without a separate meeting with insurers.
I therefore think it is important that the parties involved actively get to work on these actions.
Ik vind het daarom belangrijk dat de betrokken partijen actief met deze acties aan de slag gaan.

Within the Wlz it is registered which form of care clients use, but it is not registered what legal form the providing institution has, and it is not known whether these are commercial institutions.
Binnen de Wlz wordt geregistreerd van welke leveringsvorm cliënten gebruik maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Meer meldingen van seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de zorg'

This means that the split in the reports you requested cannot be provided.
Dit betekent dat de door u gevraagde splitsing in de meldingen niet te geven is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het online verstrekken van abortuspillen

MP Diederik van Dijk (SGP) asked about the status of a bill replacing the temporary policy rule on prescribing medicines online, whether abortion clinics use it to provide abortion pills remotely, how the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises and enforces online abortion pill provision, and how foreign online providers such as Women on Web relate to Dutch law. The minister answered that a Medicines Act amendment is in preparation, that one clinic uses digital consults under the policy rule, that the IGJ supervises and enforces under the Wafz and Criminal Code, and that enforcement against foreign providers depends on the circumstances.
Following this question I have made an inquiry among the managers of abortion clinics.
Naar aanleiding van deze vraag heb ik een uitvraag gedaan bij bestuurders van abortusklinieken.

In the coming period I am examining with IZA parties what is possible to provide patients with more information on quality of care in the short term, and I will urge them to do their best in this.
Ik onderzoek komende periode met IZA partijen wat mogelijk is om patiënten op korte termijn van meer informatie over kwaliteit van zorg te voorzien en spoor hen aan hier het optimale in te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Westerveld over het gebruik van de term ‘ras’ in de gezondheidszorg

A broad check on all medical institutions is not feasible.
Een brede check op alle medische instanties is niet haalbaar.

Binnenkort zal ik mijn reactie op het rapport van de NZa en IGJ over «de opkomst van bedrijfsketens in de huisartsenzorg» naar uw Kamer sturen en daarmee ingaan op deze twee vragen.

Under current laws and regulations, it is up to the care provider, not the Minister for Medical Care, to decide on changes to care provision together with the health insurer.

Binnen de huidige wet- en regelgeving is het aan de zorgaanbieder – en niet aan de Minister voor Medische Zorg – om, samen met de zorgverzekeraar, besluiten te nemen over wijzigingen in het zorgaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de gevolgen van een mogelijke sluiting van de afdeling verloskunde in Zoetermeer

Dit soort zaken dient in het Regionaal Overleg Acute Zorgketen (ROAZ) te worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over zorgprofessionals die massaal kampen met haperende toevoer van hulpmiddelen.

Ja, en dit is het afgelopen jaar ook gedaan.

Our Minister informs both Houses of the States General about progress in establishing and maintaining the Nature Network Netherlands.
Onze Minister informeert de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal over de voortgang van de totstandkoming en instandhouding van het natuurnetwerk Nederland
Motie van de leden Grashoff en Leenders over instandhouding en herstel van de weidevogelpopulaties
Asks government to consult provinces and propose nationwide measures by the 2016 budget to conserve and restore meadow bird populations.
requests the government to consult with the provinces with the aim of coming up with nationwide proposals for the 2016 budget debate
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met de provincies met als doel voor de begrotingsbehandeling van 2016 met landsdekkende voorstellen te komen
