Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over het wetsvoorstel opnieuw voor advies voorleggen aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State en aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens
Asks the government to resubmit the Wgs data-sharing bill for fresh advice from the Council of State and the Dutch Data Protection Authority before a vote.
requests the government to resubmit the Wgs bill for advice to the Council of State advisory division
verzoekt de regering, de Wet gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden opnieuw voor advies voor te leggen aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State
Motie van de leden Van Nispen en Buitenweg over de verplichting om discriminatie en andere mensenrechtenschendingen te voorkomen
Asks the government to clarify how data cooperation partnerships are obliged to prevent discrimination and other human rights violations and how this is supervised.
requests the government to clarify in what ways the cooperation partnerships are obliged to prevent discrimination and other human rights violations and how supervision is exercised

verzoekt de regering, te verduidelijken op welke manieren de samenwerkingsverbanden verplicht worden discriminatie en andere mensenrechtenschendingen te voorkomen en hoe hier toezicht op gehouden wordt
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over het niet hanteren van algoritmes waarvan de uitkomsten niet navolgbaar en controleerbaar zijn
Prohibits the joint data-analysis partnership from using algorithms whose outputs cannot be traced and verified, adding a safeguard against opaque profiling of citizens.
In the automated data analysis by the cooperation partnership, no algorithms are used whose outcomes are not traceable and verifiable.
Bij de geautomatiseerde gegevensanalyse door het samenwerkingsverband worden geen algoritmes gehanteerd waarvan de uitkomsten niet navolgbaar en controleerbaar zijn.
Amendement van de leden Van Nispen en Buitenweg over het in artikel 1.9, derde lid, schrappen van de uitzondering op het verschaffen van duidelijkheid
Deletes the exception allowing participants to withhold transparency about automated data analysis where serious reasons exist, so individuals are always informed about the patterns and logic used.
The exception to providing clarity in art. 1.9 para. 3 ('insofar as ... do not oppose') is deleted by this amendment.
De uitzondering op het verschaffen van duidelijkheid uit art. 1.9 lid 3 («voor zover ... niet verzetten») wordt met dit amendement geschrapt.
Motie van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen c.s. over subsidiëring van maatschappelijke organisaties beoordelen op de kwaliteit van hun programma's
Asks that subsidies to civil society organisations be assessed on programme quality, never on how far they support government policy, protecting critical independent civil society.
the subsidisation of civil society organisations must be assessed on the quality of their programmes and never on the degree of support for cabinet policy
de subsidiëring van maatschappelijke organisaties moet worden beoordeeld op de kwaliteit van hun programma's en nooit op de mate van ondersteuning van het kabinetsbeleid
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over een horizonbepaling
Adds a five-year sunset clause so the new data-sharing powers for cooperation partnerships lapse unless parliament is asked to renew them after evaluation.
the proposed powers will lapse five years after this act enters into force
de voorgestelde bevoegdheden komen vijf jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet te vervallen
Motie van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts c.s. over de capaciteit bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens
Asks the cabinet to examine how the capacity and resources of the Data Protection Authority can be structurally strengthened from 2022 and how to implement the KPMG report.
requests the cabinet also to examine how the capacity and resources of the Data Protection Authority can structurally reach an adequate level from 2022
verzoekt het kabinet, tevens om te onderzoeken hoe de capaciteit en middelen van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens vanaf 2022 structureel op een afdoende niveau kunnen komen
Motie van de leden Buitenweg en Van Toorenburg over een strategie ontwikkelen om de productie van ongewenste deep nudes tegen te gaan
Motion asks the government to urgently develop a strategy against unwanted deep nudes, considering criminal code changes, compliance enforcement and labelling duties for deepfakes.
requests the government, urgently, to develop a strategy to combat the production and distribution of unwanted deep nudes
verzoekt de regering, met spoed een strategie te ontwikkelen om de productie en verspreiding van ongewenste deep nudes tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Groothuizen c.s. over onderzoek om Polen voor het Europese Hof van Justitie te dagen

Asks the government to investigate and prepare infringement proceedings against Poland before the EU Court of Justice over non-compliance with judicial independence rulings, and to inform the House by 1 February 2021.
requests the government to investigate and make the necessary preparations to sue Poland before the EU Court of Justice, preferably with like-minded member states
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken en de nodige voorbereidingen te treffen om, bij voorkeur in samenwerking met gelijkgezinde lidstaten, Polen voor het Hof van Justitie van de EU te dagen
Motie van het lid Groothuizen c.s. over ondersteunen van de sociaal advocatuur werkzaam in het personen- en familierecht
Asks the government to propose using unspent legal aid budget to support social lawyers in family and personal law.
requests the government to come with a proposal in the next supplementary or spring memorandum to use part of the remaining budget to support social lawyers
verzoekt de regering, bij de eerstvolgende na- of voorjaarsnota met een voorstel te komen om (een deel van) het overgebleven budget in te zetten voor het ondersteunen van de sociaal advocatuur
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over overleg met banken over compensatie van slachtoffers van bankfraude
Asks the government to talk with banks about compensating victims of bank fraud and to report on tracing criminals and recovering their proceeds.
requests the government to talk with banks as soon as possible with the aim of compensating the victims
verzoekt de regering, zo snel als mogelijk met banken in gesprek te gaan met als doel de slachtoffers te compenseren
Motie van de leden Buitenweg en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over inzicht in de afhankelijkheid van digitale processen en diensten bij vitale processen
Motion asks the government to create insight into which foreign private digital products and services vital processes depend on, via a cyber dependency picture.
requests the government to gain insight, for example via a cyber dependency picture, into which parties and digital processes vital processes depend on

verzoekt de regering, om inzichtelijk te krijgen, bijvoorbeeld via een cyberafhankelijkheidsbeeld of anderszins, van welke partijen, digitale processen en diensten het functioneren van vitale processen in de Nederlandse samenleving afhankelijk is
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over ondersteuning voor freelancejournalisten bij beveiliging na bedreiging
Asks the government to investigate how freelance journalists threatened with harm can be financially supported for security measures, possibly via PersVeilig.
requests the government to investigate, by early February 2021, with PersVeilig and news organisations, how freelance journalists can be financially supported
verzoekt de regering, uiterlijk begin februari 2021, onder andere samen met PersVeilig en nieuwsorganisaties/uitgeverijen te onderzoeken
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over voor de veiligheid van journalisten één aanspreekpunt bij het Team Bedreigde Politici te realiseren
Asks the government to create a single police contact point, equivalent to the Team Bedreigde Politici, for the most serious threats against journalists.
to create an equivalent point of contact at the Team Bedreigde Politici for the safety of journalists
voor de veiligheid van journalisten een gelijkwaardig aanspreekpunt aan het Team Bedreigde Politici te realiseren
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over openbare registers waarin huisadressen voorkomen zo afschermen dat deze alleen door het bevoegd gezag kunnen worden ingezien
Asks the government to shield public registers containing home addresses so only the competent authority can access them.
requests the government to shield public registers containing home addresses so they can only be viewed by the competent authority
verzoekt de regering, openbare registers waarin huisadressen – of aan een onderneming gekoppeld huisadres – voorkomen, zo af te schermen dat deze alleen door het bevoegd gezag kunnen worden ingezien
Amendement van de leden Van Nispen en Buitenweg over extra middelen voor de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens
Moves 9 million euro from the core ministry staff budget to the Dutch Data Protection Authority to clear backlogs and strengthen privacy supervision.
Because of this modest budget, an investment of 9 million euros is now needed to clear backlogs at the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Vanwege dit bescheiden budget is nu een investering van € 9 miljoen nodig om achterstanden bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens weg te werken.
Amendement van de leden Van Nispen en Buitenweg over middelen voor het Expertisebureau Online Kindermisbruik
Shifts 300,000 euro structurally from the Terrorism and national security article to the Crime prevention article of the Justice and Security budget to fund the Expertisebureau Online Kindermisbruik.
This amendment gives the EOKM the minimum coverage, through a structural investment of 300,000 euros, needed to continue its current activities.
Dit amendement biedt het EOKM de minimale dekking, middels een structurele investering van 300.000 euro, die nodig is om de huidige activiteiten voort te zetten.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Buitenweg ter vervanging van nr. 7 over extra middelen voor het TBKK
Shifts 4 million euro within the justice and security budget from traffic enforcement to police capacity for the child pornography team, plus funds for the Public Prosecution Service.
The total of 4 million euro is covered from the non-legally mandatory funds intended for implementing the traffic enforcement programme
De in totaal 4 miljoen euro wordt gedekt uit de niet-juridisch verplichte middelen die bestemd zijn voor de uitvoering van het programma verkeershandhaving
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over extra middelen voor het TBKK
Moves 3.5 million euro from the Veiligheid en criminaliteitsbestrijding budget article to the Politie article to expand the TBKK child abuse unit.
The total of 3.5 million euro is covered from non-legally committed funds.
De in totaal 3,5 miljoen euro wordt gedekt uit de niet-juridisch verplichte middelen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Buitenweg en Bergkamp t.v.v. nr. 6 over een evaluatie na vijf jaar
Amendment requiring the Minister for Legal Protection to report to parliament within five years on the effectiveness of provisions against marriage captivity.
sends to the States General within five years of entry into force a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law
zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Buitenweg c.s. t.v.v. nr. 30 over een instemmingsrecht van de Kamer op ministeriële regelingen
Replaces the light pre-consultation procedure for COVID-19 ministerial regulations with a procedure where the House can approve or reject them, with automatic lapse if it rejects them within a week.
This amendment aims to replace the light pre-consultation procedure in the bill with a procedure in which the House of Representatives can decide whether or not to approve ministerial regulations.

Dit amendement strekt ertoe de in het wetsvoorstel opgenomen lichte voorhangprocedure te vervangen door een procedure waarbij de Tweede Kamer kan besluiten al of niet met ministeriële regelingen in te stemmen.

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. t.v.v. nr. 26 over versterking van de informatievoorziening aan het parlement en het horen van de Raad van State over een voorgenomen verleng
Requires the government to state its expectations on continuing the COVID measures and to have the Raad van State advisory division heard every three months before any decision to extend the law.
The Advisory Division of the Council of State is heard every three months on the measures in force under this chapter before the decision to extend.
De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State wordt elke drie maanden gehoord over de krachtens dit hoofdstuk geldende maatregelen voorafgaand aan het besluit tot verlenging
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. t.v.v. nr. 31 over aanscherping van de noodzakelijkheids- en proportionaliteitseisen en afschalen wanneer dat kan
Tightens necessity and proportionality tests for COVID-19 measures, requires explicit weighing of fundamental rights, and requires measures to be scaled down or withdrawn when no longer necessary.
that with every use of the powers granted in this temporary law it is made clear that a less far-reaching arrangement to restrict fundamental rights is not possible.
dat bij elk gebruik van de in deze tijdelijke wet toegekende bevoegdheden duidelijk wordt gemaakt dat een minder vergaande regeling om grondrechten in te perken niet mogelijk is.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Brenk c.s. t.v.v. nr. 29 over een bezoekrecht voor bewoners van zorglocaties
Amends the COVID-19 care-home rules so that residents can always receive visits from at least one relative or close contact, limiting care providers' and ministerial power to restrict visits.
The aim of this amendment is that a client can always receive visits from at least one family member or close relative.
Het doel van dit amendement is dat een cliënt altijd bezoek van tenminste één familielid of naaste kan krijgen.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Veldman c.s. t.v.v. nr. 25 over verlaging van de sancties en uitsluiten dat overtredingen gevolgen hebben voor de VOG
Amends the penalty provisions of the COVID-19 bill to lower sanctions for natural persons and to keep offences from affecting certificates of conduct (VOG).
They are of the view that for natural persons a criminal penalty of 7 days or a first-category fine is generally sufficient and strong enough.
Zij zijn van mening dat voor natuurlijke personen een strafbedreiging van 7 dagen of een geldboete van de eerste categorie in algemene zin volstaat en fors genoeg is.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Dam c.s. t.v.v. nr. 28 over het waarborgen van de betrokkenheid van en verantwoording aan colleges en gemeenteraden
Requires the mayor to keep aldermen informed and the chair of the safety region to account to municipal councils when using transferred emergency powers.
he is accountable to the councils concerned for this
is hij daarover verantwoording schuldig aan de betrokken gemeenteraden
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. t.v.v. nr. 21 over aanscherping van de noodzakelijkheids- en proportionaliteitseisen en afschalen wanneer dat kan

Amends the COVID-19 emergency law's purpose clause to require necessity, democratic rule-of-law consistency and minimal rights infringement, and requires measures to be scaled down or the distance rule relaxed once no longer necessary, with a parliamentary draft-submission waiting period before amending or withdrawing ministerial rules.
It is of great importance that with every use of the powers granted in this temporary law it is made clear that a less far-reaching regulation to restrict fundamental rights is not possible.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Toorenburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over een mogelijkheid tot het verlengen van de termijn voor onderzoek en besluitvorming
Lets the House of Representatives extend by up to two months the three-month deadline for its procedure on a possible criminal complaint (ambtsmisdrijf) against a minister.
The House of Representatives may decide to extend the term referred to in the first paragraph by at most two months.
De Tweede Kamer kan besluiten de termijn, bedoeld in het eerste lid, te verlengen met ten hoogste twee maanden.
Amendement van het lid Van Toorenburg c.s. over een mogelijkheid tot het verlengen van de termijn voor onderzoek en besluitvorming
Lets the House of Representatives extend by up to three months the deadline for its procedure on a complaint about a possible official misdemeanour, so it can investigate fully.
The House of Representatives may decide to extend the term referred to in the first paragraph by up to three months.
De Tweede Kamer kan besluiten de termijn, bedoeld in het eerste lid, te verlengen met ten hoogste drie maanden.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Buitenweg en Verhoeven ter vervanging van nr. 8 over een evaluatie binnen vijf jaar
Amendment adds a clause requiring the Minister of Justice and Security to send Parliament a report on the effectiveness and effects of the act within five years of entry into force.
Our Minister of Justice and Security sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this act in practice within five years of its entry into force.

Onze Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over het opnemen van een horizonbepaling in combinatie met  een evaluatie na vijf jaar
Requires the minister to report to parliament within five years on the effectiveness of the counterterrorism powers and to promote a bill to repeal them unless parliament chooses to keep them.
Our Minister of Justice and Security shall send the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this act in practice within five years of its entry into force.

Onze Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het vervallen van de voorwaarde van herleidbaarheid
Replaces the proviso that a source-protection disclosure must not be traceable to the source, removing a condition on the Code of Criminal Procedure article 218a.
in article 218a, first paragraph, the phrase: on condition that the disclosure cannot be traced back to them, lapses.
vervalt in artikel 218a, eerste lid, de zinsnede: onder voorwaarde dat de verstrekking niet tot hen kan worden herleid.
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over het niet koppelen van bronbescherming aan het beroep van journalist en publicist

Extends source protection to anyone holding information published to the public and moves review of source-protection claims from the investigating judge to a three-judge panel of the Hague district court.
Not the investigating judge but the multi-judge chamber of the Hague district court assesses a claim to this privilege.
niet de rechter-commissaris, maar de meervoudige kamer van de rechtbank Den Haag, een beroep op dit verschoningsrecht beoordeeld
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over de gevolgen van het niet betalen van griffierecht
Asks the government to legislate that not paying court fees does not in all cases make an appeal inadmissible, protecting access to an independent court.
requests the government to write into law, in the interest of legal certainty, that not paying court fees does not in all cases lead to inadmissibility
verzoekt de regering in het belang van de rechtszekerheid in de wet op te nemen dat het niet betalen van het griffierecht niet in alle gevallen tot niet-ontvankelijkheid leidt
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 over de Stichting Geschillencommissies Consumentenzaken
Amendment moving 638,207 thousand euro from the central department budget to legal aid and justice to keep subsidy for the consumer disputes committees.
to make 638,207 euro available to the Foundation for Consumer Dispute Committees
om 638.207 euro beschikbaar te stellen aan de Stichting Geschillencommissies Consumentenzaken
Motie van het lid Buitenweg c.s. over de ZSM-bijstand
Asks the government to inform the Chamber when and how legal aid for ZSM cases will be provided in 2018, given that the reserved budget was withdrawn.
considering that the reserved budget for legal aid has been withdrawn
overwegende dat het gereserveerde budget voor rechtsbijstand is ingetrokken
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over geen lager budget voor gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand
Asks the government to drop the principle that subsidised legal aid must fit within a predetermined lower budget, prioritising quality of access to justice.
requests the government to abandon the premise that the subsidised legal aid system must in any case fit within a predetermined lower budget framework
verzoekt de regering het uitgangspunt te verlaten dat het stelsel van gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand hoe dan ook binnen een vooraf vastgesteld lager budgettair kader moet passen
Motie van het lid Buitenweg c.s. over rechtsbijstand voor on- en minvermogenden
Asks the government how legal aid point allocation for lawyers serving low-income clients can match actual time spent, and to inform the House.
requests the government to indicate promptly how the point allocation in the current subsidised legal aid system can be brought into line with actual time spent
verzoekt de regering, op korte termijn aan te geven hoe de puntentoekenning in het huidige stelsel van gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand in overeenstemming kan worden gebracht
Motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over experimenten met wietteelt
Asks the government not to pursue a single uniform experiment with regulated cannabis cultivation but to allow diverse experiments.
requests the government not to proceed from one uniform experiment on regulated cannabis cultivation but to introduce diversity in the experiments
verzoekt de regering om, niet uit te gaan van één uniform experiment omtrent gereguleerde wietteelt, maar juist diversiteit in de experimenten aan te brengen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over Sektesignaal
Proposes restoring a 50,000 euro subsidy to Sektesignaal, funded by unused external hiring money on the core department's budget.
This amendment aims to make 50,000 euros available to Sektesignaal.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om 50.000 euro beschikbaar te stellen aan Sektesignaal.
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over Femmes for Freedom
Moves 200,000 euros from a contingency item to the justice budget as a subsidy for the organisation Femmes for Freedom, which helps women in forced marriages.
This amendment grants a subsidy of 200,000 euros to Femmes for Freedom (FFF).
Dit amendement kent een subsidie van € 200.000,– toe aan Femmes for Freedom (FFF).
Motie van het lid Azarkan c.s. over de bijdrage aan De Geschillencommissie
Asks the government not to reduce its contribution to the Geschillencommissie, an alternative dispute body for consumers and businesses.
requests the government not to lower its contribution to the Geschillencommissie
verzoekt de regering, haar bijdrage aan De Geschillencommissie niet te verlagen
Motie van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over de bejegening van zedenslachtoffers
Asks the cabinet to examine victims' experiences of sexual offences contact with police and to develop a standard approach to their treatment.
requests the cabinet to further develop a standard approach so that the treatment of sex crime victims can be optimally improved
verzoekt het kabinet voorts te komen tot een standaardaanpak, zodat de bejegening van zedenslachtoffers optimaal kan worden verbeterd
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over Sektesignaal
Amendment restores 98,000 euro subsidy for Sektesignaal, funded by cutting central department staff hiring spending.
This amendment aims to make 98,000 euro available to Sektesignaal.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om 98.000 euro beschikbaar te stellen aan Sektesignaal.
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid, het Keurmerk Veilig Ondernemen en Veiligheid Kleine Bedrijven
Moves a small sum from the Straffen en Beschermen article to Veiligheid en criminaliteitsbestrijding to reverse a planned cut to the CCV and related crime-prevention bodies.
the planned cut to the Centre for Crime Prevention and Safety (CCV) is reversed
de voorgenomen bezuiniging op het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid (CCV) ... teruggedraaid
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over het Expertisecentrum Online Kindermisbruik
Amendment moves 113,000 euro from the central department's staffing budget to the Expertise Centre Online Child Abuse to handle its backlog of reports.
to make 113,000 euro available to the Expertise Centre Online Child Abuse (EOKM)
om 113.000 euro beschikbaar te stellen aan het Expertisecentrum Online Kindermisbruik (EOKM)
Amendement van het lid Kuiken c.s. over mediation in het strafrecht
Shifts €1.5 million from the penal policy budget to legal aid to fund criminal-law mediation under the Utrecht model.
This amendment aims to free up €1.5 million for continuing mediation in criminal law
Dit amendement beoogt dat een bedrag van € 1,5 miljoen wordt vrijgemaakt voor de voortzetting van mediation in het strafrecht
Amendement van het lid Buitenweg over rechtsbijstand

Moves 6 million euro from the crime-fighting budget to legal aid to partly restore funding for intended legal aid in the ZSM settlement procedure, so suspects understand the consequences of settlement offers.
Persons receiving a ZSM offer are too often unaware of the far-reaching consequences of accepting that offer, such as a criminal record entry.
Betrokkenen die een ZSM-aanbod krijgen zijn zich te vaak niet bewust van de verstrekkende gevolgen van instemming met dat aanbod, bijvoorbeeld vermelding op het strafblad.
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over de Nederlandse Vereniging voor de Rechtspraak
Shifts €387,000 from the Kerndepartement budget to the judiciary legal aid budget to raise the subsidy to the Nederlandse Vereniging voor de Rechtspraak, which advises on legislation.
the NVvR will be able to continue its important advisory role on legislation
zal de NVvR haar belangrijke adviserende taak op het gebied van wetgeving kunnen blijven voortzetten
Amendement van het lid Van Nispen c.s. over de Stichting Geschillencommissies Consumentenzaken
Moves 638,207 thousand euro from the ministry's core department budget to legal aid to keep subsidy for the consumer dispute committees (SGC).
This amendment aims to make 638,207 euros available to the Consumer Dispute Committees Foundation
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om 638.207 euro beschikbaar te stellen aan de Stichting Geschillencommissies Consumentenzaken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat het CBS toegang kreeg tot privacygevoelige locatiedata van klanten van T-Mobile

MP Buitenweg asked about reports that Statistics Netherlands (CBS) had access to sensitive location data of T-Mobile customers, raising privacy, legal basis, oversight and contracting concerns. Minister Blok answered that the Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are investigating, that CBS says it only received anonymised or aggregated data, and that CBS is an independent body the minister cannot instruct on individual contracts.
The Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are currently jointly investigating the matter as supervisors following the NRC article.
Het Agentschap Telecom en de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doen op dit moment als toezichthouders samen onderzoek naar aanleiding van het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat Huawei toegang had tot gegevens van miljoenen Telfort-klanten

MPs Buitenweg and others asked whether Huawei had access to millions of Telfort customers' data, as revealed by a 2011 internal KPN audit, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the vulnerable legacy system was retired in 2018, that Huawei had only maintenance access with no known data theft, that the government will require mobile operators to use only trusted vendors in critical network parts, and that it declined to say which parts are critical.
The cabinet makes no public statements about which parts have been designated as critical.
Het kabinet doet geen openbare uitspraken welke onderdelen als kritiek zijn aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Buitenweg over het advies van de politie om na intimidatie online onder een andere naam verder te gaan

MPs Paternotte and Buitenweg asked the Justice Minister whether police advised a local politician to change his Twitter name after reporting intimidation, and how that fits with protecting free expression and with police policy on reporting online intimidation. Minister Grapperhaus confirmed the case, said police may advise victims to adjust their behaviour to end a threatening situation quickly, that the victim decides whether to follow it, and that such advice is consistent with putting victim safety first.
This advice is given on the consideration that the safety of the victim comes first or may be at risk.
Dit advies wordt gegeven uit de overweging dat de veiligheid van het slachtoffer voorop staat of mogelijkerwijs gevaar loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over kwetsbaarheden in de cybersecurity van scanners in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the government about cybersecurity vulnerabilities in Nuctech cargo scanners at the Rotterdam port, including Chinese state links, supplier screening, remote maintenance access and server separation. The ministers answered that a Douane external audit is underway, that the remote maintenance connection will not be shut off pending the audit, and that existing procurement and national security rules apply.
The remote connection for maintenance will not be shut down pending the external investigation, because ending it carries the risk that scanning equipment remains broken for a long time.

De remote verbinding voor onderhoud wordt in afwachting van het extern onderzoek niet stilgezet, omdat het opheffen hiervan het risico met zich meebrengt dat scanapparatuur langdurig in storing blijft staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Bromet, Kröger en Buitenweg over misstanden in de transportsector

MPs asked whether TLN and PostNL tried to influence a study into criminal abuse and labour exploitation in the transport sector, and what the government will do with its findings. The minister answered that TLN commissioned the study, that the ministry only co-sat on the steering group and held a subsidy, that the methodology was judged sound, and that a cabinet response will follow in spring.
I will study the outcomes and discuss them with TLN and the Minister of SZW, among others.
Ik ga de uitkomsten bestuderen en onder meer met TLN en de Minister van SZW bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Buitenweg over het bericht dat Huawei in technologie investeert voor de etnische profilering van Oeigoeren

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Huawei and other Chinese tech firms are developing facial recognition to identify Uyghurs, and what Dutch and EU responses, export controls and standards safeguards could address this. The government answered that it cannot confirm Huawei's denial, raised the issue with the company, noted that Dutch export controls do not cover ethnic-identification technology, and said it will consider EU human rights sanctions and due diligence obligations.
The cabinet cannot confirm this explanation from Huawei on the basis of its own information.
Het kabinet kan deze uitleg van Huawei op basis van eigen informatie niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de artikel 7-procedure tegen EU-lidstaten Polen en Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether it shares the Portuguese presidency's view that Article 7 proceedings against Poland and Hungary cannot proceed without physical hearings, and whether it will help organise them. The government agreed the procedure should not stall, explained that video meetings are informal and risk later annulment challenges, and said it will press for regular agenda items and welcomes the presidency's plan to table the procedures in a physical General Affairs Council.
The cabinet agrees that stagnation of both Article 7 procedures would be undesirable.
Het kabinet is het er mee eens dat stagnatie van beide artikel 7-procedures onwenselijk zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Dam over wachttijden bij het opvolgen van aangiftes over verkrachtingen

MPs Buitenweg and Van Dam asked about long waiting times before police act on rape reports, including delays in questioning suspects, whether this weakens prosecution, and whether victims are advised to stay silent during investigations. The Minister acknowledged high workloads and 798 open cases over six months, outlined extra capacity funding and a six-month target, and said victims are heard quickly to limit influence and support referral.
The police are working hard to improve the performance of the vice squad's duties.
De politie werkt hard aan verbetering in de taakuitvoering van de zedenpolitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Buitenweg over het onderzoek naar taakdifferentiatie bij de brandweer

Two MPs (Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Buitenweg) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the consequences of task differentiation in the fire service, including effects on volunteers and whether EU working-time and part-time rules can be met. The minister answered that consequences were analysed for all 25 safety regions, that task differentiation is feasible but needs organisational change, and that volunteer status will be preserved while EU compliance steps will be taken.
I consider it necessary that the safety regions, as employers of fire service personnel, quickly take concrete steps to arrange that.
Ik vind het noodzakelijk dat de veiligheidsregio’s als werkgevers van het brandweerpersoneel snel concrete stappen zetten om dat te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Groothuizen, Van Dam en Buitenweg over de rechtsstaat in Polen en de gevolgen voor Nederland

MPs Groothuizen, Van Dam and Buitenweg asked the government about media pluralism and press freedom in Poland, press lawsuits, EU tools, Polish asylum claims under the Aznar protocol, free movement, and detained Polish suspects after extradition suspensions. The government answered at length, largely describing EU monitoring frameworks, noting the limits of EU instruments, declining to provide asylum-motive statistics, and reporting that no one is held in Dutch detention solely due to the suspension.
The cabinet is not aware that Polish citizens are currently experiencing problems exercising their right to free movement in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet is er niet mee bekend dat Poolse burgers momenteel problemen ondervinden bij het uitoefenen van hun recht op vrij verkeer in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over algemene dreigingsniveaus en de concrete bedreigingen van joodse instellingen

MP Buitenweg asked whether the NCTV's general threat level, lowered from 4 to 3, reflects the concrete threat to Jewish institutions, whether security measures were scaled back on the basis of general analyses, and whether specific threat levels should be stated. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the threat level is a general indication only, that security decisions are based on concrete threat and risk, that responsibility for protecting religious institutions is decentralised, and that the DTN will not be changed, though he gave no commitment to a concrete new step.
Regarding how security measures were built up, I cannot make statements, as your House knows.
Over de wijze waarop beveiligingsmaatregelen zijn opgebouwd, kan ik zoals uw Kamer weet, geen uitspraken doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het rapport van Amnesty International rapport ‘We sense trouble: Automated discrimination and mass surveillance in predictive policing in the Netherlands’

Parliamentary questions from MP Buitenweg (GroenLinks) about the Amnesty International report on predictive policing and the Sensing project in Roermond asked about selection criteria, effectiveness, feedback loops, discrimination, privacy, legal basis and oversight. The Minister answered that the Operational Testing Ground Roermond targets mobile banditry, that criteria cannot be disclosed for investigative reasons, that effectiveness cannot yet be assessed, that oversight lies with the steering group, the data protection officer, the Dutch Data Protection Authority and the Inspectorate, and that he does not consider the project to violate rights and will not stop it.
I have had access to the list, but I cannot make this information public. This would undermine investigative and enforcement interests.
Ik heb inzage gehad in de lijst, maar ik kan deze informatie niet openbaar maken. Dit zou het opsporings- en handhavingsbelang doorkruizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kröger over het mogelijk instellen van een (regionale) avondklok-maatregel

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would use the Coordination Act on states of emergency or the Act on extraordinary powers of civil authority to impose a (regional) evening curfew during the COVID-19 pandemic, and why it now considered this after earlier saying a state of emergency was not necessary. Minister Grapperhaus answered that a curfew is not currently on the table, that it would be based on article 8 of the Wbbbg without declaring a state of emergency, that parliament would be informed in advance by royal decree, and that no substantive weighing of curfew measures has yet been made.
Of an intention to do so, notice will be given to the States General, so that views can be exchanged between government and States General if desired, unless urgency prevents it.

Van een voornemen daartoe zal mededeling worden gedaan aan de Staten-Generaal, zodat daarover desgewenst tussen regering en Staten-Generaal van gedachten kan worden gewisseld, tenzij de vereiste spoed zich daartegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Smeulders en Buitenweg over Coronatestlijn

MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that staff of the coronavirus testing helpline could access personal data beyond what their tasks required, about WhatsApp data sharing, training, outsourcing to Teleperformance, unpaid hours and working conditions. The government answered that access is necessary for the job, that logging and confidentiality agreements safeguard privacy, that GGD-GHOR is responsible, and that labour conditions are for employers and social partners, with the Inspectie SZW available for complaints.
Care in handling personal data is of course of great importance.
Zorgvuldigheid is bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens uiteraard van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de beveiliging van raadslieden en familieleden van bedreigde (kroon)getuigen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the protection of relatives and legal representatives of threatened crown witnesses, following a reported conflict with the public prosecution service over the brother of crown witness Nabil B.; the questions covered the procedure for deciding and monitoring protection, whether family interests were weighed, the meaning of 'changing insight', relocation abroad, refusal of a meeting, and other conflicts. The minister answered that protection is assessed case by case and monitored periodically, that family interests could have been weighed more explicitly in the deal, that specific measures and the decision on a meeting rest with the coordinating prosecutor, and that details of measures will not be disclosed for the protected persons' sake.
Regarding the concrete nature and extent of measures already taken and yet to be taken, in the interest of the persons to be protected I will not provide further details.
Over de concrete aard en omvang van reeds genomen en nog te nemen maatregelen, doe ik in het belang van de te beveiligen personen geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Buitenweg over ex-partnergeweld

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how ex-partner violence is registered, how many women were stalked, victimised or killed by an ex-partner in 2017-2019, and what protocols, evaluation and expertise exist. The minister answered that ex-partner violence is not registered separately within the partner category, that stalking was not measured in the prevalence study with a new survey pending, and that specific protocols, the impact monitor and calamity-based learning are in place.
Ex-partner violence is not registered separately.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de totstandkoming van een nieuwe EU drugsstrategie

The MP asks whether the Commission's new EU drug agenda was properly prepared with consultation, what it means for the Dutch approach, and whether the government will press the Commission to withdraw it. The minister says there was public and civil society consultation but no member state consultation on content, that the proposals are not binding but lack balance on health and human rights, and that the government has raised the issue and will ensure NGOs are heard in the new strategy.
The Netherlands, like several other member states, has raised this with the European Commission and brought the problem up in the relevant council working group.
Nederland heeft, net als verschillende andere lidstaten, de Europese Commissie hierop aangesproken en het probleem in de betreffende raadswerkgroep aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over de uitwerking van de digitale ondersteuning van bron- en contactonderzoek

MPs Buitenweg and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about the government's digital support for contact tracing, including the GGD programme of requirements, reliance on Bluetooth technology, and the composition of the expert group and advisory committee. The minister answered that the programme of requirements was published on 19 May 2020, that Bluetooth was chosen after research on the Apple and Google framework, and described how expertise and the advisory committee were assembled.
No, that is not correct. The programme was presented to me on 19 May 2020 and I published it that same day.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Het programma is op 19 mei 2020 aan mij aangeboden en op die dag door mij gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Hoe beveiligers van Thierry Baudet met geweld een demonstrant onschadelijk maken’

MPs Özütok and Buitenweg asked whether private security guards of Thierry Baudet used physical force to stop a lone demonstrator, whether demonstration freedom may only be restricted by authorities under the Wom, and whether measures would be taken against repeat offending security firms. The Minister replied that private guards have no force powers beyond any citizen, that the complainant filed a police report, that such incidents are not separately registered, and that the Wpbr allows fines and licence withdrawal.
Private security guards, like any other citizen, have no authority to use force.
Particuliere beveiligers hebben, net als iedere andere burger, geen bevoegdheid tot het aanwenden van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het besluit van de Britse regering om Huawei volledig uit te sluiten van het Britse 5G-netwerk

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the UK decision to fully exclude Huawei from its 5G network, the value of UK intelligence insight, US sanctions, updating the Dutch 5G risk analysis, EU/NATO coordination, the timing of ministerial rules on trusted suppliers, and the implications of Hong Kong's national security law for Chinese firms. The government answered that it makes its own assessment through a structural process reviewing threats and technology, that the 5G supplier ministerial regulation is expected in early 2021, and that there is no direct link between the Hong Kong law and trust in Chinese firms.
No public statements are made about the knowledge position of intelligence services.
Over de kennispositie van inlichtingendiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over het datalek bij de infectieradar website

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the health minister how he reacted to Formdesk's claim that it received no warning about the Infectieradar data leak, and why the ministry's account of the security checks differed from its earlier statements. The minister answered that RIVM implemented the fix Formdesk advised, that a second flaw was only found on 6 June, and that RIVM now concedes an extra test could have caught it, while stating there is no remaining disagreement with Formdesk.

In hindsight, RIVM concludes that this problem could have been noticed on 25 March if an extra test of this risk had been carried out after implementing the measure advised by Formdesk's supplier and before the Infectieradar was placed online.

Achteraf gezien concludeert het RIVM dat dit probleem op 25 maart opgemerkt had kunnen worden indien ná implementatie van de door de leverancier van Formdesk geadviseerde maatregel en vóór het online plaatsen van Infectieradar een extra test op dit risico was uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two MPs asked the government to clarify how many people gathering at 1.5 metres constitutes a breach of the emergency ordinances, and why the Prime Minister's statements on group size, and the definition of an event, seemed inconsistent with fines and enforcement practice. The minister explained the successive rules for public spaces and gatherings, said the definition of event and the distinction with gatherings is clarified in an ordinance, and noted that a bill in preparation will address gathering norms.
In general, an emergency ordinance must contain sufficiently precise provisions to be complied with and enforced.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat een noodverordening voldoende bepaalde voorschriften moet bevatten om te kunnen worden nageleefd en gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van den Berge over de strafrechtspleging in Coronatijd

MPs Buitenweg and Van den Berge asked about the state of criminal justice during the COVID-19 period, including police capacity, legal aid, backlogs, courtroom access, detainee participation and tbs (forensic psychiatric) leave. The minister replied that physical hearings were gradually resumed from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, backlogs are being addressed through an integrated approach, and various measures on legal aid, video hearings and probation were described, mostly without concrete new commitments beyond promised letters.
Your House will be informed in writing about the approach once it is ready.
Uw Kamer wordt schriftelijk geïnformeerd over de aanpak zodra deze gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Justice and Interior Ministers about legal objections that COVID-19 emergency ordinances (noodverordeningen) based on the Public Health Act lack basis, bypass the constitutional state-of-emergency regime, restrict constitutional rights without grounds, and lack democratic control. The government defended the ordinances as lawful, pointed to Ministerial instructions as subject to parliamentary oversight and to council information duties, and announced temporary specific legislation with consultation of local bodies.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it desirable that the measures to be taken after the acute crisis phase be developed in consultation with parliament.
Wel acht het kabinet het gewenst dat de maatregelen die moeten worden getroffen na de fase van acute crisisbeheersing in samenspraak met het parlement tot stand worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de toegang tot en het gebruik van archieven van het Rode Kruis voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek

An MP asked the minister whether strict conditions on access to Red Cross war archives transferred to the National Archives, citing GDPR, are justified for researchers and memorial institutions. The minister answered that the conditions follow the minimal GDPR-based requirements of the Dutch implementing act, that existing access arrangements will be continued after the transfer, and that adequate access remains possible.
Other conditions than the minimum conditions mentioned in Article 24 UAVG are therefore not imposed.
Andere voorwaarden dan de minimale voorwaarden, genoemd in artikel 24 UAVG, worden dan ook niet gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Buitenweg, Van Dam en Groothuizen over de brief van the European Network of Councils for the Judiciary (ENCJ) aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie over recente anti-Europese wetgeving

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about the ENCJ letter on Polish rule-of-law reforms, the Polish 'muzzle law' and the Commission's infringement actions, and whether the Netherlands should start an Article 259 TFEU procedure against Poland. The ministers expressed serious concern, noted the Court of Justice's rulings and the Commission's role, supported rule-of-law conditionality in the EU budget, but argued that a Member State-initiated Article 259 procedure is not the appropriate instrument.
The separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary are essential principles of the democratic rule of law and form the core values of the European Union.
De scheiding der machten en onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht zijn essentiële beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat en vormen de kernwaarden van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Buitenweg over de berichtgeving ‘Ook in Nederland gezichtsherkenning met omstreden programma Clearview‘

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch public or semi-public bodies used Clearview AI's facial recognition software, whether it is compatible with GDPR and human rights, and related questions. The minister said he was not aware of any Dutch government use or agreements with Clearview, that the police had confirmed no contact or purchases, and that the Interior Minister would look further and inform parliament, with separate letters on facial recognition promised.

The Minister of the Interior stated during the Digitalisation committee meeting of 11 March that he would examine more broadly whether government bodies use or have used Clearview and inform the House.

De Minister van BZK heeft tijdens het AO Digitalisering van 11 maart jl. op vragen van het lid Verhoeven toegezegd breder bij de overheid te bezien of er gebruik wordt of is gemaakt van Clearview en uw Kamer hierover te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Kröger en Buitenweg over geweld en seksuele intimidatie in de trein en op het spoor

MPs asked the Justice and Security and Infrastructure ministers about sexual harassment in trains and on platforms, including the number of incidents, advice to travellers, cooperation with international carriers and use of expertise from the national sexual violence centre. The government answered that about 200 incidents were registered by carriers in 2019 but figures may be incomplete, that there is no specific traveller advice beyond general reporting channels, and that NS cooperates internationally and with specialist organisations, with no specific new commitments.
The police currently have no additional figures on sexual harassment specifically in trains and on platforms.
De politie heeft op dit moment geen aanvullende cijfers met betrekking tot seksuele intimidatie specifiek in de trein en op het perron.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de berichtgeving ‘Zelden rechtszaak na verkrachting’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Justice Minister why sex-crime cases take so long, why many rape reports lead to no prosecution, and about victim care and the Inspectorate's review. The minister acknowledged the long delays and attributed them to complexity and workload, pointed to added police capacity, and said the Inspectorate's findings are expected before summer.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of the investigation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over vrouwelijke slachtoffers van moord en doodslag

MP Buitenweg asked the Justice Minister whether the government will do more to protect women victims of murder and manslaughter, given that most female victims are killed by a partner or ex-partner, and what measures will improve prevention and training on stalking. The minister acknowledges the problem as serious but not new, points to the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme and stalking-specific measures following an Inspectorate report, and commits to police and ZSM training and regular working visits.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Buitenweg over het interview ‘Politiechef Anja Schouten: Er moet een eerste hulp bij onbegrepen gedrag komen’ en het opinieartikel ‘Laat de politiegeen zorgtaken uitvoeren’

GroenLinks MPs Renkema and Buitenweg asked the state secretary for Health and the Justice minister about police chief Schouten's call for a first-aid response to 'confused behaviour' (E33 reports) and an op-ed against police doing care tasks. The government answered that the problem is multi-faceted and needs regional, personalised solutions, reported E33 incident counts for 2011–2019, and declined to adopt a national model or a mandatory crisis-point in every region.
A single national approach would also not do justice to the complexity of the problem and would leave insufficient room for local customisation.
Eén landelijke aanpak zou ook geen recht doen aan de complexiteit van de problematiek en onvoldoende ruimte bieden voor lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Verhoeven over de privacyrisico’s van onveilige beveiligingscamera’s

MPs Buitenweg and Verhoeven asked the Minister for Legal Protection about privacy and security risks of insecure internet-connected security cameras, including minimum security standards, data on hacks, enforcement, and privacy by design. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to EU-level work on minimum security requirements for IoT devices, said no data on hacks is recorded, and declined to take on a coordinating role with producers, leaving that to the Dutch DPA and manufacturers.
The total number of cases per year involving hacked security cameras is not known to me.
Het totaal aantal gevallen per jaar waarbij sprake is van gehackte beveiligingscamera’s is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg inzake het bericht dat de Consumentenbond de noodklok luidt om illegale datahandel

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumer Association report on illegal data trading in Europe, including whether GDPR and UAVG are violated, why apps exclude behavioural data from personal data, and what enforcement has followed. The Minister says the GDPR and UAVG give sufficient tools, the AP has not yet imposed any sanctions for illegal sharing, and he welcomes the AP's focus on data trade and will press for stronger ePrivacy rules.
Given the effective exercise of the AP's supervisory tasks, I cannot give you more concrete information on the number of investigations or enforcement trajectories.
Gelet op een effectieve uitoefening van de toezichtstaken van de AP kan ik u geen concretere informatie geven over de hoeveelheid onderzoeken of handhavingstrajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over SyRi

An MP asked the state secretary why earlier answers on SyRi in Capelle aan den IJssel omitted that no investigations resulted from the risk reports, and how this discrepancy arose. The state secretary admitted the two answer sets were confusing because a draft report was used for the second set, said the error should have been flagged, and stated that no investigations followed from SyRi risk reports in that project.
The confusion could have been prevented by stating at the time that an error had been made in the publication of the reports.
De verwarring had voorkomen kunnen worden door toen te melden dat er een fout in de publicatie van de rapporten was gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de veiligheid van het 5G netwerk

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers about the security of 5G networks, including vendor screening, classification of high-risk network parts, human-rights principles and EU industrial capacity. The minister answered that vendors are assessed on intent and foreign legal obligations to share data, that the list of critical components is classified and cannot be shared, and that EU industrial policy is still under discussion.
The list of critical components has been classified as confidential and I therefore cannot share it with you.
De lijst met kritieke onderdelen is als vertrouwelijk geclassificeerd en kan ik daarom niet met u delen.
Antwoord op van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van SyRI in Capelle aan den IJssel

The MP Buitenweg asks the State Secretary whether earlier answers on the SyRI project in Capelle aan den IJssel were complete, given an evaluation stating none of the 41 risk reports led to further investigation, and why publication was delayed. The State Secretary says 137 risk reports led to 41 addresses, the data were destroyed before the earlier answer, the project was applied incompletely, and publication was delayed by personnel changes, admitting it would have been better to publish earlier.
I note that it would have been more proper and better to publish earlier, even if no statutory deadline exists for it.
Ik constateer dat het netter en beter was geweest om eerder te publiceren, zelfs als daar geen wettelijke termijn voor bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Taking Stock of App Stores’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about app store operators' dominance, commission fees and possible self-preferencing by Apple, and about ongoing competition investigations. The State Secretary answered that the open internet regulation does not cover app stores, that the ACM is conducting a follow-up investigation into Apple, that the European Commission is investigating a Spotify complaint, and that ex ante powers for gatekeeper platforms could be considered.
It is not for me to assess whether an undertaking abuses its dominant position.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of een onderneming haar machtspositie misbruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Geheime diensten morren over nieuwe toezichthouder’

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the intelligence services are unhappy with the Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden (TIB), which authorises their special powers, over alleged assertive, detailed review and disputes about its scope and appeal rights. The minister acknowledges some disagreement on the scope of the TIB's legality review, says it is not a marginal review, and defers any change such as an appeal option to the evaluation of the Wiv 2017 starting in 2020.
As confirmed during the parliamentary treatment of the Wiv 2017, the TIB's review is not a marginal review.
Zoals tijdens de parlementaire behandeling van de Wiv 2017 is bevestigd, is de toets van de TIB géén marginale toets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Den Boer over de laatste stand van zaken rondom de aanschaf van tweeduizend bodycams

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about the status of the purchase of 2,000 police bodycams, including procurement progress, evidence on effects, privacy safeguards, ethnic profiling and the Ombudsman's role. The minister answered that procurement is underway with operational use expected by end 2020, that privacy rules and a 28-day review regime exist, and that bodycams are not used to combat ethnic profiling.
We are currently having that examined and will inform your House in the second police half-yearly report of 2019 about the outcome of that study.
Ik laat dat op dit moment onderzoeken en zal uw Kamer in het tweede halfjaarbericht politie van 2019 informeren over de uitkomst van dat onderzoek.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Den Boer, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Politiechef die racisme aankaartte weggestuurd’

MPs Den Boer, Van den Berge and Buitenweg asked whether the Leiden team chief who raised racism and bullying in the police was sidelined by the police leadership, and how the force handles such reports. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the team chief was not placed on non-active duty, that the force says all reports of misconduct are taken seriously, and that he will discuss police culture with the chief commissioner but will not comment on individual personnel cases.
Like your House, I believe we should exercise great restraint in commenting on individual cases.
Met uw Kamer ben ik van mening dat ons grote terughoudendheid past in te gaan op individuele casussen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van den Berge over de berichten ‘Ik walg van politieagenten die zich Marokkanenverdelgers noemen’ en ‘Burgemeesters regio Den Haag: geen verziekte cultuur bij politie’

MPs Buitenweg and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that eleven Hague-region mayors concluded there is no 'rotten culture' in the Hague police regarding discrimination and racism, while an internal investigation into the Hoefkade unit was still running, and about dismissals, a letter from police leadership on an 'undesirable culture', and the treatment of a former team chief who spoke out. The Minister declined to comment on the ongoing case and individual personnel matters, said the police chief takes reports seriously, pointed to an ombudsman post and existing reporting channels, and saw no need for further structural measures for now.
In view of the ongoing investigation at the Hoefkade team, I will not go further into this case.
Gelet op het lopende onderzoek bij het team Hoefkade ga ik verder niet op deze casuïstiek in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht Gedwongen uitgehuwelijkte Fatima: ‘Meisjes zoals ik worden verkocht als golden tickets’ van Hart van Nederland

MPs asked the ministers how forced marriage of young women with a non-Western migrant background is measured, what protection and legal tools exist, and how the vrouwenopvang shortage affects victims. The government answered that reliable figures are lacking, pointed to existing reporting channels, laws and an action agenda due end 2019, and said it would evaluate the Wet tegengaan huwelijksdwang and study the shelter capacity problem.
Precise and reliable figures on the scale of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van kunstmatige intelligentie in zedenzaken

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Maastricht University chatbot for victims of sexual harassment, including whether government might use it, what data trained it, and who is liable for errors. The minister said the chatbot is only being monitored, the training data was anonymised and mostly from India, and liability follows general civil law, with the Justice Ministry committing to watch AI developments without firm action.
I find developments in this area interesting and I follow them.
De ontwikkelingen op dit gebied zijn interessant en die volg ik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Ojik over garantstelling sprekers De Balie

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether the IND's demand for a financial guarantee for Turkish and Sri Lankan guest speakers at De Balie hinders free public debate, and whether such demands could be dropped for debate-centre invitees. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said EU Schengen visa rules allow a guarantee as one way to show sufficient means, and argued the motion on event security does not override those rules.
I cannot, however, go into the individual case, also for reasons of protecting personal data.
Ik kan evenwel niet op de individuele casus ingaan, ook om redenen van bescherming van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het aanpakken van pro-anorexia websites en ‘anorexiacoaches’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about pro-anorexia websites, the scale of such online communities, and the 'anorexia coaches' who solicit sexual images from vulnerable girls. The government said a research study by CKM and GGZ Rivierduinen is ongoing with results due in autumn, that a ban on pro-ana sites would be ineffective and could reinforce stigma, and pointed to existing criminal law, grooming provisions and the K-EET care chain initiative as its response.
It has not been mapped how extensive the pro-anorexia websites are in the Netherlands, and there is no overall picture of the websites, forums and social media channels.
Er is niet in kaart gebracht hoe omvangrijk de pro-anorexia websites zijn in Nederland en er is geen totaalbeeld van de websites, fora en sociale mediakanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over het advies van de AIVD over de nationale veiligheid en veiling 5G

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the AIVD advice on 5G and national security of 4 February 2019 was not sent to parliament earlier or attached to the 1 July letter, and whether the government will adopt the AIVD recommendations on phasing out high-risk suppliers and on open source software. The government answered that the advice was weighed in the Taskforce risk analysis and shared confidentially with parliament, that its 5G approach is country-neutral, that it adopts the AIVD advice for C2000 with a verification study, and that open source software is a long-term option to be pursued at European level.
Because the AIVD and MIVD letter is one part of the Taskforce's analytical process, it was decided not to send the letter separately and outside the context of the report to the House.
Omdat de brief van de AIVD en de MIVD één onderdeel is van het analyseproces van de Taskforce is er voor gekozen de brief niet los en buiten de context van de rapportage aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Westerveld over geweld in de jeugdzorg

MPs Buitenweg and Westerveld asked whether psychological child abuse is punishable under Dutch criminal law and how prosecutors handle it, and what measures the government will take. The minister answered that Article 300 Sr can cover psychological abuse, that the Public Prosecution Service examines such cases case by case, that no Criminal Code revision is currently considered opportune, and listed ongoing programmes and a pending bill strengthening child abuse liability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de uitzending ‘Ruim 350 zedenzaken blijven maanden liggen door onderbezetting’ van Nieuwsuur van 21 augustus

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a Nieuwsuur report that serious sex-crime cases wait months or up to a year before police investigate, blaming understaffing, and asked about staffing, consequences and acceptable timelines. The minister acknowledged the delays are unacceptable, cited rising caseloads and capacity fluctuations, and said an Inspectorate study on victim treatment is expected in early 2020.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security is currently investigating the treatment of sex-crime victims in sex-crime cases.
Op dit moment doet de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid onderzoek naar de bejegening van zedenslachtoffers in zedenzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het melden van seksueel geweld

An MP asked whether sexual violence victims report sooner after the offence, whether police and prosecution figures reflect this, whether Centra Seksueel Geweld (CSG) have enough capacity and name recognition, and how the government will encourage reporting. The minister replies that police and prosecution figures show only a slight rise in reports and a fall in suspect inflow, that CSG capacity is adequate, and announces a pilot covering CSG visit costs and a multi-year awareness campaign.
In the autumn I will start a multi-year campaign to increase the willingness of victims of sexual violence to report.
In het najaar start ik een meerjarige campagne om de meldingsbereidheid van slachtoffers van seksueel geweld te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat Nederland met kinderlevens speelt

MP Buitenweg asks whether Dutch children in Kurdish camps without parental care should be repatriated, and what the consequences of revoking a parent's Dutch nationality are for the children. The government answers that about 90 children with a Dutch link are in the camps, that revocation does not affect already-born children's nationality, that it sees no treaty obligation to repatriate, and that it assesses orphan cases case by case without sending people into unsafe areas.
The cabinet continues to assess cases of Dutch orphaned children on a case-by-case basis and to explore the possibilities.
Het kabinet blijft gevallen van Nederlandse weeskinderen van zaak tot zaak beoordelen en de mogelijkheden verkennen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken, Krol, Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Minister in de strafzaak tegen het lid Wilders

MPs from D66, SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice about possible contacts between his predecessor Opstelten or ministry staff and the Public Prosecution Service over the case against MP Wilders, including a timeline of contacts and why ambtsberichten are kept confidential. The Minister says he cannot vouch for all contacts, will not comment on individual prosecutions, and provides a partial timeline with confidentiality grounds for withholding the advisory reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Buitenweg over de mogelijke verhuizing van interceptieschotels uit Burum

MPs Diks and Buitenweg asked the ministers of Defence and the Interior whether the government is frustrated with the intelligence services over relocating the Burum interception dishes because of 5G, and what consultation, analysis and parliamentary involvement there would be before any relocation decision. The minister denied the frustration, said a TNO study concluded coexistence is not possible, and promised an alternative by September 2022 via international cooperation, while withholding details of that cooperation for confidentiality reasons.
Because of the confidentiality required in this context, I cannot say anything further about the precise shape of this international cooperation.
Ik kan vanwege de in dit verband vereiste vertrouwelijkheid verder geen uitspraken doen over de precieze invulling van deze internationale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de motivering van automatisch genomen besluiten

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether automatically taken decisions should disclose their decision rules, given that a rule analyst's structuring choices shape outcomes. The minister answered that publication adds little where algorithms are a one-to-one translation of law, but that disclosure is warranted where additional choices are made beyond statute and policy rules.
Disclosure is appropriate where further choices are made in addition to choices already contained in legislation and policy rules.
Openbaarmaking is wel op haar plaats, als nadere keuzes worden gemaakt in aanvulling op keuzes die al in wetgeving en beleidsregels zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de noodkreet van een strafrechtsadvocaat over de zin van het strafrechtelijk aanpakken van psychisch gestoorden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a criminal lawyer's complaint that mentally ill suspects and convicts are wrongly handled by criminal justice instead of psychiatric care, including the high share of suspects with limited intellectual ability, sexual intimidation in care, detention while seeking shelter, and how to secure appropriate care. The minister answered that criminal law applies to all, that courts and prosecutors consider such circumstances, that holding people in pre-trial detention to find shelter is undesirable, and pointed to existing mechanisms such as forensic observation, BOPZ and future Wvggz measures.
Criminal law applies to everyone, including when psychological problems or limited intellectual ability are involved.
Het strafrecht geldt voor iedereen, ook wanneer er psychische problemen of LVB aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de inzet van private beveiligers bij de arrestantenzorg in Oost-Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the use of private security staff in custody care in the Oost-Nederland police unit and the chronic understaffing behind it. The minister answered that external hires are a temporary measure for support tasks only, that they do not perform official acts, and that the unit is working on a structural solution, while giving no measurable targets.
External hiring for custody care in the Oost-Nederland police unit is only used for support tasks and is a temporary measure
De externe inhuur voor de arrestantenzorg in de politie-eenheid Oost-Nederland wordt alleen ingezet voor ondersteunende taken en is een tijdelijke maatregel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg, Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht 'AIVD en MI5 gestopt met samenwerking met Oostenrijkse diensten'

MPs Buitenweg, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about reports that the AIVD and MI5 stopped cooperating with Austrian intelligence services, including effects on the Club van Bern, CTG, PESCO and the Burum satellite station. The minister declined to comment publicly on the specifics of intelligence cooperation, citing legal risk-weighing procedures, and otherwise answered that bilateral and EU relations with Austria remain good.
The AIVD and MIVD make no public statements about the precise nature of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert’

MPs Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked whether the Netherlands can refuse entry to US preacher Steven Anderson and prosecute or prevent his hate speech, and whether the government will act.
