The State Secretary answered that entry can be refused under Schengen rules and extremist speakers can be barred under existing instruments, that Dutch criminal law cannot prosecute speech made abroad, and that contact with the municipality exists, while declining to comment on other countries' decisions.
I cannot provide information about possible refusals of entry by other countries.
Over eventuele toegangsweigeringen van andere landen kan ik geen informatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over wifitracking

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Dutch Data Protection Authority reviewing an industry opt-out register for wifi tracking, which municipalities are using wifi tracking, whether citizens' legal safeguards are adequate, and whether citizens can complain. The Minister said the AP has not yet received a formal request, municipalities have no visibility over private tracking, the legal framework is clear and sufficient, and the AP can act ex officio as well as on complaints.
The AP is an independent supervisory authority that as a rule does not make statements about ongoing or possible investigations or other activities.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die als regel geen mededelingen doet over lopende of mogelijke onderzoeken of andere werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de terugkeer van gedetineerden naar de Pointe Blanchegevangenis op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether detainees were returned from the Netherlands to the Pointe Blanche prison on Sint Maarten despite inhumane conditions, and whether officials had warned the return was legally contested. The minister confirmed eight returns in 2018 (three after October for imminent release, five earlier at Sint Maarten's request), said the return of the rest was suspended pending improvement measures, and committed to monitoring progress.
Five detainees returned between April and July 2018 at Sint Maarten's request in the context of their legal proceedings.
Vijf gedetineerden zijn tussen april en juli 2018 teruggekeerd op verzoek van Sint Maarten in het kader van hun rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Buitenweg en Van der Staaij over de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld, Buitenweg and Van der Staaij asked the ministers about youths being placed in closed youth care because no alternatives exist, the acceptability of deprivation of liberty, waiting lists, and compliance with children's rights. Minister De Jonge answered that closed care should be minimised, pointed to a best-fit care plan and expert teams, acknowledged the lack of alternatives and the need for a new legal framework, and said several points are under study.
That young people have experienced stays in a closed institution as a prison, I consider an important signal.
Dat jongeren het verblijf in een gesloten instelling als een gevangenis hebben ervaren, vind ik een belangrijk signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de gevolgen van overbelasting van het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut voor strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in ernstige zedenzaken

MP Buitenweg asked whether police were limited to five sexual-offence DNA kits per department per month at the Netherlands Forensic Institute, and what consequences any such limit had for prosecuting serious sex crimes. The Minister denied any limit, explaining that five extra kits per week can be sent for urgent outsourced analysis on top of existing NFI urgent capacity, and that the police and prosecution expect NFI capacity to suffice.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, this is not a limitation but an expansion of urgent capacity for DNA investigations in sexual offence cases.
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 1 gaat het niet om een beperking, maar om een uitbreiding van de spoedcapaciteit voor de DNA-onderzoeken in zedenzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het kweken van wiet als medicijn

MPs Van Nispen, Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked why home cultivation of medicinal cannabis should remain illegal for patients who cannot get adequate relief from the five pharmacy-available varieties, and about the Tilburg case and the court ruling in Jeffrey's favour. The minister answered that the five varieties largely meet need, that home-grown cannabis cannot guarantee consistent quality and dosage, that the appeal against the ruling prevents comment, and that no talks with Tilburg are planned.
An urgent appeal has been lodged against this ruling. I therefore cannot respond to it.
Tegen deze uitspraak is spoedappèl ingesteld. Ik kan hier derhalve geen reactie op geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over etnisch profileren door de politie

Parliamentarian Buitenweg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of stops without clear cause and ethnic profiling by police, including what measures exist, how prevalence is measured, where anti-profiling goals are recorded, what concrete commitments the police have made and how they are monitored. The minister answered that a package of measures (the Kracht van het Verschil programme, a proactive-checks framework, awareness training and an app study) is in place, that no measurement instrument for ethnic profiling exists because ethnicity is not recorded, and that results will be reported in summer 2019 with the possibility of further measures.

A package of measures to address distinction in police action without objective justification is in place, and a set of efforts, activities and projects is being carried out under the multi-year programme 'De Kracht van het Verschil'.
Er is en wordt – met het meerjarige programma «De Kracht van het Verschil – een set aan inspanningen, activiteiten en projecten verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebrek aan onderzoekscapaciteit naar mogelijke politiefraude

An MP asked whether a complaint against police over a major tender has lain idle with the Rijksrecherche for six months, whether understaffing leaves police misconduct unexamined, and whether threats against mayors are blocking corruption investigations. The minister confirms the complaint was filed earlier, with later filings and a Article 12 complaint causing delay, and now sits with the Public Prosecution Service; he acknowledges capacity limits forcing scaled-back or dropped investigations, and denies that threats against mayors are the cause.
The file is now under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service.
Inmiddels ligt het dossier ter beoordeling voor aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Buitenweg over collectief beheer bij Video on Demand

MPs Kwint and Buitenweg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about collective management of remuneration for Video on Demand, including whether American rightsholders are paid and whether similar international arrangements could apply. The Minister answered that a convenant between Dutch PAM collecting societies and Rodap covers VOD remuneration until 1 January 2020, that no data exist on cross-border flows, that some non-Rodap VOD providers such as Netflix have not paid so far, and that an evaluation of the Wet auteurscontractenrecht will be started.

Inquiries with the CBOs show that no overviews exist of the total remuneration collected through mandatory and voluntary collective management and its distribution to foreign authors and neighbouring rightsholders.

Navraag bij CBO's levert op dat er geen overzichten bestaan van het totaal via verplicht en vrijwillig collectief beheer geïnde vergoedingen en de repartitie daarvan aan buitenlandse auteurs- en naburig rechthebbenden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de toestand in Justitieel Medisch Centrum Scheveningen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of poor hygiene, medication and treatment failures, and dilapidated buildings at the Scheveningen prison hospital JCvSZ, and whether the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) should re-inspect it. The minister said the IGJ found improvement points but no shortcomings requiring immediate intervention, pointed to a hygiene action plan and periodic audits, and saw no reason to request a new inspection.
I therefore see no reason to doubt the quality of care at the JCvSZ.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om te twijfelen aan de kwaliteit van zorg in het JCvSZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Bromet over de concrete aanpak van bedreigingen van boeren

MPs Buitenweg and Bromet asked the Justice, Interior and Agriculture ministers how threats against farmers by violent animal activists are being tackled, including the scale, reporting and prosecution figures and the AIVD's assessment. The minister condemned the intimidation, said such threats are not separately registered, stressed reporting and existing police and prosecution responses, and did not commit to new measures.
Threats against farmers or vandalism of barns motivated by animal activism are not as such registered by the Public Prosecution Service and the police.
Bedreiging van boeren of vernieling van stallen vanuit dieren-activistische motieven, wordt niet als zodanig door het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Geen kinderen meer in de isoleercel? Niet haalbaar, zeggen instellingen’

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked about reports that youth care institutions say the goal of ending solitary confinement of children by 2021 is unrealistic, and about the current frequency of isolation, enforcement, and staffing. The minister says no such letter has been received, a uniform definition and registration of forced isolation is being developed with results due May 2019, the Inspectorate will supervise the rules, and staffing shortages are being addressed through a recruitment campaign.
It is not clear whether young people in Jeugdzorgplus are now forcibly isolated more or less often than in previous years.
Het is niet duidelijk of jongeren in de Jeugdzorgplus nu vaker of minder vaak dan in voorgaande jaren gedwongen worden afgezonderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het fenomeen breast ironing

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether breast ironing, a reported ritual practice affecting girls in Britain, occurs in the Netherlands, whether it constitutes child abuse, and whether a prevention campaign is planned. The minister answered that such cases are not known to Veilig Thuis or the police, saw no reason for research, stated that breast ironing is punishable as mistreatment, and said coordination of harmful traditional practices now sits with the Ministry of Health, with follow-up actions to be developed.
Neither Veilig Thuis nor the police are aware of such cases.
Zowel bij Veilig Thuis als bij de politie zijn dergelijke gevallen niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over het bericht dat 20 procent van de kinderen van gescheiden ouders hun vader niet meer ziet

GroenLinks MPs asked about reports that 20 percent of children of divorced parents no longer see their father, requesting research, figures, international data and policy measures. The minister pointed to ongoing UvA/CBS and WODC research, cited a 2017 WODC figure of about 12 percent no contact with fathers, and described existing action plans on shared parenting and a planned review of child benefit rules.
In addition, the WODC is currently conducting research into the non-compliance with contact arrangements.
Daarnaast doet het WODC thans onderzoek naar het niet-nakomen van omgangsregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het gebruik van SyRI in Capelle aan den IJssel

An MP asked about the SyRI risk-profiling system in Capelle aan den IJssel, including how many cases were investigated, whether investigative powers were used against people without suspicion, and whether SyRI operations should be documented and reported annually. The state secretary said the 62 no-violation cases came from a separate collaboration rather than SyRI, that data were destroyed late, that risk reports are not proof, that SyRI methods will remain undisclosed, and that SyRI use is already documented with a possible mention in a semi-annual letter.
I maintain that the data files and analysis methods used by SyRI should not be made public.
Ik blijf van mening dat gebruikte databestanden en analysemethoden van SyRI niet openbaar moeten worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over straffen en belonen in de jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers whether a silent-sitting punishment and the withdrawal of earned privileges in youth care institutions are still used, whether extra oversight took place after a 2010 ruling, and what is done to protect youths and promote evidence-based methods. The minister answered that Pluryn reports the measure is no longer used, that the IGJ will make unannounced visits and will inspect all closed youth care institutions in early 2019, that advocates reported only minor concerns, and that a knowledge programme on effective methods starts in January 2019.
The IGJ will visit DHG unannounced to verify this as well.
De IGJ zal DHG onaangekondigd bezoeken om dit ook te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de voortgangsbrief van de TIB

An MP asked the ministers of Interior and Defence about the TIB's progress letter, including why the number of authorisation requests to the TIB is withheld, why this differs from publishing AIVD/MIVD wiretap statistics, the TIB's view on the hacking power, and the vulnerability of its membership. The ministers said they object only to publishing absolute figures now but accept an aggregated total in the TIB's annual report, and promised a supplementary-member provision in the law amendment.
The Minister of Defence and I are of the view that the absolute figures in the TIB's progress letter, given the short period it covers, give too much insight into this method of working.

De Minister van Defensie en ik zijn van oordeel dat de absolute getallen in de voortgangsbrief van de TIB, mede gelet op de korte periode waarop de voortgangsbrief betrekking heeft, teveel inzicht geeft in deze werkwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de registratie van incidenten met vuurwapens

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether firearms incidents are poorly recorded, whether the creation of the National Police has worsened this, and what concrete steps will curb firearms among schoolchildren. The minister acknowledged that firearms incidents are not easily retrievable in statistics, described an experimental free-text search model, and listed existing school checklists, police training, local campaigns and a planned amnesty, without committing to a specific new statistical or legislative change.
When a firearm was used in such a case, this is recorded in the free-text fields of the systems, but to date it cannot be easily retrieved when generating statistical data.
Als hierbij een vuurwapen is gebruikt, wordt dit wel in de vrije tekstvelden in de systemen vastgelegd, maar dit is tot op heden niet goed terug te vinden bij het genereren van statistische gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over lessen uit het Belgisch voetbalschandaal

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about lessons from the Belgian match-fixing scandal, including Dutch measures, links to other crime, the role of agents and international cooperation. The minister answered that a national match-fixing platform exists, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot, there are no concrete signals of spread to the Netherlands, and an in-depth study of agents is not planned though international cooperation continues.
To improve this, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot period.
Om hierin verbetering aan te brengen, wordt voor een pilotperiode van twee jaar een informatiecoördinator benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het onderzoek van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) naar medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the government whether WHO evidence on medicinal cannabis should change Dutch policy, including home cultivation for patients, and what position the Netherlands will take at the UN. The minister answered that home cultivation remains prohibited under the Opium Act, that only a contracted grower may supply quality-controlled medicinal cannabis, and that the Dutch position will depend on the WHO conclusions to be presented in December.
Cultivating cannabis under unconditioned conditions (such as home cultivation) will result in the composition and concentration of various substances in the end product varying continuously.

Het telen van cannabis onder ongeconditioneerde omstandigheden (zoals thuisteelt) zal tot gevolg hebben dat de samenstelling en concentratie van verschillende stoffen in het eindproduct steeds verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het groeiende drugsafvalprobleem

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the growing problem of drug waste dumping, including its cost, a possible link to repressive drug policy, and MDMA use and risks. The minister said he lacked data to confirm the waste figures, gave only partial cost data from a co-financing fund, cited CBS figures on MDMA users, and promised a letter from the health state secretary on normalisation of drug use in early 2019.
I do not have data to confirm these claims exactly.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens om deze stellingen exact te staven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over drugsfeest in Justitieel Complex Zaanstad

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about leaked footage of a drug party in JC Zaanstad prison, whether it was known in advance, and whether the planned closure of other prisons should be reconsidered. The Minister confirmed the footage, described searches and isolation of the seven inmates involved, and declined to reverse the closure decision, stating the prisons have a good detention climate.
This case was not previously known to me.
Dit geval was mij niet eerder bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de organisatie van cold case teams

MP Buitenweg asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether police units devote too little capacity and expertise to cold cases, whether dedicated teams should be centralised, and what professionalisation steps are planned. The Minister says capacity must be prioritised, opposes a national cold case team, and points to a cold case calendar and AI experiments as innovation.
I am not in favour of a national team for conducting criminal investigations into cold cases.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een landelijk team voor het uitvoeren van opsporingsonderzoeken naar cold cases.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Buitenweg en Groothuizen inzake het bericht ‘Het sluiten van woningen op grond van de Wet Damocles’

MPs Van Nispen, Buitenweg and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about closures of homes under article 13b of the Opium Act after a case where a tenant was evicted for 14 grams of cannabis. The minister said closure data are not centrally held, cited a study finding courts upheld appeals in 30% of published cases, noted a monitoring motion, and stated that closure is a measure to end violations rather than a punishment.
It is for the court to assess whether the mayor could reasonably use his closure power and, if so, whether the way the power was applied is proportionate.

Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de burgemeester in redelijkheid van zijn sluitingsbevoegdheid gebruik heeft kunnen maken en, zo ja, of de wijze waarop de bevoegdheid is toegepast evenredig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘bedrijven die DNA-materiaal van hun cliënten met anderen delen’

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether companies that obtain clients' DNA for ancestry research may share it with third parties such as pharmaceutical firms, and what remedies citizens have. The minister answered that such sharing requires explicit consent for a specific purpose, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority supervises compliance, and that existing information for citizens is sufficient, so no new measures are planned.
Only when a person gives explicit consent for the disclosure of their special (genetic) data to another company may that person's special personal data be shared.

Alleen wanneer een persoon uitdrukkelijke toestemming geeft voor het verstrekken van zijn of haar bijzondere (genetische) gegevens aan een ander bedrijf, mogen de bijzondere persoonsgegevens van deze persoon gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked whether sexual abuse by tantra massage practitioners persists and what authorities are doing about it, including reports, prosecutions, municipal permit requirements and enforcement. Minister Grapperhaus answered that sexual abuse is unacceptable, municipalities can enforce permit rules, a victim awareness campaign is planned, and provided limited figures while stating that specific data on prosecutions for tantra abuse is not registered.
Furthermore, I do not have information on the number of prosecutions or criminal sanctions, as cases of sexual abuse by tantra masseurs are not specifically registered.

Verder beschik ik niet over informatie ten aanzien van het aantal gevallen van vervolging of strafrechtelijke sancties aangezien er niet specifiek wordt geregistreerd op gevallen van seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Waarom help Nederland zijn meisjes niet’

MPs Özütok, Van Ojik and Buitenweg asked the Foreign Affairs and Legal Protection ministers why the Netherlands helps so few women and girls who are victims of forced marriage or abandonment abroad, why the ticket fund is little used, and how Norway compares. The minister's answer describes 38 reports in 2017, the handling of cases, the limited use of the ticket fund, and commits to reporting results of the forced marriage unit soon.
There is no national registration of victims of forced marriage and abandonment.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van slachtoffers van huwelijksdwang en achterlating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Toenemende agressie tegen gevangenispersoneel’

MPs Buitenweg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising aggression against prison staff, workload, and staffing norms in prisons. The minister acknowledged the reports, said staff stability and workload scores are unchanged, noted a fragile balance in staffing, and saw no need for additional measures given existing convenant-based investments.
In view of this, I currently see no need to take additional measures.
Gelet hierop zie ik op dit moment geen noodzaak aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over seksueel misbruik binnen de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen

Four MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether at least five victims had filed reports of sexual abuse within the Jehovah's Witnesses, whether these reports warrant further investigation, how police and prosecutors handle them, whether Jehovah's Witnesses can invoke the clergy testimony privilege, and whether internal instructions to store abuse allegations in sealed envelopes comply with the GDPR. The minister confirmed the reports, said an ongoing criminal investigation prevents further comment, stated the prosecution has nationwide oversight, said the testimony privilege belongs to individuals not organisations and will be considered in the review of extending the reporting duty, and referred the GDPR question to the independent Data Protection Authority.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation, which may result in prosecution and trial.
Er is sprake van lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat kan resulteren in vervolging en berechting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de oproep om voor meer beveiliging voor de familie van kroongetuigen te zorgen

MPs Buitenweg and Van Nispen asked whether the minister will heed a lawyer's call to strengthen protection of the family of crown witness Nabil B., and about the status of a motion on filling vacancies at the protection service. The minister declined to discuss case details or protection measures for security reasons, said crown witnesses are indispensable, and said additional measures are being taken to fill vacancies in the medium term.

As I also reported in my letter of 5 June following the debate on combating liquidation violence, and as is generally known to your House, I cannot go into the details of the case or into any security measures taken to protect persons.

5 juni naar aanleiding van het debat over de strijd tegen het liquidatiegeweld, en zoals in het algemeen bekend is bij uw Kamer, kan ik niet ingaan op de details van de casus noch op de eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen die worden genomen om personen te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Buitenweg over het overwegen van strafverzwarende omstandigheden bij geweld met een racistisch, antisemitisch of homofoob oogmerk

Two MPs (Segers and Buitenweg) asked the Justice Minister about treating discriminatory motives (racist, antisemitic, homophobic) as aggravating circumstances in criminal sentencing, including whether prosecutors can go above the statutory maximum, how often courts do so, and whether ECRI's advice to legislate for this will be followed. Minister Grapperhaus explained the Dutch system of general offences with CODIS sentencing uplifts of 50-100% requested by prosecutors, said data on court treatment is unavailable, and announced renewed review through a letter to parliament.
So far it has not been possible to answer this question.
Het is tot op heden niet mogelijk gebleken deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Gevaarlijk 'pedohandboek' al jaren op internet te vinden’

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked whether a 'paedophile handbook' circulating online can be prosecuted, and whether Dutch law should be changed, including what other countries do. The Minister of Justice answered that possessing or distributing texts from such a handbook can already be prosecuted under existing provisions, so no new legislation is needed, and promised a progress letter on online child sexual abuse in September.

Since it has not so far been shown that the aforementioned criminal provisions would be inadequate to act criminally against the making, possession and distribution of such handbooks, I see no reason to introduce new legislation.

Nu vooralsnog niet is gebleken dat de voormelde strafbepalingen ontoereikend zouden zijn om strafrechtelijk te kunnen optreden tegen het vervaardigen, voorhanden hebben en de verspreiding van dergelijke handboeken, zie ik voor de introductie van nieuwe wetgeving geen reden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Buitenweg over het horen van slachtoffers / getuigen in de strafzaak rond de Groningse gaswinning

MPs Van Tongeren and Buitenweg asked whether the investigating judge would hear witnesses and victims at their homes, in the presence of NAM's lawyers, in the criminal case on Groningen gas extraction, and how secondary victimisation could be avoided. The Minister answered that the suspect's counsel have a statutory right to attend, that the home-hearing request came from the witnesses themselves, that the Public Prosecution Service opposed it, and that the investigating judge had not yet authorised it, with each witness supported by a lawyer during questioning.
The Public Prosecution Service opposed hearing the witnesses on location.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft zich verzet tegen het horen van de getuigen op locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het schikkingsbeleid van het Openbaar Ministerie

MP Buitenweg asked the Justice Minister whether mega-settlements with companies such as SBM Offshore, Rabobank and KPMG, which avoid prosecution, should require prior judicial approval, and asked for details of the SBM settlement terms. The ministers answered that the OM has discretion to reopen cases on new facts, that appeal to the Court of Appeal under art. 12 Sv is already possible, and that the high-transaction procedure will be reviewed in the evaluation of the Wet OM-afdoening.

As I wrote to your House in response to the 2016 annual report of the Council for the Judiciary, interested parties can lodge a complaint with the Court of Appeal under article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Zoals ik uw Kamer in de reactie op het jaarverslag over 2016 van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak heb geschreven, kunnen belanghebbenden op grond van artikel 12 Sv. beklag doen bij het Gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over een hoge transactie of schikking

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a high settlement (transactie) and cost reimbursement the Public Prosecution Service paid to the widow of a criminal, who was herself suspected of money laundering, potentially avoiding prosecution. The Minister confirmed the payment, defended the settlement's legality, admitted insufficient public openness about the reimbursement, and said the PPS does not register settlements with cost reimbursements.
The PPS does not register settlements in which a cost reimbursement is also granted and therefore has indicated it cannot answer the question.
Het OM registreert niet op schikkingen waarbij tevens een onkostenvergoeding is toegekend en heeft derhalve aangegeven geen antwoord te kunnen geven op de vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de beveiliging van mevrouw El-Rhazoui

An MP asked the Minister whether the Dutch state should have provided protective security for Zineb el-Rhazoui, who was threatened and speaking at De Balie, and why the NCTV and police judged Dutch protection unnecessary. The government answered that the local authority took appropriate measures based on threat assessments, that the NCTV advised negatively on the bodyguards' firearm permits, and that the state will protect people's free speech when threats warrant it.
The local competent authority decided to take appropriate measures.
Het lokaal bevoegd gezag heeft besloten tot het treffen van passende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de beantwoorde vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de stijging van het aantal aangiften voor seksueel misbruik

Buitenweg (GreenLeft) asks whether the Minister accepts the 1-in-8 rape prevalence figure, what the 2017 Rutgers monitor on forced sex shows, and what measures will prevent sexual violence. The Minister says he is not aware of the 1-in-8 claim, cites newer Rutgers data (11% of women experienced forced intercourse), and points to existing prevention campaigns, the Soa/sexual health action plan and a planned consultation with the Centra Seksueel Geweld on a reporting campaign.
To examine how reporting willingness can be increased, consultation with the Centra Seksueel Geweld on a campaign to be set up will take place soon.
Om te bezien hoe die meldingsbereidheid kan worden bevorderd vindt binnenkort overleg plaats met de Centra Seksueel Geweld over een op te zetten campagne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Tongeren over door de politie afgelegde huisbezoeken aan aardbevingsdemonstranten

MPs Buitenweg and Van Tongeren asked whether police home visits to earthquake protesters before a minister's Groningen visit were lawful, proportionate and compatible with the right to demonstrate, and what will prevent repetition. The minister defended the visits as normal police information-gathering under mayoral responsibility, saw no reason to change the practice, and noted the Groningen mayor said phoning could have been used instead.
I therefore see no reason to change the police's approach on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over beveiligde GGZ-zorg

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about shortages of secured mental health care (beveiligde GGZ), time-out beds and suitable housing, and why zorgverzekeraars may be holding back budget. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortages, pointed to agreements to raise purchasing of secured care, a sector norm due April 2018, and housing initiatives, while attributing part of the gap to insurers' contracting and providers not claiming care.

My predecessor informed you in her letter of 13 July 2017 that agreement was reached with the parties involved to immediately increase the purchasing of secured mental health care for patients who display aggressive or dangerous behaviour.

Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in haar brief van 13 juli 2017 u medegedeeld dat met betrokken partijen de afspraak is gemaakt de inkoop van beveiligde ggz-zorg voor patiënten, die agressief of gevaarlijk gedrag vertonen, onmiddellijk te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kuiken over de opvang van vluchtelingen in Turkije op basis van de Turkijedeal

MPs Buitenweg and Kuiken asked whether Turkey's treatment of migrants returned from Greece under the EU-Turkey deal, as described in a VU report, meets refugee law obligations, and what follow-up is planned. The government rejects the report's conclusions, says all migrants can apply for asylum in Turkey and that only a small share of non-Syrians have applied, and it will not take new steps beyond existing EU monitoring and support.
The cabinet reaches different conclusions than the Vrije Universiteit study commissioned by VluchtelingenWerk Nederland.
Het kabinet komt tot andere conclusies dan het onderzoek van de Vrije Universiteit dat is opgesteld in opdracht van VluchtelingenWerk Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over de situatie van LHBTI-asielzoekers afkomstig uit Oekraïne

MP Buitenweg asks why the government did not respond to UNHCR's 2017 letter arguing Ukraine is unsafe for LGBTI asylum seekers, and whether practical safety and government protection were weighed in designating Ukraine a safe country of origin. The State Secretary maintains Ukraine's designation, citing multiple public sources and noting that individual asylum claims can still be granted, while promising to revisit safe-country assessments later.
The House of Representatives will also be informed of these reassessments.
Ook van deze herbeoordelingen zal de Tweede Kamer op de hoogte worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over een mogelijk uitgevaardigd arrestatiebevel tegen een naar Duitsland gevluchte voormalig hoofdredacteur van de Turkse krant Cumhuriyet

A GroenLinks MP asked whether an arrest warrant had been issued against Can Dündar, a former Cumhuriyet editor who fled to Germany, and how the Netherlands prevents abuse of INTERPOL and Turkish extradition requests. The Minister said no international arrest request was known, described the INTERPOL safeguards and Dutch case-by-case screening, declined to comment on a safe-conduct, and pointed to an EU-level initiative.
If there are indications that the person concerned will not be extradited by the Netherlands, the request is not registered and the person can enter and leave the Netherlands unhindered.

constaterende dat enkelglas een warmtelek van jewelste is en tot een onnodig hoge energierekening en energieverspilling leidt
Motie van de leden Ceder en Bontenbal over mediawijsheid voor opvoeders onderdeel maken van de werkagenda en het Programma Digitale Samenleving
Asks the government to make media literacy for parents an explicit part of the work agenda and the Digital Society Programme.
requests the government to make media literacy for parents explicitly part of the work agenda
verzoekt de regering mediawijsheid voor opvoeders expliciet onderdeel te maken van de werkagenda
Motie van het lid Bontenbal c.s. over een adviesaanvraag uitwerken voor de WRR over de sociaal-maatschappelijke impact van nieuwe digitale technologieën
Asks the government to prepare an advisory request to the WRR on the long-term socio-cultural impact of new digital technologies.
requests the government to prepare an advisory request to the WRR centred on the socio-cultural impact of new digital technologies
verzoekt de regering een adviesaanvraag uit te werken voor de WRR waarin de vraag centraal staat wat de sociaal-maatschappelijke impact is van nieuwe digitale technologieën
Motie van het lid Rajkowski c.s. over een ministeriële regeling veiligheid en integriteit voor de volledige Nederlandse vitale infrastructuur
Asks the government to make a ministerial regulation on security and integrity for all vital Dutch infrastructure against digital threats.
requests the government to make a ministerial regulation on security and integrity for the full Dutch vital infrastructure
verzoekt de regering een ministeriële regeling veiligheid en integriteit te maken voor de volledige Nederlandse vitale infrastructuur
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over een advies van de Regeringscommissaris Informatiehuishouding over het gebruik van communicatiekanalen in relatie tot archief- en openbaarheidswetgeving
Motion asking the government to have the Government Information Commissioner advise on communication channels and archiving, and tighten guidelines for ministers.
requests the government to have the Government Commissioner for Information Management issue advice on use of communication channels in relation to archive and disclosure law
verzoekt de regering de regeringscommissaris Informatiehuishouding advies uit te laten brengen over het gebruik van communicatiekanalen in relatie tot archief- en openbaarheidswetgeving
Motie van het lid Ellian c.s. over een uniforme werkwijze voor bewindspersonen voor het archiveren van communicatie
Asks the government to create a uniform, controlled procedure for ministers archiving communications such as text and app messages.
requests the government to establish a uniform method for ministers regarding archiving communications such as text and app messages, and to realise more control and safeguards in that method

verzoekt de regering om een uniforme werkwijze te realiseren voor bewindspersonen ter zake van het archiveren van communicatie, zoals sms- en appberichten, en meer controle en waarborgen in die werkwijze te realiseren
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over ervaringen rond huidige geothermieprojecten meenemen bij nieuwe projecten
Asks the government to take into account experiences of residents, municipalities and provinces with existing geothermal projects in evaluating new ones.
requests the government to include the experiences of residents, municipalities and provinces in developing and evaluating new geothermal projects
verzoekt de regering de ervaringen van omwonenden, gemeenten en provincies mee te nemen in de uitwerking en de evaluatie van nieuwe geothermieprojecten
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over ervoor zorgdragen dat wél duurzame warmteprojecten worden beschikt in de SDE++-ronde van 2022
Asks the government to ensure that sustainable heat projects are awarded subsidies in the 2022 SDE++ round, with an extra autumn round if needed.
requests the government to prevent 2022 from becoming a lost year for sustainable heat projects
verzoekt de regering te voorkomen dat 2022 een verloren jaar wordt voor duurzame warmteprojecten
Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over de haalbaarheid van lithiumwinning bij diepe geothermie onderzoeken
Asks the government to study the feasibility of lithium extraction from geothermal water in the Netherlands, including ecological, economic and legal aspects.
requests the government to study the feasibility of lithium extraction from deep geothermal in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering de haalbaarheid van lithiumwinning bij diepe geothermie in Nederland te onderzoeken
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een aangepast en opgeschaald nationaal isolatieprogramma
Motion asking the government to present an enlarged national insulation programme before the summer recess, focused first on regions with the most energy poverty.
requests the government to come well before the summer recess with an adjusted and scaled-up national insulation programme
verzoekt de regering om ruim voor het zomerreces met een aangepast en opgeschaald nationaal isolatieprogramma te komen
Amendement van het lid Boucke c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over verhoging van het budget voor de subsidieregeling coöperatieve energieopwekking
Increases the budget for the cooperative renewable energy generation subsidy scheme, a spending decision without changes to executive checks.
This amendment increases the commitment amount for the SCE scheme by 113 million euros
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag voor de SCE-regeling met 113 miljoen euro

Motie van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over het voorbereiden van meerdere planfases en mogelijke mitigatiemaatregelen voor inpassing van een buisleidingencorridor tussen de haven van Rotterdam en Chem
Asks the government to prepare a programme organisation and mitigation measures for a pipeline corridor between Rotterdam port and Chemelot while final decisions are pending.
requests the government, pending final decision-making and in consultation with provinces and municipalities, to already work on a programme organisation
verzoekt de regering in afwachting van definitieve besluitvorming in overleg met provincies en gemeenten alvast te werken aan een programmaorganisatie
Motie van het lid Bontenbal c.s. over een structureel overleg tussen het Rijk en het platform Groeiagenda Zuid-Holland
Asks the government to organise a structural consultation between the national government and the Groeiagenda Zuid-Holland platform.
requests the government to organise a structural consultation between the Rijk and the Groeiagenda Zuid-Holland platform
verzoekt de regering een structureel overleg te organiseren tussen het Rijk en het platform Groeiagenda Zuid-Holland
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over een analyse van de effectiviteit van initiatieven om personeelstekorten in de technieksector op te lossen
Asks the government to analyse the effectiveness of initiatives addressing technical staff shortages and to report to the House, as a basis for an action plan.
to make an analysis of the effectiveness of these initiatives and to examine where additions are needed
een analyse te maken van de effectiviteit van deze initiatieven en te onderzoeken waar aanvullingen nodig zijn
Motie van het lid Boucke c.s. over ruimte voor marktpartijen om de problemen op het elektriciteitsnet op te lossen
Asks the government to investigate whether market parties can be allowed to resolve electricity grid congestion under a right-to-challenge principle.
requests the government to examine whether there is room in laws and regulations for market parties to resolve the grid problems
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er ruimte is in wet- en regelgeving om marktpartijen de problemen op het elektriciteitsnet op te laten lossen
Motie van het lid Erkens c.s. over onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de marktordening voor de waterstofketen
Asks the government to involve external experts in a study of the planned market design for hydrogen and to inform the House in spring 2022.
requests the government to inform the House in spring 2022 about the planned market design for the hydrogen chain
verzoekt de regering om de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2022 te informeren over de beoogde marktordening voor de waterstofketen
Amendement van het lid Boucke c.s. over verhoging van het budget voor de subsidieregeling coöperatieve energieopwekking
Increases the budget commitments and cash appropriations for the cooperative renewable energy subsidy scheme in 2022, funded from an unspent climate reserve.
This amendment raises the commitment amount for the SCE scheme by 113 million euros and the cash budget by 32 million euros.
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag voor de SCE-regeling met 113 miljoen euro en het kasbudget met 32 miljoen euro.
Motie van het lid Boucke c.s. over voor het eind van het jaar een aanvullend ontwerp Programma Noordzee 2022-2027 ter inzage leggen
Motion asks the government to put a supplementary draft North Sea Programme out for public inspection by year end and start offshore grid permit procedures.
requests the government to put a supplementary draft North Sea Programme 2022-2027 out for inspection before the end of the year
verzoekt de regering voor het eind van het jaar een aanvullend ontwerp Programma Noordzee 2022–2027 ter inzage te leggen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 20 over het verkorten van de evaluatietermijn en bijzondere aandacht voor Europese klimaatontwikkelingen
Shortens the evaluation period of the minimum CO2 price electricity law from five to three years, with attention to European climate developments.
In article IV, 'five years' is replaced by 'three years'
In artikel IV wordt «vijf jaar» vervangen door «drie jaar»
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het verkorten van de evaluatietermijn en bijzondere aandacht voor Europese klimaatontwikkelingen
Amendment shortens the evaluation deadline for the minimum CO2 price law from five to three years and adds attention to European climate policy developments.
In article IV, 'five' is replaced by 'three'
In artikel IV wordt «vijf» vervangen door «drie»
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het bericht 'Woningbouw in gevaar door nieuwe regels netcongestie'

Two CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Climate and Green Growth and of Housing about press reports that new grid-congestion priority rules could endanger housing construction, and about the four municipalities' warnings. The minister answered that the ACM will publish a new priority framework by 1 January 2026 keeping housing priority, that interim rules apply until 1 July 2026 with gradual release of reserved capacity, and that municipalities and provinces will be involved in further talks.
As mentioned in the annex 'progress grid congestion policy' to the parliamentary letter of 6 October, grid operators currently reserve capacity for connecting all (future) small consumers.

Zoals genoemd in de bijlage «voortgang beleid netcongestie» bij de Kamerbrief voortgang netcongestie van 6 oktober 4 , reserveren de netbeheerders momenteel capaciteit voor het aansluiten van alle (toekomstige) kleinverbruikers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de verlening van subsidie door een gemeente aan een lokale welzijnsorganisatie

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior about a Council of State ruling requiring municipalities to offer competition or justify single-bidder grants when subsidies are scarce, and about its consequences for local governance, bureaucracy and social-sector organisations. The minister answered that the ruling formalises subsidy allocation and adds transparency and work, that legislative change is not currently needed, and that signals of problems for small local organisations will be checked.
I have not yet received signals that the ruling leads to unworkable situations, but I will have this verified with municipalities.
Ik heb vooralsnog geen signalen ontvangen dat de uitspraak tot onwerkbare situaties leidt, maar ik laat dat verifiëren bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de uitbreiding van het hoogspanningsnet in Gelderland, Utrecht en de Flevopolder met jaren is vertraagd

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked why the Utrecht/Gelderland/Flevopolder high-voltage grid expansion has been delayed to 2033 or later, and about acceleration options such as location choice, expropriation, a new Raad van State chamber and taking over competence. Minister Hermans attributes the delay to a complex site, land acquisition and technical problems, outlines the Versnellingspakket measures, and explains why Rijk takeover would currently slow the decision, while committing to a location choice after the summer.
A takeover of the competent authority by the central government could delay the location choice by several months, because the project is already far advanced.
Het overnemen van het bevoegd gezag door het Rijk kan de locatiekeuze met enkele maanden vertragen, doordat het project al ver gevorderd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het bericht dat Amerikaanse experts geheime communicatieapparatuur hebben aangetroffen in Chinese zonne-omvormers

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that rogue communication devices were found in Chinese solar inverters, and about risks to the grid, AIVD's role, EU measures, inverter numbers in the Netherlands, detection controls and follow-up to a 2023 RDI report. The government answered that the report is based on anonymous sources and cannot be verified, outlined existing and forthcoming EU and Dutch cybersecurity rules enforced by the RDI, and described ongoing industrial and supervisory initiatives.
The cited article states that secret components have been installed in solar panel inverters, allowing China to switch inverters on and off remotely and change settings.
In het aangehaalde artikel staat dat er geheime componenten in omvormers voor zonnepanelen zijn aangebracht, waarmee China op afstand omvormers aan en uit kan schakelen en instellingen kan aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het tegengaan van buitenlandse beïnvloeding bij de verkiezingen

CDA MPs asked the ministers how Dutch elections can be protected against foreign online disinformation campaigns, including the risks, existing measures, the DSA, Sweden's psychological defence agency and a public awareness campaign. The minister answered that the government is taking coordinated measures, is preparing new powers and legal bases for later elections, and will commission studies, but noted that the new powers will not be introduced before the 2025 elections.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Krul en Boswijk over het bericht “Wake-up call: Microsoft sluit e-mail ICC zonder pardon af”

Three CDA MPs asked whether Microsoft cut off the ICC prosecutor's email on US orders, what the government is doing to restore access and protect the court, and whether dependence on US digital services undermines democratic institutions. The minister declined to confirm the reported cut-off, condemned the sanctions, said talks with the US and business are ongoing, and stated that digital dependence is a policy issue being addressed through a planned digital autonomy vision rather than an acute threat to democracy.
It is not for the cabinet to confirm or deny reporting on the implementation of sanctions imposed by other states.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om berichtgeving over de implementatie van sancties die door andere staten zijn opgelegd te bevestigen of te ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat miljoenen zonnepaneelhouders ook na het vervallen van de wettelijke salderingsregeling in 2027 recht blijven hebben op salderen

An MP asked the minister whether consumers keep a contractual right to net metering (salderen) after the statutory scheme ends in 2027, and how this relates to a court ruling and consumer protection. The minister answered that the statutory duty ends on 1 January 2027, that the private contractual position is for the parties and courts to decide, and that the government urges suppliers to communicate clearly with customers.
That is up to the contracting parties, because it is an arrangement that forms part of the contract between the supplier and the end user.
Dat is aan de contractpartijen, omdat het een afspraak betreft die onderdeel vormt van de overeenkomst tussen de leverancier en de eindafnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Vedder over de toepassing van module D in product-LCA’s voor milieuprestaties van bouwproducten

MPs Bontenbal and Vedder asked the housing minister whether the use of module D in product LCAs distorts building product environmental performance scores, punishing frontrunners and reducing incentives for direct decarbonisation. The minister acknowledged the criticism, announced an evaluation of module D, disagreed in part with the analysis and said adjustments would depend on that evaluation and on building costs and housing targets.
At present I am preparing an evaluation of module D. I will share its outcomes with your House.
Op dit moment bereid ik een evaluatie van module D voor. De uitkomsten daarvan zal ik met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de CO2-heffing

Conservative MP Bontenbal asked the minister how the government will implement the motion to remove national taxes ('koppen') and what this means for the national CO2 levy on industry, given a study finding unilateral levies mainly cause leakage and questioning the post-2030 price path. The minister replies that the levy is retained as a 'stick behind the door', the reduction target shifts from 2030 to 2032, the rate rises to 216 euro/ton by 2035, and the government will consult industry and propose alternatives with PBL advice.
The cabinet will discuss this with industry and other stakeholders.
Het kabinet gaat hierover in gesprek met de industrie en andere stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de CO2-heffing en het verduurzamen van de Nederlandse industrie

Deputy MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the pace of industrial decarbonisation, the expected yield of the CO2 levy, the risk of carbon leakage and the treatment of cluster 6 firms. The minister answered that emissions fell with production cuts and that the levy yield of around 291 million euro is outdated, with a new estimate to follow with the bill on Prinsjesdag.
A new estimate will form part of the bill on the CO2 levy for industry to be presented on Budget Day (Prinsjesdag).
Een nieuwe raming zal onderdeel uitmaken van het wetsvoorstel voor de CO 2 -heffing industrie dat wordt gepresenteerd met Prinsjesdag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de kosten van de energie-infrastructuur

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how fully options to reduce the projected 219 billion euro grid investment need to 2040 have been explored, whether the NPE constrains the IBO, and questions the robustness of the FIEN+ and IBO analyses including the role of nuclear energy, offshore wind costs, heat pumps and grid-tariff measures. The Minister responds that the IBO tested sensitivities, that a public knowledge programme and a later NPE update in 2026 are planned, that a dedicated nuclear systems study is due in autumn, and that grid-tariff reforms are being pursued, while noting ACM holds exclusive tariff powers.
In the cabinet's response to the IBO, the cabinet has announced a targeted public knowledge programme.
In de kabinetsreactie op het IBO heeft het kabinet dan ook aangekondigd een gericht publiek kennisprogramma op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over hervorming van de Europese elektriciteitsmarkt en het oprichten van een e-faciliteit

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about an EESC proposal for a state-created e-facility acting as a market maker in electricity, and about EU coordination and market reform. The minister answered that the cabinet opposes creating such a facility, judging the current market model adequate and the proposal risky, while supporting EU coordination and planned capacity-mechanism policy.
The cabinet therefore sees, given the currently well-functioning European electricity market and the intervention options already available to it, no reason to establish an e-facility.

Het kabinet ziet daarom, in de context van de huidige goed functionerende Europese elektriciteitsmarkt en de interventiemogelijkheden die het kabinet op dit moment al tot zijn beschikking heeft, geen reden tot het oprichten van een e-faciliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie overweegt om gebruik te maken van internationale koolstofkredieten voor de invulling van het Europese klimaatdoel voor 2040

Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister whether the EU's consideration of international carbon credits for its 2040 climate target is a missed opportunity, and whether the Dutch Climate Act would need changing to allow such credits. The minister opposes using foreign credits for the existing 2030 and 2050 targets, critically approaches a possible EU proposal for 2040, and says a change to the EU and possibly Dutch climate law would be needed.
The cabinet awaits the European Commission's proposal before taking a position and will share its negotiating stance with you as usual through the BNC procedure.
Het kabinet wacht voor een standpunt hierover het voorstel van de Europese Commissie af en zal de inzet zoals gebruikelijk met u delen aan de hand van de BNC-procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over de voorgenomen ontslagrondes bij UNHCR en IOM

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked the minister about planned job cuts at UNHCR and IOM caused by US funding reductions, and about the impact on refugees and possible Dutch or EU responses. The minister confirmed the cuts and the US role as largest donor, gave 2024 Dutch contributions, expressed concern, but said the Netherlands cannot restore US funding, that it faces its own budget cuts, and that EU options are still being examined.
For 2025 these amounts are not yet known.
Voor 2025 zijn deze bedragen nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het mogelijk maken van meer aansluitingen op het laagspanningsnet door een flexibele backstop

Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a flexible backstop that would curtail grid-intensive devices during overload, allowing more low-voltage connections, and about Germany's comparable system and next steps. Minister Hermans answered that the government is exploring this 'netbescherming' technically and legally with grid operators, will report by year-end, and will consider it in requirements for grid-intensive devices, without committing to a decision.
The cabinet will inform the House at year-end about the outcomes of this exploration.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer einde jaar informeren over de uitkomsten van deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het behoud en de verduurzaming van de Nederlandse industrie

An MP from the CDA asks how the government responds to industry calls and the EU Clean Industrial Deal for relief, including lower energy taxes, the revenue and effects of the CO2 levy on industry, expected ETS and other revenues, subsidy support, and the risk of industrial decline. The minister answers that the government supports EU energy tax reform and an ETS-aware approach, will evaluate the CO2 levy later this year, and shares revenue and subsidy figures, but declines to model the tax loss from industrial shrinkage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de meest recente cijfers over de asielinstroom en asielketen

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration for the latest asylum inflow figures, EU comparisons, IND processing times, return rates, COA occupancy by status holders, and the effect of the fall of the Assad regime on Syrian inflow. The minister provides the figures, acknowledges the IND backlog and long waiting times, notes return numbers rose modestly, and promises the Raad van State advice will be addressed with the bills soon.
It is still too early to make statements about the effect of the fall of the Assad regime on Syrian asylum inflow to the Netherlands.
Het is nog te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over het effect van de val van het regime van Assad op de Syrische asielinstroom in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de stijgende kosten voor duurzame warmteopwekking met vloeibare biomassa

An MP asked the minister about rising excise duties on heavy fuel oil that have made liquid-biomass heat installations under SDE++ subsidy unprofitable, and whether the subsidy calculation will account for this. The minister acknowledged the problem for existing projects, said the subsidy basis cannot be adjusted, and offered affected firms the option to withdraw and re-apply in the 2025 round.
It is not possible to adjust the base amount for existing decisions because it is fixed in regulations.
Het is niet mogelijk om het basisbedrag voor de bestaande beschikkingen aan te passen omdat dit vastligt in regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Grinwis over internationale koolstofmarkten

MPs Bontenbal and Grinwis asked the minister what COP29 agreed on Article 6 carbon market standards, how these make climate action cheaper, when the PACM becomes operational, how companies and Dutch government could use PACM and ITMOs. The minister answered that standards for Article 6.4 credits were adopted, first credits expected mid-2025, companies can buy credits, and the Netherlands does not currently intend to use Article 6 credits for its own targets.
The cabinet is therefore currently not intending to use the options that Article 6 offers.
Het kabinet is daarom momenteel niet voornemens om gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheden die artikel 6 biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over geothermiebronnen en het maatschappelijk prioriteringskader netcongestie

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked whether geothermal heat sources, which reduce electricity demand for heating, should be given priority under the ACM's grid congestion prioritisation framework, and why ACM has not classified them as congestion mitigators or basic needs. Minister Hermans answers that geothermal supply reduces electricity demand and that heat networks get priority as basic needs, while geothermal connections are not direct congestion relievers; the government says the ACM is responsible for the framework and will raise the point in its planned evaluation.
It is up to the ACM to adapt the prioritisation framework.
Het is dus aan de ACM om het prioriteringskader aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de opschaling van groene, blauwe en andere koolstofarme waterstof in Nederland

Two MPs (Erkens, VVD, and Bontenbal, CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about scaling up blue, green and other low-carbon hydrogen, including infrastructure, the REDIII industry obligation, Norwegian import contracts, nuclear-based hydrogen and cost competitiveness. The minister answered that hydrogen policy is largely technology-neutral, that the government is exploring barriers for low-carbon hydrogen, and that the industry quota and a demand subsidy are still being designed, with several points deferred to a later letter and studies.
The cabinet will also examine whether and how companies can be facilitated in jointly purchasing low-carbon and renewable hydrogen.
Het kabinet zal daarnaast onderzoeken of en hoe bedrijven gefaciliteerd kunnen worden bij het gezamenlijk inkopen van koolstofarme en hernieuwbare waterstof
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Vermeer, Bontenbal, Postma en Beckerman over de misleidende praktijken van energieleverancier Hollandse Energie Maatschappij (HEM)

MPs from several parties asked the minister about misleading and intimidating practices by energy supplier HEM, what consumer protection and enforcement tools exist, and whether firms like HEM can be barred from supplying energy. The minister said the Energy Act will give the ACM stronger powers (integrity screening, supply stops, licence revocation), noted bailiff-threat issues fall under the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and answered all ten questions in turn.
In the Energy Act, the ACM is given sufficient new tools to act firmly when it deems this necessary.
In de Energiewet krijgt de ACM voldoende nieuwe handvatten om stevig op te treden als zij dat nodig acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Erkens, Vermeer en Grinwis over de overstap van de industrie naar groene waterstof en de raffinageroute

Four MPs asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the proposed 0.4 correction factor for the refinery route for green hydrogen, which they feared would undermine hydrogen investment and rely on uncertain market assumptions. The minister defended the correction factor as a balance between CO2 reduction, pump prices and hydrogen stimulation, acknowledged investment risks and committed to a study under a parliamentary motion on the refinery route's impact.

After the parliamentary questions were asked, the House adopted the motion by MPs Bontenbal and Vermeer calling for a study into how the refinery route should be designed to contribute maximally to the industry's sustainability goals.

Na het stellen van Kamervragen heeft de Kamer de motie van de leden Bontenbal en Vermeer aangenomen over een onderzoek naar hoe de raffinageroute eruit moet zien om maximaal bij te dragen aan de verduurzamingsdoelstellingen van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bontenbal over het potentiële valmeerproject bij de Haringvlietmonding

MPs Grinwis and Bontenbal asked the government about the proposed Delta21 valmeer (storage reservoir) at the Haringvliet mouth, its energy value, flood safety, ecological impact, strategic autonomy, and whether it should be included in the grid security plan and a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answers that the project has potential value as large-scale electricity storage but faces large uncertainties and ecological drawbacks, and commits to a broader cost-benefit comparison of flexibility options and an update of the energy storage roadmap.

As promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (7 November 2024), the cabinet is willing to map the pros and cons of a valmeer project for the energy system, including a comparison with other flexibility applications.

Zoals is toegezegd tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (7 november 2024) is het kabinet bereid om in kaart te brengen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van een valmeerproject voor het energiesysteem, inclusief een vergelijking met andere flexibiliteitstoepassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over verschillende vormen van woonegoïsme

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about residents who file objections or appeals against housing projects to extract buyouts, and about procedural delays in housing construction. The minister condemned appeals made purely for financial gain but said it cannot be measured, defended the right to appeal, and pointed to the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting to speed up housing-project litigation through single-instance appeal.
It is not possible to determine how many objections and appeals have been withdrawn in recent years on such suspicion.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel bezwaar- en beroepschriften de afgelopen jaren vanwege een dergelijk vermoeden zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over ETS2

An MP from the CDA asks the Climate and Growth minister and the State Secretary of Finance about the expected costs and revenues of the EU ETS-2 carbon pricing for households and businesses, including the Social Climate Fund, compensation options and fairness of the burden. The minister answers that the government expects ETS-2 revenues to flow into general funds, rejects cutting energy tax and excise as compensation given the climate targets, and states that costs are estimated and kept under review.
Dutch budget policy is based on the principle of separating revenues and expenditures.
Het Nederlandse begrotingsbeleid is gebaseerd op het principe van scheiding van inkomsten en uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked whether the Monitor Leveringszekerheid 2024 shows electricity supply reliability problems by 2033 due to falling dispatchable capacity, and what the government will do before the costs of action rise. The minister confirms the projected 2033 shortfall, calls it an early warning rather than a certainty, and promises a letter by year-end on options including a strategic reserve, without a concrete timetable.
I will inform the House about this at the end of this year.
Hierover zal ik de Kamer eind dit jaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over het bericht «Bureaucratie binnen de Rijksoverheid uitgegroeid tot zeldzame proporties»

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked about reports that over half of ministry staff work in overhead, its causes, Woo workload, and cost-cutting goals. The minister estimates overhead at 45-50 percent, admits no reliable per-ministry figures, promises a Woo workload study and a bureaucracy-reduction agenda, but gives no concrete targets yet.
I do not have reliable figures per ministry.
Over betrouwbare cijfers per ministerie beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontebal over het bericht ‘Starmer begint zijn ‘reset’ met EU, Brexiteers vrezen dat hij het VK er weer ‘in rommelt’

An MP from the CDA asked the government whether it would take similar initiatives to intensify bilateral cooperation with the United Kingdom after Starmer's planned bilateral treaty with Germany and France, and whether it would invite Starmer to visit. The government welcomed renewed UK engagement with the EU, listed existing bilateral frameworks and defence and science cooperation, and said it was open to intensifying relations without announcing new concrete initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Grinwis over het tariefsysteem voor de kosten van het elektriciteitsnet voor kleinverbruikers

MPs Bontenbal and Grinwis asked the minister about Flemish and Walloon time-based grid tariffs for small consumers and whether the Dutch flat-capacity tariff is fair. The minister said network operators will publish an alternative tariff study this autumn, that the ACM decides on tariffs, and that a proposal will be sent to parliament before the 28 November debate.

After Netbeheer Nederland publishes the study on an alternative grid tariff for small consumers, I will share my appreciation of it with your House ahead of the Electricity Grid, Energy Infrastructure & RES committee debate on 28 November.

Na publicatie door Netbeheer Nederland van het onderzoek naar een alternatief nettarief voor kleinverbruikers zal ik mijn appreciatie daarvan met uw Kamer delen, voorafgaand aan het Commissiedebat Elektriciteitsnet, Energie-infrastructuur & RES op 28 november a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het toewijzen van sociale huurwoningen aan statushouders

An MP from the CDA asks the ministers whether municipalities must house refugee status holders, whether priority allocation of social housing to them is being abolished, and what the consequences of banning such priority would be for asylum flow, dispersal and costs. The government confirms the statutory housing quota and gives the half-year figures, but says the share of social housing allocated to status holders is not tracked nationally, and defers the substance of the priority ban and its consequences until the coalition programme is further elaborated.
Currently it is not possible to provide insight into the percentage of social rental homes allocated to status holders over the past five years, because this is not tracked nationally.
Momenteel is het niet mogelijk om inzicht te bieden in het percentage sociale huurwoningen dat de afgelopen vijf jaar is toegewezen aan statushouders, omdat dit niet landelijk wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over het bericht ‘Energiereus Engie vreest tekort aan stroom in Nederland: ’Binnen vijf jaar al gebrek’’

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about Engie's warning of a near-term electricity shortage, including capacity changes, a capacity mechanism and possible gas plant guarantees. The Minister answered that the latest monitoring shows no security-of-supply risk until 2030, that no capacity mechanism is needed yet, and that options will be explored and reported to parliament by year-end.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk, Paternotte en Rooderkerk over de stijgende invoer van Russisch gas

MPs asked whether EU imports of Russian gas are rising, whether this creates dependence and vulnerability, whether cheap Russian gas undermines alternatives, and what measures the EU could take. The minister acknowledged a slight rise in early 2024 but said Russian shares have fallen sharply since 2021, outlined EU phase-out steps and Dutch proposals for a roadmap, while declining to provide a list of affected projects because the government lacks access to market parties' data.
Such an overview cannot be provided, because the Dutch government has no insight into the projects of market parties and their economic feasibility.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven, omdat de Nederlandse overheid geen inzage heeft in de projecten van marktpartijen en de economische haalbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de kosten voor het transport van elektriciteit naar Duitsland

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the costs of deep landfall of offshore wind power and the Delta Rhine Corridor cables, including whether costs fall on Dutch consumers, and whether cost-sharing with Germany is being negotiated. The Minister answered that costs currently pass through network tariffs, that the DRC investment decision and cost allocation with Germany remain open, and that cost-sharing is being pursued through EU and North Seas Energy Cooperation channels.
I do not foresee that the decision-making process on the DRC will be jeopardised if no satisfactory agreements on cost allocation can be reached with Germany.
Ik voorzie niet dat het besluitvormingstraject over de DRC in gevaar komt als er geen bevredigende afspraken kunnen worden gemaakt over de verdeling van kosten met Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de nieuwe elektrische boiler bij de elektriciteitscentrale van Vattenfall in Diemen ongebruikt blijft vanwege de hoge netwerkkosten

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about reports that Vattenfall's new electric boiler at Diemen stays unused because of high grid costs, including the cost increase, savings potential, and possible support schemes. Minister Hermans answered substantively on all nine questions, acknowledging the rent-driven cost rise and outlining SDE++ options, new grid contracts and an ongoing policy review.
I am currently exploring the possibilities for a category in the SDE++ that would only compensate the operational costs of an e-boiler.
Ik verken momenteel de mogelijkheden voor een categorie in de SDE++ waarin alleen de operationele kosten van een e-boiler worden vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de kabinetsreactie op de invoeringstoets op de Wet open overheid (Woo)

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked about the government's response to the Woo implementation review, including unknown FTE capacity for handling Woo requests, a cost study, and anti-misuse measures. The minister agreed to a study of implementation costs and capacity expected in Q1 2025, but deferred decisions on a benefit-cost weighing and legal changes until that study is complete.
For this reason, a study into the concrete implementation burdens, costs and (required) capacity for handling Woo requests is also being carried out.
Mede om die reden wordt ook het onderzoek naar de concrete uitvoeringslasten, kosten en (benodigde) capaciteit voor de afhandeling van Woo-verzoeken uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het artikel ‘Russia plotting sabotage across Europe, intelligence agencies warn’

Two CDA MPs asked the government about warnings from European intelligence services of a growing Russian threat of violent sabotage, including to North Sea infrastructure, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The government answered that it shares the concern, points to the North Sea infrastructure protection action plan and the national response framework, and says EU cooperation is being strengthened, while declining to detail the services' current knowledge of targets.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy, the working methods and current knowledge level of the services are not discussed publicly.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding wordt er in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze dan wel het actuele kennisniveau van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk  over het artikel 'Netbeheerders kunnen weinig met prioriteit voor Brainport'

CDA MPs asked whether the minister knew of reports that grid operators could do little with the government's promised priority for the Brainport region, why the November 2023 letter seemed to surprise them, and what the grid response would be. The minister answered that the priority concerns congestion instruments and the regional energy infrastructure plan (MIEK), not individual connection priority which is set by the regulator ACM, and described short-, medium- and long-term actions with TenneT, Enexis and the region.
The priority status of Brainport is not intended to mean that connecting individual companies on the waiting list in the region would automatically get higher priority than in other regions.

Met de prioritaire status van Brainport is niet bedoeld dat het aansluiten van individuele bedrijven die op de wachtlijst staan in de regio per definitie een hogere prioriteit zou krijgen dan in andere regio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat honderd oudere Surinamers een verblijfsstatus aanvragen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the government would grant legal status to undocumented older Surinamese born before 1975 via the former-Dutch-national route, and how the criteria for such a scheme would work. The State Secretary explained the strict legal conditions for re-admission of former Dutch nationals, said a scheme had been explored with Amsterdam and NGOs but was not pursued after the cabinet fell, and declined to reopen it while the cabinet is caretaker.
Given the caretaker status of the cabinet, I see no possibilities for this.
Gelet op de demissionaire status van het kabinet zie ik hiertoe geen mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de voortgang van de Delta Rhine Corridor

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked about the progress, investment timing, realisation deadline, the absence of an LPG/propylene pipeline initiator, and next steps with Germany on the Delta Rhine Corridor.
