The minister answered that the government supports and coordinates spatial planning and permits while investment decisions rest with private initiators, that no LPG/propylene initiator emerged, and that a letter on schedule effects will follow before summer.
I will inform the House before the summer of this year with a letter on the effect of this exercise on the project's planning.
Ik informeer uw Kamer voor de zomer van dit jaar met een brief over het effect van deze exercitie op de planning van het project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over congestiemanagement op het elektriciteitsnet

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about grid congestion management, including whether network operators can refuse bids for congestion services and how standard terms and prices should be set. The minister answered that network operators may refuse bids only when the requested fee exceeds what is customary in the market, that a standard price formula agreed with Energie Samen and Holland Solar was approved by the ACM, and that a government information webpage is planned.
It is up to the network operator to justify a refusal.
Het is aan de netbeheerder om een weigering te onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over Integratie van de Europese elektriciteitsmarkten

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about a Bruegel article on deeper integration of EU electricity markets, covering its benefits, the risk of fragmentation, strategic autonomy, the need for a clear vision, and the costs of not integrating. The Minister broadly endorses the article's conclusions, stresses that integration is also a political question, states the cabinet's consistent support for integration, and declines to commission new cost-benefit studies, citing existing EU research.

Given the large number of studies on the returns and positive welfare effects of further market integration, the cabinet sees no reason to further map out the implications of further market integration.

Gezien de grote hoeveelheid studies over de opbrengsten en positieve welvaartseffecten van verdere marktintegratie ziet het kabinet geen reden om de implicaties van verdere marktintegratie nader in beeld te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van het leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Koekkoek over de berichten 'Steeds meer arbeidsmigranten op straat: 'De opvang moet humaner'', 'Een half miljoen arbeidsmigranten: uitbuiting en maatschappelij

MPs from CDA and Volt asked the ministers about media reports on homeless EU labour migrants, including causes, the BRP temporary address registration, the legal-entitlement tool for municipalities, language barriers and WW benefits, and measures against exploitation. The government answered that the numbers are uncertain and being monitored via a new census, that causes are varied and mostly personal, that a legal tool and a short-stay pilot are underway, and that existing measures such as the agency-licensing bill and the labour-market reform are the route forward.
The cabinet recognises the signals that the legal reality regarding the rights of EU citizens is complex.
Het kabinet herkent de signalen dat de juridische werkelijkheid ten aanzien van de rechten van EU-burgers complex is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) de hoogte van terugleverkosten bij zonnepanelen onderzoekt

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the ACM investigating feed-in charges for households with solar panels, whether suppliers may charge them, how many do, and what consumers can do. The minister answered that such charges are not banned but must be reasonable and transparent, that the ACM is monitoring them with a follow-up study due in April, and that consumers are protected by 30-day notice, free switching and a model contract without feed-in charges.
The ACM will supervise this as an independent regulator.
De ACM zal hier als onafhankelijk toezichthouder op toezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over zonneparken die in financiële problemen komen door het uitblijven van een voorschot van de Stimulering Duurzame Energieproductie (SDE) subsidie

An MP asked the minister about solar parks facing liquidity problems because SDE subsidy advances are low or absent, due to a price-based calculation that includes the 2022 price peak, and asked for remedies and faster final settlement. The minister answered that the advance method is long-established and predictable, that projects and financiers bear responsibility for bridging the gap, that faster settlement is limited, and that RVO can offer case-by-case set-off but not tailored subsidy.
I am therefore reluctant to change the advance methodology of the SDE++.
Ik ben daarom terughoudend bij het aanpassen van de methodiek van de bevoorschotting in de SDE++.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht: ‘Oekraïners gelokt: vanuit heel Europa komen mensen nu af op gratis woning en zorg.’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Ukrainians are arriving from across Europe for free housing and care, asking about arrival numbers, motives, medical care, work rights and long-term planning. The government answered that arrivals are mostly under temporary protection rules, that a monitoring study will be launched, and that it will prepare a uniform co-payment scheme and information on self-employment rules before the summer recess.
In light of these signals, a formal (qualitatively reliable) monitoring study will be launched in the short term at the HUB in Utrecht.
Mede naar aanleiding van deze signalen zal er op korte termijn een formeel (kwalitatief betrouwbaar) monitoringsonderzoek worden opgestart bij de HUB in Utrecht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Bontenbal en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Zinkfabriek Nyrstar in Budel legt productie stil’

MPs Erkens, Bontenbal and Grinwis asked how the government views the shutdown of the Nyrstar zinc plant in Budel over high energy costs, lack of state aid and the investment climate, and whether this reflects a wider industrial trend, the effect of the tax changes and the ending of the IKC and volume compensation schemes, the link to grid congestion and balancing, and how the government will address negative sentiment around industry. The minister acknowledges the high energy costs and competitive disadvantage relative to neighbours, defends the Dutch climate-led industrial policy ('greener here than grey elsewhere'), explains the reasons for ending the IKC and the ACM's abolition of the VCR, and promises further studies on electricity costs and a report to parliament, but gives limited concrete answers on grid congestion and some questions are answered by reference to policy stance.
I expect that the cabinet will inform the House later this quarter about the findings.
Ik verwacht dat het kabinet de Kamer later dit kwartaal zal inlichten over de bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het persbericht ‘Oekraïense school in Breda moet sluiten, onbegrip is groot’

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked why the Ukrainian school in Breda, a temporary education facility, must close on 14 July 2024, and whether Ukrainian language instruction can be preserved for displaced children. The minister explained the temporary legal exemption expires by statute, that Ukrainian-language education is not a task of publicly funded schooling, and that talks with the school and municipality on alternatives are ongoing.

I understand the importance for Ukrainian children of maintaining their connection to their own language and culture. However, this is not a task of formal publicly funded education, as it is not for other newcomers either.

Ik begrijp het belang voor Oekraïense kinderen om de verbinding te houden met de eigen taal en cultuur. Dit is echter geen taak van het formele bekostigde onderwijs, zoals het dat ook voor andere nieuwkomers niet is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de wachtlijst voor aanvragen voor transportcapaciteit op het elektriciteitsnet

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the waiting list for grid transport capacity, including whether the roughly 6,000 applicants reported in 2023 had grown, how long applicants wait, and whether parties willing to offer congestion management are wrongly placed on the list. The minister answered that about 9,400 applications are queued, that the list is likely inflated by duplicates, that waiting times depend on local grid expansion and flexible capacity, and that standardised congestion-service contracts and a shared dashboard are being developed with grid operators and the ACM.
I am examining, in consultation with grid operators and the ACM, the options for cleaning up the queue.
Ik bezie in overleg met netbeheerders en ACM de mogelijkheden om de wachtrij op te schonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’'

MPs asked whether the government will prevent extremist preacher Mohamed Hoblos from spreading his message online after being denied physical entry to a Utrecht event, and why the venue and mayor could not stop it. The government answered that an online approach is being developed, that terrorist content can be removed, and that under existing law a mayor can only ban a speaker in concrete and serious threat cases, while the organiser and Jaarbeurs assured the speaker would not speak.

Through various pillars, such as dialogue with the internet sector, the local approach and an ambitious international effort, the Minister of Justice and Security is making every possible effort in this regard, nationally and internationally.

Via diverse pijlers, zoals een dialoog met de internetsector, de lokale aanpak en een ambitieuze internationale inzet spant de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zich hier, nationaal en internationaal, zo maximaal mogelijk voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder, Michon-Derkzen, Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’’

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an Australian extremist preacher planning to speak in Utrecht could be barred from entry, and what would stop him operating elsewhere in the Netherlands. The government answered that it acts against speakers who incite hatred or violence, that the preacher is flagged in the Schengen SIS system for refusal of entry, and that the municipality and services cooperated to prevent him getting a platform.
This refusal of entry applies, in line with the Schengen Borders Code, to all other Schengen member states as well.
Deze toegangsweigering geldt, in lijn met de Schengengrenscode, ook voor alle andere Schengen lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot, Erkens, Bontenbal en Geurts over het bericht ‘Verduurzaming van koopwoningen komt bij gedeeld huizenbezit slecht van de grond’

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the minister why energy-efficiency upgrades in shared-ownership apartment buildings stall when homeowners' associations (VvE) do not approve them, and what could be done. The minister answered all eleven questions, citing a VvE acceleration agenda with lower decision thresholds, support tools, subsidies, and possible future legislation, while rejecting a rule giving VvEs unconditional competence over sustainability.
I do not intend to prepare legislation to that effect.
Ik ben niet voornemens wetgeving met die strekking te gaan voorbereiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht 'Het internet is vervuilender dan de luchtvaart, met dank aan alle mails, crypto’s, videogesprekken, streams en de cloud'

Two CDA MPs asked the government about reports that internet use is more polluting than aviation, including Dutch digital emissions, government monitoring of its digital footprint and the French 'sobriété digitale' idea. The minister answered that estimates vary, no integral picture of Dutch digital emissions exists yet, research and a plan for a sustainable digital sector are under way, and that sobriety-based steering should be approached cautiously.
At this moment I do not have an integral picture of the sustainability effects of our digital economy.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over een integraal beeld van de duurzaamheidseffecten van onze digitale economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat ecologisch onderzoek nodig is bij het isoleren van spouwmuren

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers about the Council of State ruling that ecological research is required before insulating cavity walls, including effects on costs, speed and energy poverty. The minister acknowledges the ruling, outlines a medium-term plan of municipal species management plans and a task force, and refers several questions to a Kamerbrief without giving concrete figures on individual research costs.
See the letter to the House of Representatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over knelpunten voor (mono)mestvergisting

CDA MPs asked the ministers for an update on steps to expand green gas from manure digestion, including zoning, permitting, manure transport rules and additive innovations. The government answered that it is working with local authorities on faster permitting and a CO2-based blending obligation, but declined to set a sub-target for manure digestion and deferred most issues to local authorities and further research.
The cabinet is not responsible for the requirements in zoning plans; that is up to the local competent authorities.
Het kabinet gaat niet over de eisen in bestemmingsplannen, dat is aan de lokale bevoegd gezagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over energiecoöperaties die gebruik maken van de postcoderoosregeling

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about problems facing energy cooperatives under the postcoderoos scheme, including administrative burden, uncertain compensation, and a possible buy-out scheme. The minister answers that a buy-out is infeasible and state-aid-problematic, points to the successor subsidy scheme SCE and SDE++, and offers continued dialogue without committing to a new buy-out scheme.
I do not have access to this data.
Ik heb geen inzage in deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal en het lid Thijssen over de rol van ijzerpoeder in het energiesysteem van de toekomst

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of iron powder (iron power technology) in future energy storage, including its maturity, seasonal storage potential, NOx emissions, and support instruments. The minister answered that iron powder is a promising but still-to-be-proven option that could play a role in seasonal storage and heat supply, with NOx depending on application, and that support could come through existing instruments while noting business case uncertainties.
Iron powder is a potentially promising technology for which the necessary knowledge base is present in the Netherlands to develop it further.
IJzerpoeder is een mogelijk veelbelovende techniek waarvoor in Nederland ook de benodigde kennisbasis aanwezig is om dit verder door te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de plannen van Duitsland om de stroomprijs voor de energie-intensieve industrie te maximeren

The MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about the German plan to cap electricity prices for energy-intensive industry, including CfDs, PPAs, a 6 cent bridge price, and whether the Netherlands would coordinate with other member states. The minister answered that the German paper is not government policy, that the Dutch government sees the cap as costly and distortive of the level playing field and energy-saving incentives, and that it will pursue EU-level coordination and an EU-wide hydrogen-carbon agenda.
Because energy contracts between energy suppliers and energy-intensive companies are not public, this question cannot be answered exactly.
Omdat energiecontracten tussen energieleveranciers en energie-intensieve bedrijven niet openbaar zijn kan deze vraag niet exact worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Bontenbal over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de regels rond verlichting van windmolens

Two CDA MPs asked about the status of ILT approval for proximity detection to switch wind turbine obstacle lighting, notably for the Wieringermeer park, and about funding and provincial frameworks for retrofitting existing turbines. The minister replied that the ILT assessment is ongoing without a date, that new parks' costs are built into SDE++ rates, that a one-off 60/20/20 cost split with provinces is being prepared for a specific grant expected in autumn 2023, and that provinces are developing their own frameworks on individual timelines.
It is not possible during the assessment process of the application to state when the ILT will decide on its approval.
Het is niet mogelijk om gedurende het beoordelingsproces van de aanvraag een uitspraak te doen over het moment waarop besloten wordt over de instemming door de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de misstanden bij de installatie van zonnepanelen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about safety and quality problems in installing solar panels, including fatal accidents and whether only accredited installers should be allowed. The minister said the Labour Inspectorate is monitoring the sector, pointed to existing legal quality requirements and voluntary accreditation, and said safety responsibility lies primarily with employers, while the government will reassess progress next year.
We are closely monitoring these efforts by the Labour Inspectorate and the solar panel sector.
Wij volgen deze inspanningen van de Arbeidsinspectie en de zonnepanelensector op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de waterstofplannen in Duitsland

An MP asked the minister about a seven-company German hydrogen alliance in Northwest Germany, its plans for electrolysis, transport networks and import infrastructure, and the role of state-owned Gasunie. The minister confirmed awareness, described the alliance's projects and Gasunie's infrastructure role, and said the government is in close contact with German and Belgian counterparts on cross-border hydrogen transport.
It is in all our interest that an integrated European hydrogen market emerges, and a cross-border hydrogen transport network belongs to that.
Het is in ons aller belang dat een geïntegreerde Europese waterstofmarkt ontstaat en daar hoort een grensoverschrijdend transportnet voor waterstof bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over blauwe waterstof

Two MPs (Bontenbal, Erkens) asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the role of blue hydrogen, renewable hydrogen targets, investment certainty for producers, use of North Sea gas, EU RED III implementation and a level playing field, and nuclear-based hydrogen. The minister answered that demand for low-carbon hydrogen will stay large, that the instrument for renewable hydrogen will be clarified this autumn, and that rules will follow the EU and neighbours' approaches.
This autumn I also want to provide clarity on the instruments for renewable hydrogen.
Dit najaar wil ik daarnaast duidelijkheid geven over het instrumentarium voor hernieuwbare waterstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Eigen Huis: subsidieaanvraag voor groen huis rompslomp'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about reports that homeowners find the ISDE green subsidy application cumbersome. The minister acknowledged the procedure can be simpler, pointed to RVO website and form improvements and planned work with stakeholders and behavioural insights, but offered no formal change to the process.
Following the results of the Vereniging Eigen Huis complaints desk, I want to investigate further, using behavioural insights, how the application process can be simplified further.

Naar aanleiding van de uitkomsten van het meldpunt van de Vereniging Eigen Huis wil ik met gebruikmaking van gedragsinzichten nog beter onderzoeken hoe het aanvraagproces verder vereenvoudigd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over CCS in de SDE++ 2022

An MP asked the minister how the EUR 6.714 billion CCS commitment budget under SDE++ 2022 was calculated, why a 40 EUR/tonne base price was used rather than the higher 2023 figure, and whether actual cash outlays would be far lower. The minister explained the budget components, said the total cash expectation is roughly EUR 2.8 billion, declined to disclose exact figures for confidentiality, and promised to review how SDE++ results are communicated and to inform parliament on CCS policy soon.
Due to confidentiality, I cannot disclose the precise details of the eight decisions.
Vanwege vertrouwelijkheid kan ik niet de precieze details van de acht beschikkingen openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over geplande veroudering bij Apple

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government is aware of reports of planned obsolescence by Apple, how it views such practices, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to address repairability and product lifespan. The State Secretary answered that planned obsolescence has no place in a circular economy, that the ACM supervises unfair trading practices, and that the EU proposals on consumer role in the green transition and the right to repair, along with Ecodesign rules and a repairability index, are the main instruments being negotiated.
In a circular economy, repairable products must be the norm and there is no place for planned obsolescence.
In een circulaire economie moeten repareerbare producten de norm zijn en is voor geplande veroudering geen plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over methaanemissies in Turkmenistan

CDA MPs asked the government about very high methane emissions from Turkmenistan's largest oil and gas fields and how the Netherlands and EU could press for reductions ahead of COP28. The minister said the emissions figure uses a GWP-20 metric (about 128 Mt CO2-eq on GWP-100, below Dutch national emissions), and outlined EU and Dutch dialogue, technical assistance and the Global Methane Pledge as the response.

The Netherlands will also raise this methane issue in its own bilateral contacts with the Turkmen authorities and point out that several Dutch companies have expertise in detecting and preventing methane leaks.

Nederland zal deze methaan-problematiek ook opbrengen in de eigen bilaterale contacten met de Turkmeense autoriteiten en daarbij aangeven dat bij verschillende Nederlandse bedrijven expertise is voor het detecteren en tegengaan van methaanlekkages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de fiscale maatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

CDA MPs asked the government about the impact of planned energy tax changes on greenhouse growers, the feasibility of transition timelines, the treatment of combined heat and power plants, and fairness between small and large growers. The government acknowledges the strong impact, points to a combined package of measures and a possible phase-in path decided in August 2023, and says it will consider a revised proposal pending EU state aid approval.
The cabinet will decide in August 2023, based on an impact analysis yet to be published, whether to possibly adopt a phase-in path with substantial steps from 2025.
Het kabinet besluit in augustus 2023 op basis van een nog te verschijnen impactanalyse eventueel tot een ingroeipad met substantiële stappen vanaf 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Provincie Limburg zet nieuwe stap in grootschalig onderzoek naar kernenergie'

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the minister about a provincial Limburg initiative studying small modular reactors (SMRs), their role in industrial decarbonisation, and the government's plans and motion follow-up. The minister answered that the government is following SMR developments, commissioned a market analysis, plans a 65 million euro programme and a stepwise inventory via the industrial clusters, and is in contact with developers.
I am implementing this motion through a stepwise approach.
Ik geef uitvoering aan deze motie middels een stapsgewijze aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Palland over het bericht ‘Subsidie op je rieten dak, maar alleen als het riet uit China komt’

CDA MPs asked why Chinese reed qualifies for ISDE insulation subsidy while Dutch reed does not, and whether Dutch reed's lower environmental impact was ignored. The minister said Chinese reed was listed because it met the minimum insulation value, Dutch reed is awaiting a performance declaration due in May, and the subsidy does not discriminate by country of origin.
Currently it is being examined how a good environmental performance of insulation material, for example biobased insulation materials, can be valued in the insulation subsidy schemes.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht hoe een goede milieuprestatie van isolatiemateriaal – bijvoorbeeld bij biobased isolatiematerialen – kan worden gewaardeerd in de subsidieregelingen voor isolatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het combineren van maatregelen voor het reduceren van de uitstoot van stikstof en CO2 door industriële bedrijven

CDA MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked how the government will combine nitrogen and CO2 reduction for large industrial emitters, which firms overlap, and whether a joint acceleration plan will be made. The minister answered that about 35 firms are covered by a tailor-made approach addressing both CO2 and nitrogen, that grid and permitting bottlenecks remain, and that a joint plan of action with the 20 largest CO2 emitters is being developed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht dat miljoenen overheidsgeld op het spel staan na het stilleggen van een biomassacentrale in Gelderland

Two CDA MPs asked why the Primco biomass plant in Duiven stopped operating, whether public money is at risk, and what measures prevent further subsidised biomass projects from failing. The minister answered that the company bears the price risk, that the state's subsidy and investment support total about 6 million euro so far, that the state would be a creditor for overpaid SDE+ subsidy in bankruptcy, and that the government has no active role in restarting the plant, while declining to answer the question on how many projects are affected.
No. It concerns many projects with very specific business operations and agreements on both costs or revenues for the use of biomass and revenues for the supply of heat.
Nee. Het betreft veel projecten met zeer specifieke bedrijfsvoeringen en afspraken zowel qua kosten of inkomsten voor de inzet van biomassa als qua opbrengsten voor de levering van warmte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Pro-Russische DDoS-aanvallers hebben het gemunt op Nederlandse ziekenhuizen’

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether pro-Russian DDoS attacks on Dutch hospitals threaten healthcare and what is being done to protect hospitals and share threat information. The government answered that care continuity was not affected, described existing protections (DDoS scrubbing, Z-CERT, NCSC information sharing and the amended Wbni) and said monitoring of similar attacks is ongoing, without committing to new structural changes beyond a promised letter on the NIB2 implementation.
The Minister of Justice and Security will inform the House further on this in a letter in the spring.
De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal u hierover nader informeren middels een brief aan uw Kamer in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over fossiele subsidies

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked whether the fossil subsidy debate should focus on the carbon pricing gap identified by PBL, whether energy tax on electricity is too untargeted and should be revised, and how the Energy Tax Directive and non-energy use of fossil fuels should be handled. The government answered that carbon pricing analysis is useful, agreed to ask PBL for an update, acknowledged the electricity tax issue and EU negotiations, and said further study of non-energy fossil use is needed.
I will ask PBL to update the 2021 analysis.
Ik zal het PBL vragen om een actualisatie van de analyse uit 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over waterstof uit kernenergie

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the minister whether the Netherlands would pursue hydrogen from nuclear energy, following a Franco-German roadmap, and whether it should count toward EU green hydrogen targets for industry. The minister welcomed Franco-German cooperation, said nuclear-based hydrogen may be imported or produced later, but kept the Dutch position on additionality and a level playing field and committed to no concrete new step beyond ongoing EU negotiations.
I attach importance to maintaining a level playing field for hydrogen producers and users.
Ik hecht er waarde aan dat het gelijke speelveld voor waterstofproducenten en -gebruikers behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over CO2-verwijdering

Two MPs asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about the gap between carbon dioxide removal (CDR) in national climate plans and what the Paris goals require, and about policy steps, a long-term target and a roadmap for negative emissions. The minister agrees a policy vision from central government is needed, points to the 2024 Climate Plan and an ongoing study, and says CDR should not replace faster emission reductions.
I will send your House a letter in March on the elaboration of the climate neutrality policy agenda.
Ik zal uw Kamer in maart een brief sturen over de uitwerking van de beleidsagenda op Klimaatneutraliteit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de kwaliteitscriteria voor waterstof

Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about the quality criteria for hydrogen, including whether the 98% minimum purity advised by Kiwa and DNV is too low compared with the 99.5% producers prefer, and who bears purification costs. The minister explained the consultation results, agreed to commission additional research with a single long-term purity standard, and promised to decide after that research and inform parliament before summer.
I will commission additional research in which insights from the market consultation are weighed.
Ik ga opdracht geven voor aanvullend onderzoek waarin inzichten uit de marktconsultatie worden meegewogen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gevolgen van de inframarginale prijscap op biogasproducenten met een warmtekrachtkoppeling (WKK)

MP Bontenbal asked whether the infra-marginal price cap threatens biogas CHP plants with bankruptcy, whether the 240 euro/MWh cap is too low, and whether the cap should match Germany's 285 euro/MWh. The minister agreed to raise the cap for biogas CHP plants to 285 euro/MWh based on German cost data, but refused to switch to an averaged seven-month cap instead of monthly settlement.
Based on the German analysis, I will adjust the price cap for biogas CHP installations to 285 euro/MWh, so that for this category too only excess profits are taxed.
Op basis van de Duitse analyse zal ik de hoogte van het prijsplafond voor biogas-WKK installaties aanpassen naar 285 euro/MWh, om zo ook voor deze categorie alleen overwinsten af te romen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de inzet van dieselaggregaten

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers about the use, air-quality and CO2 impact, municipal and provincial levers, EU emission standards and alternatives for diesel generators, and whether a strategy and a three-year phase-out by grid operators are planned. The state secretary answered that diesel generators (about 11,000, mostly in construction) have limited national impact but local effects, that municipalities rarely use their powers, that a routekaart and convenant are being prepared, and that a three-year phase-out is too short, proposing about ten years.
Once the routekaart SEB is final and the convenant signed, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de routekaart SEB definitief is en het convenant ondertekend, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Russische hackers hebben het gemunt op Nederlandse gasinstallaties’

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch gas infrastructure, on land and at sea, is adequately protected against Russian state-linked cyberattacks and sabotage, and whether emergency plans exist. The minister answered that the operators bear primary responsibility, that the government supports them through information sharing and the Wbni framework with RDI supervision and NCSC assistance, and that gas crisis plans (BH-G, NCP Gas) and a North Sea protection strategy are in place or in development.

In its governing role over vital infrastructure, I set requirements together with the Minister of Justice and Security, which are laid down in laws and regulations, and I supervise compliance with them.
Vanuit haar regierol op de vitale infrastructuur stel ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid eisen op die worden vastgelegd in wet- en regelgeving en zie ik toe op de naleving ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over decentrale productie van bio-LNG

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the rising CO2 emissions of long-distance transport, the role of bioLNG, and the trade-offs between decentralised and centralised bioLNG production. The state secretary replied that bioLNG is a transition fuel, that policy supports both production routes via SDE++ and RED II/III, and that a study into biogas use in mobility versus buildings may limit biogas use in transport, with further information promised.
I will inform your House about this together with Minister Jetten as soon as possible.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer samen met Minister Jetten zo snel mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de berichten 'Twitter heft adviesraad op die platform veilig moest houden' en 'Elon Musk daalt op zijn Twitter steeds dieper af in het konijnenhol'

A CDA MP asked the State Secretary about reports that Twitter dissolved its safety advisory council and about Elon Musk's posts and account blocks of journalists, and how Dutch public debate would be protected. The State Secretary answered that platform obligations under the EU Digital Services Act, enforced by the European Commission, would apply and that she disapproves of unjustified press restrictions, while leaving the content of Musk's personal posts to US authorities.
Mr. Musk's personal tweets will have to be assessed under American law by the supervisory authorities there.
De persoonlijke tweets van de heer Musk zullen onder Amerikaans recht beoordeeld moeten worden door de toezichthoudende instanties aldaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Van der Molen over het artikel ‘Studentgegevens ondanks kritiek massaal in de Amerikaanse cloud gezet’

MPs Bontenbal and Van der Molen asked about a report that student data was massively moved to US cloud providers despite criticism, raising privacy, espionage and strategic autonomy risks. The Secretary of State answered that institutions are responsible for their own cloud choices under the GDPR, pointed to DPIAs, sector-wide contracts via SURF, the knowledge security framework, and EU cloud initiatives such as IPCEI Cloud and a European cloud certification scheme.
The Ministry of OCW does not itself have data on cloud use by universities.
Eigen gegevens over het cloudgebruik door universiteiten zijn niet bekend bij het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoord op vragen van Boswijk en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Steunmaatregelen 'zeer teleurstellend' voor glastuinbouw: 'Dit gaat tuinders niet helpen"

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked the ministers of Agriculture and Economic Affairs about reports that support measures for greenhouse horticulture were insufficient, and about the sector's energy costs, its classification, and EU support options. The government disagrees that the measures do not help, points to raised compensation ceilings and a generic SME scheme, and says it sees no need for additional EU-based support for the sector.
I do not agree with the statement that the measures taken do not help the growers.
Ik ben het niet eens met de uitspraak dat de maatregelen die zijn genomen de tuinders niet helpt.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Gratis games zetten kinderen onder druk om aankopen te doen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a Consumentenbond report that free games aimed at children use in-game purchases to pressure them into buying advantages, and about the legality of such designs, enforcement, and whether children need stronger protection. The State Secretary called the findings worrying, announced an EU-level proposal to treat loot boxes as unfair commercial practices and a public awareness campaign, but said no specific national ban is planned and enforcement rests with the ACM.
In this context, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate intends to ask the European Commission whether loot boxes can be classified as an unfair commercial practice.
In het kader hiervan is de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat voornemens aan de Europese Commissie voor te leggen of loot boxes 5 als oneerlijke handelspraktijk kunnen worden aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over Europese belemmeringen voor het invoeren van een kwaliteitseis voor bio-ethanol

An MP asks whether EU law prevents the Netherlands from requiring pure, undenatured ethanol for bio-ethanol blending and why it will not introduce such a quality requirement despite other member states doing so. The State Secretary answers that the Commission's reply does not allow that conclusion, that a Dutch quality requirement would conflict with the Fuel Quality Directive via the RED incentive system, and that the government does not intend to introduce the requirement but will consider CO2-reduction rewards during RED III implementation.
I am also considering implementing this in national implementation.
Ik overweeg dit bij de nationale implementatie ook door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over speculatie op de gasbeurs

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about speculation on the TTF gas exchange, its effect on prices, and whether trading volumes are excessive. The Minister answered that the AFM sees no indications of market manipulation, that financial firms provide liquidity useful for hedging, that position limits and AFM oversight exist, and that restricting trade would harm long-term price stability and supply security.
The AFM currently has no indications that there has recently been any form of market manipulation or other market abuse in trading in gas derivatives.
De AFM heeft vooralsnog geen indicaties dat er bij de handel in gasderivaten recentelijk sprake is (geweest) van enige vorm van marktmanipulatie of andere vormen van marktmisbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens en Valstar over versnelling geothermie

MPs Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens and Valstar asked how to accelerate geothermal heat projects amid the gas crisis, including exceptions to SDE++ deadlines, a correction scheme for glasshouse horticulture, and simpler permitting and risk frameworks. The Staatssecretaris answered that retroactive SDE++ changes are unfair to other bidders, that a temporary correction scheme is being explored with a decision expected soon, and that permitting and risk rules will change in spring 2023 with a taskforce being set up.
An adjustment after the tender has closed, with retroactive effect, affects equal treatment of projects for two reasons and therefore also the government's reliability.
Een aanpassing na afloop van de tender – met terugwerkende kracht – raakt om twee redenen aan de gelijke behandeling van projecten en daarmee ook aan de betrouwbaarheid van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Kuik over het bericht “De meest gehate sites ter wereld, in de lucht via Flevoland”

MPs Bontenbal and Kuik asked whether Dutch hosting firms facilitate hate-speech and child-abuse websites such as 8kun and Daily Stormer, and what the government can do. The minister answers that hosts must act on known illegal content, that the ATKM will cover terrorist and child-abuse material while online hate speech remains outside its scope, and that an interdepartmental inventory on hate speech is underway.
There is no legal framework for supervising the content hosted in the Netherlands.
Er bestaat geen wettelijk kader voor toezicht op de content die in Nederland wordt gehost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de uitspraken van de rechtbank over het behoud van contracten bij faillissement energieleverancier

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about court rulings on retaining energy contracts when a supplier goes bankrupt, the curator's sale of customer books, and how to better protect households. The Minister says the ACM is responsible for applying the rules, that the procedure for transferring customers will be clarified in lower regulation, and that the MP's policy proposals will be addressed in a separate letter.
The ACM has asked me to clarify the Besluit leveringszekerheid on this point.
De ACM heeft mij verzocht om het Besluit leveringszekerheid op dit punt te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over het bericht dat gemeenten duurdere gascontracten moeten sluiten

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal asked whether Dutch municipalities should be forced to switch away from Gazprom-linked gas contracts, arguing this benefits Russia, and asked about costs and compensation. The minister answered that SEFE (formerly Gazprom Germania) was nationalised so existing contracts can be kept and no exemption is needed, while confirming municipalities will be compensated for extra costs incurred from switching.
That information is not available at my ministry and is commercially confidential, and was therefore also not shared with us by the company or the German government.
Die informatie is bij mijn ministerie niet aanwezig en is commercieel vertrouwelijk en dus ook niet gedeeld met ons door het bedrijf of de Duitse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder en Haverkort over de rol van afvalenergiecentrales in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal, Agnes Mulder and Haverkort asked about the Royal HaskoningDHV report on waste-to-energy plants, the effects of the waste import levy on CO2 emissions, the role of waste incinerators in a climate-neutral system, CO2 capture and chemical recycling. State Secretary Heijnen answered that the levy reduced cross-border waste incineration, disputed the claimed emissions increase, and said incinerators will play a shrinking role as waste is shifted to higher-value recycling, while committing to examine how instruments can support both transitions.
The cabinet will examine in the coming period how instruments can be deployed to support both the transition to a climate-neutral economy and the transition to a circular economy.

Het kabinet zal de komende tijd bezien hoe instrumenten zo kunnen worden ingezet dat zij zowel de transitie naar een klimaatneutrale economie als de transitie naar een circulaire economie ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de marktordening van Carbon Capture and storage (CCS)

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister how the market structure for CO2 storage under the North Sea should be shaped, including public versus private roles, the market-power risks of Shell and TotalEnergies in the Aramis project, and whether an external analysis of the market design exists. The minister answered that private market parties should lead, with EBN retaining a role for long-term storage liability, that open access rules and SDE++ subsidies limit market-power risks, and that an independent adviser was asked only to map current bottlenecks rather than an external market-design analysis.
I am also in discussion with the Norwegian government to record agreements for this, insofar as necessary.
Ik ben ook in gesprek met de Noorse overheid om, voor zover nodig, afspraken hiervoor vast te leggen.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bontenbal over de berichten 'Steeds meer productie wordt stilgelegd vanwege de hoge energieprijs' en 'De Croo: 'We dreigen in oorlogseconomie te belanden als EU niet ingrijpt''

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that production is being halted due to high energy prices and about the risk of a war economy. The minister answered that some firms have curtailed output, that industrial production has so far held up overall, and that targeted support (TEK scheme, Dutch price cap, EU temporary crisis framework) and a letter on energy-intensive industry are in preparation.
As announced in the Business Policy committee debate of 19 October, I will therefore send Parliament a letter before the end of the year on energy-intensive industry addressing the current situation.

Ik zal zoals aangekondigd in het Commissiedebat Bedrijfslevenbeleid van 19 oktober, daarom voor het einde van het jaar een brief aan uw Kamer sturen over de energie-intensieve industrie waarin op de huidige situatie zal worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de regels voor het beginnen van een energiebedrijf en het toezicht op kleine energiebedrijven door de ACM

An MP asks the Minister for Climate and Energy about the ease of obtaining a supply licence from the ACM, the practice of reselling energy under another company's licence, a flexible-rate long-term contract offered by a supplier, and consumer protection. The Minister replies that licensing requirements have been tightened through new policy rules, that the ACM supervises licensed suppliers who are liable for resellers, and that the ACM is revising the early-termination fee guidelines and further measures will follow under the Energy Act.
It is the ACM that assesses licence applications and supervises licence holders, including licence holders that sign energy contracts through resellers.
Het is de ACM die aanvragen van vergunningen beoordeelt en toezicht houdt op vergunninghouders, ook op vergunninghouders die via wederverkopers energiecontracten sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de salderingsregeling

An MP asked the energy minister whether the net-metering scheme's costs are socialised across non-solar households, whether the EU approved it, and whether it complies with the Electricity Directive. The minister confirmed costs are passed on to all customers, said a cost model could be requested from suppliers but is commercially sensitive, and argued the scheme is compliant with the directive.
However, this concerns commercially sensitive information and is difficult to verify.
Wel is het zo dat dit bedrijfsgevoelige informatie betreft en lastig te verifiëren is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Bontenbal over de stijging van het aantal korte vluchten van en naar Nederlandse luchthavens

MPs Van der Molen and Bontenbal asked the government about the rise in short private and government flights from Dutch airports, including whether cabinet members set an example and whether flights without passengers can be curbed. Minister Harbers answered that government has no control over private flights, that a cabinet-wide guideline on short government flights is being drafted, and that no legal basis or policy exists to restrict specific flights, though the impact on climate will be examined.
Furthermore, research has started into establishing an interdepartmental guideline regulating the use of the government aircraft for short flights and/or repositioning flights.
Verder is een onderzoek gestart naar de realisatie van een interdepartementale richtlijn, die het gebruik van het regeringsvliegtuig voor korte vluchten en/of positioneringsvluchten reguleert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bontenbal over ‘De kosten van energieverbruik van medische apparaten’

MPs Van den Berg and Bontenbal asked whether insurer reimbursement for oxygen equipment electricity costs is adequate, given that a concentrator may cost thousands of euros a year to run. The minister calculated about 18 cents per hour in electricity costs against roughly 6 cents per hour reimbursed, said he had informed insurers and would monitor their policy, but made no firm commitment to retroactive or minimum reimbursement.
I have pointed out this issue to health insurers and provided them with the calculation set out in the answer to question 3.
Ik heb zorgverzekeraars gewezen op deze kwestie en hen voorzien van de berekening zoals weergegeven in het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Thijssen, Peters en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit'

Four MPs asked the ministers about schools forced to cancel energy contracts with Gazprom and face sharply higher costs, including the scale of the problem, scenarios, quality of education, building insulation and inequality. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that schools in acute liquidity problems can report to OCW, that a motion asks for targeted support to be reported by 1 December, and that a subsidy scheme for sustainable public buildings opens on 3 October.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de stijgende energierekening en het functioneren van de energiemarkt

The CDA MP Bontenbal asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about rising energy bills, energy suppliers withdrawing fixed-term contracts, restrictive sign-up practices, margin calls and ACM supervision of suppliers. The Minister answered most questions in substance, confirmed existing rules and ACM's tightened financial supervision, and promised talks with ACM on fixed contracts and margin calls.
Over the past winter the ACM had external experts examine whether it could do more to protect consumers against possible financial problems of energy suppliers.
De ACM heeft afgelopen winter door externe experts laten onderzoeken of zij meer kan doen om consumenten te beschermen tegen mogelijke financiële problemen van energieleveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over meerdere ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kernenergie

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the minister about private small modular reactor initiatives, industrial clusters' interest in nuclear power, the Limburg study, government funding for nuclear innovation, Belgian investment and European SMR cooperation. The minister answered that SMRs are a possible complementary energy source, that existing funds and instruments are open to nuclear innovation, and that research and international cooperation will continue, without committing to new structural changes.
Instead, they should specialise in nationally relevant themes and cooperate in areas where interests are shared.
In plaats daarvan moeten ze specialiseren op nationaal relevante thema's en samenwerken op gebieden waar gedeelde interesses zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over fouten in energienota bij teruglevering zonnepalenen

An MP asked whether some energy suppliers net metering over quarters rather than a full year, whether this is lawful, and what tariff applies when netting solar feed-in. The minister confirmed signals of quarterly netting, stated that the intended and historically applied rule is annual netting, and announced an amendment to make this explicit in the Elektriciteitswet 1998 bill, with general administrative orders possibly setting rules for the calculation.
I therefore intend to make this explicit by amending article 31c of the Electricity Act 1998 in the present bill through an amendment note.
Ik ben dan ook van plan dit expliciet te maken door via een nota van wijziging in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel artikel 31c van de Elektriciteitswet 1998 hierop aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de oproep van provincies en gemeenten aangaande het realiseren van passende juridische kaders voor gebouwgebonden financierings- en ontzorgingsinstrumenten

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister for Housing about a joint call by provinces and municipalities for legal frameworks enabling building-linked financing and turnkey renovation instruments, and whether legal obstacles exist and will be addressed. The Minister agrees such instruments could help meet renovation targets, says a study of the obstacles is under way with a promised follow-up, and answers the questions on the Wijk bij Duurstede and Amersfoort schemes only in general terms, promising to return later.
At the committee debate on the Climate Agreement for the built environment on 6 April, I undertook to examine whether and how these obstacles can be resolved.
Ik heb in het Commissiedebat Klimaatakkoord gebouwde omgeving van 6 april jl. toegezegd te zullen bezien of en hoe deze knelpunten kunnen worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over het artikel 'EBN deed bod om gasopslag Bergermeer te nationaliseren'

Two MPs asked the minister why the government blocked EBN's bid to take over TAQA's stake in the Bergermeer gas storage, what analyses underlay that, and whether nationalisation would help supply security and allocation in shortages. The government answered that a larger ownership share would not improve storage filling, that the analyses are confidential, and that it instead subsidises market parties and tasks EBN with filling Bergermeer.

Because these documents contain, among other things, confidentially obtained commercially sensitive information and information that could harm the financial and economic interests of the state, we can only share the information confidentially with your House.

Omdat deze stukken onder meer vertrouwelijk verkregen bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en informatie die de financiële en economische belangen van de staat kan schaden bevat, kunnen wij de informatie alleen vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gedelegeerde verordening met eisen voor hernieuwbare waterstof

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Climate and Energy, in 13 questions, how the EU delegated regulation defining renewable hydrogen (eligibility rules on electricity sourcing, additionality, bidding zone and hourly matching, and import rules) would affect hydrogen rollout and market development in the Netherlands. The Minister replies that the rules leave sufficient room for Dutch hydrogen ambitions, that they are needed for clarity and will be applied to imports too, and that a certification pilot with RVO will be run this year.
Adopting unambiguous European requirements for the production, import and use of renewable hydrogen is an essential condition for rapid development of the hydrogen market in the short term.

Het aannemen van eenduidige Europese eisen voor productie, import en gebruik van hernieuwbare waterstof is een essentiële voorwaarde voor een snelle ontwikkeling van de waterstofmarkt op de korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de ACM instemt met de aanleg van een privaat net voor zonneparken in Groningen

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister about ACM approving a private grid for 500 MW of solar parks in Groningen that connects directly to TenneT's high-voltage network, raising concerns about grid congestion workarounds, criteria for exemptions, and the non-discrimination principle. Minister Jetten answered that closed distribution systems are a long-established option, that the register shows no clear rise in exemptions, that ACM applies statutory criteria, and that the non-discrimination principle is not breached, but committed to talks with ACM and grid operators on whether more regulatory control is needed.

I will therefore enter into discussions with ACM and grid operators on this subject and investigate whether there is a risk that market parties build closed distribution systems solely for these reasons

Ik zal daarom met ACM en netbeheerders in gesprek treden over dit onderwerp en onderzoeken of er een risico bestaat dat marktpartijen uitsluitend om deze redenen gesloten distributiesystemen aanleggen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gasopslag Norg

The MP Bontenbal asked why the Norg gas storage was not filled beyond 80% and whether a higher fill level would ensure supply security and affect other storage sites. The minister answered that a negative summer-winter spread removes the commercial case for filling, so the government will subsidise further filling, while the effect on prices is hard to predict and other storage sites will be filled to at least 80%.
The cabinet will work out a subsidy to further fill the Norg gas storage.
Het kabinet gaat een subsidie uitwerken om Gasopslag Norg verder te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over groen gas uit niet biogene stromen

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked whether current SDE+/SDE++ rules limit subsidised green gas to biogenic feedstock (capping non-biogenic input at 5% and 2.5%), whether gasification could broaden supply, and whether flexibility could be created. Minister Jetten confirmed the rules, said he would have PBL advise and consider opening the category in SDE++ 2023, but rejected retroactive changes to existing decisions.
I have asked PBL to advise on this for the SDE++ round of 2023.
Ik heb PBL gevraagd om hier voor de SDE++ ronde 2023 advies over uit te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de winsten van oliebedrijven

CDA MPs asked the government whether it considers oil company profits from high energy prices morally acceptable, whether share buybacks and higher dividends are acceptable, what a reasonable profit is, and whether companies invest enough in the energy transition and should contribute more. The minister answers that the government has no moral judgement on lawful profits, that companies may use profits as they see fit, that it will steer investment through carbon pricing, subsidies and tailored agreements, and gives no view on a reasonable profit level.
In general, the cabinet has no moral judgement on profits that profit-seeking companies make, as long as this happens within the rules and they pay fair tax on them.
In algemene zin heeft het kabinet geen moreel oordeel over winsten die bedrijven met een winstoogmerk boeken, zolang dit binnen de regels gebeurt en zij hierover een eerlijke belasting afdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het Acantus-arrest en de gevolgen daarvan voor de warmtetransitie

An MP asked the minister whether the Supreme Court's Acantus ruling, which treats collective heat installations as inseparable from dwellings so that capital and maintenance costs must be recovered through the rent, will undermine housing corporations' sustainability investments and the heat transition. The minister answered that corporations can factor the ruling into their business cases, that he is not changing the rules, and that he expects the abolition of the landlord levy to provide enough funds, with national performance agreements to follow.

I do not intend to change the laws and regulations on this point, because I am convinced that corporations have sufficient funds for an ambitious sustainability effort following the abolition of the landlord levy.

Ik ben niet voornemens de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt te wijzigen, omdat ik ervan overtuigd ben dat corporaties met de afschaffing van de verhuurderheffing voldoende middelen hebben voor een ambitieuze verduurzamingsinzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over ‘Het reduceren van stikstofuitstoot door het uitkopen van industriële bedrijven’

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk (CDA) asked whether the province of Gelderland could buy out industrial firms to cut nitrogen and CO2 emissions, since existing buyout schemes cover only farms, and whether such buyouts should be possible for all sectors. The minister replied that buyouts are unlikely to be cost-effective for nitrogen in most areas, that provinces may pursue individual buyouts case by case, and pointed to generic policy and the VEKI subsidy scheme for industrial firms.
Provinces can themselves arrive at a tailored solution to buy out an individual industrial company, provided this is effective and efficient.
Provincies kunnen zelf tot een maatwerkoplossing komen om een individueel industrieel bedrijf op te kopen mits dit doeltreffend en doelmatig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de huidige situatie omtrent de kolencentrales

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked about extra gas use, storage fill levels, compensation costs, CCS feasibility and cost, alternative fuels for coal plants, and whether the Urgenda emission target will be met. The minister answered with estimates (2.5 to 3 bcm extra gas per year, storage fill rise of about 7 percentage points per bcm), declined to give an exact compensation figure pending a letter before summer, and said the Urgenda target is becoming likely for 2022.
As promised, I will send a letter on coal before the summer.
Zoals toegezegd kom ik voor de zomer met een brief over kolen.

Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de oproep van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt om een algemeen prioriteringskader op te stellen om projecten voor de energietransitie voorrang te geven bij het uitbreiden

Parliamentarian Bontenbal (CDA) asks whether grid operators may prioritise energy-transition and public-interest grid expansion projects over first-come-first-served, and how the government views the ACM's call for a prioritisation framework. Minister Jetten replies that a prioritisation guideline for expansion investments is being developed with ACM, grid operators and local governments, to be presented after summer, while non-discrimination limits prioritising individual connection rights.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over de rechtszaak omtrent het toepassen van de partiële vrijstelling voor stikstof (bouwvrijstelling) bij het CO2-opslagproject Porthos

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk (CDA) asked about the Council of State case by MOB against the nitrogen construction exemption used for the Porthos CO2 storage project and wind-at-sea permits, and about the consequences of a negative ruling for energy projects and CO2 reduction. The minister replied that the cabinet trusts the exemption's justification, awaits the court, is preparing scenarios, and that a negative ruling would cause delays for many energy projects with no concrete generic fix yet.
The cabinet has confidence in the justification of the construction exemption. It is now up to the judge to rule on the Porthos case / the construction exemption.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de onderbouwing van de bouwvrijstelling. Het is nu aan de rechter om over de zaak Porthos /de bouwvrijstelling te oordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de 'Kamerbrief over stimuleren van hernieuwbare waterstof in jaarverplichting energie vervoer voor periode 2023 en 2024' en het TNO-rapport 'Impact 'fit for 55' voorstel voor

Deputy Bontenbal (CDA) asked about the TNO report on the RED revision's green hydrogen demand in transport, the 4 PJ cap on hydrogen in the annual obligation, and the viability of the refinery route after 2025. Minister Jetten answered that the RED III targets are still under negotiation, that TNO's study of all routes is due in June, and that a decision accompanying the letter addresses the refinery route from 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over aanvullende voorzieningen bij verzorgingsplaatsen langs rijkswegen

MP Bontenbal asked the state secretary about charging points as additional facilities at rest stops along motorways, including term lengths, size relative to basic facilities, safety, and whether the 2018 court ruling on fair allocation is respected. Minister Harbers answered that both permits run up to 15 years, that no numerical cap applies to additional charging points, that the ruling did not equate additional and basic facilities, and that existing policy stays in force pending the 'Verzorgingsplaats van de toekomst' project with a new letter before 1 July.
The Hague Court of Appeal (ruling of 24 July 2018) did not in fact rule that an additional facility amounts to the same thing as a basic facility, but rather emphasised the differences.

Het Gerechtshof in Den Haag (arrest, 24 juli 2018) heeft overigens niet geoordeeld dat een aanvullende voorziening op hetzelfde neerkomt als een basisvoorziening, maar heeft juist de verschillen onderstreept.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht 'Online criminelen bestoken de wereld met cyberaanvallen vanuit Nederland'

An MP asked the ministers of Justice, Economic Affairs and the State Secretary for Interior about reports that criminals use Dutch servers and hosting resellers for cyberattacks, asking about scale, enforcement, cooperation and hosting-sector responsibility. The government answered that ransomware is a growing threat with low reporting rates, that enforcement is complicated by foreign perpetrators and anonymity, and that it supports EU measures and sector codes while pointing to ongoing coalition agreement work.
If your House requests a technical briefing, this can be provided.
Indien uw Kamer verzoekt om een technische briefing kan daarin worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over zwembaden die door hoge energieprijzen tot wanhoop gedreven worden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport how swimming pools and sports halls facing high energy prices could be kept open and affordable. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to VAT cuts, municipal sports funding for energy costs, and sustainability subsidies, and said a Mulier Institute study is pending.
The Cabinet has proposed several generic measures to mitigate the consequences of this price increase, including lowering the VAT on energy from 21 to 9 percent as of 1 July 2022.
Het Kabinet heeft enkele generieke maatregelen voorgenomen om de gevolgen van deze prijsstijging te dempen waaronder verlaging van de btw op energie van 21 naar 9 procent per 1 juli 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over problemen in de glastuinbouwsector als gevolg van de aanhoudend hoge energieprijzen

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about financial distress in greenhouse horticulture caused by high energy prices, including SDE++ subsidies falling with gas prices and possible project shutdowns. The ministers acknowledged the problems, said they are in talks with the sector and banks, explained the SDE++ design, declined to intervene in the subsidy scheme, and promised a letter to parliament in April.
We have no information that would allow us to assess how many projects this concerns.
Wij hebben geen informatie waardoor wij kunnen beoordelen om hoeveel projecten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat laadpalenbedrijf Allego stopt met investeringen in langzame laders

Member Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister whether charging company Allego's decision to stop investing in slow public chargers, and the resulting need for a new placement strategy, was recognised, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary acknowledged the news, said the 'pole follows car' approach still works but new methods such as proactive placement and charging squares are being pursued under the national agenda, and undertook to re-examine the Klimaatakkoord charger targets.
I see that the transition to electric driving is taking place ever faster.
Ik zie dat de transitie naar elektrisch rijden steeds sneller plaats vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Geurts over de export van vervuilende brandstoffen naar Afrika

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the export of high-sulphur, polluting fuels from the Netherlands to West Africa, the ILT's voluntary talks with refineries, whether the approach reduces emissions, and the legal basis for enforcement. The government answered that the ILT is enforcing the environmental duty of care on Dutch fuel exporters, pursuing international fuel standards via UNEP and ECOWAS, and considering regulatory changes, while rejecting a separate external study.
The ILT is authorised under article 18.2b of the Environmental Management Act and holds these companies to their statutory duty of care.
De ILT is hiertoe bevoegd op basis van artikel 18.2b uit de Wet milieubeheer en spreekt deze bedrijven aan op het naleven van hun wettelijke zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Grote problemen op stroomnet, provincies willen kiezen wie aansluiting krijgt'

MPs Kröger and Bontenbal asked the minister about reports that provinces want to choose which companies get grid connections, and about giving provinces a bigger role in energy infrastructure. The minister sympathised with prioritisation but said priority-setting at connection stage conflicts with EU non-discrimination rules, so he will explore prioritisation earlier via spatial planning and objective, transparent investment criteria, and report by summer.
I am examining whether provinces and municipalities can set priorities and make selections at an earlier stage, via the zoning plan and other instruments of environmental law.
Zo onderzoek ik of provincies en gemeenten in een eerder stadium kunnen prioriteiten en selecteren via het bestemminsplan en andere instrumenten uit de omgevingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de energietaken van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM)

Deputy MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the government about the consequences of a September 2021 EU Court of Justice ruling on the independence of national energy regulators for ACM's tariff powers, the Energiewet, gas connection removal costs, the volume correction scheme, offshore wind cost recovery and connection deadlines. Minister Jetten answered that the national legislator may no longer set certain tariff rules, which are being removed from the draft Energiewet, that existing tariffs stay valid for 2022, and that ACM will handle connection deadlines, while declining to provide detailed connection-time data.
The ruling means that ACM, rather than the legislator, will have to set or approve the deadlines for realising connections and ensure compliance with European principles.

De uitspraak betekent dat de ACM in plaats van de wetgever de termijnen voor het realiseren van aansluitingen zal moeten vaststellen of goedkeuren en daarbij moet zorgen dat wordt voldaan aan de Europese beginselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over afstandsnormen voor windturbines

An MP (CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Energy for a timeline on new wind turbine distance norms, how the government will bridge the gap for local authorities and existing and new projects, the expected wind-on-land capacity for 2030 and 2050, and whether noise standards will be updated. The minister gave timelines for the RIVM report, the external study and the planMER (new rules expected from mid-2023), offered support to local authorities and consultation with VNG and IPO, and answered the other questions largely by referring to the ongoing planMER procedure.
The external study on the effects of different distance norms and the pros and cons of a distance norm as an instrument for wind turbine siting is expected to be delivered at the end of March.

Het externe onderzoek, naar de effecten van verschillende afstandsnormen en de voor- en nadelen van een afstandsnorm als instrument voor de inpassing van windturbines, wordt naar verwachting eind maart opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over knelpunten in de biovergistingssector

An MP asked about financial distress in the biogas fermentation sector caused by energy price volatility, the risk of large SDE++ subsidy clawbacks, and possible bankruptcies, and proposed individual accountant-based recalculation and an independent review. The minister acknowledged the problem, referred firms to RVO for possible offsetting, and rejected individual recalculation and an independent review, noting that fixed-price contracts are a business risk.
I have less insight into recent developments in feedstock prices for fermenters, as these are very diverse in nature and price formation is not transparent here.
Ik heb in mindere mate zicht op de recente ontwikkeling van de prijs van grondstoffen voor vergisters aangezien deze zeer divers van aard zijn en de prijsvorming hier niet transparant is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bontenbal over CO2-levering aan de glastuinbouw

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked why the Amsterdam waste-energy company AEB chose CCS without supplying captured CO2 to greenhouse horticulture, and what barriers and government role exist for CO2 supply and combined CCS/CCU. The minister acknowledges the choice, says the sector needs about 2.5 Mton externally sourced CO2 and that the SDE++ and CO2 allocation pilot still have flexibility and legal-clarity barriers, while committing to a new convenant and a possible roadmap before summer.
If necessary, agreements can also be made there to draw up a roadmap. We will come back to this before the summer.
Zo nodig kunnen daar ook afspraken in worden gemaakt om roadmap op te stellen. Hier komen we voor de zomer op terug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit in Nederland

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the Dutch government about the security of electricity supply in the Netherlands, including European coordination, TenneT's monitoring, neighbouring countries' nuclear and coal phase-outs, and the coal CO2 cap. The minister answered that supply adequacy is currently sufficient, that a strategic reserve is the preferred option if needed, that TenneT will supplement its 2021 monitoring within two months, and that a CO2 import/export correction will be considered when the Climate Act is amended.
TenneT has indicated that it will make an additional analysis of the Security of Supply Monitoring 2021 within two months for 2022 regarding the coal plant measures.

TenneT heeft inmiddels aangegeven voor het jaar 2022 binnen twee maanden een aanvullende analyse te zullen maken op de Monitoring Leveringszekerheid 2021 met betrekking tot de maatregelen voor de kolencentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Bontenbal over het fragment ’80 miljoen zonnepanelen in 2024 zijn een tikkende milieutijdbom’

MPs Hagen and Bontenbal asked the state secretary about reports that financing for recycling solar panels is not secured, including the 13 cent per panel fee and how it compares with Belgium's system. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said the current fee covers only present costs, and pointed to producer organisation OPEN as primarily responsible while it develops a financing roadmap and a possible removal fund.
The financing of high-quality processing of future discarded solar panels is not in order.
De financiering van een hoogwaardige verwerking van vrijkomende afgedankte zonnepanelen in de toekomst is niet op orde.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de fors hogere elektriciteits- en gasprijzen

The CDA MP Bontenbal asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about sharply higher electricity and gas prices, including whether this amounts to a European energy crisis, its causes, and how households and firms are affected. The government answered that prices reflect tight global supply and demand, that gas storage is adequate for protected users and monitored, that support measures and a ministerial taskforce are in place, and that the next government will address storage obligations.

I will also ask TenneT in good time next year to assess whether security of supply is sufficiently in order for the coming winter as well, or whether additional measures are needed that can then be developed.

Ook zal ik TenneT tijdig in het komende jaar vragen om te beoordelen of leveringszekerheid ook in de volgende winter voldoende op orde is, dan wel dat aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn die dan kunnen worden uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Welkom Energie officieel failliet: gedupeerde klanten zien kans op compensatie slinken’

The MP asks about the bankruptcy of energy supplier Welkom Energie, whose roughly 90,000 customers may lose money such as overpaid advances, and how government protects consumers from price rises and supplier failures. The Secretary of State explains that insolvency rules apply equally to all creditors so consumers are unsecured creditors with uncertain recovery, that the government is reviewing ACM supervision and financial requirements for suppliers, and that a Energiewet with stricter oversight is being prepared.

I want to examine whether it is desirable and feasible to impose further requirements in this area and, if so, which requirements best achieve the goal and are workable for both energy suppliers and the ACM.

Ik wil onderzoeken of het wenselijk en mogelijk is om hier nadere eisen aan te stellen en zo ja, welke eisen het doel het beste bereiken en goed uitvoerbaar zijn voor zowel energieleveranciers als de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Klink, Amhaouch en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Kabinet maakt reuzendraai: stopt toch met financieren fossiele brandstofprojecten in het buitenland'
