MPs from VVD and CDA asked the government about the impact of signing the COP26 pledge to end international public support for unabated fossil energy by end 2022, including effects on firms, jobs, existing export credit insurance, transition support and funding. The minister answered that roughly a quarter of the export credit portfolio is fossil-linked, that 39 countries and institutions have signed, that new policy will be implemented by end 2022, and that existing policies and contracts are unaffected.
In 2022 the cabinet will work on new policy to end international public support for the fossil energy sector, particularly regarding the export credit insurance (ekv).
Het kabinet zal in 2022 werken aan nieuw beleid voor het beëindigen van internationale overheidssteun aan de fossiele energie sector, in het bijzonder voor wat betreft de ekv.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Bontenbal over het onderzoek van Indufor naar biomassa uit Estland, in reactie op het SOMO-rapport

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about an Indufor peer review that disputes the SOMO report on Estonian wood pellet sustainability, and about why the NGOs left the biomass covenant. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands Emissions Authority is investigating the matter, declined to judge either report's content before that inquiry concludes, and defended the continued use of biomass for high-value applications.
Once the NEa investigation is completed, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra het onderzoek van de NEa is afgerond zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over zonnepanelen op daken

The MP asks about the technical rooftop area available for solar panels, structural load limits, provincial subsidies for weak roofs, system cost distortions in SDE++ and municipal powers to require panels. The government answers that data are limited, points to studies and the RES framework, says subsidies for weak roofs are a choice for a new cabinet, and describes a draft Bbl amendment allowing municipalities to require panels for industrial and other buildings.
The Minister of BZK and I have only limited information on the technical rooftop area available for placing solar panels.
De Minister van BZK en ik beschikken maar beperkt over informatie over het technische potentieel aan dakoppervlakte dat beschikbaar is voor de plaatsing van zonnepanelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Geurts over collectieve warmtesystemen in de gebouwde omgeving

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary about heat networks: the forfaitair efficiency assumption in energy labels, the supply temperature for district heating, the size of heat districts, and local government capacity to set them. The State Secretary defended the forfaitair method and the energy label design, argued that the draft law's criteria protect optimisation and innovation, noted the Expertise Centrum Warmte and ongoing talks with VNG and IPO for support, and rejected the suggested conflict of interests.
Municipalities have by far the most knowledge of the specific characteristics of the local situation.
Gemeenten hebben bij uitstek kennis van de specifieke kenmerken van de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Leijten over de investering in groen staal door ArcelorMittal en de overheden in België

MPs Bontenbal and Leijten asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about ArcelorMittal's green steel investment in Ghent with Flemish government support, and how it compares with Tata Steel IJmuiden's decarbonisation plans, including state participation, state aid rules, SSAB's withdrawn takeover interest. The minister answered that the plans are broadly similar, that the Dutch state is only examining possible support for Tata Steel without any financial commitment yet, and that a progress letter will follow before year end.
You will be informed about the state of affairs by letter to the House before the end of the year.
Over de stand van zaken wordt u voor het einde van het jaar middels een kamerbrief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Bontenbal, Erkens en Grinwis over de stijgende gasprijzen

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about rising gas and energy prices, including household exposure, the causes, the Hermans motion funds, and whether France-style price freezes or targeted support should be used. The government answered that most households face higher bills, outlined temporary energy tax reductions for 2022 and a 150 million euro scheme for vulnerable households via municipalities, and rejected price regulation as market-distorting.
This therefore requires an individual assessment of the situation of all households. That information is not available.
Dit vergt dus een individuele beoordeling van de situatie van alle huishoudens. Die informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Hagen over investeringszekerheid en annex IX, A biobrandstoffen

MPs Bontenbal and Hagen asked the state secretary about soy-based biofuels under E10, the treatment of biomethanol from the gas grid, blending rules, and whether the opt-in for Annex IX-A biofuels in shipping would continue to give investment certainty. The state secretary answered that no soy oil was used, that grid-based methanol will qualify for HBEs under conditions from 2022, that blending of fossil and renewable fuels remains restricted, and that the opt-in for shipping will run until 2025 before moving to sector-specific policy.
I intend to continue this as manageably as possible until 1 January 2025 in the Energy Decree that is before your House.
Ik ben voornemens dit tot 1 januari 2025 zo beheersbaar mogelijk voort te zetten in het Besluit energie dat bij uw Kamer voorligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de stijgende energieprijzen

MPs Erkens and Bontenbal asked the state secretary about rising gas and electricity prices, their scenarios, impact on sectors and households, flexible contracts, measures in other countries, and the role of nuclear energy. The state secretary answered on substance but deferred a promised letter on household purchasing-power effects and possible measures to the budget debate, and noted a planned tax-reduction measure under motion Hermans.
The cabinet will come back to this before the budget debate and the third round of the General Financial Deliberations.
Het kabinet zal hier voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling en de derde termijn van de Algemene Financiële Beschouwingen op terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Peters over Europese Missie voor 100 klimaat neutrale steden tegen 2030

MPs from the CDA asked how the Dutch government will engage with the EU Cities Mission (100 climate-neutral cities by 2030), including its role in the City Climate Contract, selection criteria and funding. The State Secretary answers that BZK and EZK coordinate the mission, that the government will decide later whether to co-sign contracts, that selection is up to cities, and that about EUR 300 million is reserved at EU level without geographic earmarking.
Whether the national government should play a major role in this and how that could take shape is not yet clear at this moment.
Of de rijksoverheid hierin een grote rol moet spelen en hoe dat vorm zou kunnen krijgen, is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bontenbal over koolstofvastlegging

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked the Minister of Agriculture about the potential of carbon sequestration in agriculture, how carbon farming can improve farmers' earnings, whether Commissioner Timmermans' view that the Netherlands is unsuitable for large-scale soil carbon storage is shared, what support is offered to farmers, and what a proposed AFOLU merger could mean for the agricultural sector. The minister answered each question in substance, giving sequestration estimates, outlining revenue options, describing support programmes and pilots, and stating that the AFOLU implications are still being assessed and will be reported to parliament via the BNC route.
Parliament will be further informed about this via the BNC route.
Uw Kamer zal via de BNC-route hier nader over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over nieuwe generatie kernenergie

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the role of new-generation nuclear technologies such as SMRs and fusion, costs, a possible EU programme and a tender system, and why nuclear was excluded from the Klimaatakkoord. The State Secretary answered that nuclear remains an open option, SMRs are not yet commercially available and carry first-of-a-kind risks, a tender is premature, and extra nuclear before 2030 is unlikely.
As announced when offering the market consultation on nuclear energy, I will have a scenario study drawn up for the period 2030 onward beyond 2050.
Zoals aangekondigd bij het aanbieden van de marktconsultatie kernenergie zal ik een scenario-studie (voor de periode 2030-verder dan 2050) laten opstellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bontenbal over mogelijke extra kosten bij snelladers voor automobilisten

MPs Geurts and Bontenbal asked whether drivers at DC fast chargers receive less energy than they pay for, and whether a legal framework is needed for metering. The State Secretary replied that energy loss is priced in, consumer rules already apply, and she will push for harmonised EU metrology rules and consider national rules once international standards exist.
I suggest the next cabinet consider, once there is international agreement on the requirements, whether it is possible and desirable to anchor them in national regulation in advance.

Ik geef het volgende kabinet in overweging om, zodra er internationale overeenstemming is over de te stellen eisen, te bezien of het mogelijk en wenselijk is deze alvast in nationale regelgeving te verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Pieter Heerma over belemmeringen bij hypothecaire financiering van verduurzaming eigen woning

CDA MPs asked why few lenders use the no-advice route for extra mortgages to finance home insulation, and whether the five-year limit and taxation costs should be dropped. The minister said the route was only recently opened and systems take time, kept the five-year limit for consumer-knowledge reasons, and pointed to hybrid valuations and subsidies as cost mitigations.

I see no reason to drop the five-year limit because it cannot simply be assumed that after five years the knowledge about the financial product is still sufficient to take out an additional mortgage without advice.

Ik zie geen reden om de termijn van vijf jaar te laten vervallen omdat er niet zonder meer vanuit kan worden gegaan dat na deze periode van vijf jaar de kennis over het financieel product nog voldoende is om zonder advies een aanvullende hypotheek af te sluiten.

m: Motie van de leden Sneller en Rahimi over het verzoek aan het Presidium om in overleg met de Eerste Kamer te komen tot structurele financiering van Parlement.com
Asks the Presidium, together with the Eerste Kamer, to amend the Staten-Generaal budget to fund the Parlement.com website structurally from 2025.
requests the Presidium, in consultation with the Eerste Kamer, to come to a joint proposal to amend the budget of the Staten-Generaal
verzoekt het Presidium in overleg met de Eerste Kamer tot een gezamenlijk voorstel te komen om de begroting van de Staten-Generaal aan te passen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Sneller en Rahimi over middelen voor Parlement.com
Shifts 250 thousand euro within the democracy budget as bridge funding for the parlement.com website.
with this amendment the submitter provides bridge funding of € 250,000 for 2024
met dit amendement voorziet de indiener in een overbruggingsfinanciering van € 250.000 voor 2024
Amendement van de leden Sneller en Rahimi over middelen voor Parlement.com
Moves 400,000 euro from the policy article on public administration and democracy to the general article so that the Montesquieu Institute can maintain parlement.com structurally.
Therefore the submitters propose structurally making € 400,000 available to the Montesquieu Institute to keep maintaining this knowledge source.
Daarom stellen indieners voor structureel € 400.000 ter beschikking te stellen aan het Montesquieu Instituut om deze kennisbron te blijven onderhouden.
Amendement van de leden Amhaouch en Rahimi ter vervanging van nr. 13 over een subsidie voor Mijn digitale zaak voor mkb-ondernemers
Shifts 1 million euro within the EZK budget to fund the Mijn Digitale Zaak subsidy for small businesses in 2023.
Funding is found within policy article 2 (promoting entrepreneurship).
Dekking wordt gevonden in beleidsartikel 2 (bevorderen ondernemerschap).
Amendement van het lid Rahimi c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het schrappen van de vrijwillige donatie van ondernemers aan het Ondernemersklankbord
Shifts 350 thousand euro within the entrepreneurship budget to remove the voluntary donation by entrepreneurs to the Ondernemersklankbord for 2023.
Motie van de leden Rahimi en Amhaouch over de houdbaarheid van regels voor mkb-ondernemers
Asks the government to review the durability of rules for small business via an SME test, a one-year post-implementation check on complaints, and a general evaluation after five years.
invariably a general evaluation after five years
steevast een algehele evaluatie na vijf jaar
Motie van het lid Graus c.s. over integraal nationaal maritiem industriebeleid onder regie van de minister van EZK
Asks the government for an integrated national maritime industrial policy led by the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate.
requests the government to develop an integrated national maritime industrial policy under the direction of the Minister of EZK
verzoekt de regering om een integraal nationaal maritiem industriebeleid onder regie van de Minister van EZK
Motie van de leden Romke de Jong en Rahimi over met verzekeraars om tafel gaan om te kijken naar knelpunten bij het verzekeren van zonnepanelen op bedrijfsdaken
Asks the government to meet insurers to identify obstacles to insuring solar panels on business roofs and to explore a guarantee fund for solar panel debris.
requests the government to sit down with insurers to see where the bottlenecks are
verzoekt de regering met verzekeraars om tafel te gaan om te kijken waar de knelpunten zitten
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over het opstellen van een meerjarenplan voor de ROM's
Asks the government, together with provinces, to draw up a multi-year plan for the regional development companies (ROMs), including support for SMEs.
requests the government, together with provinces, to draw up a multi-year plan for the ROMs
verzoekt de regering om samen met provincies een meerjarenplan op te stellen voor de ROM's
Motie van de leden Graus en Rahimi over regierol om disproportionele regeldruk en onnodige nationale koppen te voorkomen en de mkb-toets voor regelgeving te borgen
Asks the Minister of Economic Affairs to take a coordinating role to prevent disproportionate regulatory burden and gold-plating and to secure the SME test for regulation.

requests the government to assign a coordinating role to the Minister of EZK to prevent disproportionate regulatory burden and unnecessary national gold-plating and to secure the SME test for existing and new regulation

verzoekt de regering om een regierol voor de Minister van EZK ter voorkoming van disproportionele regeldruk en onnodige nationale koppen en om de mkb-toets voor bestaande en nieuwe regelgeving te borgen
Amendement van het lid Rahimi over het schrappen van de vrijwillige donatie van ondernemers aan het Ondernemersklankbord
Proposes removing the 2023 voluntary donation by entrepreneurs to the Ondernemersklankbord, funded from the entrepreneurship budget; a budget shift without bearing on executive checks.
The total cost is 350,000 euro for 2023. This is covered from the budget for promoting entrepreneurship.
De totale kosten hiervoor bedragen 350.000 euro voor 2023. Dit wordt gedekt uit het budget bevorderen ondernemerschap.
Amendement van het lid Rahimi c.s. over het opnemen van een hardheidsclausule voor voorraadhoudende detailhandelaars.
Amendment adding a hardship clause allowing retailers holding stock to agree payment terms up to 60 days under the late-payment rules.
The submitters therefore propose including a limited hardship clause in the bill.
Daarom stellen de indieners voor een beperkte hardheidsclausule op te nemen in het wetsvoorstel.
Motie van het lid Rahimi over onderzoeken of als gevolg van de wet nadelen zijn ontstaan voor de detaillisten in het mkb
Asks the government to examine in the law's evaluation whether small retailers in the mkb suffered disadvantages from shorter payment terms and to report to the House.
requests the government, in the evaluation of the law, to examine whether disadvantages have arisen for mkb retailers as a result of this law
verzoekt de regering bij de evaluatie van de wet te onderzoeken of als gevolg van deze wet nadelen zijn ontstaan voor de detaillisten in het mkb
Amendement van het lid Rahimi c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het opnemen van een hardheidsclausule voor voorraadhoudende detailhandelaars
Adds a hardship clause allowing parties to agree payment terms of up to 60 days for stock-holding retailers facing unforeseen or unreasonable harm from the 30-day limit.
The new seventh paragraph sets two requirements for applying the hardship clause.
Het nieuwe zevende lid stelt twee vereisten aan de toepassing van de hardheidsclausule.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Experts sabelen overheid neer om belangrijke websites als DigiD: ‘Pas nu domeinnaam aan’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about calls to move key government websites such as DigiD to a uniform .gov or .overheid domain to counter cybercrime and phishing. The State Secretary answered that a national top-level domain is not possible for now, that a second-level domain such as overheid.nl or gov.nl is being worked on with an implementation approach to follow, and that such a change alone will not prevent cybercrime.
An implementation approach for a single extension is currently being worked on.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een implementatie-aanpak voor één extensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Ellian over het bericht 'Ambtenaar vervalste meerdere rapporten over beveiliging DigiD-aansluiting'

MPs Rahimi and Ellian asked about reports that an official at Justis falsified security audit reports for DigiD connections, including the 2020 Suwinet report. The minister answers that the official acted outside his assigned duties, four-eyes checks were introduced, digital signing and mandatory digital submission from 2024 were adopted, and a risk assessment and cause investigation are ongoing.
After the manipulation was discovered, the audit process at Justis was improved and tightened, for example by introducing the four-eyes principle.
Na de constatering van de manipulatie is bij Justis het auditproces verbeterd en aangescherpt, zo is bijvoorbeeld het vierogenprincipe ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Slootweg over het bericht 'Digitale identiteit voor burgers: doelen behaald, maar nog onduidelijkheid over toekomstige inlogmiddelen'

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about an Court of Audit report on digital identity, fearing that stricter login security from 1 July 2023 could leave many citizens unable to log in to government services because a central connection point is not yet ready. The State Secretary replied that SMS login remains available, that connection of service providers will be gradual through 2024-2026 with DigiD and eHerkenning kept in place until then, and that the government will consult parliament before changing SMS login policy.
I have indicated that I will consult with your House before any changes are made to this policy starting point.
Ik heb aangegeven dat ik in overleg met uw Kamer zal treden voordat er wijzigingen plaatsvinden in dit beleidsuitgangspunt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Rajkowski en Rahimi over de berichten 'Naaktbeelden borstkankerpatiënten VS gepubliceerd om ziekenhuis af te persen' en 'Paspoorten van dokters op straat na hack bij oudereninstel

MPs Hermans, Rajkowski and Rahimi (VVD) asked about reports of ransomware attacks on Dutch healthcare institutions, leaked patient and staff data, and how the sector and Z-CERT protect against cyber threats. The minister answered that five ransomware incidents were registered in 2022, outlined existing security norms, Z-CERT support, awareness measures and the National Cybersecurity Strategy, and promised to answer the earlier related questions before the 30 March debate.
I am not aware of how many of these incidents involved patient or staff data being stolen.
Het is mij niet bekend bij hoeveel van deze incidenten er gegevens van patiënten of (zorg-)medewerkers zijn ontvreemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Oude ict kost fiscus miljoenen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that outdated ICT costs the tax authority millions, requesting yearly ICT spending, modernisation ratios, timelines, tender plans, and the link to tax morale. The State Secretary gave detailed budget and portfolio figures, a 2026 modernisation target, and declined to reveal the timing of upcoming tenders for commercial and legal reasons while promising to answer each question.
For tenders that are in preparation or will be brought to the market in the near future, the Tax Authority gives no advance insight.
In aanbestedingen die in voorbereiding zijn of in de nabije toekomst op de markt zullen worden gebracht, wordt door de Belastingdienst geen inzage vooraf gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rahimi over het bericht 'Stille ramp in bakkerswereld: 'We kunnen straks geen brood meer bakken''

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a newspaper report on crisis-hit SMEs such as bakeries, including whether government will map affected sectors and coordinate across ministries. The minister answered that support such as the energy cost tegemoetkoming (TEK) and tax payment deferral is available, that some firms may still have to close, and that departments already cooperate and monitor sector signals.
It is therefore also not excluded that companies will be forced to close due to high energy costs, however drastic in individual cases.
Het is daarom ook niet uitgesloten dat bedrijven door de hoge energiekosten gedwongen zullen moeten sluiten, hoe ingrijpend in individuele gevallen ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Bouwend Nederland: trage betalingen Rijk kosten bouwsector miljarden'

MPs Rahimi and De Groot asked the Minister about reports that the central government pays construction SMEs only after about 75 days, far beyond the legal 30-day term, and what this means for project delays and supplier exits. The Minister answered that the 75 days includes time before invoices are submitted, that over 95% of central government invoices are paid within 30 days, and that no link to project delays or supplier withdrawal has been found, while promising to inventory payment bottlenecks and inform the House before summer.

That is why I have committed to inventorying, with the relevant ministers of Finance, Interior and Kingdom Relations, and Infrastructure and Water Management, where problems arise in the process regarding late payment and how we can speed this up.

Daarom heb ik toegezegd om met de betrokken bewindspersonen van Financiën, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Infrastructuur en Waterstaat te inventariseren waar in het proces problemen ontstaan met betrekking tot late betaling en hoe we dat kunnen versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Kabinet wil minder fastfoodwinkels in de stad’

MPs Heerema and Rahimi asked whether the government will restrict fast-food outlets, how this fits EU and national rules on freedom of enterprise, and what the preventive agreements and industry commitments achieve. The State Secretary answered that legal options for municipalities to shape the food environment are being explored, subject to EU Services Directive justification, and that industry product-improvement steps are underway.
I am having the options explored to give municipalities more legal tools in this area.
Ik laat de mogelijkheden verkennen om gemeenten op dit vlak daarom meer juridische handvatten te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Ondernemers sneller in problemen door uitzondering in faillissementswet’

MPs Ellian and Rahimi asked whether the WHOA out-of-court insolvency settlement scheme works in practice, and what the Supreme Court ruling that pension premiums fall under the employee exception means for restructurings. The minister reported about 200 declarations and 23 homologation decisions so far, said an evaluation is planned by end 2023, and promised to discuss the consultation results with the insolvency sector and social partners before summer and inform the House in autumn.
How often a WHOA process has led to a settlement before the court became involved is not known, because the vast majority of these processes take place in confidentiality.
Hoe vaak een WHOA-traject heeft geresulteerd in een akkoord nog voordat de rechter daarbij aan te pas kwam, is niet bekend omdat veruit de meeste van deze trajecten in beslotenheid plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Rahimi over het UBO-register

MPs Heinen and Rahimi asked the Finance Minister about privacy and safety concerns for UBOs in the public beneficial ownership register, the pending CJEU case and Advocate General Pitruzella's opinion, and whether the registration deadline should be postponed. The minister acknowledged the concerns, defended the existing privacy safeguards, said the AG's points largely align with Dutch practice and that no postponement is warranted, while promising to follow the final CJEU ruling.
In view of the AG's conclusion, which largely aligns with the Dutch implementation, I see no reason to postpone the registration deadline.
Gelet op de conclusie van de A-G, welke in belangrijke mate in lijn ligt met de Nederlandse implementatie, zie ik geen aanleiding tot uitstel van de deadline tot registratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rahimi over het bericht 'Mkb’er kiest voor lening om aan eisen banken te voldoen'

Rep. Rahimi asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she is talking with banks and entrepreneurs about SMEs being pushed into costlier financing and whether she will act on the resulting funding gap. The Minister says her ministry consults banks and entrepreneurs regularly, points to existing guarantees and funds (BMKB, Qredits, DACI, a planned SME equity fund) and promises a reply to the Comité voor Ondernemerschap advice in spring.
In the spring I will send a response to this advice to your House.
Ik zal in het voorjaar een reactie op dit advies aan uw Kamer sturen.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Lahlah c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over een voorhang voor de maatregel voor visueel toezicht en de maximering van het aantal rechtsbijstandverleners
Adds a four-week waiting period before the government submits to parliament a general administrative order on visual supervision and lawyer limits for detainees.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under the first sentence will not be submitted earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens de eerste zin vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Lahlah c.s. over een zware voorhang voor de maatregel voor visueel toezicht en de maximering van het aantal rechtsbijstandverleners

Adds a heavy prior-parliamentary submission (voorhang) requirement of four weeks before the general administrative orders on visual supervision of detainee-lawyer contacts and limiting lawyers are submitted, with a right for parliament to require a statute.
By adding a heavy prior-submission procedure to a general administrative order that elaborates the proposed Article 38(8) and Article 40a, this legitimacy is further regulated and emphasised.

Door het toevoegen van een zware voorhangprocedure aan een algemene maatregel van bestuur die het voorgestelde artikel 38, achtste lid, en het voorgestelde artikel 40a, uitwerkt, wordt deze legitimiteit nog eens extra geregeld en benadrukt.
Amendement van het lid Uitermark over het kunnen raadplegen van de rechter en het betrekken van een gedragskundige voor een advies over de persoonlijkheid van de gedetineerde
Lets the minister consult the court that last handled the case, and requires a behavioural expert's advice when a restriction order rests only on the detainee's personality.
the Minister must, in his order, obtain advice from a behavioural expert.
dient de Minister in zijn bevel een advies van een gedragsdeskundige te betrekken.
Motie van de leden Mutluer en Uitermark over een structureel betere afpak-keten met meer samenhang tussen beleid en uitvoering
Motion asks the government to report in the next justice budget on whether a more ambitious asset-recovery target is met, so the Court of Audit can include this in its annual accountability audit.
requests the government to report in the next Justice budget on whether a more ambitious asset-recovery target is met, so that the Court of Audit can include this in its annual accountability audit

verzoekt de regering om in de volgende JenV-begroting te rapporteren over het al dan niet behalen van een ambitieuzer afpakdoel zodat de Algemene Rekenkamer de mogelijkheid heeft om dit te betrekken in haar jaarlijkse verantwoordingsonderzoek
Motie van het lid Uitermark c.s. over de wijze waarop de beroepsgroep van mediators op korte termijn positie kan krijgen in de justitiële keten
Asks the government to consider how the mediators profession can quickly gain a recognised position in the justice chain.
requests the government to consider how the mediators profession can quickly gain a position in the justice chain
verzoekt de regering te bezien op welke wijze de beroepsgroep van mediators op korte termijn positie kan krijgen in de justitiële keten
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark over het bericht ‘Ook mensen met een paar jaar cel niet in gevangenis door personeelstekort’

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that some offenders with multi-year prison sentences are not being summoned to prison due to staff shortages, including those with sentences near four and five years, and asked for breakdowns by sentence length, offence type, and the self-surrender criteria. The Minister confirmed that twelve outstanding self-surrenders have sentences over three years (highest about 4.5 years), that 87.1% have 90 days or less remaining, explained the CJIB assessment framework and the temporary summons stop for adult male self-surrenders, and said the one-week deadline could not be met.
Due to the potential traceability to individuals, I do not provide information on individual cases.
In verband met de potentiële herleidbaarheid naar personen verstrek ik geen informatie over individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uitermark over de artikelen 'Onrust binnen het OM over aanpak van overlastgevende asielzoekers, die een boete betalen middels een celstraf” en 'Met zijn lik-op-stukbeleid zoekt het OM opnie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about press reports that the Public Prosecution Service issued a working instruction letting prosecutors use fines with pre-trial detention set-off against asylum seekers committing minor offences, raising concerns about unlawful detention and political motives. The Minister answered that the instruction was a non-binding route map, the set-off instrument has not been applied because systems are not ready, the detention length depends only on investigative interest, and work on the instrument as a general option is ongoing.
The length of the pre-trial detention is therefore determined solely by the investigative interest and not by the (desired) height of the fine.
De lengte van de inverzekeringstelling wordt dus uitsluitend bepaald door het onderzoeksbelang en niet door de (gewenste) hoogte van de geldboete.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uitermark over het bericht ‘Rechter Haags gerechtshof geschorst na valse ondertekeningen in 43 vonnissen’

An MP asked the Minister whether 43 judgments signed with a false panel of three judges at the Hague Court of Appeal, which generated about 110,000 euro extra income, reflect perverse financing incentives in the judiciary, and asked for investigation of that and of workload effects. The Minister answered that the Raad voor de rechtspraak reports no financial gain for the judge and no likely impact on parties, that the Court has repaid the excess, that an external investigation is commissioned, and that the Minister will await its results and a workload exploration before drawing conclusions.
This does not alter the fact that the Council for the Judiciary sees reason to now commission an external investigation to rule out that a similar method was used elsewhere.
Dit laat onverlet dat de Raad voor de rechtspraak aanleiding ziet nu een extern onderzoek te laten uitvoeren om uit te sluiten dat een vergelijkbare werkwijze elders is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark en Joseph over het bericht 'Richard (35) zit zonder strafblad al 12 jaar opgesloten in tbs-kliniek tussen zware criminelen: hij is niet de enige'

MPs Uitermark and Joseph asked about reports that a psychiatric patient without a criminal sentence has been held for 12 years in a tbs clinic, and about shortages of care places. The minister said seven people without a criminal title are in a level-4 setting for treatment reasons, that a plan of action with sector partners is underway to create temporary and permanent places for about sixty people, and that co-placement is in principle undesirable but may be clinically justified.
I cannot go into the case mentioned in the article and therefore cannot give a judgement on the reporting on this point.
Ik kan hier niet ingaan op de in het artikel genoemde casus en daarom ook geen oordeel geven over de berichtgeving op dit punt.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over het aankomend verbod op gezichtsbedekking tijdens demonstraties

An MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about the planned ban on face coverings at demonstrations, including its compatibility with ECHR Articles 10 and 11, the Hague court ruling, police workload and the effect on protesters fearing foreign repression. The minister confirms work on a statutory ban, says it is in principle legally possible and that a consultation bill is planned this year, while leaving the design, exemptions and police concerns open.
The cabinet shares the concerns of MP Lahlah about the safety of demonstrators who face a security risk when they demonstrate recognisably.
Het deelt daarbij de zorgen van het lid Lahlah over de veiligheid van demonstranten die een veiligheidsrisico lopen wanneer zij herkenbaar demonstreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior which BZK units use or access Palantir software, and whether other projects such as the 'Raffinaderij' use it. The Minister replied that BZK does not use Palantir software, declined to comment on the AIVD, and said the Raffinaderij falls outside BZK's domain, referring to the Justice Minister.
In addition, I refer you to the answers to written parliamentary questions given by the Minister of Justice and Security.
Daarnaast verwijs ik u graag naar de beantwoording van schriftelijke Kamervragen door de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over hoe het demissionaire kabinet omgaat met de keuze voor mailcommunicatie in eigen beheer

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked the caretaker cabinet how it handles the choice to keep government email and data in-house rather than in Microsoft's cloud, including the Exchange support deadline of 14 October 2025 and US sanctions risks. The State Secretary answered that departments decide on cloud use themselves, most ministries and agencies keep mail on-premise, the Belastingdienst is considering a Microsoft365 migration, and the government will sharpen its cloud and digital sovereignty policy without committing to a binding halt.
Departments are themselves responsible for deciding which considerations they make regarding cloud use.
Departementen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk om te bepalen welke afwegingen zij maken rondom cloudgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Lahlah over raadsleden met een uitkering

MPs Chakor and Lahlah asked whether councillors receiving benefits are unduly deterred from office, citing a report on benefit-related salary offsetting. The minister acknowledges the signals but rejects the report's proposals as unworkable, instead pointing to clarification of existing rules and an ongoing WIA policy review.
But I do want to make an effort toward improved and clearer implementation.
Ik wil mij wel inspannen voor een verbeterde en duidelijkere uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen de leden van Baarle en Ergin over het rapport ‘Tussen Minaret en Ministerie’ Ministerie’

Two DENK MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers how the government will restore trust among mosque boards and Muslim communities after the 'Tussen Minaret & Ministerie' report, and whether it will apologise, ban discriminatory policy, appoint a national coordinator against anti-Muslim hatred and hold structured dialogue. The government answered that rebuilding trust is needed and it is pursuing dialogue, a discrimination test in the Beleidskompas, and periodic talks with Muslim organisations, but it declined a separate anti-Muslim-hatred coordinator in favour of a single coordinator for all discrimination grounds.

Nevertheless, the cabinet considers it desirable that the other grounds of discrimination be housed in a single institute, so that fragmentation of attention and approach to these grounds is prevented.
Desalniettemin acht het kabinet het wenselijk dat de overige discriminatiegronden bij één instituut belegd worden, zodat versnippering van de aandacht en aanpak van deze gronden voorkomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het RSJ-advies over het stemrecht van gedetineerden

MPs Van Nispen and Koops asked about the RSJ advice on voting rights for detained persons, noting that practical obstacles cause many votes to be lost and asking what can be improved before the next election. Staatssecretaris Rutte answered that voting by proxy is the statutory route, that DJI will implement several measures including clearer information, proxy forms, a pilot mobile polling station and access to voting aids, and that the RSJ recommendations are adopted where feasible and legally possible.
Where feasible and legally possible, the RSJ recommendations are therefore adopted.
Waar uitvoerbaar en juridisch mogelijk, worden de aanbevelingen van de RSJ daarom overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over iftars op ministeries

An MP asked the Minister of Interior which ministries organised iftar dinners in 2025, on whose initiative, and at what cost, and how facilitating religious gatherings squares with church-state separation and civil servant neutrality. The minister answered that iftars were organised by staff networks or activity committees as part of diversity events, that religion holds no specific place among these, and that this is not contrary to neutrality, with costs listed per ministry.
This approach is not in conflict with the neutrality and/or impartiality of civil servants.
Deze aanpak is niet in strijd met de neutraliteit en/of onpartijdigheid van ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de verlening van subsidie door een gemeente aan een lokale welzijnsorganisatie

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior about a Council of State ruling requiring municipalities to offer competition or justify single-bidder grants when subsidies are scarce, and about its consequences for local governance, bureaucracy and social-sector organisations. The minister answered that the ruling formalises subsidy allocation and adds transparency and work, that legislative change is not currently needed, and that signals of problems for small local organisations will be checked.
I have not yet received signals that the ruling leads to unworkable situations, but I will have this verified with municipalities.
Ik heb vooralsnog geen signalen ontvangen dat de uitspraak tot onwerkbare situaties leidt, maar ik laat dat verifiëren bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Diederik van Dijk over het onderhandelaarsresultaat voor de nieuwe politie-cao

SGP MPs Flach and Van Dijk asked whether the new police collective agreement, which makes three Christian holidays exchangeable for individual leave, undermines commonly recognised public holidays and why parliament was not consulted. The government answered that the holidays remain in the Algemene termijnenwet, that collective bargaining is an employer-union matter, and that the Barp amendment will be prepared via the ministerial process with later publication, but it did not commit to advance parliamentary involvement.
Your House will receive the answers to these questions well before this publication.
Uw Kamer ontvangt ruim voor deze publicatie de beantwoording op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over ‘de groeiende afhankelijkheid van Amerikaanse techgiganten’

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether government organisations, including Logius, would reconsider moving data and services to US cloud providers, and what the risks would be if US access were cut off. The State Secretary answered that Logius does not use US cloud services, that the government is reviewing its cloud policy and exploring a sovereign government cloud, and that several planned migrations were reconsidered or halted.
The revision of the government-wide cloud policy also addresses further reducing dependence on a few suppliers, the so-called market concentration and continuity risks.

4 In de herziening van het rijksbreed cloudbeleid wordt tevens aandacht besteed aan het verder beperken van afhankelijkheid van enkele leveranciers, de zogeheten marktconcentratie- en conti nuïteitsrisico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over de gebrekkige naleving van de Europese toegankelijkheidswetgeving (EAA)

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health and the Interior Ministry about poor compliance with the European Accessibility Act, citing NOS reporting that most Dutch websites fail accessibility criteria, and asked about enforcement, ministry coordination, and complaint channels. The government answered that the directive only binds private firms, that supervisors have adequate powers and mandate, that it is too early to judge effects so an implementation review is planned, and that complaint reporting channels exist though no figures are yet available.
I will therefore first await practical experience and intend, together with the other relevant ministries, to have an implementation review of the European Accessibility Directive carried out.
Ik wacht daarom eerst de praktijkervaringen af en ben voornemens om samen met de andere betrokken ministeries een invoeringstoets op de Europese Toegankelijkheidsrichtlijn te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over “het bericht dat de minister van LVVN haar bevoegdheid misbruikte om de publicatie van emissiegegevens te verhinderen

MP Podt (D66) asks whether Minister Wiersma misused her powers and acted unlawfully by re-running the objection procedure and delaying publication of farm emissions data containing farmers' addresses, despite an Advisory Council and court ruling favouring publication. The minister defends the delay as a careful protection of farmers' privacy and safety, refuses to withdraw the appeal, and promises a study into farmers' social safety.
The use of this power is in accordance with the legal framework and is aimed at careful decision-making, not at delaying disclosure.
Het gebruik van deze bevoegdheid is in overeenstemming met het wettelijk kader en is gericht op een zorgvuldige besluitvorming, niet op het vertragen van openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Patijn over interim-salarissen in de publieke sector

MPs Mohandis and Patijn asked how interim executives in the public sector can combine several assignments to evade the WNT pay cap, and whether the rules should change. The minister says the WNT is not being circumvented, commits to investigating whether the situation recurs and, if so, to proposing an extension of the anti-cumulation rule to interim managers, and explains the enforcement roles of the Tax Authority and supervisory bodies.
Following this case, the Minister of BZK will have it investigated whether the situation described occurs or has occurred more often.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zal de Minister van BZK laten onderzoeken of de beschreven situatie zich vaker voordoet of heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op de leden Dassen en Paternotte over het artikel ‘Baudet ontkent contact met Rusland, maar FVD-Kamerlid Ralf Dekker videobelt met Poetins partij Verenigd Rusland’

Dassen (Volt) and Paternotte (D66) asked the government whether contacts between Forum voor Democratie MPs and sanctioned Russian politicians from Putin's party pose security risks, whether such contacts will be condemned, and whether financial ties and election interference can be ruled out. The government answered that MPs are free to maintain contacts, that Russian influence and the risk of covert interference are recognised, that AIVD awareness briefings and warnings exist, that absolute certainty about sanctions compliance cannot be given (investigation would follow signals), and that election-security measures and EU cooperation are in place.
MPs, like everyone else, are free to maintain contact with anyone.
Kamerleden, net als iedereen, vrij zijn om met eenieder contact te onderhouden.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘intelligence gathered by the Dutch'

An FVD MP asked the Minister of the Interior to provide, possibly confidentially, the intelligence the AIVD allegedly shared with US intelligence services, referenced in an interview as 'intelligence gathered by the Dutch'. The minister answered that specific intelligence would only be shared with the Parliamentary Committee on Intelligence and Security Services if there is cause to do so.
If there is cause to inform the House of specific intelligence, this will happen through the Parliamentary Committee on Intelligence and Security Services.
Indien er aanleiding is om de Kamer op de hoogte te stellen van specifieke inlichtingen, dan gebeurt dat via de Commissie voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Plas over het bericht dat een oud-AIVD’er waarschuwt dat brandstichtingen door dierenextremisten “weer terug dreigen te komen”

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports of animal-rights extremist occupations of slaughterhouses in Apeldoorn and warnings of renewed arson, asking about arrests, threat assessments, prosecution, sanctions listing, and protection of food-chain firms. The government answered that the investigation is ongoing, declined to share intelligence or assess specific groups, reported that 42 people were arrested for trespass but not detained, and promised to invite sector organisations for talks.
At this moment the police, under the authority of the Public Prosecution Service, are investigating these incidents. We cannot anticipate the outcomes.
Op dit moment doet de politie onder gezag van het OM onderzoek naar deze incidenten. Wij kunnen niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op het lid Van Waveren over de spreiding van rijkswerkgelegenheid en de ontwikkeling van de Rijksdienst

An MP asked whether the government still backs its targets for regional distribution of central government jobs, how the coordinating role of the Minister of Interior has been implemented, what concrete relocations have resulted, and how the budget cut (taakstelling) affects regional spreading. The minister answers that the government continues the effort, cites examples and an upcoming annual report, but says concrete results are limited so far and that the cut is left to individual ministers, with a principle that shrinkage happens mainly in the Randstad.

In the annual report on the state of the regional distribution of central government jobs (letter to parliament to be sent in early September), an overview of cases worked on over the past year will be presented, as promised in the committee debate of 5 February 2025.

In de jaarlijkse rapportage over de stand van de spreiding van rijkswerkgelegenheid (Kamerbrief te verzenden begin september) wordt, zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat Regio's en grensoverschrijdende samenwerking van 5 februari 2025, een overzicht gepresenteerd van casussen waaraan het afgelopen jaar is gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel ‘Zwolle weigert te stoppen met geheim overleg, net als tientallen andere gemeenten: ‘Minister moet ingrijpen’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities holding structural closed meetings, such as Zwolle and Tubbergen, violate the openness rules of the Municipalities Act and whether the government will intervene. The minister answered that all preparatory meetings of council committees fall under openness rules, that closed meetings must follow the statutory procedure, and that he will not sanction municipalities via the municipal fund or seek advice from the Raad van State, leaving responsibility with the councils.
Closed meetings must therefore always be an exception and open meetings the rule.
Besloten vergaderingen dienen dan ook altijd een uitzondering te zijn en openbare vergaderingen de regel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over de publicatie van de WRR

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the WRR report on the expert government, covering shortages of expertise in small municipalities, reliance on external consultants, weak career paths for subject specialists, and the planned 22 percent cut to the civil service. The minister answered that the government is exploring expert pools, a personnel strategy, basic training in constitutional law, and a reduction of external hiring, while stating that the cuts are not intended to weaken knowledge.
I do not consider that dependence desirable.
Ik acht die afhankelijkheid niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Haagse rechters, topambtenaren, bestuurders en ceo's zitten in dezelfde club, zonder dat iemand het weet’

MPs Sneller (D66) asked whether membership of exclusive networks such as the Haagse Schouw by judges and senior officials should be registered as secondary positions and disclosed. The minister answers that the Wrra leaves the assessment case by case to the official, that the Leidraad and Gedragscode are for the judiciary to decide, and that transparency must be weighed against freedom of association and privacy, so no automatic disclosure duty follows.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Rotterdam van 11 februari 2025

An MP asked the minister about a Rotterdam court ruling that historical dual-nationality records (code 404) in the BRP are personal data that must be erased when not necessary. The state secretary agreed with the court, said the records will be removed for people who held Dutch nationality from birth, and committed to amending the regulation in 2026.
Partly in response to this ruling, I am preparing an amendment to the Regulation on the Basic Registration of Persons and the Logical Design of the Basic Registration of Persons.
Mede naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak bereid ik een wijziging voor van de Regeling basisregistratie personen en het Logisch Ontwerp Basisregistratie Personen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Diederik van Dijk over ‘De geëscaleerde demonstratie bij een bijeenkomst van Christenen voor Israël’

MPs Bikker and Van Dijk asked how the government views an escalated pro-Palestinian demonstration at a Christenen voor Israël gathering in Barneveld, including intimidation of attendees, the role of the mayor and police, and whether freedom of assembly is safeguarded. The government answered that the gathering went ahead, that intimidation is unacceptable, and that the mayor is responsible for facilitating and intervening, while referring to a WODC study on how demonstration rights relate to other fundamental rights due in summer 2025 and a government response in autumn.
It is the responsibility of local authorities, in particular the mayor, to facilitate demonstrations as much as possible and to intervene where necessary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag, in het bijzonder de burgemeester, om demonstraties zoveel mogelijk te faciliteren en waar nodig in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de bezorgtijden van PostNL in relatie tot de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen

MP Sneller asked how PostNL's move to 48-hour delivery for letter post affects the upcoming Tweede Kamer election, including delivery of voter cards and postal votes, and whether the five-day deadline for requesting replacement voter cards is still adequate. The minister replies that the 48-hour standard applies only to universal postal service mail, not election mail, which is governed by contracts with PostNL, and that the new rule does not take effect until July 2026; the government stresses timely delivery, asks municipalities to use alternative couriers for late replacement cards, and says the replacement-card deadlines will be examined in the candidate-nomination bill.
That is why I earlier indicated that I would examine the Electoral Act deadlines for delivering voting documents and include them in the bill on the candidate nomination procedure.
Daarom heb ik eerder aangegeven de termijnen in de Kieswet voor de bezorging van stembescheiden te onderzoeken en te betrekken bij het wetsvoorstel over de kandidaatstellingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel hoe de jacht op ‘verdachte’ inwoners in de armste wijken ontspoort

An MP asked the ministers about an investigative article on an integrated intervention team in Zaandam that allegedly targeted residents of poor neighbourhoods with harsh, discriminatory-sounding tactics, and whether officials felt pressured and unable to report concerns. The government answered that the municipality of Zaanstad is investigating the team's conduct and communication, that discrimination is unacceptable, and that fundamental rights must be safeguarded, but largely defended the area-based approach and left the detailed review to the municipality.
When asked, the municipality of Zaanstad indicated it would further examine the signals from the FTM publication regarding communication and internal working methods for accuracy and background.
Desgevraagd heeft de gemeente Zaanstad aangegeven de signalen uit de publicatie van FTM ten aanzien van de communicatie en de interne werkwijze nader te onderzoeken op juistheid en achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht ‘Hoe wij bij een CvI-lezing werden belaagd en geïntimideerd door demonstranten’

MPs Van Dijk and Flach asked the government about reports of intimidation of attendees at a lecture by a Dutch organisation, and whether protest rights permit criminal conduct without enforcement. The Minister condemned the intimidation, said demonstration rights do not cover criminal acts, and pointed to local authority and prosecutors for enforcement while a WODC study on conflicting fundamental rights is pending, with no commitment to amend the Public Demonstrations Act yet.
I am not anticipating changes to legislation ahead of the results of the WODC study.
Ik loop niet vooruit op het wijzigen van wetgeving voorafgaand aan de resultaten van het WODC-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach en Diederik van Dijk over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 22 april in Lelystad

MPs Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach and Van Dijk asked whether a counter-demonstration at a Christians for Israel lecture in Lelystad, which forced attendees to stay inside for about three quarters of an hour, was announced or permitted, what support municipalities get, and how safety will be guaranteed. The minister answers that the municipality was informed only shortly before, that the mayor is responsible for facilitating demonstrations, and that a research study on the legal framework is expected at the end of summer.
In the Netherlands the mayor is responsible for facilitating the right to demonstrate.
In Nederland is de burgemeester verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van het demonstratierecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 17 april in Zaltbommel

MPs Eerdmans and Bikker asked whether the government would guarantee safety at a Zaltbommel event after a counter-demonstration intimidated attendees, and why organisers were not warned in advance. The Minister answered that the demonstration was not announced, that safety is a matter for the mayor and police, and that a WODC study on the demonstration right will report later this year.
It is a local matter and the mayor is accountable to the municipal council for it.
Het is een lokale aangelegenheid en de burgemeester legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de subsidie uitkeringen tijdens het Herdenkingsjaar Slavernijverleden en het slavernijverledenfonds

The MP Eerdmans asks about subsidies from the Herdenkingsjaar Slavernijverleden, including a dance project featuring a Rwandan king, how subsidy payments were checked given Finance Ministry warnings, a full list of subsidies, and whether any underspending of the 200 million euro slavery fund should return to the treasury. The ministers answer that the project fits the scheme's aims, that the funds' annual reports and standard procedures provide verification and accountability, that no underspending is currently foreseen, and that any underspending would be redistributed to the fund's goals rather than returned.
The spending of the subsidy funds has been fully accounted for through the public annual reports of the Mondriaan Fund and the Fund for Cultural Participation.
De bestedingen van de subsidiegelden zijn volledig verantwoord via de openbare jaarverslagen van het Mondriaan Fonds en het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de beveiliging van Joodse en Amerikaanse locaties

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch Jewish and American locations should receive extra security after France tightened protection amid the Iran-Israel conflict, and what measures were taken. The government answered that threat level is substantial, that measures are taken as needed based on current threat information, but declined to disclose specific measures for individual institutions for security reasons.
For security reasons, I never make public statements about measures taken to protect individual institutions or persons.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over maatregelen die worden getroffen ten behoeve van de veiligheid van individuele instellingen of personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Piri over kritische demonstranten die bij een bezoek aan de Chinese vicepremier buiten het zicht werden geposteerd

MPs Lahlah and Piri asked about protesters being kept out of sight during the visit of the Chinese vice-premier, camera use, transnational repression and a planned ban on face coverings at demonstrations. The minister replies that the Hague municipality found no restriction tied to content, that demonstrations were not limited by the Chinese delegation, that camera use is for public order under the Municipalities Act, and that a WODC study on the right to demonstrate is pending.
Restriction of the right to demonstrate, or consideration of it in the context of this visit, has not been an issue.
Beperking van het demonstratierecht of overweging daartoe in het kader van het onderhavige bezoek is niet aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het bericht dat Amerikaanse experts geheime communicatieapparatuur hebben aangetroffen in Chinese zonne-omvormers

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that rogue communication devices were found in Chinese solar inverters, and about risks to the grid, AIVD's role, EU measures, inverter numbers in the Netherlands, detection controls and follow-up to a 2023 RDI report. The government answered that the report is based on anonymous sources and cannot be verified, outlined existing and forthcoming EU and Dutch cybersecurity rules enforced by the RDI, and described ongoing industrial and supervisory initiatives.
The cited article states that secret components have been installed in solar panel inverters, allowing China to switch inverters on and off remotely and change settings.
In het aangehaalde artikel staat dat er geheime componenten in omvormers voor zonnepanelen zijn aangebracht, waarmee China op afstand omvormers aan en uit kan schakelen en instellingen kan aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het tegengaan van buitenlandse beïnvloeding bij de verkiezingen

CDA MPs asked the ministers how Dutch elections can be protected against foreign online disinformation campaigns, including the risks, existing measures, the DSA, Sweden's psychological defence agency and a public awareness campaign. The minister answered that the government is taking coordinated measures, is preparing new powers and legal bases for later elections, and will commission studies, but noted that the new powers will not be introduced before the 2025 elections.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Joseph en Vermeer over het bericht ‘Hervorming politieke pensioenen per 2028 in gevaar’

MPs Joseph and Vermeer asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that the reform placing politicians' pensions in the new pension system by 2028 is at risk, including the bill's status, budgetary effects of delay, unresolved legal issues, and timing of consultation. The minister answered that the bill is in preparation, the target date of 1 January 2028 still stands, legal and technical issues will be addressed in the bill, and consultation is aimed for 2025.
The aim is to put the bill into consultation in 2025.
Het streven is het wetsvoorstel in 2025 in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Wrijving in kabinet over migratiebeleid: Faber wil handtekening Schoof onder kritische brief'

An MP asked the Prime Minister and ministers about a reported cabinet dispute over a letter by Denmark and Italy criticising European Court of Human Rights interpretation of migration removal rules, including the timeline, reasons for not co-signing, and whether criticism of the ECtHR undermines the rule of law. The government answered that it supports dialogue on removing convicted foreigners but declined to co-sign the part questioning ECtHR interpretation, citing judicial independence, and said it would pursue other routes.
The Netherlands does not want to give the impression of wanting to sit in the judge's seat and therefore cannot support that part of the call.
Nederland wil niet de indruk wekken op de stoel van de rechter te willen zitten en kan daarom dat deel van de oproep niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht “Rotterdam legt trouwambtenaar ten onrechte beperking op: ‘geen enkele verwijzing naar God en geloof’”

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Rotterdam wrongly barred a marriage registrar from any reference to God or faith during ceremonies, and raised equal treatment, freedom of expression and language questions. The minister answered that the registrar's discretion is bounded by the anti-discrimination rules and the Civil Code, that supervision of the speech is a municipal matter, and that the courts or the Equal Treatment Commission must judge specific cases.

It is not for me to test the conditions set in a specific case at a marriage ceremony against the prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion; that is for the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights or the judge.

Het is niet aan mij om de voorwaarden die in een concreet geval bij een huwelijksvoltrekking zijn gesteld te toetsen aan het verbod van onderscheid op grond van godsdienst; dat is aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens of de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht dat de tweelingbroer van de staatsecretaris van Defensie directeur wordt van een drone-bedrijf

SP MPs asked the Defence minister whether the Defence state secretary's twin brother taking a job at a drone company, while the army invests millions in drones, creates a conflict of interest, and what safeguards exist. The minister answered that the appointment was known within Defence, cited existing post-employment and integrity rules, and promised the state secretary would be cautious in direct contacts with AI Armaments.

Furthermore, the State Secretary will be restrained in direct contacts with AI Armaments, and specific communication about and/or specific cooperation with AI Armaments falls under the responsibility of the Minister.

Verder geldt dat de Staatssecretaris terughoudend zal zijn in directe contacten met AI Armaments en dat specifieke communicatie over en/of specifieke samenwerking met AI Armaments onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Lee, Van der Burg en Dassen over Chinese spionage via diplomatieke posten

MPs from several parties asked whether US concerns about Chinese espionage linked to the large Chinese embassy in London also affect the Netherlands, including via financial infrastructure, internet hubs and diplomatic expansion, and whether the EU should adopt joint risk-analysis guidelines for diplomatic buildings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, points to existing measures such as DORA, the Wbni and the forthcoming Cbw, says no Chinese embassy expansion request is pending in the Netherlands and no increase in Chinese diplomats has occurred, and states it will raise China-related issues within the EU.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the investigations or working methods of the services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de onderzoeken of werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat bestuursorganen risicoprofilering mogen toepassen zonder specifieke wetgeving

An MP asked the government about reports that public bodies may use algorithmic risk profiling without specific legislation, and whether this conflicts with GDPR Article 22, CJEU case law and fundamental rights. The government answers that risk selection not leading to decisions without meaningful human intervention falls outside Article 22, commits to transparency measures (Algorithm Register, notification of citizens, a report to parliament before end 2025), but declines to publish all national profiling algorithms.

Following the motion by MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra, the State Secretary for the Interior is currently gathering input from other governments and implementing bodies on the possibilities to always inform citizens when a (partly) automated risk selection has taken place and led to a decision.

Naar aanleiding van de motie van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra haalt de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties momenteel input op bij de medeoverheden en uitvoeringsorganisaties over de mogelijkheden om burgers altijd te informeren als er een (deels) geautomatiseerde risicoselectie heeft plaatsgevonden en dit tot een besluit heeft geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over de invulling van de 10%-korting bij het niet overhevelen specifieke uitkeringen en de bescherming van de financiële positie van medeoverheden

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the 10% budget cut kept in place when a specific grant is not transferred respects the motion requiring no negative effects on municipalities' and provinces' finances, and how lower performance requirements are verified. The minister replied that the cut is applied via a framework (alternative funding, lower performance requirements or agreements on efficiency), that it should not burden subnational governments, and that departments will inform parliament in autumn 2025 without a commitment before Prinsjesdag.

In my letter of 21 May 2025 I indicated that the above is in line with the motion by MP Wingelaar, since the described route is aimed at preventing negative consequences for the financial position of subnational governments.

In mijn brief van 21 mei 2025 heb ik aangegeven dat het bovenstaande in lijn is met de motie van het lid Wingelaar 6 , aangezien de beschreven route immers gericht is op het voorkomen van negatieve gevolgen voor de financiële positie van medeoverheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over “het riante wachtgeld voor de opgestapte PVV-bewindslieden”

SP MPs Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Minister of the Interior whether the lengthy benefit scheme (Appa) for ex-politicians, including the departed PVV ministers, should be abolished or brought under the unemployment benefit rules, including its lack of a fault test. The minister rejected the 'wachtgeld' label, defended the Appa benefit as a safety net needed because of the confidence convention, and declined to abolish it or apply the WW fault test.
No, I am not willing to abolish the benefit scheme for former politicians.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de uitkeringsregeling voor oud-politici af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over uitspraken van de Nationaal Coördinator over moslimdiscriminatie

An MP asked whether the national anti-discrimination coordinator's claim that Muslim discrimination costs the Netherlands billions is correct, and if so to explain. The minister answers that the coordinator spoke of discrimination and racism in general, not specifically Muslim discrimination, and that a study on the costs of discrimination in the Netherlands is needed, citing a US study as a basis for assuming substantial costs.
The NCDR calls for research into what discrimination costs society, because little is currently known about the societal costs of discrimination and racism in the Netherlands.
De NCDR pleit voor een onderzoek naar wat discriminatie de samenleving kost, omdat er op dit moment weinig bekend is over de maatschappelijke kosten van discriminatie en racisme in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikkers over het artikel in Binnenlands Bestuur ‘Zorgen over decentraal ‘hosten’ van verkiezingsuitslagen’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the Council of State's advice on the decree on election results software, including whether the law would take effect on 1 July 2025 and what this means for the 2026 municipal elections. The minister answered that the law will likely take effect on 1 August 2025 instead, that no effect on the 2026 municipal elections is expected, and that the Electoral Council will continue to provide decentralised results software.
It has not proven feasible to bring the Election Results Software Act and the draft decree into force together on 1 July 2025.
Het is niet haalbaar gebleken om de Wet programmatuur verkiezingsuitslagen en het ontwerpbesluit samen op 1 juli 2025 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP from JA21 asked ministers across many departments how much money, which diversity, gender and inclusion policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and consultants their implementing agencies use. The government answered that spending is mostly embedded in general HR policy, lists the agencies' trainings and monitoring tools, and provided the requested figures per organisation where available.
There is a large number of implementing and sui generis organisations.
Er is sprake van een groot aantal uitvoerings- en sui generis organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het voornemen van Extinction Rebellion om winkels te bestoken met boterzuur

An MP from FVD asked ministers about Extinction Rebellion's announced plan to disrupt shops with butyric acid, the scope of past XR damage, municipal shifting of costs onto businesses, investigation of XR's structure and funding, equal treatment of demonstrations, and the AIVD/NCTV focus on right-wing versus left-wing extremism. The government called the butyric acid plan unacceptable, declined to compile an overview or damage figures, said municipal mayors decide on demonstration measures, refused to investigate XR, denied unequal treatment, and said the AIVD monitors left-wing extremism but XR's actions are currently seen as activism.
Such an overview cannot be generated.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over geweld tegen klimaatdemonstranten

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked whether the government condemns a provincial councillor who drove into a peaceful Extinction Rebellion demonstrator and whether it will act against calls for violence against demonstrators. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, noting a police report had been filed and the OM is investigating, and said responsibility for demonstration safety lies with local government while any suggestion of violence against demonstrators is unacceptable.
It is not for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to make statements about individual and ongoing cases.
Het is niet aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, om uitspraken te doen over individuele en lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de aflevering “Gaby overlijdt, maar familie kan niet rouwen door onze overheid”

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked about delays in foreign death certificates for Dutch citizens dying abroad and municipalities refusing to register deaths without them. The government answered that municipalities may register deaths on lower-ranked source documents under the BRP Act, that case-by-case judgment is needed, and that guidance will be reiterated to municipalities, without new rules.
Following the broadcast and these parliamentary questions, the NVVB has already brought this to the attention of its members in its newsletter.
Naar aanleiding van de uitzending en deze Kamervragen heeft de NVVB dit in haar nieuwsbrief al onder de aandacht gebracht van haar leden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Waveren en Idsinga over de bezorging van overheidspost

MPs Van Waveren and Idsinga asked ministers about the National Ombudsman's warning that late or failed delivery of government post harms citizens. The minister answered that complaint data is kept centrally via PostNL under the Rijksbrede postcontract, that responsibility for mail delivery and legal consequences is shared across departments and courts, and that the ACM study on the postal market will inform further policy.
There is no record within the Ministry of Economic Affairs or the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations of such internal reports.
Er is binnen het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties geen registratie waarin dergelijke interne meldingen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Six Dijkstra over de stroomstoring in Spanje en Portugal

Two MPs asked the government about the April 2025 blackout in Spain and Portugal, including the risk of a similar outage in the Netherlands, the protection of the grid, emergency plans, and public preparedness for long outages. The government answered that such a blackout is unlikely in the Netherlands, described existing grid safeguards, crisis plans and the coming Cbw/Wwke rules, and said citizens should be prepared for 72 hours of self-reliance.

In mid-2025 a multi-year public campaign (national government, other authorities, businesses and social organisations) starts to further increase societal resilience to long-term failure of daily services.

Medio 2025 start een meerjarige publiekscampagne (rijksoverheid, andere overheden, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties) om de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid bij langdurige uitval van dagelijkse voorzieningen (ongeacht de aard van de dreiging) verder te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Soepboer en De Hoop over het onterecht moeten inleveren van pompeblêdspeldjes door een Friese delegatie bij de Tweede Kamer

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether a Frisian delegation was wrongly required to surrender their pompeblêd pins at the Tweede Kamer entrance, and whether such symbols are political expressions. The minister acknowledged the situation as unpleasant for those involved, said the interpretation of symbols and enforcement of house rules rest with the Speaker and the presidium, and declined to commit to changing the rules.

The interpretation of such symbols falls under the responsibility of the presidium and the Speaker of the House of Representatives, who decide within the framework of the House rules whether expressions are appropriate in parliamentary decorum.
