De interpretatie van dergelijke symbolen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het presidium en de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer, die binnen de kaders van de Kamerorde beslissen of uitingen passend zijn in het parlementaire decorum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de brandbrief ‘bezorgde (oud-)ambtenaren

An MP from BBB asks the Climate and Interior ministers about an open letter by (former) civil servants urging climate policy such as coal plant closure, questioning whether signatories' public action fits political neutrality, the oath of office, the integrity code and conflict-of-interest rules. The minister replies that civil servants are politically neutral but may express views within the functioning norm, that the integrity code applies only to active staff, that only a very small number of signatories are active at the relevant departments, and that assessment is a personnel matter for each employer.
Whether the 'functioning norm' is exceeded cannot be said in general terms or for whole groups.
Of de «functioneringsnorm» wordt overschreden kan niet in algemene zin, of voor hele groepen worden gezegd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de brandbrief die Amsterdamse kerken aan de burgemeester van Amsterdam stuurden in verband met het gebrek aan fysieke ruimte om hun diensten en activiteiten plaats te laten vinde

MP Ceder asked whether the government recognises the shortage of physical space for church services in Amsterdam, whether Article 6 of the Constitution guarantees such space, and whether the government will press municipalities, including Amsterdam and Rotterdam, to reserve space for religious communities. The minister answered that space allocation is a municipal matter, that Article 6 imposes no obligation to guarantee physical space, that the state can only intervene if freedom of religion is rendered illusory, and that existing guidance is sufficient, with no concrete new action committed.
Article 6 of the Constitution, however, does not impose on the government an obligation of result to make sufficient physical space available for holding religious services.
Artikel 6 van de Grondwet legt de overheid echter geen resultaatsverplichting op om voldoende fysieke ruimte beschikbaar te maken voor het houden van erediensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked multiple ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy, budgets, training, quotas and evaluation within implementing agencies. The answers, given for RVO and TNO, describe small budgets, existing training programmes, targets for gender and cultural diversity and no external consultants.
No external organisations or consultants have been hired.
Er zijn geen externe organisaties of consultants ingehuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

MP Eerdmans asked ministers about the budget, content, training, monitoring and external advisers of diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The government answered for the NVWA, estimating about €70,000 for 2025, listing planned priorities and training, and stating it has no external consultants and no removal of artworks; it also said it would answer per agency separately.
Question 8: Could you provide the answers per implementing agency separately? Answer 8: Yes.
Vraag 8 Zou u de beantwoording per uitvoeringsinstantie afzonderlijk kunnen aanleveren? Antwoord 8 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Waveren over de inzet van het kabinet voor de versobering van de Algemene Bestuursdienst (ABD)

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why the proposed reform of the Algemene Bestuursdienst (ABD) removing salary scale 15 from its target group is presented as austerity, how it affects HR, recruitment and external intake, and why scales rather than organisational roles were used. The minister answered that the options are still under study, that decentralising services to departments is expected to substantially reduce ABD service provision (though it is not primarily a cost measure), that conditions for talent oversight and central development will be kept, and promised a letter before the summer recess.
The cited decision memorandum does not describe any considerations.
In de genoemde beslisnota staan geen afwegingen beschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buijsse over het bericht 'Ministeries getroffen door groot datalek'

MP Buijsse asked the Minister of Interior about a reported data leak affecting ministries, including which data leaked, how it happened, and why parliament was not informed and learned of it from the media. The State Secretary answered that personal data in document metadata (names, usernames, occasionally phone numbers) leaked, that parliament was not informed because the leak was active and public disclosure could increase misuse risk, and that the government regrets the media disclosure.
Unfortunately this is an active data leak. We are still in the first phase of addressing the data leak.
Het gaat hier helaas om een actief datalek. We bevinden ons nog in de eerste fase van de aanpak van het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Buijsse over de kansen van generatieve AI voor de productiviteit in de publieke sector

MPs Erkens and Buijsse (VVD) asked about generative AI's potential to raise public-sector productivity, cite claimed savings of up to 20 billion euro, and question whether AI can ease staff shortages and reduce the need for a growing civil service. State Secretary Szabó replies that productivity trends are mixed, that the government is exploring AI in service processes via the National Digitalisation Strategy and an upcoming overheidsbrede handreiking, while stating that savings and job effects cannot be quantified yet and that many pilots are not yet evaluated.
That there are currently 425,000 vacancies is not entirely correct.
Dat momenteel sprake zou zijn van 425.0000 vacatures is niet geheel correct.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de berichten 'Toegang tot het recht krimpt, terwijl maatwerk faalt' en 'Maatregelen regeerprogramma inkomenszekerheid: waarom de gemeente aan zet blijft'

An MP asks the ministers about news reports saying access to justice is shrinking and that gemeenten remain responsible for income support, and whether the government shares the ombudsman's view that citizens are sent from desk to desk. The ministers answer that the government is committed to accessible services, cite a kwartiermaker to map legal aid gaps, the expansion of overheidsbrede loketten to 25 initiatives, and a proactive services bill to be submitted in 2025.
To implement the Van Nispen/Palmen motion, a kwartiermaker will be appointed before the summer (J&V, BZK, SZW) to explore how a nationwide network of socio-legal services can best be organised.

Ter uitvoering van de motie Van Nispen/Palmen 4 wordt voor de zomer een kwartiermaker benoemd (J&V, BZK, SZW) die verkent hoe een landelijk dekkend netwerk van sociaaljuridische dienstverlening het best vormgegeven kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valize en Deen over de berichtgeving omtrent de grote datalekken bij de ministeries van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, Economische Zaken en Klimaat en Groene Groei

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about media reports of large data leaks at several ministries, when the leak was discovered, whether it is a privacy problem and why the Dutch Data Protection Authority was not contacted directly, what information was exposed, what measures were taken, and whether a state actor was involved. The State Secretary confirmed the leak was known from 10 April, said it exposes civil servants' personal data in document metadata and that a joint notification was made to the Data Protection Authority, listed containment measures including a central crisis team and an investigation, and stated no state actor appears to be involved.
All affected ministries have made a preliminary notification to the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Er is door alle getroffen ministeries een voorlopige melding gedaan bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over bescherming tegen digitale aanvallen op internationale instellingen in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about Dutch and EU protection of international organisations in the Netherlands against state-linked cyberattacks, following a press report on the hack of the EMA in Amsterdam. The minister answered that primary responsibility lies with the organisations, that the host state has an effort obligation, that the AIVD and NCSC can assist only on a voluntary basis, and that EU cooperation is being strengthened through NIS2 and Regulation 2023/2841.
I do not make statements about specific AIVD cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over specifieke casussen van de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie en het ministerie van SZW en VWS iftars organiseren

Two SGP MPs asked whether police and ministries hold iftar gatherings during Ramadan, questioning their neutrality given a reported in-uniform prayer, their costs, and why Islamic holidays dominate. The government answered that police and ministries organise gatherings for diversity and inclusion, that costs are absorbed in existing budgets, that in-uniform prayer is undesirable while attending iftars is acceptable, and that no nationwide policy governs which days are marked.
A call to prayer in uniform does not seem to me to fit with a police force that projects neutrality.
Een oproep tot gebed in uniform vind ik niet passen bij een politie die neutraliteit uitstraalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Opkomst gemeenteraadsverkiezingen naar dieptepunt’

MP Sneller asked the Minister of the Interior about the record-low turnout in municipal elections of 2022, its structural causes, and what the government is doing to raise turnout for the March 2026 elections, including targeting young people and supporting municipalities. The Minister agreed the causes are structural (notably low trust in politics), outlined campaign shifts, communication toolkits, youth initiatives and a planned webinar, but set no formal numeric turnout target.
The aim is that during the municipal elections of 18 March 2026 more eligible voters cast their vote than in the 2022 elections.
Het streven is dat tijdens de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 18 maart 2026 meer kiesgerechtigden hun stem uitbrengen dan tijdens de verkiezingen in 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over het artikel 'Hongarije neemt wet aan die Pride-mars verbiedt'

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked whether the government shares concern about Hungary's law banning Pride marches, its fines and facial recognition, what message the Netherlands conveys to Hungary, and whether the minister will join the Budapest Pride. The government calls the Hungarian laws very worrying, says the Commission must assess EU law compliance and urges action, reports a BeNeLux statement at the Council of Europe and conveyed concerns to the ambassador, and says the minister will not attend Pride though participation is still being considered.
The Netherlands will call on the Commission to do this expeditiously and take action if it finds that Union law has been breached.
Nederland zal de Commissie oproepen om dit voortvarend te doen en actie te ondernemen indien zij constateert dat het Unierecht is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het gemeentefonds

An MP asks whether the government made errors in calculating the gemeentefonds accres after the switch to the new normering system, whether restoring the opschalingskorting and youth care cuts were meant to fall outside later accres calculations, and how inflation forecast errors affect municipalities and provinces. The Staatssecretaris answers that the amounts were agreed with the VNG and IPO, that the VNG's claimed extra accres (92 and 108 million structural) was not agreed, and that the forecast gap was mainly caused by volatile crisis years, with commitments to improve reporting on taakmutaties in circulars.

Together with municipalities, provinces, the VNG and the IPO, it will be examined how to report on this in the circulars in such a way that the accres calculation is traceable for municipalities and provinces.

Samen met gemeenten, provincies en de VNG en het IPO wordt bekeken hoe hierover in de circulaires te rapporteren op een dusdanige wijze dat voor gemeenten en provincies de berekening van het accres navolgbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Tseggai over ‘de conclusies van de lokale ombudsman dat de gemeente Almere nalatig was bij het beschermen van de grondrechten van moslimgemeenschap’

MPs Van Baarle and Tseggai asked about the local ombudsman's finding that Almere municipality seriously failed to protect Muslim community fundamental rights through security analyses (krachtenveldanalyses) funded by central government. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own compliance, that the Rijk lacks a complete overview of analyses, and that the government acknowledges the unrest but has not offered formal apologies.
Municipalities are the commissioners of the analyses and the research bureau is the author. It is up to these parties involved to grant access.
Gemeenten zijn de opdrachtgever van de analyses en het onderzoeksbureau is de opsteller. Het is aan deze betrokken partijen om inzage te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Minister Faber negeerde eigen inspectie bij vorming asielwet’

The MPs Piri asked why the minister did not involve the Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid in drafting the Asylum Emergency Measures Act and the two-status system bill, despite the inspection guidelines, and whether this breaches the draft Framework Act on state inspectorates. The minister answered that consultation was limited to directly affected organisations for speed, that the inspectorate is not directly affected, that the guidelines allow this, and that she will not request an implementation check afterwards.
I will not ask the Inspectorate after all for an implementation check.
Ik zal de Inspectie niet alsnog om een uitvoeringstoets vragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Krul en Vedder over het bericht 'Zie de mens, niet het getal'; Senioren lopen aan tegen 'discriminatie op basis van leeftijd', ouderenorganisatie luidt noodklok'

MPs Inge van Dijk, Krul and Vedder (CDA) asked the government to respond to reports and a survey by ANBO-PCOB showing widespread age discrimination against seniors, and to set out measures across finance, labour, vehicle rental and volunteering. The minister answered that age discrimination is serious, that the government will discuss the survey with ANBO-PCOB, and that existing policies such as the Offensief Gelijke Kansen apply, but that no specific action plans exist for finance and no concrete new measures were announced beyond a planned study on vehicle rental insurance.
The fact that so many older people experience age discrimination is a reason for me to discuss the results of this research further with ANBO-PCOB.
Het gegeven dat zoveel ouderen leeftijdsdiscriminatie ervaren is voor mij aanleiding om met ANBO-PCOB verder te spreken over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte, Sneller en Bromet over het voorgenomen staatsbezoek aan Kenia

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the planned Dutch state visit to Kenya, amid serious human rights violations under President Ruto, would legitimise his government and what concrete steps the government would take. The minister replied that a state visit is not a personal endorsement, that human rights concerns were raised privately with Kenyan authorities and in public signals, and that Nederland will continue joint EU and partner statements.
During the visit I conveyed my concerns about the human rights situation in discussions with my counterpart.
Tijdens het bezoek heb ik mijn zorgen over de mensenrechtensituatie overgebracht in de gesprekken met mijn ambtsgenoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in executive agencies; this answer from the Education minister covers DUO and NWO. The minister says there are no plans to intensify or scale back the policy, explains the budget and training offered, and states that the set of questions concerns internal personnel policy rather than checks on executive power.
OCW has no specific diversity or gender policy.
OCW heeft geen specifiek diversiteits- of genderbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wijen-Nass over het vertrek van rijksdiensten uit Roermond

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the loss of central government jobs in Roermond, whether compensation is warranted, whether Roermond will be prioritised under the 'Elke Regio Telt' policy, and whether an action plan will be drawn up for a fairer spread of government jobs. The Minister answered that the decline was largely due to a one-off relocation, that structural compensation is not desirable, that concrete outcomes take time and that a ministry-level exploration with Roermond will take place without committing to specific relocations.
I do not consider structural compensation desirable or workable.
Ik acht een structurele compensatie niet wenselijk en niet werkbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Van Nispen en Flach over het bericht 'Ambtenaren verwachten ontevreden VNG na Kamerbrief'

MPs Chakor, Van Nispen and Flach asked why the government did not implement a motion requiring consultation with municipalities and provinces (VNG and IPO) on the new GDP-based normering system and its effects on the municipal and provincial funds. The State Secretary answered that consultations took place in 2024-2025, that government and local authorities hold different views on 2026 finances, that the matter was discussed in the BOFv of 6 March, and that the Minister will inform parliament before the 26 March debate.

Between November 2024 and February 2025 there were both administrative and civil-service consultations with the subnational governments on the financial effects and the pros and cons of the new calculation method for task changes.

Er is in de periode november 2024 tot februari 2025 zowel bestuurlijk als ambtelijk gesproken met de medeoverheden over de financiële effecten en de voor- en nadelen van de nieuwe berekeningswijze van taakmutaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over uitzonderingsgronden op basis van het Verdrag van Aarhus

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about exceptions to public access to environmental and emissions information under the Aarhus Convention, Directive 2003/4/EC, the GDPR and the Dutch Woo, including case law and whether Dutch disclosure rules are broader than in neighbouring countries. The minister answered question by question, explaining that emissions data cannot be withheld under several exceptions, that the Woo is applied in line with EU law, and that a study on comparable regimes in other countries is underway.
Under the Woo, emissions data must always be made public (Article 5.1, seventh paragraph, of the Woo).
Op grond van de Woo moet emissiegegevens altijd openbaar worden gemaakt (artikel 5.1, zevende lid, van de Woo).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked the ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removal, quotas, success metrics and consultants. The government answered for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, saying the spending is about EUR 60,000 within normal operations, no artworks were removed, the statutory disability quota applies, and no external consultants were hired.
External organisations or consultants are not hired to advise on the above-mentioned themes.
Externe organisaties of consultants worden niet ingehuurd voor advisering op het gebied van bovengenoemde thema’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies. The Minister of Health answered for RIVM: a €50,000 budget for 2025, continuation of existing policy, a 2.76% quota plus government-wide targets, and a hired project leader costing €24,000.
RIVM currently has a Diversity & Inclusion policy budget of €50,000 reserved for 2025.
Het RIVM heeft momenteel een Diversiteit & Inclusie (D&I) beleidsbudget van € 50.000,– euro gereserveerd voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra over de nieuwe werkplek van SSC-ICT

MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra asked whether migrating 58,000 government digital workplaces to the public cloud is necessary, what it costs, whether US cloud laws and dependencies pose risks, and how data and metadata are handled. The State Secretary answered that migration is needed because Windows 10 and Ivanti components reach end of support, that most data stays in government data centres with only metadata held by US providers, and that risks are being managed and a revised cloud policy is coming in mid-2025.
I am still consulting on how we can share the advice of the intelligence and security services in outline, whether or not confidentially.
Ik ben nog in overleg hoe we op hoofdlijnen, al dan niet vertrouwelijk, de adviezen van de inlichtingen-en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Agent kan voortaan ook eed zweren op Allah of andere god’

An MP asks why the police oath was modernised to allow religious formulas (such as invoking Allah) without prior parliamentary consultation, questioning consistency with other public employers and the BZK minister's earlier statements on religion. The minister replies that the change is a labour-terms matter agreed with police unions within mandate, that BZK is not responsible for police, and describes the rationale, the Defence-inspired wording, and a work instruction for religious formulas.
The change to the oath and pledge is a change in terms of employment between the police employer and the police unions within the cabinet's mandate.
De wijziging van de eed en belofte betreft een rechtspositionele wijziging tussen werkgever van politie en de politievakbonden binnen mandaat van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Boomsma over hulp bij toeslagen voor statushouders

Two MPs asked how responsibility for helping asylum status holders apply for benefit allowances passed from COA to municipalities, whether the process was careful, and who now supports them. The minister says COA stopped its service on 1 January 2025 after system changes at the Dienst Toeslagen, that the government is cooperating with VNG and Divosa on handouts and platforms, and that statushouders remain responsible for their own allowances, with some answers and letters promised but the answers were not given within the requested week.
Yes, the text has meanwhile been adjusted on the website for COA residents.
Ja, de tekst is inmiddels aangepast op de website voor bewoners van het COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Waveren over het puntensysteem dat de gemeente Utrecht hanteert bij de afhandeling van Woo-verzoeken en in strijd is met de wet

Van Waveren asked the Minister of Interior whether Utrecht's point-based prioritisation of Woo requests, which deducts points for multiple requests and treats journalists differently, is lawful and whether the ministry oversees such practices. The minister said the municipality may prioritise within Woo limits, that no oversight body supervises decentralised Woo handling beyond objection and appeal, and that an evaluation of the Woo will start at the end of this year.
There is no body that supervises the handling of Woo requests by decentralised governments.
Er is geen instantie die toezicht houdt op de afhandeling van Woo-verzoeken van decentrale overheden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie subsidies heeft verstrekt aan milieuorganisaties om specifieke wetgevingsvoorstellen te promoten, zoals de Natuurherstelwet

An MP asked the Dutch ministers whether EU Commission subsidies to environmental NGOs to promote legislation such as the Nature Restoration Law raise transparency concerns, and asked for an overview, conditions, and publication of Dutch subsidies to such groups. The minister denied that Dutch subsidies fund lobbying, declined a full overview and publication of individual subsidy agreements, and stated no changes to subsidy policy are planned.
No. The cabinet does not keep a central overview of all national government subsidies.
Nee. Het kabinet houdt geen centraal overzicht bij van alle rijkssubsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de berichten ‘Driekwart gemeenten krijgt begroting niet rond, keuzes uitgesteld’ en ‘Zuid-Holland stemt in met begroting met groot gat’

MPs Flach (SGP) asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that only a quarter of municipalities can present a balanced budget and that Zuid-Holland approved a budget with a large gap. The minister said municipalities' finances are under pressure, that provincial supervisors check structural balance but multi-year deficits are not yet decisive, that the reserve rules were loosened and that she is exploring additional supervisory criteria to report in Q2 2025.
I expect to be able to inform the House further on this in the second quarter of 2025.
Naar verwachting kan ik uw Kamer hierover nader informeren in het tweede kwartaal van 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over adviezen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State naar de media zijn gelekt

An MP asked the Asylum and Migration Minister whether leaks of Raad van State advisory opinions to the media were unusual, whether only the ministry received the opinions, and whether the leak would be reported to the police. The minister said the leaked content was unusual and undesirable but declined to qualify it as criminal, said no criminal complaint would be filed for lack of grounds, and noted the opinions were later published by the Raad van State on schedule.
I consider it undesirable when statements are made about Raad van State advisory opinions before they are made public by the Raad van State.
Ik vind het onwenselijk wanneer mededelingen worden gedaan over adviezen van de Raad van State, voordat deze openbaar zijn gemaakt door de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Wijen-Nass over het artikel 'Weer meer wethouders gestopt in 2024, roep om uitbreiding van colleges'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about news reports of more aldermen leaving office in 2024 and calls to expand city executives, including workload relief, legal changes, financial support and support programmes. The minister answered that 157 aldermen left in 2024, gave the numbers for small and medium municipalities, said a letter on the attractiveness of the office will come before the summer recess, and noted that changing the legal cap on aldermen requires amending the Municipalities Act.
From my ministry we offer financial support for this.
Vanuit mijn ministerie bieden we hiervoor financiële ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked eight ministers how much money, which policies, courses, quotas, KPIs and external consultants their implementing agencies use for diversity, gender and inclusion policy. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management refers to the answers already sent on 14 January 2025 for the whole ministry, including Rijkswaterstaat, as no other information is available.
As no other information is available, reference is made to the information already shared with the House on 14 January.
Aangezien er geen andere informatie beschikbaar is, wordt daarom verwezen naar de informatie die op 14 januari al met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked several ministers how much is spent on diversity, gender and inclusion policy at executive agencies, how it is shaped, whether artworks were removed, and how success is measured. The Minister of Finance answered with budget figures, the continuation of current policy, quota and ambition targets, and confirmed separate answers per agency.
In the coming years the current diversity, gender and inclusion policy will be continued in its current form.
De komende jaren wordt het huidige diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid voortgezet zoals huidig vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de tijdsplanning van het wetsvoorstel overgang pensioenaanspraken politieke ambtsdragers naar het nieuwe pensioenstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why the bill moving political office holders' pensions (APPA) into the new pension system has not yet been put to consultation and why it is delayed. The minister attributes the delay to the cabinet change and complex legal and technical issues, expects to submit the bill in 2025, and aims for full entry into force on 1 January 2028.
The aim remains to bring the Aanpassingswet Appa fully into effect on 1 January 2028.
Het streven blijft er op gericht om de Aanpassingswet Appa volledig in werking te laten treden per 1 januari 2028.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van der Lee over “de online surveillance van Bunq”, naar aanleiding van een artikel in het Financieele Dagblad van 19 december 2024

MPs Kathmann and Van der Lee asked whether bank Bunq pressured customers via its app to stop online criticism, whether it may link user data to such posts, and whether supervisors should investigate. The minister replied that Bunq denies threatening or terminating customers, that banks cannot use online criticism as a legal basis to process customer data, and that the independent supervisors AFM and DNB cannot be instructed to investigate a specific case.
The AFM and DNB are independent administrative bodies and function as independent supervisors. I therefore cannot ask the supervisors to investigate a specific situation.
De AFM en DNB zijn zelfstandige bestuursorganen en functioneren als onafhankelijke toezichthouders. Ik kan de toezichthouders daarom niet vragen om een specifieke situatie te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid binnen diverse uitvoeringsinstanties

An MP asked several ministers about diversity, gender and inclusion policy in implementing agencies, including budgets, training, art removals and targets. The government answered per agency, stating UWV spends about €320,000 in 2025 and SVB about €340,967, with targets and training described and no external consultants hired.
UWV intends to continue monitoring this policy in the coming years.
UWV is voornemens dit beleid de komende jaren te blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over sollicitatiegegevens die met Google gedeeld worden

An MP asked whether job applications to the AIVD and MIVD via werkenvoornederland.nl leak identifying data to Google through Google Analytics, and about related privacy and US-law risks. The minister denied any sharing of applicant data, said GA4 is configured for anonymity, but largely deflected on alternatives, the AP investigation, and which foreign services use Google Analytics.
It is impossible that the identity of applicants to the AIVD or MIVD is shared via Google Analytics.
Het is onmogelijk dat de identiteit van sollicitanten bij de AIVD of MIVD via Google Analytics wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Eén man, 25 baby’s:‘schijnkinderen’zijn een nieuwe manier om verblijfspapieren te krijgen’

An SGP MP asked the Asylum and Migration minister about reports of 'sham fatherhood' recognitions used to obtain residence permits, including what action is taken and whether recognition should be criminalised. The minister called the signals serious, outlined existing legal tools (refusal by civil registrars, court annulment, prosecution), and said a new approach is being developed, while declining to share a confidential IND report.

That is why an approach to the problem of sham recognitions in Chavez residence applications is currently being developed together with the IND, the Public Prosecution Service, the Dutch Association for Civil Affairs and the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security.

Daarom wordt er op dit moment, in samenwerking met de IND, het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Burgerzaken en de Ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid gewerkt aan een aanpak voor de problematiek rondom schijnerkenningen bij Chavez-verblijfsaanvragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van der Wal over uitvoering van de motie Van der Wal en Mohandis en eerder onbeantwoorde schriftelijke vragen over de bevrijdingsfestivals in het kader van 80 jaar vrijheid

MPs Mohandis and Van der Wal asked whether the government would fund Bevrijdingsfestivals in 2025 through a guarantee scheme, given a Chamber-adopted motion. The state secretary replied that interdepartmental talks ended with a one-off, final contribution of EUR 700,000 for 2025 but explained that a guarantee scheme would imply a structural relationship the government does not intend.
The cabinet, however, sees the contribution as incidental.
Het kabinet ziet de bijdrage echter als incidenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Deen en Wilders over het bericht ‘Kamer-bobo laat zich door beveiligers rondrijden in opgeëiste dienstauto: chique bolide heeft pikant verleden’

PVV MPs Deen and Wilders asked the Minister of Interior whether the House Clerk (Griffier) obtained a chauffeured service car driven by Chamber security staff, and whether this should end. The Minister replied that she had no role in the decision, which falls under the House's own budget and personnel responsibility (Presidium), and therefore would not go into the reports.
For the above reasons, I will not go into the reported news any further.
Vanwege bovenstaande redenen zal ik niet nader ingaan op de genoemde berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

MP Eerdmans asked whether the National Citizens' Climate Assembly is representative given self-registration after a lottery, who formulated its central question, why the new cabinet kept the process, what it costs, what funds exist for implementing its recommendations, and how outcomes are secured. The minister answers that participants were selected on five characteristics, that the question was jointly set with parliament and the previous cabinet and re-confirmed, that the process continues with a 10-15% extra cost claim under review, and that the cabinet commits to a substantive response within six months and a follow-up meeting after twelve months.
This additional claim is currently being assessed by both responsible ministries and will be handled in the regular budget cycle.
Deze aanvullende claim wordt op dit moment beoordeeld door beide verantwoordelijke ministeries en zal meelopen in de reguliere begrotingscyclus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Dringend meer geld nodig voor schoolgebouwen'

MPs Sneller and Rooderkerk asked the government whether school building funding is adequate, citing an IBO finding of at least 730 million euros a year shortfall, and how school housing fits the Herstelplan and the planned school housing bill. The State Secretary acknowledged the IBO figure and the need for faster renewal but said no additional funds are available, and argued the housing bill sets no new building standards and that gemeenten will be compensated via the gemeentefonds.
The honest story is that this cabinet has had to make hard choices; there are no additional funds.
Het eerlijke verhaal is dat dit kabinet scherpe keuzes heeft moeten maken; er zijn geen aanvullende middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'VNG: 'BZK tovert op papier miljardenkorting weg''

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior why the Integrale Overzichten Financiën letter omitted the multi-billion euro cut to the municipal fund that VNG and CPB point to, and whether the government complies with the Financiële-verhoudingswet and Gemeentewet on funding decentralised tasks. The Minister rejects the claims, saying the letter is retrospective, that future fund developments appear in budget documents, and that talks with local governments on the balance of tasks and funding continue, with a fund-normering impact report promised for spring.
I do not recognise the claim that the cabinet would not comply with the Financial Relations Act and the Municipalities Act.
Ik herken mij niet in de stelling dat het kabinet niet zou voldoen aan de Financiële verhoudingswet en de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Podt over het artikel 'Ongrijpbaar voor haar ambtenaren, onbereikbaar voor de buitenwereld: minister Faber opereert ‘volstrekt ongebruikelijk’'

MPs Sneller and Podt asked about reports that a political assistant to the Minister of Asylum and Migration had not passed an AIVD security screening, whether they had access to sensitive information via WhatsApp groups, and about staff departures and the absence of spokespersons at that ministry. The government declined to discuss the individual case, described the general screening procedure and rules on messaging apps, and said an independent advice on extra rules for political assistants had been requested.
Due to the confidential nature of personnel information of this type, I will not make any statements about individual cases.
In verband met het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter van dit type informatie doe ik geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over overbodige functies, adviesorganen en doublures bij de Rijksoverheid in relatie tot voorgenomen besparingen op het overheidsapparaat

MP Erkens asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about growth in central government staff, advisory bodies and external hiring, and how savings and overlap would be managed. The minister acknowledged significant growth, said the savings target has no fixed FTE goal, promised a plan on reducing external hiring and a separate letter on the parliamentary motion, and answered most questions with data or general descriptions.

In the parliamentary debate on the functioning of the civil service of 6 November 2024 I committed in this context to send your House an action plan for reducing external hiring in the first quarter of 2025.

In het commissiedebat Functioneren Rijksdienst van 6 november 2024 heb ik in dit kader toegezegd om in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 een plan van aanpak terugdringen externe inhuur aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Van Nispen over foutieve geboortedata in de Basisregistratie personen

MPs Chakor and Van Nispen asked whether incomplete birth dates (00 or XX) in the BRP, which can cause problems with digital systems such as AOW, can be replaced by a usable fictitious date. The State Secretary says about 35,950 residents still have a partial or unknown birth date, that people can request rectification via their municipality using a sworn statement, and that the Minister of Asylum and Migration can supply a date where needed, but does not commit to a new general measure.
Persons registered in the BRP with an incomplete birth date can submit a request to their municipality to have their birth date rectified.
Personen die met een onvolledige geboortedatum in de BRP staan, kunnen bij hun gemeente een verzoek indienen om hun geboortedatum te laten rectificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de noodklok van de Wethoudersvereniging over onuitvoerbaar beleid

An MP from CDA asks the Minister of Interior about the Wethoudersvereniging's alarm over unworkable national policy, the feeling that The Hague acts as a sole ruler, insufficient involvement of local officials, and a shortfall in local funding for open-ended decentralised tasks. The Minister responds by pointing to the Overhedenoverleg, the UDO feasibility test, planned structural talks with aldermen's representatives, a review of the maximum number of aldermen, and ongoing consultations with the VNG, while asserting that municipal funds are unconditional and that medebewind costs are reimbursed.
In addition, I consider it important that when new bills are introduced, (organisations of) decentralised governments are invited to contribute through formal consultation.
Daarnaast vind ik het van belang dat bij nieuwe wetsvoorstellen (organisaties van) decentrale overheden worden uitgenodigd om door middel van een formele consultatie hun inbreng te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski over de toepassing van de Tijdelijke Wet nu het huisvestingsvraagstuk van de CTIVD (voorlopig) opgelost is

An MP asked whether, now that the CTIVD's housing problem is provisionally resolved, the intelligence services' suspended powers under the Temporary Act can be resumed and from when. The government answered that some powers are already being applied under the Temporary Act through agreements with the CTIVD, that a shift to CTIVD oversight is planned, and that full application will follow as CTIVD staffing grows, without giving a firm date.
The starting point is and remains full application of the Temporary Act under the necessary independent oversight, within the shortest possible term that is feasible for all parties.
Uitgangspunt is en blijft volledige toepassing van de Tijdelijke wet onder het noodzakelijke onafhankelijke toezicht, op de kortst mogelijke en voor alle partijen uitvoerbare termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdiensten

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about the digital accessibility of government services, citing a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report and raising issues such as the non-compliance of many public websites, IDO funding, accessibility in healthcare and education, and emergency services. The State Secretary responded that the government is working on a work agenda, accessibility standards, a planned 2028 deadline, and reform of IDO financing, while acknowledging compliance is too low but declining to commit to sanctions for now.
The Ministry of BZK considers the number of government websites and apps that meet the legal requirement to be too low.
Het Ministerie van BZK vindt het aantal overheidswebsites en -apps die aan de wettelijke verplichting voldoen te laag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri , Ceder, Koekkoek en Podt over het bericht 'Faber beperkt inspraak van adviesorganen bij overhaaste wetgeving’

MPs asked why the Minister for Asylum and Migration shortened the consultation period for two asylum bills (two-status system and tighter family reunification) and why the emergency asylum bill was not sent to the Dutch Bar Association, and how this fits Dutch legislative drafting guidelines. The minister answered that urgency justified the accelerated process, that consultation was only with directly affected bodies such as the IND, the Council for the Judiciary and the Raad van State division, that the 'confidential' marking was an error, that no shortened consultation is planned for other migration bills, and that IND concerns about implementation will be taken into account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over het bericht 'Brandbrief over racisme bij de rijksoverheid: medewerkers van kleur lijken systematisch doelwit te worden'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a report that employees of colour are systematically targeted with racism in central government and how complaints are handled. The minister acknowledges the problem, outlines planned measures (guidance for managers, a protocol update, a model for an integrated anti-discrimination approach, external confidential advisers) and gives a partial answer that defers several points to later.
I expect the relevant departments to get this in order as soon as possible, and I will make sure that this happens.
Ik ga ervan uit dat de betreffende departementen dit zo spoedig mogelijk op orde maken en ik zal mij ervan vergewissen dat dit gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en El Abassi over het niet naleven van de Wet politiegegevens

MPs Kathmann and El Abassi ask why the police have not complied with the Wet politiegegevens' deletion deadline for removed data, which the korpschef deliberately did not destroy from 2019 pending legal reform, and who oversees this. Minister Van Weel answers that the non-compliance is a deliberate, politically backed choice limited to article 14 data usable in cold cases, that the Raad van State has been asked for advice, and that a bill is planned for consultation in 2025.
There is no question of a tolerance decision. The korpschef decided, pending an amendment of the retention periods in the Wpg, not to proceed with destroying the relevant data.
Er is geen sprake van een gedoogbesluit. De korpschef heeft besloten in afwachting van een wijziging van de bewaartermijnen in de Wpg niet over te gaan tot vernietiging van de betreffende gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over het artikel 'Brandbrief over racisme bij de rijksoverheid: ‘Medewerkers van kleur lijken systematisch doelwit te worden’'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about a letter from 58 civil servants with migrant backgrounds alleging institutional racism in the central government, and about measures against managers, reporting channels, and diversity policy. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes planned measures such as a manager handbook, diverse confidential advisers, a focused anti-racism approach and effect reporting, but states that the 2022 survey baseline does not allow firm conclusions on rising racism.

To this end I will develop a model for an effective integrated approach and periodically ask the departments to deliver a policy and effect report on discrimination and racism according to this model.

Ik zal hiervoor een model voor een effectieve integrale aanpak ontwikkelen en periodiek aan de departementen vragen om een beleids- en effectrapportage discriminatie en racisme volgens dit model op te leveren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Chakor over ondersteuning voor mensen met een beperking voor hun functie als gemeenteraadslid, Statenlid of lid van het algemeen bestuur van een waterschap

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about support and barriers for people with disabilities who become councillors, provincial members or water board members, including benefit and allowance offsetting and accessibility of council chambers. The minister answered that the government supports more representation, points to existing measures such as an action plan, a pilot and a new online platform, but says it cannot remove all barriers, that benefit rules are complex and case-specific, and that it will discuss council-chamber accessibility with local governments.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht: ‘Overheid aan kop met het inzetten van interim-managers’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that government use of interim managers remains high, that their rates rise faster than market rates, and whether the target to cut external hiring is realistic. The minister answered that interim management was 5% of external hiring spending in 2023, disputed the rate-increase claim, pointed to a planned action plan on reducing external hiring in Q1 2025 and a new ministerial committee.

In the committee debate on the functioning of the civil service of 6 November 2024, I committed in this context to send Parliament an action plan for reducing external hiring in the first quarter of 2025.

In het commissiedebat Functioneren Rijksdienst van 6 november 2024 heb ik in dit kader toegezegd om in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 een plan van aanpak terugdringen externe inhuur aan Uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga over Staatssecretaris Jansen en de veiligheid op de werkvloer op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MP Bamenga asks ministers about a letter from 175 civil servants at the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management protesting Staatssecretaris Jansen's remarks about Moroccans, the reported sick leave of advisers, and how ministers will restore a safe working climate and address institutional racism in the civil service. The government answers that it takes the concerns seriously, that talks with staff are ongoing, that a broader integrated anti-discrimination approach and reporting model are planned, and declines to give individual personnel details.
We do not comment on internal individual personnel matters.
Over interne individuele personele aangelegenheden doen wij geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de beantwoording van vragen over het bericht over gedoe rond vergadering van pro-Palestinastudenten

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences must keep security measures within fundamental rights, including photographing protesting students, covert listening and guards at meetings. Minister Bruins answered that institutions bear primary responsibility, that the minister has a stelselverantwoordelijkheid, that existing law and the joint protest guidelines suffice, and that complaints should go to the institution or the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
As the minister responsible for the system, I have no involvement in the institution-specific considerations institutions make when developing and implementing their security policy.
Als stelselverantwoordelijk Minister heb ik geen bemoeienis met de instellingsspecifieke afwegingen die instellingen maken bij het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van hun veiligheidsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over het bericht 'Evangelist op station Maastricht met machtsvertoon staande gehouden: 'Intimiderende en dreigende sfeer''

ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers whether police intervention against evangelists singing at a Maastricht station piano, and NS house rules restricting evangelising folders, are compatible with freedom of religion, and whether they will talk to NS about this. The government answered that police acted on a nuisance report under local responsibility, that no restrictions were imposed and the group left voluntarily, that house rules and WP2000 obligations justify NS enforcement, and that it sees no reason to talk to NS now.
The police's conduct was based on knowledge of the local situation and under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het optreden van de politie is op basis van de kennis van de lokale situatie en onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over racisme en discriminatie binnen de Rijksoverheid

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about racism and discrimination within the national civil service, including union calls for a personal letter to staff and the design of an independent integrity commission. The minister answered that racism has been condemned through an internal message, distinguished the complaints commission from the integrity commission, and committed to establishing the integrity commission by 1 May 2025 with union involvement.
I acknowledge the importance of establishing the Integrity Commission Rijk in the short term.
Ik erken het belang om de Integriteitscommissie Rijk op korte termijn op te richten.
Antwoord op het lid Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Politieke partijen blijven anonieme donaties aannemen’ uit Vrij Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether political parties can still receive anonymous or split donations via loopholes, including advice to return gifts over EUR 250 to the donor and the ability to split large donations. The Minister defended the rules as transparency-focused, said full loophole closure is not possible, and pointed to a forthcoming Political Parties Act bill.
It is not possible to legally close all possible circumvention routes.
Het is niet mogelijk om wettelijk alle mogelijke omzeilingsroutes te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'Een nieuw kiesstelsel, ongelijk en onevenredig'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about an article arguing that a district electoral system would conflict with the constitutional principles of equal suffrage and proportional representation, and posed 13 questions on overhang seats, proportionality, timing and alternatives. The minister answered that the new system must fit within constitutional limits, that research by Leiden and Twente is underway on three variants, and that a problem analysis will follow in March 2025 without substantive commitments on the questions raised.
As announced in the letter of 4 December, I expect to inform your House in March 2025 about the direction the cabinet has in mind for the electoral system.
Zoals aangekondigd in de brief van 4 december jl. verwacht ik in maart 2025 uw Kamer te informeren over de richting die het kabinet voor ogen heeft voor het Kiesstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het van het lid Bamenga over de plannen voor (intensievere) controles aan de landsgrenzen

An MP asked the ministers about intensified border controls, whether checks occur without individual suspicion, what safeguards prevent ethnic profiling, and related use of number plates and sensors. The government answered that the Marechaussee is bound by non-discrimination rules, no longer uses ethnicity in selection, complaints go to the KMar, Inspectie JenV and the Nationale ombudsman, and that controls are risk- and information-driven rather than random.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security supervises the conduct of the KMar.
De Inspectie van Justitie en Veiligheid houdt toezicht op het handelen van de KMar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Geschrokken reacties na vuurwerkbekogeling raadsleden'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how she would respond to fireworks thrown at councillors on their way to a council meeting, and what could be done against threats to councillors. The minister condemned the attack, pointed to existing criminal and administrative options, contact with the municipality, and the Weerbaar Bestuur support team, and promised continued support but no new legal measures.
I find all forms of aggression and intimidation against political office holders unacceptable.
Ik vind alle vormen van agressie en intimidatie tegen politieke ambtsdragers onacceptabel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Bikker over het rapport ‘Hamas in Europe’ en het bericht 'Buurlanden komt hij niet in, tóch mag omstreden kopstuk van pro-Palestinaclub spreken op universiteit in Nijmegen'

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government would investigate persons and organisations linked to Hamas in a report, and whether it would act against the Samidoun coordinator invited to speak at Radboud University. The government replied that the AIVD investigation continues, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, that the speaker has been flagged for entry refusal, and that talks with the Public Prosecution Service and AIVD on Samidoun-type organisations took place without indications for criminal suspicion.
Naturally, no public statement can be made about whether intelligence and security services are conducting investigations into persons or organisations.
Vanzelfsprekend kan in de openbaarheid geen uitspraak worden gedaan over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten naar personen of organisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over de zorgen van gemeenten over de grenscontroles

MPs Chakor asked how the government involved municipalities in planning border controls and whether it would address the burden on cross-border residents and businesses. The Minister replied that officials had contact with local authorities, a administrative meeting was held with commissioners and border mayors, and measures such as risk-based, non-systematic checks and no speed restrictions unless strictly necessary were announced.
Both before and after 11 November, there has been official contact with subnational authorities.
Zowel voor 11 november jl. als daarna is ambtelijk contact geweest met medeoverheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Flach over de versterkte gebedsoproepen door moskeeën

MPs Eerdmans and Flach asked the Minister of Interior about enhanced call-to-prayer broadcasts from mosques, including their frequency, number of complaints and legal basis. The minister answered that no data on mosques, frequency or complaints is yet available, that a fact-finding trajectory is underway to inform future rules, and that the practice is a constitutionally protected connex right subject to necessity and proportionality.
No, we do not yet have this information at this time.
Nee, wij beschikken op dit moment nog niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Mutluer over gezichtsherkenning bij de politie

MPs Kathmann, Lahlah and Mutluer asked about police use of facial recognition and camera surveillance at peaceful demonstrations, citing an Amnesty report, and asked about oversight, data sources, retention and procurement. The Minister replied that police do not use real-time facial recognition at demonstrations, only retrospectively against suspects of crimes, that the Dutch DPA has adequate expertise to supervise, and that a national legal framework and an AI-regulation-based transparency register are being explored and will follow.
Only when criminal offences have been committed can the police subsequently use facial recognition technology to identify suspects.
Enkel wanneer sprake is van strafbare feiten kan door de politie achteraf gezichtsherkenningstechnologie worden ingezet om verdachten te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palmen over het artikel 'Overheid verzaakt plicht om transparant te zijn: ’U wilt die informatie zeker niet meer hè?’'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether ministries breach the statutory Woo deadlines for freedom-of-information requests, why, and whether journalists are asked to withdraw requests as outdated. The minister confirms that all ministries miss the deadlines, attributes this to structural causes, defends contacting requesters as permissible, and announces measures, an evaluation brought forward and a dashboard.
In this context, I consider it permissible and desirable to contact Woo requesters about their requests.
In dit kader acht ik het toegestaan en wenselijk om over Woo-verzoeken in contact te treden met Woo-verzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'Overheid verzaakt plicht om transparant te zijn: ’U wilt die informatie zeker niet meer hè?’'

MP Sneller asks whether ministries try to let Woo information requests lapse, what share are handled on time, what fines were paid, what extra effort is made, and what targets and information-management measures apply. The minister denies steering requests toward lapse, reports that only 39.6% of ministry Woo requests were handled on time in 2023, notes EUR 2.09 million in penalties, and commits to a target of half of requests on time in 2025 plus phased active disclosure and an improved information management plan.
In doing so, it is important that the requester's information need is leading and that there is no steering towards letting information requests lapse.
Het is hierbij wel van belang dat de informatiebehoefte van de verzoeker leidend is en er niet wordt gestuurd op het laten vervallen van informatieverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de inzet van digitale surveillance bij demonstraties

The MP asks whether police digital surveillance at peaceful demonstrations, the legal basis for it, retention and sharing of data, and notification of participants comply with privacy and the right to demonstrate, following an Amnesty International report. The minister answers that camera use is occasional and based on risk assessments, that no identity registration occurs, that detailed per-demonstration information is not requested from municipalities, and that the broader Amnesty recommendations will be addressed in a later police progress letter.
I do not have an overview of demonstrations at which the police deployed cameras.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van demonstraties waarbij de politie camera's heeft ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tseggai over de toenemende discriminatie tegen moslims

An MP asked ministers about rising discrimination against Muslims, citing an EU survey showing 55% of Dutch Muslims report discrimination, and about school discrimination, national anti-discrimination policy, and training measures. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a forthcoming national study on Muslim discrimination, outlined the division of responsibilities across ministries, and referred to existing programmes and a future action plan without committing to new binding measures.
On the basis of the findings of the study, it will be considered which specific additional measures can be taken to prevent discrimination against Muslims.
Op grond van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek wordt bezien welke specifieke maatregelen aanvullend getroffen kunnen worden om moslimdiscriminatie te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht aangaande de aanstelling van een woordvoerder op het ministerie van Asiel en Migratie

An MP asked the ministers whether Minister Faber (Asylum and Migration) refused to appoint a former spokesperson of the Amsterdam mayor, how spokesperson appointments work, and why the appointment was withdrawn. The government answered the procedure questions in general terms but declined to comment on the individual case, and gave no figures on refused appointments.
I do not make statements about individual case matters.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht ‘Gedetineerde uit De Westereen mocht niet in het Fries met beppe bellen’

MPs Paternotte and Sneller asked whether a detainee was wrongly barred from calling his dementia-stricken grandmother in Frisian, and whether Frisian speakers' language rights are being respected in detention. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, said language restrictions can apply for security monitoring reasons, and noted that the appeals judge found refusing a Frisian interpreter reasonable.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Eerdmans over het bericht dat gemeenten nauwelijks van elkaar leren over nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Nispen and Eerdmans asked whether municipalities learn enough from each other about preventing New Year's Eve disorder, and what role the minister sees for herself. The minister replied that knowledge sharing already happens via VNG networks, regional consultations and the Strategic Consultation with mayors, that local preparation is a municipal responsibility, and offered no new concrete step.
Preparing for the New Year's celebration is a local responsibility and runs through the local triangle.
Het voorbereiden van de jaarwisseling is een lokale bevoegdheid en verloopt via de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op het lid Chakor over de rijkswerkgelegenheid in Noord-Nederland n.a.v. het artikel ‘Rijksbanen verdwijnen uit de regio

An MP asks why Groningen government jobs are projected to fall 5.5% despite the Elke Regio Telt goal of decentralising jobs, what measures prevent regional decline, why new civil-service jobs cluster in the Randstad, and about the Assen and Groningen hubs and the planned Groningen meeting place. The minister answers that the projection is outdated, mainly due to the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen's finite mandate, that the government is working on better spreading of jobs with regions, and gives timelines for the Groningen meeting place.
In the parliamentary letter I announce that I will examine how the reliability of the projections can be improved.
In de Kamerbrief kondig ik aan te zullen onderzoeken hoe de betrouwbaarheid van de prognoses kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de demonstratie waarbij de Kromhout Kazerne urenlang werd geblokkeerd

An MP asked the Defence and Interior ministers about a protest that blockaded the Kromhout barracks in Utrecht for hours, forcing cancellation of an NIDV defence-industry event, and whether the mayor and authorities should have intervened and whether restrictive rules are needed. The minister answered that the event was cancelled, that the mayor is responsible for public order and that a WODC study on demonstration law is underway, while stating that blanket bans on demonstrations at military sites are not possible under current law.
It is not possible to ban demonstrations in public spaces in advance as a standard measure.
Het is niet mogelijk om demonstraties op openbaar terrein vooraf standaard te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bikker over het artikel 'Brede welvaart nu gaat steeds meer ten koste van latere generaties'

MPs Sneller and Bikker asked the Minister of Interior how often the generation test (generatietoets) has been applied since the Segers-Jetten motion, whether it has been evaluated, and how future generations' interests can be weighed structurally. The Minister answered that the test is still being developed in an interdepartmental working group, has not been evaluated yet, will be embedded in the Beleidskompas, and promised to inform the House in Q1 2025.
Ik ben het hier volmondig mee eens.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over het uitlezen van mobiele telefoons

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister how the CJEU ruling allowing phone searches for minor offences would affect Dutch practice, and what protocols, consent rules and data retention apply. The minister replied that the ruling's impact is still uncertain, that a codifying bill will be consulted on once clearer, and described current Dutch rules, biometric unlocking and data storage periods.
Before the end of the year, your House will receive the policy response to the evaluation reports.
Voor het einde van het jaar ontvangt uw Kamer de beleidsreactie op de evaluatierapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht dat gemeenten volgend jaar minder geld krijgen voor de opvang van Oekraïners

Piri (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked whether the government's planned cut of about 30% in the per-day reimbursement for municipal Ukrainian refugee shelter would stop municipalities creating enough places, and how this fits the target of 125,000 places. The minister answered that the rates are recalibrated to a cost study, that the exception allowing actual costs to be claimed remains, and that municipalities will not be financially disadvantaged, while many questions were answered only by restating policy or referring to the cost-study outcome.
The starting point here is that municipalities do not suffer any financial disadvantage from the reception task for displaced persons from Ukraine.
Het uitgangspunt hierbij is dat gemeenten geen financieel nadeel ondervinden van de opvangtaak voor ontheemden uit Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Inge van Dijk en Bontenbal over verschillende vormen van woonegoïsme

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about residents who file objections or appeals against housing projects to extract buyouts, and about procedural delays in housing construction. The minister condemned appeals made purely for financial gain but said it cannot be measured, defended the right to appeal, and pointed to the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting to speed up housing-project litigation through single-instance appeal.
It is not possible to determine how many objections and appeals have been withdrawn in recent years on such suspicion.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel bezwaar- en beroepschriften de afgelopen jaren vanwege een dergelijk vermoeden zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Chakor over ´het onder druk zetten van ambtenaren´

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a minister pressured civil servants at the Ministry of Infrastructure to use specific Schiphol and KLM data in flight-cap calculations despite their concerns, and asked how integrity and independent advice are safeguarded and whether the decision should be independently reviewed. The government replied that the question is for the other minister to answer, reaffirmed the importance of independent advice and integrity, and declined to commission an independent review of another department's decision-making.
It is not for me to review or have reviewed the policy and decision-making within another department.
Het is niet aan mij om de beleids- en besluitvorming binnen een ander departement te recenseren of te laten toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar  over het bericht uit de Telegraaf van 4 oktober jl. 'Boosheid om ophoping waterschapsbelasting: Rekening van €1200 binnen zeven maanden tijd’

An MP asked the Minister about a water board (Amstel, Gooi en Vecht) sending multiple overdue tax bills after ICT failures, and about provincial oversight, hardship, and citizens' rights. The minister answered that the provinces, not the ministry, supervise water boards, that the board offers instalments, relaxed waiver rules and restrained enforcement, and that the ministry has no authority to intervene because the issue does not concern sound water management.
Provincial executives are responsible for carrying out supervision of the water board and therefore for how they communicate with the board about it.
Gedeputeerde staten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het toezicht op het waterschap en hiermee ook voor de wijze waarop zij hierover communiceert met het waterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitvoering van de motie Snoeren (2021)

An FVD MP asks why the government-commissioned evaluation of the Sint Pancras and Koedijk municipal merger does not ask residents whether they would prefer to belong to Alkmaar, as required by the 2021 Snoeren motion, and whether the research bureau will add that question. The Minister replies that the province of Noord-Holland and Dijk en Waard run the evaluation through an independent bureau and a steering group, that BZK sits on that group, that the bureau drafted the survey participatively, and that the outcome will be awaited before any judgement is made.
I would prefer to await this information before going into more detail on your questions.
Ik wacht graag deze informatie af, alvorens meer in detail op uw vragen in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de uitspraak van de minister van VWS ‘Als het staatsnoodrecht in gaat, wil ik nog wel eens zien wie zo stoer is om het tegen te houden’

An MP asks whether a minister's remark that she would like to see who dares to stop emergency powers (staatsnoodrecht) from taking effect is a threat to parliament or the courts and whether it conflicts with collective cabinet responsibility and the rule of law. The minister says it was not meant as a threat, expresses respect for parliament, and states that parliament has the final word on emergency powers.
Parliament has the last word on the use of emergency powers.
Het parlement heeft het laatste woord over de inzet van het staatsnoodrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MPs Rooderkerk and Van der Werf asked whether misogyny should be treated as ideological extremism after a UK announcement, whether there are links to far-right ideology and violence against women, and whether security services monitor it. The government answered that misogyny is not classed as an extremist ideology by itself but appears in extremist narratives, that the NCTV will consult the UK, and that the AIVD cannot publicly detail how it investigates threats.
As stated in the answer to question 9, the AIVD cannot, under the Wiv 2017, publicly disclose how it investigates threats to national security.

Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 9 kan de AIVD, op basis van de Wiv 2017, geen uitspraken in het openbaar doen op welke wijze onderzoek wordt gedaan naar dreigingen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MP Becker asked the government about the UK's plan to treat misogyny as ideological extremism, and whether the Netherlands should follow with a stronger approach to misogyny, incels and manosphere influencers. The government answers that misogyny is a serious problem covered by existing plans and laws, that it is not classed as an extremist ideology but appears in extremist narratives, and that it will consult the UK and include misogyny in the forthcoming Emancipation Note.
The cabinet therefore does not regard misogyny as an extremist ideology, but it does appear as part of the narrative within various extremist and terrorist ideologies.

Vrouwenhaat wordt door het kabinet daarom niet gezien als een extremistische ideologie, maar komt wel terug als onderdeel in het narratief bij verschillende extremistische en terroristische ideologieën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de aanpak van institutioneel racisme

An MP asked the Minister of BZK how the government defines and tackles institutional racism, including in digital systems and algorithms, and what timeline applies. The minister answered that the CRM definition is used, outlined planned measures (discrimination test, Staatscommissie, Awgb review, algorithm framework, discrimination protocol) with timelines, but gave no concrete binding commitment beyond existing plans.
I expect to inform your House at the end of 2024 or in the first quarter of 2025 about the outcome of this study.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer eind 2024 of in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 te informeren over de uitkomst van dit onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Tseggai over het Advies van het college voor de Rechten van de Mens om de discriminatiegrond ‘opleiding’ op te nemen in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling

MPs Stultiens and Tseggai asked the ministers about the Human Rights Institute's advice to add education level as a protected ground under the equal treatment act, and about government support for vocational education. The minister acknowledged the advice, said the government will respond in a cabinet reaction, will study the advice together with the Interior Minister, and will examine socio-economic status as a ground separately.
I will study this advice carefully, together with my colleague the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal dit advies, samen met mijn collega-minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, goed bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Chakor over de belofte van goed bestuur en de gebrekkige naleving van afspraken over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Chakor asked the Minister of Interior why ministers keep incomplete public agendas and omit external meetings, despite the rule to update them weekly and the GRECO recommendations on transparency. The minister acknowledges the agendas are not kept adequately, says ministers are individually responsible, points to the pending Braun evaluation and a possible lobby register, and says her agenda has been updated retroactively.
The OSF research shows that this is still not happening adequately enough.
Het onderzoek van OSF laat zien dat dit nog niet adequaat genoeg gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Kathmann over het archiveren van zakelijke appjes

MPs Chakor and Kathmann asked how ministries ensure that business WhatsApp messages are properly archived, why compliance with the 2023 guidelines is inconsistent, and how oversight and responsibility are organised. The state secretary answers that compliance has improved, that oversight rests with the Inspectie OE and CIO Rijk monitoring, that a Rijksbrede chat-archiving facility is being built, and that the government will respond to the ADR audit report with the Algemene Zaken budget.
The aim is to provide the response to the ADR audit report before the Algemene Zaken budget debate.
Gestreefd wordt om de reactie op het ADR-onderzoeksrapport voor de behandeling van de begroting van Algemene Zaken te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Inge van Dijk over het bericht «Bureaucratie binnen de Rijksoverheid uitgegroeid tot zeldzame proporties»

MPs Bontenbal and Inge van Dijk asked about reports that over half of ministry staff work in overhead, its causes, Woo workload, and cost-cutting goals. The minister estimates overhead at 45-50 percent, admits no reliable per-ministry figures, promises a Woo workload study and a bureaucracy-reduction agenda, but gives no concrete targets yet.
I do not have reliable figures per ministry.
Over betrouwbare cijfers per ministerie beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de hernieuwde fatwa van imam Jalali

Wilders asked whether the government knew of imam Jalali's renewed fatwa against him, whether it condemns the threats, what it has done to get the imam imprisoned, and what consequences non-cooperation by Pakistan would have.
