The minister said AIVD and NCTV information cannot be discussed publicly, condemned the threats, described diplomatic and legal-assistance efforts with Pakistan, and declined to pre-empt consequences for relations with Pakistan.

As is known to your House, no public statement can be made about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat casuistry and security measures for individuals.

Antwoord 2 Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, kan er over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigingscasuïstiek en beveiligingsmatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Kathmann over het onderzoek van Trollrensics over desinformatienetwerken tijdens de EU verkiezingen

MPs Piri and Kathmann asked the government about a Trollrensics report on disinformation networks targeting the 2024 European elections, including whether AIVD, MIVD and NCTV confirm it, whether similar campaigns occurred in the Netherlands, the role of Dutch hosting infrastructure, and whether the DSA suffices against platforms like X. The minister answered that the network was not observed in the Netherlands, that the services cannot publicly confirm investigations, that DSA enforcement by the European Commission is ongoing, and that a broader Dutch disinformation strategy is underway.
The cabinet cannot publicly disclose where the intelligence and security services are or are not conducting investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen naar waar de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten al dan niet onderzoek naar doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over onderzoeken of (voormalige) regeringspartijen of politici verbonden aan (voormalige) regeringspartijen zijn gefinancierd met geld uit Oekraïne of de Verenigde Staten

An MP (Baudet, FVD) asked whether state actors such as Ukraine, the United States or Russia might influence Dutch politics, including through funding, awards or think tank roles, and whether the government would have the Algemene Rekenkamer investigate Dutch party politicians since 2014. The minister answered that foreign influence is monitored mainly by the intelligence services, that foreign party donations have been banned since 2023, and that the government will not request such an audit.
She considers it very important that we further arm ourselves against undesirable influence and strengthen the public debate.
Zij vindt het van groot belang dat we ons verder wapenen tegen ongewenste beïnvloeding en het publieke debat versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht ‘Gemeenten dreigen miljarden mis te lopen’

An MP asked the minister whether municipalities and provinces lose hundreds of millions yearly because the fund normering underestimates inflation, and whether the compensation should be set earlier. The minister replied that the bbp-based system is stable and transparent, that it gives no direct inflation compensation, that the government sees no reason to change it, and that it will keep discussing financing with the local government bodies.
In view of the above, the cabinet sees no reason to change the system.
Het kabinet ziet gezien het bovenstaande geen reden om de systematiek te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de nieuwsberichten dat gemeenten vanwege een te laag ingeschatte inflatie door het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) mogelijk een half miljard euro mislopen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are shortchanged by about half a billion euro because CPB underestimated inflation, and whether they should be fully compensated for inflation. The minister answered that the fund system grows with GDP without direct inflation compensation, that the government sees no reason to change it, and that the CPB's forecasts are independent and volatile.
In view of the above, the cabinet sees no reason to change the system.
Het kabinet ziet gezien bovenstaande geen reden om de systematiek te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Six Dijkstra over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de conceptenrichtlijn

MPs Palmen and Six Dijkstra asked the Interior Minister whether earlier answers on draft documents under the Woo transparency law were correct, including a nota showing a ministry applied a blanket draft-exclusion policy. The minister acknowledges the 2022 Woo instruction was too strict, leading to routine refusal of drafts, that it was revised in July 2024, and that a study of Woo implementation costs will start, but denies the Chamber was deliberately misinformed.

As previously stated in the letter to the House of 12 February 2024, the Woo instruction appeared stricter than intended, so that in practice drafts were refused more often than they should have been.
Zoals ook eerder aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 12 februari 2024 oogde de Woo-instructie strakker dan bedoeld, waardoor in de praktijk concepten vaker werden geweigerd dan zou moeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Welzijn over de vermogensgrenzen voor lokale kwijtscheldingen

MPs Lahlah and Welzijn asked about the asset limits for local tax exemptions after a Council of State ruling that municipalities must follow national rules even when they want to allow beneficiaries a savings buffer. The minister acknowledged the wish for a buffer, noted the existing €2,000 allowance, and said a study on raising the asset limit is underway, with the Chamber to be informed before the budget debate.
I am now having a study carried out, partly in response to the amended motion by Palmen and Mohandis, into the questions in that motion and the policy issues.
Ik laat nu, mede naar aanleiding van de Nader gewijzigde motie van de leden Palmen en Mohandis 5 een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de vragen uit deze motie en de beleidsvraagstukken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Chakor over de “buitengewone omstandigheden” die de minister-president zouden nopen het parlement buitenspel te zetten

MPs Piri and Chakor asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government's plan to invoke emergency powers under articles 110-111 of the Aliens Act to suspend chapters 1-7 for an asylum crisis is lawful, and whether it bypasses parliament. The minister answered that the Aliens Act and these powers fall under the Minister of Asylum and Migration, that a reasoned justification will follow, that a bill extending article 111 must be submitted promptly to parliament, and that the Council of State will advise.
Importantly, after article 111 is brought into force, a bill on the continuation of article 111 must be submitted to the House of Representatives without delay.
Van belang hierbij is dat, na de inwerkingstelling van artikel 111, onverwijld een wetsvoorstel bij de Tweede Kamer moet worden ingediend over het voortduren van de werking van artikel 111.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Nispen over berichtgeving over de het verleden van de BVD met betrekking tot het uitwisselen van informatie over vermeende Indonesische communisten

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of the Interior whether she would respond to press reports that the former BVD shared information on suspected Indonesian communists with the CIA and Indonesian authorities, and whether thorough historical research should be done. The Minister replied that the files show exchanges with Western services but cannot conclusively establish BVD contribution to persecution or killings, that no information went to an Indonesian service in the 1960s as far as the files show, and that the AIVD has appointed a historical adviser to promote external academic research.
Like my predecessor, I attach great value to independent and scientific research, including into the BVD.
Net als mijn ambtsvoorganger hecht ik grote waarde aan onafhankelijk en wetenschappelijk onderzoek, ook naar de BVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Rajkowski over het zonder veiligheidsonderzoek toelaten door Hongarije van Russische en Wit-Russische «gastarbeiders» tot het Schengengebied

Two MPs asked whether Hungary's extension of its National Card work permit to Russian and Belarusian workers without security screening violates Schengen and sanctions rules, and what risks this poses for the Netherlands. The government answered that individual entry bans still apply, that Hungary must still carry out border checks, that the Commission has asked Hungary for information and the Netherlands is awaiting its assessment, and that the risk of intelligence officers using this route is taken seriously.

EU Commissioner for Home Affairs Ylva Johansson requested by letter on 1 August that Hungary's Minister of Internal Affairs provide text and explanation at short notice on the extension of the National Card to Belarusian and Russian nationals.
Eurocommissaris voor Binnenlandse Zaken Ylva Johansson heeft op 1 augustus jl. per brief aan de Hongaarse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken Hongarije verzocht op korte termijn tekst en uitleg te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Wilders over het feit dat de MIVD de wettelijk verplichte notificatieplicht bij afluisteren, aftappen en andere bijzondere bevoegdheden niet nakomt

MPs Omtzigt and Wilders asked why the MIVD has not fulfilled its statutory duty to notify people subjected to special powers, and about the status of its notification backlog since the CTIVD's 2017 report. The minister acknowledged a backlog from 2019 to November 2023, said measures are underway with full repair targeted by 1 April 2025, but declined to give figures on targets, politicians, lawyers or journalists and did not disclose compliance incidents to Parliament.
The aim is for the MIVD to have fully cleared the backlog by 1 April 2025.
Het streven is dat de MIVD de achterstand voor 1 april 2025 volledig heeft hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Volkskrant-artikel ‘AIVD en MIVD rekruteerden journalisten als agent, ‘ondermijning geloofwaardigheid’ van het vak’

An FVD MP asked the Defence and Interior Ministers about a Volkskrant report that the AIVD and MIVD recruited journalists as agents, including how many, whether it continues, and whether the public may know their names. The government confirmed the legal possibility under the Wiv 2017 with extra safeguards, but refused to disclose numbers, current use, or any list of journalists citing source protection and secrecy duties.
The heads of the services are, under Article 23 of the Wiv 2017, responsible for keeping their sources and the safety of agents secret.
De diensthoofden zijn, conform artikel 23 van de Wiv 2017, verantwoordelijk voor de geheimhouding van hun bronnen en de veiligheid van agenten.

m: Motie Meeuwis over afschaffing van de Wet werk en inkomen kunstenaars
Asks the government to propose gradually abolishing the Wet werk en inkomen kunstenaars, the special social security scheme for artists.
requests the government to make a proposal to gradually abolish the Work and Income (Artists) Act
verzoekt de regering een voorstel te doen om de Wet werk en inkomen kunstenaars geleidelijk af te schaffen
Motie Meeuwis en Koşer Kaya over de totale kosten van re-integratie

Asks the government to commission independent research into the total costs and effectiveness of re-integration for national government and municipalities and send the results to the House before summer 2010.
requests the government to commission independent research into the total costs of re-integration for national government and municipalities
verzoekt de regering onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten doen naar de totale kosten van re-integratie voor Rijk en gemeenten
Motie van het lid Timmermans c.s. over het opzeggen van het vertrouwen in de minister van Asiel en Migratie
Declares that the Chamber withdraws its confidence in the Minister of Asylum and Migration.
withdraws confidence in the Minister of Asylum and Migration
zegt het vertrouwen op in de Minister van Asiel en Migratie
Motie Pechtold c.s. over adequate juridisch bijstand
Asks the government to create a regulation fixing a minimum standard of legal aid for Dutch nationals abroad who face possible capital charges, as a safety net.
Requests the government to introduce a regulation that lays down this responsibility.
verzoekt de regering een regeling in te voeren die deze verantwoordelijkheid vastlegt
Amendement van het lid Ormel c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 63 over het toekennen van een bedrag van 7 miljoen euro aan het MATRA-programma
Shifts €7 million within the foreign aid budget to the MATRA programme for pre-accession countries, funded by cuts to the stability fund and OSCE budget.
This amendment aims to allocate an amount of 7 million euros to the MATRA programme.
Dit amendement beoogt een bedrag van 7 miljoen euro toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma.
Asks the government to deliver by 1 March 2011 a plan to restructure the diplomatic post network along the lines of an earlier motion.
requests the government to come up with an elaboration as requested in that motion
verzoekt de regering met een uitwerking te komen zoals verzocht in die motie
Asks the government to map the financial extra costs of repairing image damage and embassy efforts caused by the PVV toleration arrangement and inform the House.
requests the government to map the financial extra costs of repairing the image damage incurred
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen wat de financiële meerkosten zijn van het herstel van de opgelopen imagoschade
Motie-Thieme c.s. over de ecologische voetafdruk
Asks the government to continuously pursue reducing the Netherlands' ecological footprint abroad in its foreign policy.
requests the government to continuously strive, in its foreign policy, to reduce the Netherlands' ecological footprint abroad
verzoekt de regering bij haar buitenlandbeleid voortdurend te streven naar verkleining van de ecologische voetafdruk van Nederland in het buitenland
Amendement van het lid Ormel c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 72 over het toekennen van een bedrag van 7 miljoen euro aan het MATRA-programma
Moves 7 million euro into the MATRA programme for pre-accession countries, funded by cuts to the stability fund and OSCE budget.
This amendment aims to allocate 7 million euro to the MATRA programme, aimed at pre-accession countries including Turkey.
Dit amendement beoogt een bedrag van 7 miljoen euro toe te kennen aan het MATRA-programma, gericht op pre-accessielanden, inclusief Turkije.
Motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over de situatie in Papoea
Asks the government to seek open dialogue with Indonesia in international fora to stop human rights violations in Papua and report back.
requests the government to take initiatives in international fora leading to open and constructive dialogue with Indonesia on the situation in Papua
verzoekt de regering in internationaal verband initiatieven te ondernemen die moeten leiden tot een open en constructief overleg met Indonesië over de situatie in Papoea
Motie van het lid Nicolaï c.s. over beveiliging diplomatiek verkeer
Asks the government to review the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and inform the House before summer 2011.
requests the government to consider the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and to inform the House about it before summer 2011
verzoekt de regering zich te beraden op de technische beveiliging en classificatie van het Nederlandse diplomatieke verkeer en daarover de Kamer voor de zomer van 2011 te informeren
Motie-El Fassed c.s. over het Shelter City Initiative
Asks the government to join the Shelter City Initiative and introduce emergency visa procedures for human rights defenders at risk.
requests the government to join the Shelter City Initiative and introduce related emergency visa procedures
verzoekt de regering aan te sluiten bij het Shelter City Initiative en bijbehorende procedures voor noodvisa in te voeren
Asks the government to take initiative in the EU or UN for a code of conduct on internal and external accountability of NGOs, including sports federations.
requests the government to take the initiative in EU and/or UN context towards a code of conduct
verzoekt de regering het initiatief te nemen in EU- en/of VN-verband om te komen tot een gedragscode
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri en Nordkamp over Nederlandse onderdelen in Russische drones en raketten

MPs Timmermans, Piri and Nordkamp asked whether the government knew Dutch components were used in Russian drones and missiles, what concrete action was taken, whether the parts are covered by sanctions, and which Dutch firms are involved. The State Secretary answered that sanctions evasion is a priority, that the parts are already sanctioned, that enforcement rests with Customs and the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government cannot give insight into concrete actions against individual companies.
The cabinet cannot give insight into concrete actions that may be taken with individual companies.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in concrete acties die mogelijk worden gedaan bij individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en De Hoop over het negeren van de Grondwet door een kabinetslid

Opposition MPs Timmermans and De Hoop ask why Minister Keijzer will not amend a bill banning priority housing for status holders despite a severe Council of State advisory opinion that it conflicts with equal treatment under the Constitution, and whether the cabinet backs submitting it unchanged. The minister answers that she is still studying the advice, will send a further report to parliament shortly, and that the bill's draft report has yet to be discussed in cabinet.
I expect to send a further report to the House shortly addressing the advice.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een nader rapport naar de Kamer te sturen waarin wordt ingegaan op het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Klaver over de schending van het Poolse luchtruim door Russische drones

MPs Timmermans and Klaver asked whether the government would convene an extra EU Council, form a leaders' group with Poland, push for a sanctions package banning Russian energy imports, accelerate REPowerEU, pressure blocking member states on frozen Russian assets, and explain remaining Russian oil and gas imports via Dutch ports and port-access powers. The government answered that NATO and EU channels are primary, that a separate leaders' group is not appropriate, that negotiations are ongoing, that Dutch oil imports from Russia have ceased and LNG imports are limited, and that port refusal rests on EU sanctions law and with ports and municipalities rather than the national government.
The cabinet regrettably cannot go further into detail on the Dutch position in ongoing negotiations.
Het kabinet kan helaas niet verder in detail ingaan op de Nederlandse positie in lopende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op van de leden Westerveld en Timmermans over de voorgedragen nieuwe demissionaire minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

MPs Westerveld and Timmermans asked the Prime Minister about past remarks by the proposed incoming acting Minister of Education, Culture and Science comparing rainbow zebra crossings to swastikas, and how such a figure could lead the ministry responsible for emancipation, asking 12 questions. The Prime Minister declined to comment on the candidate, stating that the appointment procedure is still ongoing and that he cannot make statements about candidate ministers until it is completed, referring to a general emancipation letter for other matters.
Until the appointment procedure has been completed, I cannot make any statements about candidate ministers and the process outlined above.
Tot het moment dat de benoemingsprocedure is afgerond, kan ik over kandidaat-bewindspersonen en het proces zoals hierboven geschetst geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Timmermans en het lid Piri over de aankondiging van Frankrijk om de Palestijnse staat te erkennen

MPs Timmermans and Piri asked whether the government welcomes France's announced recognition of a Palestinian state, whether the international community should pressure Israel, and whether Nederland should recognise Palestine. The minister said recognition must be part of a political process toward a two-state solution, that the occupation is unlawful per the ICJ, and that the Netherlands currently has no plans to recognise Palestine.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering recognising the Palestinian state.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet niet om de Palestijnse staat te erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Timmermans over de erkenning van de Palestijnse Staat

Opposition MPs Timmermans and Piri asked the government about recognition of a Palestinian state, Israeli threats of annexation, and Israeli settlement expansion. The minister answered that no contact with Israel on recognition has occurred, that the government condemns settlements and supports EU measures, and that recognition is not currently on the agenda for the Netherlands.
Recognition is not currently on the agenda for the Netherlands.
Erkenning is voor Nederland op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, De Hoop en Kostić over renovatie van wijken met erfgoedwaarde zoals Meezenbroek

MPs Timmermans, De Hoop and Kostić asked the housing minister about demolition of the historic Meezenbroek neighbourhood in Heerlen, residents' right to return, tenant protections, consultation, and the financial and environmental case for renovation over demolition. The minister answered that housing corporations decide locally, that tenant protections and a national demolition-and-renovation statute apply, that no absolute right of return is desirable, and that a national study on demolition is due end 2025.
Given the major impact demolition/new construction has on residents, I attach importance to involving residents in good time in such projects.
Vanwege de grote invloed die sloop/nieuwbouw op bewoners heeft, hecht ik waarde aan het tijdig betrekken van bewoners bij dit soort trajecten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Tseggai en Lahlah over het bericht 'Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los', en het verzoek van het lid Timmermans om een brief te o

MPs Timmermans, Tseggai and Lahlah asked the cabinet whether it still stands by its statement that no opinions of people with a migration background would be recorded, given the Becker motion requiring research into people with a migration background, and how this fits with the non-discrimination principle. The cabinet answered that the SCP research will cover the whole population without distinguishing by migration background, that it sees no break in cabinet policy, and that it will consider how to provide the requested information within legal frameworks.
The cabinet observes no break in the unity of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet constateert geen breuk in de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Jetten, Dijk, Ouwehand, Bikker, Dassen en Van Baarle over de uitzetting van de elfjarige Mikael

MPs asked the government whether it could grant a residence permit to eleven-year-old Mikael and his mother despite a Council of State ruling, and why the child-amnesty rules required being 'in beeld' with the immigration chain. The minister answered that residence permits require a statutory basis, that the discretionary power was replaced in 2019 and is limited to harsh circumstances in the first application, and that the government will not take measures to prevent harsh outcomes in individual cases.
The cabinet does not intend to take these measures.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om deze maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de dolfijnenslachtingen door Japan en de Faeröer en het plan van Japan om de walvisjacht weer te hervatten

An MP asked the government about dolphin hunts in Japan and the Faroe Islands, Danish police role, whether Japan would resume Antarctic whaling despite the ICJ ruling, and the EU-Japan trade and framework agreements. The ministers said Denmark would be pressed on dolphin killings, the ICJ ruling strengthens opposition to whaling, and whaling and dolphin killing would be raised in the EU-Japan framework negotiations, though no EU consensus exists on linking trade to whaling.
The cabinet will again address Denmark and indicate that killing dolphins, as happens in the Faroe Islands, is not acceptable.
Het kabinet zal Denemarken opnieuw aanspreken en aangeven dat het doden van dolfijnen, zoals dit gebeurt op de Faeröer eilanden, niet acceptabel is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over aanhoudend geweld bij mijnen in Zuid-Afrika

An MP asked the government about ongoing violence at Lonmin mines in South Africa, whether the IFC should pressure Lonmin, whether transparency of payments should be mandated, and whether conflict minerals should be restricted. The minister answered that the South African investigation should not be prejudged, pointed to existing OECD guidelines, EITI and Voluntary Principles, said Lonmin cannot be obliged to disclose payments, and noted that EU negotiations on payment reporting are ongoing.
It is better not to anticipate the outcomes of this investigation.
Het is beter niet vooruit te lopen op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de celstraffen van drie Vietnamese bloggers

MP Timmermans asked the foreign minister about the prison sentences of three Vietnamese bloggers, whether other members of the Club for Free Journalists face similar risks, and whether the government will raise the case bilaterally and at EU level. The minister said the sentences conflict with international free-expression obligations, knows of no similar cases, and that the EU High Representative and the Netherlands have urged Vietnam to respect free expression and release the bloggers.
Bilaterally and within the EU I press for respect for freedom of expression and in particular internet freedom in Vietnam.
Bilateraal en in EU-verband dring ik aan op het respecteren van de vrijheid van meningsuiting en in het bijzonder internetvrijheid in Vietnam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans, Recourt en Marcouch over neonazi’s in Duitsland

MPs Timmermans, Recourt and Marcouch asked the Justice minister about the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia banning three far-right groups and a large police raid, and whether this threatens spillover into the Netherlands and whether closer cooperation is needed. The minister answered that cooperation with German police and the AIVD is good and structural, that the raid led to no Dutch link so far, and that action will follow if Dutch links emerge.
Should facts emerge later in the investigation that relate to the Netherlands, action will be taken on this.
Mochten er in het verdere verloop van het onderzoek alsnog feiten boven tafel komen die verband houden met Nederland, dan zal hier actie op worden ondernomen.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de praktijken van het consulaat van Eritrea

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Eritrean consulate in The Hague extorts Eritrean Dutch nationals through a 2% income levy, whether refusers are threatened or denied consular services, and what the government will do, including possible expulsion of the consul or closure. The minister answered that the levy itself is not illegal in the Netherlands, that police and prosecutors will investigate any reported extortion or intimidation, that protest would be lodged if abuses are confirmed, and that sanctions would be considered if criminal conduct is found, while declining to pre-empt those steps.
While an investigation is ongoing, no statements are made about it.
Lopende een onderzoek worden geen mededelingen daarover gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over het bericht dat energiebedrijven nog steeds niet openbaar maken of ze bloedkolen gebruiken

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether Dutch energy companies disclose whether they use coal linked to human rights abuses, including coal from Drummond mines in Colombia, and what the coal dialogue has achieved. The state secretary answered that self-regulation via the coal dialogue is preferred, that energy companies proposed only aggregated disclosure of mines citing commercial sensitivity, and listed interim dialogue results with the dialogue expected to run to end 2012.
Information on the specific suppliers of coal to energy companies is, according to the latter, commercially sensitive.
Informatie over de specifieke leveranciers van steenkolen aan energiebedrijven is, volgens laatstgenoemden, commercieel gevoelig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Timmermans over de aanvraag van uitstel van betaling door SW-bedrijf Licom

MPs asked the state secretary about Licom, a sheltered-employment (Wsw) company seeking suspension of payments after its municipal shareholders withdrew funding, and about its impact on staff, sector-wide deficits, and the ministry's role. The state secretary answered that responsibility for Wsw implementation and oversight lies with municipalities and their councils, so the ministry cannot provide a sector-wide overview and sees no direct role, while noting municipalities pledged to guarantee jobs and wages and that the ministry will monitor developments.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wsw and for sound financial management.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de Wsw en een verantwoord financieel beheer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over financiering van Nigeriaanse veiligheidstroepen door Shell

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether the government will hold Shell to account for funding Nigerian security forces linked to alleged human rights abuses and whether this conflicts with the Voluntary Principles, which the Netherlands chairs. The minister answered that the government raises these issues with Shell regularly, that Shell says it applies the Voluntary Principles, and that the government presses Nigeria to endorse them, while transparency reporting is left to participants themselves.
For the implementation of the VPs and communication about it with stakeholders, the participants in the VPs, including Shell, are themselves responsible.
Voor de invulling van de VP’s en de communicatie daarover met belanghebbenden zijn de deelnemers aan de VP’s, waaronder Shell, zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over het slopen van sloppenwijken voor de Olympische Spelen in Rio de Janeiro

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked whether the displacement of about 8,000 people for the Rio Olympics is acceptable and whether the government will raise it internationally, and what has been done on the NGO/sports-body conduct code motions and FIFA/IOC responsibility. The minister answered that the number cannot be verified, housing is offered, no international raising is planned for now, an EU expert group will report by end 2012, and that FIFA/IOC cannot be held responsible for host governments' choices.
An exact number cannot be determined.
Een exact aantal valt niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pechtold, Timmermans en El Fassed over ‘tegenstrijdige kabinetsuitlatingen’

MPs Pechtold, Timmermans and El Fassed asked the Prime Minister to reconcile minister Leers' claim that PVV rhetoric made Dutch intentions suspect in the EU with earlier government statements about the PVV's influence on European policy and the 'no misunderstanding' remark. The government answered that the statements concerned different matters (migration versus European dossiers generally), that it depends on other parties for most European files, and that it sees no contradiction, though it agrees such inconsistency would be undesirable.
Yes, but there is no question of contradiction.
Ja, maar van tegenstrijdigheid is geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de Jordaanvallei

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about an Oxfam Novib report on how Israeli settlement policy and movement restrictions in the Jordan Valley harm Palestinian livelihoods, and whether the government will press Israel to halt settlement construction and demolitions. The minister confirms awareness of the report, attributes the valley's socio-economic lag partly to Israeli security restrictions and partly to other factors, calls settlements illegal under international law, and says the Netherlands has urged Israel to stop settlement construction in EU and bilateral channels.
The Netherlands advocates this both within the EU and bilaterally.
Nederland draagt – in EU-verband en bilateraal – dit uit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink over eerherstel voor drie mariniers

Two PvdA MPs asked whether three marines convicted in 1948 for refusing to burn a kampong should receive full rehabilitation and be held up as examples of integrity. The minister replied that the courts found the burning militarily necessary, that no facts justify revising that judgment, that the marines were pardoned and partly restored, and that judging them by today's standards would not be careful.
However, I do not consider it prudent to reassess the conduct of these marines against today's standards and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het echter niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van deze mariniers te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over de behandeling van mensen in Nederlandse en Nederlands-Indische overheidsdienst die indertijd hebben geweigerd mee te doen aan de politionele acties

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked ministers about rehabilitation and treatment of Dutch and Dutch East Indies civil servants and military personnel who refused to take part in the police actions, including how many were punished and whether they will be rehabilitated. The government answered that the numbers of refusers among civil servants and colonial staff are unknown, declined to discuss an individual case, and said it will not reassess past individual conduct against today's norms.

Recognising that the period in question is now viewed in a different light, I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against today's norms and with present-day knowledge.

In het besef dat de desbetreffende periode nu in een ander licht wordt gezien, acht ik het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over de aardbeving in Iran

Timmermans asked the Dutch government whether it knew of the Iran earthquake's consequences and whether Iran had requested international aid, and whether the Netherlands would offer relief. Minister Rosenthal confirmed awareness, expressed condolences, offered humanitarian aid if Iran requested it, and noted that no such request had been made to the Red Cross or the UN.
I have offered him humanitarian aid should Iran request it.
Ik heb hem humanitaire hulp toegezegd zo Iran daarom zou verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over het hardhandige optreden van de Zimbabwaanse politie tegen LGBTI (Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Intersex) activisten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and rough treatment of GALZ LGBTI activists by Zimbabwean police, whether their safety is at risk, and whether Zimbabwe's authorities will be pressed on constitutional and international human rights obligations. The minister answered that the ambassy is in regular contact with GALZ, supports them via lawyers and a counseling unit, and that the EU and the Netherlands have voiced concern and urged Zimbabwe to respect its human rights obligations.
At Dutch urging, the EU expressed serious concern about the situation to the Zimbabwean government shortly after the incident.
Mede op Nederlands aandringen heeft de EU kort na het incident haar ernstige zorgen over de situatie uitgesproken tegenover de Zimbabwaanse overheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de veroordeling van de hoofdredacteur van de Egyptische krant Al-Dostor

An MP asked the foreign minister about the prosecution of the editor-in-chief of the Egyptian newspaper Al-Dostor for insulting the president, and whether Egypt's media laws comply with its human rights obligations and whether the Netherlands would press for reform. The minister said the Netherlands seeks press freedom reforms in bilateral and EU contacts, noted a presidential decree limiting pre-trial detention of journalists and announced plans to revise media law, and said the embassy would monitor the trial.
The Netherlands will follow whether and how the announced amendments are implemented.
Nederland zal volgen of en hoe de aangekondigde aanpassingen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over overstromingen op de Molukken

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would help relieve the suffering of flood victims in the Moluccas, either by supporting private fundraising or by providing emergency aid with local and Indonesian authorities. The State Secretary answered that the Jakarta embassy found Indonesia did not need international support, as the national disaster agency said sufficient Indonesian resources were available and the situation was improving.
Contact with the Indonesian authorities has shown that there is no need for support from the international community.
Uit contact met de Indonesische autoriteiten is gebleken dat er geen behoefte is aan ondersteuning door de internationale gemeenschap.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over straffeloosheid bij moorden op Somalische journalisten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Somali transitional government should launch an independent investigation into recent murders of journalists, whether Amnesty's call for an independent inquiry will be raised with Somali authorities, and whether Somalia's human rights obligations will be pressed bilaterally and through the EU and UN. The minister agreed on the need for investigation and to press Somalia on its obligations, noting that independent investigation remains difficult until security improves, and that the Netherlands presses for it in line with a parliamentary motion.
In light of the Hachchi motion (22 831, no. 71), the Netherlands presses for this.
Mede in het licht van de motie Hachchi ( 22 831, nr. 71 ) dringt Nederland hierop aan.
Antwoord vragen Klijnsma en Timmermans over naheffing door de Duitse fiscus aan Nederlandse oud-dwangarbeiders

Two PvdA MPs asked why elderly Dutch former forced labourers received back-tax demands from the German tax authority on their German state pensions despite a stated exemption, and asked for clear Dutch-language guidance and relief. The state secretary answered that an exemption exists but requires formal recognition as 'Verfolgte', that Germany agreed to a bilateral arrangement for those who can show their pension stems from forced labour, and that Dutch-language information is available and being sent with tax forms.
He then promised to resolve this problem efficiently and without bureaucracy by also granting exemption, within bilateral consultation, to forced labourers who formally fall outside the exemption.
Hij heeft mij toen toegezegd deze problematiek op efficiënte en onbureaucratische wijze te willen oplossen door in het kader van bilateraal overleg ook vrijstelling te verlenen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over over de veroordeling van de band Pussy Riot door de Russische rechterInperking van vrijheid van meningsuiting door verschillende landen

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the sentencing of Pussy Riot members was politically motivated and whether the EU should condemn it and intensify the human rights dialogue with Russia. The minister said she shares international concern about the proportionality of the sentence, endorsed the EU High Representative's statement, and said the existing EU-Russia human rights dialogue will continue with concerns raised.
I share the broad international concern about the disproportion between the limited gravity of the offence and the length of pre-trial detention, the prosecution's demand and the final sentence.
Ik deel de brede internationale zorgen over de verhouding tussen enerzijds de beperkte zwaarte van het vergrijp, en anderzijds de lengte van het voorarrest, de strafeis en de uiteindelijke straf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de situatie rond de Syrische stad Aleppo

An MP asked the foreign minister about the escalating fighting around Aleppo, Kofi Annan's appeal, and what the EU and the Netherlands could do to bring about a ceasefire and pressure Russia and China. The minister answered that the Netherlands favours a political solution, raises the crisis bilaterally with Russia and China, supports the UN General Assembly resolution, backs the opposition and has contributed 7 million euro in humanitarian aid.
The Netherlands remains in favour of a political solution for Syria.
Nederland blijft voorstander van een politieke oplossing voor Syrië.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over Rechtshulpverzoeken door Spanje inzake de Gürtel-corruptiezaak

Parliamentarian Timmermans asked whether the Netherlands has for three years refused to provide Antillean bank account information to Spanish prosecutors in the Gürtel corruption case, and why, given Spanish requests. The minister answered that the Netherlands has assisted the 2008 Spanish request, that additional information was needed and received in 2010, that a FIOD investigation ran until late 2011 and a court permission procedure is pending, and that any remaining evidence in Curaçao is for Curaçao's own authorities to handle.
That investigation lasted until the end of 2011, after which the permission procedure was started at the court, which has not yet reached a final decision.
Dit onderzoek heeft tot eind 2011 geduurd waarna de verlofprocedure bij de rechtbank is gestart welke nog niet tot een eindbeschikking is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over arrestaties van dissidenten door het Cubaanse regime bij de begrafenis van Oswaldo Paya

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Cuba detained at least ten dissidents attending Oswaldo Paya's funeral, whether the government protested, and about suspicions of foul play in his death and the risk to dissidents. The minister confirmed at least thirty were briefly detained without charge, said the embassy monitors the situation and Dutch efforts run through EU-Cuba dialogue, and said only that rumours of a second car exist, with appropriate EU measures possible if developments worsen.
At least thirty dissidents were arrested at Oswaldo Payá's funeral on 24 July and released after a few hours without charge.
Er zijn bij de begrafenis van Oswaldo Payá op 24 juli jl. ten minste dertig dissidenten aangehouden en na enkele uren zonder aanklacht vrijgelaten.
Antwoord vragen Arib en Timmermans over Tweede Kamervragen over Jordaanse wetgeving die toestaat dat een verkrachter met zijn slachtoffer mag trouwen

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would press Jordan, given international rules, to reform Article 308 of its penal code, which lets rapists escape prosecution by marrying their victims. The minister acknowledged rights concerns, said international pressure is important, and said the issue will be raised in bilateral consultations and in EU forums.
I will raise this issue within the EU; the Human Rights Subcommittee under the EU Association Agreement with Jordan and the relevant EU Council working groups offer opportunities to do so.

Ik zal deze problematiek in EU verband aan de orde stellen; het Subcomité Mensenrechten in het kader van het EU Associatieakkoord met Jordanië en de relevante EU-raadswerkgroepen bieden daartoe mogelijkheden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Jadnanansing over de onderwijsachterstand in Zuid-Limburg

MPs Timmermans and Jadnanansing asked the Education Minister whether educational disadvantage in South Limburg is comparable to the Randstad, whether it stems from mine closures and deprived pupil populations, and whether a joint regional approach will be initiated. The minister answered that there is no indication the problems are comparable, that no research links them to mine closures, and that existing provincial and national programmes and a convenant already cover the regional approach.
I do not have any indication that the problems are comparable to those in the Randstad.
Ik beschik niet over een indicatie dat de problemen vergelijkbaar zijn met die in de Randstad.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Hilkens over steenkolenmijnen op de UNESCO-werelderfgoedlijst

MPs Timmermans and Hilkens asked whether the government would consult Limburg authorities to nominate remaining Limburg coal-mining heritage for the UNESCO World Heritage List, after three Walloon mines were listed. The state secretary replied that the independent commission's advice, adopted in 2011, did not include Limburg mining heritage, so no consultation was planned.
I therefore see no reason to now enter into discussions with authorities in Limburg about a World Heritage nomination of parts of the mining region.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding nu in gesprek te gaan met overheden in Limburg over een werelderfgoednominatie van delen van de mijnstreek.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Eijsink over het besluit van Canada zich terug te trekken uit het AWACS-programma

Two PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Canada's withdrawal from the NATO AWACS programme, its reasons, the effect on the Netherlands, and whether the Netherlands would reconsider its own participation. The minister answered that Canada cited a strategic defence review and budget cuts, that no other partners are known to be considering withdrawal, that financial consequences are still under discussion, and that ending Dutch participation is not on the agenda.
Ending the Dutch participation in the AWACS programme is not on the agenda.
Beëindiging van de Nederlandse deelneming in het AWACS-programma is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Heijnen en Taverne over problemen bij het stemmen in het buitenland

MPs Timmermans, Heijnen and Taverne asked whether Dutch citizens abroad calling the DUTCHHELP line were given incorrect information, including that they could vote online, and why election information was not on all Dutch missions' websites and at counters. The minister answered that no online voting was mentioned, only registration (which can partly be done online), that election links were provided on embassy and consulate sites, and that posts promoted registration and displayed the website at counters.
No. There is no mention of casting a vote via the internet; however, information is provided on how and where one can register.
Neen. Er wordt niet gesproken over het uitbrengen van de stem via internet; wel wordt informatie verstrekt over hoe en waar men zich kan registreren.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam en Timmermans over het feit dat bezwaarschriften voor aanvragen van visa voor Nederland in veel gevallen in een andere taal dan het Nederlands dienen te worden geformuleerd

MPs Van Dam and Timmermans asked whether Schengen partners handle Dutch visa applications on Nederland's behalf so that appeals must be filed with another country, possibly in its language, and how that burdens Dutch citizens. The minister confirmed the arrangements and language requirements, but pointed to new applications or Dutch posts as alternatives and made no commitment to change the rules.
In those cases, an appeal against the refusal of the Schengen visa must be lodged with the Schengen country concerned.
In die gevallen dient een beroep tegen de weigering van het Schengenvisum bij het betreffende Schengenland te worden ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de mogelijke executie van vijf Iraanse Ahwazi Arabieren

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest bilaterally and in the EU over the possible execution of five Ahwazi Arabs held without fair trial, and whether it would back tougher EU sanctions. The minister replied that four of the five had already been executed, that Nederland and the EU have protested and urged abolition of the death penalty, and that additional EU sanctions on Iranian human rights violators and internet monitoring exports were adopted in March.
In response to the report you cite, I have advocated an appropriate response among my EU colleagues to the concerning situation of the Ahwazi community in general and this case in particular.

Mede in reactie op het door u aangehaalde bericht heb ik bij mijn EU collega's een passende reactie op de zorgelijke situatie van de Ahwazi gemeenschap in het algemeen en deze zaak in het bijzonder bepleit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over 'de blokkade van Gaza'

An MP asked the government whether it shares the view of fifty development, human rights and peace organisations that Israel's Gaza blockade must be lifted, whether it considers the blockade a collective punishment contrary to the Geneva Conventions, and whether it has raised the issue with Israel and will press for its lifting. The minister answered that the Dutch position is unchanged and backs free movement via regular crossings subject to Israeli security interests, regards the measures as security measures under the Fourth Geneva Convention, reports raising the issue with Israel and funding a container scanner, and notes Dutch and EU calls for unconditional opening of the crossings.
The government regards the measures taken regarding access to Gaza as a security measure based on the Fourth Geneva Convention.
De regering beschouwt de getroffen maatregelen rond de toegang tot Gaza als een veiligheidsmaatregel die is gebaseerd op de Vierde Geneefse Conventie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Timmermans, De Roon, Ormel, Voordewind en El Fassed over het zwijgen van het Westen over de strafkampen in Noord-Korea

Six MPs asked the foreign minister why the West is silent about North Korea's prison camps, citing the HRNK report and asking about international action and China's refoulement of refugees. The minister acknowledged the report, described UN and bilateral efforts (UN resolutions, UPR, raising the issue at the UNGA, funding a Korean NGO) and said North Korea denies the camps, making dialogue difficult.
The Netherlands will again call on North Korea at the 2012 UN General Assembly to improve the human rights situation in the country, referring to the HRNK report.
Dit zal Nederland niet weerhouden tijdens de AVVN 2012 Noord-Korea opnieuw op te roepen de mensenrechtensituatie in het land te verbeteren met verwijzing naar het rapport van HNRK.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over het besluit van de Oegandese regering om 38 Niet-Gouvernementele Organisaties (NGO's) te verbieden omdat deze homoseksualiteit promoten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether she knows of Uganda's call to ban 38 NGOs for allegedly promoting homosexuality, which NGOs are affected, whether Dutch NGOs are affected, and whether she will raise this with Ugandan authorities as a breach of human rights obligations. The minister answered that the Ugandan NGO Council has said it will not act on the minister's call, and that the position of homosexuals is a recurring item in bilateral and EU political dialogue with Uganda, without committing to a new specific step.
The Ugandan NGO Council, which is responsible for registering NGOs, has however indicated that it does not intend to take action following that call.
De Oegandese NGO-Raad, die belast is met de registratie van NGO's, heeft echter te kennen gegeven niet van plan te zijn naar aanleiding van die oproep actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over Nederlanders in het buitenland die op 12 september 2012 willen stemmen

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked whether Dutch citizens abroad can register and vote in the 12 September 2012 election, given registration backlogs, staffing, and slow postal delivery of ballots. Minister Donner replied that registration is running normally at about 30,000 requests with roughly 2% rejected, that 36 temporary staff are handling it with capacity expandable if needed, and that ballots will be sent once candidate lists are final, with embassy drop-off points and proxy voting as fallbacks.
If necessary, capacity will be expanded.
Indien nodig zal de capaciteit worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over 'de Palestijnse gevangene Mahmoud al-Sarsak'

An MP asked the foreign minister about Palestinian prisoner Mahmoud al-Sarsak, held under Israel's administrative detention law, and whether the government would press Israel on the law and his release. The minister replied that al-Sarsak ended his hunger strike and is due for release on 10 July, that administrative detention is permitted in exceptional cases with international safeguards, and that the cabinet opposes long detention without prospect of trial.
The cabinet is opposed to prolonged detention of prisoners without prospect of trial.
Het kabinet is tegen langdurig detineren van gevangenen zonder uitzicht op proces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans over een mogelijke Duitse boycot van het EK voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about a possible German boycott of Euro 2012 over the situation of Ukrainian opposition figures, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit by not sending a political delegation. The minister said concerns about the rule of law and Timoshenko's treatment prompted a conditional stance, that Minister Schippers attended the Netherlands-Denmark match after improvements in Timoshenko's detention, and that the government raised the issue with Ukraine at EU level.
The cabinet previously indicated that if Ms Timoshenko's situation did not sufficiently improve, the Netherlands would not send a political-level delegation to Ukraine.
Door het kabinet is eerder aangegeven dat als de situatie van mevrouw Timosjenko niet voldoende zou verbeteren, Nederland niet op politiek niveau naar Oekraïne zou gaan
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Van Dekken en Timmermans over homorechten in Oekraïne

MPs Marcouch, Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about the cancelled Kyiv gay pride, a Ukrainian bill criminalising public expression of homosexuality, and whether this should affect Dutch attendance at Euro 2012 matches and the final's location. The government condemned the violence and bill, said Dutch ministers would attend a match with a human rights programme, but rejected moving the final to Poland as impractical.
On 21 May I expressed to the media my disappointment at the cancellation of the Kyiv Pride Parade.
Ik heb op 21 mei jl. tegenover de media mijn teleurstelling uitgesproken over de afgelasting van de Kyiv Pride Parade.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Lange en Timmermans over het bericht dat het gehele Noorden van Mali in handen is van extremisten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that extremist groups control northern Mali, asking about threats to security, Dutch and EU responses, a contact group, ECOWAS progress, humanitarian aid and food security. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs multilateral, ECOWAS-led efforts, supports regional anti-crime programmes and humanitarian funding, and will assess any request to join an international Mali group.
The Netherlands favours an approach within a multilateral framework.
Nederland is voorstander van een aanpak in multilateraal verband.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Timmermans over een 14-jarig Marokkaans meisje dat gedwongen werd haar verkrachter te trouwen

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the Dutch government whether it would press Morocco, bilaterally and within the EU, to reform article 475 of its penal code after a 14-year-old girl was forced to marry her rapist, and what concrete steps it would take. The minister answered that the issue is raised through the UN Universal Periodic Review and the EU-Morocco neighbourhood dialogue, that a bilateral working group is not the right forum, and that Morocco's national debate on the article has not yet started.
That is why I have had this case raised in Morocco's review under the UN Human Rights Council's Universal Periodic Review.
Daarom heb ik deze zaak aan de orde laten stellen in het landen-examen van Marokko in het kader van de Universal Periodic Review van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over benoeming van Mugabe tot ambassadeur van toerisme door de Wereld Toerisme Organisatie (UNWTO)

An MP asked whether the UN World Tourism Organization had appointed Zimbabwe's President Mugabe as a tourism ambassador and what Dutch and EU steps would follow if so. The minister replied that UNWTO denies any such appointment and that the UNWTO has no Ambassadors Programme, so the follow-up questions were not applicable.
No, UNWTO denies such an appointment. UNWTO has no 'Ambassadors Programme'.
Nee, UNWTO weerspreekt een dergelijke benoeming 1 . UNWTO heeft geen «Ambassadors Programme».
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over 'het Nederlandse standpunt ten aanzien van de invoer van producten uit nederzettingen van de Westelijke Jordaanoever'

Labour MP Timmermans asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands pressed for changes to EU Council conclusions on imports from West Bank settlements and whether it would ban such imports. The minister declined to disclose the proposed changes, said customs checks are applied correctly, and stated the Netherlands opposes trade sanctions as a tool in the peace process.
Regarding the various proposals, the cabinet, as usual, makes no announcement.
Over de verschillende voorstellen doet het kabinet – zoals gebruikelijk – geen mededeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over de arrestatie van de Sudanese journalist Faisal Mohammed Salih

An MP asked the foreign minister about the detention of Sudanese journalist Faisal Mohammed Salih, whom he says is held as a prisoner of conscience at risk of torture, and whether other journalists face similar treatment. The minister confirmed the arrest appears linked to a critical interview, said at least 11 related arrests occurred in April and May, and said the Netherlands and EU partners are raising the case and calling for his immediate release.
The Netherlands, together with EU partners, is working on this case.
Nederland zet zich, samen met EU-partners in voor deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over groeiend antisemitisme in Hongarije

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that a Hungarian town cultural committee tried to bar Jewish actor Jozsef Szekhelyi and that the committee was described as making antisemitic remarks, and whether the government would act and place antisemitism on the EU agenda. The minister said Hungarian authorities are investigating, no ban was imposed, he condemns such remarks if confirmed, and the Netherlands combats antisemitism through international bodies.
If the statements were indeed made as reported in the media, I strongly condemn them.
Mochten de uitspraken inderdaad gedaan zijn zoals in de media is bericht, dan veroordeel ik die ten zeerste.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de arrestatie van de Chinese activiste Ni Yulan en haar echtgenoot Dong Jiqin

An MP asked the foreign minister about the detention and sentencing of Chinese activist Ni Yulan and her husband, and whether the Netherlands would protest, investigate the proceedings, and keep raising human rights with China. The minister expressed concern about the sentences and lack of transparency, said the Netherlands had protested via the EU and bilaterally, declined to intervene in Chinese legal proceedings, and committed to continued raising of human rights.
I do not wish to interfere in the Chinese judicial process.
Ik wil niet treden in de Chinese rechtsgang.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over 27 hongerstakers in gevangenissen in Marokko

An MP asked the foreign minister about 27 hunger strikers held in Moroccan prisons, who claim unfair trials, torture and inhumane treatment, and whether an investigation and raising the matter with Morocco is warranted. The minister answered that the situation is a concern, that Morocco's National Human Rights Council has opened an inquiry and that prison directors were instructed to respect human rights, and that the matter will be discussed in the EU-Morocco human rights dialogue.
In the human rights dialogue the EU conducts with Morocco under the European Neighbourhood Policy, the progress of investigation and action will be discussed.
In de mensenrechtendialoog die door de EU met Marokko wordt gevoerd in het kader van het Europese Nabuurschapsbeleid, zal de voortgang van onderzoek en actie worden besproken.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Timmermans over het rapport “Second class citizens. Discrimination Against Roma, Jews and Other National Miniorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina” van Human Rights Watch

MPs Albayrak and Timmermans asked whether the EU Roma inclusion programme in Bosnia and Herzegovina has had little effect because the government does not prioritise it, whether the Netherlands pressed for its implementation, and whether the EU should weigh constitutional reform after the 2009 ECtHR ruling more heavily in SAA progress reports. The minister answered that discrimination against Roma persists, that action plans exist and progress is uneven in health and education, that the Netherlands raises minority reforms with Bosnia, and that the EU is involved in constitutional reform, which the SAA's entry into force depends on, so no separate push was announced.
In its contacts with the government of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Netherlands urges the country to carry out reforms.
Nederland dringt er in zijn contacten met de regering van Bosnië-Herzegovina op aan dat het land hervormingen doorvoert.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de detentie van Afghaanse vrouwen

An MP asks the foreign minister about the detention of Afghan women and girls who flee domestic violence or forced marriage, and whether the government will press Afghan authorities to implement the elimination-of-violence law nationwide and adopt the new family law. The minister says the Netherlands raises women's rights and the HRW findings in bilateral and multilateral contacts, but cannot name concrete improvements and only commits to continue raising these issues.
Yes. The subject of women's rights is explicitly raised.
Ja. Het onderwerp vrouwenrechten wordt nadrukkelijk aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over het verbod van LGBTI (Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Intersex) demonstraties in Moldavië

Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister about the ban on LGBTI demonstrations in Moldova and whether the government will press Moldovan authorities on constitutional rights, pending anti-discrimination legislation and their human rights obligations. Minister Rosenthal replies that the EU and bilateral channels have condemned the ban, that Moldova's foreign minister pledged adoption of anti-discrimination law, and that the matter will be raised at the EU-Moldova human rights dialogue and UPR follow-up.
Both bilaterally and within the EU, the Moldovan authorities are being called to account on this.
Zowel in bilateraal als in EU-verband worden de Moldavische autoriteiten hierop aangesproken.
Antwoord vragen Arib en Timmermans over de zelfmoord van het 16-jarige Marokkaanse meisje Amina Filali

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Foreign Affairs about the suicide of a 16-year-old Moroccan girl forced into marriage with her rapist under Article 475 of Morocco's penal code, and whether the Netherlands would press Morocco on it. The minister of Foreign Affairs acknowledged the article's effect on women's rights, said the Moroccan government will address the issue itself and that EU human rights dialogue will cover progress, and declined to commit to a working-group meeting.
Because the Moroccan government has indicated it will address this issue itself, it is now mainly up to the Moroccan government and society to study the legal context and revise the legislation.

Omdat de Marokkaanse regering heeft aangegeven deze kwestie zelf te zullen aanpakken, is het nu vooral aan de Marokkaanse regering en de Marokkaanse samenleving om de juridische context te bestuderen en de wetgeving te herzien.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Timmermans over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Roemenië

MPs Albayrak and Timmermans asked whether Romania's president was refusing to accept the credentials of the Dutch ambassador, whether this was linked to the Dutch veto on Romania's Schengen accession, and whether relations were damaged. The minister replied that the credentials had not yet been presented, the reason was not disclosed, the ambassador's duties are not materially hindered, Romania's new ambassador has agrément, and relations are good.
No statement has been made about the precise reason why the credentials could not yet be presented.
Over de precieze reden waarom de geloofsbrieven nog niet konden worden aangeboden, is geen mededeling gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over een oproep van de grootmoefti van Saudi-Arabië om alle kerken op het Arabisch schiereiland te vernietigen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether she would respond to the Saudi Grand Mufti's call to destroy all churches on the Arabian Peninsula, including bilateral or EU-level challenge over Saudi Arabia's religious freedom obligations. The minister deplored the remarks, said they were raised with the GCC at EU level, noted the Mufti has no formal political role, and said human rights including religious freedom are regularly discussed with Saudi authorities.
Antwoord vragen Peters, Pechtold en Timmermans over intensivering van de bilaterale relatie met Israël

MPs Peters, Pechtold and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about the Netanyahu visit, the planned intensification of Dutch-Israeli relations, the expected bilateral cooperation agreement and its transparency, and whether settlement-based firms could benefit. The minister answered that the visit was routine, a first Dutch-Israeli Cooperation Council is set for 7 June 2012 with a non-binding founding document to be shared after the meeting, and that consular services to settlement firms are refused without legal advice being needed.
The cabinet first wants to reach agreement with Israel on the content of the document.
Het kabinet wil eerst overeenstemming bereiken met Israël over de inhoud van het document.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de steun van de Liberiaanse president aan anti-homowetgeving

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Liberian President Ellen Johnson Sirleaf's reported support for anti-homosexuality bills, and whether the government would engage the Liberian authorities and the AU on international human rights obligations. The minister said the reported statements contradict the president's earlier public commitments, that the Dutch policy on LGBTI rights will be conveyed in regular contacts and EU channels, and that the EU is in contact with a Liberian activist.
The Netherlands rejects discrimination and actively advocates for the rights of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and intersex (LGBTI) persons.
Nederland wijst discriminatie af en komt actief op voor de rechten van lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele, transgender en intersex (LHBTI) personen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Timmermans, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Dibi over het bericht dat speciale milities in Irak jacht maken op homoseksuele, biseksuele, lesbische en transgender Irakezen

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Immigration ministers whether reports of militias hunting LGBT Iraqis are confirmed, whether Iraq's interior ministry should be challenged, and whether LGBT asylum seekers should be returned to Iraq. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the reports, said the Dutch embassy warned Iraqi officials, stated Nederland currently funds no related projects, and pointed to a more lenient policy for this group.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de mensenrechtensituatie in Cuba

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's report on routine short-term detentions and harassment of critics in Cuba, and whether the Netherlands will protest bilaterally and in the EU and support tougher EU sanctions. The minister acknowledges the report, says the Netherlands opposes these restrictions and presses for release of political prisoners via the EU-Cuba dialogue, and says sanctions would be considered if necessary.
The Netherlands presses for the unconditional release of all political prisoners, an end to arbitrary short detentions and improvement of the human rights situation in general.
Nederland dringt aan op de onvoorwaardelijke vrijlating van alle politieke gevangenen, beëindiging van arbitraire korte detenties en verbetering van de situatie van de mensenrechten in het algemeen.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over gevangenisstraffen voor dissidenten in Iran

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether reported prison sentences for Iranian dissidents Ali Shakouri-Rad (4 years) and Abdolfattah Soltani (18 years) signal growing repression, and whether the EU should intensify pressure, including harder options against Iranian leaders. The minister confirmed increasing repression, reported that the Netherlands pushed for additional EU sanctions, and noted that the EU adopted an expanded list of human rights violators and an export ban on internet monitoring technology on 23 March.
The Iranian regime is exercising increasing repression against the opposition, dissidents and human rights activists.
Het Iraanse regime oefent toenemende repressie uit tegenover de oppositie, dissidenten en mensenrechtenactivisten.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, Arib en Marcouch over ongeregeldheden in Noord-Marokko

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about arrests of demonstrators in northern Morocco, including a Dutch-Moroccan man detained for photographing a demonstration, and about Morocco's democratic and human rights reforms. The minister said protesters were detained, that the government should allow peaceful demonstrations, that the man is now free but still faces trial, and that further steps depend on the court outcome.
It is important that the new government shows it takes the modernisation process seriously and allows peaceful demonstrations.
Het is belangrijk dat de nieuwe regering aantoont het moderniseringsproces serieus te nemen en vreedzame demonstraties toestaat.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de toekenning van een prijs van het Prins Claus Fonds 2011 aan Tsering Woeser

An MP asks the foreign minister about Tibetan writer Tsering Woeser, who was reportedly barred by Chinese authorities from collecting a Prins Claus Fonds prize at the Dutch embassy in Beijing, and whether the government will raise it at the EU level and in human rights dialogue. The minister replies that China denies house arrest and only asked her not to attend, that the prize and money were transferred, and that the government will raise the case in the EU-China human rights dialogue.
I will argue that her case is raised when individual cases are addressed in that framework.
Ik zal bepleiten dat haar zaak wordt meegenomen wanneer in dat kader individuele gevallen aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven, Timmermans, Pechtold, Ormel en Voordewind over Chinese deportaties van Noord-Koreaanse vluchtelingen naar hun vaderland

Six MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that China continues to deport North Korean refugees and what the government is doing about it, including pressing China, supporting South Korea at the UN Human Rights Council, and pursuing arbitration with UNHCR. The minister answered that the government is concerned and has raised non-refoulement with China, but China rejects the refugee label and treats the matter as bilateral, so no concrete change is expected.
Both the Netherlands and the EU have previously raised with China the principle of non-refoulement and advocated UNHCR access.
Zowel Nederland als de EU heeft China eerder aangesproken op het principe van non-refoulement en toegang van UNHCR bepleit.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de actie van Invisible Children op YouTube en Twitter

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the Invisible Children Kony 2012 campaign, its independence and funding, and whether government should inform users of NGO status on social media and promote social media for human rights. The minister acknowledges the campaign's attention value, says NGOs themselves must communicate their status and independence, and states the government supports internet freedom projects but declines a dedicated letter beyond existing policy reporting.
It is up to NGOs themselves to communicate about their status and independence to users of social media.
Het is aan NGO's zelf om over hun status en onafhankelijkheid te communiceren met gebruikers van sociale media.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de toespraak van de minister van buitenlandse zaken voor de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the 'receptor approach' is official Dutch human rights policy, as stated in a UN Human Rights Council speech, and why the promised letter to parliament explaining it was not sent earlier. The minister answers that the approach is being explored in a pilot as requested by parliament, that the letter has been sent, and that the speech is consistent with prior exchanges with parliament.
Implementation of the receptor approach is currently being explored in a pilot, as requested in the Van der Staaij et al. motion.
Uitvoering van de receptorbenadering wordt op dit moment verkend in een pilot zoals in de motie Van der Staaij c.s. verzocht.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de berichtgeving dat Bahrein het bezoek van VN onderzoeker Juan Mendez wil uitstellen

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Bahrain wants to postpone the visit of UN investigator Juan Mendez, whether NGOs face visa restrictions, and whether the government will raise this with Bahrain or at the EU Gymnich meeting. The minister confirmed awareness, said states must grant the UN Special Rapporteur on torture access, and said the Netherlands raises this, including NGO restrictions, in the UN Human Rights Council.
The Netherlands raises this, as well as the restrictions on NGOs, in the UN Human Rights Council.
Nederland stelt dit, net als de restricties voor NGO’s, aan de orde in de Mensenrechtenraad van de VN.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over Kameroense wetgeving die mensen vastzet op verdenking van homoseksualiteit

An MP asked the foreign minister about Cameroonian law that detains people on suspicion of homosexuality, whether it breaches Cameroon's international human rights obligations, and whether the government will raise this with Cameroon bilaterally and through the EU. The minister confirmed awareness, said such a law breaches Cameroon's human rights obligations, and said the Netherlands has raised the issue in the EU, which issued a demarche, and will keep pressing it.
The Netherlands will continue to press within the EU for LHBT rights to be put on the agenda in relations with the Cameroonian government.
Nederland zal binnen de EU blijven aandringen op het agenderen van LHBT rechten in de relaties met de Kameroense regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over een nieuwe internationale aanpak van de problematiek in Somalië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported UK consideration of air strikes against pirates and Al Shabaab in Somalia, and about Dutch representation and position at the London conference. The minister answered that the Netherlands was represented, argued for an integrated (non-military-only) approach, announced funding for a stability fund and an anti-piracy centre, and said the UK had not asked for the Dutch position on military action.
