On behalf of the government, the minister argued for an integrated approach to the problems in Somalia.
Namens de regering heeft de minister gepleit voor een geïntegreerde aanpak van de problematiek in Somalië.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi, Smeets en Timmermans over het salaris van de Floriadedirectie en de vergoedingen van de commissarissen bij de Floriade

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Floriade directorate's pay exceeds the Balkenende norm, how much public subsidy funds it, and whether commissioners' fees (reportedly 4000 euro per meeting) are excessive and publicly financed. The minister answered that the Wopt does not apply to the Floriade company, that the directorate's pay is reportedly below the norm, that no state subsidy is used for directorate salaries, that commissioner fees average 750 euro net per month and are not state-financed, and that the exhibition commissioner's fee is split 50/50 between the ministry and the company.
At my request, the chair of the Supervisory Board informed me that the Floriade directorate's remuneration does not exceed the norm amount.
Op mijn verzoek heeft de voorzitter van de Raad van Commissarissen mij medegedeeld dat de vergoeding van de Floriadedirectie niet boven het normbedrag ligt.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over het voorliggend wetsvoorstel in Sint Petersburg dat het recht op vrije meningsuiting van LGBT'ers enorm zal inperken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the St Petersburg bill restricting LGBT expression violates human rights and Russia's Council of Europe commitments, and whether Russia will be challenged bilaterally and through the EU and Council of Europe. The minister agreed the bill restricts LGBT rights, called it contrary to Russian federal law and ECHR/ICCPR obligations, and reported EU demarches and personal concerns raised with Lavrov, while noting Russia's view that the law protects minors.
This regional legislation is in conflict with Russian national legislation and with Russia's international obligations.
Deze regionale wetgeving is in strijd met Russische nationale wetgeving en met de internationale verplichtingen van Rusland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans over de staking van de olieproductie in Zuid-Sudan

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about the South Sudan oil production shutdown, alleged Sudanese seizure of oil, Dutch and EU roles in the negotiations, and the humanitarian situation. The minister answered that both states should revise unilateral steps and resume talks under the AU panel, that the Netherlands plays a supporting role, that the EU's role is supportive, and that the Netherlands will monitor the humanitarian situation.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over de steenkolendialoog

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the government about the stalled coal dialogue, supply-chain transparency for coal origin, and whether Nuon's commercial interests justify withholding it. The government replied that the dialogue is progressing, that origin disclosure is commercially sensitive and an imperfect indicator, and that it will invite parties to be transparent without itself publishing results.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation will, from its observer position, call on the parties involved to be transparent about the progress of the dialogue and the results achieved when the occasion arises.

Het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, zal vanuit zijn waarnemerspositie, de betrokken partijen oproepen bij gelegenheid zelf transparant te zijn over het verloop van de dialoog en de bereikte resultaten.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de mogelijke arrestaties van honderden Tibetanen door de Chinese autoriteiten

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports of hundreds of Tibetans arrested by Chinese authorities while travelling to India, and whether detention and political re-education camps are involved. The minister said the events cannot currently be verified due to restricted access to Tibet, promised the human rights ambassador will try to visit Tibet, and referred to ongoing EU efforts to raise access and the situation with Chinese authorities.
It is not currently possible to establish what exactly happened.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk na te gaan wat er precies is gebeurd.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Timmermans over een inval van Syrische troepen bij een NGO

MPs Pechtold and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister how the government would respond to a Syrian raid on an NGO that reportedly detained human rights defenders, and whether it would raise the incident at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister replied that the government was deeply concerned, that EU High Representative Ashton had already issued a statement calling for release, and that the EU Council had discussed Syria on 27 February.
Expressing our concerns through the EU is the most effective approach in this case.
Het uiten van onze zorgen via de EU is in dit geval het meest effectief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Timmermans over het uitblijven van een reactie op uitlatingen van de heer Rick Santorum

An MP asked the foreign minister why the Dutch embassy in Washington did not publicly rebut US candidate Santorum's false claims about forced euthanasia of the elderly in the Netherlands, and whether the ambassador would be instructed to respond publicly. The minister answered that the embassy had provided facts to Santorum's campaign team and to US media, and that Santorum's claims do not match Dutch practice and law.
The embassy provided facts to Mr Santorum's campaign team that refuted the statements he used.
De ambassade heeft feiten verstrekt aan het campagneteam van de heer Santorum waar de door hem gebezigde uitspraken werden weerlegd.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en De Lange over het bericht dat Zuid- Sudan afstevent op een hongersnood

MPs Timmermans and De Lange asked whether the government knows of WFP/FAO reports that South Sudan is heading toward famine, whether Dutch food aid is requested and how it will be funded, whether it will support cash transfers, helicopter support, and a role in preventing famine. The state secretary confirmed the reports, outlined a EUR 4 million contribution via the UN humanitarian fund plus multi-agency contributions, said FAO will assess cash transfers, and said no formal helicopter request was received while transport capacity is adequate.
The Netherlands plans to contribute EUR 4 million to this humanitarian action plan.
Nederland is van plan EUR 4 miljoen bij te dragen aan dit humanitaire actieplan.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Indonesië kogels inzet tegen protesterende werknemers (

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers about reports that Indonesian police used bullets against striking workers, including alleged deaths, and whether arms sales such as Leopard tanks should be halted. The government said the death toll could not be confirmed, that human rights concerns are raised bilaterally and in the EU dialogue, that arms exports are assessed case by case under the EU criteria, and that it is considering a parliamentary motion.
On 15 December, a motion by MP El Fassed on this issue was adopted. The government is considering how to implement the motion.
Op 15 december jl. is een motie van het kamerlid El Fassed aangenomen, die op deze kwestie ingaat. De regering beraadt zich op uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over beschietingen van kinderen bij de grens met de Gazastrook

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about reported shootings of children near the Gaza border and Israel's restrictions on building materials for Gaza. The minister condemned violence against children, said Israel has legitimate security needs and must act within international law, and said Dutch concerns are shared with Israel.
On the basis of the available information I cannot assess whether these Israeli military actions, as described in the question, were specifically directed against children.
Ik kan op basis van de beschikbare informatie niet beoordelen of deze Israëlische militaire acties zoals in de vraag gesteld zich specifiek tegen kinderen richtten.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans, De Lange en Marcouch over een anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

MPs Timmermans, De Lange and Marcouch asked the foreign minister whether she knows the anti-homosexuality bill providing for the death penalty has been reintroduced in Uganda's parliament, whether she considers it a human rights violation, and how she will increase pressure on Uganda. The minister confirmed the bill violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations, said the Netherlands has repeatedly raised this bilaterally and multilaterally, and noted the Ugandan prime minister distanced himself from the proposal in a written statement.
The Netherlands has repeatedly pointed out to the Ugandan authorities, both bilaterally and multilaterally, that such a law violates human rights and Uganda's international obligations in this area.

Nederland heeft herhaaldelijk in zowel bi- als multilateraal verband de Oegandese autoriteiten erop gewezen dat een dergelijke wet in strijd is met de mensenrechten en de Oegandese internationale verplichtingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de Mensenrechtentulp

An MP asked the foreign minister whether she had pressured the independent jury over the human rights award, contacted Chinese authorities, moved the award ceremony, and apologised to China. The minister denied influencing the jury, said she had only asked Chinese authorities about blocking the laureate's daughter's trip and had not apologised, and declined to discuss cabinet deliberations.
I do not make statements about deliberations in the Council of Ministers.
Over beraadslagingen in de ministerraad doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de positie van Nederland op de 'scorecard' van The European Council on Foreign Relations

An MP asks the foreign minister about the Netherlands' poor ranking in the ECFR 2012 scorecard, its weaker standing versus Sweden and Denmark, its retreat on multilateral issues, its alleged obstruction of EU positions on the Middle East, and how it will restore its international position. The minister disputes the methodology, reframes the criticised positions as principled, and rejects the criticism while stating that Dutch interests remain central.
I do not share your negative assessment.
Ik deel uw negatieve oordeel niet.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over het bericht dat Nederland ingrijpt bij kritische EU-tekst over Israël

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he intervened to keep a reference to a sensitive EU diplomatic report on Israel out of EU conclusions, and why. The minister confirms Dutch input shaped the text toward a balanced formulation supporting direct talks, says non-public reports are not usually cited, and denies colleagues objected.
The discussions on Council conclusions are confidential.
De besprekingen over Raadsconclusies zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans over de samenwerking tussen Afghaanse politiemensen en militairen met de Taliban

Timmermans (PvdA) asked the foreign minister about reports that Afghan police and soldiers cooperate with the Taliban in Kunduz, including NATO document claims and possible ISI ties. The government declined to discuss the confidential NATO document, denied rising Taliban influence in Kunduz and any infiltration of Dutch-trained units, and stressed Pakistan's importance.
In line with NATO regulations, the government makes no statements on the content of classified NATO documents.
De regering doet conform regelgeving van de NAVO geen uitspraken over de inhoud van gerubriceerde NAVO documenten.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Smeets en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw, en Innovatie over het grootste lek in een olieveld van Shell in Nigeria sinds tie

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers about a large oil spill from a Shell pipeline off Nigeria, covering environmental and economic damage, liability, cleanup oversight, and compliance with OECD guidelines and Ruggie Principles. The government answered that Nigerian authorities determine damage and liability, that SNEPCO is cleaning up, that no economic impact information is yet available, and that the OECD guidelines are enforced via the National Contact Point and ongoing dialogue with Shell.
It is for the Nigerian authorities to determine under Nigerian law who is liable for the oil spill, its cleanup, and to decide on any compensation.

Het is aan de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten om op grond van het Nigeriaanse recht vast te stellen wie aansprakelijk is voor de olielekkage, het opruimen daarvan en te beslissen over eventuele schadevergoeding.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi (beiden D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks), en Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bevordering van politieke vrouwenparticipatie in

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would back a gender quota for Libya's new constitution-making body, and how it funds women's political participation in the MENA region. The minister said the Netherlands supports women's participation, will remind the NTC of its commitments, has earmarked EUR 2 million for 2011 and 2012, and will take a lead role within the EU, but did not commit to requesting a quota.

I follow developments in Libya closely and where necessary I remind the NTC and the interim government of their commitments in the draft Constitutional Charter regarding the democratic transition, including women's rights.

Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in Libië nauwgezet en waar nodig herinner ik de NTC en de interim-regering aan hun toezeggingen in the draft Constitutional Charter ten aanzien van de democratische transitie inclusief vrouwenrechten.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Afghaanse wetgeving die de in de praktijk niet wordt toegepast (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

Two MPs (Dikkers and Timmermans, PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister why Afghan laws protecting women from violence are barely enforced, and what the government will do bilaterally, through the EU and at the Bonn conference. The minister acknowledged the enforcement shortfall, said Dutch and EU engagement on women's rights is ongoing with significant funding, and argued that aid need not be directly conditioned on specific reforms.
A direct link between aid and the improvement of women's rights is therefore not necessary.
Een directe koppeling tussen hulp en de verbetering van vrouwenrechten is daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over oriënterende gesprekken die Shell voert in Zuid-Sudan

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked whether Shell is exploring activities in South Sudan, including a possible pipeline to Ethiopia, and how the government ensures responsible conduct. The minister confirmed a general exploratory visit notified in advance to the ministry and embassy, said Shell has no pipeline plans, and pointed to OECD guidelines and Shell's assurances on transparency.
Shell has informed that it has no plans to construct a pipeline from South Sudan to Ethiopia.
Shell heeft laten weten dat het geen voornemens heeft om een pijpleiding van Zuid-Sudan naar Ethiopië aan te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de onderdrukking van tegenstanders van het Saudische regime (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about mass detentions of protesters in Saudi Arabia, a draft counter-terror law threatening peaceful protesters, and whether the government will press Saudi authorities on human rights obligations. The minister confirms awareness of the Amnesty report, says the EU is seeking information and has raised concerns about the draft law, and states the Netherlands raises these issues regularly, including during a planned February 2012 visit by the Human Rights Ambassador.
The Netherlands regularly raises the responsibility of the Saudi authorities in bilateral and multilateral settings.
Nederland spreekt de Saoedische autoriteiten in bi- en multilateraal verband regelmatig aan op hun verantwoordelijkheid.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de visumverlening door de Indiase autoriteiten (ingezonden 13 december 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Dutch travellers holding Indian visas are sometimes refused entry at arrival without any reason given, how widespread this is, and whether the government will raise it bilaterally and in the EU. The minister confirmed the practice, said about two cases occurred in three years with one person receiving an explanation from the Indian embassy, and said the matter would be raised bilaterally and via the EU only if it proves systematic.
If it were to turn out to be a systematic phenomenon, I will discuss that bilaterally and via the EU with the Indian authorities.
Als mocht blijken dat het zou gaan om een stelselmatig verschijnsel, zal ik dat bilateraal en via de EU met de Indiase autoriteiten bespreken.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het beëindigen van de samenwerking van de anti-corruptiewaakhond Transparency International (TI) met d

MPs Van Dekken and Timmermans asked the health minister about Transparency International ending its cooperation with FIFA and not being admitted to an anti-corruption panel. The minister replied that FIFA is a private Swiss body outside her responsibility, that TI withdrew voluntarily, and that she will not raise the issue internationally, though she pursued an EU expert group on sports governance.
I see no role for myself in this.
Ik zie hier geen rol voor mijzelf in weggelegd.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een aanval van de Turkse luchtmacht, waardoor 35 burgers zijn omgekomen (ingezonden 30 december 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkish authorities acknowledged the airstrike that killed 35 civilians mistaken for PKK fighters, whether compensation would follow, whether the incident undermines Turkey's rapprochement with Kurds, and how the EU could help. The minister answered that Turkey called it a tragic mistake, expressed regret, promised compensation and an investigation, that the strike harms the Kurdish settlement effort, and that the cabinet raises a political solution bilaterally and through the EU.
The Turkish government declared that the bombing of the civilians was a sad mistake.
De Turkse regering heeft verklaard dat het bombardement op de burgers een trieste vergissing was.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verkiezingsuitslag in de Democratische Republiek Congo (DRC) (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about alleged large-scale fraud in the DRC's 2011 presidential election, the opposition's claim to victory, risks of violence, Kabila's legitimacy, economic motives of foreign backers, support for human rights defenders and safety of Dutch nationals. The minister acknowledged serious shortcomings and a lack of transparency, called for dialogue and reaffirmed diplomatic engagement, while stating no international mission found Tshisekedi would have won without the irregularities.

The Netherlands shares the conclusions of the EU observation mission and High Representative Catherine Ashton that the Congolese presidential elections were marred by serious shortcomings and a lack of transparency.

Nederland deelt de conclusies van de EU-waarnemingsmissie en Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Catherine Ashton dat de Congolese presidentsverkiezingen gepaard zijn gegaan met serieuze tekortkomingen en een gebrek aan transparantie.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gratieverlening door de Surinaamse president Bouterse (ingezonden 30 december 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch state, as an injured party, should condemn President Bouterse's pardon of his stepson, who was sentenced to 15 years for a murder and a grenade attack on the Dutch ambassador's residence, and insist on full sentence enforcement. The minister confirmed the pardon, said it sends a wrong signal, but argued the assessment is primarily for Surinamese society, parliament and authorities.
The assessment of this decision is primarily for Surinamese society, the Surinamese parliament and other Surinamese authorities.
De beoordeling van dit besluit is primair aan de Surinaamse samenleving, het Surinaamse parlement en andere Surinaamse autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bekentenis van een veteraan over de executies van 120 personen in Rawagade in 1947 (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether a veteran's confession about the 1947 Rawagede executions justifies renewed prosecution and new academic research on the date of the killings. The minister replied that no new facts emerged, prosecution remains impossible, and an independent government-commissioned study is not warranted, citing existing sources.
No new facts or circumstances have become known that give reason to revise the finding in those earlier answers that prosecution of the summary executions at Rawagede in 1947 is no longer possible.

Er zijn geen nieuwe feiten of omstandigheden bekend geworden die aanleiding geven tot bijstelling van de in die antwoorden opgenomen vaststelling dat vervolging van de standrechtelijke executies in 1947 in Rawagede niet meer mogelijk is.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de ter dood veroordeelde Reggie Clemons (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

Timmermans (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether the government had raised the case of death-row inmate Reggie Clemons in the US and whether it opposes capital punishment generally. Minister Rosenthal answered that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and raises it through the EU, but has not raised the Clemons case because it is pending before the Missouri Supreme Court.
Since this case is still pending before the Missouri Supreme Court, the Dutch government has not raised attention to this case and does not wish to anticipate a possible outcome.

Aangezien deze zaak nog in behandeling is bij het Hooggerechtshof van Missouri, heeft de Nederlandse regering geen aandacht gevraagd voor deze zaak en wil daarbij ook niet vooruitlopen op een eventuele uitkomst.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minster van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Extremistische Joden slaan om zich heen» (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

Labour MP Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister about reports of violence by Israeli settlers in the West Bank, including attacks on Palestinian property, peace activists, Arabs and the army, and whether this harms the peace process. The minister condemns the violence, notes Israeli government measures to curb settler violence, and says Dutch concerns have been conveyed to Israeli authorities.
The Dutch concerns about the increase in violence by settlers have been conveyed to the Israeli authorities.
De Nederlandse zorgen over de toename van geweldsplegingen door kolonisten zijn aan de Israëlische autoriteiten overgebracht.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toename van geweld in de Democratische Republiek in Congo (DRC) (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about rising violence and suspected electoral fraud in the DRC after the November 2011 elections, and whether he would press the issue urgently in the EU and UN and hold the Congolese authorities to their human rights obligations. The minister answered that irregularities were reported, that the EU and UN have repeatedly issued statements calling for transparency and calm, and that the Netherlands will keep raising human rights in EU and bilateral channels.
The Netherlands will continue to do this both within the EU and bilaterally.
Nederland zal dit zowel in EU-verband als bilateraal blijven doen.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de alarmerende situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers in de Democratische Republiek Congo (DRC) (ingezonden 4 november 20

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the foreign minister about the situation of five human rights defenders in the DRC, EU coordination on monitoring them, emergency visas, Shelter Cities, and urging EU High Representative Ashton to prioritise the issue. The minister replied that Nederland will monitor Katende with EU partners, that no listed defender has requested an emergency visa, that visas are only for acute emergencies, and that the EU is already addressing the issue.
With EU partners in Kinshasa it was agreed that the Netherlands will take on monitoring the situation of Jean Claude Katende.
Met de EU-partners in Kinshasa is afgesproken dat Nederland het monitoren van de situatie van Jean Claude Katende op zich zal nemen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de twee Israëlische wetsvoorstellen die beperkingen opleggen aan Israëlische NGO’s (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister about two Israeli bills restricting Israeli NGOs, whether he shares concern about restrictions on civil society, and what steps the Netherlands and the EU have taken. The minister answers that the bills have been postponed indefinitely, that the Netherlands has raised the issue through various channels, and that the EU is following the bills closely.
The Netherlands has drawn attention to questions surrounding these bills through various channels.
Nederland heeft via verschillende kanalen aandacht gevraagd voor vragen rond deze wetsvoorstellen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over gewonden in Syrische ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 31 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the EU and the Netherlands would offer to bring wounded Syrians to European hospitals, as was done for Libya, and what other steps were feasible given Syria's refusal of foreign involvement. The minister answered that Syria rejects foreign intervention so the situation differs from Libya, that Turkey can absorb refugees and the Netherlands funds UNHCR, and that the Netherlands and EU keep pressing Syria through sanctions and UN diplomacy.
The Syrian authorities so far refuse any form of foreign interference.
De Syrische autoriteiten weigeren tot op heden elke vorm van buitenlandse inmenging.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een rapport van twee Israëlische mensenrechtenorganisaties (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a report by two Israeli human rights organisations alleging that doctors complicit in torture of Palestinian detainees by Shin Bet fail to document injuries and send detainees back to interrogation, and whether the minister would condemn this and raise it with Israel. The minister acknowledged the report, said Israel must respond first, referred the matter to the UN Committee against Torture, and noted that the human rights dialogue with Israel could address detention and interrogation obligations.
It is first and foremost up to the Israeli authorities to respond to this.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de Israëlische autoriteiten om een reactie daarop te geven.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van twee journalisten in Zuid-Sudan (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about the detention of two journalists in South Sudan held without trial by the National Security Services beyond the constitutional 24-hour limit, and about press freedom. The minister acknowledged the detention, said the 24-hour rule concerns police rather than the security service whose rules are still being developed, called the situation for journalists worrying, and said the Netherlands would raise the case bilaterally and in the EU and press for compliance with human rights obligations.
Although those involved were released without formal charge on 18 November, the Netherlands will hold the South Sudanese government to account for how the matter was handled.
Hoewel betrokkenen zonder formele aanklacht op 18 november zijn vrijgelaten, zal Nederland de Zuid-Sudanese regering aanspreken op de gang van zaken.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minster van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitspraak van de minister over een militaire interventie in Iran (ingezonden 16 november 2011).

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister why she refused to rule out military options against Iran, whether this conflicts with the EU position, and why the Netherlands did not seek a common EU stance. The minister replied that keeping maximum pressure on Iran is the priority, that speculating on other options is not on the agenda, and that the Netherlands is working with EU partners on tighter sanctions.
I consider it necessary to keep the pressure on Iran at its maximum.
Ik acht het noodzakelijk om de druk op Iran maximaal te houden.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over rechten voor Afghaanse vrouwen die in het geding zijn (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about risks to Afghan women's rights after 2014, the lack of nationwide implementation of the anti-violence law, funding, and inclusive peace talks. The minister replied that women's rights remain a priority, cited Dutch programmes and funding of about EUR 7.2 million, and said Nederland will keep raising the issue bilaterally and in the EU.
The Netherlands will therefore continue to advocate strict adherence to the agreed conditions.
Nederland zal daarom blijven pleiten voor het strikt handhaven van de overeengekomen voorwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toenemende mate van onderdrukking van persvrijheid en het recht op demonstratie in Uganda (ingezonden 3 november 2011

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the Foreign Minister about rising repression of press freedom and the right to demonstrate in Uganda, including arrests of activists, a public-order bill and a press amendment bill, and a planned end to bail for detained protesters. The minister answered that the embassy monitors the cases and raises the concerns bilaterally, in the EU and as chair of a donor group, and that the bail proposal is not yet a concrete bill.
The Netherlands, within the EU and as chair of the Justice, Law and Order donor group, has repeatedly raised the repressive policy on demonstrations.
Nederland heeft in EU-verband en als voorzitter van de Justice, Law and Order donorgroep het repressieve beleid ten aanzien van demonstraties herhaaldelijk aan de orde gesteld.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het besluit van de Israelische regering de bouw van illegale nederzettingen in bezette Palestijnse gebieden te versnellen (ingezonden 3 nov

MP Timmermans asked the foreign minister whether he agrees that Israel's decision to accelerate settlement construction in occupied territories violates international law and harms peace talks, and whether he will condemn it and raise it with Israel and EU partners. The minister answered that he expressed concern and called on Israel to reverse the decision, and that the EU and other member states had made similar statements.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het doorgaan met bouwen van ongeveer 1000 woningen in de Gilo nederzetting (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether she shares concern over Israel's plan to build about 1000 homes in the Gilo settlement, whether she will condemn settlement building and how she keeps the parties to their commitments. The minister answers that she has expressed concern in writing and by phone, considers the plan counterproductive, calls on both parties to refrain from obstructive steps, and states that Dutch policy on settlements as illegal under international law is unchanged.
I will continue to call on the parties to refrain from steps that hinder the resumption of negotiations.
Ik zal partijen blijven oproepen zich te onthouden van stappen die de hervatting van onderhandelingen belemmeren.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de doodstraf in Japan (ingezonden 1 november 2011).

MP Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the Japanese Justice Minister's refusal to rule out executions during his term, whether this contradicts earlier statements, whether Japan should stop signing death warrants, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Japan bilaterally and within the EU. The minister confirms awareness, says the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and has made this known to Japan, and says the Netherlands and EU partners consistently raise the EU position.
The Netherlands and other European partners consistently and continuously emphasise the EU position on the death penalty.
Nederland en andere Europese partners benadrukken consequent en continu de EU-positie ten aanzien van de doodstraf.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Russische weigering een Nederlandse verkiezingswaarnemer toe te laten (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why Russia refused accreditation to Dutch election observer Alexander Münninghoff for the December Duma elections, whether political motives lay behind it, and whether the government would seek clarification. The minister answered that no reason was given, the ambassador requested an explanation from the Russian deputy minister, and the ODIHR findings will be considered in assessing the election.
No motivation has been given for this.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de weigering door Nederland om op instigatie van het Internationaal Strafhof vier Congolese getuig

MPs Spekman and Timmermans asked why the Netherlands refused to admit four detained Congolese witnesses of the International Criminal Court into the Dutch asylum procedure, and whether the Court's ruling was being ignored. The ministers replied that the Court did not order admission, that the witnesses are outside Dutch jurisdiction under the seat agreement, and that their requests will be assessed under non-refoulement principles without the Aliens Act applying.
It is not correct that the International Criminal Court (hereafter 'ICC' or 'Court') instructed the Netherlands to include the four Congolese witnesses in the Dutch asylum procedure.
Het is niet juist dat het Internationaal Strafhof (hierna «ISH» of «Hof») Nederland heeft opgedragen de vier Congolese getuigen in de Nederlandse asielprocedure op te nemen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een Iraans complot om de Saoedische ambassadeur in de VS te vermoorden (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the government to condemn an alleged Iranian Revolutionary Guard plot to assassinate the Saudi ambassador in the US, to coordinate sanctions with the EU and US, and to ensure Dutch security services prevent similar plots. The minister answered yes to the reports and threat, said Iran would be condemned and the response decided with the EU and US if Iran is implicated, found no indications of plots in the Netherlands or Europe, and stated that services are continuously vigilant.
If the Iranian government turns out to be involved in the attacks, I strongly condemn this.
Indien de Iraanse regering bij de aanslagen betrokken blijkt te zijn, veroordeel ik dit ten zeerste.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de economische betrekkingen tussen Nederland en Israel (ingezonden

MPs Peters and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch economic ties with Israel, including settlement businesses, the Dutch-Israeli Cooperation Council, and Gaza gas fields. The government restated its policy of discouraging economic relations with businesses in occupied territories, said it does not actively check trade with settlement firms, and declined to see evidence of unlawful Israeli use of Gaza gas.
In general, the government discourages economic relations with businesses in the occupied territories.
In zijn algemeenheid ontmoedigt de regering economische relaties met bedrijven in de bezette gebieden.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een Iraanse actrice die veroordeeld is tot negentig zweepslagen (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MP Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister whether the government will push, within the EU, for a clear condemnation of the sentencing of Iranian actress Marzieh Vafamehr to 90 lashes and a prison term, and of the prosecution of six independent filmmakers, and whether it will keep raising Iran's human rights obligations bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN. The minister answers yes to each, citing an EU High Representative condemnation of 18 October and a 26 September objection, and says the Netherlands presses Iran on human rights and supports a UN Iran resolution and access for the UN Special Rapporteur.
Yes. The Dutch government raises with the Iranian government its obligations regarding the protection of human rights, both bilaterally and within the EU.
Ja. De Nederlandse regering spreekt de Iraanse overheid aan op haar verplichtingen ten aanzien van de bescherming van mensenrechten, zowel bilateraal als in EU verband.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Hachchi (D66) en El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse inzet tijdens de Review Conferentie van de

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands will act at the CCW Review Conference on cluster munitions, including whether a draft Protocol VI with a weaker standard than the CCM should be supported. The minister replied that the Netherlands will push for a protocol with the broadest scope, citing a total ban as the end goal, will promote universalisation of the CCM, and will consider a political declaration if no consensus is reached.
The Netherlands wants a Protocol VI with the broadest possible scope, explicitly including a total ban on cluster munitions as the final goal.
Nederland wil een Protocol VI met zo groot mogelijke reikwijdte, waarin een totaalverbod van clustermunitie expliciet als einddoel wordt opgenomen.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «NAVO verbaasd over vermindering trainers» (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Eijsink asked the Foreign Minister whether he had seen a report that NATO was surprised by a reduction in police trainers in Afghanistan, and asked for an updated table of commitments on the police training mission by 1 November 2011. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said an updated commitments table would be attached to a supplementary progress letter already promised.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een hof in Saudi-Arabië dat een vrouw veroordeeld heeft tot tien zweepslagen omdat ze achter het stuur zat van een auto (in

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about a Saudi court sentencing a woman to ten lashes for driving, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it in the EU and back the Women2Drive campaign. The minister noted the king pardoned her, said the government raises women's rights bilaterally and in the EU, knows of no similar cases, welcomes the planned women's voting rights, and supports Women2Drive and an EU human rights strategy for Saudi Arabia.
The Dutch government raises it bilaterally and in EU-level talks with the Saudi authorities.
De Nederlandse regering stelt het aan de orde bilateraal en bij gesprekken in EU-verband met de Saudische autoriteiten
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van Derwisjen en advocaten in Iran (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011 september 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of around sixty Gonabadi Dervishes and three lawyers in Iran, whether the government supports Amnesty's call for release and will raise the matter with Iran. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes repression of religious freedom, shares concern, supports the EU High Representative's statement, and will continue to raise human rights obligations bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands advocates, bilaterally and multilaterally, for the release of persons detained in Iran on grounds of their religion or belief.
Nederland pleit, bilateraal en multilateraal, voor vrijlating van personen die in Iran worden vastgezet op grond van hun godsdienst of levensovertuiging.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het zeer gewelddadige optreden van het regime Assad tegen de Syrische bevolking, onder andere in Hama (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the Assad regime's violent repression in Syria, including the killings in Hama, and whether further sanctions, asset freezes, ICC action, Arab League pressure and UN steps are possible. The minister answers that EU and US sanctions are hitting the regime's economy but violence continues, that the Netherlands is pushing for tighter sanctions and asset freezes, that only the UN Security Council can refer Syria to the ICC, and that Russia and China vetoed a UN resolution.
The Netherlands therefore continues to press for increased pressure on this regime by tightening existing sanctions.
Nederland spant zich daarom onverkort in voor het verhogen van de druk op dit regime door middel van het aanscherpen van bestaande sancties.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vervolging van historicus Michail Soeproen (ingezonden 26 september 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Russian historian Michail Soeproen is being prosecuted for researching Stalin-era deportations of ethnic Germans, including on privacy grounds, and whether this is an abuse of power warranting EU or Council of Europe protest. The minister denies prosecution for the research itself, says the charges concern consent for collecting ancestors' data and incitement by an official, notes that similar research was previously allowed but archive access has become harder, and says the case will be followed through Russian legal channels without protest.
I will follow the legal process in the Russian Federation.
Ik zal de rechtsgang in de Russische Federatie volgen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de veroordeelde Palestijnse mensenrechtenactivist Ameer Makhoul (ingezonden 7 september 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether Palestinian activist Ameer Makhoul, convicted in Israel, is a human rights defender, whether his coerced confession and conviction without evidence meet international standards, and whether the minister will raise the case with Israeli authorities. The minister replies that Makhoul's espionage for Hezbollah is incompatible with the human rights defender role, that trust in Israeli justice remains, that issues are raised with Israel where needed, and declines to raise the case again.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie voor mensenrechtenverdedigers in Mexico (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

MP Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister whether the government shares Protection International's bleak assessment of worsening conditions for human rights defenders in Mexico, including claims that authorities obstruct protection, and whether it will support NGO proposals, press Mexico on the Cererzo case, and intensify EU-Mexico human rights dialogue. The minister acknowledges the concerns, points to Mexico's protection mechanism and court rulings, and describes existing bilateral and EU channels, including raising the Cererzo case in an EU working group and with the High Representative, without committing to new formal steps.
To this end, the Netherlands will continue to raise the situation of human rights defenders with the services of HR Ashton.
Hiertoe zal Nederland de situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers bij de diensten van HV Ashton aan de orde blijven stellen.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gegeven dat Nederland de mensenrechten van transgenders schendt (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands violates transgender rights by requiring sterilisation for legal gender recognition under article 28 of the Civil Code, and whether article 28 will be amended. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the HRW report and said the sterilisation requirement will be removed, with a draft bill out for consultation and simplified changes to diploma gender markers planned.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Nederland een gezamenlijk EU-standpunt Midden-Oosten blokkeert (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands blocked a joint EU position on the Middle East, why, and what it was doing to restart Israeli-Palestinian talks. The minister said the talks ended because the 27 member states could not agree a text, that the Dutch objected to an unbalanced draft, and that the Netherlands supports the two-state solution and continues diplomatic efforts.
The consultation was ended because the 27 EU member states could not reach consensus on a common text.
Het overleg is beëindigd omdat de 27 lidstaten van de EU geen consensus konden bereiken over een gemeenschappelijke tekst.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het voornemen van de Amerikaanse procureur-generaal de gerechtelijke bewijsvoering van ruim honderd CIA zaken te staken (ingezonden 16 sept

An MP asked the foreign minister why the government considers the US Attorney General's review of over 100 CIA cases independent, why it differs from other bodies' findings, why John Durham was appointed, and whether the US will be pressed on human rights obligations. The minister replied that there is no reason to doubt the independence of the review, that 99 of 101 cases found no grounds for prosecution, and that the US is meeting its international obligations so no pressure is needed.
I have no reason to doubt the independence of the US Attorney General and of the investigations carried out by Assistant U.S. Attorney John Durham.
Ik heb geen reden te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid van de Amerikaanse procureur-generaal en de onderzoeken uitgevoerd door de Assistent U.S. Attorney John Durham

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het op grote schaal verstrekken van bouwvergunningen aan Joodse kolonisten in Oost-Jeruzalem (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he condemns Israel's approval of large-scale building plans for Jewish settlers in East Jerusalem, which ends the earlier construction freeze, and whether he will press Israel to reverse it and coordinate EU pressure. The minister confirmed the decision, said the government considers it counterproductive to the peace process and has raised the matter with Israel, and said the EU focuses on resuming negotiations rather than revising EU-Israel relations.
The government considers the relevant decisions counterproductive to the Middle East Peace Process (MEPP).
De regering vindt betreffende besluiten contraproductief voor het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces (MOVP).

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de opvolging van aanbevelingen van het VN-Mensenrechtencomité en de opvolging van de aanbevelingen van het VN-comité voor de uitbanning van

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands is slow to report to and follow up recommendations of UN human rights treaty bodies, including the reservations to the ICCPR and the overdue torture report. The minister answers that delays stem from constitutional reforms and inter-departmental coordination, and promises to send reports to parliament after submission and to reconsider reservations by 2014.
Reports arising from treaty obligations will in future be sent to the House of Representatives for information as soon as possible after submission to the UN.
Rapporten die voortvloeien uit verdragsverplichtingen zullen in de toekomst zo spoedig mogelijk na indiening bij de VN ook ter kennisgeving aan de Kamer worden gestuurd.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van dertig dissidenten in Cuba (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Cuban regime arrested thirty dissidents to stop a planned demonstration, and whether the Netherlands would protest bilaterally and in the EU and push for their release and tighter EU sanctions if Cuba refused. The minister said there were several short arrests of peaceful activists who are often released within hours or days, that the EU was asked to demarche in Havana demanding release of all political prisoners, and that the EU will evaluate its common position on Cuba and consider further restrictions.
I have asked the EU to demarche in Havana, to convey the EU's concern and call for the immediate and unconditional release of all political prisoners.
Ik heb de EU verzocht om in Havana te demarcheren, om de zorg van de EU over te brengen en op te roepen tot onmiddellijke en onvoorwaardelijke vrijlating van alle politieke gevangenen.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP), Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de besteding van 850 000 euro

MPs from several parties asked why the 850,000 euro promised in 2009 for Balongsari (Rawagede) has not been fully disbursed, how much went via Hivos and an agreement with Indonesia's Interior Ministry, and whether the funds will be released quickly. The ministers explained a 250,000 euro microcredit project run by Hivos is operating, the school/market/health project is delayed in Indonesian administrative procedures, and funds will be transferred once preparations are complete, with Dutch monitoring.
Embassy funds can only be transferred to the Indonesian Ministry of Home Affairs once the aforementioned preparations are completed.
Fondsen van de ambassade kunnen pas naar het Indonesische ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken worden overgemaakt als eerdergenoemde voorbereidingen afgerond zijn.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de luchtbrug voor Somalië (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

Labour MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether the WFP would run an airlift to Mogadishu and whether the Netherlands would support it with funds or Air Force transport given the severe hunger in Somalia. The state secretary answered that humanitarian organisations are already flying aid to Mogadishu, that Dutch aid totals over 25 million euro, and that WFP has not asked for Dutch transport capacity.
WFP has indicated it has sufficient resources for the earlier mentioned air transports to Mogadishu, and has not asked the Netherlands to make transport capacity available.
WFP heeft aangegeven over voldoende middelen te beschikken voor de eerder genoemde luchttransporten naar Mogadishu, en heeft Nederland niet verzocht om transportcapaciteit ter beschikking te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Hachchi (D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Israëlische antiboycotwet (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Israeli anti-boycott bill, which would make calling for boycotts a civil wrong and allow damages without proof of harm, conflicts with freedom of expression and whether it shields settlements. The minister said the law may conflict with freedom of expression, that the Israeli Supreme Court is reviewing it, that settlements are contrary to international law, and that the Dutch government opposes boycott calls in this context while noting Israel's democratic debate.
I am not anticipating the judgment of the Court.
Ik loop niet op het oordeel van het Hof vooruit.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een omstreden wetsvoorstel van de Cambodjaanse regering waardoor het werk van niet-gouvernementele organisaties (NGO's)

Two MPs asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands supports NGOs and human rights organisations in Cambodia, and what the consequences would be if a controversial NGO law is adopted. The minister said the government is concerned, that it gives no direct support to NGOs but funds UNICEF Cambodia, that the Netherlands has no bilateral aid relationship with Cambodia, and that the EU has repeatedly raised the law with Cambodian authorities.

Vragen het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de veroordeelde mensenrechtenverdediger Vidadi Isganderov en de arrestatie van mensenrechtenactivisten in Azerbeidzjan (ingezonden 2 september

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the conviction of human rights defender Vidadi Isganderov and six activists in Azerbaijan, and whether the government will raise their treatment and the use of evidence with Azerbaijani authorities. The minister confirms the convictions, cites EU and OSCE statements and says the EU and the Netherlands will keep following the case and raise it bilaterally, without committing to a specific new step.
The EU has closely followed the proceedings against the seven persons and will continue to do so.
De EU heeft de procesgang van de zeven personen nauwlettend gevolgd en zal dat blijven doen.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van een vrouw in Saoedi-Arabië omdat zij achter het stuur van een auto zat (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would condemn the arrest in Saudi Arabia of a woman filmed driving, and push for EU action demanding her release. The minister confirmed the arrest, condemned it as an example of structural discrimination against women, said she was released on 30 May, and stated the issue is raised bilaterally and in EU talks with Saudi authorities.
It is a specific matter of concern that is also raised, both bilaterally and in EU talks with the Saudi authorities.
Het is een specifiek onderwerp van zorg dat ook aan de orde wordt gesteld, zowel bilateraal als bij gesprekken in EU-verband met de Saudische autoriteiten.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het voornemen van de Amerikaanse procureur-generaal die de gerechtelijke bewijsvoering van ruim honderd CIA zaken wil staken (ingezonden 6

An MP asked the foreign minister about the US Attorney General's plan to close investigations into roughly 100 CIA cases, and whether the Netherlands would press the US on its human rights obligations. The minister answered that the US Attorney General closed most cases after independent review, opened a further criminal investigation into two deaths in CIA detention, and that the US is meeting its treaty obligations, so there is no reason to press it.
In his view, it was rightly established in these cases that there is no ground for prosecution.
Naar zijn mening is in deze zaken terecht geconstateerd dat er geen grond is voor vervolging.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Buitenlandse Zaken over de snelle en zorgvuldige administratieve afhandeling van een overlijden in

MPs Heijnen and Timmermans asked why the registration of a death abroad in Tunisia was delayed by a lengthy legalisation process and whether foreign death certificates could be provisionally registered. The minister acknowledged the delay was regrettable, explained the legalisation steps and the lost application, but declined to change the procedure, citing its long-standing reliability.
There is therefore insufficient reason to reconsider such a fundamental revision of the process.
Er bestaat derhalve onvoldoende aanleiding om een dergelijke fundamentele herziening van het proces te heroverwegen.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Dikkers en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over anti-homo uitspraken van een Surinaamse parlementslid (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns anti-gay remarks by a Surinamese parliamentarian, Asabina, and whether the EU will jointly condemn them and open dialogue with Suriname on LGBT rights. The minister agreed the remarks are undesirable, stated they do not reflect the Surinamese government's position, and said LGBT rights are part of bilateral and EU human rights dialogue and that the ministry supports Surinamese LGBT organisations.
The statements by parliamentarian Asabina do not reflect the position of the Surinamese government.
De uitlatingen van de parlementariër Asabina geven niet het standpunt van de Surinaamse regering weer.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat een Nederlandse vrouw onder onmenselijke gevangenisomstandigheden in detenti

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice about reports of a seriously ill Dutch woman held in harsh conditions in a Moroccan prison, and whether the Netherlands was doing enough to have her transferred to serve her sentence at home under the prisoner transfer treaty. The minister answered that the embassy visits and advises detainees, that medical care is provided, that Nederland will request transfer if Morocco does not, and that 59 Dutch nationals were detained in Morocco.
As soon as a WOTS request on behalf of the person concerned is received in the Netherlands by the Ministry of Security and Justice, it will be handled with goodwill.
Zodra een WOTS-verzoek ten bate van betrokkene in Nederland door het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie wordt ontvangen, zal dit met welwillendheid in behandeling worden genomen.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie in Somalië (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister whether Al Shabaab is blocking humanitarian access and starving civilians in Somalia, and whether it should be referred to the ICC. The government answered that some Al Shabaab leaders threaten people fleeing and that aid access is partly expanding, that ICRC and UN agencies have limited access, and that ICC referral is not excluded but no support currently exists, pointing instead to UN sanctions listings.
It is not ruled out that obstructing humanitarian access may indeed fall under crimes against humanity and thus within the jurisdiction of the ICC.

Het is niet uitgesloten dat het belemmeren van « humanitarian access » inderdaad onder de noemer misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid kan worden gebracht en daarmee binnen de rechtsmacht van het ICC valt.

Vragen van de leden Peters (GroenLinks), Timmermans (PvdA) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Wetsvoorstel om schade aan de Staat Israël te voorkomen als gevolg van boycot (ingezonden 18 m

MPs Peters, Timmermans and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli anti-boycott bill, including its territorial reach, civil-wrong liability, its possible link to protecting settlements, and its effect on free expression. The minister replied that the law adopted in July differs from earlier drafts and referred to answers given to other MPs' questions on the adopted law.
The bill was adopted by the Israeli parliament on 11 July.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 11 juli jongstleden in het Israëlische parlement aangenomen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gevaren voor Tibetaanse vluchtelingen in Nepal (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about an International Campaign for Tibet report alleging that UNHCR and Nepal fail to protect Tibetan refugees, including non-refoulement, and whether the government would press for its recommendations. The minister answered that Nepal is not party to the refugee conventions but has an informal arrangement with UNHCR, that the EU and others raise the issue, and that the Netherlands discussed it with UNHCR in Geneva.
Nepal is not a party to the Refugee Convention and the Statelessness Convention and has no national refugee legislation or asylum procedures.
Nepal is geen partij bij het Vluchtelingenverdrag en het Staatloosheidsverdrag en kent geen nationale wetgeving voor vluchtelingen of asielprocedures.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Irakese jongeren die tegen het Iraakse regime protesteren (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Iraqi youth protests against the regime, excessive force, root causes such as lack of economic prospects and corruption, and whether the government would press Iraqi authorities for dialogue. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the reports, called the violence regrettable, pointed to Arab-wide demands for economic opportunity and democracy, and said the Netherlands and the EU regularly raise the issue with Iraqi authorities.
To my knowledge, the Iraqi authorities have in a number of cases used violence against demonstrators.
De Iraakse autoriteiten hebben voor zover mij bekend in een aantal gevallen gewelddadig opgetreden tegen demonstranten.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie in Marokko van de Nederlandse pro-democratie activiste Fatima Zahra Moukafih (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011

MPs Timmermans and Marcouch asked the foreign minister whether Dutch activist Fatima Zahra Moukafih had been arrested in Morocco and whether the government would protest and use diplomatic means to secure her release. The minister confirmed the arrest and replied that she had already been released, so no protest was made.
No, the person concerned has meanwhile been released.
Vragen van de leden Eijsink, Timmermans en Smeets (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Defensie over het Financieel Diensten Centrum in Kerkrade (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

MPs Eijsink, Timmermans and Smeets asked the Defence Minister whether the Financial Services Centre in Kerkrade will be closed and moved to Utrecht, with job losses, and whether this breaks the earlier compensation agreement for Kerkrade. The minister replied that the real estate reallocation plan will be sent later this month and that administrative consultation on it is ongoing.
Administrative consultation on the reallocation of the real estate is currently still ongoing.
Over de herbelegging van het vastgoed is op dit moment nog bestuurlijk overleg gaande.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over activisten in Bahrein die door een militaire rechtbank zijn veroordeeld (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the conviction of 21 activists in Bahrain by a military court, whether this breaches international law, and whether the government will support Amnesty's call for release and raise the case with the EU. The minister confirmed the convictions, said the national security court has been abolished with cases now heard in civilian courts, reported that the Dutch ambassador raised concerns with Bahrain's deputy foreign minister, noted diplomatic observers attended hearings, and said the government pushes for EU action and an active EU role at the UN Human Rights Council.
All proceedings are now conducted before a civilian court, including appeal cases.
Alle processen worden nu gevoerd voor een civiele rechtbank, inclusief hoger beroepszaken.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Defensie over de artikelen «Kerntaak infanterist is vechten» en «Officieren: we waren te passief. Nederland heeft militaire kansen laten liggen

MPs Eijsink and Timmermans asked the Defence Minister about press articles claiming the Netherlands missed military opportunities in Uruzgan through passive conduct, and whether a return to combat-focused tasks conflicts with the 3D approach. The minister reaffirmed support for the 3D policy, called the articles part of an internal debate, stated Dutch units acted offensively where needed, and denied receiving indications from Australia that more offensive action was required.
I regard the articles as part of an internal discussion that the Association of Infantry Officers is conducting about developments in their field.
Ik beschouw de artikelen als een onderdeel van een interne discussie die de Vereniging van Infanterie Officieren voert over ontwikkelingen in hun vakgebied.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van de Syrische mensenrechtenactivist Amjad Baiazy (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister whether Syrian activist Amjad Baiazy was arrested, what he is suspected of, and whether the government will protest and seek an EU demarche and report back. Minister Rosenthal confirms the arrest and release on 30 June, reports a suspicion of spreading false information, and says the Netherlands raised the issue within the EU and that the EU called for release of political prisoners.
On 27 May the Netherlands within the EU expressed concern about the fate of political prisoners and human rights activists in Syria and called for a joint EU demarche to the Syrian authorities.

Op 27 mei jl. heeft Nederland binnen de EU zorg uitgesproken over het lot van politieke gevangenen en mensenrechtenactivisten in Syrië en opgeroepen tot een gemeenschappelijke EU-demarche bij de Syrische autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een gemartelde dichteres in Bahrein die een jaar celstraf krijgt (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether she would support Amnesty's call for the release of a poet jailed for a year in Bahrain, and whether the EU would condemn her arrest and about 500 other arrests and consider sanctions. The minister replied that the ambassador raised the case, the poet was released early to house arrest, and the government works through the EU and UN Human Rights Council, but sanctions are a last resort and are not yet justified given recent positive developments.
On 13 July she was released early and placed under house arrest.
Op 13 juli is zij vroegtijdig vrijgelaten en onder huisarrest geplaatst.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitlatingen van de Afghaanse president Karzai (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the US was conducting peace talks with the Taliban on behalf of ISAF and whether the Netherlands was informed and consulted, and whether allies should be told. The minister answered that only exploratory contacts exist, that the Netherlands is kept within an agreed international strategy, and saw no reason for consequences.
There are no formal negotiations or peace talks underway.
Er zijn geen formele onderhandelingen of vredesbesprekingen bezig.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Iraaks-Koerdische mensenrechtenactivist Karman Kamal (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

Timmermans (PvdA) asked the foreign minister whether a shooting at Kurdish human rights activist Karman Kamal is true and whether an independent investigation should be ordered, with pressure on the Kurdistan regional government. The minister confirmed the shooting, said the Dutch embassy asked the regional government to investigate, and promised continued bilateral and EU pressure for respect of human rights.
The Dutch embassy in Baghdad asked the Kurdish regional government on 29 June to launch an investigation into the shooting of Karwan Kamal.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Bagdad heeft op 29 juni de Koerdische regionale overheid gevraagd om een onderzoek naar de beschieting van Karwan Kamal in te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over arrestaties bij protest tegen het bewind van president Loekasjenko (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

MP Timmermans asked the foreign minister about mass arrests at anti-Lukashenko protests in Belarus, and whether the right to demonstrate, media freedom and social media access are being upheld and actively pursued. The minister answered that the EU consistently raises the right to demonstrate with Belarus, that sanctions were tightened at Dutch urging, and that the Netherlands funds NGOs and raises the issue bilaterally.
I work to ensure that the EU consistently brings this position to the attention of the governments concerned.
Ik zet mij ervoor in dat de EU dit standpunt consequent bij betrokken regeringen onder de aandacht brengt.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het staken van het juridische onderzoek naar massaverkrachting in Oost-Congo (ingezonden 8 juli 2

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs about reports that Congo suspended a legal investigation into mass rapes in Walikale, the protection of civilians by MONUSCO, Dutch funding against sexual violence, and Dutch donor coordination in eastern DRC. The government answered that the Congolese authorities did not halt the investigation but suspended victim interviews due to threats, and described MONUSCO measures, Dutch programmes and its diplomatic presence in the east.
Yes. However, the Congolese authorities have not halted the legal investigation.
Ja. De Congolese autoriteiten hebben het juridisch onderzoek echter niet gestaakt.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Arib (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over toenemend geweld bij demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government is aware of escalating violence against 20 February Movement protesters in Morocco, including a death after police action, and whether it will press Morocco and the EU on the right to peaceful protest and on dialogue. The minister acknowledged the reports and a death under investigation by Moroccan authorities, said there is no evidence the movement has turned to violence, stated the EU and diplomats have already raised concerns and will do so again if needed, and noted Morocco's constitutional referendum and expected early elections as the primary route forward.
Should the situation give cause for this again, I will express my serious concern to the Moroccan authorities, directly and via the EU.
Mocht de situatie hiertoe wederom aanleiding geven, dan zal ik bij de Marokkaanse autoriteiten mijn ernstige zorg hierover uitspreken, rechtstreeks en via de EU.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de hervormingsplannen van de Marokkaanse koning (ingezonden 21 juni 2011).

Timmermans (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister whether the Moroccan King's announced constitutional reform plans fall short of the 20 February Movement's demands for separation of powers, and whether the EU should keep pressing for democratisation. The minister answered that the government views the revised constitution positively as a step towards democracy and the rule of law, notes the 98.5% referendum approval, and says it will keep encouraging further reform directly and via the EU.
The Dutch government is closely following the reforms in Morocco and will continue to encourage the Moroccan government, directly and via the EU, to take further steps towards democratisation.
De Nederlandse regering volgt de hervormingen in Marokko op de voet en zal rechtstreeks en via de EU de Marokkaanse regering blijven aanmoedigen verdere stappen naar democratisering te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks), Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mediasituatie in Arabische landen, en

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and PvdA asked the government about internet and media restrictions in Yemen and Bahrain during protests, including whether the Netherlands would condemn these as strongly as Libya, and what it would do to secure internet access. The government answered that it condemns the restrictions wherever they occur, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU, supports media projects, and declined to answer the questions before the scheduled debate.
This has unfortunately not proved possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de opvolging van aanbevelingen van het VN-Mensenrechtencomité en de opvolging van de aanbevelingen van het VN-comité voor de uitbanning van

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the government has followed up on recommendations from the UN Human Rights Committee and the UN committee on racial discrimination, including a letter from a rapporteur and a deadline for a response. The minister confirms awareness of the reports and letter, says the response will be submitted before mid-August 2011 and the racial discrimination follow-up by 15 July, and acknowledges the importance of timely compliance.
The government will respond to the request of the UN committee on the elimination of racial discrimination by 15 July at the latest.
De regering zal uiterlijk 15 juli a.s. gehoor geven aan het verzoek van het VN-comité voor de uitbanning van rassendiscriminatie.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de recente vrijlating van kunstenaar Ai Weiwei (ingezonden 27 juni 2011).

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister about the recent release of artist Ai Weiwei, whether the government would work for his full freedom, whether it would support Amnesty's call for release of co-defendants, and whether it would keep raising human rights obligations with China. The minister answered yes to knowing the reports, said efforts are made bilaterally and via the EU, noted the four co-defendants were already released, and said yes to continued engagement on human rights.
Yes. This happens both bilaterally and through the EU.
Ja. Dit gebeurt zowel bilateraal als via de EU.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Chinese mensenrechtenadvocaten die onder druk worden gezet door de Chinese autoriteiten (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the Amnesty report on Chinese authorities tightening control over human rights lawyers, including annual reviews that strip licences of lawyers taking sensitive cases, and whether the Netherlands will press China on its human rights obligations. The minister shares concern about the growing control over the legal profession, says the issues were raised at the EU-China human rights dialogue, and states that human rights will continue to be raised bilaterally, via the EU and UN, and through rule-of-law programmes.
The Netherlands will raise these bottlenecks bilaterally.
Nederland zal bilateraal aandacht besteden aan deze knelpunten.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans (PvdA) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de ontvoering in Libanon van Amsterdammer Priit Raistik (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the March 2011 kidnapping in Lebanon of Priit Raistik, an Amsterdam resident, and what the Netherlands was doing to locate and free him and his companions. The minister answered that the seven Estonians were freed on 14 July through cooperation between Estonia, Lebanon and other partners, and that Dutch embassies had been in contact with Estonian authorities throughout and offered all available means.
The seven Estonian nationals were freed on the morning of 14 July as a result of cooperation between Estonia, Lebanon and other partners.
De zeven Estse staatsburgers zijn in de ochtend van 14 juli bevrijd als gevolg van samenwerking tussen Estland, Libanon en andere partners.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanslag op het Intercontinental Hotel in Kabul (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about the attack on the Intercontinental Hotel in Kabul, including whether Afghan police helped the attackers, whether Afghan forces can take over security from ISAF, and whether police infiltration by the Taliban makes cooperation risky. The government answered that the precise circumstances are unclear, that the Afghan authorities responded adequately, that vetting and monitoring measures exist, and that there is no evidence of systematic Taliban infiltration.
There is no evidence of systematic Taliban infiltration of the Afghan army or police.
