Er zijn geen bewijzen voor systematische infiltratie van de Taliban in het Afghaanse leger of de politie.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het onderzoek naar de vliegramp bij Tripoli (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Libya is legally bound to report within a year on the Tripoli air crash investigation, and whether the minister misinformed parliament and should apologise to victims' relatives. The minister answered that ICAO rules require a final report within a year where possible and an interim report annually otherwise, and expressed concern over the relatives' uncertainty without apologising.
It is clear that if that deadline is not met, an (interim) report must in any case be drawn up and published every year on the date of the accident.
Helder is dat, indien die termijn niet gehaald wordt, in ieder geval elk jaar op de datum van het ongeval, een (tussen)rapportage moet worden opgesteld en gepubliceerd.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de veroordeling van twee voormalige presidentskandidaten in Wit-Rusland (ingezonden 30 mei 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the conviction of two former Belarusian presidential candidates for joining demonstrations, and whether the government would raise it bilaterally and in the EU. The minister confirmed the right to demonstrate is essential, blamed the protests partly on the opposition while noting unidentified attackers were never investigated, and said the issue will be raised bilaterally and multilaterally, with new EU sanctions adopted on 20 June.
Yes, I will continue to raise the conviction of former presidential candidates and demonstrators in bilateral contacts and in multilateral fora (EU, OSCE, Council of Europe, EBRD).
Ja, ik blijf de veroordeling van voormalige presidentskandidaten en demonstranten in bilaterale contacten en in multilateraal kader (EU, OVSE, Raad van Europa, EBRD) aan de orde brengen.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het aanhoudende geweld in Nigeria (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the foreign minister about ongoing violence in northern Nigeria following the 2011 presidential election, including its causes, possible EU mediation between Jonathan and Buhari, and economic instruments to address northern deprivation. The minister condemned the violence, described its perpetrators and causes, said Buhari refused substantive dialogue, and pointed to existing EU programmes and Dutch diplomatic efforts.
Yes, in Nigeria this is actively conveyed by the Dutch embassy in its contacts with the Nigerian government.
Ja, in Nigeria wordt dit actief uitgedragen door de Nederlandse ambassade in de contacten met de Nigeriaanse overheid.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans en Plasterk (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken, en de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over speculatie met grondstof

PvdA MPs asked the government about speculation in commodity markets, DNB's warning on leveraged commodity strategies, price volatility, effects on developing countries, and whether EU regulation should match the US. The ministers replied that DNB and AFM supervision is sufficient, that no additional measures are planned now, and that they await European Commission proposals on commodity derivatives regulation.
I consider the financial supervision carried out by DNB and AFM sufficient to address the risks. I do not currently intend to take additional measures.
Ik acht het financieel toezicht uitgevoerd door DNB en AFM voldoende om de risico's te adresseren. Ik ben momenteel niet van plan additionele maatregelen te treffen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie in Iraaks Koerdistan (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about a Human Rights Watch report on intimidation and arrests of critical journalists in Iraqi Kurdistan and whether the government would protest to Iraq and the Kurdish authorities. The minister acknowledged pressure on press freedom, said the Kurdish authorities pledge to improve the situation, and committed to continue raising the issue bilaterally and through the EU.
I will continue to press the Iraqi authorities in Baghdad and in the Kurdish region, both bilaterally and within the EU, to respect these rights and to prosecute those who violate them.

Ik zal zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband bij de Iraakse autoriteiten in Bagdad en in de Koerdische regio blijven aandringen op respect voor deze rechten en op vervolging van degenen die deze rechten schenden.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de dood van Haleh Sahabi, dochter van Ezzatollah Sahabi, vooraanstaand lid van de Iraanse oppositie (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that Haleh Sahabi died after police mistreatment in Iran are true, whether the government will seek clarification and protest, and whether EU sanctions should be tightened. The minister said he could not confirm the reports, that the Netherlands pressed EU partners to ask Iran for clarification with protest if the reports prove true, and that expanding sanctions requires prior research and EU-wide agreement, which is under way.
The Netherlands has urged EU partners to ask the Iranian authorities for clarification on this case.
Nederland heeft er bij EU-partners voor gepleit de Iraanse autoriteiten om opheldering te vragen over deze zaak.
Vragen het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de oplopende spanningen tussen Azerbeidzjan en Armenië (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

Timmermans asked the foreign minister about rising tensions and military buildup between Azerbaijan and Armenia over Nagorno-Karabakh, and about the role of the Minsk Group, human rights and media freedom in both countries. Minister Rosenthal said the Netherlands supports the Minsk Group and a peaceful settlement, promotes human rights through the EU Eastern Partnership and bilateral contacts, and referred to the planned Kazan meeting for the answer on mediation.
The Netherlands will continue to press for a peaceful solution to the conflict, both bilaterally and multilaterally.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband blijven aandringen op een vreedzame oplossing van het conflict.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het gegeven dat seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in Congo veel vaker voorkomt dan tot dusver werd aa

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs about a study showing sexual violence against women in Congo is far more common than UN statistics suggest, and about Dutch-funded projects and the planned removal of the DRC from the list of priority countries. The government confirmed the study, listed existing Dutch-funded anti-violence projects, said central funds will remain available after the DRC leaves the country list, and described efforts against impunity.
As announced in the Focus Letter on Development Cooperation of 18 March, central funds remain available even if the DRC is no longer on the country list.
Zoals aangekondigd in de Focusbrief Ontwikkelingssamenwerking van 18 maart jl. blijven centrale middelen beschikbaar, ook als de DRC niet meer op de landenlijst staat.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de onrust in Georgië (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about excessive force against protesters in Georgia, the refusal of President Saakashvili to engage in dialogue with the opposition, and whether international instruments should be deployed. The minister replies that an investigation must establish whether force was excessive, supports calls for a transparent inquiry and adequate treatment of detainees, notes that dialogue has stalled, and commits to monitoring developments and raising the matter with Georgian authorities.
I support the call by the Georgian Ombudsman, the OSCE and non-governmental organisations for the Georgian government to set up a thorough and transparent investigation into the unrest.
Ik steun de oproep van de Georgische Ombudsman, van de OVSE en van non-gouvernementele organisaties aan de Georgische regering een grondig en transparant onderzoek in te stellen
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over politiegeweld tegen homo's in Moskou (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether she knew of police violence against gay people at a Moscow equal-rights demonstration, whether Russia breaches its Council of Europe obligations, and whether she would press Russia bilaterally and through the EU and condemn the police conduct. The minister confirmed the reports, said Russia is bound by European Court rulings to allow such demonstrations, and described ongoing bilateral and EU pressure, an EU statement of concern and Dutch support for LGBT organisations, without a new concrete step.
Both bilaterally and within the EU, the Netherlands presses the Russian authorities on the importance of freedom of expression and the right to demonstrate.
Zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband dringt Nederland bij de Russische autoriteiten aan op het belang van de vrijheid van meningsuiting en het recht op demonstratie.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de celstraf voor Cubaanse activisten (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

Rep. Timmermans asks whether four Cuban activists were jailed for distributing pamphlets, whether this signals worsening repression, and whether the EU should act with protests or sanctions. The minister confirms the sentences, says political prisoner releases are not structural and short detentions are rising, and says the EU is reviewing strategy and Netherlands will condemn the sentences in dialogue, without committing to sanctions.
I will also advocate in the EU that the EU, in its political dialogue with the Cuban authorities, strongly condemn the recently imposed prison sentences.
Ik zal tevens in de EU bepleiten om in de politieke dialoog van de EU met de Cubaanse autoriteiten de recent opgelegde celstraffen krachtig te veroordelen.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de grote kans op etnische zuiveringen in de Abyei-regio (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about the risk of ethnic cleansing in Abyei after the Northern Sudanese invasion, Khartoum's refusal to withdraw troops, and what the Netherlands can do diplomatically. The government answered that it shares the concern, calls for returns and withdrawal, backs AU and UN mediation and sent envoys, but gave no concrete new commitments beyond existing diplomacy.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers , Timmermans en Marchouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitwet in Oeganda (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

MPs Dikkers, Timmermans and Marchouch asked whether the Netherlands would use development aid as leverage against Uganda's proposed anti-homosexuality bill, whether it would press the EU and World Bank to condition aid, what was being done to protect threatened LGBTI activists, and whether the embassy would open to them. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposes the bill and has raised concerns at the highest level, but that aid conditionality is not currently on the table, that EHAHRDP has run a security assessment and provided practical protection, and that the embassy already maintains contacts with the LGBTI community.
Using Dutch aid to Uganda as a means of pressure, as well as making EU and World Bank aid conditional, is currently not on the agenda.
Het inzetten van de Nederlandse hulp aan Oeganda als pressiemiddel, maar ook het conditioneel maken van de hulp van EU en Wereldbank, is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toename van gewelddadigheden in Oeganda (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising violence and heavy-handed police action against opposition demonstrations in Uganda, including Human Rights Watch's call for an independent inquiry. The government answered that it is concerned, that Ugandan commissions and internal reviews are underway with Dutch and EU pressure for publication, and that the EU urges dialogue and prosecution of violence, while sanctions are not currently on the table.
The Netherlands and the EU will press for these reports to be made public.
Nederland en de EU zullen aandringen op openbaarmaking van deze rapporten.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het risico op escalatie van conflict in Kirgizië (ingezonden 9 juni 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister about Amnesty's report on unpunished human rights violations after the 2010 violence in southern Kyrgyzstan, the humanitarian situation of Uzbeks and Kyrgyz, implementation of the international commission's recommendations, and the OSCE High Commissioner's role. The minister endorsed calls for accountability, said the security situation has improved while Uzbeks still face police abuse, and said the EU and the OSCE High Commissioner handle the dialogue, with the latter's recommendations confidential.
The HCNM mediates behind the scenes, therefore the content of the discussions and his recommendations to the Kyrgyz authorities are confidential.
De HCNM bemiddelt achter de schermen, derhalve zijn de inhoud van de besprekingen en zijn aanbevelingen aan de Kyrgyzische autoriteiten vertrouwelijk.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Nederlandse diplomaten die vertragingstactieken gebruiken om uitbreiding van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens (EVRM) te voo

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Dutch diplomats use delaying tactics to block EU accession to the European Convention on Human Rights, and whether this fits the government's human rights policy. The minister denies using delaying tactics, argues careful preparation outweighs timing, and affirms support for EU accession and respect for human rights treaties.
Dutch diplomats do not use delaying techniques in the negotiations on the accession of the European Union to the ECHR.
Nederlandse diplomaten gebruiken geen vertragingstechnieken in de onderhandelingen over de toetreding van de Europese Unie tot het EVRM.
Vragen het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verslechterde mensenrechtensituatie in China (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

Timmermans (PvdA) asked the foreign minister about reports of mass arrests of Chinese dissidents, the cause of the deterioration, a demand for action on China's human rights obligations, and the case of Ni Yulan and Ai Weiwei. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the deterioration, cited instability fears as a likely cause, and said concerns were raised bilaterally and via the EU, with the EU-China human rights dialogue planned and the Chamber to be kept informed.
I will advocate that the EU again raises her case with the Chinese authorities and will keep your House informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal bepleiten dat de EU haar zaak wederom onder de aandacht van de Chinese autoriteiten brengt en uw Kamer op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de aanbevelingen van het VN-Comité inzake Economische, Sociale en Culturele r

MPs Spekman and Timmermans asked ministers how the government would respond to the UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights' 2010 concluding observations on Dutch compliance, including direct effect of the Covenant, discrimination against migrants, detention of asylum seekers and unaccompanied minors, and the optional protocol. The government rejected the criticism on direct effect under the Dutch monist system, described existing measures on discrimination, VVE and youth detention, and said the optional protocol ratification was still under consideration.

Question 7: What is the status of the Netherlands' ratification of the Optional Protocol to the Covenant adopted in December 2008, which among other things provides an individual complaints procedure for citizens?

Vraag 7 Wat is de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de ratificatie door Nederland van het in december 2008 aangenomen Facultatieve Protocol bij het Verdrag, dat onder meer voorziet in een individueel klachtrecht voor burgers?
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van een Iraanse mensenrechtenactiviste (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether Iranian human rights activist Maryam Bahreman was arrested in Shiraz, what charges she faces, and whether the government will protest bilaterally and in the EU and demand her release. The minister confirmed reports of her arrest were credible but had no confirmation from Iranian authorities, said media reported national security charges, and said officials raised concerns with the Iranian ambassador and the embassy raised the case with EU partners.
At official level, the Iranian ambassador has been asked for clarification on this case.
Ambtelijk is de Iraanse ambassadeur opheldering gevraagd over deze zaak.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanbevelingen van de onderzoekscommissie Goldstone (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

MP Timmermans asks the foreign minister whether the Goldstone report's call for independent investigations into the Gaza war is being met by Israel and the de facto Hamas authorities, and whether the Netherlands will push for international follow-up. The minister says the investigations by Israel and the Palestinian Authority are ongoing and the Netherlands favours national investigations rather than an international follow-up mechanism, promising to raise the Goldstone report at the next EU and UN opportunity.

Furthermore, the Netherlands has consistently stated that it is not in favour of establishing international follow-up mechanisms, because the primary responsibility for investigating international crimes and prosecuting suspects lies with the parties concerned.

Nederland heeft daarnaast steeds kenbaar gemaakt geen voorstander te zijn van instelling van internationale opvolgingsmechanismes, omdat de eerste verantwoordelijkheid voor het doen van onderzoek naar internationale misdrijven en het vervolgen van verdachten bij betrokken partijen ligt.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de politiek onrustige situatie in Burkina Faso (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister about rising political tensions in Burkina Faso, including the new smaller cabinet and the role of the international community. The minister said the situation is unclear, that the cabinet reshuffle should restore trust, and that the Netherlands will press the government through EU political dialogue and donor support.
The Netherlands, together with other EU partners, conducts an intensive political dialogue with the government of Burkina Faso.
Nederland voert, samen met andere EU-partners, een intensieve politieke dialoog met de regering van Burkina Faso.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Hilkens (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over groeiend antisemitisme en toenemend geweld tegen Roma in Hongarije (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Hilkens asked the Foreign Minister about reports of rising antisemitism and violence against Roma in Hungary, including Roma fleeing a village over threats from a paramilitary movement, and whether Hungary's authorities are tolerating it and whether the government will press Hungary under EU and Council of Europe obligations. The minister answered that Hungary has deployed police to protect the village, is drafting legislation to restrict paramilitary movements, and that the Hungarian government rejects such intimidation and is committed to its treaty obligations, while noting the Dutch embassy supports Roma integration projects.
The Hungarian government is committed to guaranteeing safety in these villages.
De Hongaarse regering zet zich in om de veiligheid in deze dorpen te garanderen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het Australische voorstel voor internationale rampenbestrijding (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister whether she knows Australian minister Rudd's proposal for a global disaster-response system, whether slow international rescue justifies it, and whether the Netherlands will support it bilaterally and in the EU. The minister replied that the proposal is not yet elaborated, that UN coordination of rescue teams already works reasonably well, and that the Netherlands will urge any initiative to align with existing UN coordination.
The Netherlands will advocate to Australia that initiatives align with existing UN coordination of the international disaster response.
Nederland zal bij Australië bepleiten dat initiatieven aansluiten bij bestaande coördinatie van de internationale respons op rampen door de VN.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) en Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse zaken en van Defensie over eventueel gebruik van munitie met verarmd uranium en clust

MPs from SP and PvdA asked the Foreign and Defence ministers how Dutch support for UN resolution 65/55 on depleted uranium translates into action, whether a moratorium is considered, whether the US, UK, Israel and Russia will be asked to release strike coordinates, whether depleted uranium or cluster munitions were used in Libya, and whether non-signatories will be urged to stop using cluster munitions. The government answered that it supports further health research and protective guidelines but sees no basis for a moratorium, will not repeat the request for coordinates, found no confirmed US depleted uranium use in Libya and uses none itself, and will urge non-signatories to join the cluster munitions convention.
The government takes note of such research with interest and appreciates the efforts undertaken in this area by international organisations and research institutions.
De regering neemt met belangstelling kennis van dergelijk onderzoek en waardeert de inspanningen die op dit gebied door internationale organisaties en onderzoeksinstellingen worden verricht.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de berichten dat het Rotterdamse graanhandelsbedrijf Nidera zich volgens justitie in Argentinië schuldig maakt aan «slav

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the foreign minister about reports that Rotterdam grain trader Nidera was accused of slavery-like practices at its Argentine plantation, and about FMO's financing of the company. The government answered that the accusations are unsubstantiated, that it has engaged Nidera on CSR without intervening directly, that FMO applies social criteria and commissioned consultant reviews, and that it sees no need to change FMO lending conditions.
The answer to question 9 is available for confidential inspection by members only, deposited with the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives.
Het antwoord op vraag 9 is ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de leden, gelegd bij het Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over Nederlandse bedrijven die geen heil zien in Uruzgan

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked why Dutch firms have barely started economic activity in Uruzgan despite FEOU funding, and about the termination of a feasibility project and the closure of the fund. The state secretary explained local insecurity and weak demand, reported the fund closed on its legal date, and described the handover of the business office to the Dutch trade centre.
The FEOU was closed on 31 December 2010, on the legal date published in the Staatscourant.
Het FEOU is op 31 december 2010 gesloten, op de wettelijke datum die in de Staatscourant was gepubliceerd.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de onderbetaling van ambassadepersoneel (ingezonden 18 maart 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Vermeij asked whether the Moroccan embassy underpays locally hired staff with Dutch passports and what steps the government will take. The minister said embassies must respect Dutch labour law, that Dutch inspectorates lack legal power to investigate foreign embassies under the Vienna Convention, and that he raises concrete cases with the ambassador.
Dutch inspection and investigative services have no legal authority to investigate embassies, consulates and individual diplomats of other countries.
Nederlandse inspectie- en opsporingsdiensten hebben geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om onderzoek te doen bij ambassades, consulaten en individuele diplomaten van andere landen.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over investeringen door bedrijven en personen die gelieerd zijn aan staten (i

MPs Timmermans and Smeets asked ministers whether Dutch supervisors adequately screen investments by foreign state-owned companies and whether the government will map assets of foreign states and leaders, and whether Libya sanctions were delayed by asset searches. The minister rejected claims of inadequate supervision, declined to compile a list of state-owned company assets citing the investment climate and existing rules, and said Libya sanctions were implemented immediately by financial institutions.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch investment climate and of our economic and diplomatic relations abroad to list all assets of foreign state-owned companies.

Het is niet in het belang van het Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat en van onze economische en diplomatieke relaties met het buitenland om alle bezittingen van buitenlandse staatsbedrijven op een lijst te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de dreigende uitzetting van een Libische asielzoeker (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked whether deportations of Libyan asylum seekers should be suspended given the unsafe situation in Libya, how many Libyans are in detention, and whether the outdated country report still permits returns. The minister answered that returns to Libya are not currently on the agenda, that about ten Libyans are detained for Dublin transfers or public order reasons, and that the country report predates recent events but the government monitors the situation.
Deportations to Libya are currently not on the agenda given the uncertainty about developments in Libya.
Uitzettingen naar Libië zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde gelet op de onzekerheid omtrent de ontwikkelingen in Libië.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Smeets en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de gebiedsontwikkeling Ooijen-Wanssum (ingezonden 7 februari 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the Ooijen-Wanssum area development in light of plans to reverse flood-protection connecting zones and the high Meuse water levels. The state secretary said a decision depends on completing the MIRT process and budget constraints, that the project cannot be confirmed for the spring 2011 MIRT meetings, and that no short-term certainty can be given.
Around the summer I will inform you about this, in accordance with my commitment in the committee meeting of 13 December 2010.
Rond de zomer zal ik u, conform mijn toezegging in het AO op 13 december 2010, hierover informeren.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van leiders van de Iraanse oppositie (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Iran arrested opposition leaders Moussavi and Karoubi on charges of counter-revolution and treason, and whether the EU and UN would condemn it and how pressure would be increased. The minister said the arrests were unconfirmed by Iran, reported an EU demarche and a High Representative statement, and said the Netherlands would follow the matter and raise it where possible.
The Netherlands will, where possible, address the Iranian authorities on this issue.
Nederland zal daar waar mogelijk de Iraanse autoriteiten aanspreken op deze kwestie.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verviervoudiging van het aantal overvallen in Zuid-Limburg (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the sharp rise in armed robberies in South Limburg, including solution rates, perpetrators, cross-border drug trade, police capacity, extra support, methods and the possibility of driving bans as additional punishment. The minister answered that solution rates rose to 30% in 2010, that cross-border links were not found, that no special support is planned for now beyond the national action programme, and that he is not inclined to legislate driving bans for robbers.
For now I do not intend to initiate legislation that would make this possible, because I doubt the effectiveness of such a measure.
Ik ben vooralsnog niet van plan om wetgeving te initiëren die dit mogelijk zou maken omdat ik twijfel aan de effectiviteit van een dergelijke maatregel.
Vragen de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het OM-onderzoek naar Trafigura op Jamaica (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about a Public Prosecution Service investigation into Trafigura in Jamaica, including a reported 466 thousand euro payment to a minister's re-election fund and whether the government knew of it. The minister confirmed the investigation exists but said she cannot comment on this ongoing case, and that the Jamaican government filed no complaint.
This is an ongoing investigation about which I cannot make any statements.
Dit is een lopend onderzoek waarover ik geen mededelingen kan doen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over kunst en erfgoed uit Egypte (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign and Education ministers whether Italy's special checks on travellers from Egypt for stolen cultural objects should be replicated in the Netherlands, and whether this should be done immediately and nationwide. The government answered that the Erfgoedinspectie has alerted customs to watch for illegally exported Egyptian heritage, but did not commit to new airport and seaport checks.

Based on news reports and alerts from international heritage organisations such as UNESCO and ICOM, the Heritage Inspectorate, part of the Ministry of OCW, has informed customs so that they must be extra alert to possibly illegally exported heritage from Egypt.

Op basis van nieuwsberichten en alarmeringen van internationale erfgoedorganisaties als UNESCO en ICOM heeft de Erfgoedinspectie, onderdeel van het ministerie van OCW, de douane geïnformeerd opdat zij extra alert moet zijn op mogelijk illegaal uitgevoerd erfgoed uit Egypte.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen in het rapport van de Commissie Davids (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

MP Timmermans asks the Foreign Minister whether a planned independent legal adviser at the ministry, working only occasionally, fits the Davids Commission recommendation and earlier promises of full implementation, and whether the internal and external legal advisory roles should be clearly separated and comparable in status and resources. The minister answers that legal advisers in the legal department will advise him directly without instructions, that an external international law expert can be consulted for a second opinion, and that she is willing to discuss implementation with the House.
To give content to recommendation 22 of the Davids Commission, I will ensure that international law advice is sent directly to me.
Om inhoud te geven aan aanbeveling 22 van de Commissie Davids zal ik waarborgen dat volkenrechtelijke adviezen mij rechtstreeks toegezonden worden

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Recourt en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over vrijwilligerswerk in een Afrikaans Kindertehuis door verdachte Robert M (ingezonden 28 december 2010).

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government had information about a children's home in Kenya where suspect Robert M. allegedly volunteered, whether children there may have been abused, and whether an investigation would be launched. The minister said the government has no concrete information, offered full cooperation with judicial authorities, but declined to order its own inquiry so as not to interfere with the criminal investigation.

I want to prevent an investigation initiated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs from interfering with this important criminal investigation, and therefore cannot answer your questions further at this time.

Ik wil daarbij voorkomen dat een op initiatief van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken ingesteld onderzoek dit belangrijke strafvorderlijk onderzoek doorkruist en kan daarom op dit moment uw vragen niet verder beantwoorden.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een georganiseerde campagne van geweld in Ivoorkust (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the Foreign Minister about reports of an organised violence campaign in Ivory Coast by Gbagbo's forces and militias against Ouattara supporters, and whether the government would act on Human Rights Watch's call for stronger pressure. The minister confirmed the reports, pointed to recent EU sanctions and support for the UN mission, and promised continued pressure and follow-up on a forthcoming UN human rights report.
The Netherlands will continue to increase targeted pressure on Gbagbo and those supporting him through the EU.
Nederland blijft via de EU de gerichte druk op Gbagbo en degenen die hem ondersteunen opvoeren.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het grote aantal doden als gevolg van de watersnood in Brazilië (ingezonden 27 januari 2011).

Timmermans (PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister about the high death toll from flooding in Brazil, whether poor water management and city planning worsened it, and whether the Netherlands would offer water-management expertise under the 2008 agreements. Minister Rosenthal answered that the main cause was unsafe building on slopes, that Brazil did not request international aid so the EU's EUR 1.5 million was not allocated, that a Dutch water-expertise dialogue is ongoing, and that a possible future Brazilian request would be considered with the Infrastructure and Environment minister.

Should Brazil request Dutch water-management expertise for the disaster area in the Serrana region, I will seriously consider it in consultation with my colleague of Infrastructure and the Environment.

Een eventueel Braziliaans verzoek om Nederlandse watermanagement-expertise te leveren voor het thans getroffen rampgebied in de regio Serrana, zal ik in overleg met mijn ambtgenoot van Infrastructuur en Milieu serieus bekijken.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het UNEP/OCHA rapport over loodvergiftiging in Noord-Nigeria (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the UNEP/OCHA report on lead poisoning from artisanal gold mining in Zamfara state, Nigeria, including health risks, sustainable mining, and EU gold trade links. The minister answered that the report shows serious concerns, that Nigerian authorities must act, that Dutch-funded initiatives such as EITI and Green Gold exist, and that the gold trade is too fragmented to trace.
It is now primarily up to the Nigerian authorities to follow up on the recommendations in the report.
Het is nu in de eerste plaats aan de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten om opvolging te geven aan de aanbevelingen in het rapport.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de mishandeling van een Nederlandse journalist in Caïro (ingezonden 27 januari

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign and education ministers about the beating of a Trouw correspondent in Cairo by police and whether the Egyptian ambassador would be summoned and prosecution of the perpetrators pressed. The minister said the ambassador had raised concern with Egyptian authorities and that there was no indication of targeted violence against journalists.
The ambassador in Cairo expressed to the Egyptian authorities annoyance and concern about how this and other journalists were treated.
Door de ambassadeur in Cairo is tegenover de Egyptische autoriteiten ergernis en zorg uitgesproken over de wijze waarop deze en andere journalisten zijn behandeld.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Timmermans en Smeets (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de dijken in Limburg (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about Limburg dike safety, whether provincial funding requests were justified, and how costs would be split between the state and water boards. The state secretary confirmed the request and the Maaswerken budget use, said the national picture would follow the Inspectorate's validation, and gave no firm timetable or final cost split.
The national picture will be final after the Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management has judged all provincial assessments.
Het landelijk beeld wordt definitief na het oordeel van de Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat op alle provinciale oordelen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie in Ivoorkust (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

MP Timmermans asks whether ECOWAS and African Union diplomacy on Ivory Coast's post-election crisis has reached a deadlock, how the EU can help, and whether a US offer to let Gbagbo go into exile should be matched. Minister Rosenthal answers that the efforts continue and it is too early to speak of a deadlock, that the EU backs ECOWAS and AU initiatives with sanctions and recognition of Ouattara's ambassadors, and that the Netherlands sees no reason for a similar offer.
The Netherlands will continue to press for a united effort by the AU and ECOWAS and to support them, when asked and where possible within the EU framework.
Nederland zal blijven aandringen op een eensgezinde inzet van de AU en ECOWAS en deze desgevraagd en waar mogelijk in EU verband ondersteunen.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Albayrak (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de nieuwe Hongaarse mediawet (ingezonden 23 december 2010).

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether the new Hungarian media law, which creates a regulatory body that can impose fines for 'non-objective' reporting, breaches press freedom and EU obligations, and what action the Netherlands would take. The minister acknowledged the law may conflict with press freedom, said the European Commission should analyse it, and said the Netherlands would hold EU member states to account if it breaches EU law, without committing to a specific step.
It is therefore good that the European Commission (EC) analyses this law.
Het is daarom goed dat de Europese Commissie (EC) deze wet analyseert.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over geweld tegen vrouwen op Haïti (ingezonden 7 januari 2010).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about a report on sexual violence against women in Haiti's earthquake camps, and whether Dutch aid for reconstruction could be conditioned on protecting women and girls. The state secretary agreed the violence is serious, described existing protection measures in the camps and UN efforts, and said Dutch aid bodies would pursue these issues in their projects.

I will therefore continue to press the Haitian authorities, the international aid organisations and the non-governmental organisations involved in managing the camps to do everything possible against this.

Ik zal dan ook doorgaan met het aanspreken van de Haïtiaanse autoriteiten, de internationale hulporganisaties en de niet-gouvernementele organisaties die betrokken zijn bij het beheer van de opvangkampen om hier al het mogelijke tegen in stelling te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de overstromingen in Queensland, Australië (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

Timmermans asked the foreign minister about the Queensland floods, whether the government had noted the premier's warning and whether it would contact Australia to offer Dutch water-management expertise, and whether it would inform parliament of results. Minister Rosenthal answered that the government has noted the situation, that Dutch know-how has been offered in a letter from the prime minister, and that Australia currently sees no need for international assistance, with contact to follow if a need is signalled.
If signals are received from Australia that there is actually a need for such support, I am willing to contact my Australian colleague Kevin Rudd.
Wanneer signalen uit Australië worden ontvangen dat er daadwerkelijk behoefte zou zijn aan dergelijke ondersteuning, ben ik bereid contact op te nemen met mijn Australische collega Kevin Rudd.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verkiezingen in Belarus (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to condemn police violence against demonstrators and the unfair Belarus elections, to tighten EU sanctions on the Lukashenko regime, and to rule out EU financial aid conditional on free elections. The minister answered that he condemned the violence, arrests and unfair elections, called for release of detainees, will urge the EU to consider reinstating a travel ban, and sees no reason for financial support to a regime that behaves badly.
I have called on the Belarusian authorities to release detainees immediately.
Ik heb de Belarussische autoriteiten opgeroepen om arrestanten direct vrij te laten.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie van de koptische gemeenschap in Nederland en andere Europese landen (ingezon

MPs Timmermans and Marcouch asked about online threats against Coptic communities in Europe, protective measures, and whether Dutch Coptic churches were on an Al-Qaeda list. The minister replied that NCTb and police see no concrete threat in the Netherlands, will stay alert, take security measures where needed (including at Christmas), and that European coordination on protection and prosecution already takes place.
As usual, no further details are provided on the nature of these measures.
Over de aard van deze maatregelen worden, zoals gebruikelijk, geen nadere mededelingen gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Albayrak en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een «homotest» die de Tsjechische autoriteiten gebruiken bij asielzoekers die vanwege hun geaardheid in eigen

MPs Timmermans, Albayrak and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about the Czech authorities' use of a 'homotest' on asylum seekers persecuted for their sexual orientation, how often it was used, and whether concerns were raised with Czech authorities. The minister answered that ten asylum seekers were tested voluntarily in 2008-2009, that the test was discontinued in early 2010, and that no concerns were raised since the test had ended.
I am, together with the EU agency, of the view that such tests are not compatible with existing European and international treaties and are an infringement of the right to privacy.
Ik ben, met het EU-agentschap, van mening dat dergelijke testen niet verenigbaar zijn met bestaande Europese en internationale verdragen en een aantasting zijn van het recht op privacy.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over oplopende spanningen in Guinee naar aanleiding van de presidentsverkiezingen van 15 november 2010 (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MP Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister about rising tensions in Guinea after the November 2010 presidential election, including the International Crisis Group's call for international action. The minister said the government shares the concerns, that the UN is already engaged and calling for restraint, and that the EU is the most effective channel, pressing for transparent elections and a fair handling of complaints.
I am of the view that the problems in Guinea can most effectively be addressed within the EU framework.
Ik ben van mening dat de problematiek in Guinee het meest effectief in EU-verband kan worden aangepakt.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans, Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitspraak van de Keniaanse premier Raila Odinga over homoseksuele mannen (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga's reported call for arrests of gay men, whether such remarks are undesirable, whether the Dutch ambassador should discuss them, and what risks gay men face in Kenya. The minister agreed the remarks are undesirable, judged a meeting with the Kenyan ambassador unnecessary since Odinga had already corrected the picture, described limited risks and reported the embassy's ongoing work with local groups and the expected repeal of the colonial-era ban.
The embassy will continue to follow this process closely.
De ambassade zal dit proces nauwgezet blijven volgen.
Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de moord op een Nederlander door de Russische geheime dienst (ingezonden 29 november 2010).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that the Russian secret service murdered a Dutch architect and five foreign nurses, whether Russia ever investigated, and whether the government has raised concerns and will press for a full inquiry. The minister confirms the reports, says the case is still open with Russian authorities, notes repeated Dutch concerns raised with Moscow, but declines for now to make a formal demarche, deferring to the Red Cross which is in contact with Russia.
The Red Cross recently reported being in contact with the Russian authorities about the investigation.
Het Rode Kruis heeft onlangs gemeld in contact te staan met de Russische autoriteiten over het onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over conclusies en aanbevelingen uit het rapport van de Commissie Davids (ingezonden 23 no

MP Timmermans asked whether the government implemented the Davids Commission recommendations on the Iraq invasion decision-making, including appointing an independent international law adviser and why the commission's website was taken down. The minister answered that the cabinet's response is being implemented, promised to appoint the international law adviser within three months, and said the commission's content was moved to rijksoverheid.nl.
I will appoint the international law adviser within three months.
Ik zal binnen drie maanden de volkenrechtelijk adviseur benoemen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Thieme en Van Klaveren over Beschuldiging van Turkse wapenleveranties aan terroristische organisaties

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Turkey supplied arms to jihadist groups including IS, and about reports of recruitment centres and a prisoner swap. The minister said the government could not confirm the allegations, relied on Turkey's denials and its IS listing, and declined to seek clarification from Turkey or back an independent international inquiry.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, as is the House, but, as indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, cannot confirm them.
Het kabinet is net als de Kamer op de hoogte van deze berichten, maar kan, zoals ook in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen aangegeven, deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat ISIS beschikt over chemische wapens

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that ISIS possesses chemical weapons, including outdated Iraqi stocks, alleged chemical attacks in Kobani, the risk to Dutch trainers, and whether border controls are needed. The ministers answered that the Iraqi weapons were destroyed, that the Netherlands cannot confirm the Kobani findings without samples, that protective measures will follow threat analyses, and that border controls are not necessary given existing EU customs risk regimes.
No, the cabinet sees no need for this.
Nee, het kabinet ziet daartoe geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht ‘UN envoy urges Turkey to allow Kurds to protect Syria’s Kobani’

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Kobani is surrounded, whether the government will press Turkey to guarantee civilians safe passage, and whether it supports the UN envoy's call for Turkey to admit volunteers to defend the town. The minister said the situation is volatile, Turkey is not blocking civilians fleeing, and the government understands the call but notes Turkey's PKK concerns; it reports Turkish agreement to let Iraqi Kurdish fighters transit to Kobani.
No, according to UNHCR Turkey is not preventing civilians from fleeing to Turkey.
Nee, volgens UNHCR verhindert Turkije niet dat burgers naar Turkije vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over het nieuws dat Turkije de man heeft vrijgelaten die in februari 2013 in Kopenhagen de Deense journalist Lars Hedegaard probeerde te vermoorden

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked why Turkey released the man who attempted to murder Danish journalist Lars Hedegaard, whether the Netherlands should protest, press Turkey to re-arrest and extradite him, and whether a country releasing terrorists belongs in NATO. The minister replied that Denmark has raised the matter with Turkey, which has promised to investigate, and that the cabinet sees no reason to raise Turkey's NATO membership.
Denmark has made inquiries about this matter, which is primarily a criminal case between Denmark and Turkey, with the Turkish authorities.
Denemarken heeft navraag gedaan over deze kwestie, die in eerste instantie een strafrechtelijke zaak is tussen Denemarken en Turkije, bij de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Omtzigt over ‘Gaza met onmiddellijke ingang onder controle van Hamas en Fatah’

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas and Fatah would jointly govern Gaza, and about whether Dutch or EU funds could reach Hamas through Palestinian Authority salaries and prisoner payments. The minister answered that there is no joint budget, that Qatari one-off payments are not salaries, that EU-funded civil servant lists are unchanged, and that the prisoner payment rules remain duration-based, with the Netherlands continuing to press for reform.
The money concerns Qatar, not the EU or the Netherlands.
Het betreft geld van Qatar, niet van de EU of NL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Servaes over misdaden van ISIS tegen Yezidi’s in Irak (nieuwe versie)

MPs Ten Broeke and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS crimes against Yezidis in Iraq, including reported killings, rape, slavery and mustard gas use, and whether the government confirms UN figures. The minister said the government has no independent information to confirm these reports, referred to UN OHCHR/UNAMI figures on killings and detention, and described the Dutch military and humanitarian contributions.
The cabinet does not have independent information that can confirm such reports.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie die dergelijke berichten kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onderzoeken naar de aanslag op de MH17

An MP asked when a progress report on the MH17 investigations would be sent, whether Ukraine would be asked to make the investigation agreement with the Dutch Safety Board public, and about the status, signing, and secrecy of the joint investigation team (JIT) agreement, including whether it contains vetoes or prosecution provisions. The ministers answered that the Safety Board's final report is expected in July 2015, that the JIT agreement is binding and signed with government knowledge but will not be published because it contains operational working arrangements, and that it is limited to the investigation phase with no prosecution arrangements.
This agreement is not public, as it concerns a document containing operational working arrangements in an ongoing criminal investigation.
Deze overeenkomst is niet openbaar, aangezien het hier een document betreft met operationele werkafspraken in een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over open sky tussen Suriname en de voormalige Nederlandse Antillen

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch government had signalled no interest in a full open-sky regime with Suriname and how the current air agreement works for flights between Schiphol and Paramaribo. The Foreign Minister answered that the existing agreement works satisfactorily, that Dutch airlines can still add two carriers per country, that the Antilles and Aruba air relations with Suriname are their own competence, and that Curaçao may conclude its own air deals.
The current air transport regime between the Netherlands and Suriname has so far been satisfactory.
Het huidige luchtvaartregime tussen Nederland en Suriname voldoet tot op heden naar tevredenheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het rapport van Human Rights Watch ‘Israël: in depth look at Gaza school attacks’ en de aankondiging van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar een aantal incidenten door het Israë

MP Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about a Human Rights Watch report finding Israeli strikes on Gaza schools lacked military purpose, were disproportionate and indiscriminate, and about Israel's criminal probes into some incidents conducted under military responsibility. The minister said the government takes the report seriously, backs an independent international investigation, and noted that Israeli military-led investigations can be acceptable if impartial and independent, with the Netherlands pressing Israel to strengthen its internal review mechanism.
The cabinet cannot yet confirm a criminal investigation into the two other attacks examined by HRW.
Het kabinet kan een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar de twee andere door HRW onderzochte aanvallen nog niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de normalisering van de diplomatieke betrekkingen met Suriname

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he had decided to restore full diplomatic relations with Suriname after speaking with his counterpart, what other reasons underlay this, and whether the Chamber would be informed of recent developments. The minister answered that Suriname agreed to the ambassador-level appointment of the current chargé d'affaires, that the Netherlands had requested agrément in December 2013, and that shared history and ties justify ambassador-level relations, and he agreed to inform the Chamber.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over het Israëlische nederzettingenbeleid

An MP asked why the Netherlands did not join five larger EU states in a formal protest against Israeli land expropriations on the West Bank. The minister replied that the Netherlands is not part of that group, that an EU statement was issued partly at Dutch instigation, and that the government condemned the expropriation publicly and through the embassy in Tel Aviv.
The Netherlands does not belong to the 'Quint' of these five larger EU member states.
Nederland behoort niet tot de «Quint» van deze vijf grotere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland inlichtingen over Toearegs verstrekt aan het Malinese leger

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch intelligence supplied to Mali's army could help it attack Tuareg groups, and whether this undermines the UN mission and mediation. The government denied sharing intelligence with the Malian army, said Dutch-gathered intelligence goes to the UN mission (MINUSMA) and that sharing with Bamako is up to the UN, and described ongoing peace negotiations.
The Netherlands does not share intelligence with the Malian army, as the article claims.
Nederland deelt geen inlichtingen met het Malinese leger, zoals in het artikel wordt gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over inlichtingenverstrekking door Nederlands leger aan leger van Mali

MP De Roon asked whether Dutch military intelligence sharing with Mali's army in its internal conflict with Tuareg insurgents, and whether the government would prevent it. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares no intelligence with the Malian army; the Dutch contribution to the UN ASIFU unit serves only MINUSMA and sharing with Mali is for the UN to decide.
The Netherlands does not share intelligence with the Malian army.
Nederland deelt geen inlichtingen met het Malinese leger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onthulling over steun Turkije aan Al Qaeda

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey supported Al Qaeda-linked groups in Syria, restricted coalition operations against IS, and tolerated IS recruitment and oil smuggling. The minister replied that the government has no indications Turkey supports jihadist groups, rejected the need for an independent international inquiry, and largely denied or deflected the allegations.
The cabinet cannot in general make statements about intelligence information.
Het kabinet kan in het algemeen geen mededelingen doen over inlichtingeninformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over 130.000 vluchtelingen naar Turkije

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about reports that Turkey had closed border crossings to Syrian refugees and whether the Netherlands would press Turkey, offer more humanitarian aid, and resettle more refugees. The minister answered that Turkey reduced crossings to two rather than closing all, described Turkish reception and registration, pointed to 30 million euro in extra aid, and said resettlement would continue in 2015 with details to follow.
To prevent further chaos, two border crossings remain open so that Turkey and UNHCR can register the refugees in a controlled manner.
Om verdere chaos te voorkomen blijven vooralsnog twee grensovergangen open zodat Turkije en UNHCR gecontroleerd de vluchtelingen kunnen registreren

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Bommel over bericht dat de Saudische blogger Raif Badawi in beroep is veroordeeld tot duizend zweepslagen, 10 jaar gevangenisstraf gevolgd door een 10-jarig uitreisverbod

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Bommel asked whether the minister is aware of the appeal sentence against blogger Raif Badawi (1,000 lashes, 10 years prison, travel ban and fine) and what steps the government will take, including public pressure on Saudi authorities and an EU statement. The minister confirmed awareness and said the government prefers to raise individual cases within the EU, noting a demarche in May 2014 and that the Netherlands will keep pressing for action to prevent enforcement.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts within the EU for new action towards the Saudi authorities to prevent enforcement of the sentence.
Nederland zal zich in EU-verband blijven inspannen voor nieuwe actie richting de Saudische autoriteiten om uitvoering van het vonnis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat elf vliegtuigen zijn verdwenen van het vliegveld van Tripoli

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether eleven aircraft had disappeared from Tripoli airport, who holds them, and what is being done to verify this, plus concerns about terror use and lawlessness in Libya. The minister answered that the government sees no reason to believe the reports are true, that Libyan and US authorities deny them, and outlined support for a UN-led political process and ceasefire.
The cabinet sees no reason to assume that the rumour about missing aircraft is correct.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om aan te nemen dat het gerucht over vermiste vliegtuigen juist zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Gambia

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about Gambia's anti-gay bill and deteriorating human rights, including whether he would raise it with Gambia, in the EU and at the UN, and the effect on EU aid. The minister answered that the bill passed parliament and awaits presidential assent, expressed concern, said the EU and the Dutch ambassador have raised it with Gambian authorities, and that Gambia will be reviewed at the UN Universal Periodic Review, with EU aid decisions to be reassessed later.
The cabinet considers that dialogue on the bill can be conducted most effectively at EU level.
Het kabinet vindt dat een dialoog over het wetsvoorstel het meest effectief in EU-verband gevoerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over de berichten ‘Werknemers pro forma tot de islam bekeerd’ en ‘werknemers bekeerd voor klus’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that Dutch workers were pro forma converted to Islam for a job in Saudi Arabia were known, and how their safety and the Saudi restrictions on non-Muslims were viewed. The minister confirmed awareness, said there were no indications the workers were at risk, declined to judge Saudi policy or the company director's stance, and said the matter would be raised in regular contacts.
The matter will be raised in the regular contacts between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands.
De kwestie zal opgebracht worden in de reguliere contacten tussen Saoedi-Arabië en Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Madlener over het bericht 'Moldaviërs halen Roemenen in'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure about reports of Dutch transport firms 'flagging out', foreign drivers, lorry parking and the sale of passports and driving licences, and whether borders should be closed to Eastern European workers. The government answered that data on flagged-out firms and job losses is unavailable, that it cannot track non-EU nationality entitlements, that enforcement is being strengthened in cooperation with the ILT and Inspectie SZW, and that closing the labour market is not a realistic option.
It is not known how many Dutch lorry drivers have lost their jobs since the labour market was opened to Romanians, Bulgarians and Poles.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs sinds de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Roemenen, Bulgaren en Polen hun baan hebben verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht «Nederland weigert eigen tolk asiel»

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about press reports that the Netherlands refused asylum to a former Dutch interpreter from Uruzgan, whose claim was rejected by Norway, and about the wider treatment of Afghan interpreters. The government answered that Norway is responsible under Dublin, that no individual circumstances justified taking over the claim, that individual talks and compensation payments to a group of 25 Afghan interpreters are under way, and that a referral route via the IND exists.
As the Chamber is aware, I am reticent about providing information on an individual case.
Als uw Kamer bekend, ben ik terughoudend met het verstrekken van informatie over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over Repatriëringsmissie MH17

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked about the MH17 repatriation mission, the joint investigation agreements with Ukraine, Belgium, Australia and Malaysia, and the scope of the local search operation in the crash area. The ministers largely answered by citing operational agreements, confidentiality requests from partner states and the separation of investigative responsibilities, while providing limited detail on search areas and maps.
The nature of such information is not suitable for disclosure.
De aard van dergelijke informatie leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over aanwezigheid van een Hezbollah-cel in Suriname

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Dino Bouterse admitted housing Hezbollah militants in Suriname and planned to arm them for attacks on the US and the Netherlands, and about measures against Hezbollah activity. The minister replied that the cabinet has no independent information confirming the reports and pointed to EU terrorist listing of Hezbollah's military wing and related criminal prohibitions.
The cabinet does not have independent information that confirms these reports.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het mogelijk plegen van genocide en andere misdrijven door de zogenoemde Islamitische staat

Omtzigt asked whether internal legal advice on possible genocide by ISIS in Iraq and Syria would be shared, and when external international-law advice was sought and what it asked. Minister Timmermans declined to release internal advice to protect policy formation, shared the external advice (received 3 September) with the House on 5 September, and explained that the ICJ Bosnia obligation to prevent genocide applies only to states able to influence the perpetrators, which the government considers not to apply to the Netherlands while still committing to prevention and aid.
The internal legal advice on this must remain confidential to allow unhindered internal policy formation.
De interne juridische adviezen hierover dienen vertrouwelijk te blijven voor een onbelemmerde interne beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de rol van Turkije in de strijd tegen de Islamitische Staat

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's role against IS, including whether Erdogan refused a rescue operation from Turkish soil, Turkey's NATO coalition membership, and alleged ties to extremist groups. The minister said the cabinet lacks independent information on the rescue, confirmed Turkey's participation, and found no evidence of Turkish support for jihadist groups.
The cabinet does not have independent information on this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Ten Broeke en Verheijen over de Sanctiewet van Curaçao

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers how the Curaçao parliament's rejection of the Kingdom sanctions law affects implementation of EU sanctions against Russia and whether a national Kingdom sanctions law (Rijkssanctiewet) is needed. The government answered that EU sanctions must apply across the Kingdom, that Aruba and Sint Maarten have adapted their rules, that work on a national law continues because Curaçao has not yet adapted its ordinance, and that Curaçao's autonomous legislative competence cannot be overridden.
The draft national sanctions law does allow each country to determine separately which parts of the law enter into force.
De concept Rijkssanctiewet voorziet overigens in de mogelijkheid om voor elk Land afzonderlijk te bepalen welke onderdelen van de wet in werking treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de stroperige gang van zaken bij een overlijden in het buitenland

The MP asked why repatriating a deceased Dutch national from Germany took a week, forcing a closed-coffin funeral, and what could be done to speed up such cases. The Minister of Foreign Affairs replied that the ministry was not involved in this case, that release of bodies is a matter for local authorities and national procedures, and that EU coordination offers no prospect of change.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was not involved in the repatriation of the body of Mr. K.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen betrokkenheid gehad bij de repatriëring van het lichaam van de heer K.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over door Israël gevangengenomen Palestijnse parlementariërs

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the deportation-style restriction of Palestinian MP Khalida Jarrar and the detention of Palestinian legislators by Israel, asking whether the government shares concern and will summon the Israeli ambassador. The minister shares concern about the military court's order placing Jarrar under supervision in Jericho without access to evidence, reports 36 PLC members in detention, and sees no reason to summon the ambassador.

The cabinet shares concern about the decision of an Israeli military court to move PLC member Khalida Jarrar to Jericho for security reasons and place her under supervision there for six months, without giving her access to the evidence.

Het kabinet deelt de zorgen over het besluit van een Israëlische militaire rechtbank om PLC-lid Khalida Jarrar vanwege veiligheidszorgen over te brengen naar Jericho en haar daar voor een periode van zes maanden onder toezicht te plaatsen, zonder haar inzage in de bewijslast te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over de dreigende veroordeling van de Tunesische mensenrechtenactiviste Héla Boujneh

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of Tunisian human rights activist Héla Boujneh, whether she was held without reasons or lawyer access, and whether the Netherlands would raise her case and send an observer to her trial. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the government is seeking facts, noted her release pending trial, committed to raising the case with his Tunisian counterpart, and said the embassy intends to send an observer, while answering the women's rights question with general praise for Tunisian reforms.
The cabinet is trying to establish the factual circumstances of Héla Boujneh's arrest.
Het kabinet tracht de feitelijke omstandigheden van Héla Boujnehs arrestatie te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Parex-bank

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asks whether the Parex bank put option with the EBRD, and related Latvian transactions, were correctly recorded under ESA95 and whether Eurostat and the EBRD should be asked to revise or disclose them. The Minister answers that the transactions were correctly recorded, refuses further Eurostat or EBRD requests, and describes existing Commission verification powers.
The EBRD has indicated that it cannot disclose further specific information.
De EBRD heeft aangegeven geen verdere specifieke informatie openbaar te kunnen maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de "mogelijke genocide in Irak en de maatregelen die Nederland verplicht is te nemen, zoals het onmiddellijk stoppen van alle jihad reizen van Nederlanders en het voornemen tot

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice whether the government's suspicion of IS genocide in Iraq obliges the Netherlands under the Genocide Convention to stop Dutch jihadist travel and criminalise it, and sought legal advice. Minister Timmermans answered that the Convention binds the Netherlands regardless of the government's qualification, that efforts to block departures are ongoing, that a bill on losing dual nationality is coming, and that external legal advice has been requested.
The cabinet refers in this regard to the answers to parliamentary questions on IS and the situation in Iraq of 11 August 2014
Het kabinet verwijst in dat verband naar de beantwoording van de Kamervragen over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak van 11 augustus 2014

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de «mogelijke genocide» in Irak en de maatregelen die Nederland verplicht is te nemen, zoals het onmiddellijk st

MP Omtzigt asks the Foreign and Justice ministers whether, after the cabinet said IS is probably responsible for genocide, Dutch treaty duties under the Genocide Convention require action such as stopping jihad travel, prosecuting nationals, and criminalising intent to travel, and asks about legal advice and a bill on nationality loss. Minister Timmermans replies by enclosing an external international-law adviser's opinion on the consequences of the cabinet's statement, which the questions had referred to.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) en Sjoerdsma (D66) aan de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het gebruik van artikel 7d van de rijkswet Goedkeuring en bekendmaking van verdragen (ingezonden 30 juli 20

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the Foreign Minister how often and when the cabinet has used article 7d of the treaty approval act since WWII, which allows secret treaties without parliamentary approval, and for the titles and texts of those treaties. The minister's follow-up answer sends a confidential overview of the notification letters under article 13(3), with copies of earlier letters, available only for members' inspection at the CIP.

As promised in my answer to the aforementioned parliamentary questions, I am sending you, for confidential inspection, an overview of the notification letters pursuant to article 13, third paragraph, of the treaty approval act.

Hierbij zend ik u zoals toegezegd in mijn antwoord op voornoemde kamervragen, ter vertrouwelijke kennisneming, een overzicht van de mededelingsbrieven overeenkomstig artikel 13, derde lid, van de rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de nog steeds niet uitgevoerde motie over het uitwisselen van informatie over in het buitenland veroordeelde zedendelinquenten, zodat ze niet in Neder

CDA MPs asked why a motion to exchange information on foreign-convicted sex offenders, so they cannot obtain a VOG and work in childcare, remains unimplemented, and whether Dutch children are adequately protected. The Minister confirmed the motion, said information exchange with non-EU countries happens only case by case, and promised an Interpol-related study and a progress report before the end of 2014, while acknowledging the VOG cannot fully exclude misuse.
in contrast to the arrangements within the EU, criminal information is not exchanged structurally with countries outside the EU
wordt in tegenstelling tot de afspraken die gelden binnen EU-verband, niet op structurele wijze strafrechtelijke informatie uitgewisseld met landen buiten de EU
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over piraterijbestrijding in de Golf van Guinee

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a US counter-piracy plan for the Gulf of Guinea, including armed private guards and convoys, and whether Dutch navy should act more in international waters. The government answered that it supports a regional, EU-coordinated approach focused on maritime capacity building, notes most attacks occur within coastal states' territorial waters, and sees no need for a more active navy role beyond existing exercises and training.
The cabinet favours a regional solution to maritime crime in the Gulf of Guinea, through regional prevention, prosecution and maritime capacity building.

Het kabinet is voorstander van een regionale oplossing voor het probleem van maritieme criminaliteit in de Golf van Guinee, door middel van regionale preventie, vervolging en maritieme capaciteitsopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over piraterijbestrijding bij Somalië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether pressuring Somali piracy protectors toward legal economic activity or destroying their landing facilities is a viable, cheaper policy. The government answered that naval missions have sharply reduced attacks, that state-building and the New Deal are the long-term answer, and that the 2012 raid on a pirate depot was a one-off with no exclusive pirate facilities remaining.
Since 2012 no ships have been hijacked.
Sinds 2012 zijn er geen schepen meer gekaapt.
