Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over zware aanklacht tegen Iraanse voorganger

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and possible death-penalty charge against Iranian pastor Matthias Haghnejad, and about the persecution of Iranian Christians and EU action on religious freedom. The minister replied that the facts of the charge are not yet known, that the government shares concern and monitors the case, and that Nederland and the EU raise religious freedom with Iran bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Universal Periodic Review, while acknowledging that individual cases are better addressed at EU level.
Nothing has been made public about the background of the charge.
Over de achtergrond van de aanklacht is niets bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over de gevolgen van de uitbraak van het ebolavirus in West-Afrika

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the spread of the Ebola outbreak in West Africa, Dutch involvement, risks to Dutch public health, screening of travellers, and the differing travel advice of the US and the Netherlands. The government answered that the risk in the Netherlands is low, that it follows WHO, RIVM and LCR advice, that entry screening is not recommended, and that it has provided funding and tightened travel advice for some affected countries.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs therefore has no view of the exact number of Dutch nationals in these countries.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft daarom geen zicht op het exacte aantal Nederlanders in deze landen.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bizarre samenstelling van de VN-onderzoekscommissie voor de recente Gaza-oorlog (ingezonden 13 augustus 2014).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the composition of a UN Human Rights Council inquiry into the 2014 Gaza war, questioning the chair's past calls for prosecution of Israeli leaders, a member's controversial remarks, and a member's withdrawal. The minister answers that the Netherlands and EU support an independent inquiry, that the appointments were made by the Council president, that the withdrawal was unfortunate, and that the government does not anticipate the findings.
The EU and the Netherlands favour an international and independent investigation into alleged violations of international humanitarian law and human rights committed by all parties involved.

De EU en Nederland zijn voorstander van een internationaal en onafhankelijk onderzoek naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht en van de mensenrechten gepleegd door alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het onaanvaardbare geweld van Israël in Gaza

Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's attacks on civilian targets in Gaza would be met with further diplomatic measures, such as summoning the ambassador, whether the government would inform parliament and consider EU Association Agreement consequences and an investigation into possible war crimes, and whether it would support Palestinian accession to the ICC. Minister Timmermans replied that diplomatic contacts had voiced serious concern without summoning the ambassador, favoured an independent investigation via existing UN mechanisms, and said only states can join the ICC and the Netherlands does not recognise Palestine.
The cabinet has chosen not to summon either Israel's or the PA's representative.
Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om de vertegenwoordiger van Israël noch die van de PA te ontbieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Leegte over investeringen van Nederlandse bedrijven in de Palestijnse gebieden

Two VVD MPs asked whether Dutch government pressure discouraged Dutch firms from investing in the Palestinian territories, and whether the government would contact a company that suspended a joint venture. The minister replied that businesses decide their own activities, the government addresses firms involved in settlement activity and provides no services for it, and it will not intervene in the individual company's decision.
However, the cabinet does not interfere in the decisions of individual companies about their economic activities.
Het kabinet treedt echter niet in de beslissingen van individuele bedrijven over hun economische activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de uitspraken van de Turkse premier Erdogan inzake het handelen van Israël in Gaza

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon) asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemned Turkish PM Erdogan's comparisons of Israel's conduct in Gaza to Hitler, whether he would summon the Turkish ambassador, seek EU support against Turkey, suspend EU accession talks, or reconsider the Patriot mission. The minister answered that the remarks were regrettable, that summoning the ambassador was unnecessary, that accession talks remain the best lever, and that the Patriot mission fulfils NATO solidarity.
The cabinet does not consider it necessary to summon the Turkish ambassador specifically for this.
Het kabinet vindt het niet nodig specifiek hiervoor de Turkse ambassadeur te ontbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie in Gaza

MP Servaes asked the government whether its view on Israeli strikes on schools and hospitals in Gaza had changed, whether it still expects Israel to respect necessity and proportionality, and how it judges US, UN and EU statements and its own contacts with Israel. The government condemned the strike on a UNRWA school, said it lacks facts for a firm judgement, called for an independent international investigation, and noted its contacts with Israeli leaders.
The cabinet does not have the necessary factual information about attacks on schools and hospitals to give a well-founded judgement on the circumstances of these attacks.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feitelijke informatie over aanvallen op scholen en ziekenhuizen om een gefundeerd oordeel te kunnen geven over de toedracht van deze aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Omtzigt, Van Haersma Buma, Voordewind, Slob en Van der Staaij over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak

Members of parliament from the CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the government about the humanitarian emergency facing Yazidis and Christians fleeing IS in Iraq, US airstrikes and genocide claims, and whether Dutch and EU action is adequate. The minister answered that the government supports US aid to Iraq, has given an extra 400,000 euro via the Red Cross, is examining airlift support through defence, and is pressing for a unity government in Baghdad.

In response to the current humanitarian crisis, the cabinet has decided to immediately provide an extra 400,000 euro via the Netherlands Red Cross to the International Red Cross for emergency aid in Iraq.

Naar aanleiding van de huidige humanitaire crisis heeft het kabinet besloten onverwijld een extra bijdrage van 400 000 Euro via het Nederlandse Rode Kruis te geven aan het Internationale Rode Kruis ten behoeve van noodhulp in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het gebruik van artikel 7d van de Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen

MPs Knops, Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked how often since WWII the cabinet has used article 7d of the treaty approval act to exempt confidential treaties from parliamentary approval, and asked for the titles and texts. Minister Timmermans answered that the provision dates from 1994, that confidential treaties were notified to parliament under confidentiality, and that a list of notification letters will be shared confidentially; titles for 1945-1994 are available online.
As usual, you will shortly be sent an overview of these notification letters for confidential inspection.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal u op korte termijn een overzicht van deze mededelingsbrieven ter vertrouwelijke kennisneming worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over het bericht dat Frankrijk hulp en opvang gaat bieden aan christenen

Two CDA MPs asked whether France's offer of aid and shelter to Christians expelled by IS from Mosul would be matched by Dutch asylum options, and what support minorities and the EU provide. The minister answered that asylum cases from IS-controlled Iraqi areas are postponed until a new country report appears in early September, while the EU and Netherlands continue supporting minorities.

Once the new country report is available, the State Secretary for Security and Justice will consider whether the information in it should lead to an adjustment of the current asylum policy regarding Iraq.

Zodra het nieuwe ambtsbericht er is, zal de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien of de informatie in het ambtsbericht tot een aanpassing moet leiden in het huidige asielbeleid ten aanzien van Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de Ebola-ziekte in West-Afrika

An MP asked the ministers about the Ebola epidemic in West Africa, including vaccine availability, international coordination, Dutch funding, travel advice and information for Dutch nationals. The minister answered that no vaccine or licensed treatment exists yet, listed WHO-led coordination and Dutch contributions of about 722,600 euro, and said travel advice was updated to refer to the outbreak.
It is correct that there is still no vaccine or effective treatment for Ebola.
Het klopt dat er nog geen vaccin of effectieve behandeling van Ebola is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de militaire dreiging door Venezuela om Aruba binnen te vallen

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about reports of a Venezuelan military threat to invade Aruba, the release of Venezuelan intelligence chief Carvajal, and Maduro's remarks about escalation, and whether defence spending should rise. The minister answered that Carvajal was released because he enjoys consular immunity under international law, that justice is autonomous for Aruba, that Maduro's remarks were noted from the media, and that further defence cuts are not advisable though any increase will be considered in budget talks.
Diplomatic and consular relations, including immunity, are powers of the Kingdom.
Diplomatieke en consulaire relaties, inclusief immuniteit, zijn bevoegdheden van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht dat de beoogde Venezolaanse consul generaal voor Aruba, Hugo Carvajal, is vrijgelaten

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hugo Carvajal, designated Venezuelan consul-general for Aruba, was released, alleged Venezuelan naval threats, and the basis for granting him immunity and declaring him persona non grata. The minister answered that the Venezuelan navy sighting was routine transit with no threats, that immunity rested on Article 13 of the Vienna Convention given Venezuela's reasonable reliance on a non-diplomatic designation note, and that persona non grata status requires no reasons.
It concerns an autonomous decision of mine that was not coordinated with the US.
Het betreft een autonoom besluit van mij dat niet is afgestemd met de VS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over de dramatisch zorgelijke situatie van christenen in Mosul

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about threats by ISIS against Christians in Mosul, how such groups can be protected, and whether a safe haven could be created and the issue raised at the UN General Assembly. The minister answered that minorities' rights are a priority, cited UN Security Council and UNAMI calls for accountability, ISIS UN sanctions, EU aid, and said a political solution in Iraq is needed, without committing to a specific new step.
Both the protection of minority rights and freedom of religion or belief are priority subjects of Dutch foreign policy.
Zowel bescherming van de rechten van minderheden als vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging zijn prioritaire onderwerpen van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de voortgang van de behandeling van de claims van weduwen van slachtoffers van standrechtelijke executies in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about delays in handling compensation claims from widows of victims of summary executions in Indonesia, including claim outcomes, deaths of claimants, evidentiary standards and inheritance of claims. The government denied deliberate delay, reported eight claims granted and ten rejected, said evidentiary requirements are less strict than in court, and referred to a separate letter for several answers.
It is incorrect that the payment of a possible compensation is being deliberately delayed.
Het is onjuist dat de uitbetaling van een mogelijke schadevergoeding wordt getraineerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de houding van geprivilegieerden t.a.v. betaling van boetes

An MP asks whether diplomats who ignore serious traffic fines should be sanctioned more effectively, including via a blacklist and fuel-card measures like those used in the United States. The minister answers that roughly half of the fines in 2012-2013 went unpaid, that Netherlands lacks jurisdiction over absolute-immunity diplomats, and that announced measures aim to encourage payment, while the US-style approach is deemed unsuitable.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has examined in detail the options for holding privileged persons to account for unacceptable conduct, without undermining the treaty obligations the Netherlands has.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft uitvoerig gekeken naar mogelijkheden om geprivilegieerden aan te spreken op onacceptabel gedrag, zonder dat daarmee afbreuk wordt gedaan aan de verdragsrechtelijke verplichtingen die Nederland heeft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over het uiten van extreme geweldsdreigementen en het plegen van daadwerkelijk terroristisch geweld tegen (de Joodse inwoners van) Israël door te

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked whether Fatah officials and affiliated groups calling for violence and firing rockets at Israel should be treated as terrorism, whether the Palestinian Authority is responsible, and whether EU and Dutch funding and cooperation should be halted. Minister Timmermans answered that these are not formal Fatah statements, that Fatah is a political movement that renounced violence, and that suspending cooperation is not on the table, while pledging to raise the issue at the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
No. Fatah is a political movement that has renounced violence.
Nee. Fatah is een politieke beweging die geweld heeft afgezworen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het rapport van United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA)

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a UNRWA report on Gaza casualties, the proportionality of Israel's response, a remark by an Israeli minister about temporarily taking over Gaza, and EU efforts toward a ceasefire. The minister confirmed the report, affirmed Israel's right to self-defence within the limits of international humanitarian law, said no Israeli takeover is currently planned, and described ongoing EU and bilateral diplomatic pressure for de-escalation.
The Netherlands recognises Israel's right to protect its citizens and territory against rocket attacks by Hamas from the Gaza Strip, subject to the limits international humanitarian law imposes.

Nederland erkent het recht van Israël om zijn eigen burgers en grondgebied te beschermen tegen raketbeschietingen van Hamas vanuit de Gaza-strook, met inachtneming van de grenzen die het oorlogsrecht hieraan stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de rakettenregen van Hamas en Fatah onder toeziend oog van de terroristische Palestijnse “eenheidsregering"

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian unity government and Fatah allowed rocket fire on Israel, whether the government condemned it, and whether all Dutch and EU financial and political support to the Palestinian government and Authority should be halted. The minister answered that the government condemns the rocket attacks, holds the technocratic government to its actions under the Quartet principles, and sees no reason to stop cooperation or funding since Hamas controls Gaza, not the new government.
On the basis of the above, the government sees no reason to stop cooperation with the Palestinian technocratic government.
Het kabinet ziet op grond van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om de samenwerking met de Palestijnse technocratische regering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Eritreërs in Nederland onder grote druk staan van de Eritrese regering

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would back Eritrean residents pressured to pay a diaspora tax, enable anonymous reporting, investigate the tax, and close the Eritrean consulate. The government answered that the tax is not illegal per se if voluntary, that anonymous reporting is possible case by case, that the issue is being pursued at EU level, and that closing the embassy is not currently on the table.
To establish abuses, the public prosecution service and police depend substantially on reports and complaints from victims.
Om misstanden vast te kunnen stellen zijn het OM en politie in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door slachtoffers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Schouw over de gevolgen van de definitieve beslissing van het Europees Comité van de Sociale Rechten (ECSR) inzake de opvang van vreemdelingen

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government has responded to the European Committee of Social Rights' final decision on a complaint about shelter for undocumented and rejected asylum seekers, and asked for the findings to be shared and for prompt measures and clarity for municipalities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the findings were sent confidentially to the Committee of Ministers and the parties, cannot be shared until the Committee of Ministers adopts a position or four months pass, and that the government is not obliged to act within four months, promising to inform the House once the Committee of Ministers has spoken.

The findings of the ECSR only become public once the Committee of Ministers has adopted a position, or four months after their transmission if the Committee of Ministers has not yet adopted a position by then.

De bevindingen van het ECSR worden pas openbaar als het Comité van Ministers een standpunt heeft ingenomen, dan wel vier maanden na toezending van de bevindingen in het geval het Comité van Ministers op dat moment nog geen standpunt heeft ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een Nederlandse topdiplomaat die steun wilde geven aan Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel seeks to declare UN envoy Robert Serry persona non grata for allegedly trying to channel aid to Hamas, and whether the Netherlands should condemn his action. The minister confirmed the media reports, explained Serry's account of a Palestinian request about paying Hamas-employed civil servants in Gaza, and said Dutch involvement was not at issue.
On the basis of the information described in the answer to questions 2 and 3, the cabinet does not consider Dutch involvement to be at issue.
Op basis van de informatie zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vragen 2 en 3 acht het kabinet Nederlandse betrokkenheid niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het mogelijk tot 'persona non grata' verklaren van de Nederlandse diplomaat Serry wegens poging tot steun aan Hamas

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch diplomat Robert Serry, UN coordinator for the Middle East peace process, attempted to arrange payment of millions of dollars to Hamas and whether Israel might declare him persona non grata. The minister answered that Serry, now a UN official, acted in a matter for the UN, that Dutch relations with Israel face no consequences, and that the government will take no further steps.
The conduct of Mr Serry is a matter for the UN.
De handelswijze van de heer Serry is een zaak voor de VN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Tanamal en Van Bommel over gevangenschap van politieke activisten in Indonesië

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about political prisoners in Indonesia, including Johan Teterissa, arrests at a 25 April demonstration, and whether the government would press for their release or transfer closer to family. The minister confirmed awareness of the cases, noted Dutch concerns raised bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and committed to raising transfers of Moluccan prisoners with Indonesia and in the EU.

At the human rights debate on 30 June it was promised that the cabinet will raise the placement of Moluccan prisoners closer to home with the Indonesian government, and that this will also be pursued at EU level.

Tijdens het nota-overleg mensenrechten op 30 juni is toegezegd dat het kabinet de plaatsing van Molukse gevangenen dichter bij huis met de Indonesische regering zal opnemen, en dat dit ook in EU-verband zal worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het Parex-schandaal in Letland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the rescue of Latvian bank Parex, alleged Russian dirty money, EBRD stakes in its successor Citadele, and lessons for Lithuania's euro entry. The government answered most questions by pointing to Latvian authorities, the Commission and the EBRD, stated that no Dutch loans or guarantees were used beyond a roughly 5% share of EU balance-of-payments aid, and declined to disclose EBRD due diligence and transaction details.
Beyond the information under questions 13 and 14, the EBRD has indicated that it cannot make further specific information public.
Buiten de informatie bij vraag 13 en14 heeft de EBRD aangegeven dat het verdere specifieke informatie niet openbaar kan maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse steun voor ISIS-strijders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports of Turkish support for ISIS fighters, and whether he would seek an international inquiry and reconsider the Dutch Patriot deployment in Turkey. The minister referred to a separate letter answering these questions (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr. 135) without restating its substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de Global Summit to End Sexual Violence in Conflict

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would attend the 2014 London summit on ending sexual violence in conflict, what steps and budget the government commits to, and whether sexual violence outside conflict is covered. The minister answered that the Netherlands will push accountability and comprehensive services, commits to existing multi-channel policy and possibly more funding, and confirms that policy covers sexual violence outside conflict as well.
At the Global Summit to End Sexual Violence in Conflict, the Netherlands mainly pushed for accountability for sexual violence as a weapon of war.
Nederland heeft tijdens de Global Summit to End Sexual Violence in Conflict Nederland vooral ingezet op het belang van accountability voor de misdaad van seksueel geweld als oorlogswapen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Servaes, Van Ojik over de Egyptische strafeis tegen een Nederlandse journaliste

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Egypt seeking maximum prison terms against about 20 journalists, including Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether Egypt kept its promise of a fair trial. The minister answered that the Netjes sentence of ten years in absentia is not a fair process, that the Netherlands raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and referred to a separate letter for further measures.
The Netherlands informed the Egyptian authorities that it deeply regrets that, due to the course of events in Egypt, Ms. Netjes is denied the possibility of returning safely and doing her work there.
Nederland heeft de Egyptische autoriteiten geïnformeerd dat het zeer betreurt dat mw. Netjes door de gang van zaken in Egypte de mogelijkheid wordt ontzegd om veilig te kunnen terugkeren

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de aangenomen motie Omtzigt (Kamerstuk 33 750 V, nr. 30) over informatie over veroordelingen van Nederlanders voor zedendelicten in het buitenland

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked about information exchange on Dutch nationals convicted of sex offences abroad, which can allow them to obtain a VOG and work with children. The government explains that EU exchange works under treaties and ECRIS, while information exchange with non-EU countries occurs only case by case, with Thailand approached and an Interpol-based approach being explored.
It is not separately recorded in how many cases a VOG was refused to a person with a Dutch passport for a sex offence conviction abroad.
Er wordt niet apart geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen de VOG is geweigerd aan iemand met een Nederlands paspoort voor een veroordeling voor een zedendelict in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de strafeis tegen de Nederlandse journalist Rena Netjes

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister to confirm the heavy prison sentences sought against 20 journalists in Egypt, including the Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether the government would seek clarification from Egyptian authorities and whether fair trials are possible in Egypt. The minister confirmed maximum sentences were requested, reported that Netjes was sentenced in absentia to ten years, described diplomatic steps taken including summoning the Egyptian ambassador, and expressed serious concern about Egyptian judicial developments.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about various negative developments in Egyptian judicial practice.
Het kabinet maakt zich grote zorgen over diverse negatieve ontwikkelingen in de Egyptische rechtspraak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Baay-Timmerman over het stoppen met de paspoortuitgifte bij consulaten

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Baay-Timmerman ask why the government is phasing out passport issuance at consulates before informing parliament and before 2016, and demand a cost-benefit analysis and a halt to the process. The Minister replies that biometric passport services at honorary consulates are being phased out for cost and efficiency reasons, that the consulate-general plans are still in draft and parliament will be informed later, and that he will provide the cost-benefit analysis in that letter.
The cost-benefit analysis of phasing out consular services at the consulates-general will be made after the action plans are assessed and included in the letter promised to your House.

De kosten-baten analyse bij afbouw van de consulaire dienstverlening bij de consulaten generaal zal na beoordeling van de plannen van aanpak gemaakt worden en verwerkt in de aan uw Kamer toegezegde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Servaes over de repressie die zou zijn ingezet tegen straatkinderen in Rio de Janeiro in de aanloop naar het WK voetbal en de Olympische Spelen

MPs Omtzigt and Servaes asked the government about alleged repression of street children in Rio de Janeiro ahead of the World Cup and Olympics, including reports of unlawful detention, child killings and disappearances, and whether Brazilian authorities withheld information. The Minister answered that the government does not see a systematic repression strategy or systematic child-rights violations, that the cited IBGE report could not be verified, that no Brazilian data was found to have been deleted, and that no international investigation is warranted, while committing to raise human rights bilaterally, supporting NGOs, and pursuing sport-federation human rights clauses.
The Cabinet currently sees no reason for an international investigation, because the Brazilian government recognises the problem
Het Kabinet ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een internationaal onderzoek, omdat de Braziliaanse regering de problematiek onderkent

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Nederlandse bedrijven indirect betrokken zijn bij schendingen van de arbeidsrechten bij de bouw van faciliteiten voor het WK 2022 in Qa

MPs asked whether Dutch banks, pension funds and companies invest in firms accused of labour rights abuses in building Qatar's 2022 World Cup facilities, and what the government will do about it. The government said it lacks such investment data, will raise labour rights in the ILO and OECD frameworks and with Qatar, and reported on sports-human rights steps.
The government does not have this kind of information and therefore cannot make statements about it.
De regering beschikt niet over dit soort informatie en kan derhalve geen uitspraken hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Amerikaanse militaire activiteiten in Mali

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reported US training of Malian commandos, US support to French forces, US drone use and funding for counterterrorism in the Sahel, and whether MINUSMA and EUTM are affected. The government said it had no information on the reported secret US training, that MINUSMA and EUTM do not train special counterterrorism units, declined to comment on other countries' operations, and promised only the usual biannual parliamentary reporting.
The cabinet does not make statements about such activities of other countries.
Over dergelijke activiteiten van andere landen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat Slowakije het homohuwelijk uitsluit

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Slovakia constitutionally defining marriage as between a man and a woman and whether the Netherlands would respond. The minister called it a disappointment, said the government would raise concerns with Slovakia's foreign minister, and noted that marriage law is a member-state competence.
Are you willing to address the Slovak government about the constitutional amendment and convey your disapproval to them?
Vraag 4 Bent u bereid de Slowaakse regering aan te spreken op de grondwetswijziging en uw afkeuring hierover bij de Slowaakse regering kenbaar te maken?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers, Dijkgraaf, Van Bommel en De Roon over het bericht ‘Verboden vlag overschaduwt Veteranendag’

MPs from several parties asked whether veterans were barred from carrying the Morgenster flag at the National Veterans Day parade because of sensitivities with Indonesia, and whether the government had raised the matter with Indonesian authorities. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regimental flags at the formal parade, a rule agreed with veterans' associations and not a ban, that Indonesia had objected in past years without the committee being pressured, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The committee discussed this with the veterans' associations and they agreed to it.
Het comité heeft dit met de veteranenverenigingen besproken en zij hebben hiermee ingestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vernietiging van 1500 fruitbomen door de Israëlische autoriteiten bij de “Tent of Nations” boerderij in de omgeving van Bethlehem

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the destruction of 1,500 fruit trees at the Tent of Nations farm near Bethlehem, whether Israeli courts had a pending appeal, and about Area C land use and Israeli policy. The minister said the conflicting claims on ownership and legality could not be resolved by the cabinet and that local authorities must decide, while describing the wider Area C situation and international law concerns about settlements and house demolitions.
Because of the conflicting information and accounts, it is not possible for the cabinet to determine which party is right regarding the property rights and the legality of uprooting the trees.

Door de conflicterende informatie en lezingen is het voor het kabinet niet mogelijk een afweging te maken welke partij in het gelijk staat wat betreft de eigendomsrechten en de wetmatigheid van de ontworteling van de bomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ISIS en Jabhat Al Nusra als terroristische organisaties

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's list of suspected jihadists, Turkey's position on Jabhat al-Nusra and ISIS as terrorist organisations, EU and Dutch implementation of UN sanctions, prosecution of Dutch fighters, and financing and arms flows. The minister answered largely on substance, confirming Turkey's asset freeze and sanctions implementation while declining to confirm the intelligence list and deferring prosecution matters to the public prosecutor.
No public statements can be made about which information is shared with which organisations.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen in het openbaar gedaan worden over de vraag met welke organisaties welke informatie gedeeld wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de stand van zaken in Irak en de opmars van ISIS

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about returned Syria jihadists, recruiters, terror financing, mosque closures and denaturalisation/detention of returnees. The government answered that about thirty returnees are known, that operational details and locations are not disclosed, that prosecutors and services monitor them, and that mosque closure and nationality revocation are possible under specific legal conditions.
Operational matters and specific cases cannot be disclosed publicly.
Over operationele aangelegenheden en concrete gevallen kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat het mestbeleid een koude douche voor boeren is

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a press report that manure policy is a cold shower for farmers, questioning whether the cabinet ignores business input, why LTO's proposals on the fifth Nitrates Action Programme were not adopted, the status of equivalent-measures and phosphate-chain agreements, and whether negotiation documents with the European Commission on the derogation will be shared. The State Secretary largely defended the process, refused to release negotiation documents and departmental involvement details, and acknowledged that communication on the phosphate-fertiliser ban could have been better, without offering an apology.
I will not make available any documents relating to the course of the negotiations with the European Commission.
Ik zal geen documenten ter beschikking stellen die betrekking hebben op het verloop van de onderhandeling met de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de Saoedische handelsmaatregelen tegen Nederland

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi trade sanctions against the Netherlands, including effects on Dutch firms, the handling of the dispute, human rights and whether an apology should be avoided. The minister answered that no confirmed measures had been received, that firms face varying problems, that a senior delegation and ministerial contacts are ongoing, and that dialogue on human rights continues.
The cabinet is doing everything it can to remove the concerns of Dutch business.
Het kabinet doet er alles aan om de zorgen van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Baay-Timmerman over de sluiting van het honorair-consulaat in de Spaanse provincie La Nuncia per 1 september 2014

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Baay-Timmerman asked why the honorary consulate in La Nucia (Spain) would lose its passport and visa functions from 1 September 2014, whether the minister had promised to wait until 2016, and whether a cost-benefit analysis was made. The minister replied that the change is part of budget cuts and the network modernisation, that the consulate remains available for emergencies, that the 2016 timeline still applies, and that the chosen cuts will not be reversed.
A cost-benefit analysis was made for the honorary consulates with biometric equipment.
Er is een kosten/baten analyse gemaakt voor de honoraire consulaten met biometrische apparatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over seksueel geweld tegen (Dalit) vrouwen in India

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would raise caste discrimination and impunity for sexual violence against Dalit women in India and Bangladesh at UN forums, co-sponsor a side event, and raise the issue bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness and past discussions, noted India's announced zero-tolerance policy and Dutch UN resolution work, but declined to co-sponsor the side event and could not answer before the deadline.
To increase the effectiveness of this event it is important that not only European countries co-sponsor it, but especially countries from other parts of the world.
Om de effectiviteit van dit evenement te vergroten is het van belang dat niet alleen Europese landen dit evenement co-sponsoren», maar juist ook landen uit andere delen van de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het faillissement van het bedrijf Thermphos en de rol van de Nederlandse en Europese overheid daarin

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the Thermphos bankruptcy, including the Dutch abstention on the EU anti-dumping decision on Kazakh white phosphorus, whether the government foresaw the costs, and whether compensation or EU budget funds were pursued. The minister answered that the Netherlands abstained, that no causal link between the lack of duties and the bankruptcy was demonstrated, that the government actively sought a buyer and a green restart, and that no compensation was pursued.
The Netherlands abstained from voting, as did Spain, France and Hungary.
Nederland heeft zich onthouden van stemming, evenals Spanje, Frankrijk en Hongarije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Hamas die toetreedt tot de Palestijnse regering

An MP asked whether Hamas was joining the Palestinian Fatah-led government and whether Dutch aid to the Palestinian Territories should be cut as a result. The minister denied that Hamas had joined, described the government as technocratic and unaffiliated, and said the cabinet would judge it on its actions without expressing outrage.
No. Hamas has not joined the Palestinian government.
Nee. Hamas is niet toegetreden tot de Palestijnse regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Omtzigt, Van Bommel over de vernietiging van 64 kerken in de Chinese provincie Zhejiang

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 64 churches in China's Zhejiang province were demolished or stripped of Christian elements under a demolition campaign, and whether central authorities back it. The minister confirmed the reports, said the campaign targets illegal buildings and anti-corruption, and said Dutch concerns on religious freedom are raised bilaterally and via the EU.
The Netherlands will continue to raise this worrying development both bilaterally and through the EU.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als via de EU aandacht blijven vragen voor deze zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht “Israël schoot schooljongens dood”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that Israeli forces shot two schoolboys dead, whether an independent investigation should follow, whether this fits a wider pattern of excessive force by Israeli security forces, and whether he would raise concerns with Israel and the EU. The minister confirmed awareness, called for thorough investigation, noted Israel's announced inquiry, said the government watches a rise in violent incidents with concern, and that the Netherlands regularly urges Israel to improve its internal military investigation mechanism.

The cabinet will, together with EU partners, continue to closely follow this issue and keep holding Israel to its international legal obligations on the use of force and on investigating its own military conduct.

Het kabinet zal, samen met EU-partners, dit onderwerp nauw blijven volgen en Israël blijven aanspreken op zijn internationaalrechtelijke verplichtingen bij het gebruik van geweld en het onderzoeken van het eigen militair handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de gevolgen van het sluiten van het consulaat te Atlanta

The MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister about objections to closing the Atlanta consulate, including the economic damage compared with the savings, and which other US consulates face closure. The minister answers that the honorary consulate will not be closed, but its biometric visa and passport processing will be phased out by 1 January 2016 as part of a wider modernisation and budget cut affecting 37 honorary consulates in 12 countries, and that no US consulates will close.
The honorary consulate in Atlanta will not be closed.
Het honorair consulaat in Atlanta zal niet worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over Turk veroordeeld wegens 'Allah' in twitternaam

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about a Turkish Twitter user sentenced to fifteen months for using the word 'Allah' in his username, whether this shows Turkey is not Western and should never join the EU, why Turkey receives nearly 1 billion euro in EU pre-accession aid, and when the government will veto accession talks. The minister acknowledges serious rule-of-law and free-expression shortcomings in Turkey, defends accession negotiations as the best lever for reform, notes IPA aid can be adjusted on merit, and declines to halt the talks.
The cabinet is of the view that accession negotiations are the best way to encourage Turkey to reform to European standards.
Het kabinet is van mening dat toetredingsonderhandelingen de beste manier vormen om Turkije aan te sporen te hervormen naar Europese maatstaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het het bericht “UN backlash as Uganda’s ‘anti-gay’ minister heads for human rights top job”?

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the candidacy of Uganda's foreign minister Sam Kutesa, who opposes LGBT rights, for President of the UN General Assembly, and what tools Netherlands and the EU have to influence it. The minister condemned Uganda's LGBT policy but said national policy does not bind the Assembly president, that Kutesa pledged to respect non-discrimination, and that NL and the EU have no instruments beyond stating principles.
The cabinet nevertheless assumes that Uganda's national policy on this matter has no influence on Mr Kutesa's exercise of the office of President of the General Assembly.
Het kabinet gaat er evenwel vanuit dat het nationale, Oegandese beleid terzake geen invloed heeft op de uitoefening van de functie van Voorzitter van de Algemene Vergadering door de heer Kutesa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over het bombarderen van een ziekenhuis in het Nuba gebergte in Soedan

Two CDA MPs asked the government about an alleged bombing of the only hospital in the Nuba Mountains in Sudan, the EU/UN response, Dutch private-sector trade promotion in Sudan, and a visit by Sudanese officials to Europe, and whether the government would raise the bombing with them. The government answered by referring to an earlier letter on the political situation in Sudan, without substantive answers to the individual questions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de transparantie van Raadsdocumenten

Pechtold (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about the leaked Council secretariat paper on implementing the Access Info Europe ruling on how Council documents are drafted, including whether Member State positions should be named. Minister Timmermans answered that the ruling is clear and is being applied, that the Council reached a compromise in line with it, and that no further Council-level discussion will take place.
The Court ruling is clear and it is being followed up in practice.
De Hofuitspraak is duidelijk en er wordt in de praktijk opvolging aan gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mogelijke doodstraf na bekering tot het christendom

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence imposed on a Sudanese woman for converting to Christianity, and whether Dutch aid to Sudan should be halted. The government condemned the verdict, summoned the Sudanese ambassador, pursued EU action and noted that Dutch bilateral aid ended in 2011, with remaining humanitarian and NGO funding not to be stopped now.
The Netherlands will closely follow the case and, depending on the progress of the legal proceedings, consider with EU partners what further measures can be taken.
Nederland zal de zaak nauw blijven volgen en, afhankelijk van het verloop van de rechtsgang, samen met EU-partners bezien welke verdere maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de doodstraf voor een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the government about the death sentence imposed on a pregnant Christian woman in Sudan for refusing to return to Islam, including protests, possible sanctions and Sudan's debt relief. The minister answered that the Sudanese ambassador was summoned, the verdict was condemned, an appeal is pending, the EU was engaged, no documented overview of recent anti-Christian incidents exists, and debt relief is conditional on proven progress.
The cabinet had the Sudanese ambassador summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Het kabinet heeft de Sudanese ambassadeur laten ontbieden op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het bericht dat Suriname van de Toescheidingsovereenkomst af wil

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views Suriname's wish to terminate the Treaty on Dual Nationality (Toescheidingsovereenkomst), whether talks are ongoing, and whether the Netherlands would go to the International Court of Justice if Suriname unilaterally set the treaty aside. The minister replied that unilateral termination is not possible under treaty law, that the Netherlands opposes ending the treaty while the rights of certain Surinamese-Dutch are not adequately safeguarded, that talks have stalled since 2010, and that the treaty's main goal of settling nationality has been achieved, so recourse to the ICJ is not currently warranted.
Unilateral termination of the Treaty on Dual Nationality (TO) is not possible under treaty law.
Eenzijdige opzegging van de Toescheidingsovereenkomst (hierna: TO) is verdragsrechtelijk niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voortgaande subsidiëring van anti-Israël organisaties

An MP asked whether Dutch taxpayer money funds Palestinian NGOs (Badil, Addameer, Al-Haq) via the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat, and whether an investigation or measures to stop such funding are planned. The minister answered that the funding supports rights monitoring, that the Secretariat has strict selection and suspension procedures, and that no investigation or additional measures are considered necessary.
On the basis of the above, the cabinet sees no reason to take additional measures.
Het kabinet ziet op grond van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over verlenging van het mandaat van VN-missie MINURSO (Missie van de VN voor het Referendum in de Westelijke Sahara)

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether human rights monitoring should be added to the MINURSO mandate in Western Sahara, and what the Netherlands would do bilaterally or within the EU. The minister answered that monitoring is sensitive, the Security Council lacks support for it, human rights paragraphs were added instead, and that the EU and Morocco's national human rights commission cover monitoring.
The Netherlands will continue to discuss the Western Sahara issue with various European partners.
Nederland blijft de kwestie Westelijke Sahara met verschillende Europese partners bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over religieuze spanningen in Birma/Myanmar

An MP asked the foreign minister about the exclusion of the Rohingya from Myanmar's census, the violence against them, aid access in Rakhine, and whether the Netherlands should strengthen human rights capacity in Myanmar. The minister condemned the census exclusion, described Dutch diplomatic efforts on aid access, and argued that current human rights capacity, including the new Yangon office, is adequate.
The cabinet currently considers the human rights capacity with regard to Myanmar sufficient.
Het kabinet acht de huidige mensenrechtencapaciteit met betrekking tot Birma/Myanmar op dit moment toereikend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Segers en Dijkgraaf over het rapport “The European Union Integrity System” van Transparency International

MPs Omtzigt, Segers and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would act on Transparency International's report on EU integrity gaps (openness and corruption) and its 12 recommendations, whether it would raise the report at the European Council, and who should check EU institutions on rule of law. The minister said the government supports follow-up on transparency and anti-corruption measures in Council and EU fora, but declined to put the report on the European Council agenda, and stated the EU's rule-of-law oversight is shared with member states.
The cabinet attaches importance to the greatest possible transparency regarding European legislative and decision-making processes.
Het kabinet hecht aan een zo groot mogelijke transparantie ten aanzien van Europese wetgevings- en besluitvormingsprocessen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over in Brunei Darussalam ingevoerde wetgeving

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister for his judgement on Brunei's new Syariah Penal Code, which allows stoning, whipping and amputation, and whether he shares Amnesty's concerns. The minister shared concern, said the EU broadly shares Dutch concerns, and said the EU will await implementing provisions before deciding further.
There is agreement not to initial the agreement until the human rights situation, and in particular the implementation of the SPC provisions, has been reassessed by the EU.

Er bestaat overeenstemming niet tot parafering over te gaan alvorens de mensenrechtensituatie en in het bijzonder de uitwerking van de invoeringsbepalingen van de SPC door de EU opnieuw zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse weigering om slachtoffers van Turkse invasie op Cyprus te compenseren

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's reported refusal to pay the 90 million euro ECHR compensation to Greek Cypriot victims of the 1974 invasion and how to press Turkey to comply. The minister replied that ECtHR judgments are binding, the cabinet expects Turkey to comply, and the execution will be placed on the Council of Europe Committee of Ministers agenda where the Netherlands will push for compliance.
Now that the Court's judgment is in place, its execution will be placed on the agenda of the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe.
Nu de uitspraak van het Hof er ligt, zal de tenuitvoerlegging daarvan worden geagendeerd in het Comité van Ministers van de Raad van Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether the Ministry of Defence should stop using live animals in military medical training, given available simulators and EU rules, and why it allegedly told PETA US otherwise. The minister acknowledged live-animal training remains mandatory for trauma surgeons and anaesthetists (DSTC/DATC courses) with no alternative, denied a breach of Dutch law, and admitted the 2011 statement to PETA was inaccurate.
This information is not known to me. There are no international agreements or obligations regarding such reporting, and in practice this information is also not exchanged.
Deze informatie is mij niet bekend. Er zijn geen internationale afspraken of verplichtingen inzake dergelijke rapportages en ook in de praktijk wordt deze informatie niet uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de onhoudbaarheid van Joods leven in Europa

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports on rising antisemitism in Europe, Jewish fear of displaying identity, and what the government would do at European level. The minister answered that antisemitism is unacceptable and concerning, distinguished the EJC and FRA reports, declined to confirm some claims, and pointed to existing human rights policy without committing to a new concrete step.
Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of the Dutch human rights policy.
Vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging is één van de prioriteiten van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Klaveren over de invoering van de sharia in Brunei

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Sharia criminal law taking effect in Brunei applies to non-Muslims, how many Dutch nationals are there, and what measures will protect them. The minister confirmed the first phase took effect 30 April 2014, said the law reaches non-Muslim residents and foreigners though some provisions apply only to Muslims, and promised monitoring with EU embassies and advice to Dutch citizens.

In close contact with EU member state embassies established in Brunei Darussalam and the international business community there, how the introduction and enforcement of the new legislation develops will be assessed.

In nauw contact met de in Brunei Darussalam gevestigde ambassades van EU-lidstaten en het daar gevestigde internationale bedrijfsleven zal worden beoordeeld hoe de invoering en handhaving van de nieuwe wetgeving zich zal ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de arrestatie van een Brits politicus wegens het citeren van Winston Churchill

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of a British politician for quoting Churchill on Islam violates free speech, whether the UK should be pressed to drop charges, and how the Netherlands will defend free expression internationally. The minister answered that free speech limits are for an independent court to judge, that the Dutch government has no grounds to contact UK authorities, and that free expression is already a priority in Dutch human rights policy.
It is for an independent judge to determine whether the limits of freedom of expression have been exceeded in this case.
Het is aan een onafhankelijke rechter om vast te stellen of de grenzen van de vrijheid van meningsuiting in dit geval zijn overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat de plaatsvervangend Secretaris-Generaal van de Navo Rusland tot tegenstander verklaarde

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about a report that NATO's deputy Secretary General called Russia an adversary, asking on what basis, who authorised it, and whether NATO would retract it. The minister replied that the deputy SG spoke only in his personal capacity, that the government does not know the basis for his view, and that NATO is discussing the longer-term future of the Russia relationship rather than retracting the remark.
Deputy SG NATO Vershbow did not speak on behalf of the Alliance; he gave his own opinion.
Plv. SG NAVO Vershbow heeft niet namens het Bondgenootschap gesproken; hij heeft zijn eigen mening gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Na weken van desinteresse wil de wereld dat Nigeriaanse meisjes thuis komen'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister how the government responds to the abduction of Nigerian schoolgirls, whether the Netherlands and the EU offer search support, whether the abduction counts as terrorism, and whether Boko Haram should be listed on the EU terrorism list. The minister answered that the government is concerned, offered help if Nigeria requests it, said the EU urged release and prosecution, and confirmed the Netherlands again pressed for listing Boko Haram.
At the Foreign Affairs Council of 12 May 2014, the Netherlands again argued for listing Boko Haram on the European terrorist list.
Nederland heeft tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van 12 mei 2014 opnieuw gepleit voor het opnemen van Boko Haram op de Europese terreurlijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de extra miljoenen voor de EU en ontwikkelingshulp

An MP asked whether the national net contribution to the EU and development aid would rise due to a revised national accounts methodology, and how this affects lastenverlichting. The ministers answered that the effect cannot yet be quantified, that information will follow in the Voorjaarsnota and Miljoenennota 2015, and that they do not share the view that the money should go to tax relief at home.
The cabinet will inform the House in the Voorjaarsnota about changes in this budget year to EU contributions compared with the Miljoenennota 2014.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer in de Voorjaarsnota informeren over wijzigingen die zich dit begrotingsjaar in de EU-afdrachten voordoen ten opzichte van de Miljoenennota 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over door Israël vernielde gebouwen in Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the government whether Israel demolished three EU-co-funded buildings in Palestinian territory, whether fifteen more are threatened, and whether Israel should compensate the EU and the government should demand compensation. The government confirmed the facts, said the EU Commission is in talks with Israel and Israel refuses compensation as the demolitions are legal, and that the Netherlands will keep raising demolitions in area C with Israel.
The Netherlands also continues to hold the Israeli government to account for demolishing property in area C.
Ook Nederland blijft de Israëlische regering aanspreken op het slopen van onroerend goed in area C.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Roon over misdrijven plegende Afghaanse diplomaat en de uitzending van PowNews d.d. 17 april 2014

Parliamentarians Helder and De Roon asked why an Afghan diplomat who assaulted and damaged property was only reprimanded, not expelled, waived immunity or prosecuted, and what was done about his parking abuse and diplomatic plates. The government answered that the diplomat's conduct was unacceptable but did not warrant expulsion, that Nederland cannot waive or prosecute under absolute immunity, and that a New York-style plate revocation was studied and rejected for legal and practical reasons.
In this case the diplomat's conduct was indeed completely unacceptable, but it did not qualify for such a visible and politically charged sanction.
In dit geval was het gedrag van de betreffende diplomaat weliswaar volstrekt onacceptabel, maar kwalificeerde het niet voor het treffen van een dergelijke zichtbare en politiek beladen sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht “Diplomaat slaat er bij ruzie op los en gaat vrij uit”

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the case of an Afghan diplomat who assaulted a Dutch citizen and damaged his car, and who was not prosecuted due to diplomatic immunity. The minister answered that the Afghan embassy was summoned and told the conduct was unacceptable and damages were owed, but declined to disclose the full report and said no tax-pass blocking had yet occurred.
To date, no fuel cards have yet been blocked.
Tot heden zijn er nog geen tankpassen geblokkeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het stelen van honden in Roemenië

An MP asked the government about reports that a Dutch dog shelter in Romania was looted, whether Romanian authorities reward killing stray dogs, and whether EU funds are used and what action will be taken. The government said it had no evidence of killing bounties beyond small local payments and some municipal fees, called the case regrettable, and said it will raise concerns about local enforcement with its Romanian counterpart.
I will therefore share my concerns about the implementation of Romanian legislation at local level with my Romanian colleague on the margins of the Agriculture and Fisheries Council.
Ik zal daarom mijn zorgen over de uitvoering van de Roemeense wetgeving op lokaal niveau en marge van de Landbouw- en Visserijraad delen met mijn Roemeense collega.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de uitkomsten van de Nederlandse ‘subsidiariteitsexercitie’

An MP from D66 asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the Dutch 'subsidiarity exercise' yielded real results, citing press criticism that only a handful of the 54 action points succeeded, and whether the government's promises of a more focused EU were kept. The minister replied that results are still being negotiated, that the aim is a lasting change in EU behaviour, and that the government does not consider the outcome meagre.
The aim is a lasting change in behaviour. This is not something that happens overnight.
Het doel is een blijvende gedragsverandering. Dit is niet iets dat van de ene op de andere dag tot stand komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over concurrentie tussen verschillende VN-instanties

An MP asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about overlapping mandates and competition between UN agencies in humanitarian response, prompted by a press article. The minister acknowledged overlapping mandates and coordination difficulties, stated that existing agreements and OCHA coordination are adequate, and described reforms and Dutch funding for the Central African Republic without committing to new concrete measures.
I am of the view that the UN has an adequately organised system for humanitarian aid.
Ik ben van mening dat de VN een adequaat ingericht systeem heeft voor humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een incident met VN-gezant Serry in Jeruzalem

An MP asked the foreign minister about a reported incident in which UN envoy Robert Serry was delayed and denied access at Easter 2014 in Jerusalem, and whether religious freedom was at stake and how Israeli justifications were judged. The minister confirmed awareness, said Serry's account is known but not endorsed by Israeli authorities, and stated that access improved compared with the previous year while parties still disagree on further access for Palestinian Christians.
Consultation before the Easter festival between the Christian communities and the Israeli police led to improved access compared with last year.
Overleg voorafgaand aan het Paasfeest tussen de Christelijke gemeenschappen en de Israëlische politie heeft tot een verbeterde toegang ten opzichte van vorig jaar geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over het bericht dat landbouwgeld nog steeds naar sportclubs, kerken en golfbanen gaat

MPs Pechtold and Schouw asked whether EU agricultural subsidies still reach sports clubs, churches and golf courses, and whether the government will ensure spending is limited to farmers. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the 2014-2020 rural development programme aims at farmers, while LEADER and some cooperation measures may reach non-farmers, and that the Netherlands will not oppose member states choosing to fund non-farmers within EU rules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over een VN-onderzoek naar gifgasaanvallen in Syrië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a UN/OPCW fact-finding mission into alleged chlorine gas attacks in Syria and whether accountability and consequences would follow. The minister confirmed the mission departed on 1 May, said chlorine is not a scheduled chemical but its use as a weapon would breach humanitarian law, and committed to informing parliament of any consequences.
Your House will be informed if such or other consequences of the use of chemical weapons arise.
Uw Kamer wordt geïnformeerd indien dergelijke of andere gevolgen van de inzet van chemische wapens optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over  afspraken over bezoeken van buitenlandse delegaties

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Chinese security screens that blocked protesters from view during Xi Jinping's Amsterdam visit, and whether foreign security details may hold special powers or immunity in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Dutch state is responsible for security, foreign security staff have no powers, foreign official missions enjoy immunity under customary law, and that permitting demonstrations is primarily a local matter.
The Dutch State is responsible for the security of foreign delegations and takes all necessary measures to this end.
Antwoord 4 en 5 De Nederlandse Staat is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van buitenlandse delegaties en treft hiertoe alle benodigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over de ter dood veroordeling van een Pakistaanse christen

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence imposed in Pakistan on a Christian for alleged blasphemy, the causes of the case, the situation of Christian minorities and the government's response. The minister answered that blasphemy laws are prone to misuse, that the case is under appeal, and that the Netherlands raises the issue through quiet diplomacy in bilateral and multilateral channels.
The Netherlands will, both within the EU and UN framework and bilaterally, continue to raise the position of religious minorities with the Pakistani authorities.
Nederland zal, zowel in EU- en VN-verband als bilateraal, bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht voor de positie van religieuze minderheden blijven vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over het bericht dat voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel bij terugkeer in Guinee geen enkele opvang beschikbaar is

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked about reports that Guinean trafficking victims returning from the Netherlands would find no shelter, and whether deportations should be suspended. State Secretary Teeven replied that the trafficking residence scheme and asylum rules offer adequate safeguards, that a general Guinea country report will address FGM and vulnerable women and minors, and that deportation will not be suspended since minors are not returned without adequate reception.
Yes, I am willing to examine the possibilities.
Ja, ik ben bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over CG Osaka

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the NFIA figures showing 15 Japanese investment projects creating 673 jobs in 2013, and whether the Osaka consulate could stay open in reduced form given the economic importance of Japan. The minister confirmed the figures, said the size of an economy need not match the number of posts, and stated that a halved structural cut to the post network would allow Osaka to remain open in slimmed-down form focused on investment promotion.

With a halving of the structural cut to the post network and continuation of the planned savings, it is possible to keep the Osaka consulate open in slimmed-down form, focused on investment promotion.

Met een halvering van de structurele korting op het postennet en bij voortzetting van de voorgenomen besparingen is het mogelijk CG Osaka in afgeslankte vorm, toegespitst op investeringsbevordering, open te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over moderne antitankwapens in handen van Syrische rebellen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Syrian rebels obtained US-made TOW anti-tank missiles, and whether the US could be asked about supply, onward transfer notifications, and assurances of use. The minister confirmed the reported use by the Hazm Brigade, said the supplier is unknown, that the US gave no detail on specific deliveries, and that assurances cannot be given.
The US also did not make available more detail on specific deliveries to specific groups, even when asked.
Meer detail over specifieke leveranties aan specifieke groeperingen heeft de VS ook bij navraag niet beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het aftreden van de regering in Mali

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the resignation of Mali's government, its effect on the northern reconciliation talks, and the impact of the UN mission MINUSMA. The minister explained the reshuffle as routine after elections, described the negotiations as slow, and said the mission's impact is growing but harder to make visible.
The cabinet has no data on increased prostitution in Mali.
Het kabinet zijn geen gegevens bekend over toegenomen prostitutie in Mali.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een nieuwe nederzetting in Hebron

SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about a new Israeli settlement in Hebron at the Al-Rajabi building, including whether settlers' occupation breaches Israeli law and what the Netherlands and the EU will do to prevent it. The minister confirmed that Israeli defence approval was given and that three Jewish families moved in, expressed serious concern, said the Netherlands raised the issue bilaterally and pushed for an EU statement, but did not commit to a specific new step beyond that.
Defence Minister Ya'alon gave permission on 13 April for settlers to occupy the building, after which three Jewish families moved in.
Minister Ya’alon van Defensie heeft op 13 april jl. toestemming gegeven voor het betrekken van het gebouw door kolonisten, waarna drie Joodse families zich er hebben gevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Turkije betrokken is bij onder andere steun aan Syrische rebellen

An MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that Turkey supplies Syrian rebels, supports Al Nusra and was linked to the Ghouta sarin attack, and asked whether Turkey would be questioned and whether Dutch intelligence had information. The Minister answered that the government cannot independently assess the allegations, denied none of the claims could be verified, said talks with Turkey continue, and declined to share intelligence exchanges.
No public statement can be made about the sharing of information between intelligence services.
Over het delen van informatie tussen de inlichtingendiensten kan in het openbaar geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over Blokkade Turkije YouTube

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's blocking of Twitter and YouTube, whether the EU has tools to respond, and whether a country blocking such sites can join the EU. The minister says the government is concerned, welcomes the lifting of the Twitter block after a Turkish constitutional court ruling, reports EU and Dutch critical dialogue with Turkey, and states that the blocks conflict with the Copenhagen criteria.
The cabinet is concerned about the decision to block access to Twitter and YouTube.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over het besluit om toegang tot Twitter en YouTube af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen vann de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de voorwaarden voor het laten overkomen van gezinnen naar Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the criteria for exempting nationalities from the provisional residence permit requirement, and about the availability and telephone-based administration of the Dutch language test abroad. The government answered that exemptions rest on old agreements (South Korea added for economic reasons in 2007), that the test is available at more locations than claimed, that it will not be offered at all posts, and that candidates get a free retake if the phone connection fails.
With the exception of South Korea, this exemption is based on agreements or treaties concluded with these countries in the (distant) past.
Met uitzondering van Zuid-Korea is deze vrijstelling gebaseerd op afspraken of overeenkomsten die in het (verre) verleden met deze landen zijn gemaakt of afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Nijboer over het bevriezen van Oekraïense tegoeden en het voorkomen van belastingontwijking via Nederland door de Oekraïense elite

MPs Servaes and Nijboer asked about the amount of Ukrainian assets frozen in the Netherlands and how the FIU reported only one suspicious transaction linked to Ukraine, and whether the government would investigate how the assets came to the Netherlands and improve supervision. The minister declined to give amounts or breakdowns citing secrecy rules, explained the separate legal procedures for freezing and reporting, and committed to examine the cases and feed the results into an anti-money-laundering policy monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak en Sjoerdsma (D66) over het bericht dat Nederlandse data mogelijk zijn gebruikt bij drone-aanvallen

MPs from SP and D66 asked whether Dutch intelligence from MIVD, shared for antipiracy operations off Somalia, may have been used for US drone targeted killings, and about the legal basis and data-sharing arrangements with the US. The government answered that it does not work with illegal targeted killings, cannot confirm or deny the specifics of partner use or the number of drone strikes, will not comment publicly on NSA or partner-service cooperation, and sees no indication that the shared intelligence was used in breach of international law.

If it were shown that a foreign partner demonstrably carries out illegal targeted killings for which Dutch information is also used, this will lead to a renewed assessment of whether such intelligence is shared with that partner.

Als zou blijken dat een buitenlandse partner aantoonbaar illegale targeted killings uitvoert, waarvoor ook Nederlandse informatie wordt gebruikt, zal dit leiden tot het opnieuw beoordelen van de vraag of dergelijke inlichtingen met die partner worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een conceptwet over kindhuwelijken in Irak

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a draft Iraqi law that would allow marriage of girls from age nine and permit marital rape, and whether the Netherlands would act. The minister confirmed the draft, said it is not expected before parliament for now, that it conflicts with Iraq's own treaty obligations, and that the Netherlands will raise its concerns with Iraqi authorities and within the EU.
The Netherlands will raise its concerns about this draft legislation with the Iraqi authorities.
Nederland zal zijn zorgen over deze conceptwetgeving aan de orde stellen bij de Iraakse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over oorlog Turkije tegen Syrië onder valse vlag

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about leaked recordings allegedly showing Turkish officials discussing a false-flag pretext for war with Syria, the downing of a Syrian jet, and jihadist attacks near Kessab, and asked whether NATO Patriot deployments should be withdrawn. The government said it cannot verify the recordings, that Turkey claims they were illegally recorded and manipulated, that Dutch Patriots were not designed to track such incidents, and that it will not speculate on Turkish intentions.
The cabinet cannot assess the authenticity of these audio recordings and therefore cannot form a judgement on their alleged content.
Het kabinet kan de echtheid van deze geluidsopnames niet beoordelen en kan zich dus geen oordeel vormen over de vermeende inhoud ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Madlener en Wilders over gesjoemel met EU-subsidie voor moskeeën

MPs asked whether Amsterdam and the Interior Ministry obtained EU subsidy for two mosques by misdescribing a building as a multicultural centre, and asked about a mosque construction halt and punishment of those responsible. The minister answered that the mosque part was excluded from subsidy, that the subsidy went to Amsterdam Groot-Oost rather than the ministry, that the OLAF investigation outcome is pending, and rejected a construction halt and a withdrawal of EU involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat in Egypte 529 aanhangers van Morsi ter dood zijn veroordeeld

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 529 Morsi supporters were sentenced to death in Egypt, questioning the fairness of the trial, the EU response and whether the ambassador would be challenged. The minister called the trial a flagrant violation of rule-of-law principles, said appeal remains possible, pointed to EU statements and the incentive-based approach, and said Nederland would raise the matter bilaterally.
The cabinet sees in the trial a flagrant violation of the most fundamental principles of the rule of law.
Het kabinet ziet in het proces een flagrante schending van de meest fundamentele beginselen van de rechtsstaat.
Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma (beiden D66) aan de Ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat zeemansgraven worden geschonden (ingezonden 8 januari 2014).
