MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Dutch naval war graves were being desecrated, including whether this should be made internationally punishable and which WWII-sunk Dutch ships are known. The government's follow-up answer reports that Cambodian authorities investigated and state the Cambodian vessel involved was not near the Dutch wrecks, according to logbook and official statements.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat het Litouwse parlement stemt over een anti-homowet

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about a Lithuanian parliamentary amendment penalising public expression of non-traditional family values, asking whether it was discriminatory, whether the minister had raised it with Lithuania, and whether he would raise it in the EU. The minister answered that the amendment was withdrawn from the agenda, that the Netherlands has raised LGBT issues with Lithuania and in EU working groups, and that the government will monitor the situation closely.
This concerns a proposal from the parliament and not from the government.
Het gaat hier om een voorstel van het parlement en niet van de regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over steun en onderdak aan terroristen door Turkije

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey harbours and supports terrorists, including Hamas figures and Al Qaeda financiers, and whether the government will press Turkey on this. The minister answered that the government has no independent information on the alleged activities, that Turkey denies supporting Al Qaeda and says it takes measures, and that counter-terrorism is discussed in NATO, EU and bilateral channels.
The cabinet has no independent information on the alleged activities and travel movements of the named persons, nor on the alleged money transactions.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie ten aanzien van de veronderstelde activiteiten en reisbewegingen van genoemde personen, noch over de veronderstelde geldtransacties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Keijzer over orgaanroof in China

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Dutch government about organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China, EU and UN concerns, Dutch patients travelling abroad for transplants, and Dutch hospital ties to Chinese hospitals. The government said it shares the concern, cannot independently verify the allegations, will keep raising the issue in EU and bilateral channels, and knows of no Dutch hospital ties to suspect Chinese hospitals.
The Netherlands will continue to make efforts to keep this issue on the EU agenda.
Nederland zal zich blijven inspannen om deze kwestie op de agenda van de EU te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind en Dijkgraaf over de uitspraken van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het EU-lidmaatschap voor Turkije

MPs Segers, Voordewind and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Foreign Minister's remark that the Netherlands would welcome Turkey as an EU member was premature, given Turkey's rule-of-law shortcomings, the Cyprus blockade of chapters 23 and 24, and recognition of the Armenian genocide. The minister answered that accession talks are open-ended and conditional on meeting strict criteria, acknowledged serious shortcomings on press freedom and rule of law, and said concerns were raised in Ankara, while recognition of the genocide is not an accession criterion.
The cabinet particularly emphasised its concerns about press freedom and freedom of expression.
Het kabinet benadrukte in het bijzonder de zorgen over persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over aanvallen van Japanse walvisvaarders op Nederlandse schepen van Sea Shepherd

The MP asks the government whether it knows of Japanese whaling vessels attacking a Sea Shepherd ship, whether this endangers maritime safety, what it has done to respond, and whether it will prosecute or raise the issue at the IWC. The minister answers that the ILT has examined the February 2 incidents, found intimidating manoeuvres that may have been deliberate, referred the report to the Public Prosecution Service, raised concerns with the Japanese ambassador, and will voice concerns at the IWC.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether further action will follow.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of terzake nadere actie zal volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over discriminerende LHBT wetgeving in Kansas en Arizona

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether bills in Kansas and Arizona allowing businesses to refuse services to LGBT people on religious grounds conflict with international human rights treaties, and what the government would do. The minister replied that both bills failed (Kansas Senate rejected it, Arizona governor vetoed it), that such a law would breach the non-discrimination norm in the ICCPR, that the US is responsible for compliance with its treaty obligations, and that no steps are planned since the bills were not adopted.
The bill mentioned in the US state of Kansas was rejected by that state's Senate.
Het genoemde wetsvoorstel in de Amerikaanse staat Kansas is verworpen door de senaat van die staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht “Colombia is geen democratie”

MP Servaes asks the Foreign Minister about political violence in Colombia, including an attack on presidential candidate Aida Avella, the state of the FARC peace talks, and what the Netherlands and the EU can do to protect the process before elections. The minister acknowledges elevated risks of political violence, describes gradual progress in the peace talks, and states Dutch and EU political support, OAS monitoring, and readiness to assist implementation on request.
The Netherlands is willing to support the implementation of the peace process if Colombia requests it.
Nederland is bereid de implementatie van het vredesproces te ondersteunen indien Colombia daarom verzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijke rol van Turkije bij kidnapping van bisschoppen in Syrië

Mr Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Turkish involvement in the kidnapping of two bishops in Syria, including claims that Turkish authorities misrepresented the detention of the Abu Banat group and that the MIT intelligence service tracked the kidnappers. The minister answered that the government has no independent information confirming these claims, that Turkey says the group is detained and the law must take its course, and that the government will seek closer counter-terrorism cooperation with Turkey.
The cabinet has no independent information that confirms the claim in question.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie die de genoemde bewering bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over samenwerking met Turkije bij terrorismebestrijding

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will cooperate with Turkey on counterterrorism, given reports of Turkish ties to Hamas, arms transfers to jihadist groups in Syria, and alleged Al Qaeda bases, and why Turkey is considered a reliable partner. The minister answered that cooperation runs through existing channels, that Turkey holds a different view on Hamas, that the government does not recognise the arms-transfer claims, and that Turkey itself acknowledges the jihadist threat and has denied the Al Qaeda bases.
Based on recent contacts with the Turkish authorities, the cabinet does not recognise the suggestion that Turkey would tolerate arms deliveries to jihadist fighting groups.
Op basis van recente contacten met de Turkse autoriteiten herkent het kabinet zich niet in de suggestie dat Turkije wapenleveringen aan jihadistische strijdgroepen zou gedogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Omtzigt over nucleaire ontwapening en non-proliferatie

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers whether the B61 nuclear bomb modernisation adds new military capabilities, citing claims of greater precision, yield reduction and F-35 compatibility. The government answered that the US-run life-extension programme adds no new military capabilities, that the Netherlands has no say in it, and that it will not speculate on Russian reactions.
The cabinet is not responsible for the content and implementation of the US life-extension programme and therefore makes no statements about the US Government Accountability Office's claims on this.

Het kabinet is niet verantwoordelijk voor inhoud en uitvoering van het Amerikaanse levensduurverlengingsprogramma en doet dan ook geen uitspraken over beweringen van de Amerikaanse Rekenkamer hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over EU-plan om Oekraine geld te geven

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would provide financial aid to Ukraine, how much per Dutch citizen, why it should not instead fund tax relief, and whether the EU's planned aid could be used for tax relief. The minister replied that the Netherlands gave about EUR 1.5 million in bilateral rule-of-law and human-rights aid to Ukraine (a fraction of a euro per citizen), that these are grants, and that the EU's EUR 11 billion package is being discussed separately with the Dutch share around 5%.
Because these funds serve a different purpose: contributing to strengthening the rule of law and protecting human rights in a neighbouring country of the European Union.
Omdat deze middelen een ander doel dienen: bijdragen aan de versterking van de rechtsstaat en de bescherming van de mensenrechten in een buurland van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over mogelijke steun Turkije aan jihadisten Syrië

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey supports jihadists in Syria, citing Israeli and press reports of Al Qaeda bases and weapons transfers, and whether the Patriot mission should be questioned. The minister answered that Turkey denies such support, that the government has no independent information confirming the bases or safehouses, that the border situation is opaque so support via Turkish territory cannot be excluded, and that the issues were raised in bilateral consultations and will not be pursued through an international investigation.
The cabinet has no independent information that Al Qaeda bases exist within Turkey.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie dat binnen Turkije bases van Al Qaeda bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over Consulaire bijstand aan een Nederlandse vader

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about consular assistance to a Dutch father denied contact with his daughter in Turkey since 2011, including whether the embassy attended court hearings and whether Turkey is obstructing his case. The minister reports repeated formal and informal embassy contact with Turkish authorities, a Turkish Supreme Court ruling confirming his access right, and no evidence of active obstruction, while noting the practical barrier of denied entry and that a Dutch court cannot enforce visitation.
Although the father has thus been upheld by Turkey's highest court regarding his access right, he faces the practical obstacle that he is not admitted to Turkish territory.

Hoewel betrokkene dus door de hoogste Turkse rechter in het gelijk is gesteld ten aanzien van zijn omgangsrecht, bestaat voor hem de praktische belemmering dat hij geen toegang krijgt tot het Turkse grondgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over voorlichting voor kiezers buiten Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked how voter registration for the 2014 European Parliament election among Dutch citizens abroad is being promoted, including direct outreach and EU-national outreach. Minister Plasterk answered that registration numbers are lower than in 2009 mainly due to the absence of local campaigning in Aruba, that information campaigns are comparable to 2012, and that municipalities were advised to actively approach EU nationals in the Netherlands.
Organising the elections is a national matter, and so is informing voters about the voting process.
Het organiseren van de verkiezingen is een nationale aangelegenheid en daarmee ook het informeren over het stemproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over hervorming van Israëlische arrestatieprocedures op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli military reforms to arrest and prosecution of Palestinian minors in the West Bank, including a pilot to end night arrests and a low rate of abuse complaints. The minister answered that the government welcomes the IDF pilot, has raised concerns with Israeli authorities, and will raise the issue in further contacts, while noting that complaint rates are reported differently by various sources.
The cabinet welcomes the announcement of the IDF pilot intended to improve the situation regarding night-time arrests, and will raise it in contacts with EEAS and Israeli interlocutors.

Het kabinet verwelkomt de aankondiging van de pilot van het IDF die de situatie m.b.t. nachtelijke situaties dient te verbeteren en in contacten met EDEO en Israëlische gesprekspartners zal het ter sprake worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het “Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt” van de EU ten aanzien van Cuba

MP Omtzigt asked the government about the settlement of a Dutch export-credit insurance debt owed by Cuba's state bank, including the amount outstanding, the write-off, the 2% interest rate, the repayment schedule, and whether other Paris Club members were consulted. The minister answered in detail, explaining the debt was roughly budget-neutral, the 2% rate reflects OECD CIRR benchmarks, and bilateral settlements were permitted outside the Paris Club, though some sensitive figures (interest rate in original loan) were withheld as commercially confidential.
The interest rate in the original loan agreements between the insured party and the Cuban bank is commercially confidential information.
Het rentepercentage in de oorspronkelijke leningsovereenkomsten tussen de verzekerde partij en de Cubaanse bank betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over diens uitspraak aangaande de vermeende excuses van Vitens

MP Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether he stood by his claim that Vitens had apologised for suggesting the ministry gave a negative opinion on cooperation with Mekorot, and whether he would apologise to Vitens for putting it in a bad light. The minister replied that the ministry gave neither a negative nor a positive opinion, that he had discussed the matter with Vitens' CEO, and that the issue was considered closed.
The ministry has given neither a negative nor a positive opinion on the planned cooperation with Mekorot.
Het ministerie heeft geen negatief en geen positief advies gegeven over de voorgenomen samenwerking met Mekorot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het artikel “ook zoon Janoekovitsj sluisde vermogen weg via Nederlandse belastingroute”

GreenLeft MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether Dutch tax structures (Mako Holding, Artvin Holding) were used to channel money from Ukraine's Janukovych family, and whether the Netherlands would support a public beneficial-ownership register and freeze assets. The government answered that tax secrecy prevents details on individual taxpayers, described existing anti-money-laundering and beneficial-ownership rules and a planned restricted central shareholder register, and said EU sanctions on Ukrainian officials were being prepared.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information can be given about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan geen informatie worden gegeven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over mensenrechtenschendingen in Egypte

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about human rights violations in Egypt after the 2013 coup, including Amnesty's call to suspend arms exports, and whether the Netherlands would press this at the EU Foreign Affairs Council. The minister condemned violence, said the EU had adopted an export suspension for goods usable for internal repression, and that Dutch licensing of military exports to Egypt is on hold though assessment may resume depending on developments.
The Netherlands moreover holds all new applications for export of military goods to Egypt in abeyance.
Nederland houdt daarenboven alle nieuwe aanvragen voor export van militaire goederen naar Egypte aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over dolfijnenslachtingen in Taiji en handel in dolfijnen voor entertainment

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the dolphin slaughter in Taiji, the sale of dolphins for entertainment, and follow-up on earlier motions and IWC efforts. The government answered that the ambassador voiced disapproval, that Dutch efforts continue via the IWC and EU trade talks, and that it will inform parliament of outcomes.
On the Dutch position at the upcoming IWC annual meeting in September 2014, your House will be informed in good time.
Over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de komende jaarvergadering van de IWC in september 2014 zal uw Kamer tijdig worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over verlenging van het mandaat van de Speciale Rapporteur van de VN voor Burma

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the UN Human Rights Council will renew the Special Rapporteur mandate on Burma and whether the government will push for renewal given ongoing rights violations. The minister confirmed the March 2014 renewal decision and said the Netherlands will work within the EU to extend the mandate, since no firm agreement on an OHCHR office has yet been reached.

Because firm agreements on opening an OHCHR office are still lacking, the Netherlands will work within the EU during the March Human Rights Council session to extend the mandate of the Special Rapporteur.

Omdat harde afspraken over de opening van een OHCHR-kantoor vooralsnog uitblijven zal Nederland zich tijdens de Mensenrechtenraad van maart a.s. in EU-verband inzetten voor de verlenging van het mandaat van de Speciaal Rapporteur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over spanningen tussen het Malinese regime en Bert Koenders (MINUSMA)

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Malian president was in conflict with Bert Koenders, head of the UN mission MINUSMA, and whether this endangered his position and the peace process. The minister said the reports rest on an anonymous source, that no tension is known to the government, that the reconciliation process is slow and stalled over disarmament demands, and that no steps are needed.
As far as the cabinet is aware, there is no such thing.
Voor zover het kabinet bekend, is hiervan geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het Europese bankenresolutiefonds

Green Left MP Klaver asks whether the intergovernmental treaty underpinning the European banking resolution fund breaches EU law principles such as loyal cooperation, institutional balance, democracy, standstill and equal treatment, and whether the Court of Justice's short-selling ruling undermines the Meroni objection to Article 114 TFEU. The government answers that the intergovernmental route is lawful because the matter falls within shared competence not yet exercised by the Union, that the Court of Justice and European Parliament retain oversight roles, and that it sees no need to seek separate advice from the Council of State.
According to the cabinet, the intergovernmental approach does not conflict with the principles mentioned.
Volgens het kabinet is de intergouvernementele aanpak niet in strijd met de genoemde beginselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht “Veel misstanden bouw stadions Brazilië”

MPs Servaes, Van Dekken and Kerstens asked the minister about reports of labour violations, safety breaches and intimidation in building World Cup stadiums in Brazil, and whether the government would act, raise it with Brazil, and implement a motion on human rights in sports event awarding. The minister answered that the conclusions are FNV's responsibility, that Brazil is handling labour issues, that no direct talks are planned, and that the sports minister is pursuing human rights in sports awarding via NOC*NSF and a European letter.
The conclusions FNV draws from this research are FNV's own responsibility.
De conclusies die FNV trekt op basis van dit onderzoek zijn voor rekening van FNV.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de benoeming van de Venezolaanse Consul in Aruba

Two PVV MPs asked whether Venezuela appointed a consul in Aruba who is suspected of drug trafficking linked to a terrorist organisation, whether he is on US watch lists, whether an international arrest request applies, and whether this was raised during a Dutch delegation visit. The minister answered that no request for a new Venezuelan consul-general in Aruba has been received, that the person is publicly listed on the US Treasury SDN list since 2008, that the Justice Minister will not comment on non-public lists or arrest requests, and that the delegation visit did not raise the appointment.
The Minister of Security and Justice does not comment on non-public lists of the United States or on international arrest and detention requests.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie doet geen uitspraken over niet-openbare lijsten van de Verenigde Staten of internationale opsporings- en aanhoudingsverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een door de vredesmacht United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) gerapporteerd incident in 1980

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a 1980 UNIFIL incident in which Dutch peacekeepers reported Israeli forces blowing up bodies of Palestinian fighters, and whether this was a war crime. The government answered that it took the report seriously, that the UN inquiry found the Dutch acted in good faith but could not verify their observations, and that it sees no reason to revisit its position or to call it a war crime.
The cabinet is aware of the observations voiced in Andere Tijden, but sees no reason to reconsider the position stated above.
Het kabinet is bekend met de observaties, zoals geuit in Andere Tijden, maar ziet geen aanleiding het hiervoor genoemde standpunt te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het «Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt» van de EU ten aanzien van Cuba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked why Cuba was absent from the minister's travel schedule, whether the EU Common Position on Cuba would be changed, and why a Memorandum of Understanding with Cuba and a debt repayment deal were not sent to parliament earlier. The minister answered that the Cuba trip was not yet confirmed in early December, that the Common Position remains in force until a new mandate-based agreement exists, that MoUs are departmental and not routinely sent to parliament, and provided the main terms of the Cuban debt repayment agreement while withholding the full contract as commercially sensitive.
This agreement contains commercially sensitive information and therefore cannot be made fully public.
Dit akkoord bevat bedrijfsgevoelige informatie en kan derhalve niet volledig openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een luchtaanval in Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a December 2013 airstrike in Yemen that killed wedding guests, including whether the strike was a US drone attack, whether the victims were lawfully targeted, and whether the government would seek clarification and accountability. The minister answered that the government lacks specific factual information about the operation, supports transparency and a fact-finding inquiry, and that compensation is under negotiation between the Yemeni government and the families.
The cabinet does not have the requested specific factual information about this operation.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de gevraagde specifieke feitelijke informatie over deze operatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht "Ook Moldaviër mag zonder visum Nederland in"

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that Moldovan nationals can enter the Netherlands without a visa, and why, given existing crime and nuisance, immigration should continue to be allowed. The minister confirmed awareness, explained that the visa waiver covers short stays only, that long-term immigration remains governed by national law, and pointed to the emergency brake procedure as a safeguard.

Furthermore, the emergency brake procedure that came into force on 9 January, which allows the visa requirement to be temporarily reintroduced in the event of a sudden increase in illegal stay and/or asylum applications, provides an adequate safety net.

Verder biedt de op 9 januari jl. in werking getreden noodremprocedure, die het mogelijk maakt bij een plotselinge toename van illegaliteit en/of asielaanvragen tijdelijk de visumplicht weer in te voeren, een adequaat vangnet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de berichten dat Sri Lanka, Thailand en het Hoge Commissariaat voor de Vluchtelingen van de Verenigde Naties (UNHCR) wanhopige christenen aan hun lot over laten

The MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that Sri Lanka, Thailand and UNHCR leave desperate Pakistani Christians without protection, and whether the government will press these countries and Pakistan on asylum and the blasphemy law. The minister answers that UNHCR handles asylum claims individually, that Sri Lanka tolerates applicants pending decisions, that Thailand is not a refugee convention party, and that the Netherlands follows UNHCR policy and raises minority rights with Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Thailand is not a party to the refugee convention. UNHCR is present and has recognised about 200 Pakistani refugees.
Thailand is geen partij bij het vluchtelingenverdrag. UNHCR is wel aanwezig en heeft circa 200 Pakistaanse vluchtelingen erkend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat bij de Olympische Spelen grootschalig gegevensopslag plaatsvindt van aanwezige sporters en andere geaccrediteerden

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government whether Dutch Olympic visitors' communications data stored by Russia (three-year retention, accessible to the FSB and other unnamed agencies) could reach Dutch intelligence services and what was being done to inform and protect Dutch citizens. The government answered that Dutch intelligence services have no access to the database, that Dutch visitors are covered by a travel advisory and the Oranje Boekje, and that it cannot exclude storage of delegation members' data for security reasons.
Dutch intelligence and security services have no access to the said database.
Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen toegang tot de genoemde database.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'PGGM haalt beleggingen uit Israëlische banken'

MPs Madlener, De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government considers PGGM's divestment from Israeli banks a boycott, how much PGGM invests in Israel and the Palestinian territories, and what the government will do against investor withdrawal and anti-Israel sentiment. The minister answered that PGGM's decision is its own, that PGGM still invests in Israeli companies (over EUR 60 million in several dozen firms), that the government does not track investments and does not intervene in company decisions, and that it is working to deepen economic ties with Israel.
The government does not keep track of PGGM's investments.
Het kabinet houdt de investeringen van PGGM niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes over de anti-homowetgeving in Oeganda

MPs Yücel and Servaes asked whether the government knew of Uganda's anti-homosexuality law, whether it opposes it, and how Dutch development aid to Uganda relates to good governance and human rights. The minister confirmed the law, said President Museveni refused to sign it and that the Netherlands pressed for EU action, and described the roughly 23 million euro aid programme, including funds for human rights and the justice sector.
The Dutch cabinet pressed within the EU for joint pressure on the Ugandan government not to approve this law.
Het Nederlandse kabinet heeft binnen de EU aangedrongen op gezamenlijke druk op de Ugandese regering om niet met deze wet in te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de blokkade door UNESCO van een tentoonstelling over het Joodse volk

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO blocked an exhibition on Jewish ties to the Land of Israel under Arab pressure, and how the government views this. The minister answered that the exhibition was postponed to June rather than blocked, partly due to concerns from Arab states and incomplete agreement on content, and that the government welcomes its going ahead, while hosting it in the Netherlands is up to the organiser.
The exhibition "The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land" was not prevented but postponed until June of this year.
1 Antwoord 1 De tentoonstelling «The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land» is niet verhinderd, maar uitgesteld tot juni van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen het van lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de VN-Organisatie voor Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur (UNESCO) een internationale expositie over Israël heeft geschrapt

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO's cancellation of an exhibition on Jewish history and the Holy Land was justified, whether the government would protest, and what it would do if UNESCO persisted. The minister replied that the exhibition was postponed to June rather than cancelled, cited UNESCO's concerns about Arab states and unfinished content agreement with the Wiesenthal Center, welcomed the postponement, and expected the exhibition to proceed.
The exhibition "The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land" has not been cancelled but postponed until June of this year.
1 Antwoord De tentoonstelling «The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land» is niet geschrapt, maar uitgesteld tot juni van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een Turkse wet over het verlenen van eerste hulp

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish law requiring state permission before doctors may give emergency first aid, and whether the government would raise its concerns. The minister confirmed the law was passed but not yet in force, said the government regrets it and will raise it bilaterally and within the EU with Turkey.
The government will therefore raise this bilaterally and within the EU with the Turkish government.
Het kabinet zal dit dan ook bilateraal en in EU-verband bij de Turkse regering aankaarten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Sjoerdsma over het EU-Visserijakkoord met Marokko

MPs Ten Broeke and Sjoerdsma asked whether the new EU-Morocco fisheries protocol covers occupied Western Sahara, whether EU rules bar spending in occupied territories, and how the deal fits EU and international law. The minister answered that the protocol does not name Western Sahara but does not exclude application there, that economic activity is lawful provided it benefits the local population, and that the Netherlands will press for concrete safeguards.
The protocol contains no direct reference to Western Sahara, but in practice it does not exclude its application there.
Het protocol bevat geen rechtstreekse verwijzing naar de Westelijke Sahara, maar sluit toepassing op de Westelijke Sahara in de praktijk niet uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over bericht dat homo's in Oeganda voortaan levenslang krijgen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to Uganda's anti-homosexuality law providing life imprisonment, and what steps it has taken and funds LGBT projects there. The minister called the law contrary to fundamental human rights, described diplomatic pressure via EU and bilateral channels, said no consequences have been decided yet since the law is not yet in force, and listed Dutch-funded LGBT and human rights programmes in Uganda.
It is too early to decide on consequences upon the law's introduction.
Het is te vroeg om te besluiten over consequenties bij de invoering van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over de smeergeldaffaire in verband met bouwprojecten van Ballast Nedam in Saudi-Arabië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the ministry interfered with the criminal investigation into the Ballast-Nedam bribery affair in Saudi Arabia and whether political interference is lawful, and asked about the UK precedent with BAE. The minister denies any involvement by the ministry, says the Public Prosecution Service's post-publication response was correct, and states that the only lawful ministerial intervention is a formal instruction under the Judiciary Organisation Act, subject to parliamentary control.
There has been no involvement, interest or obstruction from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Er is geen sprake geweest van bemoeienis, betrokkenheid of hindering van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat etnische segregatie plaatsvindt binnen een VN-kamp in Zuid-Sudan

Rep. Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the Foreign Minister about reports of ethnic segregation in a UN camp in South Sudan, whether separate housing of Dinka and Nuer was acceptable, and whether the UN should avoid emphasising tribal differences. Minister Timmermans answered that the UN does not pursue segregation policy, that the arrangement was informal and the sign was unauthorised and removed, that the cabinet understands separate housing, that no Dutch soldiers are present, and that no further action is planned.
No, the UN has itself already taken the necessary action.
Nee, de VN heeft zelf al de benodigde actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de Nigeriaanse president de anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands would respond to Nigeria's anti-gay law and reported arrests of gay men in Bauchi. The minister called the law disappointing, described past quiet diplomacy and EU statements, said the response is still being considered, and noted a Dutch-funded LGBT rights programme.
The Netherlands and like-minded countries are currently considering possible follow-up steps.
Nederland en gelijkgezinde landen beraden zich op dit moment over mogelijke vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat zeemansgraven worden geschonden

D66 MPs asked whether the wreck of Dutch submarine O-16 in the South China Sea, possibly disturbed by a Cambodian salvage vessel, constitutes grave desecration, what happened to the crew's remains, whether international criminal prohibition should be pursued, and for an overview of sunk WWII Dutch ships. The government said the disturbance would be unlawful, that criminalisation exists via international legal assistance, that Cambodian authorities have not yet replied, and that it would not publish a wreck overview for fear of provoking further incidents.
Moreover, making such an overview public is not expedient, as it could precisely provoke more incidents.
Daarbij is het openbaar maken van een dergelijk overzicht niet opportuun, omdat daarmee juist meer incidenten zouden kunnen worden uitgelokt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het ontmoedigingsbeleid

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the government withdrew a minister's visit to Mekorot, whether the settlement-discouragement policy is coherent with indirect investment, and how it fits the Oslo accords. The minister answered that the policy rests on international law on settlements, that the Oslo allocation of C-areas does not change this, and that cooperation with Mekorot is acceptable if not benefiting settlements.
I refer you to the letter to your House of 16 January 2014, reference 2014.35843, which addresses this matter.
Ik verwijs u graag naar de brief aan uw Kamer van 16 januari 2014, met kenmerk 2014.35843, waarin op deze kwestie wordt ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over het bericht “India top court reinstates gay sex ban”

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about the Indian Supreme Court reinstating the ban on same-sex relations, and whether the Netherlands would raise abolition of the law with India. The minister answered that only parliament can amend the provision (or the government via ordinance with presidential consent), that the EU High Representative already expressed concern, and that the Supreme Court left repeal to parliament, so no concrete step was committed.
The Supreme Court indicated that it is for parliament to possibly revise this provision.
Het Hooggerechtshof heeft aangegeven dat het aan het parlement is om deze bepaling eventueel te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Ark over het bericht dat homoseksualiteit weer strafbaar wordt gesteld in India

MPs Ten Broeke and Van Ark asked the Foreign Minister about India's Supreme Court ruling reinstating criminalisation of same-sex relations, and whether legal steps, political support for reform, and EU pressure are possible. The minister answered that the court left reform to parliament, that a review petition is possible but mainly addresses procedural errors, that protests occurred, and that the EU High Representative had already expressed concern.
With this ruling the Supreme Court has placed the initiative with the legislature to remove or amend this provision.
Met deze uitspraak heeft het Hooggerechtshof het initiatief bij de wetgevende macht neergelegd om deze bepaling te verwijderen dan wel te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de uitzending van Bureau Buitenland over foute regimes die Interpol misbruiken

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government about a Bureau Buitenland broadcast alleging that Interpol notices are misused to arrest recognised refugees and human rights activists in Europe, and how Dutch checks on such notices work. Minister Opstelten answered that Interpol itself makes no arrests, that Dutch notices are screened against refugee status and persecution grounds before any extradition, that data on arrests from notices cannot be retrieved from police systems, and that Interpol removes notices that breach its constitution.
It cannot be derived from police systems how many or which arrests have taken place following an Interpol notice.
Uit de systemen van de politie kan niet worden afgeleid hoeveel of welke aanhoudingen hebben plaatsgevonden naar aanleiding van een Interpolsignalering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Segers over afschaffing slavernij

MPs Slob and Segers asked why the Netherlands did not sign the 1949 UN Convention on trafficking and prostitution, whether it will do so, what anti-trafficking goals exist, and how the government addresses the legacy of slavery such as discrimination. The government answered that it will not join the convention because it would criminalise exploitation of adult voluntary prostitution, that regulation is preferred, and outlined trafficking task force and referral mechanism plans plus commemoration and anti-discrimination actions.
The Netherlands does not intend to become a party to the UN Convention.
Nederland is niet van plan partij bij het VN-Verdrag te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Ark over de doodslag van twee mannen vanwege seksuele gerichtheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a reported video of two gay men beaten to death in Kenya, and whether the government would press for prosecution and cut aid if not prosecuted. The minister answered that the event apparently did not take place in Kenya, so no Kenyan investigation exists, and declined to take further action on that basis.
On the basis of environmental details it is clear that it did not take place in Kenya.
Op basis van omgevingsdetails is wel duidelijk dat het niet in Kenia heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de situatie in Zuid-Sudan met grote aantallen slachtoffers van etnisch geweld

Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of the ethnic violence in South Sudan, how high the risk of genocide was, and what the UN Secretary-General and EU/Netherlands were asked to do. Minister Timmermans answered that the risk of escalation exists but genocide cannot be predicted, describes diplomatic efforts via IGAD and the UN Security Council reinforcement of UNMISS, and says the Netherlands keeps its UNMISS contribution.
Parties must also agree a ceasefire as soon as possible; in addition, the protection of civilians is of great importance.
Partijen moeten voorts zo spoedig mogelijk een staakt-het-vuren overeenkomen; daarnaast is de bescherming van burgers van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het artikel ‘Asscher ziet wel iets in boud plan Cameron’

Two D66 MPs asked the Social Affairs and foreign ministers about Cameron's plan to delay free movement for new EU members until they reach a certain economic level, and whether Minister Asscher's reported openness to it conflicts with EU free movement. The government calls the idea a potentially interesting contribution to building support for free movement, citing exploitation of lower-income workers, and says reciprocity depends on future accession negotiations while transitional restrictions are compatible with free movement.
Whether the possibility of reciprocity will also be included in the accession treaties with new members depends on negotiations with those countries, which is not yet on the agenda.

Of de mogelijkheid tot wederkerigheid ook in de toetredingsverdragen met nieuwe toetreders wordt opgenomen, hangt af van de onderhandelingen met deze landen, hetgeen voorlopig nog niet aan de orde is.

This item is a list of dozens of written parliamentary questions from various MPs that the government has declared lapsed, because they were answered otherwise or are no longer considered opportune to answer. Since no substantive questions are answered, the government gives no answers on the merits.
The questions below are to be considered lapsed.
Onderstaande vragen dienen als vervallen te worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over etikettering van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara

An SP MP asked the government about EU rules on labelling products from Western Sahara (such as tomatoes) as Moroccan, preferential tariffs, and whether a labelling advisory like the one for Israeli settlement products is needed. The government answered that EU labelling rules have no specific provision for Western Sahara, that an EU-wide approach is preferred, and that it has urged the Commission for more clarity without the Commission yet acting.
The Netherlands has therefore urged the European Commission for more clarity regarding the origin and provenance of products from Western Sahara.
Nederland heeft dan ook bij de Europese Commissie aangedrongen op meer duidelijkheid ten aanzien van de oorsprong en herkomst van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de nieuwe Egyptische grondwet

MP Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows the new Egyptian constitution, how he assesses the rights of women and minorities and the expanded military position including military trials of civilians, and whether High Representative Ashton has responded. The minister confirms awareness, says the Netherlands follows the process closely but finds it too early to judge the content before the referendum, and says Ashton has not yet responded.

Given that the Egyptian population still has to vote in a referendum on the amendment of the constitution, the cabinet considers it too early to give a judgement on the content of the future constitution.

Gezien het feit dat de Egyptische bevolking zich nog per referendum moet uitspreken over aanpassing van de Grondwet acht het kabinet het echter te vroeg om een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van de toekomstige Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het mogelijk schrappen van de visumplicht voor Turken

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that Turks could enter the EU without a visa within a few years were accurate, and what had been agreed with Turkey. The minister confirmed a 2012 EU-Turkey JBZ cooperation package, with visa liberalisation conditional on a readmission agreement and strict criteria rather than a timetable, and said national rules for long-stay visas and work permits would not be affected.
Regarding visa liberalisation, the Netherlands holds that the process is tied to strict conditions, with the criteria leading and not the timetable.
Ten aanzien van visumliberalisatie staat Nederland voor dat het proces is verbonden aan strikte voorwaarden, waarbij de criteria leidend zijn en niet het tijdpad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de VN geen inzage krijgt in misbruikdossiers van Vaticaan

Two D66 MPs asked why the Holy See refuses to give the UN Committee on the Rights of the Child detailed information on child abuse cases by clergy, and whether it should do so under the Convention. The Foreign Minister answered that the Convention requires cooperation but not detailed case information, that the Holy See does assist foreign mutual legal assistance requests, and that Nederland will not press the Holy See on the matter.
Given the answer to questions 1, 2 and 3, however, it is not reasonable for the Netherlands to confront the Holy See on this.
Gezien het antwoord op de vragen 1, 2 en 3 ligt het echter niet in de rede dat Nederland de Heilige Stoel hierop aanspreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over Visumvrij reizen door Turken

MPs Madlener and Wilders asked whether Turkish citizens would gain visa-free travel to the EU once a readmission agreement is signed, and whether the government would push to halt negotiations. The Minister replied that visa abolition is not yet on the table, that it depends on strict conditions in an action plan, and that the government sees the readmission agreement as in Dutch interests.
Abolition of the visa requirement is not yet on the agenda.
Afschaffing van de visumplicht is nog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over het bericht dat het parlement in Libië stemde voor islamitisch recht

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Libya's transitional parliament (GNC) decided Islamic law should be the basis for legislation, and about its assessment and practical consequences. The minister said it is a matter for Libya, that the Netherlands will respond critically if human rights are violated, that the practical effects await the GNC's elaboration, and that the EU already discussed Libya's situation in November.
The choice of a legal system is a matter for the country concerned.
De keuze voor een rechtsstelsel is een zaak van het desbetreffende land.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind over het gegeven dat waterbedrijf Vitens zijn samenwerkingsverband met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot heeft beëindigd 'om neutraal' te

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government was involved in Vitens ending its cooperation with Israel's Mekorot, whether this harms innovation and the peace process, and whether it fits the water top-sector policy. The minister answered that the government does not interfere in individual companies' decisions, that the ministry only explained Dutch non-encouragement policy when consulted, and that companies decide their own economic relations.
The government does not intervene in the decisions of individual companies.
De regering treedt niet in de besluiten van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de 21-jarige Nederlander die al bijna drie jaar in een Turkse cel wacht op uitlevering naar Nederland

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked why a 21-year-old Dutch national had been held for nearly three years in Turkey awaiting extradition, and whether the government had withdrawn the request. Minister Opstelten answered that the extradition request was withdrawn effective 1 December 2013 because proceedings had taken so long that detention would exceed the likely Dutch sentence, and that the man was released that day after consular assistance.
At the last contact Turkey was asked that, if the extradition request was still under consideration on 1 December 2013, the extradition procedure be terminated as of that date.

Bij het laatste contact is aan Turkije verzocht om, wanneer het uitleveringsverzoek op 1 december 2013 nog steeds in behandeling zou zijn, de uitleveringsprocedure met ingang van die datum te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Caluwe en Ten Broeke over steniging in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about a reported proposal in Afghanistan's law reform working group to reintroduce stoning, and whether Dutch funding to the Afghan bar association should be stopped. The ministers answered that no such proposal was made by the sub-working group or the bar association chair, that Dutch funding is for lawyer training via local partners, and that Nederland will monitor the reform and raise concerns if needed.
The Netherlands will monitor the criminal law reform process with its partners and, if necessary, raise this point again.
Nederland zal met de partners het proces van de herziening van de strafwet monitoren en indien nodig, dit punt opnieuw onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, van Bommel en van Ojik over Nederlandse steun voor bedrijven in nederzettingen

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP and GroenLinks asked whether Dutch support for Israeli companies in settlements, including a planned Dutch-Israeli business forum, conflicts with the Netherlands' discouragement policy and whether the forum's reach would extend to occupied territories. The government answered that the discouragement policy applies to the forum, that Israeli settlement firms are not invited and are monitored, that the Palestinian Authority and Israel were informed of the policy, and that a fully watertight system is not possible.
It is technically not feasible to set up a filter that excludes Israeli companies located in settlements.
Het is technisch niet haalbaar een filter in te stellen die Israëlische bedrijven gevestigd in nederzettingen uitsluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Ulenbelt over investeringen in de kernwapenindustrie

MPs from the SP asked whether the government would discourage or ban investment by Dutch banks and pension funds in nuclear weapons producers, following an IKV Pax Christi report. The minister replied that financial institutions are responsible for their own investment policies, that the government will not amend the legal framework, and that no ban is being considered.
Pension funds and banks are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen en banken zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de uitvaart van Nelson Mandela

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government would request the arrest and extradition of Suriname's president Desi Bouterse, convicted to 11 years for cocaine trafficking, and whether it was improper for the King to attend a ceremony with him. The minister answered that Netherlands values attendance at the Mandela memorial, that the conviction stands but cannot be enforced while Bouterse enjoys head-of-state immunity.
The court's judgment convicting Bouterse remains in force, but cannot be enforced as long as he enjoys international immunity as head of state of Suriname.

De uitspraak van de rechtbank waarbij Bouterse is veroordeeld blijft van kracht, maar kan niet tot uitvoering worden gebracht, zolang hij als staatshoofd van Suriname internationaal immuniteit geniet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Roon over journalist van PowNews / Angolese ambassade

MPs Helder and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about an Angolan embassy employee who assaulted a PowNews journalist, and whether diplomats committing offences should be expelled. The minister said the matter went to police and the public prosecutor, outlined diplomatic tools such as protest, requests to lift immunity and persona non grata status, and promised a letter on tackling offences by privileged persons.
During the budget debate of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, a letter was promised to the House on tackling offences committed by privileged persons.

Tijdens de behandeling van de begroting van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is aan de Kamer een brief toegezegd over de aanpak van de problematiek rondom overtredingen en/of misdrijven door geprivilegieerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Area C en de levensvatbaarheid van de twee-statenoplossing

An MP asked the foreign minister how the government responds to a World Bank report on restrictions in Area C of the West Bank, the planned economic use of that area, settlement expansion and home demolitions, and what Dutch and EU action is taken to support the two-state solution. The minister answers that the findings are serious but not new, that Nederland has urged Israel to lift restrictions and freeze settlements, that EU Heads of Mission reports are internal and cannot be discussed, and that Dutch funding supports land development and water projects in Area C.
The EU Heads of Mission reports are internal EU documents intended for internal policy-making and are not published.
De EU «Heads of Mission» rapporten zijn interne EU-documenten bedoeld voor interne beleidsvorming en worden niet gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de schending van de rechten van homo- en biseksuelen en transgenders (LGBT) in Iran

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the Foreign Minister about the rights of LGBT people in Iran, citing a report on discriminatory provisions in Iran's penal code and asking whether the Netherlands can directly support Iranian LGBT-rights NGOs. The minister agreed that the penal code discriminates and that it conflicts with international human rights norms, but said direct funding to Iranian NGOs is generally not possible due to Iranian state conditions, and listed indirect measures such as EU and UN diplomacy and project funding.

Providing a direct (financial) contribution to non-governmental organisations (NGOs) in Iran is usually not possible due to the controlling conditions the Iranian government imposes on NGOs that receive support from abroad.

Het leveren van een rechtstreekse (financiële) bijdrage aan niet-gouvernementele organisaties (NGO's) in Iran is meestal niet mogelijk vanwege de controlerende voorwaarden die de Iraanse overheid stelt aan NGO's die steun ontvangen uit het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Rusland en Saudi-Arabië gekozen zijn in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

An MP asked the foreign minister about Russia and Saudi Arabia being elected to the UN Human Rights Council, including whether the election reflects their human rights records and how the council's legitimacy is affected. The minister replied that votes are secret, that all members can take part in agenda-setting and debates, that candidates pledge to improve their human rights situation, and that Israel was invited to join the WEOG group.
The elections for a seat on the UN Human Rights Council (HRC) are secret.
De verkiezingen voor een zetel in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad (MRR) zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over het bericht 'Geen hoger loon voor EU-functionarissen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about the ruling that EU officials will not receive a higher salary, and about the Commission's options, the pension premium proposal and the status of the EU civil service statute. The minister welcomed the Court's ruling, said the Commission's pension premium proposal is still pending in the Council, and said the government's position on EU salaries and pensions has not changed.
It is currently not known what the European Commission will do following this ruling.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend wat de Europese Commissie naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak zal doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over vertegenwoordiging van Taiwan bij internationale organisaties

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Taiwan's participation in bodies such as the UNFCCC, WHA and ICAO should be encouraged, given its CO2 emissions and growing invitations to meetings. The minister answered that Taiwan cannot become a party to treaties due to its status, that limited involvement such as observer or guest roles can serve international interests, but that the Netherlands will not support Taiwanese membership under its one-China policy.
Therefore the Netherlands will not support Taiwanese membership of international organisations.
Daarom zal Nederland Taiwanese lidmaatschap van internationale organisaties niet steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Duitse plannen om tol te heffen op buitenlandse auto’s

An MP asked the minister whether German plans to charge tolls only to foreign drivers would disadvantage Dutch road users, especially border residents, and what international rules apply. The minister replied that tolls must apply to all users in the EU, that no concrete German plan exists yet, that she has raised Dutch concerns with her German counterpart, and that she will inform parliament once concrete plans appear.
When concrete plans are presented by the German government, I will inform the House of Representatives about them.
Wanneer er concrete plannen voorliggen van de Duitse regering, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de activiteiten en het toezicht op de Europese geheime dienst IntCen

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how the EU intelligence body IntCen receives and shares intelligence, its legal basis and status, and what oversight applies, including whether it processes personal data. Minister Plasterk answered that IntCen only produces strategic analyses from voluntary member-state contributions, now sits within the EEAS under the same legal controls as other EU institutions (Ombudsman, Court of Justice, data protection supervisor), and that Dutch oversight of its AIVD input rests with the CTIVD.

Given that SitCen produces only strategic analyses, processes no personal data, acquires no intelligence of its own and receives information from member states only on a voluntary basis, the Council considered that no special legal basis was required to establish SitCen.

Gelet op het feit dat SitCen uitsluitend strategische analyses opstelt, geen persoonsgegevens verwerkt, geen eigen inlichtingen verwerft en dat informatie uit de lidstaten slechts op basis van vrijwilligheid wordt verstrekt, was de Raad van mening dat voor de oprichting van SitCen geen bijzonder rechtsbasis was vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de VN-vredesinspanningen voor de Westelijke Sahara

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Western Sahara, UN peace efforts under envoy Ross, the rejected US proposal for monitoring, a US internal report, and Western Sahara's legal status. The minister answered that rights monitoring is hard to verify, the EU backs Ross's shuttle diplomacy, MINURSO's mandate was extended without human rights, and the Dutch government cannot assess the unofficial US report.
The cabinet does not have it and therefore cannot assess it.
Kabinet beschikt daar niet over en kan het daarom ook niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht in een recent rapport van Amnesty International dat honderden Syrische vluchtelingen niet zijn toegelaten tot Jordanië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's report that hundreds of Syrian refugees were refused entry at Jordan's border, and about Dutch efforts on burden-sharing and reception. The minister acknowledged the concerns, confirmed the border categories and the funding given, and said the government would keep raising the issue with Jordan and the EU.
The Netherlands raises this issue in various contacts with the Jordanian authorities.
Nederland brengt deze problematiek in diverse contacten met de Jordaanse autoriteiten onder de aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over de verwoesting van het Syrische christelijke dorp Sadad

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about reports of mass killings and destruction in the Christian Syrian village of Sadad, the background, international responses, and possible action. The minister said SOHR reported 45 civilian deaths but no destruction of the village, that no further information was available, and that the Netherlands would press for respect for minorities and referral of Syria to the International Criminal Court.
No information is available about the background of these killings.
Over de achtergronden van deze moorden is geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het falen van het Kompas-syteem op de Filipijnen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the newly launched Kompas registration system for Dutch citizens in the Philippines failed to warn people before Typhoon Haiyan, how many registered, how many Dutch nationals remain unaccounted for, and what is being done to find them. The minister answered that the system only became operational on 1 October and was still in its start-up phase, that 343 Dutch nationals had registered, that none of the four people without contact were registered, that Dutch citizens had been warned through other channels, and that a consular team was deployed.
The system is technically operational. Over the coming period work will be done to expand the number of registrations so that more Dutch nationals can be reached.
Het systeem is technisch operationeel. De komende tijd zal worden gewerkt aan het uitbreiden van het aantal registraties zodat meer Nederlanders bereikt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over Kroatië en de buitensporig tekortprocedure

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Croatia, as a new EU member, is already in breach of budget rules and whether the government regrets supporting its accession, and whether it would argue for Croatia to leave the EU. The minister answered that the Commission assesses compliance under the European Semester and may propose an excessive deficit procedure, that Croatia met accession requirements, and that parliament also approved accession.
Croatia has met the EU requirements in the accession process.
Kroatië heeft aan de EU-eisen in het toetredingstraject voldaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het incident in het Corinthia hotel

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the 10 October 2013 armed abduction of Libya's prime minister from the Corinthia Hotel in Tripoli, including whether EU and Dutch diplomats' rooms were entered, whether diplomatic immunity under the Vienna Convention was violated, and whether security measures would change. The minister answered that the group entered EUBAM rooms but took only bulletproof vests, that a violation of diplomatic immunity would occur only if accredited diplomats' rooms were entered, and that no change to the security regime was currently warranted, while withholding the location of diplomats for security reasons.
With a view to the safety of the Dutch and other European diplomats sent to Libya, the cabinet cannot say anything about their accommodation location.
Met het oog op de veiligheid van de naar Libië uitgezonden Nederlandse en andere Europese diplomaten, kan het kabinet geen uitspraken doen over hun huisvestingslocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Ten Broeke over het bericht "Syrian chemical weapons mission only funded until end of month

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the OPCW lacks funds to continue its Syrian chemical weapons programme after November. The minister denied any funding shortfall, listed donors and pledges, and said Syria bears responsibility for destruction costs.
As stated in the answer to question 2, there is currently no funding shortfall at the OPCW.
Zoals gesteld in het antwoord op vraag 2 is er op dit moment geen sprake van een financieringstekort bij de OPCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de toenemende vervolging van christenen op Sri Lanka

MPs Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about reported rising persecution of Christians in Sri Lanka, including church closures, an attack on a church in Hanwella, police inaction, and removal of Sri Lanka from the human rights fund country list. The minister acknowledged rising religious tensions, said no independent information was available on several specifics, explained the 2011 reduction of the fund's country list, and noted EU and UN expressions of concern without committing to new national measures.
There is no independent information available to make a statement about this.
Er is geen onafhankelijke informatie beschikbaar om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de geschillenbeslechting tussen Zimbabwe en Nederlandse ondernemers

An MP asked ministers about the unresolved arbitration award owed by Zimbabwe to Dutch farmers whose land was expropriated in 2001-2002, including progress, the route for dispute settlement, and whether Dutch engagement with Zimbabwe is consistent with the unpaid compensation. The minister replied that Zimbabwe was ordered by an ICSID tribunal in 2009 to pay compensation, that payment has not yet followed despite repeated pressure, that the case remains a priority, and that development cooperation has not resumed while Dutch firms decide on investments themselves.
The Netherlands will continue to request attention, both publicly and on the margins, at appropriate moments for this recognised claim of Dutch investors.
Nederland zal op gepaste momenten zowel openlijk als en marge aandacht blijven vragen voor deze erkende claim van de Nederlandse investeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar uitspraken over Volkel”

PVV MPs asked whether criminal investigation of former ministers Lubbers and Van Agt over their statements on nuclear weapons at Volkel is blocked by the government withholding information, and whether the state secrecy and official secrecy provisions have become empty. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the Public Prosecution Service cannot assess a state secret breach without government statements, NATO agreements exclude discussing nuclear weapon numbers and locations, and the provisions are still used in practice.
Within NATO it has been agreed that agreements relating to the numbers and locations of nuclear weapons present on allied territory are not discussed.
In NAVO-verband is overeengekomen dat niet wordt ingegaan op afspraken die verband houden met aantallen en locaties van op bondgenootschappelijk grondgebied aanwezige kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de omstandigheden van Rohingya-vluchtelingen in Thaise detentiecentra

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about poor conditions for Rohingya refugees in Thai detention centres, Dutch-funded camps being inaccessible to them, EU emergency aid, and human trafficking. The minister agreed detention is undesirable, explained that the Thai authorities do not recognise Rohingya as refugees so they cannot access the camps, and described EU-funded improvements and raising of the issue with Thailand.
It is undesirable that male Rohingya refugees are held in Thai detention centres.
Het is onwenselijk dat mannelijke Rohingya-vluchtelingen in Thaise detentiecentra worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rechtmatigheid van Amerikaanse targeted killings in Pakistan en Jemen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch reports on US drone strikes in Pakistan and Yemen show unlawful killings, whether the government shares those conclusions, and how the Netherlands prevents contributing to illegal targeted killings. The minister said the government shares the concerns but cannot pre-judge legality without specific facts, that authorities should investigate where there are indications of unlawful conduct, and that the Netherlands will refuse US requests for assistance where cooperation would breach international law.
The cabinet will not grant a possible US request for information or other contribution if there are indications that cooperation would lead to an act in violation of international law.

Het kabinet zal een eventueel verzoek van de VS om informatie of een bijdrage in andere zin niet inwilligen, als er aanwijzingen zijn dat medewerking zou leiden tot een handeling in strijd met het internationaal recht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Van Bommel over het ongekende geweld tegen christenen in Egypte, zoals gedocumenteerd door Amnesty International

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's documentation of large-scale violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt, including trends, casualty figures, the interim government's protection efforts and possible international initiatives. The minister said the reports are troubling, that the government urges independent investigation bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, that no reliable casualty figures exist, and that Dutch initiatives include judicial training and interfaith contacts.
The cabinet advocates the need for such an impartial investigation with the Egyptian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU and UN.
Het kabinet bepleit de noodzaak van een dergelijk onpartijdig onderzoek bij de Egyptische autoriteiten, zowel bilateraal als in EU- en in VN-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de grotendeels onbestrafte islamitische jihad tegen Kopten in Egypte

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about alleged unpunished jihadist violence against Egyptian Copts, including whether Muslim Brotherhood support, police neglect and partisan investigations were involved. The minister answered that Nederland rejects jihad calls, denies supporting the Muslim Brotherhood, condemns the August 2013 attacks, and urges independent investigations without yet reporting concrete results.
The cabinet urges independent investigation into all incidents and prosecution of the perpetrators.
Het kabinet dringt aan op onafhankelijk onderzoek naar alle incidenten en vervolging van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Servaes over misbruik van Syrische minderjarige vluchtelingen

Two MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about reports of child abuse and child marriage among Syrian refugee girls, whether the trend is confirmed, what international measures exist, and whether Dutch funding addresses it. The ministers confirmed that child marriage is a known and possibly rising problem but lacks reliable figures, described Dutch-backed UN initiatives and funding for UNHCR and UNICEF, and did not commit to new concrete action beyond existing policy.
The trend of child abuse, and in particular child marriage, is known.
De trend van kindermisbruik en met name kindhuwelijken is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Dijkhoff over de aanslag van Al Shabaab in Nairobi

Two VVD MPs asked why Al Shabaab is not on the Dutch, EU and UN terrorist lists, whether it should be listed, and about Dutch jihadists and the progress of motions on citizenship revocation and travel visas. The minister replied that Al Shabaab is covered by UN and EU Somalia sanctions (asset freeze, travel bans, arms embargo) but not by the terrorism lists, that no dossier suitable for EU listing exists, and that the Justice minister will inform parliament by letter on the motions.
The House will shortly be informed by the Minister of Security and Justice, by letter, about the commitments made and motions adopted.
De Kamer wordt binnenkort door de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie door middel van een brief geïnformeerd over de gedane toezeggingen en moties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over mensenrechtenbeleid met betrekking tot Saudi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the government agrees with Amnesty's finding that Dutch and EU support for persecuted Saudi human rights defenders has been weak and whether quiet diplomacy should be replaced. The minister agrees the human rights situation is serious, defends quiet diplomacy with EU coordination, and says it will consult partners on Amnesty's recommendations, noting some are already practiced.
As promised during the Human Rights Policy consultation on 30 September, the cabinet will consult other member states on this and inform the House of the outcomes.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het Notaoverleg Mensenrechtenbeleid op 30 september jl. zal het kabinet zich hierover verstaan met andere lidstaten en de Kamer over de uitkomsten hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht ‘Nederlander onder daders Nairobi’

An MP from the PVV asked the ministers whether a perpetrator of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national, how the AIVD missed him, whether Al-Shabaab should be put on the terror list, and whether he should be denaturalised. The government answered that it has no information showing any perpetrator is Dutch, that the AIVD annual report notes support activities for Al Shabaab in the Netherlands, and that denaturalisation is therefore not applicable.
The cabinet has no information showing that one of the perpetrators of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat een van de daders van de aanslag in Nairobi een Nederlander is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over orgaanhandel in China

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Falun Gong practitioners in China were killed for organ trade and whether China's organ trade complies with international norms, and whether the issue would be raised at China's Universal Periodic Review. The minister said independent verification is not possible, that China's 2007 law exists but implementation and organ statistics remain concerning, and that the issue was not raised in the UPR intervention but will be pursued bilaterally.
Falun Gong and organ trafficking were not raised in the Netherlands' intervention during China's second Universal Periodic Review (22/10).
Nederlandse interventie tijdens China's tweede Universal Periodic Review (22/10) zijn Falun Gong en orgaanhandel niet aan de orde gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Nederlands/Turkse journaliste Fusün Erdogan

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Dutch-Turkish journalist Füsun Erdoğan, held in pretrial detention in Turkey since 2006, including when Dutch authorities were informed, whether her trial was fair, and whether the case was raised in human rights dialogue. The minister answers that the Netherlands follows the case but does not intervene in Turkish legal proceedings, while backing the European Commission's concerns about long pretrial detention and defence rights, and that consular staff visited her and attended her hearing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Koeweit voornemens is bij binnenkomst in het land een ‘medische screening’ te doen om zodoende homoseksuelen te detecteren
