An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Kuwait plans medical screening at entry to identify gay people, whether homosexuals would be unwelcome across GCC states, and whether the government will raise this with Kuwait. The minister answered that the proposal concerns gender tests for visa applicants and seems aimed more at transgender people, that the ambassador did not confirm it, that the government lacks information on GCC-wide exclusion, and that it is monitoring the situation and may act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The cabinet does not have such information.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over zulke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Ojik over het weren van lesbiënnes, homo’s en bi’s in de Golfstaten

Two Green Left MPs asked whether they condemn a reported Kuwaiti proposal for Gulf states to subject visa applicants to sex testing that would target transgender people, and whether they would raise it diplomatically. The minister said the proposal conflicts with equal treatment and the government's values, that the ministry is monitoring the situation and will act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is closely monitoring the situation, is in contact with EU partners, and will take appropriate action jointly with international partners if opportune.

Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken volgt de situatie op de voet, staat in contact met EU-partners en zal indien het opportuun mocht zijn gepaste actie ondernemen gezamenlijk met internationale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Turkse steun aan jihadisten in Syrië

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about alleged Turkish state support for jihadist groups in Syria, the Dutch Patriot deployment in Turkey, and whether an international criminal investigation or diplomatic action was warranted. The minister replied that the Netherlands knows of media reports but has no confirmed evidence of Turkish support, that Turkey denies it, and that cooperation on foreign fighters has been pursued, while rejecting an investigation and leaving Turkish responses to Turkey.
The Netherlands is aware of media reports of alleged Turkish support for jihadist groups in Syria, but is not aware of actual Turkish support for such groups.
Nederland kent de mediaberichten over vermeende Turkse steun aan jihadistische groeperingen in Syrië, maar is niet bekend met daadwerkelijke steun van Turkije aan dergelijke groepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doden van honden in Roemenië

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about Romania's law permitting mass killing of stray dogs and whether the government will raise it with Romania. The government replied that decisions are made case by case by local authorities, that euthanasia must be performed by a vet using a quick, painless method, and that Dutch NGOs can be put in contact with Romanian authorities.
It is for the Romanian authorities to formulate policy in compliance with European and international regulations.
Het is aan de Roemeense autoriteiten om beleid te formuleren met in achtneming van Europese en internationale regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ondergedoken Papua activisten

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would act on reports that Papuan activists linked to the Freedom Flotilla went into hiding after threats from Indonesian police and military, and whether it would press Indonesia and raise the issue in the EU and UN. The minister answered that Indonesia had stated it wanted to avoid force, that the ministry had no information supporting fears for local participants, and that human rights are discussed in the bilateral dialogue and EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no information that could substantiate the concerns of the Freedom Flotilla spokesperson.
Het Ministerie van BZ beschikt niet over informatie die de zorgen van de woordvoerder van de Freedom Flotilla kunnen onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Riyad

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of an ambassador's tweet calling Hajj a showcase of Islam as a religion of peace, asked him to explain that claim, and asked whether the ambassador should be recalled. The minister confirmed awareness of the tweet, said the cabinet does not share the MPs' view of Islam, and refused to recall the ambassador.
Question 4: Will you immediately recall this ambassador, who evidently knows nothing of all these matters or behaves like a dhimmi?
Vraag 4 Wilt u deze ambassadeur, die van al die zaken kennelijk geen weet heeft oftewel zich als een dhimmi gedraagt, onmiddellijk terugroepen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Verheijen en Taverne over de dreigende deportatie van een journalist uit Turkije

Three VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Turkey threatens to deport NRC correspondent Vermeulen as a security risk, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister said the government does not know what the alleged security problem is, that the ministry has raised the case with Turkish authorities and pressed for his right to return and work, and that the government is concerned about press freedom in Turkey.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has raised attention with the Turkish authorities for Mr Vermeulen and urges that he be able to enter Turkey, where he lives, and carry out his work as a journalist there.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft bij de Turkse autoriteiten aandacht gevraagd voor de heer Vermeulen en dringt er op aan dat hij Turkije – waar hij woont – binnen kan komen en daar zijn werkzaamheden als journalist kan verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de bouw van een nieuwe nederzetting op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the construction of a new Israeli settlement (Leshem) on the West Bank, its legal status, the attendance of a minister at its inauguration, its compatibility with the Oslo Accords, and whether the government would call for its dismantling. The minister answered that Leshem is formally treated by Israel as a neighbourhood of Aley Zahav but shows settlement characteristics, that the government considers such construction harmful to the peace process, and that the Dutch position has been conveyed to Israeli authorities without committing to a demand for dismantlement.
The Dutch position on construction in and of settlements is known to the Israeli authorities.
Het Nederlands standpunt ten aanzien van bouw in en van nederzettingen is bekend bij de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de civiele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat der Nederlanden bij militaire uitzendingen

Three VVD MPs asked whether the Supreme Court's 6 September 2013 rulings on State civil liability for the Srebrenica deployment affect future military deployments, local staff, command structures, the Bakker commission framework, and whether such liability can be excluded. The government answered that the rulings rest on Srebrenica-specific facts, do not change current practice, command or the assessment framework, and that excluding liability is not possible.

In future military deployments other facts and circumstances will be at issue. It is therefore not possible to make statements in advance about the possible liability of the State in future deployments.

Bij toekomstige militaire uitzendingen zullen andere feiten en omstandigheden aan de orde zijn. Het is dan ook niet mogelijk op voorhand uitspraken te doen over de eventuele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat bij toekomstige uitzendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Ontmoeting met een Cubaanse blogger

An MP asks the foreign minister why he praised Cuba's reforms and sought closer ties despite reported human rights abuses, and whether he will visit Cuba and inform parliament. The minister replies that reforms are seen as positive, that engagement is more effective than isolation, that human rights are closely monitored, and that he will inform parliament about Cuba policy before the budget debate and before a visit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over sektarisch geweld in Irak

An MP asked the foreign minister about rising sectarian violence in Iraq, alleged torture by Iraqi security services, and the attack on Camp Ashraf, and whether the Iraqi ambassador had been contacted. The minister acknowledges growing sectarian tensions but says a civil war is not yet underway, notes UNAMI's findings on Camp Ashraf and an announced Iraqi investigation, and says contact with the ambassador is regular.
Regarding Camp Hurriya, the Netherlands supports the efforts of the United Nations, both UNAMI and UNHCR, to increase security at Camp Hurriya.
Ten aanzien van Kamp Hurriya steunt Nederland de inspanningen van de Verenigde Naties, zowel van UNAMI als van VN-vluchtelingenorganisatie UNHCR, om de veiligheid in Kamp Hurriya te vergroten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over executies in Indonesië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether senior Dutch political and civil figures, including Prime Minister Beel, knew of summary executions in the Indonesian war while they were ongoing, and why no co-financing was given for research into the period. The minister confirmed that political and military leaders were informed from late 1946 and by February 1947, acknowledged excesses, but refused to co-finance independent research.
In February 1947 Prime Minister Beel was also informed of this.
In februari 1947 was ook minister-president Beel hiervan op de hoogte.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Servaes over de arrestatie van journalist Ali Anouzla in Marokko

MPs Arib and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of journalist Ali Anouzla in Morocco for publishing a link to a terrorist group video, and whether this reflects wider press freedom problems and whether the Netherlands had raised it with Moroccan authorities. The minister answered that the case is a pending court matter, that the Netherlands monitors it and has discussed it with EU partners, and pointed to existing human rights and press freedom programmes with Morocco.
The Netherlands is following this case closely, but will not interfere in an ongoing court case.
Nederland volgt deze zaak nauwlettend, maar zal zich niet mengen in een lopende rechtszaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de Open Ended Working Group

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the UN Open Ended Working Group on nuclear disarmament and whether the government would vote for renewing its mandate. The minister confirmed Dutch participation as 'friend of the chair' and said it is not yet clear whether a renewal resolution will be tabled, so the voting position depends on the text.
At this moment it is not yet clear whether a new resolution will be submitted to the UN General Assembly to extend the OEWG mandate.
Het is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk of er bij de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties een nieuwe resolutie zal worden ingediend om het mandaat van de OEWG te verlengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over mogelijke proliferatie van Syrische chemische wapens

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows of reports that Syria transferred chemical weapons to Hezbollah and Iraqi actors, and what the consequences would be for UN Resolution 2118 and OPCW inspections. The minister answers that the transfers cannot be confirmed, that a breach would violate the resolution, and that the matter will be judged after OPCW verification, so no separate investigation is announced.
The statements by Mr al-Sakat and various other sources that Syria would be moving chemical weapons to Hezbollah and actors in Iraq cannot be confirmed.
De uitspraken van de heer al-Sakat en verschillende andere bronnen dat Syrië chemische wapens zou wegvoeren naar Hezbollah en actoren in Irak kunnen niet worden bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het rapport “Turkey: Gezi Park protests: Brutal denial of the right to peaceful assembly in Turkey

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about an Amnesty report on excessive police force against Gezi Park protesters in Turkey, including whether an independent Turkish investigation took place and whether the Netherlands would accept opening chapter 22 of accession talks without one. The minister said the government shares the report's concerns, notes revised police instructions on force and tear gas, and says an investigation took place, to be addressed in the Commission progress report.
The government shares the view that Turkey must respect the right to peaceful association and assembly and that the police must facilitate demonstrations responsibly.
Het kabinet deelt het oordeel dat Turkije het recht op vreedzame vereniging en vergadering moet respecteren en dat de politie demonstraties op verantwoorde wijze moet begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Kritiek op peperdure EU-campagne’

An MP from the PVV asks the Foreign Minister why EU Parliament election information campaigns cost 6.6 million euro and 41.5 million euro next year, and what the government will do to stop the spending. The minister defends the campaign as informing citizens about the vote, notes the low turnout, and says the government favours a sober EU budget while leaving spending priorities to the European Parliament.
The cabinet favours a sober and efficient EU budget and, as is known, takes a critical stance on the level of administrative spending by the European institutions.
Het kabinet is voorstander van een sobere en efficiënte EU-begroting en neemt zoals bekend een kritische houding aan over de hoogte van de administratieve uitgaven van de Europese instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Bommel over wanbetalende diplomaten

MPs Kooiman and Van Bommel asked whether diplomats unpaid traffic fines can be compelled to pay, given Article 41 of the Vienna Convention, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replies that quarterly reminders and talks with embassies have largely worked, some embassies have agreed to pay, and other coercive measures like withholding plates or parking permits are ruled out by the Vienna Convention.
The Netherlands is bound by the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations and must therefore act within the limits of that convention.
Nederland is gehouden aan het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer en heeft daardoor te handelen binnen de grenzen van dit verdrag
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanval op Camp Ashraf in Irak

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the 1 September 2013 attack on Camp Ashraf in Iraq, which reportedly killed 47 or more Iranian exiles, and about investigations into it and earlier attacks. The minister answered that UNAMI counted 52 deaths, that Iraqi authorities announced investigations whose outcomes are unknown, and that the government has urged Iraq to produce results and supports UN efforts to improve safety.
Both the Netherlands and the European Union have stressed the importance of this to the Iraqi authorities.
Zowel Nederland als de Europese Unie hebben het belang hiervan bij de Iraakse autoriteiten onderstreept.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Servaes over het Russische voornemen kinderen weg te halen bij homoseksuele ouders

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister about a Russian bill that would allow children to be removed from homosexual parents, and whether the Netherlands would act on it. The minister confirmed knowledge of the bill, called it objectionable, estimated possibly over 2 million children affected, and said the Netherlands would raise the issue in EU-Russia human rights channels.

At the next Foreign Affairs Council discussion where Russia is on the agenda, the Netherlands will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and the pending bill, whose adoption is still uncertain.

Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking in de RBZ waar Rusland op de agenda staat de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin en het voorliggende wetsvoorstel, waarvan nog onzeker is of het zal worden aangenomen, aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over het EU-besluit het embargo tegen diamanten uit Zimbabwe op te heffen

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the ministers whether the EU lifting the Zimbabwe diamond embargo was justified, given conditions at the Marange mine and possible ZMDC financing of ZANU-PF, and whether the Kimberley Process should be strengthened. Minister Timmermans answered that the Marange mine met Kimberley Process requirements since late 2012, that ZMDC was delisted for lack of evidence of financing violence, and that broadening the Kimberley Process to human rights had no consensus.

On 25 September 2013 ZMDC was removed from the EU list of restrictive measures, because there are no indications that the company was involved in financing the (limited) violence during the July 2013 elections.

Op 25 september 2013 is ZMDC van de EU-lijst van beperkende maatregelen verwijderd, omdat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat het bedrijf betrokken is geweest bij het financieren van het (beperkte) geweld tijdens de verkiezingen van juli 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de bouw van een Russisch hek aan de Georgische grens

Ten Broeke (VVD) asked the foreign minister whether he agrees that a Russian fence on the Georgian border with South Ossetia violates the 2008 ceasefire, breaches international law and restricts local residents' movement, and what the EU and EUMM can do. The minister confirms the fence, says the Netherlands is concerned and that it conflicts with the 6-point plan, and describes EU and EUMM statements and Geneva talks, while noting the EUMM has no mandate to stop construction.
The EUMM has no mandate to prevent the construction of the fence.
De EUMM heeft geen mandaat om de bouw van de afscheiding tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Oijk over de betrokkenheid van Royal HaskoningDHV bij een illegaal Israëlisch project in Oost-Jeruzalem

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Royal HaskoningDHV's involvement in an Israeli wastewater project in East Jerusalem and Israel's obstruction of Palestinian water authorities, asking whether the government would press Israel on water rights. The minister welcomed the company's withdrawal in principle, said the government had raised the issue with the firm and with Israel, and noted that bilateral water cooperation would be discussed at upcoming consultations, while stating it lacked exact information on the Joint Water Committee.
The government does not have exact information on what is discussed in the Joint Water Committee.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over exacte informatie over hetgeen in de JWC wordt besproken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het Poolse onderzoek naar betrokkenheid bij het CIA rendition programma

MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about Poland's investigation into alleged CIA detention and interrogation sites, including the Council of Europe commissioner's concern about political interference with prosecutors. The minister said the Polish prosecution is conducting an independent investigation, that the Dutch government cannot assess the alleged interference, that he will raise the case with his Polish counterpart, and that the Dutch government has no role in US-Polish cooperation.
As promised during the consultation on Dutch human rights policy (30 September), I will ask my Polish counterpart about the state of affairs when the opportunity arises.
Zoals toegezegd bij het notaoverleg over het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid (30 september jl.) zal ik mijn Poolse collega bij gelegenheid vragen naar de stand van zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over mensenrechtenschendingen in Rusland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked what Dutch and EU action has been taken against Russia's anti-gay propaganda and NGO laws, and whether a state complaint, suspension under Council of Europe Article 8, or a UN resolution is warranted. Minister Timmermans answered that Nederland and the EU have raised concerns repeatedly and will pursue dialogue, UN statements and bilateral initiatives, but judged a state complaint, suspension and a UN resolution not appropriate or lacking support.
The Netherlands wants to focus on broad international attention and dialogue on the legislation and the position of the LGBT community in Russia rather than initiating a bilateral process.
Nederland wil inzetten op brede internationale aandacht en dialoog over de wetgeving en de positie van de LHBT-gemeenschap in Rusland in plaats van een bilateraal proces te entameren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de boycot van Israëlische producten door een aantal supermarkten

MP De Roon (PVV) asked ministers whether planned labelling of settlement products and supermarket boycotts harm Palestinian livelihoods and whether the government would tell retailers that specific labelling is unnecessary. The government replied that labelling advice is not a boycott, that no specific settlement labelling has been decided, that EU origin rules apply to all imports, and that it will inform the retail association of the state of play.
There is no question of a decision on specific labelling of products from settlements.
Er is geen sprake van een besluit tot specifieke etikettering van producten uit nederzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over geweld in de provincie Xinjiang

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about reported deadly violence between police and Uighurs in Xinjiang, China, including whether the dead were terrorists, whether counter-terrorism is overstated, and whether the Netherlands would press China on restraint and fair trials. The minister said the death toll is disputed and unverifiable, that the cabinet cannot judge the terrorist claim, and that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly raised concerns with China.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to make a statement on this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over voldoende informatie om hierover een uitspraak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over NGO-wetgeving in Indonesië

MP Van Bommel asks the Foreign Minister about Indonesia's new law on mass organisations, including whether NGOs can be warned, suspended or banned without court involvement, whether anti-corruption and Papua/Maluku activism is restricted, and whether Dutch unions and NGOs face problems. The minister replies that warnings and up to six-month suspensions are possible without a court, dissolution requires a judge, the law is open to interpretation, no problems have been reported, and the Netherlands raises civil society space in bilateral talks.
The authorities can warn an NGO in writing if they consider that the NGO violates the law.
De autoriteiten kunnen een ngo schriftelijk waarschuwen indien zij menen dat de ngo de wet overtreedt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de zorgen die een Duitse deelstaatpremier en de Senaat en het Huis van Afgevaardigden van Michigan hebben geuit over de sluiting van Nederlandse consulaten

An MP asked the ministers of General Affairs and Foreign Affairs about concerns raised by a German state premier and US Michigan legislative bodies over the closure of Dutch consulates-general in Munich and Chicago. The government answered that consulate closures are necessary to cut about 100 million euro from the network budget, that consular and economic functions will be taken over by alternatives, and that it will not postpone closures pending a full cost-benefit analysis.
The cabinet wants to maintain a worldwide network and keeps as many embassies open as possible.
Het kabinet wil wereldwijd een netwerk behouden en houdt zoveel mogelijk ambassades open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het incident in Khirbet Al-Makhul op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the foreign minister about a clash at Khirbet al-Makhul in the West Bank in which an EU diplomat was reportedly involved, asking whether she joined a protest and whether Israeli forces acted disproportionately. The minister answered that the diplomat accompanied a humanitarian convoy rather than joining the crowd, that the Netherlands considers the Israeli army acted disproportionately, and that EU representatives have requested explanations from Israeli authorities.
Inquiries by the Dutch representation in Ramallah confirm that the diplomat in question did not join the gathered crowd.
Navraag door de Nederlandse vertegenwoordiging in Ramallah bevestigt dat de diplomaat in kwestie zich niet heeft aangesloten bij de verzamelde menigte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voortgaande buitenlandse islamitische inmenging in Nederland

An MP asked the government about foreign Islamic financing of a Rotterdam foundation (reportedly 380,000 USD from the Islamic Development Bank), the risks to integration, and measures against foreign funding of mosques. The minister said foreign funding is permissible but intervention is warranted where core democratic values are at stake, that the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or finances due to church-state separation, and that mosques should be transparent, with additional instruments under review.
I therefore call on mosque boards receiving money from abroad to maximise openness in their financial relations with foreign countries.
Ik roep de moskeebesturen die geld ontvangen vanuit het buitenland dan ook op om maximale openheid te betrachten in de financiële relaties met het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over de dreigementen van de Russische kustwacht aan het adres van het Greenpeace-schip Artic Sunrise

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked the government about Russian coast guard threats to fire on the Greenpeace ship Arctic Sunrise, the denial of access to the Kara Sea, and Russian oil exploration in the Arctic. The minister condemned the threats, invoked UNCLOS coastal-state rules on the Northern Sea Route, reported summoning the Russian ambassador, and referred to earlier policy on Arctic oil exploration.
On 27 August the Russian embassy was summoned to obtain clarification about the inspection of the Arctic Sunrise carried out by Russia.
Op 27 augustus jl. is de Russische ambassade ontboden teneinde opheldering te verkrijgen over de door Rusland uitgevoerde inspectie van de Artic Sunrise.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over verspilling van belastinggeld t.b.v. het oppoetsen van het imago van de EU

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the EU is spending about 7 million euros extra on boosting its public image and whether this is a good use of tax money during the financial crisis. The minister answered that the campaign is a European Parliament information drive for the 2014 elections, that the government supports informing voters and a sober EU budget, but that setting communication priorities is for the Parliament itself.
The cabinet favours a frugal and efficient EU budget and, as is known, takes a critical stance on the level of administrative spending of the European institutions.
Het kabinet is voorstander van een sobere en efficiënte EU-begroting en neemt zoals bekend een kritische houding aan over de hoogte van de administratieve uitgaven van de Europese instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over de discriminatie van homoparen bij interlandelijke adoptie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch intercountry adoption practice through Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions tolerates discrimination against same-sex and non-Christian couples in South Africa, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary replied that the South African discrimination investigation is ongoing, that Abba Adoptions has removed discriminatory criteria, that the Central Authority acted adequately, and that the government is open to a second intermediary and to a possible European working group, without committing to a new discrimination-free alternative.
As I have already shared with your House, there are no longer any discriminatory conditions in the cooperation between Wereldkinderen and Abba Adoptions.
Antwoord 5 Zoals ik al eerder met uw Kamer heb gedeeld 3 , zijn er geen discriminerende voorwaarden meer in de samenwerking tussen Wereldkinderen en Abba adoptions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het weren van diplomaten die hun boetes niet betalen

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch policy allows withdrawal of agrément from diplomats who repeatedly commit traffic offences and do not pay fines, and why the agrément procedure is not more publicly visible. The minister answered that agrément is never withdrawn, that persona non grata is a last-resort instrument with risk to bilateral relations, and that the ministry sends quarterly letters to embassies about unpaid fines.
Agrément is granted but not withdrawn.
Agrément wordt verleend maar niet ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de artikelen ‘de grote voetbalroof’ en ‘onderzoek gewenst naar mensenhandel’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about press reports on investment funds in football, UEFA's Financial Fair Play, possible match-fixing and human trafficking, and whether an investigation or a ban on such funds should follow. The minister answered that there is no evidence of coercion in these cases, that the sector's own rules (KNVB and UEFA) cover independence, and that no investigation or ban is planned, while a pending prosecution inquiry prevents disclosure on match-fixing.

Because of the possible investigative interest – the preliminary inquiry could lead to a criminal investigation, which is not served by premature disclosure of research data – I cannot make substantive statements on this at this time.

Vanwege het mogelijke opsporingsbelang – het voorbereidend onderzoek kan immers leiden tot een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat niet gediend is bij voortijdige openbaarmaking van onderzoeksgegevens – kan ik daarover op dit moment geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht "Israël verbolgen over richtlijnen EU"

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the EU Commission issued guidelines barring EU agreements with Israel from applying to territories occupied since 1967, and whether he would stop them. The minister replied that these are non-binding Commission guidelines consistent with long-standing EU and Dutch policy, that he cannot prevent them, and rejected the calls to cut the EU bureaucrats involved.
No. The Commission can independently adopt guidelines.
Nee. De Commissie kan zelfstandig richtsnoeren vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de opstelling EU en vredesproces Midden-Oosten met betrekking tot de inspanningen van US Secretary of State Kerry

An MP asks the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands views new EU guidelines barring EU funding for Israeli entities beyond the 1967 Green Line, and whether they could undermine US Secretary Kerry's renewed Middle East peace talks. The minister answers that the guidelines follow from established EU policy that settlements are illegal, that the Netherlands welcomes the talks, and that the EU will support the process without linking it to the guidelines.
These guidelines are prompted by the fact that settlements are illegal and form an obstacle to the peace process.
Deze richtsnoeren zijn ingegeven door het feit dat nederzettingen illegaal zijn en een obstakel vormen voor het vredesproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over handel in zand uit West-Sahara

MP Van Bommel asked whether a Groningen-linked shipping company's transport of sand from Western Sahara breached international law, whether proceeds benefit the local population, and whether the government would act against Dutch firms. The minister confirmed the shipment, said economic activity there is not per se unlawful if proceeds benefit the inhabitants, noted no embargo applies, and declined to take action against the shipping company.
Economic activities in Western Sahara are not per se in violation of international law.
Economische activiteiten in de Westelijke Sahara zijn niet per definitie in strijd met het internationaal recht.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over een nieuw protocol voor de Partnerschapsovereenkomst inzake visserij tussen de EU en Marokko (ingezonden 7 augustus

An SP MP asks the ministers whether the new EU-Morocco fisheries protocol covers waters off Western Sahara, whether it complies with international law, and whether the Sahrawi population benefits and controls the funds. The government confirms the protocol covers those waters without implying recognition of Moroccan sovereignty, says funds are conditional on agreement in the Joint Committee, and says it will seek further clarification before forming a final view.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to respond to all parts of publications.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op alle onderdelen van publicaties te reageren.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Gesthuizen en Kooiman (allen SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over ambassades en diplomaten die hun boetes niet betalen (ingezonden 17 juli 2013).

SP MPs asked why diplomats and embassies leave parking and traffic fines unpaid, with about half of Den Haag's CD-plate fines unpaid in 2012 and rising national totals. The ministers confirmed the figures, said quarterly reminders and a single summons had limited effect since no legal enforcement exists, and declined to create a fund or intensify action beyond existing steps.
Such steps yield mixed success, because legal means to enforce payment are not available.
Dergelijke stappen leveren wisselend succes op, omdat wettelijke middelen om de betaling af te dwingen niet ter beschikking staan.

Vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat slechts ongeveer de helft van de diplomaten in Den Haag hun verkeersboete betaa

Two CDA MPs asked whether roughly half of diplomats in The Hague leave their traffic fines unpaid, how many fines Dutch diplomats abroad pay, which countries complained, which ten missions owe the most, and what action is taken. The government confirmed the non-payment, said no central figures exist for fines abroad, listed the ten missions with the largest arrears, and described quarterly reminders and occasional summons, noting it lacks enforcement tools. It also gave a limited answer on minister car fines, pointing to published overviews.
No central figures are available on fines and traffic fines imposed abroad on officials and family members sent out by the Netherlands.
Er zijn op centraal niveau geen cijfermatige gegevens beschikbaar van in het buitenland opgelegde boetes en verkeersboetes aan door Nederland uitgezonden ambtenaren en hun gezinsleden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Ark over het bericht "homo's Rusland digitaal vernederd"

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of digital humiliation of gay people in Russia and about rising anti-LGBT violence after Russia's anti-'homopropaganda' law. The minister acknowledged the law's discriminatory effect, said Nederland will raise LGBT rights with Russia and seek an EU position, and noted IOC assurances that the law will not apply during the Sochi Games.
At the next Foreign Affairs Council meeting, the Netherlands will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly and push for a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.

Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking van de RBZ de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen en bevorderen dat over de anti-homopropagandawet een gezamenlijk EU-standpunt zal worden ingenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over de uitspraken van de Russische minister van Sport

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Russia's anti-gay law would apply to athletes at the Sochi Winter Olympics, whether Russia would guarantee non-interference, and how the Dutch government would act under its human rights note and EU LGBTI guidelines. The government condemned the law as discriminatory, reported the IOC's written guarantee from Russia, and committed to raising the issue in the EU Foreign Affairs Council and in bilateral contacts.
The Netherlands will continue to press internationally that the anti-gay propaganda law not be applied to participants and visitors during the 2014 Winter Games.
Nederland zal in internationaal verband er op blijven aandringen dat de anti-homopropagandawet tijdens de Winterspelen in 2014 niet op deelnemers en bezoekers wordt toegepast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel, Van Dekken en Servaes over berichten inzake de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen van 2014

MPs Yücel, Van Dekken and Servaes asked the government about reports of worsening human rights in Russia ahead of the 2014 Sochi Olympics, including LGBT rights, and what the Netherlands would do about it, and whether personal expression of sexual orientation is compatible with the Olympic Charter. The minister says the Netherlands is concerned, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU fora including a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law, and that personal expression of sexual orientation is not a political statement and not contrary to the Olympic Charter.

The cabinet will raise the human rights situation in Russia broadly at the autumn Foreign Affairs Council, which will prepare the half-yearly EU-Russia Summit, and promote a joint EU position on the anti-homopropaganda law.
Het kabinet zal in de RBZ in het najaar, die de voorbereiding van de halfjaarlijkse EU-Rusland Top ter hand zal nemen, de mensenrechtensituatie in Rusland in brede zin aan de orde stellen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over persvrijheid in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the UK government infringed press freedom in the Guardian/Miranda affair, including alleged pressure to suppress documents, destruction of computers and the detention of a journalist's partner under anti-terrorism powers. The minister confirmed the reported facts in part and said that the UK's democratic oversight mechanisms, including an independent reviewer and parliament, will assess the police conduct, without the Netherlands taking a position.
The democratic control mechanisms function in the British system.
De democratische controlemechanismen functioneren in het Britse systeem.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht van een negatief Nederlands bouwadvies

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister whether the government advised Royal HaskoningDHV to stop building a sewage treatment plant in East Jerusalem, and what legal basis and consequences such advice has. The minister replied that the government only informed the company about the occupation and its obligations, that settlement investment is discouraged as policy, but that companies are not forbidden and bear responsibility themselves.

The Cabinet considers Israeli settlements unlawful and an obstacle to peace and therefore discourages Dutch companies from making investments or undertaking other activities in or for the benefit of Israeli settlements.

Het Kabinet acht Israëlische nederzettingen onrechtmatig en een obstakel voor de vrede en ontmoedigt daarom Nederlandse bedrijven investeringen te doen of andere activiteiten te ontplooien in of ten behoeve van Israëlische nederzettingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Homorechten in de Verenigde Republiek Tanzania

MP Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether they were aware of the Human Rights Watch report on discrimination against sexual minorities in Tanzania and of Zanzibar's president rejecting LGBT rights linked to aid, and what the government would do about criminalisation and abuse of LGBT people, including raising it with President Shein and coordinating EU action. The government said it shares the concerns, will monitor enforcement through the embassy, raised rule of law and human rights in talks with Zanzibar's leaders, and will answer for the upcoming Human Rights policy debate.
As usual, no statements are made about the conversation with the King.
Over het gesprek met de Koning worden zoals gebruikelijk geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over "de islamitische inmenging van Koeweit in Nederland"

MPs Van Klaveren, De Roon and Wilders asked whether Kuwaiti state involvement in the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, including funding and board links, should be tolerated, and whether the mosque should be closed and the Kuwaiti ambassador expelled. The minister said the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or funding absent national security concerns, asked the mosque board for openness on financing, and rejected closure and expulsion.
I do not have information on Kuwait's funding of mosques and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de bekostiging door Koeweit van moskeeën en/of de bestuurders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Van Klaveren over het bericht ‘Asscher’s hypocriete waarschuwing tegen EU-arbeidsmigranten’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Van Klaveren asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a news report on Asscher's warning regarding EU labour migrants, questioning Polish, Romanian and Bulgarian crime and welfare figures and calling for the closure of borders and reintroduction of work permits. Minister Asscher answered that the crime and welfare figures are relatively elevated but must be nuanced, announced a pilot on residence-rights and benefits and a governmental summit on EU labour migration, and stated the transitional restrictions cannot be extended after 1 January 2014.
Under the Accession Treaties, a Member State of the European Union may (under conditions) impose restrictions on the free movement of workers from new member states.
Op basis van de Toetredingsakkoorden kan een lidstaat van de Europese Unie (onder voorwaarden) beperkingen stellen aan het vrij verkeer van werknemers met nieuwe lidstaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over LHBT-gezinnen in Rusland

An MP asked the foreign minister about the Russian anti-gay propaganda law, including fines, child removal from LGBT families, the safety of LGBT families and how the Netherlands will defend their family life rights. The minister answered that no fines or convictions were known nationally yet, that child removal is not in the law, and that the government is concerned and will raise LGBT issues with Russian authorities.
The cabinet is of course concerned about this remark and will follow developments on the matter.
Het kabinet is vanzelfsprekend bezorgd over deze opmerking en zal de ontwikkelingen ter zake volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de gevolgen van het faillissement en de herstart van Better Place inzake accu-oplaadstations

An SP MP asked the Economics and Foreign Affairs ministers about the consequences of Better Place's bankruptcy and relaunch for EU and Dutch support, possible claw-back of subsidies, and whether Dutch and EU engagement with the company was consistent with due diligence regarding Israeli settlements. The minister answered that the cabinet had no prior notice of the relaunch, that the Dutch state had no financial obligations or direct involvement, that the EU subsidy fell under EU guidelines, and that Dutch settlement policy is unchanged.
The cabinet was not informed in advance of the relaunch.
Het kabinet is niet vooraf op de hoogte gesteld van de doorstart.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse regering bezwaar heeft aangetekend tegen de herintreding van Bolivia in het Enkelvoudig Verdrag inzake verdovende middelen uit 196

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands objected to Bolivia's re-accession to the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs with a reservation on traditional coca leaf chewing, and why it did not object to Bolivia's earlier amendment proposal. The minister confirmed the objection, said it concerns the procedure of withdrawal and re-accession with a reservation rather than coca use itself, and refused to withdraw it.
The objection lodged by the Dutch government was prompted by concerns about the integrity of the treaty and the proper application of treaty law in general.
Het door de Nederlandse regering aangetekende bezwaar is ingegeven door zorgen omtrent de integriteit van het verdrag en de juiste toepassing van het verdragenrecht in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Fokke over de toekomst van het European Institute of Public Administration

MPs Verheijen and Fokke asked whether EIPA may leave Maastricht after the Dutch government cuts its subsidy, who will be responsible for its support, and whether the government will consult Limburg and Maastricht. The minister answered that the government is considering an additional regional contribution, that responsibility is still open, and that letters requesting a regional contribution were sent on 2 July, with the Chamber to be informed once EIPA's financial position is clear.
Once there is clarity about EIPA's financial position, the cabinet will inform the Chamber about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is rondom de financiële positie van EIPA zal het kabinet de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht ‘Egypt’s Christians face backlash for Morsi ouster’

An MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about reports that Coptic Christians face backlash after Morsi's ouster, including how many have been attacked, whether the interim government protects minorities, and whether Copts should be treated as a risk group in asylum policy. The minister answered that sectarian violence has increased, the security forces and local authorities have not sufficiently prevented it, but no new country report or asylum risk-group designation is deemed necessary.
There is currently no unambiguous and reliable information available on the number of victims and the number of churches destroyed.
Er is op dit moment geen eenduidige en betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar over aantallen slachtoffers en over aantallen kerken die vernield zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het niet ingrijpen van het Egyptische leger bij moslimgeweld tegen Koptische christenen

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Egyptian army's passivity during attacks on Coptic Christians makes them unprotected, and whether the government will press Egypt's authorities on discrimination and state protection of Christians. The minister acknowledged inadequate protection and lax local authorities, said the government is concerned and raised the issue with Egyptian leaders and in EU Council conclusions, without committing to a specific new step.
It is regrettable that the Egyptian security sector insufficiently prevents violence against Christians.
Het is betreurenswaardig dat de Egyptische veiligheidssector het geweld tegen christenen onvoldoende voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de aanhoudende berichten van geweld tegen Koptische christenen in Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he knew of the Human Rights Watch report on sectarian attacks on Coptic Christians in Egypt and what steps had been taken, including at EU level, to press the Egyptian interim government to protect them. The minister said the government condemns sectarian violence, raised rights and an inclusive transition with Egyptian leaders on 7 August, and that the EU condemned the attacks and addressed them in Council conclusions on 21 August.
The cabinet is concerned about the position of religious minorities in Egypt and condemns all forms of sectarian violence.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de positie van religieuze minderheden in Egypte en veroordeelt iedere vorm van sektarisch geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Christenen die in Nigeria als beesten worden afgeslacht

Two MPs from the PVV asked the foreign minister about reports of Christians being forced to convert and killed in Nigeria, and about alleged Iranian support for militants there. The minister condemned rights abuses, said the Boko Haram attacks also target non-Christians, and said the government has no reliable information confirming Iranian involvement.
The Cabinet does not have reliable information that confirms this assumption.
Het Kabinet beschikt niet over betrouwbare informatie die deze veronderstelling bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over "besmet verklaren" van bezoek aan Australië

MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about an embassy email in Australia telling diplomatic staff, and honorary consuls, not to attend meetings during Wilders' visit, and whether consular assistance was restricted. The minister replied that the request was to avoid the impression of an official visit, that consular help is available to all Dutch citizens, and that no change to consular guidelines is considered necessary.
There was no prohibition on attending as a private person or interested citizen, but on doing so as official representatives of the Netherlands.
Er was geen sprake van een verbod om als privépersoon of geïnteresseerde burger aanwezig te zijn, maar om het feit dat ze niet als officiële vertegenwoordiger van Nederland zouden deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders, De Liefde en Ten Broeke over het importverbod van Rusland op pootaardappelen en plantmateriaal

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the foreign trade minister about Russia's import ban on Dutch seed potatoes and plant material, asking about EU and Dutch action, WTO compliance, and how to prevent such unilateral bans. The government answered that it keeps pressing the European Commission for quick follow-up talks with Russia, supports a derogation and traceability measures, and sees no WTO challenge yet, while acknowledging the ban harms Dutch growers.
I will keep urging the European Commission for swift follow-up steps given the major trade interests of Dutch business.
Ik zal bij de Europese Commissie blijven aandringen op spoedige vervolgstappen gezien de grote handelsbelangen van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Erdogan’s heksenjacht op dissidenten en uitsluiting van niet-moslims

An MP from the PVV asks the government about Erdogan's crackdown on dissidents, arrests of protesters and journalists, exclusion of non-Muslims, and whether a planned Dutch economic mission to Turkey should be cancelled. The minister confirms about 3,600 detentions (most released within 48 hours), says the government will keep a critical rule-of-law dialogue within accession talks, and does not cancel the economic relationship.
In response to recent events, the cabinet, as set out in my letter of 25 June, chooses a credible accession process that adheres to strict accession conditions.
In reactie op de recente gebeurtenissen kiest het kabinet, zoals uiteengezet in mijn brief van 25 juni, voor een geloofwaardig toetredingsproces dat vasthoudt aan strenge toetredingsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het niet terugkeren van Afghaanse diplomaten naar Afghanistan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about media reports that Afghan diplomats in Germany are not returning to Afghanistan, and whether Afghan officials visiting the Netherlands have applied for asylum or disappeared. The government said it has no clear evidence of a trend, that the IND does not register professions so the figures cannot be generated, and that there is no specific EU policy beyond visa rules.
The IND does not register the profession of an asylum applicant in its systems.
Door de IND wordt de professie van een asielaanvrager niet in de systemen geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de afwijzing van het herzieningsverzoek van dienstweigeraars Nederlands-Indië

MP Van Bommel (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government would act after the Supreme Court rejected the review request of two conscientious objectors convicted in the 1950s for refusing service in the Dutch East Indies, including whether it would legislate rehabilitation. The Defence minister answered no: judges applied the norms of the time, reassessing conduct by today's standards would not be careful, and no rehabilitation law is planned.
I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons against contemporary norms and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen te herbeoordelen aan de hand van hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink over de afwijzing van het herzieningsverzoek van dienstweigeraars Nederlands-Indië

An MP asked whether Dutch courts' 2013 rulings on Indonesia-era conscientious objectors imply that political bodies should consider rehabilitating them, and whether their convictions and rehabilitation can be reconsidered. The minister answered that such assessments belong to politics, that the military deployment had democratic legitimacy and the law then provided for conscientious objection, and that reassessing individual conduct by today's standards would not be careful, so no further rehabilitation mechanism is planned.
I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against contemporary norms and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de moord op een homo-activist in Kameroen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister how the government would respond to the murder of gay rights activist Eric Lembembe in Cameroon, including pressing for investigation, decriminalisation, and monitoring and protecting LHBT people. The minister condemned the killing, said the Netherlands is acting mainly through the EU since closing its Yaoundé embassy, and that the EU High Representative called on Cameroon to prosecute the perpetrators, with monitoring to continue.
At the Dutch request, High Representative Ashton called on the Cameroonian government to track down and prosecute the perpetrators.
Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Ashton heeft op Nederlands verzoek de Kameroenese regering opgeroepen de daders op te sporen en te berechten.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over het bericht dat Europese rechters de sancties tegen Iran ondergraven

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether EU courts undermining Iran sanctions by requiring disclosure of secret information is acceptable, whether some member states enforce sanctions less actively, and whether sanctioning entire sectors would avoid the problem. The minister answered that confidential information may be shared with an independent court without necessarily breaching confidentiality, that he has no reason to think member states fail to enforce sanctions, and that sanctions are chosen for effectiveness.
In my view, sharing information with an independent judge does not necessarily mean that the confidentiality of the information is breached.
Het delen van informatie met een onafhankelijke rechter betekent in mijn ogen niet noodzakelijkerwijs dat de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie wordt geschonden.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke en Van Ojik over de arrestatie van vier Nederlandse documentairemakers in Moermansk op verdenking van 'homopropaganda'

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest in Murmansk of four Dutch documentary makers on suspicion of 'homopropaganda', and whether they could leave Russia and what the government would do about the law's effect on journalists. The minister answered that the group left Russia after paying small fines for a visa violation, the propaganda charge was dismissed on procedural grounds, and the government raised the matter with Russian authorities and the EU's High Representative, and will raise LGBT rights again at the next Foreign Affairs Council.
At the next discussion of developments in Russia in the Council, the Netherlands will again raise attention to LGBT rights in that country, partly in response to this matter.
Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking van ontwikkelingen in Rusland in de Raad opnieuw aandacht vragen voor LHBT-rechten in dat land, mede naar aanleiding van deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over persvrijheid en demonstraties in Turkije

An MP asks the foreign minister about press freedom in Turkey, including journalist dismissals, arrests of demonstrators, use of anti-terrorism law and police violence. The minister confirms awareness, reports around 3,600 detentions (most released within 48 hours), no known anti-terrorism charges, five deaths, and that the outcome of investigations into excessive force is not yet clear.
There is not yet a clear picture of the progress and/or outcomes of such investigations, including that of the Turkish National Ombudsman.
Er is nog geen helder beeld van de voortgang en/of uitkomsten van dergelijke onderzoeken, waaronder dat van de Turkse Nationale Ombudsman.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en voor Buitenlande Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over geweld in Soedan en in Zuid-Soedan en de precaire situatie tus

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign and trade ministers about renewed violence and a precarious relationship between Sudan and South Sudan, covering Darfur, Abyei, the Nuba Mountains, civil society, aid and EU/AU mediation, in 15 questions. The government's follow-up answer only says a NGO report on South Kordofan and Blue Nile would be sent separately, and that this report has not yet been published.
The report states that a new version would become available on 3 July 2013. However, this report has not yet been published.
In het rapport staat aangegeven dat een nieuwe versie beschikbaar zou komen op 3 juli 2013. Dit rapport is echter nog niet uitgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de deelname van Sam Rainsy aan de Cambodjaanse verkiezingen

An MP asked the foreign minister about Sam Rainsy's exile, the Paris Peace Agreements, and whether the Netherlands would press for charges and immunity to be lifted so he could contest the 2013 Cambodian elections. The minister acknowledged concern about freedom of expression, said Cambodia's election schedule meets the Paris Agreement, and noted the EU's technical assistance and that Rainsy had been pardoned and was expected to return.
It is worrying that freedom of expression is under pressure.
Het is zorgelijk dat de vrijheid van meningsuiting onder druk staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de inperking van de internetvrijheid in Singapore

An MP asked the foreign minister about Singapore's new licensing requirement for news websites with at least 50,000 visitors and the 24-hour takedown rule, and whether the Netherlands would act. The minister answered that the content standards are unchanged, the impact is limited, and the embassy will monitor the matter with EU partners but no direct step to Singapore is planned.
The impact of the new regulations is limited.
De impact van de nieuwe regelgeving is beperkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bonis over Israëlische luchtaanval op Damascus

An MP from the Labour Party asked the foreign minister about an Israeli airstrike on a Syrian military complex near Damascus, its escalation risks, and whether the government would seek clarification from Israel and push for an emergency UN Security Council session. The minister said the government is aware of the media reports, shares concern about spillover, has no information giving reason to ask Israel for clarification, and has repeatedly urged UN Security Council action.
I do not have information that gives me cause to ask the Israeli government for clarification.
Ik beschik niet over informatie die mij aanleiding geeft de Israëlische regering om opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Europese subsidies voor Israëlische bedrijven in de militaire industrie en Israëlische bedrijven die in illegale nederzettingen actief zijn

An MP asked the foreign minister whether EU research subsidies under FP7 went to Israeli defence firms and firms active in illegal settlements, and whether such funding should be excluded under Horizon 2020. The minister confirmed some grants, said the Commission has no overview of settlement-linked grants, and said the Commission is exploring criteria changes, with the Netherlands favouring alignment with EU arms-export criteria.
Once these have led to more clarity on the technical and legal (im)possibilities of adjusting the criteria, your House will be informed about this.
Zodra deze hebben geleid tot meer duidelijkheid over de technische en juridische (on)mogelijkheden van aanpassing van de criteria, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over Iran

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Iran runs a terror and intelligence network through its embassies in South America, including Suriname, and about Canada closing its Iranian embassy. The minister said the ministry has received no signals of Iranian use of its posts in Suriname for intelligence or terror, that unconfirmed reports circulate and services monitor foreign interference without public disclosure, and that Canada expelled Iranian diplomats and closed its embassy in Teheran.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has received no signals that Iran uses its diplomatic network for intelligence services and terror attacks in Suriname.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen signalen gekregen dat Iran het postennetwerk gebruikt voor inlichtingendiensten en terreuraanslagen in Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bonis over een wetsvoorstel van de Israëlische regering strekkende tot de gedwongen verplaatsing van tienduizenden bedoeïenen

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the Israeli government's bill to forcibly relocate 20,000 to 40,000 Bedouin from the Negev into townships, whether he shares Amnesty's view that it violates international law, and whether he will press Israel on it during his visit. The minister confirms awareness, declines to judge a bill still before the Israeli legislature, and states that the Netherlands engages Israel structurally on human rights including the Arab minority.
It is not for the Dutch cabinet to pass judgment on a bill that still has to be definitively assessed by the Israeli legislature.
Het is niet aan het Nederlandse kabinet om een oordeel uit te spreken over een wetsvoorstel dat nog definitief door de Israëlische wetgevende macht moet worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, de Roon, Madlener en van Klaveren over de samenwerking tussen de EU en de Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about EU cooperation with the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, including its observer status, its stance on criticism of Islam and whether the EU should end contacts. The minister rejected most premises, affirmed continued support for free expression and religious freedom, and declined to end the observer status.
No. However, the OIC has for some time paid considerable attention to combating religious intolerance.
Nee. Wel heeft de OIC al geruime tijd veel aandacht voor het tegengaan van religieuze intolerantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berckmoes-Duindam over resolutie van Parlementaire Assemblee van de OVSE over water en veiligheid

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he knows the OSCE Parliamentary Assembly resolution making water management and security a 2014 OSCE priority, whether he supports that focus, and whether he will press for it at the OSCE ministerial. The minister confirmed awareness, outlined Dutch water diplomacy efforts, and said he will raise water management with the Swiss counterpart before the December ministerial.
I intend to discuss water management with my Swiss counterpart already before the OSCE Ministerial Council in December.
Ik ben voornemens om reeds voorafgaande aan de Ministeriële Raad van de OVSE in december watermanagement te bespreken met mijn Zwitserse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de grondrechtensituatie in Hongarije

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about the fundamental rights situation in Hungary following the European Parliament's Tavares report, including whether the European Council should respond, whether an 'Article 2 trilogue' should be created, and whether EPP party contacts had worked. The minister said Commission and Venice Commission dialogue has been constructive and that Netherlands opposes country-specific mechanisms, while supporting a general EU rule-of-law mechanism; he acknowledged the EPP efforts had not yet produced results.
In addition, the cabinet is working to develop an additional rule-of-law mechanism within the EU, as recently discussed again in the General Affairs Council.
Daarnaast zet het kabinet zich in voor de ontwikkeling van een aanvullend rechtsstaatelijkheidsmechanisme binnen de EU, zoals onlangs wederom besproken in de Raad Algemene Zaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over Nederlandse sponsoring van een Turks festival in Turkije

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands sponsored a Turkish festival in Bodrum with taxpayer money and whether it would be recovered. The minister confirmed a 5,000 euro contribution to the International Bodrum Carnival to showcase Dutch culture and two Dutch bands, and defended cultural promotion abroad as serving Netherlands' international image.
The Netherlands contributed 5,000 euros to the International Bodrum Carnival in Bodrum, with the aim of introducing a Turkish and international audience to Dutch culture.
Nederland heeft 5.000 euro bijgedragen aan het International Bodrum Carnival in Bodrum, met als doel een Turks en internationaal publiek te laten kennismaken met Nederlandse cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de ledenr Omtzigt, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de EU-richtsnoeren over vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the minister did not inform parliament in advance about the EU guidelines on freedom of religion or belief adopted in June 2013, and whether the Netherlands would discuss a ranking of persecuted religious minorities in EU fora. The minister answered that the guidelines were prepared in the Council working group, were not discussed substantively at the Foreign Affairs Council, will be communicated to parliament by letter, and that the freedom of religion topic will be raised in EU consultations after parliament debates the human rights note.
As promised to your House during the committee meeting on freedom of religion of 15 May, your House will be informed by letter about the adoption of these guidelines.
Zoals tijdens het AO godsdienstvrijheid van 15 mei jl. aan uw Kamer toegezegd, wordt uw Kamer per brief over de aanname van deze richtsnoeren geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de nieuwe NGO-wet in Egypte

Six MPs asked the foreign minister whether Egypt's draft NGO law, despite amendments, still violates freedoms of expression and assembly, threatens human rights work and civil society, and whether the Netherlands has raised objections. The minister agreed the draft appears to conflict with Egypt's international obligations, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the law is not yet adopted, with the EU to raise it if adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nonetheless become law, I will raise it as soon as possible within the EU framework.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie van Niet-Gouvernementele Organisaties (NGO's) en NGO-medewerkers in Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister about Egypt's crackdown on NGOs, including a court ruling against foreign NGO staff and a restrictive draft NGO law. The minister expressed serious concern, said the ruling violates freedom of association, and described diplomatic efforts with Egypt and EU statements, while stating no EU measures are yet warranted because the draft law is not adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nevertheless become law, I will raise it in the EU as soon as possible.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Syrië

MP Ten Broeke asks the Foreign Minister whether the US claim that Assad used sarin, and the evidence behind it, changes the Dutch assessment, whether chemical weapons use is a red line, and whether the OPCW/UN investigation is still active. The minister replies that the Dutch government is seriously concerned, that the underlying evidence is not known to it, that chemical weapons use is prohibited by international law regardless of perpetrator, and that Syria has refused the UN team free access beyond one site.
The data underlying those statements are not known to the cabinet, and therefore the cabinet cannot make any statements about them.
De gegevens die ten grondslag liggen aan genoemde verklaringen zijn het kabinet niet bekend en hierdoor kan het kabinet daarover dus geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de Baltic Pride in Litouwen

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Vilnius authorities were effectively blocking the 2013 Baltic Pride march, whether he had raised it with Lithuania, and whether he would press the issue at EU level. The minister replied that the dispute concerned venue logistics rather than a ban, that the issue was raised in the EU human rights working group, and that the Netherlands supports LGBT rights through its embassy and EU policy without committing to a specific new step.

There is no ban by the Vilnius municipality on the planned Baltic Pride on 27 July, but there is a dispute between the municipality and the organisers of the Baltic Pride over the location where the Pride will take place.

Er is geen sprake van een verbod van de gemeente Vilnius op de geplande Baltic Pride op 27 juli, maar wel van een geschil tussen de gemeente en de organisatoren van de Baltic Pride over de locatie waar de Pride zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Yücel over de arrestatie van tientallen mensen tijdens een Gay Pride demonstratie in Rusland

MPs Servaes and Yücel asked the foreign minister about police ending a Gay Pride demonstration in St Petersburg and arresting dozens under Russia's new anti-propaganda law, and whether he had raised concerns with Russian counterparts and how Russian civil society could be supported. The minister confirmed the facts, condemned the dispersal, said the government raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and pledged continued support for projects on acceptance and free expression.
The government will keep repeating, in bilateral talks and at EU level, that the new legislation has a stigmatising effect.
Het kabinet zal blijven herhalen, in bilaterale gesprekken en in EU-verband, dat de nieuwe wetgeving een stigmatiserende werking heeft
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the Koning Willem-Alexander water project in Israel, focusing on the Joods Nationaal Fonds' links to KKL-JNF, its statutes, control over its board, and whether projects are open to all groups. The minister answered that the foundation is statutorily tied to KKL-JNF but says it operates autonomously, the project is run by KKL-JNF and projects are within internationally recognised borders and accessible to all population groups.
The board of the foundation operates autonomously and makes its own considerations.
Het bestuur van de stichting opereert autonoom en maakt zijn eigen afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de besteding van EU-geld aan Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister about the Court of Auditors' finding that EU aid to Egypt failed to improve governance, its transparency and conditionality, and whether EU funds should be recovered or frozen. The minister acknowledged serious shortcomings, said the EU is now withholding about EUR 200 million pending reforms, and stated the Commission is responsible for enforcing conditionality.
The cabinet broadly agrees with the Court of Auditors' recommendations to increase the effectiveness of aid.
Het kabinet is het in de kern eens met de aanbevelingen die de Rekenkamer doet om de effectiviteit van steun te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Ten Broeke over het bericht «EU-miljard voor Egypte verdween in zwart gat»

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a newspaper report that EU aid of a billion euros to Egypt had disappeared, and about the European Court of Auditors' critical findings on the use of the funds. The minister acknowledged serious shortcomings, said the Netherlands had pressed the Commission and EEAS for stricter conditions, noted that Egypt's remaining aid is withheld pending IMF-linked reforms, and said Dutch bilateral aid carries negligible risk of misuse.
The Netherlands argued that this critical report again confirms the need to set clearer conditions on the use of funds for the Arab region.
Nederland heeft ingebracht dat dit kritische rapport nog eens de noodzaak bevestigt van het stellen van duidelijkere voorwaarden aan de besteding van fondsen voor de Arabische regio

Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Servaes over het bericht ‘Barrières terug van weggeweest. Nederlandse technologiebedrijven krijgen zelfs binnen EU met belemmeringen te maken’ zoals gepubliceerd in Trouw op 19 jun

MPs Jan Vos and Servaes asked ministers whether they agree that trade barriers facing Dutch tech firms, both inside and outside the EU, are a bad development and what the government will do about them. The government agreed barriers are undesirable, said most reported obstacles concern non-EU export markets, and pointed to EU initiatives, Solvit, the trade barrier complaint point and diplomatic posts as support tools.
I am happy to consult with FME-CWM to further clarify the identified problems.
Ik ga graag in overleg met FME-CWM om de gesignaleerde problemen nader te duiden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over afgeluisterde EU-diplomaten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether the government would raise with the US the reported NSA surveillance of EU diplomats in Washington, Brussels and New York. The government said it had raised the matter at high level, that European and American experts will examine intelligence gathering and data protection together, and that next steps will follow from their findings.
European and American experts will jointly examine the issues of intelligence gathering and data protection.
Europese en Amerikaanse experts zullen zich gezamenlijk buigen over de problematiek van inlichtingenvergaring en dataprotectie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over een eventuele bijdrage van Nederland aan de EU trainingsmissie in Mali

Christian Democrat MPs Omtzigt and Knops asked why the Netherlands offered troops to the EU training mission in Mali without informing parliament, why the offer was not coordinated with Belgium, and whether defence cuts motivated participation. The government answered that the offer was made under political reservation during the force generation process, that the mission had no current need for it, and that participation decisions rest on substantive grounds, not budget considerations.
If the cabinet again considers a Dutch contribution in the future, the House will be informed about it.
Als het kabinet in de toekomst opnieuw een Nederlandse bijdrage overweegt, wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanval op Iraanse ballingen in Irak

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether a rocket attack killing two Iranian exiles at Camp Hurriya in Iraq warrants an independent investigation and prosecution, and whether the Netherlands will press for resettlement of camp residents. The minister confirmed the attack, said the Netherlands supports independent investigation, noted Iraqi authorities have opened an inquiry without a known outcome, and stated the Netherlands only admits residents who hold Dutch nationality while the EU has no common resettlement policy.
Following the attack on Camp Hurriya in February, the Iraqi authorities launched an investigation whose outcome is not yet known.
Naar aanleiding van de aanval in Kamp Hurriya in februari jl. hebben de Iraakse autoriteiten een onderzoek ingesteld waarvan de uitkomst op dit moment nog niet bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de gewelddadigheden rondom de opening van een “LGBT support center” in Skopje, Macedonië

An MP asks the foreign minister about an attack by anti-LGBT demonstrators on an LGBT support centre in Skopje during Pride Week, and whether the Dutch embassy and the minister raised it with Macedonian counterparts. The minister confirms the incident, says the embassy and ministry were in contact, reports that the ambassador raised concerns with the Macedonian foreign minister and in writing with the Macedonian embassy in The Hague and EU working groups, and that the EU will raise it at a Stabilisation and Association Council.
On 26 June the Dutch ambassador explained the Dutch concerns in a personal conversation with the Macedonian foreign minister.
Op 26 juni jl. heeft de Nederlandse ambassadeur de Nederlandse zorgen in een persoonlijk gesprek met de Macedonische minister van Buitenlandse Zaken nader toegelicht
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een Brits inreisverbod voor Islamcritici

An MP asked the foreign minister about a UK entry ban on US commentators Pamela Geller and Robert Spencer and whether the Netherlands should press the UK over it. The minister said free speech matters but that UK authorities must weigh each case, and saw no reason to doubt the UK Home Office considered free speech.
I share your view that safeguarding freedom of expression is an important task of the government.
Ik deel uw mening dat het waarborgen van de vrijheid van meningsuiting een belangrijke taak van de overheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Agnes Mulder over geweld in Sudan en in Zuid-Sudan en de precaire situatie tussen beide landen
