Two MPs from the CDA asked the government about violence in Sudan and South Sudan, human rights abuses, humanitarian access, the Abyei dispute, the suspension of oil transport, civil society space and the future of EU and AU mediation roles. The government answered at length, noting concern, backing AU-led mediation and cross-line humanitarian access, but declined to commit to new fact-finding missions and said the EU Special Representative's mandate would be transferred.
To verify the data in these reports, humanitarian access to these areas is needed, as well as an independent investigation into the human rights situation in South Kordofan and Blue Nile.

Om de gegevens in genoemde rapporten te kunnen verifiëren is humanitaire toegang tot deze gebieden nodig, alsmede een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de mensenrechtensituatie in South Kordofan en Blue Nile.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de administratieve detentie van Ahmad Qatamesh door Israël

An MP asks the foreign minister about the administrative detention of Palestinian writer Ahmad Qatamesh by Israel, including his extended detention without charge, his health, his transfer to an Israeli prison, and whether the Netherlands will press Israel for release. The minister confirms the key facts, says the transfer appears to breach humanitarian law, and states the government follows the matter closely with Israel and in EU contacts without committing to a specific demand for release.
The cabinet is of the view that the situation of Palestinian prisoners in Israeli detention deserves prominent attention.
Het kabinet is van mening dat de situatie van de Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische detentie prominente aandacht verdient.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking Uyghur interpreters suspected of leaking confidential information to Chinese authorities, whether they face prosecution, how they passed vetting, and what is being done for affected asylum seekers. The state secretary answered that a criminal complaint was filed, the interpreters were excluded from further use, all asylum cases were re-assessed with almost all granted asylum, and no Uyghurs were returned to China.
The IND has filed a criminal complaint against the interpreters concerned.
Er is door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) aangifte gedaan tegen de betreffende tolken.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over wapenleveranties aan Indonesië

Two SP MPs asked whether Vulcano 76mm naval gun ammunition, possibly used on frigates being supplied to Indonesia, is designed for ground targets and whether the Netherlands co-funds it, and whether this conflicts with the government's view on internal tensions. The minister answered that the Netherlands is not involved in developing that ammunition, that it contributed about EUR 6.2 million to a different Vulcano 127mm program, that the frigate supply was assessed against the eight export criteria, and that no known involvement of Indonesian navy equipment in repression has occurred since 1998.
These questions will be answered as soon as possible.
Deze vragen worden op de kortst mogelijke termijn beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over recent geweld in Irak

MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about deadly clashes and protests in Iraq, including reports of dozens killed and detained demonstrators, and whether the government would press Iraqi counterparts for restraint and humane treatment. The minister confirmed the casualty figures, described the Sunni marginalisation and the need for dialogue, and said the Netherlands supports EU efforts for dialogue and prison and justice reform.
Inquiries show that it is not possible to say exactly how many demonstrators are being held.
Navraag leert dat niet precies valt aan te geven hoeveel demonstranten worden vastgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Maij, Servaes en Bonis over voorgestelde wetgeving in Litouwen en Macedonië die de toegang tot abortus zal beperken

Three PvdA MPs asked the Dutch government whether it is aware of proposed abortion restrictions in Lithuania and North Macedonia, whether it considers this worrying for women's health and rights, and whether it will raise concerns with those governments. The minister replied that reproductive rights are fundamental human rights and that Dutch concern is noted, that a Lithuanian bill is pending in committee and a Macedonian law is said by its government not to be more restrictive, and that the Netherlands will raise reproductive health policy in human rights reporting forums.

The Netherlands will raise the policy on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights, including abortion legislation and its implementation, in the appropriate forums during the review of human rights reports.

Nederland zal bij de behandeling van mensenrechtenrapportages het beleid omrent Seksuele en Reproductieve Gezondheid en Rechten, inclusief abortuswetgeving en de uitvoering daarvan aan de orde stellen in de daarvoor geëigende gremia.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rechtmatigheid van Amerikaanse drone aanvallen in Pakistan

An MP asked the foreign minister whether US drone strikes in Pakistan are lawful, given repeated Pakistani objections, a parliamentary resolution and a UN rapporteur's statement that they violate sovereignty, and whether the minister would press the US to stop them. The minister confirmed the cited statements but declined to conclude the strikes are unlawful, calling consent a bilateral matter, and saw no reason to press the US, while noting general engagement on transparency.
Whether consent is given is ultimately a bilateral matter between the US and Pakistan, in which the cabinet does not have full insight.
Het al dan niet geven van toestemming is uiteindelijk een bilaterale aangelegenheid tussen de VS en Pakistan, waarin het kabinet geen volledig inzicht heeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de anti-homowet in Rusland

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about Russia's anti-gay law, the safety of LGBT people and NGOs, foreign-agent rules, EU human rights strategy, and Dutch steps taken. The minister said he is concerned about the law's signal effect, will monitor NGO court cases in EU framework, and raised the issue with Russian officials.
The intention is to continue following the court cases against NGOs under the foreign agent legislation within the EU framework, if the NGO concerned wishes this.
Het voornemen is om de rechtszaken tegen NGO's n.a.v. de «foreign agent»-wetgeving te (blijven) volgen in EU-verband, indien de betreffende NGO dit wenst.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Madlener over het bericht 'Poll:39% Nederlanders wil uit de EU'

PVV MPs Wilders and Madlener asked whether the government will prepare for Dutch withdrawal from the EU after a poll showing 39% support for leaving, and whether a referendum will be held. The minister replied that the government takes citizens' concerns seriously and will pursue EU reform, that withdrawal is not on the table, and that no referendum is needed.
A departure of the Netherlands from the EU is not on the table as far as the cabinet is concerned.
Een vertrek van Nederland uit de EU is wat het kabinet betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de inzet van chemicaliën tegen betogers in Turkije

MP Thieme asked the Foreign Minister whether the reported use of chemicals against protesters in Istanbul is disproportionate and whether the government will raise its concerns with Turkey. Minister Timmermans said he deplores the excessive force, shared his concerns with his Turkish counterpart, who promised an investigation, and that good relations allow mutual concerns to be voiced.
I deplore the excessive violence used against demonstrators, such as during the clearing of Taksim Square and Gezi Park on the weekend of 15 and 16 June.
Ik betreur het buitensporige geweld dat is gebruikt tegen demonstranten, zoals bij de ontruiming van het Taksimplein en het Gezi park in het weekend van 15 en 16 juni.
Antwoord vragen Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht “Afghaanse tolk vreest bijltjesdag”

D66 MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether Afghan interpreters working for the Dutch mission in Kunduz face danger after the withdrawal, how many are employed, whether asylum claims are expected, and whether a lighter regime or contact with Germany is planned. The ministers replied that the situation is unforeseeable, some safety measures and an inventory have been made, four monitors and sixteen interpreters are under German contracts, asylum claims are assessed individually without a special collective scheme, and contact with Germany exists.
We see no reason for a special (collective) arrangement.
We zien geen aanleiding voor een bijzondere (collectieve) regeling.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over het rapport 'Failing to make the grade' over de situatie van de Palestijnse bevolking in area C gebied van de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Oxfam-linked report finding little progress since EU Council conclusions of May 2012 on Palestinian living conditions in Area C of the West Bank, including demolitions, master plan approvals, PA control and donor project permits. The minister acknowledged the lack of progress as regrettable, described Dutch coordination and funding efforts, said no master plans had been approved, and withheld permit data as unavailable.
Information on permits rejected or granted by Israel in Area C is not available.
Informatie over vergunningen die door Israël zijn afgewezen of afgegeven in area C is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Poolse betrokkenheid bij het CIA rendition programma

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Polish involvement in the CIA rendition programme, the Amnesty International report, the long-running Polish criminal investigation and whether Poland meets its international obligations. The minister answered that the investigation is an independent Polish judicial matter, that the government will not speculate on its findings or delays, and that it has no reason to think Poland disregards its international obligations.

Pending the outcome of this independent judicial investigation, the cabinet sees no reason to speculate about its possible findings, or about possible reasons why the investigation has not yet been concluded.

Hangende de uitkomsten van dit onafhankelijke, justitiële onderzoek ziet het kabinet geen reden te speculeren over mogelijke bevindingen daarvan, noch over mogelijke redenen waarom het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het terugsturen van negen gevluchte Noord-Koreanen naar hun eigen land

An SGP MP asked the foreign minister about the forced return of nine Korean refugees from Laos via China, the risks they face, China's and Laos's non-refoulement practice, and steps to press China, Laos and North Korea. The minister answered that the cabinet is concerned, that UNHCR lacks access and China does not treat North Koreans as refugees, and that the Netherlands and EU will raise non-refoulement with China and Laos and voice concerns to North Korea.
The Netherlands and the EU will raise the principle of non-refoulement with Laos through an EU-level demarche and during the EU-Laos human rights dialogue.
Nederland en de EU zullen Laos aanspreken op het principe van non-refoulement door het uitvoeren van een demarche op EU niveau en tijdens de EU-Laos mensenrechtendialoog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en en Van Raak over Nederlandse jihadisten

MPs Van Bommel and Van Raak asked whether the AIVD contacted a Dutch jihadist returnee codenamed 'Salem', whether he was turned away by the Tripoli embassy, and what the government does to gather information from returning jihadists. The minister declined to give concrete public information on AIVD contacts, said the embassy inquiry could not be resolved given the anonymous source, and stated the AIVD prioritises research into jihadist travel and return.
I cannot make any concrete public statements about AIVD contacts.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over contacten van de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over door het Internationaal Strafhof vrijgesproken verdachten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how acquitted ICC suspect Ngudjolo could be released on Dutch soil, whether the ICC met its host-state duties, and how witnesses or acquitted suspects excluded from asylum under Article 1F would be handled. The government answered that the ICC must arrange transfer after acquittal, Dutch authorities facilitate it, structural arrangements with the ICC registry are being developed, and detained witnesses' cases are discussed in that context without individual details.
Regarding the status of the procedure, I maintain the principle that I do not comment on individual cases.
Wat betreft de stand van de procedure hanteer ik het uitgangspunt dat ik niet inga op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Madlener over de absurde verhoging van de EU-uitgaven aan ontwikkelingshulp

Two PVV MPs asked why EU development spending is rising, including the planned EDF amount for 2014-2020 and Dutch contributions, and whether the government will stop the flow of Dutch money to development aid. The minister confirmed Dutch EU development contributions of about 507 million euro for 2013, explained that the final EDF 2014-2020 envelope was lowered to 30.5 billion euro, and said the Regeerakkoord cuts the ODA budget by 750 million euro per year in 2014-2016 and 1 billion euro from 2017.
The coalition agreement includes a substantial cut target for the development cooperation budget.
In het Regeerakkoord is een forse taakstelling opgenomen met betrekking tot het budget voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over het gezag van het Internationaal Strafhof in Afrika

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the government how it responds to African Union accusations that the ICC targets Africans, to the AU call to refer the Kenyatta and Ruto cases to Kenyan courts, and to the effects on the ICC's standing, and what the Netherlands did at the AU summit. The minister rejects the AU claims, notes the ICC acts independently and that half of African situations were referred by states or the UN Security Council, says the Kenyan admissibility challenge was rejected, and describes bilateral and EU efforts to support the ICC in Africa without committing to a new report on the summit.
The cabinet disagrees with the statements of the African Union chairperson, Hailemariam Desalegn, which imply that the ICC is biased.
Het kabinet is het oneens met de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Afrikaanse Unie, Hailemariam Desalegn, waarin wordt geïmpliceerd dat het ICC vooringenomen zou zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel 'Timmermans goede bedoelingen brengen Syrië dichter bij de hel'

MP Omtzigt asks the Foreign Minister whether arming Syrian rebels and recognising the Syrian National Coalition are compatible with international law, citing the non-intervention principle, Austria's position, and risks of weapons reaching extremists. Minister Timmermans answers that recognition is a political act, that arms supply is not currently under consideration, that non-intervention is a norm which may be set aside in exceptional cases, and refers to a letter of 4 June for legal analysis, declining to seek new advice or publish the legal opinions.
For the reasons stated in the above letter, the cabinet understands that the non-intervention principle is coming under pressure.
Vanwege de redenen aangegeven in bovengenoemde brief heeft het kabinet er begrip voor dat het non-interventiebeginsel onder druk komt te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Omtzigt over een werkbezoek aan het Internationaal Strafhof

MPs Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the ICC's staffing shortage, the consequences of closing the Scheveningen prison for detainees, and whether witnesses are admitted to the Netherlands long enough. The minister said the Netherlands is in dialogue with the ICC and supports strengthening its investigative capacity, referred the prison question to the Justice State Secretary's earlier answer stating detention for international tribunals continues in Scheveningen, and said he was unaware of witness admission problems, pointing to the host-state agreement.
The Netherlands is aware of the ICC's concerns about limited staffing capacity and is in dialogue with the ICC about it.
Nederland is bekend met de zorgen van het ICC over de beperkte personele capaciteit en is hierover met het ICC in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Graus over het bericht “EU wil meer concurrentie met haven Rotterdam”

PVV MPs Madlener and Graus asked ministers whether the government would act against EU port-liberalisation proposals that could strengthen competitors of Rotterdam and how much EU money would fund them. The minister said the Port Regulation is still being studied, that TEN-T funds are not linked to the regulation and effects on the second Maasvlakte cannot yet be stated, and that the Netherlands opposes unfair competition and will treat all applications equally.
Via the BNC procedure I will inform you as agreed no later than 14 June 2013.
Via de BNC procedure zal ik u volgens afspraak uiterlijk op 14 juni 2013 informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

An MP asked the government about sexual violence against women in India, the restrictions on human rights NGOs under India's FCRA rules, the treatment of the Dutch Human Rights Tulip winner, and visa problems for Dutch aid workers and journalists. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises civil society freedom in EU and UN forums, that India decides its own conditions for enforcing its law, and that no Dutch-funded organisation has been prevented from working by Indian restrictions.
The Netherlands is committed to keeping the issue of freedom for human rights organisations on the EU and UN agendas and will also do so at the EU Human Rights Dialogue.
Nederland spant zich ervoor in dat het onderwerp «vrijheid voor mensenrechtenorganisaties» op de agenda van de EU en VN aandacht blijft krijgen en zal dat ook doen bij de EU Mensenrechtendialoog.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over betalingen aan krijgsheren, drugsbaronnen en de Taliban in Afghanistan

An SP MP asked the foreign and defence ministers whether CIA cash payments in Afghanistan reached warlords and the Taliban and whether Dutch funds did too. The government said it had no information on the CIA payments, that Dutch aid might not be fully protected from reaching informal power holders, and described its risk analysis and controls.
The government has no information that such payments were made and therefore cannot confirm that there was no critical oversight of the use of such payments.

De regering heeft geen informatie dat dergelijke betalingen zijn gedaan en kan daarom evenmin bevestigen dat er geen kritisch toezicht op de besteding van dergelijke betalingen zou hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het arrest van het Europees Hof van Justitie in zaak C-398/11

An MP asks the state secretary and foreign minister about the CJEU ruling in case C-398/11 (Hogan), which held that member states may be liable if insolvency wipes out half or more of occupational pension rights, and about its consequences for the Netherlands, European liability schemes and the government's position. The government confirms awareness, says the ruling is still being analysed with results promised before the summer recess, states no European guarantee proposal exists, and describes the Dutch position in the hearing.
The CJEU judgment in the Hogan case (C-398/11) is currently being analysed.
Het arrest van het Hof van Justitie in de zaak Hogan (C-398/11) wordt op dit moment geanalyseerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de ILGA-Europe Annual Review of the Human Rights Situation of Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans and Intersex People in Europe 2013

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about the Netherlands dropping in the ILGA-Europe 2013 rankings, the human rights situation of LGBT people in Europe, and whether the government would back an EU action plan and anti-discrimination directive. The minister answered that the rankings methodology changed, that the Netherlands remains a leader on LGBT rights, and that the government supports the proposed EU initiative.
The cabinet supports the COC proposal.
Het kabinet steunt het voorstel van het COC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Voordewind over de mensenrechtennota

MPs asked when the human rights note would reach parliament, whether the old note still guides policy, and how much was spent from the human rights fund since the new cabinet took office. The minister replied that the letter will be sent after cabinet approval, that it will state continuity and new emphases, and that ongoing commitments from the fund have been honoured.
The human rights letter will be sent to the House immediately after the Council of Ministers has approved it.
De mensenrechtenbrief wordt direct nadat de Ministerraad deze heeft goedgekeurd aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bonis, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van Ojik over het rapport "Detainee Treatment"

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about the 2013 Constitution Project report on US detainee treatment at Guantanamo, including torture allegations, indefinite detention without trial, and medical personnel involvement. The minister called the allegations worrying, said the US must determine whether torture occurred, and reiterated that Guantanamo should close, without committing to a new concrete step beyond continued diplomatic contacts.

It is now up to the American authorities to determine, in light of the Constitution Project report, whether torture and inhuman treatment within the meaning of the aforementioned conventions has indeed occurred.

Antwoord 3 Het is nu aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om, gezien het rapport van het Constitution Project , vast te stellen of inderdaad sprake is van foltering en onmenselijke behandeling in de zin van bovengenoemde verdragen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over het (voorbarig publiceren van het) advies omtrent etikettering van producten uit Joodse nederzettingen

The MP De Roon asks why the draft advice on labelling products from Israeli settlements was published prematurely, whether labelling is a politically motivated and discriminatory measure, and whether it breaches WTO rules. The minister replies that the advice concerns technical guidance to businesses on correct origin labelling under existing EU rules, that a draft was posted by mistake and then removed, and that no trade sanction or special labelling is involved.
AgentschapNL unintentionally placed a draft advice on the website, while consultations within the EU and national decision-making were not yet concluded.
AgentschapNL heeft onbedoeld een concept advies op de website geplaatst, terwijl consultaties binnen de EU en nationale besluitvorming nog niet waren afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over correcte etikettering van producten uit bezette gebieden

Sjoerdsma (D66) asks the foreign minister whether the government still supports correct labelling of products from occupied territories, when a binding legal duty to prevent consumer misinformation applies, when Dutch consumers will see correct origin labelling, and why a draft guideline was accidentally published online. Minister Timmers answers that the government supports correct implementation of the May 2012 EU decision, that EU rules forbid misleading consumers about origin, that technical coordination with other member states takes time, and that the draft was published by mistake and will not be sent to the Chamber.
Once this consultation is concluded, the Chamber will be informed of its outcomes, as well as of the cabinet's view on the report 'Trading away peace'.
Zodra dit overleg is afgerond, wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten hiervan, evenals over de kabinetsvisie op het rapport «Trading away peace».
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over het oppakken van een homorechtenactivist in Zambia

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign minister about the arrest and trial in Zambia of LGBT rights activist Paul Kasonkomona, the legal basis for his prosecution, the impact of closing the Dutch embassy on LGBT support, the safety of LGBT people, and whether the minister would press for decriminalisation. The minister confirmed the case under section 178(g) of the penal code, said the penalty is not yet known, outlined the worsening situation for LGBT people, and said Dutch efforts would continue via the EU and in ministerial contacts without a concrete commitment to a specific public intervention.
After the embassy closes in July 2013, Dutch efforts for LGBT rights in Zambia will continue within the EU framework.
Na de sluiting van de ambassade in juli 2013 zal de Nederlandse inzet in Zambia ten behoeve van LHBT-rechten in EU-verband worden voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van Bommel over de benoeming van Iran tot voorzitter van de VN-Ontwapeningsconferentie

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether Iran's rotating chairmanship of the UN Conference on Disarmament, and the US boycott of it, undermines disarmament progress and whether the Netherlands should follow a boycott. The minister replied that the chair rotates alphabetically rather than being elected, that the Netherlands will attend but leave if the Durban criteria are violated, and that a policy letter is forthcoming.
The Netherlands is a strong supporter of (nuclear) disarmament and non-proliferation, with the ultimate goal of a world without nuclear weapons.
Nederland is een groot voorstander van (nucleaire) ontwapening en non-proliferatie, waarbij het uiteindelijke doel is een wereld zonder kernwapens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over de voorschriften met betrekking tot de presentatie van olijfolie in horeca gelegenheden

An MP from the PVV asked the government whether it would implement an EU rule banning olive oil cans in restaurants, and what further EU measures burden Dutch firms. The state secretary said the Netherlands opposed the rule, which the Commission has since withdrawn, and promised a list of EU rules causing unnecessary regulatory burden.
We are pleased that Commissioner Çiolos (Agriculture), after the necessary political pressure and media outcry in the European Union, has decided to withdraw the decision.
Het verheugt ons dat Commissaris Çiolos (Landbouw), na de nodige politieke druk en de ophef in de media in de Europese Unie, heeft besloten om het besluit in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Verheijen over de voorschriften met betrekking tot de presentatie van olijfolie in horeca gelegenheden

Two VVD MPs asked why the European Commission planned to ban refillable olive oil bottles in restaurants, on what powers, and whether it breached subsidiarity and burdened hospitality businesses. State secretary Dijksma answered that the Netherlands opposed the measure, voted against it, welcomed its withdrawal, and will send the Commission a list of EU rules causing unnecessary burden.
For these reasons, the Netherlands voted against the measure.
Nederland heeft om deze redenen tegen de maatregel gestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Miljoenen Euro's belastinggeld voor Somalië

An MP from the PVV asked the foreign minister why Dutch taxpayer money should go to Somalia, a country under sharia and ranked among the most corrupt, and urged withdrawing the aid. The minister defended the aid as serving Dutch interests on piracy, terrorism and migration, noted it is channelled through the UN and IOM rather than the Somali government, and refused to withdraw it, while stating funding for one project would stop if Somalia frustrates forced returns.
I am not willing to withdraw the mentioned commitments.
Ik ben niet bereid de genoemde toezeggingen in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Nederlanders op talibanscholen

An MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether they knew of Dutch nationals studying at Taliban-linked schools in Pakistan, which nationalities they hold, how many Dutch nationals attend Islamic institutions abroad, and whether dual nationals should be denaturalised and expelled on return. The minister confirmed awareness, said travel is unregistered so the numbers cannot be tracked, and explained that denaturalisation is possible only after a terrorism conviction and only where the person holds another nationality.
It is therefore not possible to keep track of who travels to Pakistan, or abroad in general, nor which educational institutions they attend.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk bij te houden wie er naar Pakistan, of het buitenland in het algemeen, reist noch wie welke onderwijsinstellingen bezoekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de financiering van Syrische rebellen met drugsgeld

Party MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether the government had evidence for a Russian claim that 15,000 to 20,000 Syrian rebels were funded by drug money, including any Saudi link, and whether it would seek information from Russia, UNODC and Europol. The minister replied that the claim came without argument or evidence, so it could not be assessed and gave insufficient grounds for further inquiry.
The claim in the report you mention is not accompanied by any argumentation or evidence.
De bewering in het door u genoemde bericht gaat niet vergezeld van argumentatie of bewijsvoering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de Pride-evenementen in Moldavië en Oekraïne

MP Van Ojik asked the foreign minister whether he knows of Pride events in Moldova and Ukraine, whether a safe Pride is a benchmark for anti-discrimination, when visa facilitation will be decided and whether the government will signal to those governments, and what further action it will take to support Pride. The minister confirmed the events and said visa liberalisation depends on anti-discrimination laws and minority protection in the action plans, that the EU has raised concerns and the embassies actively support Pride activities.
The Netherlands will work to ensure the EU continues to press both countries on the importance of protecting and respecting the rights of (sexual) minorities.
Nederland zal zich ervoor inzetten dat de EU beide landen blijft aanspreken op het belang van de bescherming en naleving van de rechten van (seksuele) minderheden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Russische spionnen erg actief zijn in Nederland

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russian and Chinese espionage in the Netherlands, including targeting of military-technological knowledge, is adequately understood and countered. The minister answered that intelligence services (AIVD, MIVD) investigate, disrupt operations, advise on security and screen defence contractors, while acknowledging that not all operations can be detected and no further public details can be given.
No further information on this can be provided publicly.
In het openbaar kunnen hierover verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind Bonis en Thieme over financiering van bouwprojecten in India waar schending van arbeids- en kinderrechten plaatsvindt

MPs Voordewind, Bonis and Thieme asked whether Dutch-funded Asian Development Bank projects in India involve child labour and labour rights abuses, and what the Netherlands will do about oversight and sanctions. Minister Ploumen answered that the ADB has labour standards in its contracts and monitoring mechanisms, that the Netherlands has pressed the bank to strengthen complaint and sanction mechanisms, and that she will ask Dutch-represented constituencies at other development banks to scrutinise labour standards.
In talks with the ADB, the Netherlands has pointed out that complaint handling, a sanctions mechanism and monitoring are important.
Nederland heeft in gesprek met de ADB erop gewezen klachtenbehandeling, een sanctiemechanisme en monitoring belangrijk te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verheijen en Ten Broeke over het bericht "EU diplomats to spend more on salaries, less on security"

MPs Verheijen and Ten Broeke asked the foreign minister about reports that EU diplomatic service spending would shift toward salaries and away from security, and about high pay levels and allowances at the EEAS. The minister said the figures could not be confirmed as they come from draft budgets not yet public, defended the higher grades as a legacy of merged structures, and pledged to push for lower staff conditions and to inform the House after the EEAS evaluation.
The content of the report cannot be confirmed.
De inhoud van het bericht kan niet bevestigd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about a water project in Mitspe Ramon, Israel, linked to Prince Willem-Alexander and the Jewish National Fund, including alleged land appropriation, activity in settlements and water rights under international law. The minister confirmed the project lies within Israel's internationally recognised borders, uses household wastewater, and that the government is satisfied it has no link to occupied territory or settlements.

The government has satisfied itself that the projects of the Stichting Joods Nationaal Fonds in Amsterdam are located exclusively within the so-called Green Line in Israel, and thus not in occupied territory.

De regering heeft zich ervan vergewist dat de projecten van de Stichting Joods Nationaal Fonds te Amsterdam zich uitsluitend binnen de zogenaamde «groene lijn» in Israël bevinden, dus niet in bezet gebied.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Omtzigt en Voordewind over Islamitisch-extremistisch geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

MPs Van der Staaij, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about Islamist violence against Christians in northern Nigeria, including whether the Nigerian state is failing to protect its citizens and what the Netherlands and the EU will do. The minister acknowledged the violence, said Nigeria bears national responsibility and that the Netherlands will raise it bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, but gave no concrete commitments beyond ongoing dialogue and EU follow-up.
The Netherlands will, through the usual multilateral channels and mainly in the bilateral relationship with Nigeria, point to Nigeria's national responsibility for protecting its citizens.

Nederland zal via de gebruikelijke multilaterale kanalen en vooral in de bilaterale relatie met Nigeria wijzen op de nationale verantwoordelijkheid van Nigeria ten aanzien van de bescherming van haar burgers.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether a Jewish National Fund water project in Israel harms Bedouin, whether JNF afforestation caused the loss of Palestinian villages and farmland, and whether JNF is an unacceptable partner for the Dutch prince. The minister answered that the project area is undisputed and has no Bedouin residents, that the related Israeli bill is still pending in the Knesset, that the Absentee Lands afforestation was authorised by the Israeli state, and that there is no project partnership.
The Netherlands follows such developments closely.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Syrië

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports of Assad regime use of sarin in Syria, including verification, contacts with Israel, the UK's findings, and a possible NATO role. The minister said Dutch information was insufficient to verify use, backed a UN investigation with free access, and said NATO was focused on protecting Turkey.
We currently do not have sufficient information to verify whether, where and by whom such agents were used.
Wij beschikken op dit moment niet over voldoende informatie om te verifiëren of, waar en door wie dergelijke middelen zijn ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes, Kuiken en Albert De Vries over het bericht “actie ANWB tegen tolvignet België

MPs asked the government about Belgium's planned toll vignette for Belgian roads, its effects on cross-border workers and Zeeland residents, and whether the minister had raised it with Belgium. The minister confirmed the plans for 2016, said the vignette would add costs but be manageable, and reported talks with Flemish and Benelux counterparts, promising to report further developments.
If this consultation shows that further developments on the vignette can be reported, I will of course inform you of them.
Mocht uit dit overleg blijken dat er nadere ontwikkelingen rond het vignet gemeld kunnen worden, dan zal ik u daarvan uiteraard op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de reactie van de VN Speciaal Rapporteur voor de zgn. Palestijnse gebieden op de Boston-aanslagen

The PVV MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk's commentary linking the Boston bombings to US support for Israel, and whether the Netherlands would declare him no longer impartial and seek his removal. The minister rejected any justification of terrorism, called the characterisation of Netanyahu as warmongering inappropriate, and said the Netherlands would raise how Special Rapporteurs should fulfil their mandate in the regular EU dialogue with Falk, without committing to a call for his removal.
As previously promised to your House, the Netherlands will raise, in the EU context and in the regular dialogue with Mr Falk, the manner in which Special Rapporteurs should fulfil their mandate.
Zoals reeds toegezegd aan uw Kamer, zal Nederland in EU-verband in de reguliere dialoog met de heer Falk de manier waarop Speciaal Rapporteurs hun mandaat dienen in te vullen aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Klever over Iraanse gasexport naar Nederland

MPs De Roon and Klever asked whether the government would investigate Iranian claims of gas exports to the Netherlands in 2012 despite sanctions, and how it assessed existing Iran sanctions. The minister replied that the sanctions are effective, that the EU gas import ban only took effect on 21 December 2012 so no violation occurred for earlier exports, and that EU sanctions have territorial reach, so no international investigation is pursued, though the EU lobbies third countries to join.
As a result, there is no violation of sanctions if gas was exported to the Netherlands before that date.
Hierdoor is er geen sprake van overtreding van sancties indien voor die datum gas naar Nederland is geëxporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bonis over mensenrechtensitutatie in Colombia

MPs Maij and Bonis asked the government about the deteriorating situation of human rights defenders in Colombia, land restitution in Curvaradó, threats and killings, impunity, and implementation of court rulings. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these concerns in dialogue with Colombian authorities, will press for investigation and prosecution at the Universal Periodic Review and in political dialogue, and will urge implementation of court rulings.
I will press the Colombian authorities for investigation, prosecution and punishment to prevent repetition.
Ik zal bij de Colombiaanse autoriteiten aandringen op onderzoek, berechting en bestraffing om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over het bericht “Erdogan maakt werk van Yunus”

MPs Helder and Van Klaveren asked whether Turkey taking the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights infringes Dutch sovereignty, and whether Turkey's EU accession should be rejected. The minister answered that it has not been confirmed Turkey has referred the case, and that the government sees no reason to change its policy supporting Turkey's accession perspective.
It has not been confirmed that Turkey is referring the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights.
Het is niet bevestigd dat Turkije de zaak Yunus aan het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens voorlegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over toenemend geweld tegen en onderdrukking van christenen in Indonesië

An MP asks the foreign minister about rising violence against and suppression of Christians in Indonesia, including attacks on churchgoers, impunity, church closures and permit problems, and asks what the government will do. The minister acknowledges increased attacks on religious minorities, weak local protection and insufficient prosecution, says Indonesia's decentralisation complicates matters, and commits to raising the issue bilaterally, at the UN and in an upcoming debate.
I take the Archbishop of Jakarta's remarks seriously and agree that a more effective approach to violence against persons belonging to religious minorities is needed.
Ik neem de uitlatingen van de aartsbisschop van Jakarta hierover serieus en ben het met hem eens dat een effectievere aanpak van geweld tegen personen behorend tot religieuze minderheden nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de impasse in de zaak tegen Wikileaks oprichter Julian Assange

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about the impasse in the Assange case, including whether Sweden could guarantee against extradition to the United States and whether the Netherlands should mediate. The minister answered that there is no extradition request from the US, that the Swedish legal process is trusted, and that the matter is between the UK and Sweden, so no Dutch role is warranted.
No, this concerns a matter between the United Kingdom and Sweden.
Nee, dit betreft een zaak tussen het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Zweden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Bonis over de arrestatie en vervolgens vrijlating van de Nederlandse journaliste Rena Netjes in Cairo

MPs from VVD, D66, SP and PvdA asked the foreign minister about the arrest and release of Dutch journalist Rena Netjes in Cairo, including whether a citizen's arrest could fuel a witch-hunt against Western journalists. The minister confirmed no formal charge was filed, described ambassador contact with the Egyptian prosecutor leading to her release, and said the Egyptian authorities found the citizen's arrest unlawful.
As far as the embassy in Cairo could verify, there was no official charge against Ms Netjes.
Er is voor zover door de ambassade in Cairo kon worden nagegaan geen officiële aanklacht tegen mevrouw Netjes geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over sponsoring van de viering van de troonsbestijging door de Permanente vertegenwoordigingen bij de Europese Unie en de NAVO

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about corporate sponsorship (Unilever, Shell, ING, Tata Steel) of the king's accession celebration organised by the Dutch Permanent Representations to the EU and NATO, including lobbying risks, openness and whether rules exist. The minister replied that about 53,000 euro in costs is two-thirds covered by sponsorship and entry fees, that sponsorship is common practice, and that general integrity principles apply, referring to the BZ integrity code.
Diplomatic missions must, regarding sponsorship of activities, observe the broader principles of impartiality, transparency and avoidance of conflicts of interest and interference in decision-making.

Diplomatieke vertegenwoordigingen dienen zich m.b.t. het laten sponsoren van activiteiten te houden aan de breder geldende principes van onpartijdigheid, transparantie en vermijding van belangenverstrengeling en inmenging in besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de in India ter dood veroordeelde professor Singh Bhullar

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about the death sentence imposed in India on Devender Pal Singh Bhullar, including concerns about TADA detention, lack of counsel, a retracted confession, and India's resumption of executions. The minister confirmed awareness of the Amnesty campaign, said the Netherlands does not interfere in Indian court proceedings, opposes the death penalty in principle, and will keep pressing India on abolition and reinstating the moratorium.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU, for abolition of the death penalty.
Nederland zal zowel in bilateraal als in EU verband bij de Indiase autoriteiten blijven aandringen op afschaffing van de doodstraf
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Birma/Myanmar

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Myanmar meets the EU's four criteria for keeping sanctions suspended, including release of political prisoners, humanitarian access and Rohingya status, and whether the EU should postpone lifting sanctions. The minister acknowledged the remaining problems but said reforms were welcomed, sanctions were lifted with the arms embargo kept, and the EU should keep raising concerns.
The foreign ministers welcomed these reforms at the Council of 22 April and decided to lift the sanctions suspended in 2012 to support reform-minded forces in the country.

De ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken verwelkomden deze hervormingen in de Raad van 22 april jl. en besloten de in 2012 opgeschorte sancties op te heffen om de hervormingsgezinde krachten in het land te ondersteunen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over privatisering van waterbedrijven

Member Van Gerven (SP) asked whether the government would act against privatisation of water utilities, citing price rises in Paços de Ferreira, Portugal, and an EU concessions directive. The government answered that privatisation is a sovereign national choice under EU treaty rules, that Portugal's MoU was agreed with the Troika and is monitored by it, and that transparency and universal access should be preserved, without committing to halt privatisation.
The cabinet regards the way the drinking water sector is organised in other member states as a national sovereign competence.
Het kabinet beschouwt de wijze van inrichting van de drinkwatersector in andere lidstaten als een nationale soevereine bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over schending van bestandsafspraken tussen Israël en Palestijnse groepen in Gaza

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about alleged Israeli and Palestinian violations of the November 2012 Gaza ceasefire, citing OCHA and OHCHR casualty data, fishing-boat shootings and land-levelling incursions, and asked whether the international community should verify compliance and obtain legal advice. The minister answered that the government lacks sufficient information for a full overview, says the parties determine violations first with Egypt as mediator, rejects a Dutch legal review, and promises no new reporting beyond urging restraint.
The government has insufficient factual information.
De regering beschikt over onvoldoende feitelijke informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over privatisering van drinkwaterbedrijven

An SP MP asks the government to reconcile the Finance Minister's statement that privatising utilities including water can benefit society with the Infrastructure Minister's assurance that Dutch drinking water stays public, and whether the EU concession directive should exclude water. The government answers that its line on Dutch drinking water is unchanged, that member states keep sovereignty over ownership and organisation of water services, and that the Drinkwaterwet will not be amended.
The Netherlands' position is shared by the Council of the European Union.
Het standpunt van Nederland wordt gedeeld door de Raad van de Europese Unie
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Meenen over het bericht dat Iraanse studenten worden gediscrimineerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Meenen asked whether Iranian students are excluded from some courses despite a Supreme Court ruling, and how the government will respond. The minister answers that the nuclear knowledge embargo implementation will be revised before summer, that 13 exemption requests were filed with 7 refused, and that she sees no reason to apologise or compensate.

We intend to work with the higher education institutions in the short term toward a comprehensive revision of the national implementation of the UN knowledge embargo, so as to address both the Supreme Court ruling and UN Security Council Resolution 1737.

Wij zijn voornemens om in overleg met de Hoger Onderwijs instellingen op korte termijn te komen tot een integrale herziening van de nationale uitwerking van het VN-kennisembargo, zodat tegemoet wordt gekomen aan zowel het arrest van de Hoge Raad als de VN-Veiligheidsraadsresolutie 1737.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het door Marokko weigeren van een bezoek van vier Europarlementariërs aan de Westelijke Sahara

Ten Broeke (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister about Morocco refusing entry to four MEPs travelling to Western Sahara, and whether the government would protest and press for better access and human rights within the EU-Morocco relationship. Minister Timmermans answered that the trip was private, that Morocco considered the MEPs biased, that the free-trade talks fall under the existing Association Agreement with its human rights clauses but do not include Western Sahara access conditions, and that he would contact the UN envoy and inform parliament.
As I promised the House on 27 March during the General Consultation on the Arab region, I will shortly contact him and inform the House about that conversation.
Zoals ik uw Kamer heb toegezegd op 27 maart tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over de Arabische regio zal ik binnenkort met hem contact leggen en uw Kamer informeren over dat gesprek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de introductie van separate buslijnen voor joodse Israeli's en Palestijnen

An MP asked the foreign minister about Israel's introduction of separate bus lines for Palestinians and Jewish Israelis in the occupied territories, including incidents at checkpoints and whether this violates equal treatment and mobility rights. The minister said the government will hold Israel to its commitment that existing lines remain open to Palestinians, will monitor the situation critically, and will press bilaterally and in the EU for changes if unequal treatment or restricted mobility is confirmed.

Should it turn out that the new bus lines, contrary to Israel's commitment, lead to unequal treatment or restriction of the Palestinian population's freedom of movement, the Netherlands will argue bilaterally and within the EU that this system be adjusted.

Mocht blijken dat de nieuwe buslijnen – in strijd met de toezegging door Israël – leiden tot ongelijke behandeling, dan wel inperking van de bewegingsvrijheid van de Palestijnse bevolking, dan zal Nederland bilateraal en in EU-verband ervoor pleiten dat dit systeem wordt aangepast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de salarissen en arbeidsvoorwaarden van EU-ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister why the promised information on EU civil servants' pay and allowances, relative to the Dutch prime minister's salary, had not been delivered in time for the February 2013 debate, and whether the government had consulted the European Commission. The minister replied that he had discussed the requested comparison with the responsible Commissioner and would continue contact in May, promising to inform parliament afterwards.
I have explained the requested comparison to the responsible Commissioner and discussed it with him. I will continue this contact in May.
Ik heb de gevraagde vergelijking aan de verantwoordelijke commissaris toegelicht en met hem besproken. Dit contact zal ik in mei voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over een Chinees veiligheidssysteem in Tibet

An MP asked the foreign minister about China's GRID surveillance system in Tibet, arbitrary house searches and police posts, and how China's unratified ICCPR and the EU-China dialogue could be used to press for change. The minister said the Netherlands is concerned, has repeatedly urged China in EU and UN settings to respect rights and resume dialogue, pushes for ratification of the ICCPR, and will keep raising Tibet in the EU-China human rights dialogue, while noting no major policy change yet.
The Netherlands is concerned about the restriction of freedoms of Tibetan citizens
Nederland maakt zich zorgen over de inperking van vrijheden van Tibetaanse burgers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener naar aanleiding van het online artikel van De Telegraaf ‘Kroatië klaar voor Europese Unie’ van 26 maart 2013

An MP (Madlener, PVV) asked the foreign minister whether the cabinet still considers Croatia ready for EU accession despite high unemployment and poor corruption rankings, and whether it would block accession. The minister replied that the cabinet maintains its position, that unemployment and corruption are not accession criteria, and that it will not block accession.
Is this cabinet willing to still block the accession of a thoroughly corrupt, criminal and unemployed country?
Is dit kabinet bereid om de toetreding van een door en door corrupt, crimineel en werkloos land alsnog te blokkeren?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het sluiten van het Institut Néerlandais in Parijs

Sjoerdsma (D66) asks the foreign minister why the Institut Néerlandais in Paris is being closed despite earlier promises to keep it open, why the Raad voor Cultuur was asked for advice, and whether irreversible steps should wait for a postennet vision. The minister replies that the subsidy ends for a cheaper embassy-based cultural programme, that the building stays Dutch-oriented via Fondation Custodia, and that no reduction in cultural presence is expected.
Question 7: Have you calculated the long-term effects of this reduced Dutch cultural presence in France? Are you willing to share these figures with the House?
Vraag 7 Heeft u doorgerekend wat de langetermijneffecten zijn van deze verminderde Nederlandse culturele aanwezigheid in Frankrijk? Bent u bereid deze cijfers met de Kamer te delen?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het recht op veilige abortus voor verkrachte vrouwen in oorlogsgebieden

An MP asked the government whether raped women and girls in war zones have a right to safe abortion under humanitarian law, whether they should be a public champion of this (including in National Action Plan 1325), and whether the US 'no abortion' clause should be challenged. The minister answers that humanitarian law requires necessary medical care that may include abortion, that the Netherlands will press this in the EU and UN, and will urge the US to interpret the Helms amendment to allow funding for safe abortion for rape survivors.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked the foreign minister about Palestinian detainees Samer Issawi and Ayman Sharawneh in Israeli custody, including administrative detention, alleged mistreatment and the death of Arafat Jaradat. The minister replied that there is no administrative detention in these cases, that the Netherlands and the EU monitor the situation and raised it with Israel, and that an independent inquiry into Jaradat's death should follow with findings made public.
There is no question of administrative detention.
Er is geen sprake van administratieve detentie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over in Turkije opgepakte vakbondsleden

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked about the arrest of trade union members in Turkey after the February 2013 embassy bombing, including KESK members, and about Turkish union and anti-terrorism law. The minister replied that 68 KESK members remain detained on terrorism membership suspicion without a known charge, that Turkey is reforming its laws, and that the Netherlands will raise the issue in dialogue but not interfere in Turkish legal proceedings.
The Netherlands does not interfere in the Turkish judicial process, but will follow the proceedings with interest.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de Turkse rechtsgang, wel zal Nederland de processen met belangstelling volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Bontes over het bericht dat Europese superspionnen het recht krijgen om persoonlijke informatie zoals e-mails, websitebezoeken, medische data en politie bestanden in te zien

MPs Madlener and Bontes asked whether reports that EU 'super spies' would gain access to citizens' emails, website visits, medical data and police records are accurate, and whether the EU agency ENISA should be abolished. The minister replied that the report conflates a non-binding cybersecurity strategy with a Commission directive, that ENISA has no operational or investigative powers, and that the government will ensure the existing EU data protection framework is respected.
The report is not correct and, in my view, is not accurate.
Het bericht klopt niet en is mijns inziens niet accuraat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet, Fritsma en Madlener over het bericht “Inwoners EU hebben recht op uitkering”

PVV MPs asked why EU residents may receive social assistance while doubts exist about their residence right and an income requirement applies, and whether all wrongly paid benefits to foreigners will be recovered. The minister answered that residence rights under the EU free movement directive depend on an individual assessment by the IND, that municipalities handle benefit decisions, and that municipalities are responsible for recovery policy.
The implementation of the WWB has been decentralised to the municipalities.
De uitvoering van de WWB is gedecentraliseerd aan de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Remco Dijkstra over schaarse grondstoffen

Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether the Dutch government has sufficient insight into which scarce raw materials are critical to the economy, what the plan to secure essential materials entails, and the state of cooperation with business and bilateral agreements with source countries. The government answered all three questions by referring to a forthcoming letter on raw materials, without giving substance in this reply.
I refer you to the cabinet's state-of-affairs letter on raw materials, which the cabinet will send to you in April.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de stand van zakenbrief van het kabinet over grondstoffen welke het kabinet in april aan u zal sturen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over executies in Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asks the foreign minister about the recent execution of seven men in Saudi Arabia, alleged unfair trials and torture, possible minors among those executed, and the number of 2012 executions. The minister shares serious concerns, cannot confirm the minority claims, reports no known minors executed in 2012, and says the Netherlands will continue dialogue on the death penalty with Saudi authorities, mainly together with EU partners.
The Netherlands will continue the ongoing dialogue on death penalty policy with the Saudi authorities.
Nederland zet de continue dialoog over het doodstrafbeleid met de Saoedische autoriteiten voort.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten onderzoek doen naar de mogelijke corruptie bij Microsoft

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they know of Microsoft bribing or approaching Dutch officials for software contracts, whether they contacted foreign authorities, and what influence Microsoft had on the NOiV open-standards programme. The minister answered that no bribery is known, that contact between officials and companies is normal, that no information was sought abroad given the ongoing US inquiry, and that Microsoft did not sign the open-standards manifesto.
I am not aware of any bribery.
Van omkoping is mij niets bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over nieuwe stappen gezet ten aanzien van de buitenlandse financiering van Russische niet-gouvernementele organisaties

Mr. Omtzigt (CDA) asked whether the government knows of and assesses new Russian steps on foreign funding of NGOs, whether Russia's human rights situation has worsened under Putin, and what the EU and the Netherlands will do about it. Minister Timmermans answers that the government has repeatedly voiced concern about Russian NGO legislation, will raise human rights with Putin, and that the EU has discussed Russia's internal situation, without committing to a concrete new step.
Since the legislation on NGOs (foreign funding and labelling as 'foreign agent') came up in Russia last summer, my EU colleagues and I have repeatedly expressed our concerns to Russia.

Vanaf het moment dat wetgeving inzake NGO's (buitenlandse financiering en betiteling als «buitenlands agent») vorige zomer in Rusland aan de orde is, hebben mijn EU-collega's en ikzelf hier herhaaldelijk tegenover Rusland onze zorgen kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Fritsma over het bericht “Veel Zuid-Europeanen naar Nederland”.

MPs Madlener and Fritsma asked the government about a news report on rising numbers of Southern European nationals in the Netherlands and what would be done to control this immigration. The government responded that EU free movement rights apply, that the numbers differ from CBS figures, and that it will keep enforcing income requirements and tackling exploitation while continuing existing initiatives.

As long as citizens from another member state meet the conditions for free movement of persons and thus do not place an unreasonable burden on social provisions in our country, we see no reason to oppose their arrival in the Netherlands and participation in Dutch society.

Zolang burgers uit een andere lidstaat voldoen aan de voorwaarden die gesteld worden aan het vrij verkeer van personen en daarmee dus geen onredelijke belasting vormen voor sociale voorzieningen in ons land, zien wij geen reden om afwijzend te staan tegen hun komst naar Nederland en deelname aan de Nederlandse samenleving.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf inzake de berichten “Goedkope Filippijnen op truck” en “Filippijn rijdt voor € 650,-“.

An MP asked ministers about reports of cheap Filipino truck drivers undermining Dutch truckers, and whether the government would curb inflows of Eastern European and Filipino drivers. The minister answered that the case concerned a Latvian firm, that Dutch wage and labour rules apply to work for Dutch firms, and promised a letter on tackling sham constructions by 1 May.
The Minister of Social Affairs and Employment will inform the House by letter before 1 May about the approach to sham constructions.
De Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zal uw Kamer voor 1 mei per brief informeren over de aanpak van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de oproep van de Liberalen om de Syrische oppositie te bewapenen

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister how he views the Liberal International call to arm the Syrian opposition, including concerns about Islamist and jihadist fighters and arms proliferation. The minister replies that the Netherlands favours a comprehensive UN arms embargo, that the majority of member states fear arming the opposition would spread weapons and instability, and that the current embargo should be maintained while EU discussions continue.
The Netherlands is in favour of a comprehensive UN arms embargo.
Nederland is voorstander van een alomvattend VN-wapenembargo.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het propageren van mensenoffers en kannibalisme in Egypte

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Egypt's Al-Azhar university promotes human sacrifice and cannibalism against apostates, and whether the Netherlands funds or cooperates with it. The minister said the material reflects historical theoretical views, that Al-Azhar receives no direct or indirect Dutch or EU funding but takes part in a Dutch-financed interfaith dialogue, and that the government sees no consequences for its policy toward Islamic states.
There is no direct or indirect subsidy of this university by the Netherlands or the European Union.
Er is geen directe of indirecte subsidiëring van deze universiteit door Nederland of de Europese Unie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de toename van het aantal vluchtelingen vanuit Syrië

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked about the rising number of Syrian refugees, EU strategy, family reunification and visa policy for Syrians. The state secretary replied that the EU has seen asylum applications from Syrians rise sharply, that EASO and emergency funds exist for member states, that the Temporary Protection Directive is not yet triggered, that Netherlands issues no visas on protection grounds, and that EU and member states have committed substantial humanitarian funding.
The Netherlands does not issue visas for reasons of international protection.
Nederland verstrekt geen visa om redenen van internationale bescherming.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over sluiting van het Institut Français

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Institut Français's move out of its Amsterdam building and the closure of the Institut Néerlandais in Paris were linked, and about the cultural ties with France. The minister regretted the move, attributed it to high maintenance costs, denied any link with the Dutch subsidy decision and any French signals, and said cultural relations remain important.
No. France does not intend to close the Institut Français; the activities will continue at another location in Amsterdam.
Nee. Frankrijk is niet voornemens het Institut Français te sluiten, de activiteiten gaan door op een andere locatie in Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon en Ten Broeke over de aanval op een christelijke wijk in de Pakistaanse stad Lahore

Four MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke) asked the foreign minister about a mob attack on a Christian neighbourhood in Lahore over alleged blasphemy, Pakistan's government response, the misuse of blasphemy law and what the Netherlands will do to press Pakistan. The minister answered that Punjab ordered a judicial inquiry and compensation was paid, that the blasphemy law is open to abuse, and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally, multilaterally and in GSP+ assessment, but gave no concrete new commitments beyond existing channels.
I do not have confirmed figures on the number of people imprisoned on charges under this law.
Ik beschik niet over geconfirmeerde cijfers over het aantal personen dat gevangen zit vanwege een beschuldiging op grond van deze wet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over recentelijke aanval op de christelijke gemeenschap in Lahore

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about the March 2013 attack on Christians in Lahore, alleged involvement of ruling-party politicians, misuse of blasphemy law, education curricula and GSP+ human rights benchmarks. The minister answered that the ambassador expressed sympathy, that confirmation of MPs' involvement is unavailable while Dutch and EU efforts urge prosecution, and that Pakistan's GSP+ assessment will be tested against 27 international conventions.
Confirmed information on this is not available.
Geconfirmeerde informatie hierover is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verheijen over Hongaarse onderscheidingen

An MP asked the foreign minister about Hungary's constitutional amendments and the award of state honours to people with antisemitic and far-right views, and how the EU and bilateral channels would respond. The minister shares the concern, condemns the honours, notes that Hungarian journalist Szaniszló returned his decoration, and says the Commission and Council of Europe are examining the amendments with action to follow depending on their findings.
The Netherlands will continue to urge these bodies to keep fulfilling this role.
Nederland zal deze instanties blijven aansporen deze rol te blijven vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Gesthuizen over twee Chinese tolken die door de Immigratie- en naturalisatiedienst (IND) op non-actief zijn gezet

Two SP MPs asked why the IND suspended two Chinese-speaking interpreters suspected of leaking information to Chinese authorities about Uyghurs in the Netherlands, how interpreters are screened, and what the consequences are. The government answered that an AIVD warning concerned these individuals only, that screening rules apply, that about 1,000 case files used these interpreters with 75 percent granted asylum, and that the Minister of Foreign Affairs asked China for clarification.
In about 75 percent of these files asylum protection was granted.
In ongeveer 75 procent van deze dossiers is asielbescherming toegekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Oosenbrug en Eijsink over het Mandiant Intelligence Center-rapport over massale cyber-spionage in de Verenigde Staten door een groep hackers (APT1) in Shanghai

MPs Bonis, Oosenbrug and Eijsink asked whether the government would act on the Mandiant report on Chinese state-linked cyber-espionage (APT1) against firms in English-speaking countries, including possible targeting of Dutch firms, and on contacts with China and EU/UN action. The government answered that it lacks conclusive proof but the report fits the known threat picture, described existing AIVD/MIVD/NCSC measures and EU-China contacts, and said it will keep raising cyber-espionage internationally without committing to a new specific step.
We do not have conclusive evidence for this conclusion.
Wij beschikken voor deze conclusie niet over sluitend bewijs.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel over vijf vrouwen uit Gaza die niet mogen studeren op de Westoever

An MP asked the foreign minister about five women from Gaza barred from studying at West Bank universities, whether Israel must allow it, whether the travel ban has in effect blocked Gaza students since 2000, whether a separation policy exists, and whether the Netherlands will press Israel. The minister answered that Israel may take security measures but these should not de facto exclude all Gaza students, that only three Gaza students received permits since 2000 (all with foreign scholarships), that the High Court confirmed a humanitarian-only exception policy, and that the Netherlands will raise the issue with Israel within the EU and bilaterally.
The Netherlands continues to press, both within the EU and bilaterally, for an end to the blockade of Gaza and normalisation of the movement of goods and persons.
Nederland zet, zowel in EU-verband als bilateraal, onverminderd in op een einde aan de blokkade van Gaza en normalisering van verkeer van goederen en personen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over aanvaringen met illegale walvisvaarders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he would ask the Japanese ambassador for clarification, and Australia for assistance, after whaling vessels rammed Sea Shepherd ships flying the Dutch flag, and what action should follow if vigilantism occurred. The minister answered that concerns were conveyed to Japan and Sea Shepherd, that talks were held with Australia, and that no assistance had yet been needed, without committing to further concrete steps.
In doing so, an appeal was made to both parties to prevent further escalation and to take steps that ensure safety at sea.
Daarbij is een oproep gedaan aan beide partijen om verdere escalatie te voorkomen en stappen te zetten die de veiligheid op zee waarborgen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Omtzigt over Turkse pleegkinderen in Europa

MPs Keijzer and Omtzigt asked about a Turkish parliamentary committee chair's claim that Turkey might reclaim Turkish children placed with Christian or gay foster families in Europe, the Hague Convention, and foster-care numbers. The government rejected any idea of Turkish reclaiming of children under the 1961 Convention, said it does not hold the data on Turkish-passport children in care, and offered only to explain Dutch foster-care decision-making if Turkey asks.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the imprisonment of Iranian human rights lawyer Nasrin Sotoudeh, the outcome of an Iranian parliamentary inquiry, the conviction of lawyer Mohammad Ali Dadkhah, and EU action. The minister described her sentence, said the Iranian delegation's findings may not be published, confirmed Dadkhah's sentence and Dutch concern, and reported new EU sanctions and repeated EU calls for release.
If the results of their inquiry are made public, which is not certain, I will share them with your House.
Als de resultaten van hun onderzoek publiek worden gemaakt, wat niet zeker is, zal ik deze aan uw Kamer mededelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de veroordeling van Sahrawi’s in Marokko

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the military-court convictions of 25 Sahrawis in Morocco, including unexamined torture allegations, lack of independent investigation into the 2010 violence, and whether Netherlands would press Morocco for civilian retrials. The minister answered that military courts for civilians are problematic, that torture allegations should be investigated, and that the Netherlands would discuss possible action at EU level after the Supreme Court appeal outcome.
Depending on the outcome, it will be discussed at EU level whether there is reason to raise this with the Moroccan authorities.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst hiervan zal in EU-verband besproken worden of er aanleiding is om de Marokkaanse autoriteiten hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse vluchtelingenkampen

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkish refugee camps for Syrians are being used by jihadist group Jabhat al-Nusra to recruit fighters, whether Dutch funding should stop, and about the treatment of Syrian Christians in Turkey. The minister replied that no confirmed information shows recruitment in the camps, saw no reason to raise it, and said UNHCR found no evidence of sectarian violence against Christians there, while noting the Christians often choose to live outside the camps.
There is no confirmed information available about refugees in Turkish refugee camps being recruited by the terrorist organisation Jabhat al-Nusra.
Er is geen bevestigde informatie beschikbaar over vluchtelingen in Turkse vluchtelingenkampen die gerekruteerd worden door de terreurorganisatie Jahbat al Nusra.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over uitlatingen premier Erdogan over het zionisme

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the foreign minister how he judged Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's remark describing Zionism as a crime against humanity, whether the Netherlands had protested, and why the UN Secretary-General had not condemned it. The minister distanced the government from the remark, said it was raised with Turkey politically and at official level, and noted the UN Secretary-General had distanced himself from it.
I explicitly distance myself from this.
Ik neem hier uitdrukkelijk afstand van.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over mensenrechtenschendingen in de provincie Beloetsjistan in Pakistan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about alleged enforced disappearances, killings and torture of Baloch activists, teachers, journalists and lawyers in Pakistan's Balochistan, and about impunity and a humanitarian crisis there. The minister acknowledged the reports and concern, said confirmed data is lacking, noted very low prosecution rates, and stated that the Netherlands and the EU raised the issue bilaterally and in EU conclusions, including through the human rights ambassador's visit.
Confirmed information needed to verify these reports and figures at this level of detail is not available.
Geconfirmeerde informatie die nodig is om deze berichten en cijfers op dit detailniveau te kunnen bevestigen, is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak van het Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens van 3 juli 2012 in de zaak Loetsenko versus Oekraine

MP Omtzigt asks the Foreign Minister about the European Court of Human Rights ruling in Lutsenko v. Ukraine, which found Lutsenko was detained for non-legal reasons in breach of Article 18, and whether Ukraine has implemented it, whether the appeal delay was raised, and what conditions the EU set for an association agreement and public pressure on political prisoners.
