The minister answers that Ukraine must implement the ruling under Article 46, that the Committee of Ministers is supervising, that the EU and bilateral channels have raised the case, and that signing depends on rule-of-law conditions.
Once information on further implementation by Ukraine is made available, I will form a judgement on it.
Zodra informatie over verdere tenuitvoerlegging door Oekraïne beschikbaar wordt gesteld zal ik mij daarover een oordeel vormen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Krol over dodelijke aanvallen op Hazara’s in Pakistan

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about deadly attacks on Hazara Shia communities in Pakistan, including whether perpetrators have been prosecuted and whether Pakistan should investigate independently. The minister confirmed the attacks, attributed most to Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, said Pakistan pledges to pursue perpetrators while noting recent arrests, and said the Netherlands and EU raise the issue of minorities bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands regularly raises the issue of the position of (religious) minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rondom de positie van (religieuze) minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over kwalificering van zionisme en islamkritiek als “misdaad tegen de menselijkheid”

MPs De Roon and Madlener asked the Foreign Minister how he judged Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's calls to treat Islamophobia and Zionism as crimes against humanity, whether dialogue with such leaders was worthless, what the government had done about his hostile statements, whether Turkey was therefore an enemy of free speech, and when Turkish EU accession would be abandoned. The minister disassociated the government from Erdogan's remarks, reaffirmed support for Turkey-Israel normalisation and Turkish EU membership perspective subject to conditions, and gave only brief answers to the other questions.
I expressly distance myself from the statement of Prime Minister Erdogan.
Ik neem uitdrukkelijk afstand van de uitspraak van premier Erdoğan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Bonis over persvrijheid in Israël en ‘Palestina’

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about press freedom in Israel and the Palestinian territories after Reporters without Borders ranked them low, and about the causes and any Dutch response. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited arrests and military actions against journalists, said human rights are raised bilaterally and in the EU, and that the government has no contacts with Hamas but raises press freedom with journalists in Gaza.
The way in which the deepening of bilateral relations is to take shape is currently being studied. The House will be informed about this later.
Op dit moment wordt bestudeerd hoe de verdieping van de bilaterale relaties gestalte moet krijgen. Daarover wordt de Kamer later geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het delen van inlichtingen ten behoeve van drone aanvallen

SP MPs asked whether Dutch intelligence gathered in the region is shared with the United States and could be used for targeted drone killings, and whether Dutch officials risk prosecution. The minister confirmed awareness of a UK lawsuit, declined to say anything publicly about cooperation with foreign intelligence services, and stated that the UK case is not criminal prosecution.
No public statements can be made about cooperation with foreign intelligence and security services.
Over de samenwerking met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Klaver over de wijziging van de grondwet in Hongarije

MPs Servaes and Klaver asked whether the Hungarian constitutional amendment limiting the Constitutional Court and checks and balances is a concern, whether the EU and Council of Europe should act, and how EU monitoring of rule of law should be strengthened. The minister said the government shares concerns, will raise the issue at the European Council, supports a stronger Commission role and a new EU safeguard mechanism, and notes the Council of Europe's Venice Commission is reviewing the amendments.

The government will, together with the other member states that wrote the letter and possibly other supporting member states, consult the European Commission and EU member states to further develop these aspects of such a mechanism.

Het kabinet zal, samen met de andere lidstaten die de brief hebben geschreven en mogelijk ook andere lidstaten die voorstander zijn van de totstandkoming van een dergelijk mechanisme, in overleg treden met de Europese Commissie en de lidstaten van de EU om deze aspecten verder uit te werken.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een aanval op Iraanse ballingen in Irak

An SP MP asked the foreign minister about a deadly attack on Iranian exiles at Camp Liberty in Iraq, including who was responsible, whether an independent investigation and prosecutions should be pursued, and whether refugee status determination should be accelerated. The minister confirmed seven deaths and about forty injuries, said the perpetrators are uncertain, backed an independent investigation raised by the UN and the EU, and noted that UNHCR is already working as quickly as possible on refugee registration.

During the recent visit of the Secretary-General of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to Iraq, she, in line with my commitment to the House of 14 February, urged an independent investigation on behalf of the Netherlands.

Tijdens het recente bezoek van de Secretaris-Generaal van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan Irak heeft zij conform mijn toezegging aan de Tweede Kamer d.d. 14 februari j.l. namens Nederland aangedrongen op een onafhankelijk onderzoek
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit overweegt om Israël aan te klagen bij het Internationaal Strafhof voor de detentie van kinderen

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that the Palestinian Authority may bring Israel before the ICC over child detention, the reported rise in Palestinian child detentions, and Dutch responses. The minister said the ICC decides on cases, no concrete Palestinian steps are indicated, child detention numbers rose in 2012 though exact figures are unavailable, and Israel has announced a law reducing pre-trial detention of minors.
The Israel Prison Service and the Israel Defense Force (IDF) do not publish data on the number of children arrested and questioned who were then not detained.
De Israel Prison Service en de Israel Defense Force (IDF) geen gegevens openbaar maken van het aantal kinderen dat is gearresteerd, ondervraagd en vervolgens niet in hechtenis is genomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over Turkije‘s oorlogstaal en de Nederlandse Patriotmissie

Two PVV MPs asked whether Turkey's accusation that Israel commits state terrorism, and Turkish minister Davutoglu's remarks urging Syria toward war, warrant summoning the Turkish ambassador and withdrawing Dutch Patriot missiles from Turkey. The government replied that Turkey said its remarks were criticism of Assad rather than an incitement to attack Israel, that the Netherlands will keep pressing for steps toward rapprochement, and that it has no information linking a Netherlands-based figure to the Ankara bombing; it rejected withdrawing the Patriots.
The Netherlands will continue to urge Turkey and Israel to take steps that make rapprochement possible.
Nederland zal verder bij Turkije en Israël blijven aandringen op stappen die toenadering mogelijk maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Maij en Van Bommel over de marginalisatie van de Papua's in sociaal en economisch opzicht

Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Papuans are marginalised in the exploitation of natural resources, whether large development programmes bring in immigrants, who benefits, how their land is legally protected, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister acknowledged the reports, said development is aimed at the whole population, admitted the Special Autonomy Law's consultation duty and local regulation are not consistently implemented or completed, and committed to pressing Indonesia for transparency and NGO access.
This consultation obligation is not always complied with in practice.
Deze consultatieplicht wordt in de praktijk niet altijd nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de gevolgen van de sancties tegen Iran

MP Van Bommel asked whether the minister knows of a report finding that Iran sanctions contributed to shortages of medicines, and whether the government will reconsider its position and press for EU measures. The minister acknowledged the report but disagreed with its conclusions, said exemptions for humanitarian trade exist, and saw no need for an oil-for-medicines programme.
I note that the authors of the report reach a different conclusion about the relationship between sanctions and the medicine shortage in Iran than I did in my earlier answers.
Ik constateer dat de auteurs van het rapport tot een andere conclusie komen over de relatie tussen sancties en het medicijngebrek in Iran dan ik in mijn bovengenoemde antwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het programma van de conferentie in Oslo over de Humanitarian Impact of Nuclear Weapons

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the programme of the Oslo conference on the humanitarian impact of nuclear weapons, whether the Netherlands has assessed such impacts and its emergency services' preparedness, and about the delegation and briefing. The minister confirmed the conference's relevance, pointed to existing crisis preparedness and a delegation with crisis-response expertise, and promised to inform parliament later about the discussion.
At an appropriate time, the House will be informed about the discussion that took place.
Bij gelegenheid zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de gevoerde discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Agema over de absurde Turkse inmenging in aangelegenheden van pleegzorg in Nederland

PVV MPs De Roon and Agema asked whether Turkey may interfere in placement of Turkish foster children in the Netherlands and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg should stop contact with a Turkish inquiry commission. The state secretary answered that Dutch law already sets careful placement rules, that Turkey has no authority over Turkish-national foster children here, and that the Netherlands will explain its procedures if Turkish authorities ask.
The Turkish government has no authority over foster children in the Netherlands who have Turkish nationality.
De Turkse regering heeft geen zeggenschap over pleegkinderen in Nederland met de Turkse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Sjoerdsma over Turkse pleegkinderen

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked about Turkish criticism of Dutch foster care for Turkish children, whether Turkey has authority over them, and whether foster parents can be excluded on religion or sexual orientation. The state secretary answered that placement follows careful rules considering the child's religious and cultural background, that Turkey has no authority over these children, and that exclusion on religion or sexual orientation is not allowed.
I am willing to report to the House on this.
Ik ben bereid hierover verslag te doen aan de Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de verkiezingen in Kenia en de processen van het International Criminal Court (ICC) tegen Uhuru Kenyatta en William Ruto

An MP from D66 asked the foreign minister about the outcome of an AU/COMESA/IGAD delegation visit to Kenya, Dutch support for the ICC Kenya cases, and reports that witnesses were disappearing or being influenced in the Kenyatta and Ruto trials, asking about witness protection. The minister described the delegation's recommendations, listed Dutch diplomatic, logistical and financial support to the ICC and civil society, said he was concerned about witness interference, and deferred details of witness protection to the ICC.
Because of the sensitivity of the matter, I cannot provide further details on witness protection.
Ik kan vanwege de gevoeligheid van de kwestie geen nadere details over getuigenbescherming verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de EU-ambtenaren

An MP asked the ministers about EU civil servant pay and pensions, including the lapse of the 5.5% solidarity levy, salary comparisons with US and Dutch officials, and the Council's role in the salary dispute. The government answered that the levy lapsed, gave salary figures, and blamed the impasse on the Commission's salary method and the need for an MFK administrative ceiling.
The salary tables you received with Parliamentary Paper 32 833, no. 9 are current. The adjustments for 2012 and 2013 are not yet available.
De salaristabellen die u ontving bij Kamerstuk 32 833, nr. 9 zijn actueel. De aanpassingen voor 2012 en 2013 zijn nog niet beschikbaar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het boek ‘Bikkel’

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether investigation and prosecution of the 1980 mistreatment and death of Fred Ormskerk in Suriname was ever pursued, whether the government pressed for it, and how a suspect living in the Netherlands squares with the policy of denying Surinamese suspects entry. The minister replied that the Netherlands lacks jurisdiction over the Surinamese case, that protest was lodged in 1980, that the suspect does live in the Netherlands, and that the policy did not apply to his situation.
The case concerns Surinamese territory. The Netherlands has no jurisdiction in this matter and therefore cannot start its own criminal investigation into the events.
Het betreft een zaak op Surinaams grondgebied. Nederland heeft terzake geen rechtsmacht en kan dan ook geen eigen strafrechtelijk onderzoek starten naar de gebeurtenissen.
Antwoord vragen Madlener en Tony Van Dijck over het EU-trendrapport 2013 van de Algemene Rekenkamer

Two MPs (Madlener and Tony van Dijck, PVV) asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the Court of Audit's 2013 EU trend report, including the 3.9% error rate, unverified Greek loans and EFSF funds, member states' resistance to a national declaration, and whether governments should be forced to provide one. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the government opposes the error rate, that EFSF/Greek loans are controlled via conditionality and national budget channels with an audit committee being explored, that no member state refuses accountability, and that he will not link ESM aid to a national declaration.
The cabinet is exploring whether EFSF funds can be placed under the supervision of the ESM audit committee.
Het kabinet verkent of de middelen van het EFSF onder toezicht van het ESM-auditcomité gebracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over opmerkingen van VN Speciaal Rapporteur Falk

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the foreign minister to respond to UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk's comparison of Hamas actions with Dutch WWII resistance, and whether he should be dismissed. The minister called the comparisons inappropriate and unacceptable, said Falk's statements are his own responsibility, and stated Nederland will raise the matter in EU context but will keep contact with special rapporteurs.
A Special Rapporteur is appointed by the Human Rights Council.
Een Speciaal Rapporteur wordt aangesteld door de Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over investeringen in bedrijven die communicatieapparatuur aan Syrië leverden

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether Dutch banks and pension funds investing in firms that supplied communications equipment to Syria could pressure those firms to stop such exports, and about EU-level export controls on repressive technology. The minister answered that corporate responsibility rests with the financial sector under OECD guidelines, outlined Dutch proposals for an EU human-rights export clause and existing sanctions on monitoring equipment for Syria, and said Nederland supports the European Parliament's Digital Freedom resolution.

The Netherlands has proposed at EU level adding a provision to the dual-use regulation that would allow banning the export of goods and technology where there is suspicion they will be used for human rights violations.

Nederland heeft in Europees verband voorgesteld om een bepaling toe te voegen aan de dual-useverordening die het mogelijk maakt om de export van goederen en technologie te verbieden indien het vermoeden bestaat dat deze zullen worden ingezet voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over het bericht «European Commission defends privileged access for “big business”»

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the European Commission's sharing of information with big business but not other stakeholders in trade negotiations is undesirable, and whether transparency on EU trade agreements should be improved. The minister rejected the premise of disproportionate business influence, defended confidential stakeholder exchanges to protect negotiating positions, and said she will keep parliament informed in general terms without committing to concrete new steps.

It is therefore in the interest of the European Union to handle the specific interests of specific players (companies, civil society organisations or other stakeholders) as confidentially as possible.

Het is daarom in het belang van de Europese Unie om specifieke belangen van specifieke spelers (bedrijven, maatschappelijke organisaties of andere betrokkenen) zoveel mogelijk in vertrouwelijkheid te behartigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over het bericht "Duitse Patriot-militairen belaagd in zuiden Turkije"

Omtzigt and Knops (CDA) asked the Foreign and Defence ministers about reports that German Patriot soldiers were harassed in southern Turkey, and whether further unrest and host-nation funding for the Patriot deployment are expected. Minister Timmermans answered that the soldiers were unharmed, that demonstrations are small and the Patriots enjoy broad Turkish support, and that the NATO-Turkey funding agreement was completed on 12 January 2013 without being hindered by the anti-Western sentiment.
De militairen zijn niet gewond geraakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Madlener over het bericht: ‘EU-controleur in Den Haag’

MPs Wilders, Tony van Dijck and Madlener asked whether the government would send back an EU 'European Semester Officer' stationed in The Hague, object to growing Brussels interference, and station a Dutch controller in Brussels to oversee EU spending. The minister replied that the Commission's Semester role is important for budget oversight, that the officers only facilitate information exchange without changing Commission powers, and that the European Court of Auditors handles EU spending control while Netherlands pushes member-state accountability.
Appointing this officer changes nothing about the powers the Commission has under existing EU regulations.
Het aanstellen van deze functionaris verandert niets aan de bevoegdheden die de Commissie heeft op basis van de bestaande EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord op een aanvullende vraag van de leden De Roon en Wilders over opmerkingen van VN Speciaal Rapporteur Falk

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he shared criticism of UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk over alleged antisemitic remarks and whether this strengthened the case for removing him and avoiding contact. The minister answered that he was aware of these reactions and referred to his earlier answers on the same matter.
Yes, I have taken note of these reactions.
Ja, ik heb kennis genomen van deze reacties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een toespraak van de leider van de Palestijnse Autoriteit, Mahmoud Abbas

An MP from the PVV asked the foreign ministers whether a speech by Mahmoud Abbas glorifying early Fatah terror attacks, broadcast on the Palestinian Authority's official TV, is incitement, and whether the government will stop funding the PA under a parliamentary motion. Minister Timmermans said he is aware of the speech, that the background of the persons praised is insufficiently known, that he will continue efforts against incitement via the trilateral commission, and that PA support aims at a viable Palestinian state.
In line with the letter to parliament of 12 December 2012, I will continue to work to end incitement and calls for violence.
Conform de Kamerbrief (d.d. 12 december 2012) zal ik mij blijven inspannen voor een einde aan opruiing en aan oproepen tot geweld
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over de huisvestingskosten voor EDEO-vertegenwoordigers

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about the high residence costs of EU diplomats in Hong Kong and Moscow, EU diplomat pay and perks, an internal audit showing weak financial management, and whether the Netherlands should run its own diplomacy. The minister confirmed the rent figures, defended market-based selection and cost-benefit weighing, said Dutch pressure for austerity and budget neutrality continues, noted that EU financial rules are overseen by the Commission and the European Court of Auditors, and said he was not aware of misconduct, promising to raise it if found.
The cabinet is not aware of any misconduct. Where that is the case, the cabinet will raise it.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met misstanden. Waar dat wel het geval is, zal het kabinet dat aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over betrokkenheid Hezbollah bij de busaanslag in Bulgarije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether there are strong indications that Hezbollah, rather than Iran, was involved in the Bulgarian bus bombing, whether this warrants listing Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation, and whether he would consult Europol. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said only Hezbollah (not Iran) is named by Bulgarian authorities and Europol, and said the Netherlands will again push for EU listing of Hezbollah and will provide a Europol statement.
The Netherlands will once again strongly advocate placing Hezbollah on the European Union's list of terrorist organisations.
Nederland zal zich er andermaal sterk voor maken Hezbollah op de lijst van terroristische organisaties van de Europese Unie te plaatsen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over schendingen van de bestandsafspraken tussen Israël en de Palestijnse groepen in Gaza

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Israel violated the November 2012 Gaza ceasefire terms by restricting Palestinian fishing zones and imposing buffer zones, and requested an overview of violations by both sides. The minister said the incidents are for the parties to judge, Netherlands supports a wider fishing zone to at least 12 nautical miles, and will press Israel on international law.
There is insufficient information available to provide such an overview.
Er is onvoldoende informatie beschikbaar om een dergelijk overzicht te kunnen geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Visserij voor de kust van West Sahara

An SP MP asked the foreign and trade ministers about a Curaçao-flagged refrigerated ship (Nova Florida, Seatrade) reportedly active off Western Sahara, the state of the EU-Morocco fisheries deal, and whether Western Sahara waters should be excluded. The ministers replied that the ship is outside Dutch jurisdiction, that renegotiation of the protocol is ongoing with Dutch conditions, and that a deal covering those waters need not violate international law if conditions are met.
If there is a violation of Dutch or European regulations, the government will hold Dutch companies to account for it.
Indien er sprake is van overtreding van Nederlandse of Europese regelgeving, zal de overheid Nederlandse bedrijven daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Bonis, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over sluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de regering van Sudan

MPs from PvdA, CDA and D66 asked the Dutch government whether it shares EU concerns about Sudan's closure of civil society organisations, whether it will press Khartoum to reverse this, and how it supports the closed groups and threatened rights defenders. The government answered yes to each point, said the EU and member states will raise the closures with Sudanese authorities, and described ongoing contact and programme support for civil society and rights defenders.
The closure of the civil society organisation will be raised with the Sudanese authorities shortly, jointly by the EU and a number of EU member states present in Sudan, including the Netherlands.

De sluiting van de maatschappelijke organisatie zal op korte termijn gezamenlijk door de EU en een aantal in Sudan aanwezige EU-lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, bij de Sudanese autoriteiten worden aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de toegang van de Eerste en Tweede Kamer tot interne EU-Raadsdocumenten

MP Servaes asked the foreign minister why the Dutch parliament, unlike most EU national parliaments, lacked access to EU Council 'Limité' documents such as draft European Council conclusions, and whether this should be changed. Minister Timmermans answered that the government now grants both chambers direct access via the EU extranet, while maintaining confidentiality rules that limit public disclosure of such documents.

Both chambers can use the opportunity offered to them to inspect internal Council documents, among other things to verify whether the information they receive from the cabinet is correct and complete.

Beide Kamers kunnen de hen geboden mogelijkheid van inzage in interne stukken van de Raad onder meer gebruiken om te verifiëren of de informatie die ze ontvangen van het kabinet correct en volledig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het rapport van Human Rights Watch waaruit blijkt dat Syrische oppositiegroepen kerken plunderen

Members Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about a Human Rights Watch report on Syrian opposition groups looting churches, including who was responsible, whether sectarian violence is increasing, and whether attacks on religious buildings are war crimes for the ICC. The minister answered that responsibility cannot be established, acknowledged the sectarian trend and the crime, but said the ICC cannot act without a Security Council referral, which the Netherlands supports, and that the letter to the Council did not specifically mention church attacks.
No. Is it possible to establish which groups were responsible for these lootings?
Vraag 2 Is vast te stellen welke groepen verantwoordelijk zijn geweest voor deze plunderingen?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het rapport “Kenya’s 2013 Elections” van de International Crisis Group (ICG)

An MP asked the foreign minister how the government responds to an ICG report on Kenya's 2013 elections, the risk of political violence, what it does to protect the electoral commission's independence, and when international observer missions start. The minister said Netherlands supports the report's recommendations on electoral commission, judiciary and observer coordination, acknowledges the risk of violence, and gave the observer mission dates.
The Netherlands supports the fight against impunity, the implementation of the new constitution and contributes to the credibility of the democratic process.
Nederland ondersteunt de strijd tegen straffeloosheid, de implementatie van de nieuwe grondwet en draagt bij aan de geloofwaardigheid van het democratisch proces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over de Russische anti-homowet

MPs Sjoerdsma and Pia Dijkstra asked the foreign and education ministers about a Russian bill banning public speech on homosexuality, and whether the Netherlands would protest and protect LGBT rights. Minister Timmermans said the bill is discriminatory and harmful, that the concern was conveyed to the Russian ambassador, raised at the EU level and in a planned visit, and that Dutch funding for LGBT projects in Russia continues.
On 1 February I had my concerns conveyed to the Russian ambassador.
Op 1 februari heb ik mijn zorgen aan de Russische ambassadeur laten overbrengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pechtold, Van Bommel, Madlener, Van der Staaij, Ouwehand en Segers over het rapport “Seventeenth Bi-annual Report: Developments in European Union Procedures  en Practices Relevant

MPs asked the foreign minister about the COSAC report on parliamentary scrutiny of EU documents, including why the Dutch parliament lacks access to Council documents marked EU Restricted and Limité that Austrian MPs can see. The minister answered that both chambers will receive direct access to all Limité documents, that Limité is a distribution code rather than a classification, and that the Dutch parliament is already as well informed as the Austrian and European Parliaments.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de mensenrechtensituatie in Bahrein

An MP asked the foreign minister about human rights in Bahrain, including support for a European Parliament resolution, EU sanctions, arms export restrictions, implementation of the BICI report and a pending prosecution of an activist. The minister condemned rights violations and said he backs the implementation of BICI recommendations and an EU approach, but does not support sanctions for now and gave no firm commitment on the individual trial.
The Netherlands therefore condemns, in line with European Parliament resolution 2013/2513, the continued human rights violations by the Bahraini authorities and security forces.
Nederland veroordeelt dan ook, in lijn met resolutie 2013/2513 van het Europees Parlement, de doorgaande mensenrechtenschendingen door de Bahreinse autoriteiten en veiligheidstroepen
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de gevolgen van de sancties tegen Iran

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether Western sanctions on Iran are causing shortages of life-saving medicines, deaths, and whether the EU should refrain from new sanctions. The minister answered that the sanctions contain humanitarian exemptions for medicines, blamed Iranian authorities' allocation of foreign currency for the shortages, said he knows of no confirmed deaths but does not exclude them, and committed to the EU discussing how exporters can be made aware of the exemptions.
The EU sanctions regime against Iran contains exceptions for, among other things, medicines.
Het EU-sanctieregime tegen Iran kent uitzonderingen voor o.a. medicijnen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over de Duitse weigering om wapens te vervoeren in verband met de Franse interventie in Mali

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about reports that Germany would not transport weapons or ammunition supporting the French intervention in Mali, and about Dutch aircraft via the EATC. The minister answered that Germany does not transport such cargo, that the Netherlands places no restrictions on cargo, that the KDC-10 has not yet been deployed, and that Dutch aircraft are currently not used for flights to Mali pending a safety review, with the Chamber to be informed of any positive decision.
If a positive decision is taken, the Chamber will be informed further.
Bij positief besluit wordt de Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, de Roon en Wilders over Malinese jihadisten die profiteren van Nederlands belastinggeld

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid to Mali, including via subsidised NGOs, benefits jihadists and should be stopped or recovered. The minister confirmed aid to the Malian government was suspended after the 2012 coup, said stopping other aid is not at issue and no grounds exist to reclaim funds, and rejected the personal accusation in question 4.
Following the coup in Mali of 22 March 2012, the Netherlands decided in April 2012 to stop aid to the Malian government.
Naar aanleiding van de staatsgreep in Mali van 22 maart 2012 besloot Nederland in april 2012 tot stopzetten van de hulp aan de Malinese overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bonis over het bericht ‘Ironies of (In)justice in Ukraine and Strasbourg’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Strasbourg court ruling (Volkov v. Ukraine) on judicial independence in Ukraine and the alleged role of a PACE rapporteur, asking whether the government would raise the matter and press for Volkov's reinstatement. The minister said the PACE appoints its own rapporteurs and governments should not interfere, that Ukraine is bound to remedy the structural problems under Article 46 ECHR with supervision by the Committee of Ministers, and that the Netherlands will raise rule-of-law concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
The Netherlands will certainly hold Ukraine to account on this in the Committee of Ministers in case of non-compliance.
Nederland zal in het Comité van Ministers Oekraïne bij niet-nakoming zeker daarop aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over sharia-patrouilles in Londen

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Muslim patrols in a London suburb, including their remarks about white women, whether such patrols show Islam's nature, the existence of 'Muslim areas' in a major European city, and whether shariah-promoting movements should be banned. Minister Opstelten rejected the remarks and intimidation, said Islam's nature is not shown by the conduct of a few, and that courts would assess any dissolution request case by case under article 20 of the Civil Code.
If the public prosecution service so requests, the judge will have to assess each individual case on the basis of article 20 of the Civil Code.
In het geval dat het openbaar ministerie daartoe verzoekt, zal de rechter elke afzonderlijke zaak moeten beoordelen aan de hand van artikel 20 Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de islamitische opvoeding als vrijbrief voor verkrachting

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether a UK court's decision not to jail a rapist because of his Islamic upbringing shows the misogynistic nature of Islam, and whether the government would condemn it and ensure Dutch judges never act similarly. The minister answered that one individual's statements say nothing about a religion and that it is not for the Dutch government to judge a British judge's application of British law in an individual criminal case.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements about the correct application of British law by a British judge in an individual criminal case.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om uitspraken te doen over de juiste toepassing van het Britse recht door een Britse rechter in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over bericht inzake politiegeweld in Papua in december 2012

An MP asked whether the minister would review a report on police violence in Papua in December 2012, urge Indonesian authorities to allow independent foreign investigation, and have Dutch diplomats investigate and report on the incidents. The minister confirmed reading the report, said investigation is primarily Indonesia's responsibility (with the national human rights commission Komnasham), and that the Netherlands raises the issue and advocates wider access, but declined to have diplomats investigate on the ground.
Investigation of alleged human rights violations is in the first instance the responsibility of the competent Indonesian authorities.
Onderzoek naar vermeende mensenrechtenschendingen is in eerste instantie de verantwoordelijkheid van de bevoegde Indonesische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over EU-subsidie voor multinationals

Mr Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign Minister whether EU social fund money meant for Polish SMEs went to multinationals such as Unilever, Pepsi, Mercedes Benz and Deutsche Bank, and whether such grants are lawful and should be recovered. The minister replied that the Commission is investigating with the Polish managing authority, that the error rates in the EU budget are unacceptably high, and that the Netherlands will push for clearer rules and more transparency, while rejecting the view that training grants for workers of multinationals defeat the purpose of cohesion funds.
The results of the European Commission's investigation must be awaited before the cabinet can make detailed statements about this situation.
De resultaten van het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie moeten worden afgewacht alvorens het kabinet gedetailleerde uitspraken kan doen over deze situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over multinationals halen miljoenen uit EU-fonds

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that multinationals received millions from the European Social Fund, and whether EU subsidies are being wasted and how fraud will be prevented. The minister answered that the Commission is investigating the Polish case, that the Court of Auditors' error rates are unacceptably high and the Netherlands will push for better accountability and transparency, and that subsidies are open to all firms so no distortion arises, while refusing to halt EU payments.
The results of the European Commission's investigation must be awaited before the cabinet can make detailed statements about this situation.
De resultaten van het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie moeten worden afgewacht alvorens het kabinet gedetailleerde uitspraken kan doen over deze situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over VN-pleidooi voor internationaal onderzoek naar mensenrechtenschendingen in Noord-Korea

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the UN High Commissioner's call for an international inquiry into human rights abuses in North Korea, and whether it will support it and include religious freedom. The minister answered that the Netherlands will keep raising the issue in international fora, support such an inquiry in the UN General Assembly and Human Rights Council, and examine how religious freedom can be addressed within limited possibilities.

To obtain more information on the human rights situation in North Korea, the Netherlands will also support the call for an international inquiry into human rights violations in North Korea in the relevant international bodies.

Om meer informatie te krijgen over de mensenrechtensituatie in Noord-Korea zal Nederland tevens het pleidooi voor een internationaal onderzoek naar mensenrechtenschendingen in Noord-Korea in de relevante internationale gremia steunen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de verplaatsing van de inwoners van Kamp New Iraq (voormalig Kamp Ashraf) naar Kamp Hurriya

MPs Omtzigt and Van Bommel asked the foreign minister about reports that conditions in Kamp Hurriya are very poor, UNHCR's position, the progress of the transfer from Kamp New Iraq and the asylum status of residents. The minister answered that conditions meet UN standards, denied the UNHCR claim, and gave figures on interviews and resettlement options while stating Dutch concern is channelled through the Iraqi government.
Living conditions in Camp Hurriya regarding water, food and electricity meet the conditions of the United Nations (UN).
De leefomstandigheden in Kamp Hurriya op het gebied van water, voedsel en elektriciteit voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de Verenigde Naties (VN).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over Tsjechische corruptie en de rol van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that the Commission treated Czech misuse of EU funds leniently, whether public reports differed from confidential drafts, and whether controls are adequate. The minister answered that the Commission's final report follows a hearing process, that the Commission's audits show control-system failures and imposed financial corrections (10%, 5%, 22%), and that a fuller overview of error rates per member state is not yet available.
The Netherlands has asked the European Commission for such an overview.
Nederland heeft de Europese Commissie verzocht om een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over “Brussel straft Tsjechische corruptie met EU-subsidies mild”

Two PVV MPs asked whether the EU's light correction of about 450 million euros for irregularities in Czech use of EU funds is a token penalty, and whether the government will stop Czech EU subsidies. The minister answered that no fraud in the criminal sense is involved, that the Commission applies the rules in EU law, and that he will not halt subsidies or reclaim the Dutch share.
The cabinet cannot confirm the error rates of up to 100% cited in the media unless it obtains disclosure of the sources cited in the newspaper article in question.
Het kabinet kan de in de media genoemde foutpercentages tot 100% niet bevestigen dan nadat openbaarheid is verkregen over de geciteerde bronnen in het desbetreffende krantenartikel.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Van Vliet en Wilders over het protest van Marokko tegen het korten van Nederlandse uitkeringen voor Marokkanen

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch ambassador was summoned by Morocco over cuts to Dutch benefits paid to Moroccans, whether the ambassador was told to stay out of Dutch legislation, and whether new benefits to return migrants could be frozen. The minister replied that the ambassador met the Moroccan minister at Dutch request on a previously scheduled matter, that no summoning took place, and that freezing new benefits requires a treaty amendment, pointing to the residence-country principle and planned ending of child benefit export.
No. The Dutch ambassador met with the Moroccan Minister of Employment and Vocational Training on 9 January.
Nee. De Nederlandse ambassadeur heeft op 9 januari jl. gesproken met de Marokkaanse minister van Werkgelegenheid en Beroepsopleidingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Europese betrokkenheid bij het CIA rendition programma

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether he knows of the ECtHR ruling against Macedonia for handing a suspect to the CIA, whether this should be welcomed as ending impunity, and whether the Netherlands will prioritise implementation of the European Parliament resolution on CIA secret detention in Europe. The minister confirms the ruling, calls it important and says he will monitor Macedonia's implementation in the Committee of Ministers, and states the Netherlands opposes CIA renditions and supports the resolution's message without committing to specific new steps.
In the Committee of Ministers I will closely monitor how Macedonia will implement the Court's ruling.
In het Comité van Ministers zal ik nauwkeurig toezien op de wijze waarop Macedonië uitvoering zal geven aan de uitspraak van het Hof.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de arrestatie van een Saudische journalist

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he judges the arrest of a Saudi journalist for criticizing Islam, whether he agrees the journalist should be free to say Muhammad's faith must be corrected, and whether he will press for the journalist's immediate release. The minister answered that the grounds for detention are unknown, that EU partners are investigating in Riyadh, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands raises freedom of expression with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten daarvan zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over dreigende deportatie van een islam-kritische filmmaker

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Spain is deporting Pakistani-born anti-Islam filmmaker Imran Firasat on national security grounds, whether the Netherlands will protest given possible blasphemy prosecution at home, and whether his film can be published in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Spain must assess the security threat, that Dutch intervention is not warranted, that free expression carries responsibilities for courts to judge, and that the film is already online.
It is for the Spanish authorities to assess whether this person residing in Spain poses a threat to national security.
Het is aan de Spaanse autoriteiten om te beoordelen of deze in Spanje verblijvende persoon wel of niet een bedreiging vormt voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘Britse premier David Cameron zegt Brussel de wacht aan’

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the cabinet would, like British PM Cameron, stand up against Brussels, restrict social benefits for immigrants, and hold a referendum on the EU's future. The minister answered that the cabinet supports a strong Europe and subsidiarity discussions but not a redefinition of the relationship, supports free movement while seeking to prevent benefit magnets, and opposes a referendum as it favours representative democracy.
The cabinet favours representative democracy and does not intend to hold a referendum on the future of the European Union.
Het kabinet is voorstander van de representatieve democratie en is niet voornemens een referendum te organiseren over de toekomst van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over illegale Israëlische nederzettingen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israeli settlement construction, including whether the Netherlands would recall its ambassador, suspend the EU-Israel Association Agreement, and refrain from forming a Netherlands-Israel cooperation council. The minister answered that the government opposes the settlements and has raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador, but rejects recalling the ambassador, isolating Israel, or suspending the Association Agreement, while offering bilateral fora and continued mensenrechtendialoog.
The cabinet considers the Israeli settlements illegal and an obstacle to peace. However, isolating Israel is not an effective way to counter settlement policy.
Het kabinet acht de Israëlische nederzettingen illegaal en een obstakel voor vrede. Het isoleren van Israël is echter geen effectieve manier om het nederzettingenbeleid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verheijen over de mogelijke stijging van de salarissen van EU-ambtenaren

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would push back against proposed pay rises for EU civil servants, the lapse of the solidarity levy, and the stalled reform of the EU staff regulations. The minister confirmed the stalemate, said the Netherlands opposes the 1.7% rise and wants deeper pension and pay reforms tied to the MFK negotiations, and committed to keep raising the issue.
The Netherlands will continue to actively pursue this issue.
Nederland blijft zich hier actief voor inzetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht «5,5% meer loon voor EU-ambtenaren»

An MP asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of a 5.5% salary increase for EU civil servants and whether the government would block it, including the solidarity levy negotiations and the taxation, pensions and privileges of EU staff. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, referred to earlier answers on the solidarity levy, and described the EU pension and tax arrangements and Dutch pressure for modernisation and reduction of EU staff benefits.

In the negotiations on both the new EU Multiannual Financial Framework and the EU civil service regulations, the Netherlands, together with a large group of like-minded countries, is pressing for far-reaching modernisation and reduction of allowances, promotion system and pension system.

In de onderhandelingen van zowel het nieuwe Meerjarig Financieel Kader van de EU als over het EU-ambtenarenstatuut wordt door Nederland, samen met een grote groep gelijkgezinde landen, aangedrongen op vergaande modernisering en versobering van de vergoedingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht dat Iran een manier heeft gevonden om de Westerse oliesancties te ontlopen

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether a report that Iran had found a way to evade Western oil sanctions was accurate, which route it used, and how sanctions could be made more effective. The minister declined to comment on the Iranian minister's motives or the truth of the claims, stated that EU sanctions are being actively enforced with no known violations, and said Iran's rerouting of oil transport outside the EU is not a breach of EU sanctions, which the EU cannot prevent.
The EU does, however, actively lobby third countries to join the sanctions.
Wel voert de EU een actieve lobby bij derde landen om zich bij de sancties aan te sluiten.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de multiplier in de Geefwet

Parliamentarian Omtzigt asked for an overview of all laws, schemes and projects for which the Dutch government sought European Commission approval but had not yet received an answer, with dates of formal requests. Minister Timmermans replied that EU law generally does not require prior Commission approval of national legislation, with exceptions such as state aid notifications, and that no central overview of Dutch state aid notifications is kept.
No central overview is kept of Dutch state aid notifications from the various ministries.
Voor wat betreft Nederlandse staatssteunmeldingen van de verschillende ministeries wordt geen centraal overzicht bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de multiplier in de Geefwet

An MP asks whether the Commission's approval of the Geefwet multiplier for cultural institutions is still pending, and asks for correspondence and a list of pending state-aid approvals. The state secretary says approval is expected in early 2013 but refuses to release the correspondence while the procedure is open, and promises a separate reply from the foreign minister on the list.
As long as a state-aid approval procedure with the European Commission has not yet led to a decision, I cannot provide the information you requested to the House.
Zolang een procedure inzake goedkeuring van staatssteun bij de Europese Commissie nog niet heeft geleid tot een besluit, kan ik de door u gevraagde informatie niet aan de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Madlener over Roma

An MP asked the foreign minister about a mayor's warning against Eastern European and Roma migrants, including whether Roma would raise crime and welfare dependence. The government answered that migrant crime is not attributable to labour migrants, that Roma are not registered so no data exist, and that the 2014 opening of the labour market to Bulgarians and Romanians will not be reversed.
Since Roma as such are not registered, no data are known on school dropout and benefit dependence.
Aangezien Roma als zodanig niet worden geregistreerd zijn er géén gegevens bekend over schooluitval en uitkeringsafhankelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Islamitische kersttraditie in Nigeria.

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Christmas-night attacks on churches in northern Nigeria reflect Islamic intolerance, whether the OIC acted against them, and whether OIC states that signed the Cairo Declaration should be excluded from the UN. The minister answered that the violence has political, socio-economic, ethnic and religious dimensions, that the OIC condemned the attacks, and that the Cairo Declaration is outdated and no reason for UN exclusion.
The violence in Nigeria has political, socio-economic, ethnic and religious dimensions.
Het geweld in Nigeria heeft politieke, sociaaleconomische, etnische en religieuze dimensies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de discriminatie van niet-gelovigen

The MP asked the Foreign Minister about a 2012 report on discrimination against non-believers and what the government would do about it. The minister said the Netherlands promotes freedom of religion and belief including non-belief, has pushed for protection of non-believers in EU guidelines, will raise the issue bilaterally and in EU circles, and will inform the House.
I will raise this with EU partners when the occasion arises and then inform the House.
Ik zal daar bij gelegenheid aandacht van EU-partners voor vragen en de Kamer vervolgens informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Bedreiging van demonstranten door medewerkers van de Iraanse Ambassade

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Iranian embassy staff threatening demonstrators with scissors, whether the incident was reported as required, whether diplomatic immunity blocks prosecution, what diplomatic measures are available, whether the Vienna Convention should change, and whether the ambassador would be summoned. The minister replied that a complaint was filed and police contacted the ministry the same day, that immunity under the Vienna Convention prevents prosecution, that diplomatic steps such as a note or waiver request are possible but weighed against risks to Dutch diplomats, and that the ambassador was summoned pending the police investigation.
Under the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, embassy staff with diplomatic status have immunity.
Op grond van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer hebben ambassademedewerkers met een diplomatieke status immuniteit.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke over het bericht “Magnitsky wet tergt Russen”

An MP from the VVD asked the foreign minister about the US Magnitsky law and its reach to Russian rights abusers, and whether the Netherlands would take the lead for a similar EU position. The minister said he shares concerns about the Russian rule of law but that the EU lacks support for a visa ban, so he will keep raising the case with colleagues and Russian authorities.
However, there is no support within the EU for a visa ban.
Er is echter binnen de EU geen draagvlak voor een visumban.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Mensenrechtenactivisten in Noord- en Zuid-Amerika

An MP asked the foreign minister about Amnesty's report on human rights defenders in the Americas, Dutch support for the IACHR, whether Nederland would fund a specific IACHR defender unit, Brazil human rights raised at the EU-Brazil summit, and a trade mission report. The minister described Dutch funding of EUR 500,000 and EUR 250,000 a year for the IACHR, declined a dedicated unit, and argued against raising Brazil defenders explicitly at the summit.

No. Due to increasing administrative pressure on the organisation and to improve the effectiveness of human rights initiatives in the region, the IACHR asked donors at the launch of its Strategic Plan 2011–2015 to limit themselves to general, non-earmarked support.

Nee. Vanwege toenemende administratieve druk op de organisatie en ter verbetering van effectiviteit van mensenrechteninitiatieven in de regio, heeft de IACHR bij de lancering van het Strategische Plan 2011–2015 donoren verzocht zich te beperken tot algemene, niet geoormerkte steun.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de weigering dr. Zegveld toe te laten als lid van de CAVV

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Liesbeth Zegveld was refused membership of the CAVV advisory commission on international law because of her involvement in litigation against the state (Srebrenica, Zorreguieta). The minister answers that she withdrew her 2003 application after being pointed to her Srebrenica involvement, that no link to the Zorreguieta case was found, and that any future application would be assessed on expertise.
No link with the Zorreguieta case has been found.
Er is niet gebleken van een verband met de zaak Zorreguieta.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Hijum over het bericht “EU Aid for Cyprus A Political Minefield for Merkel”

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports of Russian deposits and oligarch passports in Cyprus, Cypriot anti-money-laundering efforts, and the lack of investigation into the Magnitsky fraud case, and whether they would condition EU aid on these issues. The minister replied that information on Russian deposits is limited, that Moneyval rates Cyprus positively, that Cypriot authorities have now opened an investigation without seeking Russian permission, and that he would support conditionality on tax information exchange and anti-money-laundering systems if aid is needed.
At this moment not enough information is known to make a precise estimate of the amounts of deposits by persons with Russian nationality at Cypriot banks.
Op dit moment is niet genoeg informatie bekend om een precieze inschatting te kunnen maken van de bedragen aan deposito’s van personen met een Russische nationaliteit bij Cypriotische banken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voorgenomen bouw van 3000 woningen op de E1 locatie

MP Omtzigt asked the foreign minister about his talks with the Israeli ambassador on E1 settlement construction, the US position, EU coordination and Dutch efforts within the Quartet. The minister answered that he raised concerns with the ambassador, shares the US view that unilateral action is harmful, and that Nederland supports a unified EU message calling for resumed negotiations.
I indicated that implementation of the construction plans would make the two-state solution nearly impossible.
Ik heb aangegeven dat uitvoering van de bouwplannen de twee-statenoplossing vrijwel onmogelijk zal maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de rechtmatigheid van en verantwoording over targeted killings

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government would share internal legal advice on US targeted killings, condemn such strikes as unlawful, and press the US for transparency and accountability on drone strikes. Minister Timmermans answered that the advice will be submitted to the CAVV, that prohibitions on attacks on protected persons and extrajudicial executions apply, that more openness from the US is welcomed, but that a judgement on specific strikes requires facts the government does not have.

I consider it useful to have the lawfulness and conditions for the use of armed drones further analysed and have decided to refer this question for advice to the Advisory Committee on Issues of Public International Law (CAVV).

Ik acht het nuttig om de rechtmatigheid en voorwaarden voor het gebruik van bewapende drones nader te laten analyseren en heb besloten om dit vraagstuk ter advisering aan de Commissie van Advies inzake Volkenrechtelijke Vraagstukken (CAVV) voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de berichtgeving dat de Egyptische president Morsi meer macht naar zich toe heeft getrokken

An MP asks the foreign minister whether the new decree by Egyptian president Morsi, which curbs judicial review of presidential decisions, goes beyond what is desirable in a state under the rule of law, and how it affects EU aid. The minister answers that Morsi restored judicial review on 8 December, calls on Egypt to guarantee the rule of law, and says the EU currently does not plan to change aid to Egypt.
President Morsi issued a new decree on 8 December whereby the judiciary can again review his decisions.
President Morsi heeft op 8 december jl. een nieuw decreet uitgevaardigd waardoor de rechterlijke macht zijn besluiten weer kan toetsen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over doodstraffen opgelegd in Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister about death sentences in Egypt, including one for people allegedly involved in an anti-Islam film, and whether the ambassador should be expelled or recalled. The minister confirmed awareness of the sentences and the 2011 figures, stated the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and called on Egypt to uphold free expression, but rejected expelling or recalling diplomats.
That is not on the agenda.
Dat is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over nieuwe aanwijzingen over activiteit rond de plekken waar Syrische chemische wapens zijn opgeslagen

MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about reports of new activity around Syrian chemical weapons sites, including whether the weapons were being moved and where they are located. The government declined to comment publicly on the operational questions, said NATO discussed the issue without conclusions, and noted the issue was not on the agenda of the OPCW Conference of States Parties because Syria is not a party to the Chemical Weapons Convention.
No public statements can be made on this matter.
Hierover kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Syrië en Internationaal Strafhof

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would back a Europarliamentarians' call for an ICC investigation into violence in Syria, and whether it would fund evidence gathering and raise the issue internationally. The minister answered that Syria is not an ICC state party, so a referral by the UN Security Council is needed, which the Netherlands supports, and that it funds Syrian documentation efforts and raises impunity in international forums.
The Netherlands favours such a referral by the UN Security Council and will, together with about 50 countries, issue a call to that effect.
Nederland is voorstander van een dergelijke doorverwijzing door de VN-Veiligheidsraad en zal daartoe samen met ca 50 landen een oproep doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Bonis over de Iraanse gevangene Nasrin Sotoudeh

MPs Van Bommel and Bonis asked the Foreign Minister about Iranian prisoner Nasrin Sotoudeh, her hunger strike, restrictions on family and lawyer access, her medical care, the number of conscience prisoners in Iran, and whether the government will press for her release. The minister confirmed the situation, said the Netherlands and the EU call for her immediate release and have raised it repeatedly with Iran, but could not give reliable figures on prisoners or details of her health.
The EU, partly on Dutch initiative, has repeatedly urged the Iranian authorities to immediately release Ms Sotoudeh.
De EU heeft bij de Iraanse autoriteiten – mede op Nederlands initiatief – herhaaldelijk aangedrongen op onmiddellijke vrijlating van mevrouw Sotoudeh.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over KLM en de no fly list

The MP asks whether KLM refused a passenger on a US no-fly list at Qatar, whether Dutch authorities are involved, whether there is consultation with the US on the list, and whether the government shares concerns about discrimination and the lack of redress. The minister confirms the refusal, states Dutch authorities are not involved and there is no consultation, says the list is a unilateral US decision outside Dutch responsibility, sees no reason to assume discrimination, and points to the DHS-Trip redress procedure.
The decision to place persons on the list is a unilateral decision by the American authorities.
Het besluit om personen op de lijst te zetten is een eenzijdige beslissing van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Zuid-Sudan een VN-medewerker heeft uitgezet

An MP asked the foreign minister about South Sudan expelling a UN human rights officer after alleged army abuses, the UN mission's role in improving security institutions, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The minister said the expulsion breaches the UN Charter and the status of forces agreement, that pressure has been applied to reverse it, and that the Netherlands will keep raising human rights with Juba.
The government is concerned about the signal the South Sudanese government sent with the expulsion of the UNMISS human rights officer.
De regering is bezorgd over het signaal dat de Zuid-Sudanese regering heeft afgegeven met de uitzetting van de UNMISS mensenrechtenmedewerker.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over Turkije en Iran-sancties

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Turkey circumvents international sanctions against Iran, and whether the EU and Netherlands will act. The minister answered that the transactions do not breach UN sanctions, the only ones binding on Turkey, and that the Netherlands will keep urging Turkey to adopt EU sanctions.
The transactions mentioned in the article do not violate the UN Security Council sanctions against Iran.
De in het artikel genoemde transacties zijn niet in strijd met de sancties van de VN-Veiligheidsraad tegen Iran.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Omtzigt over executies in Iran

MPs Van Bommel and Omtzigt asked about imminent executions in Iran, the number carried out this year, whether official figures understate them, whether drug offences and political motives play a role, the execution of minors, and whether the government will protest bilaterally and in the EU. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, cites 344 executions by its own count against 262 officially announced, notes no minors executed this year, and says protests have been lodged in Tehran and within the EU.
The Netherlands is fundamentally opposed to the death penalty and states this unequivocally.
Nederland is principieel tegen de doodstraf en draagt dit ondubbelzinnig uit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Fritsma over het overbrengen van piraten naar Nederland

PVV MPs asked whether the foreign minister is involved in deciding to transfer captured Somali pirates to the Netherlands for prosecution, why transfer to the region or flag state was not chosen, whether pirates could be tried under Dutch law in the region and serve sentences there, and whether they could obtain asylum or stay in the Netherlands. The minister answered that prosecution is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service coordinated with the foreign and defence ministers, that a clear Dutch interest (attempted murder of Dutch marines) justified prosecution here, that trial under Dutch law in the region is not possible and sentence execution in Somalia is currently not possible though capacity-building is supported, and that asylum is expected to be refused under Article 1F and sentences of 24 months or more.
Instituting criminal prosecution in the Dutch criminal justice system is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het instellen van strafrechtelijke vervolging is in het Nederlandse strafrechtelijke stelsel voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Pia Dijkstra over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitswet in Oeganda

Two D66 MPs asked the government about a proposed Ugandan anti-homosexuality bill carrying the death penalty, its likely passage, diplomatic steps, and whether deportations of Ugandan LGBT asylum seekers should be suspended. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised concerns, that the EU ambassadors raised them with Uganda's prime minister, that further steps are premature, and that asylum seekers are assessed individually rather than as a group.
A careful individual assessment is therefore carried out, taking into account the worrying situation of homosexuals in Uganda.
Er vindt derhalve een zorgvuldige individuele toets plaats met inachtneming van de zorgelijke situatie van homoseksuelen in Oeganda.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de inperking van internetvrijheid in Rusland

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the government is aware of Russia's November 2012 law enabling DPI-based internet surveillance, what its impact on human rights and Dutch firms will be, whether EU technology exports could be barred from use in rights violations, and what the government will do to support digital freedom in Russia. The minister acknowledges concern about misuse of the law, says Dutch dual-use export controls cannot exclude such use, and states the government will raise digital freedom in EU and bilateral channels and push for an expanded dual-use regulation.

The Netherlands has for some time been working to expand the EU dual-use regulation so that companies can be subject to an ad hoc licensing requirement if there are indications that technology could (partly) be used for human rights violations.

Nederland zet zich reeds geruime tijd in om de EU- dual use verordening uit te breiden, zodat bedrijven een ad-hoc vergunningplicht kan worden opgelegd indien er aanwijzingen zijn dat technologie (gedeeltelijk) kan worden gebruikt voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over uitbreiding van de nederzettingen door Israël

An MP asked the foreign minister about Israel's approval of 1,285 new settlement homes, whether he agreed with the British criticism, how many settlement homes had been announced or tendered since January 2012, and what the EU should do. The minister confirmed his condemnation, reported 4,644 homes announced and 3,348 tendered, and said the Netherlands will work with EU partners to dissuade Israel and seek a common EU line.
The Netherlands, in cooperation with other EU member states, will try to dissuade the Israeli authorities from this.
Nederland, in samenwerking met andere EU-lidstaten, zal trachten de Israëlische autoriteiten hiervan te weerhouden.
Antwoord vragen Bonis over de Israëlische aankondiging van de bouw van woningen in Oost-Jeruzalem en op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he condemns Israel's announced construction of about 1,300 homes in East Jerusalem and the West Bank as contrary to international law, and whether he will raise it with EU partners. The minister answered that the settlements violate international law, that he condemned the announcement, and that the EU has repeatedly urged Israel to halt settlement expansion and the Netherlands consults with EU partners on it.
I have therefore condemned the announcement.
Ik heb de aankondiging dan ook veroordeeld.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht dat de Franse president Hollande heeft gesproken over steun aan een mogelijke Afrikaanse missie in Noord-Mali

The MP Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about French support for a possible African mission in northern Mali, the security situation there, US and NATO involvement, and whether ransom payments to terrorists should be stopped. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not pay ransom or negotiate with terrorists, supports an EU training mission and a possible ECOWAS/AU mission, and will raise the issue at the Global Counter Terrorism Forum.
The Dutch policy in kidnappings of Dutch nationals abroad is that the Dutch government does not pay ransom, does not negotiate, and does not otherwise meet terrorist demands.

Het Nederlandse beleid bij ontvoeringen van Nederlandse onderdanen in het buitenland is dat de Nederlandse overheid geen losgeld betaalt, niet onderhandelt en ook anderszins niet tegemoet komt aan terroristische eisen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse regering de Syrian National Council niet langer ziet als belangrijkste representant van de Syrische oppositie

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares US Secretary Clinton's view that the Syrian National Council no longer represents the Syrian people, whether the EU and US should align, how representative the opposition is, and whether Syria is a humanitarian emergency. Minister Timmermans answered that a new, more inclusive Syrian National Coalition was formed in Doha, welcomed it, noted Dutch support for representativeness, and confirmed a humanitarian emergency with over 23.5 million euro already committed.
I welcome the establishment of this structure as an important step on the path to transition in Syria.
Ik verwelkom de oprichting van deze structuur als een belangrijke stap op de weg naar transitie in Syrië.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de verslechterde positie van moslims in Birma

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister whether the Burmese government can contain sectarian violence against Muslims in Rakhine, whether reforms are undermined, and whether the Netherlands will push for UN-level protection. The minister answered that the government has increased military presence and that reforms continue, and that the Netherlands supports UN resolutions and humanitarian aid through CERF.
The Netherlands also campaigns for this, multilaterally for example by supporting the UN human rights resolution
Ook Nederland maakt zich hiervoor sterk, in multilateraal verband bijv. door ondersteuning van de mensenrechtenresolutie van de AVVN
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Fritsma over het bericht dat de EU dreigt met herinvoering van de visumplicht voor de Westelijke Balkan

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the EU threatens to reinstate visa requirements for Western Balkan countries, asking about asylum figures, whether Roma asylum flows are undesirable, suspending Schengen expansion, and trends in Roma migration. The government answered that 2012 asylum data per country are unavailable due to the IND's system migration, that abuse of asylum is undesirable but protection must remain available, that Romania and Bulgaria's Schengen accession is not currently on the agenda, and that the registration system cannot generate figures by ethnicity.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff naar aanleiding van het bericht “Erdogan Urges Restoring Death Penalty in Violation of EU”

MP Dijkhoff asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Turkish PM Erdogan's call to restore the death penalty, whether bills were in preparation, and whether this would end EU accession talks, and asked whether he would raise it in the European Council. The minister replied that the Dutch and EU position is to abolish the death penalty worldwide, that no bills have been submitted in Turkey, and that Turkey abolished the death penalty in 2002 as a condition for accession talks, so raising it at the European Council is unnecessary.
No bills have been submitted in Turkey to reintroduce the death penalty.
In Turkije zijn er geen wetsvoorstellen ingediend om de doodstraf opnieuw in te voeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Nederland het Internationaal Strafhof in een moeilijke positie brengt

An MP asked the foreign minister about reports that Dutch host-state policy is putting the International Criminal Court in a difficult position over its housing costs, and whether the Netherlands should bear extra costs. The minister answered that the Netherlands will cover the 2012 second-half housing costs and half of 2013-2015 costs up to 9 million euro, about 12 million euro in total, while noting that housing costs are now a shared responsibility of all member states.

Moreover, the Netherlands has recently committed to also reimburse half of the temporary housing costs for the period 2013 through 2015 (completion of new construction) to the Court, up to a maximum of 9 million euro.

Bovendien heeft Nederland onlangs toegezegd ook de helft van de kosten van de tijdelijke huisvesting in de periode van 2013 tot en met 2015 (gereedkomen nieuwbouw) aan het Strafhof te vergoeden tot een bedrag van maximaal 9 miljoen euro.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over onderdrukking in China

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the crackdown on activists, black jails, internet restrictions, travel controls in Tibet and Xinjiang, and whether the government would press China for release of activists detained for their opinions. The minister confirmed restrictions on activists and rights organisations, said black jails give cause for concern raised in EU-China dialogue, and said the government raises individual cases and will do so again in the next bilateral consultations, without committing to a specific demand.
In appropriate cases, direct release is pressed for.
In voorkomende gevallen wordt aangedrongen op directe vrijlating.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de Europese Unie miljarden verspilt volgens de Europese Rekenkamer

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a report that the EU wasted billions, with an error rate of about 5 billion euro in 2011 according to the European Court of Auditors. The government answered that it is disappointed, will take a critical stance on discharge in the Ecofin Council, and seeks a much leaner EU budget with cuts of at least 100 billion euro.
The cabinet will adopt a very critical attitude when this is dealt with.
Het kabinet zal bij de behandeling hiervan een zeer kritische houding aannemen.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Dit is een klassiek voorbeeld van kinderhandel» (ingezonden 26 oktober 2012).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about press reports of child exploitation through agent-controlled youth football transfers, including long contracts and unlicensed agents, and what the KNVB and FIFA have done. The minister replied that football bodies must enforce their own rules, that the KNVB has limited reach over unlicensed agents, that disciplinary cases have often been dropped for lack of evidence, and that discussions are ongoing at EU and FIFA level.
The KNVB has informed me that it is still consulting with stakeholders, including FIFA, to amend the relevant regulations.
De KNVB heeft mij laten weten dat het nog steeds overleg voert met betrokkenen, onder meer met de FIFA, om te komen tot aanpassing van de betreffende regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over het VN-mensenrechtenexamen (Universal Periodic Review)

An MP asked the foreign minister why civil society was not consulted in time on the UPR human rights review, whether human rights education and the Optional Protocol to the ICESCR will be adopted, and whether an action plan and publicity for the UPR will follow. The minister answered that NGOs were consulted twice and submitted shadow reports, that the recommendations are a government responsibility, that the action plan is being studied, and that human rights education is covered indirectly in the curriculum while the Optional Protocol is delayed pending case law.
