Because the decision whether to accept recommendations is a government responsibility, these organisations were not consulted when preparing the government's response to the recommendations.

Omdat de afweging om aanbevelingen wel of niet aan te nemen een verantwoordelijkheid van de regering is, zijn bij de voorbereiding van de kabinetsreactie op de gedane aanbevelingen deze organisaties niet geconsulteerd.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Coenradie over het niet komen opdagen van zeker 800.000 mensen voor een afspraak in het ziekenhuis

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Health about roughly 800,000 patients missing hospital appointments and the resulting costs, and whether hospitals should collectively charge no-show fees. The Minister said no national data on no-show costs exists, that no-show policy is hospital-specific and not a national task, that hospitals may charge no-show fees under civil law, and that a collective measure would require legislation and is not desired.
No national registration is available of the number of no-shows and the resulting costs.
Er is geen landelijke registratie beschikbaar van het aantal no-shows en de daaruit voortkomende kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Brandweer en veiligheidsregio's slaan alarm over bezuiniging op rampenbestrijding: 'Onbegrijpelijk in deze tijden''

The CDA MP Boswijk asked whether a 10 percent cut to the Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR) for safety regions is responsible given geopolitical risks, and what its consequences would be for regional crisis capacity. The Minister answered that the cut follows from the coalition agreement, referred to a May 2025 letter with per-region impact figures, and said regional financial decisions will only become clear in autumn 2025, while committing to additional resilience funding without fully resolving the financing question.
The decision to cut specific grants by 10%, including the Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR), follows from the coalition agreement.
Het besluit om 10% te bezuinigen op specifieke uitkeringen, waaronder de Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR), vloeit voort uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de misstanden in de penitentiaire inrichtingen en de beloofde verbeteringen ten aanzien van de veiligheid van gedetineerde vrouwen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about abuse of detained women by prison staff, the handling of complaints and whistleblowers, medical care, and media contacts following the documentary series 'Dubbel Gestraft'. The Minister acknowledged the abuses, listed measures taken by DJI and the Inspectorate, and declined to launch a new large-scale investigation for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verder aan het licht gekomen misstanden in sektes door Undercover

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about abuses in the De Lichtfamilie sect revealed by an undercover documentary, including shunning, extortion, and claims that cancer patients are responsible for their illness, and about the status of a sect hotline and a motion on protecting people from sects. Struycken answered that the abuses are unacceptable and can be prosecuted by the OM, that the IGJ and Wkkgz/Wet BIG can act against harmful alternative care, and that a hotline pilot at Fier started in 2024 with a 2.5-year budget of €926,907, with further information promised in a letter before the summer recess.
The details of the Fier help desk will be communicated to the House in the letter on insecurity and coercive control in (closed) groups due before the summer recess.
Over de nadere vormgeving van het hulppunt bij Fier wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd in de Kamerbrief onveiligheid en dwingende controle in (gesloten) groeperingen die voor het zomerreces uitgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Van Nispen over het ondermijnen van de forensische geneeskunde door de recente aanbesteding van medische arrestantenzorg

MPs Lahlah and Van Nispen asked whether awarding all ten medical custody-care lots to one GP organisation undermines forensic medicine, and about risks to staffing, quality and the rule of law. The Minister declined to judge the provisional award, stated that custody care is distinct from forensic examination, pointed to quality and separation requirements and to the ongoing Versterking Forensische Geneeskunde programme, and noted a court procedure that may delay the final award.
The award is not yet final, as a court procedure is ongoing.
De gunning is nog niet definitief, aangezien er een procedure loopt bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Emiel van Dijk over het bericht ‘Stekende tbs’er Malek F. al eerder met onbegeleid verlof: ’Wij wisten dat hij opnieuw zou toeslaan en hebben hiervoor gewaarschuwd’

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Justice and Security why the advisory commission approved leave for a tbs patient who stabbed a man in April 2025, despite victims' warnings, and whether the leave regime should be scrapped. The government declined to discuss the individual case, said some premises in the article were incorrect, described the careful leave-assessment procedure and victim-interest considerations, and refused to abolish tbs leave.
Although I in principle do not make statements about individual cases, I wish to inform you in general that various assumptions in the article are not based on facts.
Hoewel ik in principe geen uitspraken doe over individuele casussen, hecht ik eraan u in algemeenheid erover te informeren dat verschillende aannamen in het artikel niet op feiten berust zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over geheime en onwettige detentieplaatsen in Nederland

MP Van Nispen asked the minister how an advocate was held at a secret, unlawful detention location, who ordered it, why no supervisor was informed, how many such placements occurred, and whether transparency will be guaranteed in future. The state secretary admitted the Inspectorate should have been informed, said new agreements and a supervisory commission are being set up, but withheld operational details citing security and did not give numbers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski over de capaciteit vreemdelingendetentie

Two VVD MPs asked how the government would create 50 to 100 extra immigration detention places, where they would be located, and whether this reduces prison capacity. The minister answers that 90 places will be created at Justitieel Complex Schiphol in phases (August and November 2025) and that staffing shortages may force some prison capacity offline.
We have decided to realise 90 places for immigration detention at Justitieel Complex Schiphol from 1 August 2025.
We hebben besloten om per 1 augustus 2025 90 plekken voor vreemdelingenbewaring te realiseren op het Justitieel Complex Schiphol (hierna: JCS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over onderwijs in justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the government about education in youth detention institutions (JJI's), citing Education Council and Inspectorate reports on lack of guaranteed schooling, staffing shortages, examination barriers and detained youths in adult prisons. The government acknowledges the concerns, lists funding increases and a mbo-coordinator, and promises further reactions and letters before the summer recess, though it refers many structural questions to later responses.
That there are ongoing concerns about education in the JJIs we take extremely seriously.
Dat er aanhoudende zorgen zijn over het onderwijs in de JJI's nemen wij uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de sektarische Twee aan Twee-beweging die ook in Nederland slachtoffers maakt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the Twee aan Twee movement, a closed group alleged to involve abuse and isolation of members, including in the Netherlands. The State Secretary said no police, prosecution or child protection cases were known, saw no need for independent research now, and pointed to a new Fier help and knowledge point for victims of coercive groups.
I currently see no need for independent research into this specific group.
Ik zie op dit moment geen noodzaak voor onafhankelijk onderzoek naar deze specifieke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Piri en Podt over de (beveiligde) opvang van COA-bewoners en ongedocumenteerden met ernstige psychische problemen

MPs asked the government why it appeared to downplay concerns that the Veldzicht centre would stop accepting COA residents and undocumented migrants with severe psychiatric problems, and where such people could be placed safely. The minister answered that no decisions had yet been taken, that beds for the group remain available with case-by-case assessment, that responsibility is shared across ministers, and that the group will not be left on the street, while deferring full answers until a decision on the cooperation agreement was taken.
Discussions are taking place between the parties involved to ensure it is clear under which criteria and conditions this group can be placed in the reserved beds at Veldzicht.
Er vinden gesprekken plaats tussen betrokken partijen om te borgen dat duidelijk is onder welke criteria en randvoorwaarden deze groep op de gereserveerde bedden in Veldzicht geplaatst kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Overheid verzwijgt informatie over advocatenneef Taghi, AD stapt naar de rechter’

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether earlier information about lawyer Youssef T., nephew of Ridouan Taghi, was withheld, why access to the EBI was not refused sooner, and why AD had to go to court under the Open Government Act. The state secretary refers to earlier answers, says the denial of access was based on signs of misuse of his privileged position and lifted once the bar dean found no evidence, denies obstruction of journalists, and declines to discuss the pending court case.
Since this is an ongoing procedure, I cannot go into the substance of it.
Nu dit een lopende procedure betreft kan ik hier niet inhoudelijk op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Britse overheid wil vrouwenhaat aanpakken als ‘ideologisch extremisme’’

MP Becker asked the government about the UK's plan to treat misogyny as ideological extremism, and whether the Netherlands should follow with a stronger approach to misogyny, incels and manosphere influencers. The government answers that misogyny is a serious problem covered by existing plans and laws, that it is not classed as an extremist ideology but appears in extremist narratives, and that it will consult the UK and include misogyny in the forthcoming Emancipation Note.
The cabinet therefore does not regard misogyny as an extremist ideology, but it does appear as part of the narrative within various extremist and terrorist ideologies.

Vrouwenhaat wordt door het kabinet daarom niet gezien als een extremistische ideologie, maar komt wel terug als onderdeel in het narratief bij verschillende extremistische en terroristische ideologieën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Stekende tbs’er al eerder met onbegeleid verlof'

MPs Van Eijk and Rajkowski asked about a stabbing by a tbs patient who had earlier been granted unaccompanied leave, victims' speaking rights, and the legal basis for leave for unlawfully present foreigners in tbs. The Secretary of State answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined the victim-notification and speaking-right arrangements, and acknowledged the tension between migration and criminal law, promising talks with the Minister of Asylum and Migration.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de Commissies van Toezicht in de gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about transparency, appointment procedures, annual reports, handling of complaints, and unimplemented 2009 recommendations concerning the prison Commissies van Toezicht. The state secretary answered that the commissions are independent, that appointment decisions were published anonymously after a FOI request, that annual reports are only received and not assessed by the ministry, and that a follow-up inspection is at the Inspectorate's discretion.
For the sake of the privacy of individual CvT members, however, no access can be given to individual appointment decisions traceable to persons.
Omwille van de privacy van de individuele CvT-leden kan echter geen inzage worden gegeven in individuele, tot personen herleidbare benoemingsbesluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, van Nispen, Boswijk, Koops en Bruyning over het uitblijven van investeringen voor het gevangeniswezen

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 2025 spring budget omitted funds for prisons, whether the 23 million euro withdrawal from DJI's equity amounts to a cut, and what the consequences are for staff, early release, unexecuted sentences and pardon requests. The State Secretary confirmed no extra funds were allocated, explained the withdrawal as a legal requirement used to cover other justice costs, and warned of a growing capacity shortfall of around 800 places by 2030, while answering the timing question late.
Without additional investments I cannot realise structural capacity expansions and many necessary renovations cannot be carried out.
Zonder aanvullende investeringen kan ik geen structurele capaciteitsuitbreidingen realiseren en kunnen veel van de noodzakelijke renovaties niet uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zichtbaarheid van huiselijk geweld in het familierecht

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about a Verwey-Jonker report finding that domestic violence is rarely considered in family law decisions on custody and access, and about risk-screening tools, training, and a pending motion on a assessment framework. The government acknowledges the research, promises a policy response to the Chamber before summer, and defers substantive answers on the report's recommendations and the motion to that letter.
We will also inform the Chamber in this letter about what follow-up we will give to the findings of the research.
Wij zullen de Kamer in deze brief ook informeren over welk gevolg wij zullen geven aan de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over Holocausteducatie

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Holocaust education has not yet become a fixed part of civic integration (inburgering), including whether newcomers should visit sites like the National Holocaust Museum, and when a proposal would follow. The State Secretary answered that Holocaust knowledge is now an explicit part of the integration exam from 1 July 2025, that a feasibility study on museum visits and a teacher survey are underway, and that the Chamber will be informed in the third quarter of 2025.
I expect to inform the Chamber further in the third quarter of 2025 on strengthening Holocaust education in civic integration and the next steps.
Ik verwacht de Kamer in het derde kwartaal van 2025 verder te informeren over het versterken van Holocausteducatie in de inburgering en de vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de vrees van gevangenispersoneel voor meerpersoonscellen

MP Lahlah asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about prison staff fears over multi-person cells, incidents, staff shortages, sick leave, leave policy and capacity. The State Secretary answers that staff safety and inmate safety remain guaranteed, that extra multi-person cells will be created only where staffing and buildings allow, and that measures on capacity (including sentencing reform and capacity leave) are being pursued.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Afgesproken normen in zedenzaken niet gehaald’

MPs Van der Werf and Mutluer asked why agreed time-limit norms for sex-offence cases were again not met, and what the government will do about longer processing times, reduced victim willingness to report, understaffing and prioritisation. Minister Van Weel answered that some processing times slightly improved in 2024, that the action plan is extended to end 2025, that staffing shortfalls and new Sexual Offences Act capacity are being addressed, and that no additional measures are planned for now.

None of the trajectories meets the target norm, but the general picture is that the criminal justice chain organisations managed to handle more older cases and reduce backlogs without processing times increasing.

Op geen van de trajecten wordt de streefnorm gehaald, maar het algemene beeld is dat het de organisaties in de strafrechtketen is gelukt om meer oudere zaken af te handelen en de voorraden te verminderen zonder dat de doorlooptijden zijn opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf en Mutluer over de stand van zaken van de aanpak van femicide

MPs Becker, Van der Werf and Mutluer asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the progress of the femicide action plan, including implementation steps, criminalising psychological violence, a 24/7 reporting point, funding, police training, the EU rape-centre directive, stalking, police case coordination, and children's contact with perpetrators after partner killings. The government answered that much detail will follow in a June 2025 progress letter, gave timelines for the bill on psychological violence and the EU directive (delayed to early 2026), described how the 10 million euro is being spent, and defended the existing legal framework on contact after partner killings.
I cannot currently indicate point by point in detail how the implementation of the femicide action plan stands.
Ik kan op dit moment niet per punt in detail aangeven hoe het staat met de implementatie van het plan van aanpak «Stop femicide!».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over de onrust na het dodelijke steekincident op 2 januari in Den Dolder

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether the 2017 promise that the Fivoor clinic would leave Den Dolder by 2025 would be honoured, and what options exist to relocate Fivoor or restore residents' sense of safety. The state secretaries answered that no formal promise on a departure date was made, that they lack the competence to order a relocation or an admission stop, and that they will explore use of Rijksvastgoed and continue talks with the municipality.
No formal commitment was made by the Minister for Legal Protection regarding the departure date of the Fivoor clinics from Den Dolder.
Er is door de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen formele toezegging gedaan over de vertrekdatum voor de klinieken voor de klinieken van Fivoor uit Den Dolder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de onrust na het dodelijke steekincident in Den Dolder

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the unrest after a fatal stabbing in Den Dolder, the promised relocation of the Fivoor forensic clinic by 2025 or 2027, and whether the clinic will close. The government answers that it has no power to force a relocation or closure, that the 2025 date was an intention by the owner and not a promise by the minister, and that it will explore support such as Rijksvastgoed for a move.
It is not for the Minister to close the clinic or to steer towards a timeline for the intended departure.
Het is niet aan de Minister om de kliniek te sluiten of aan te sturen op een tijdspad richting het voorgenomen vertrek.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Bruyning over het bericht ‘Alarmerende stijging aantal jongeren in gevangenis voor volwassenen: ‘Onwenselijk’'

MP Bruyning asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the rise in young people, many of them pretrial detainees, held in adult prisons because of a shortage of youth detention places, and what would be done about it. The State Secretary confirmed the rise (29 to 308 between 2022 and 2024), attributed it to lack of cell and staff capacity, agreed with the Inspectorate that the situation is undesirable, and promised capacity expansions and a further update in March.
I agree with the Inspectorate that this is an undesirable situation.
Ik ben het met de Inspectie eens dat dit een onwenselijke situatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thiadens en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht inzake de aanhouding van de 27-jarige verdachte voor de moord op een 76-jarige vrouw in Den Dolder

MPs Thiadens and Emiel van Dijk (PVV) asked about the fatal stabbing of a 76-year-old woman in Den Dolder by a 27-year-old patient on leave from a clinic, questioning who authorised the leave, the risk assessment, and safety measures. The state secretaries largely declined to answer on the specific case pending an Inspectorate investigation, pointed to the provider Fivoor's responsibility, and described general measures and a planned relocation.
Pending this investigation, we cannot address questions about this specific incident.
In afwachting van dit onderzoek kunnen we niet ingaan op vragen over dit specifieke incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over drones die boven de PI Vught vliegen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why drones were able to fly over the high-security Vught prison for an extended period despite a no-fly zone, and why they were not shot down, asking about detection, counter-drone powers and detection of operators. The State Secretary answered that drones were detected, the operators are being sought, the airspace closure is being made permanent via the Minister of Infrastructure, DJI lacks power to neutralise drones and options are being explored with results to Parliament after the summer, and a planned budget is being allocated to counter drones.
I would like to see DJI able to take these drones out of the air. I am currently exploring the (legal) possibility of this.
Ik zou graag zien dat DJI deze drones uit de lucht kan halen. Ik verken momenteel de (juridische) mogelijkheid daartoe.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Becker over het bericht ‘Groot gebrek aan noodbedden voor vrouwen die vluchten voor gewelddadige partner: noodgedwongen opgevangen in hotels en vakantieparken’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the state secretaries about a reported shortage of emergency beds for women fleeing violent partners and how many beds are needed under the Istanbul Convention. The minister acknowledged the shortage but said no complete picture exists, pointed to a monitor due in spring 2025, and placed primary responsibility with municipalities, declining to re-index the grant specifically for the 35 centre municipalities.
There is currently no complete picture of the distribution of available emergency beds or of the shortage.
Er is op dit moment geen compleet beeld van verdeling van het aantal beschikbare noodbedden en over het tekort hieraan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het bericht ’Kabinet: gevangenissen vol, gedetineerden drie dagen eerder vrij’

The MP Bruyning asked whether prisoners are released three days early while only some offenders are excluded, whether a priority ranking applies by offence type, and whether weekly reporting is possible. The State Secretary confirmed the early release of three days for end-of-sentence prisoners at certain regimes due to prison overcrowding, stated no ranking by offence type is used, and offered quarterly capacity reports rather than weekly letters.
At the Chamber's request, a quarterly progress report on capacity is sent every three months.
Op verzoek van de Kamer wordt elke drie maanden een voortgangsrapportage over capaciteit gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over Mohammed B. die een boek heeft geschreven in de gevangenis

An MP asked the State Secretary whether it is appropriate for a prison director to have a handwritten book by a detained terrorist sent by courier to ministers and MPs, and how the prison service controls the texts of detainees in terrorist wings. The State Secretary answered that privileged post may not be refused, that all correspondence of terrorist-wing detainees except privileged contacts is screened and may be refused for security reasons, and declined to comment on the individual case.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de status van zelfmelder en het risico op willekeur

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the self-surrender (zelfmelder) system is growing arbitrary, with similar cases treated differently, and whether CJIB should adopt objective protocols. The State Secretary rejects the charge of arbitrariness, stresses individual assessment within the Regeling USB, announces extra detention places and a prioritised call-up scheme, and promises an analysis of the self-surrender policy by Q1 2025.
The aim is to complete this analysis in the first quarter of 2025.
Het streven is deze analyse in het eerste kwartaal 2025 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het contact dat Faissal T. mag hebben in de EBI

MP Ellian asks whether Faissal Taghi has been placed in a group with contact rights in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting, who decided it, and how the Taghi-group ban in the Ellian motion is implemented. The Secretary of State declines to discuss individual cases, describes the general placement procedure, says the directorate reviews group compositions periodically and was re-examined after the motion, and points to a confidential technical briefing for numbers.
I will not go into the situation of individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie van individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Lahlah over de omgang met het parlement en de problemen in het gevangeniswezen

MPs Van Nispen and Lahlah asked whether a PVV motion on prison clothing was coordinated with the state secretary and whether the government is serious about parliament and prison staff concerns. The state secretary denied any pre-arranged contact or media plan, said plans to restrict branded clothing predate the motion, and said he takes parliament and staff seriously.
There was no contact between the PVV MP and me before the two-minute debate regarding the motion submitted by the PVV MP, other than the usual sounding out by my political assistant.

Er is geen sprake geweest van contact tussen het PVV-Kamerlid en mij voorafgaand aan het tweeminutendebat ten aanzien van de door het PVV-Kamerlid ingediende motie, anders dan de gebruikelijke sondering door mijn politiek assistent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over zelfmelders

An MP asks the State Secretary about self-reporting (zelfmelders) prisoners, the backlog of unserved sentences, early releases, not pursuing short-sentence arrestees, transfers of tbs patients, and how these measures fit the coalition agreement's call for harsher sentences. The government answers that capacity pressure forces prioritisation and sober-regime measures, while stating it will keep seeking capacity solutions and pilot reduced daytime programmes.
Addressing the capacity problem has the highest priority for me.
Het aanpakken van de capaciteitsproblematiek heeft voor mij de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de nog uit te werken plannen om het capaciteitstekort in het gevangeniswezen op te lossen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the capacity shortage in prisons, including the number of self-reporters, the placement of prisoners in lower-security settings and abroad, and the alternatives considered. The State Secretary gave detailed answers, stating that the offender-level data on serious violence and sex offences are not available, that 44 prisoners have used capacity leave, and that exploratory talks with Estonia on renting cells are ongoing.
These figures are not available at the requested level, mainly because "serious" is a qualification that is insufficiently defined to be recorded in systems.
Deze cijfers zijn niet op het gevraagde niveau beschikbaar, met name omdat «ernstig» een kwalificatie betreft die onvoldoende gedefinieerd is om in systemen vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de overwegingen van het kabinet om Nederlandse gedetineerden naar Estland te sturen

Two MPs (Van Nispen and Ellian) asked the State Secretary about the government's plan to send Dutch prisoners to Estland because of a cell shortage. The State Secretary confirmed an exploratory process, said Estonia is currently the only European country known to have surplus capacity, and promised that Parliament will be informed of the outcome before any irreversible steps are taken.
Your House will be informed of the outcome of the exploration.
Uw Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de situatie in de Oostvaarderskliniek

MP Ellian asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about repeated staff-patient relationships, the implementation of recommendations from a critical external report, supervision of the Oostvaarderskliniek and staff reporting channels. The State Secretary answered that relationships are not allowed, listed a verbeterplan with measures, said DJI and the inspectorates monitor implementation and will publish findings later, and pointed to internal and external reporting channels.
The inspectorates are currently analysing the information gathered. They will publish their findings at a later point and I will share the report with your House.
De inspecties zijn op dit moment bezig de opgehaalde informatie te analyseren. Zij zullen hun bevindingen op een later moment publiceren en ik zal het rapport met uw Kamer delen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de bezetting, capaciteit en spreiding in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting

An MP asked the State Secretary about the occupancy, capacity and spreading of detainees in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI), including whether criminal leaders and relatives can be kept apart. The government answered that separation and compartmentalisation are currently possible, that capacity will be expanded from 24 to 60 places by 2030, and that the Vught expansion is targeted for completion by end 2026.
It is currently entirely possible to compartmentalise within the EBI and to spread detainees.
Het is op dit moment goed mogelijk binnen de EBI te compartimenteren en gedetineerden te spreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Groeiend verzet tegen vrij rond laten lopen van veroordeelden: 'Onaanvaardbaar''

An MP from JA21 asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the roughly 2,000 convicted persons (zelfmelders) who remain free while waiting to serve their sentences due to prison capacity shortages, and about measures such as multi-person cells, reuse of empty buildings, rehiring former staff and community service. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, says it is a priority, reports ongoing efforts and promises a progress letter by end of September, but rejects several proposals as infeasible.
I inform the House about the current figures and developments every three months.
Over het actuele cijferbeeld en ontwikkelingen informeer ik uw Kamer iedere drie maanden.
